Spring 1904: all units hold per promises to France, Russia, England (no Burgundy/Picardy/Tyrolia/Silesia/Bohemia moves yet). No unowned SCs remain. Plan: split Austria with Russia (Galicia/Rumania for Russia, Silesia/Bohemia for me) once Austria weakens; confirm in Fall. Italy says no threat. Kept so far: all.

Spring 1904: all units hold to keep pacts with Austria (no Galicia/Rumania), Turkey (no Armenia/Ankara/CON), Germany (no Prussia/Berlin), England (no Norway/North Sea). All powers have said they will keep terms. No unowned centers. Next: test whether Austria/Turkey keep terms; consider F SWE to BAL for convoy of A LVN to Denmark/Berlin if Germany stays quiet.

Spring 1904: all 5 French SCs owned, no unowned centers. Holding peace with Germany, England, Italy; no clear opening to take BEL or other SCs without breaking deals. Germany is leading at 6; watch for German moves on BUR/PAR and England's fleets near BRE. Reconsider attacking BEL if Germany weakens.

Spring 1904: pacts hold with Austria, France, Turkey, Germany. F ION to AEG and F TYS to ION prepare Greece/Balkan options; no Greece entry yet. Watch Turkey on GRE and France on PIE. Consider A TUN convoy to GRE later if Turkey weakens.

Spring 1904: all units hold. Peace with France, Germany, Russia. Russia's F NOR promise to leave Norway unverified; this is my unit in NOR, so Norway is mine. Watch Russia's Baltic fleets and German moves near DEN/BEL/HOL. Consider convoy strikes only if a German unit leaves or a deal breaks.

Spring 1904: all hold as promised to Austria and Russia (no moves into SER/RUM/BUL/ARM/SEV). No unowned centers. Austria and Russia have kept their pacts so far. Reconsider a Balkan or Armenia move in Fall only if they break faith. Italy has kept Ionian/Adriatic quiet.

messages.body: Austria here. Fall 1904: I'm holding RUM, SER and BUD and will not enter Bulgaria or Greece. Please keep F BLA out of Rumania and Serbia. Are your fleets and armies staying in the south this autumn, or are you planning a move north toward Rumania or Russia? Tell me before you act.

Austria here. Our Galicia and Ukraine line holds this Fall: A RUM, A BUD and A VIE stay put. Please keep F SEV, A WAR and A LVN out of Rumania and Galicia. Are you planning any move west toward Prussia or Silesia, or into Sweden against us? I'd like to hear your intentions first.

Austria confirms: F TRI stays out of ADR and ALB this Fall, and A VEN will not enter Tyrolia, Trieste or Vienna. Please keep F ION out of the Adriatic and Albania. What are your plans for Greece and Tunis this autumn? Tell me before you change anything near Serbia.

England here. F NOR is mine and stays. Russia's F SWE and A WAR/A LVN must stay out of Norway, the North Sea and Edinburgh. I'll keep NTH and NWG out of Sweden and the Baltic. Tell me your Fall orders for Sweden, Livonia and Warsaw so we both know where we stand.

England here. Our understanding still holds: my fleets stay out of Belgium, Denmark and Kiel, and yours out of Norway, the North Sea and the British Isles. Are F BEL, A DEN or A KIE moving this autumn? I'd like to hear any change before it happens.

England here. F LON and F NTH stay out of the Channel, Brest, Picardy and Belgium this autumn, as agreed. Please keep F MAO away from English waters and LVP/EDI. I'm holding my units in place and will tell you before any change.

France here. Germany is leading the centre count, so I want to be sure we stay clear of each other. Your units hold this fall and mine stay out of Belgium and Munich. Please give me notice before any move toward Burgundy or Picardy, and I will do the same.

France here. My A MAR, A BUR, A PAR and A POR hold this fall, with none entering Piedmont. Please keep F TYS, F ION and A VEN out of the western Mediterranean and Spain. If you plan any move against Austria or Turkey, tell me first so we can coordinate.

Germany here. This Fall I hold MUN, BER, KIE, DEN and BEL with no moves toward Prussia, Warsaw or Sweden. Please confirm your Fall moves for WAR, LVN and MOS. I propose we agree now that Russia takes Galicia and Rumania and Germany takes Silesia and Bohemia, starting in 1905 when I can move.

Germany here. I am holding Munich and Berlin this Fall. Austria's southern and Balkan units seem committed to Serbia and Rumania, so I would like F TRI and VIE to stay off Bohemia and Munich. Are you planning any move against Italy or Russia this year?

Italy to Turkey: Please confirm your Spring 1904 orders, especially A GRE and F BLA. I am holding F ION and F AEG in the Ionian and Aegean, and will not enter Greece. I would rather see us both grow at Russia's expense than fight each other. Will you agree to keep A GRE out of the Ionian and Adriatic?

Italy to Russia: We have not spoken yet. I hold NAP, ROM, TUN and VEN and want no war with you. I have no units near Russian territory. What are your intentions this year, and would you keep your southern fleets out of the Black Sea and Mediterranean while I focus on the west and Balkans?

Italy to Austria: Our pact still holds. A VEN and F ION stay out of Trieste, Tyrolia, Vienna, the Adriatic and Albania. Are A SER and A RUM moving toward Greece or Bulgaria this Fall? Please tell me before any Balkan move, as we agreed.

Russia here. This Fall I hold A WAR, A LVN, A MOS, F SEV and F SWE, with no move toward Prussia, Berlin, Denmark or Kiel. Your Silesia and Bohemia idea is noted. Once Austria's Galicia is open, I will tell you before I move on it, so we can agree a clear split.

Russia here. Our Galicia and Rumania line still stands this Fall: A WAR, A LVN and F SEV hold. Please keep A RUM, A BUD and A VIE out of Galicia and Ukraine. Tell me now what A SER and F TRI do this autumn so neither of us is surprised in the Balkans.

Russia here. This Fall A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SEV hold, and none enters Armenia, Ankara, Constantinople or Rumania. F SWE stays in the Baltic. Please confirm that A GRE and A CON will not move into Bulgaria or Serbia without telling me first.

Turkey to Russia: Austria is the obstacle to both of us. Let's coordinate: you press Galicia and Bohemia, and I will strike Serbia and Rumania when the moment is right, with F BLA covering the Black Sea. Rumania could go to you and Serbia to me. Confirm F SEV stays off Rumania until then, and tell me your Fall 1904 orders.

Turkey to Austria: Our Balkan line has held, but your Russian front looks stretched. I hold Greece, Bulgaria and Smyrna and have no moves into Serbia or Rumania this Fall. Tell me your Fall 1904 orders for SER, RUM and BUD, and whether any Galicia move threatens me.

Austria here. This Fall A VIE, F TRI, A BUD, A RUM and A SER all hold. We have no moves toward Bohemia or Munich and no plans against Italy or Russia this year. Please keep your units out of Silesia and Bohemia, and tell me if your plans change.

Austria confirms: F TRI stays out of ADR and ALB this Fall, and A VEN will not enter Tyrolia, Trieste or Vienna. A SER and A RUM hold and make no move toward Greece or Bulgaria this Fall. Please keep F ION out of the Adriatic and Albania, and tell me before any change in the Ionian.

Austria here. A RUM, A BUD and A VIE hold this Fall and will not enter Galicia or Ukraine. We have no plans toward Sweden or Prussia. Please keep F SEV, A WAR and A LVN out of Rumania and Galicia, and tell me first if your western plans change.

Austria here. This Fall A SER, A RUM and A BUD hold. We will not enter Bulgaria or Greece, and F TRI stays out of the Adriatic and Albania. Please keep F BLA out of Rumania and Serbia, and tell me before any move toward Galicia or Rumania.

France here. Confirmed: F MAO stays in the Atlantic and will not enter the Channel, English waters, LVP or EDI this autumn. Brest is empty and I will not move into Brest, Picardy or Belgium. Please keep your fleets out of the Channel and off my coast, and tell me before any change to your North Sea plans.

Germany here. Confirmed: this Fall MUN, BER, KIE, DEN and BEL all hold. I have no orders toward Burgundy, Picardy, Belgium's neighbours or Tyrolia. I'll give you notice before any change near your border. Please keep A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and F BRE out of Belgium and Munich as agreed.

Germany here. This Fall my units hold: MUN, BER, KIE, DEN, BEL. None enters Prussia, Warsaw, Sweden or Livonia. Your Galicia and Rumania claim is acceptable to me, and I'll discuss Silesia and Bohemia once Austria is weakened. Please confirm your Fall orders for WAR, LVN, MOS and SWE in writing.

Germany here. This Fall F BEL, A DEN and A KIE all hold, with no movement toward the North Sea, Norway, Edinburgh or Yorkshire. Please keep NTH, NWG and NOR out of Belgium, Denmark and Kiel as agreed. I'll tell you before any change of course near your coast.

Italy here. Our pact holds this Fall. F TRI stays out of ADR and ALB, and A VEN stays out of Tyrolia, Trieste and Vienna. F ION will not enter the Adriatic or Albania. I have no plans to move against Austria. I have no orders for A SER or A RUM, so I cannot confirm their Greek or Bulgarian moves. I will tell you before any change near the Balkans.

Italy to France: Confirmed. A VEN holds and will not enter Piedmont or Tyrolia. F ION and F AEG stay out of the Gulf of Lyon, the western Mediterranean and the Spanish coast. I have no plans against France. Please keep A MAR and A BUR out of Piedmont and Venice-adjacent space as agreed, and tell me before any Iberian move toward the Italian coast.

Russia here. This Fall A WAR, A LVN and F SEV hold, and none enters Galicia, Rumania or Ukraine. Our line stands. I have no move against Trieste or Serbia from my side. Please keep A RUM, A BUD and A VIE out of Galicia and Ukraine as agreed.

Russia here. This Fall A WAR, A LVN, A MOS, F SEV and F SWE all hold. I have no fleets heading to the Mediterranean or toward Tunis or Naples. Let's both focus on our own sectors and keep the peace while we grow.

Russia here. This Fall A WAR, A LVN and A MOS hold, with no move toward Prussia, Berlin, Denmark or Kiel. Your Silesia and Bohemia idea is noted. We can settle the split once Galicia is open, and I will tell you before I act there.
Russia here. F SWE stays in Sweden this Fall and no Russian fleet moves to Norway, the North Sea, NWG or Edinburgh. Norway is yours. Please keep F NTH and F NWG out of the Baltic and Sweden as well.

Russia here. This Fall A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SEV hold, with none entering Armenia, Ankara, Constantinople or Rumania. F SEV stays off Rumania this autumn. I will not commit to a Balkan plan yet, but I will tell you before any change in the south.

Turkey here. Fall 1904: A ANK, A CON, A GRE, A SMY and F BLA all hold, so no move into Serbia or Rumania this turn. F BLA stays out of Rumania and Serbia as you asked. Please confirm your SER, RUM and BUD orders, and tell me before any Galicia move that could touch my borders.

Turkey here. This Fall A GRE holds in Greece and will not move to the Ionian or Adriatic. I have no fleet in the Ionian and no plans against Venice or Apulia. Your F ION stays out of Greece and Smyrna, and we both keep to our agreement. Tunis remains yours.

Turkey here. This Fall A ANK, A CON, A GRE, A SMY and F BLA hold, and none moves into Bulgaria or Serbia. F BLA stays off Sevastopol and Rumania. Any move by A GRE or A CON into Bulgaria or Serbia will be announced to you first. Keep A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SEV out of Armenia and Ankara.

notes.note: Fall 1904: holding all units. Peace kept with France (MAO stays Atlantic), Germany (BEL/DEN/KIE hold), Russia (F SWE stays, Norway ours). No unowned centers reachable without breaking deals. Next: watch Russia's SWE/WAR/LVN and Germany's BEL/DEN; consider convoy into DEN/BEL if Germany leaves them empty.

Fall 1904: all 5 French SCs owned, none unowned. Peace kept with England, Italy, Germany (no one has broken terms). Holding to keep centers. Consider taking BEL only if Germany is drawn into war with Austria/Russia. Watch German MUN/BEL and Italian moves toward Piedmont.

Fall 1904: holding all units to keep pacts with Austria (no Galicia/Rumania), Turkey (no Armenia/Ankara/CON), Germany (no Prussia/Berlin), England (no Norway/NTH). All have kept terms so far. No unowned centers. Plan: reassess in 1905 for Galicia/Silesia gains once an opening appears; tell partners before any move. Watch Austria at RUM/GAL.

Fall 1904: holding all units to keep deals with France, Russia, England, Austria. Plan: after Russia secures Galicia, take Silesia/Bohemia in 1905 and attack Russian SWE/WAR if Russia breaks faith. No unowned SCs remain. Watch France on BUR/PIC and Russia on PRU/WAR.

Fall 1904: holding all five to keep pacts with Turkey, Russia, Italy, Germany. No unowned centers. BUL is empty and Turkey-owned; a move there breaks my word to Turkey and invites retaliation from GRE/CON/BLA. Revisit if Turkey moves its southern army away. Watch F BLA, F SEV, Italy's F ION.

Fall 1904: all hold, keeping pacts with Austria, Russia and Italy. No unowned SCs. Austria and Russia have kept word so far. Italy wants Greece/Ionian quiet. Revisit a Balkan strike on SER/RUM only if Austria or Russia breaks faith.

Fall 1904: Attacking Greece (A TUN convoyed by F ION to GRE, F AEG supports). Breaks Turkey pact; Turkey has no quick reinforcement. Keep VEN holding; keep pacts with Austria and France (no Piedmont/Venice/Tyrrhenian moves). Tunis left empty; watch French F MAO via NAF. Next: reconsider Balkan moves depending on Turkey's response.

messages.body: Austria here. Spring 1905: I'm holding SER, RUM, BUD, TRI and VIE. Our pact stands: F TRI stays out of ADR and ALB, and we don't touch VEN. Please confirm A GRE and F ION stay out of Albania, the Adriatic and Bulgaria this spring, and tell me before any change near Serbia.

Austria here. Our Galicia and Rumania line still stands this Spring: A RUM, A BUD and A VIE hold and won't enter Galicia or Ukraine. Please confirm F SEV, A WAR and A LVN stay out of Rumania and Galicia. Tell me first if your plans toward Sweden or Prussia change.

Austria here. I see Turkey lost SMY. Spring 1905: A SER, A RUM and A BUD hold, and we won't enter Bulgaria or Greece. Please keep F BLA out of Rumania and Serbia, and A BUL out of Serbia. What are your plans for the Aegean and Smyrna this year?

England here. Norway is ours and F NOR is still gone from the North Sea, which I appreciate. Your F SWE and A WAR/A LVN must stay out of NOR, NWG, NTH and EDI this Spring. Confirm your Spring 1905 orders for Sweden, Livonia and Warsaw so we both know where we stand.

France here. Our borders have held peacefully. Your units hold this spring and mine stay out of Belgium and Munich. Germany is leading the centre count, so I want to hear your plans against Austria or Russia before any move near Burgundy or Picardy. I'll give you the same notice before I move.

France here. A MAR, A BUR, A PAR and A POR will stay out of Piedmont and the Italian coast this spring. Please keep F TYS, F ION and F AEG out of the Gulf of Lyon and the Spanish coast. If you plan any move against Austria or Turkey, tell me first so we can coordinate.

Germany here. Spring 1905: I hold MUN, BER, KIE, DEN and BEL, and none enters Prussia, Warsaw or Sweden. Please confirm in writing that A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SWE stay out of Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel this spring. Galicia and Rumania are yours. Silesia and Bohemia wait until Austria is weakened and we agree the timing.

Germany here. Our Serbia and Rumania understanding has held. I am still holding MUN and BER. Before I consider any move toward Silesia or Bohemia, I need to know whether A VIE, F TRI and A BUD stay out of Bohemia and Tyrolia this spring. Please confirm your Spring 1905 orders in writing.

Italy to Turkey: I took Greece in Fall 1904 with A TUN convoyed by F ION, and I know that broke our pact. I am willing to settle the border. Turkey keeps Bulgaria, Constantinople and Smyrna, and Italy keeps Greece and the Ionian. Will you accept this, and will A BUL and F BLA stay out of Greece and the Aegean?

Italy to Austria: I hold Greece now, so I have no plans to move north. Please confirm A SER and A RUM stay out of Greece and Albania this Spring, and that F TRI stays out of the Adriatic. I will keep A VEN and F ION out of Trieste, Tyrolia and Vienna. What are your Spring 1905 plans?

Russia here. Spring 1905: I propose we keep the Galicia and Rumania line one more season. Before I move on Galicia, tell me your plans for Trieste, Serbia and Vienna, and whether A RUM or A BUD plans anything toward Ukraine or Galicia this year.

Russia here. Spring 1905: my A WAR and A LVN stay out of Prussia, Berlin and Denmark while Austria stays intact. What are your Spring moves toward Silesia and Bohemia? Tell me before you enter Silesia so we keep our agreement clear.
Russia here. Spring 1905: F SEV and A MOS hold and stay out of Rumania, Armenia and Ankara. Tell me your Spring plans for A GRE, A BUL and A CON, and whether Serbia is your target this year.

Turkey to Italy: Greece is listed as yours and A GRE is in it. I am at only four centers and need growth. Will you pull A GRE back toward Albania or the Ionian this Spring, and let my A BUL stay put? In return my fleets stay out of the Adriatic and Ionian. Tell me your orders.

Turkey to Russia: Our Armenia and Ankara peace has held. Sevastopol sits on our Black Sea border and F BLA is in place. Would you keep F SEV and A MOS out of Armenia and Ankara, and consider a non-aggression line in the Black Sea? Tell me your Spring 1905 orders before you move south.

Austria confirms Spring 1905 orders in writing: A VIE, F TRI, A BUD, A RUM and A SER all hold. None moves into Bohemia, Tyrolia, Silesia or Munich. We expect the same from your MUN and BER and from any unit near Silesia.

Austria confirms: A RUM, A BUD and A VIE hold this Spring and will not enter Galicia or Ukraine. Please keep F SEV, A WAR and A LVN out of Rumania and Galicia as agreed. Tell me first if your moves toward Sweden or Prussia change.

Austria confirms: A SER and A RUM hold this Spring and stay out of Greece and Albania. F TRI stays out of the Adriatic and Albania. Please keep A VEN and F ION out of Trieste, Tyrolia and Vienna, and tell me before any change in the Ionian or Balkans.

Germany here. Spring 1905: F BEL, A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN all hold, with no move toward Burgundy, Picardy or Belgium's neighbours. I'm focused on Austria and Russia, as agreed. Please keep A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and F BRE out of Belgium and Munich. I'll give you notice before any change near your border.

Germany here. Spring 1905: A MUN moves to Silesia, which is not Austrian-owned, and I'm moving toward Bohemia only once Austria weakens. A BER, A KIE, A DEN and F BEL hold. I will not enter Prussia, Warsaw, Livonia or Sweden. Galicia and Rumania are yours. Please keep A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SWE off Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel.

Italy to Turkey: Greece stays Italian and A GRE will hold there this Spring. I will not pull back. I have no plans for Bulgaria or Smyrna. Keep A BUL and F BLA out of Greece and the Aegean, and we can both grow at Russia's expense. I can keep F ION out of your Aegean coast.

Italy to Austria: Confirmed. A GRE holds this Spring, and F ION will not enter the Adriatic or Albania. A VEN stays out of Tyrolia, Trieste and Vienna. Please keep F TRI out of ADR and ALB, and keep A SER and A RUM out of Greece and Albania. Tell me before any Balkan change.

Italy to France: Confirmed. A VEN holds, and F ION and F AEG stay out of the Gulf of Lyon, the western Mediterranean and the Spanish coast this Spring. I have no plans against France. Please keep A MAR, A BUR, A PAR and A POR out of Piedmont and the Italian coast. Tell me if your Iberian plans change.

Russia here. Spring 1905: F SWE holds in Sweden, and no Russian fleet enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI. A WAR and A LVN stay out of Norway. Please keep F NTH and F NWG out of the Baltic and Sweden in return, and tell me your Spring orders.

Russia here. This Spring A WAR and A LVN hold, and none enters Prussia, Berlin or Denmark while Austria stands. F SWE stays in the Baltic. Silesia and Bohemia are worth discussing only once Austria is clearly weakened. Let's keep our agreement clean until then.

Russia here. This Spring A WAR, A LVN and F SEV hold and make no move into Galicia, Rumania or Ukraine. Please keep your A RUM, A BUD and A VIE out of Ukraine as well. I will tell you before any change in the south or west.

Russia here. Agreed: this Spring A MOS and F SEV hold and stay out of Armenia, Ankara, Constantinople and Rumania. I'm open to a Black Sea line while Austria is the common problem. Please keep F BLA off Sevastopol and tell me before A GRE or A CON moves toward Serbia.

Turkey accepts your border: Greece and the Ionian to Italy, Bulgaria, Constantinople and Smyrna to Turkey. A BUL stays in Bulgaria and F BLA stays out of the Aegean and Ionian. Keep A GRE out of Bulgaria and Smyrna, and we will have no quarrel. Confirm your Spring orders for GRE and ION.

Turkey agrees to a Black Sea non-aggression line. Keep A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SEV out of Armenia, Ankara and Constantinople, and F SEV off Rumania. I will keep F BLA off Sevastopol and Rumania. Confirm this Spring, and tell me before any move toward Armenia.

Turkey here. Smyrna was lost to a winter disbanding, not to an attack, and I am rebuilding my position in the Aegean. I have no plan against Serbia or Rumania this year. Keep your SER, RUM and BUD where they are, and keep A BUL out of Serbia on your side. Tell me if Galicia changes.

notes.note: Spring 1905: holding all five per Russia, Turkey, Italy and Germany pacts. No unowned centers reachable. Watch Turkey's BUL and GRE, Russia's SEV and WAR, Italy's ION and VEN. Revisit if a pact breaks or Turkey's southern army leaves BUL.

Spring 1905: holding all units to honor pacts with Austria (no Galicia/Rumania/Ukraine), Turkey (no Armenia/Ankara/CON/Rumania), Germany (no Prussia/Berlin/Denmark), England (no Norway/NTH). All have kept terms so far. Next: F SWE to BAL to set up convoy of A LVN west; reassess Galicia if Austria weakens or breaks pact; tell partners first.

Spring 1905: MUN to SIL as told to Russia; BEL, BER, DEN, KIE hold. Russia, France, Austria all confirmed holds. Plan: Galicia/Rumania to Russia, Bohemia/Silesia to me once Austria weakens. Watch Russia on WAR/PRU and France on BUR/PIC. Need conquest; no unowned centers.

Spring 1905: holding all units to keep peace with France, Germany and Russia. Russia's F SWE and A WAR/LVN promised to stay out of NOR, NWG, NTH and EDI, so check that next turn. HOL is empty but a lone NTH there would be dislodged, so no move. Revisit a convoy into DEN/BEL/HOL only if Germany leaves them empty.

Spring 1905: Pacts kept with Austria, France, Turkey. Turkey accepted border (Greece and Ionian to Italy). Holding Greece with A GRE and F AEG. F ION moves to TUN to re-occupy our empty center vs French F MAO. No moves into Turkish SMY/BUL or Austrian Balkans. Watch Turkey on Aegean and France on Tunis/Piedmont.

Spring 1905: all hold. SMY is empty and unreachable by land; needs a fleet convoy via AEG, so no move. Keep the Balkan and Black Sea pacts with Austria, Italy and Russia. Italy agreed Greece/Ionian to them. Next: rebuild a fleet to retake Smyrna.

Spring 1905: no unowned centers and no attack on BEL can succeed (only BUR reaches it, no support). All holds keep 5 SCs. Peace kept with GER, ENG, ITA. Watch GER for BUR/PIC moves; revisit BEL only if GER is committed to Austria/Russia.

messages.body: Austria here. Fall 1905: A BUD, A RUM, A SER, F TRI and A VIE all hold. We still won't enter Bulgaria or Greece. Your A BUL is the unit nearest Serbia, so please confirm it stays out of Serbia and Rumania this autumn. Tell me if your Aegean plans involve Greece.

Austria here. Fall 1905: our Galicia and Rumania line holds. A RUM, A BUD and A VIE stay put and will not enter Galicia or Ukraine. Please confirm A WAR, A LVN and F SEV stay out of Rumania and Galicia. Tell me before any change toward Sweden or Prussia, and what your autumn plans are for SEV and WAR.

England here. Fall 1905: please confirm your orders for F SWE, A WAR and A LVN. I need no Russian unit entering NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI, and I'll keep NTH and NWG out of the Baltic and Sweden as agreed. Tell me your Fall moves so we both know where we stand.

France here. Fall 1905: A BUR, A PAR, A MAR, A POR and F MAO hold or stay in the west, with nothing entering Belgium, Munich or Picardy. Are your Fall moves against Austria or Russia? Please give me notice before any unit moves toward Burgundy or Picardy, and I will do the same.

France here. This Fall A MAR, A BUR, A PAR and F MAO stay west, away from Piedmont and the Italian coast. Are you moving against Austria or Turkey this year? If so, tell me first. I would like to keep F TYS and F ION out of the Gulf of Lyon and Spain as agreed.

Germany here. A SIL holds this Fall and I will not enter Bohemia or Tyrolia while Austria keeps its word. Please keep A VIE and F TRI out of Silesia and Munich, and confirm your Fall 1905 orders in writing so our understanding stays clear.

Germany here. A SIL is in Silesia as agreed, and Galicia and Rumania remain yours. Once Austria is clearly weakened, we can discuss Bohemia. Please confirm in writing that A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SWE stay off Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel this Fall.

Germany here. My Fall 1905 orders are F BEL, A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A SIL, with nothing toward Burgundy, Picardy or Belgium's neighbours. Please keep A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and F BRE out of Belgium and Munich, and I will give you notice before any change near your border.

Italy to France: I hold GRE, NAP, ROM, TUN and VEN and want no war with you. Please confirm no French fleet, including F MAO, moves toward Tunis or the Italian coast this Fall. I will keep F AEG and F TUN out of the Gulf of Lyon and the Spanish coast. Tell me if your Iberian plans change.

Italy to Turkey: Confirming our border: Greece and the Ionian are Italian, while Bulgaria, Constantinople and Smyrna are Turkish. A GRE and F AEG will not enter Bulgaria or Smyrna this Fall. Please confirm A BUL and F BLA stay out of Greece and the Aegean, and that you will not move toward Venice or Tunis.

Russia here. Fall 1905: I am still weighing a move on Galicia. Before I decide, tell me the exact Fall orders for A RUM, A BUD, A VIE, F TRI and A SER. Any Austrian unit entering Galicia or Ukraine ends our agreement.

Turkey to Russia: Austria is our shared problem and holds RUM, SER and BUD. I propose we plan a Spring 1906 strike on Rumania: your F SEV moves to BLA and I move F BLA into RUM, with A BUL held ready to follow. Tell me if you accept, and keep A WAR and A MOS out of Armenia and Ankara as agreed.

Turkey to Italy: You hold Greece and the Ionian, and I accept that. Austria is the bigger threat to both of us. Will you keep F NAP and A VEN ready to pressure Trieste and Austrian Adriatic coasts in 1906, while my fleets stay out of the Adriatic? Confirm your Fall 1905 orders for GRE, ION and NAP.

Austria confirms Fall 1905 orders: A RUM, A BUD, A VIE, F TRI and A SER all hold. None enters Galicia or Ukraine. We expect A WAR, A LVN and F SEV to hold too, with no move into Rumania or Galicia. Tell me before any change toward Sweden or Prussia, and tell me now if your autumn plans for SEV or WAR change.

Austria confirms Fall 1905 orders: A VIE, F TRI, A BUD, A RUM and A SER all hold. None moves toward Silesia, Bohemia, Tyrolia or Munich. We expect your A SIL, MUN and BER to stay in place as well. If your plans toward Silesia or Bohemia change, tell me first so we avoid a clash.

France here. Fall 1905: A BUR, A PAR, A MAR hold, F MAO stays in the Atlantic, and nothing enters Belgium, Munich or Picardy. Thanks for your Fall orders. I agree we should watch Austria and Russia. If your plans toward Burgundy or Belgium change, give me notice first, and I will do the same.

France here. Confirmed: F MAO stays in the Atlantic this Fall and will not move toward Tunis or the Italian coast. A MAR, A BUR and A PAR hold, and A POR stays in Portugal. I have no Iberian moves toward Italy. Please keep F AEG, F ION and F TUN out of the Gulf of Lyon and the Spanish coast as agreed.

Germany here. My Fall 1905 orders are F BEL, A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A SIL. Nothing moves toward Burgundy, Picardy or Brest, and my Silesia army is aimed at Bohemia against Austria. Please keep A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and F BRE out of Belgium and Munich, and I will give you notice before any change near your border.

Italy here. This Fall F AEG and F TUN hold, and I will not enter the Gulf of Lyon, the western Mediterranean or the Spanish coast. I have no plans against France. Please confirm F MAO will not move toward Tunis or the Italian coast, and keep A MAR and A BUR out of Piedmont.

Italy here. Agreed on the border: Greece and the Ionian are Italian, and Bulgaria, Constantinople and Smyrna are Turkish. A GRE and F AEG hold this Fall. I cannot promise 1906 moves on Austria yet, but Austria threatens us both. Please keep F BLA and A BUL out of Greece and the Aegean.

Russia here. Fall 1905: F SWE holds in Sweden, A WAR and A LVN hold. No Russian unit enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI. Our agreement stands. Please keep your NTH and NWG out of the Baltic and Sweden as well.

Russia here. Fall 1905: A WAR, A LVN and F SEV hold this autumn, and none enters Galicia, Rumania or Ukraine. I am still weighing my options, so tell me at once if your A RUM, A BUD or A VIE moves. Any such move ends our line.

Russia here. Fall 1905: A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SWE hold. None enters Prussia, Berlin, Denmark or Kiel. Bohemia can wait until Austria is clearly weakened. Keep your A SIL out of Galicia and Ukraine, and tell me before you move toward Bohemia.

Russia here. Fall 1905: A MOS and F SEV hold, staying out of Armenia, Ankara, Constantinople and Rumania. I cannot vacate Sevastopol for F BLA yet. Let us talk about a Spring 1906 Rumania plan once Austria's position is clearer. Keep F BLA off SEV meanwhile.

Turkey here. A BUL holds Bulgaria this Fall and will not enter Serbia or Rumania. F BLA stays out of Rumania and Serbia too. I have no move on Galicia planned. If Russia pushes into your Rumania or Galicia, I'd like to hear from you before any Balkan change. Please keep A BUD, A RUM and A SER out of Bulgaria and Greece.

Turkey here. I accept the border: Greece and the Ionian are yours, Bulgaria, Constantinople and Smyrna are mine. A BUL and F BLA will stay out of Greece, the Aegean and the Adriatic this Fall. Please keep F NAP and A VEN ready to pressure Austria's Adriatic coast in 1906, and keep F ION away from Smyrna.

notes.note: Fall 1905: holding all five per Russia, Turkey, Italy, Germany pacts. No unowned centers reachable. Russia has held WAR/LVN/SEV so far; Turkey A BUL holds. Watch Russia's autumn plans for SEV/WAR, Turkey's BUL/GRE, and Italy's ION/VEN. Revisit Galicia or Greece only if a pact breaks.

Fall 1905: all units hold to keep 5 SCs (BRE MAR PAR POR SPA). Promises kept: GER no move to BUR/PIC/BEL/MUN, ITA keeps F AEG/F TUN out of Gulf of Lyon. Promised F MAO stays in Atlantic, away from Tunis. Revisit BEL only if Germany is committed against Austria/Russia and I give notice first.

Fall 1905: all holds to keep pacts with Austria, France, Turkey. No unowned centers nearby. Turkey accepted border (GRE/ION Italian). Plan 1906: consider A GRE convoy to BUL/CON if Turkey weakens; Austria is the target. Watch France on TUN/PIE.

Fall 1905: all hold. No unowned SCs. Pacts: Italy (Greece/Ionian to Italy; Bulgaria/CON/SMY to Turkey), Russia (Black Sea line, F SEV off RUM), Austria (no BUL/GRE entry). Next: Spring 1906 Rumania plan with Russia (F SEV to BLA, F BLA to RUM, A BUL follows) if Russia agrees; else hold.

Fall 1905: all hold to keep pacts (Austria no Galicia/Rumania/Ukraine, Germany no Prussia/Berlin/Denmark, Turkey no Armenia/Ankara/CON, England no NOR/NTH). Austria, Germany, Turkey, England all kept terms so far. Turkey proposed Spring 1906 Rumania strike via F SEV to BLA; undecided, need SEV held. Next: reassess Galicia or Silesia/Bohemia only if Austria weakens; SWE must stay to keep center.

Fall 1905: A EDI convoyed via NTH to HOL (unowned-by-us German center, empty). Risk: Germany may dislodge. Keep LON/NOR holding home centers. Russia confirmed no entry to NOR/NWG/NTH/EDI. France and Germany kept word. Watch Germany's F BEL/A KIE response; if HOL is lost, return to peace and hold.

Fall 1905: all hold as promised to Austria, France, Russia. Austria and Russia have kept word so far; France too. Plan: Bohemia/Tyrolia vs Austria once Russia takes Galicia and Austria weakens. MUN is empty but German-owned; watch France via BUR. Need conquest; no unowned centers left.

messages.body: Austria here. Italy's A GRE sits on a former Turkish area and Italy has been strong in the Balkans. If you move against Greece this Spring, Austria will keep A SER, A RUM and A BUD out of Bulgaria and Greece and will not interfere. Tell me your Spring 1906 orders for A BUL, A CON and F BLA.

Austria here. Our Galicia and Rumania line still stands for Spring 1906: A RUM, A BUD and A VIE hold and will not enter Galicia or Ukraine. Please confirm A WAR, A LVN and F SEV stay out of Rumania. Tell me your Spring plans for Sweden and Prussia before they happen.

England here. My A EDI has convoyed to HOL, which I hold now. I'm not moving on BEL, DEN or KIE. Please confirm F BEL and A KIE won't attack HOL this spring. Holland is my only gain, and I'll keep my fleets out of your home waters.

England here. Norway stays mine and your F SWE stays in the Baltic, as agreed. I'm holding NOR, NTH and NWG this spring. Please confirm A WAR and A LVN stay out of the North Sea and Norway, and that you'll tell me before any change.

France here. Spring 1906: A BUR, A PAR, A MAR, A POR and F MAO hold, nothing enters Belgium, Munich or Picardy. Are your Spring moves still against Austria or Russia? If you move F BEL or A MUN, give me notice first. I will do the same before any move near Burgundy.

France here. Spring 1906: F MAO stays in the Atlantic and I will not enter the Channel, Brest, Picardy or Belgium. Please keep F LON, F NTH and your North Sea fleets out of Brest and the Channel as agreed. Tell me before any change near Norway or Denmark that touches my coast.

France here. Spring 1906: my armies hold in Burgundy, Paris, Marseille and Portugal, and F MAO stays in the Atlantic. Please keep F TUN and F AEG out of the Gulf of Lyon and the Spanish coast. If you plan moves against Austria or Turkey, tell me first.

Germany to Russia: A SIL holds again this Spring, and I am still open to splitting Austria. Are you moving on Galicia or Ukraine this year? If Austria's VIE falls, I want it, and I'll keep my armies off Warsaw, Prussia and Sweden while you press south. Please confirm your Spring 1906 orders.

Germany to Austria: Our Serbia and Rumania understanding has held, and A SIL still holds this Spring. Russia is pressing you in Galicia, so I want to know if you are shifting units north or south this year. Please confirm your Spring 1906 orders for VIE, TRI and BUD in writing.

Italy to Turkey: I agree Austria is the main threat to us both. Let's coordinate for 1906: you press Serbia and Rumania from the east while I hold Greece and build toward Albania and Trieste. Keep F BLA and A BUL out of the Aegean and Greece, and tell me your Spring orders.

Italy to Austria: Our pact holds this Spring. A VEN stays out of Tyrolia, Trieste and Vienna, and F ION stays out of the Adriatic and Albania. Please confirm A SER and F TRI keep out of Greece, Albania and the Adriatic, and tell me your Spring 1906 plans.

Italy to France: Confirmed, I have no plans against you. F AEG, F ION and F TUN stay out of the Gulf of Lyon, the western Mediterranean and the Spanish coast. Please confirm F MAO stays away from Tunis and the Italian coast this Spring, and keep A MAR out of Piedmont.

Russia here. I have no move into Galicia or Rumania planned this Spring; A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SEV hold. Tell me your Spring 1906 orders for A RUM, A BUD, A VIE, A SER and F TRI, and whether any of them plan to enter Galicia or Ukraine.

Russia here. I cannot vacate Sevastopol for F BLA this Spring, so the Rumania swap is off for now. F SEV and A MOS hold and stay out of Armenia, Ankara, Constantinople and Rumania. Tell me your Spring 1906 moves for A GRE, A BUL and A CON before any of them go toward Serbia.

Russia here. A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SWE hold this Spring and none enters Prussia, Berlin, Denmark or Kiel. Bohemia remains open for discussion once Austria is clearly weakened. Tell me before A SIL moves toward Bohemia, and confirm it stays out of Galicia and Ukraine.

Turkey here. Spring 1906: I hold A BUL, F BLA, A CON, A ANK, and I am not moving into Rumania or Armenia. Your F SEV is still on Sevastopol, so the Rumania plan waits. Tell me if you will vacate SEV for F BLA this year, or whether you prefer to hold the Black Sea line and go after Austria yourself.

Turkey here. Our Greece and Ionian border stands. I keep F BLA and A BUL out of the Aegean and Adriatic this spring. Please confirm F NAP and A VEN will press Austria's Adriatic coast in 1906. Tell me your spring orders for GRE, NAP and VEN.

Turkey here. Spring 1906: A BUL holds in Bulgaria and F BLA holds in the Black Sea. I have no move into Serbia or Rumania this year. Your units in SER, RUM and BUD are safe from me. If Russia moves on Rumania, I want to hear from you first.

Austria confirms Spring 1906: A RUM, A BUD and A VIE hold and will not enter Galicia or Ukraine. We expect A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SEV to stay out of Rumania and Galicia. Tell me at once if your plans for Sweden or Prussia change, and I will do the same for any move on Galicia.

Austria confirms Spring 1906 orders: VIE, TRI and BUD all hold. None moves toward Bohemia, Tyrolia, Silesia or Munich. Please keep A SIL, MUN and BER in place as well. If your plans toward Bohemia or Silesia change, tell me first so we avoid a clash.

Austria confirms: A SER and F TRI hold this Spring and stay out of Greece, Albania and the Adriatic. We expect A VEN and F ION to keep out of Trieste, Tyrolia, Vienna, the Adriatic and Albania. Our pact stands. Tell me before any change in the Ionian or Balkans.

Austria here. This Spring A SER, A RUM and A BUD hold and we will not enter Bulgaria or Greece. Please keep A BUL out of Serbia and Rumania, and F BLA out of Rumania. Tell me before any move toward Galicia or Ukraine that touches your borders.

England here. Agreed for Spring 1906: F LON and F NTH stay out of the Channel, Brest, Picardy and Belgium, and I won't move toward your coast. My North Sea fleets stay near Norway and Holland to hold our centres against Russia and Germany. Keep F MAO in the Atlantic as you say, and tell me before any move near Spain or Portugal.

France here. Confirmed: F MAO stays in the Atlantic this Spring and will not move toward Tunis or the Italian coast. A MAR holds and will not enter Piedmont. Please keep F TUN, F AEG and F ION out of the Gulf of Lyon and the Spanish coast, as agreed. If your plans toward Austria or Turkey change, tell me first.

Germany here. This Spring F BEL and A SIL hold, and A BER, A KIE and A DEN hold too. Nothing moves toward Burgundy, Picardy, Munich or Brest. I'm focused on Austria and Russia. If that changes I will tell you first, and I ask the same of your A BUR, A PAR and A MAR.

Germany here. This Spring A SIL holds and I stay out of Galicia, Ukraine, Warsaw, Prussia and Sweden. I'm not moving on Bohemia until Austria is clearly weakened, and I'll tell you before any such move. Please confirm your A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SWE stay off Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel.

Germany here. This Spring F BEL, A KIE and A DEN all hold. I'm not attacking Holland this spring, but I may want it back later, so please don't count on it as permanent. Keep your fleets out of Belgium, Denmark, Kiel and Norway as before, and I'll give you notice before any change near your coast.

Italy to France: Confirmed for Spring 1906. A VEN holds, and F NAP, F AEG and F TUN stay out of the Gulf of Lyon, the western Mediterranean and the Spanish coast. I have no plans against you. Please keep F MAO away from Tunis and the Italian coast, and tell me first if your Iberian or Burgundy plans shift toward Piedmont.

Italy to Turkey: Greece and the Ionian stay ours as agreed. This Spring A GRE and F AEG hold, and A VEN holds. I will not move against Smyrna or Bulgaria. Austria is our shared problem, and I will coordinate Adriatic pressure on Trieste with you in Fall. Please keep F BLA and A BUL out of the Aegean and Greece.

Russia here. Confirmed for Spring 1906: A WAR, A LVN and F SWE hold. No Russian unit enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI, and A WAR and A LVN stay out of Norway. I will tell you before any change in the north. Please keep your NTH and NWG out of the Baltic and Sweden.

Russia here. Spring 1906: A WAR, A LVN and F SEV hold, and none enters Rumania or Galicia. Our line stands while your A RUM, A BUD and A VIE hold as you promised. Any Austrian move into Galicia or Ukraine ends it at once. I will tell you before any Russian change in the south.

Russia here. Spring 1906: A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SWE hold, and none enters Prussia, Berlin, Denmark or Kiel. I am not moving on Galicia this spring. Bohemia stays open once Austria is clearly weakened. Please tell me before A SIL moves toward Bohemia, and keep it out of Galicia and Ukraine.

Russia here. I cannot vacate Sevastopol for F BLA this Spring, so the Rumania swap is off. F SEV and A MOS hold and stay out of Armenia, Ankara, Constantinople and Rumania. Keep F BLA off Sevastopol. I will tell you before any change in the south. Tell me before A GRE or A BUL moves toward Serbia.

Turkey to Austria: Spring 1906, I have no move into Serbia or Rumania and A BUL holds in Bulgaria. Keep your SER, RUM and BUD where they are and we stay clear. Galicia is yours; tell me before any move toward Rumania or the Black Sea.

Turkey to Italy: Agreed. Greece and the Ionian are yours, Bulgaria, Constantinople and Smyrna are mine. A BUL and F BLA stay out of the Aegean and Adriatic. I will press Austria from the east when the moment comes. Please keep F NAP and A VEN ready against Trieste and Austria's Adriatic coast.

Turkey to Russia: Spring 1906, A BUL and F BLA hold, A CON and A ANK hold, and I will not enter Rumania or Armenia. Your F SEV and A MOS staying out of Armenia and Ankara keeps our line. Austria is the common enemy, so tell me if you ever vacate Sevastopol for F BLA.

notes.note: Spring 1906: all units hold to keep 5 SCs. No unowned centers. Deals kept so far: Germany keeps off BUR/PIC/BEL/MUN; Italy keeps F AEG/F TUN/F NAP out of Gulf of Lyon; England keeps fleets out of Channel/BRE. Watch Germany's F BEL and England's North Sea fleets. Revisit BEL only if Germany is committed vs Austria/Russia, with notice.

Spring 1906: all hold to keep pacts (Austria: no Galicia/Rumania/Ukraine; Germany: no Prussia/Berlin/Denmark/Kiel; England: no Norway/North Sea; Turkey: no Armenia/Ankara/CON/Rumania). F SEV stays so Turkey's Rumania swap stays off. Austria, Germany, England, Turkey have kept terms so far. Next: revisit Galicia/Bohemia only if Austria weakens; tell partners first.

Spring 1906: all five hold to keep pacts with Russia (Gal/Ukr), Turkey (Bul/Gre), Italy (ADR/Alb/Gre), Germany (Bohemia/Tyrolia/Silesia). No unowned centers. Russia and Turkey have kept word so far. Re-evaluate Galicia or Greece if a pact breaks.

Spring 1906: all hold to keep promises to France (no Burgundy/Picardy/Munich/Brest), Russia (no Prussia/Berlin/Denmark/Kiel entry; Bohemia only after Austria weakens, tell first), Austria (no Bohemia/Tyrolia/Silesia/Munich), England (no attack on HOL this spring). All have kept word so far. Next: keep looking for Austria split once weakened; consider HOL later. Watch France on BUR/PIC.

Spring 1906: holding all. HOL is ours (listed center), NTH supports HOL holding to deter Germany. Peace kept with France, Russia, Germany. No unowned centers. Watch Germany's A KIE/F BEL vs HOL; Russia's SWE/WAR/LVN stays out of NOR/NTH. Reconsider convoy into DEN/BEL only if Germany leaves them empty.

Spring 1906: holding to keep pacts with Austria, Turkey, France (all confirmed). Austria: no VEN into TRI/TYR/VIE, no ION into ADR/ALB. Turkey: GRE/ION Italian, BUL/CON/SMY Turkish. Plan: consider A GRE convoy via ION toward Turkish SMY/BUL later if Turkey weakens; Turkey asked NAP/VEN press Trieste, but Austria pact conflicts. Watch France on Piedmont and Tunis.

Spring 1906: A ANK to SMY (empty Turkish SC, land-adjacent) to take it. CON, BUL, BLA hold to keep CON/BUL and Black Sea line. Pacts: Italy (Greece/Ionian theirs), Austria and Russia kept Rumania/Serbia quiet. Rumania swap with Russia off. Next: keep CON/BUL/ANK defended, watch Italy's F AEG.

messages.body: Austria here. This Fall I plan to hold A BUD, A RUM, A VIE, F TRI and A SER, so our Galicia and Ukraine line stands. Please confirm A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SEV stay out of Rumania and Galicia. If Sweden or Prussia plans change, tell me before any move.

Austria here. This Fall A BUD, A RUM, A SER, F TRI and A VIE hold, and we will not enter Bulgaria or Greece. Please confirm A BUL and F BLA stay out of Serbia and Rumania. If your plans toward Greece or Galicia change, tell me first.

Austria here. Our pact holds this Fall: F TRI stays out of the Adriatic and Albania, and A SER stays out of Greece. Please keep A VEN out of Trieste, Tyrolia and Vienna, and F ION out of the Adriatic and Albania. Tell me before any Ionian or Balkan change.

England here. Holland is held by my army, supported by NTH. I'm not moving on BEL, DEN or KIE and won't enter the Baltic. I'd like your word that F BEL and A KIE stay off HOL this autumn. Please tell me before any move toward Denmark or Holland.

England here. Confirming Norway stays with my F NOR, and I keep NTH and NWG out of the Baltic and Sweden. Please keep A WAR, A LVN and F SWE out of NOR, NWG, NTH and EDI this autumn, and tell me before any change in the north.

France here. Our centres are both at 5, and Austria and Russia are the real targets. If you commit A SIL and A MUN toward Bohemia this year, I'll keep A BUR, A PAR and A MAR out of Belgium and Munich. Later, I'd want to discuss Belgium once your eastern war is under way. Tell me your Spring 1907 plan first.

France here. Your fleets in the Ionian and Aegean can keep Turkey busy while I stay in the west. Keep F TUN and F NAP away from Spain and Portugal, and I'll keep F MAO out of the Mediterranean. Are you planning any move toward Austria's Adriatic coast or Greece in 1907?

Germany here. Fall 1906: I am holding A SIL and will not enter Galicia, Ukraine, Warsaw or Prussia. If you take Galicia and Rumania this autumn while Austria is pinned, I will move on Bohemia in 1907. What are your Fall 1906 orders for A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SWE?

Germany here. Fall 1906: my units hold in Silesia, Berlin, Kiel, Denmark and Belgium, and none enters Bohemia or Tyrolia. Please confirm your Fall 1906 orders for VIE, TRI, BUD, RUM and SER in writing, and tell me first if Russia's pressure changes your plans.

Germany here. Fall 1906: F BEL, A KIE and A DEN hold, and I am not attacking Holland. I may want Holland back later, so please keep your fleets out of Belgium, Denmark, Kiel and Norway. What are F NTH, F NOR and F LON doing this autumn?

Italy to Turkey: Austria is the obstacle to both of us. Proposal for Fall 1906: you move A BUL and A SMY toward Serbia and Rumania, and I move A VEN and F NAP against Trieste and the Adriatic. Please confirm your Fall orders for BUL, SMY and BLA before we commit.

Russia here. Austria is weakest on its Galicia and Bohemia flank. For Fall 1906 I propose a coordinated squeeze: your A SIL moves to BOH and you keep A BER and A KIE off Warsaw, while my A WAR and A LVN stay ready for GAL. Tell me your exact Fall orders before we commit.

Russia here. For Fall 1906 A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SEV hold, and none enters Galicia, Rumania or Ukraine. Germany is pressing your northern border, so tell me your Fall orders for A VIE, A BUD, A RUM and A SER, and whether any plan to leave those centers.

Turkey to Russia: Fall 1906. Ankara is empty and I may return A SMY there to secure it. Please keep A MOS, A LVN and A WAR out of Armenia and Ankara this autumn, and keep F SEV off Rumania. Confirm your Fall orders for F SEV and A WAR, and tell me before any move toward Constantinople.

Turkey to Italy: Fall 1906. Our border holds: Greece and the Ionian are yours, Bulgaria, Constantinople and Smyrna are mine. Please confirm F NAP and A VEN stay out of Greece, the Aegean and Bulgaria, and tell me your Fall orders for A GRE and F AEG. I will keep F BLA out of the Adriatic.

Austria confirms Fall 1906 orders: A VIE, F TRI, A BUD, A RUM and A SER all hold. None moves toward Bohemia, Tyrolia, Silesia or Munich. Please keep A SIL, MUN, BER, KIE and DEN in place too. If Russian pressure forces a change, I will tell you before any move.

Austria here. Fall 1906: A BUD, A RUM, A VIE, F TRI and A SER all hold, and none leaves its centre. Our Galicia and Ukraine line stands as long as A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SEV stay out of Rumania and Galicia. Tell me at once if Sweden or Prussia plans change.

England to Germany: Thanks for the confirmation. This autumn F NOR and F LON hold, and F NTH supports A HOL in place. I am not moving toward Denmark, Kiel or Belgium. I need your word that F BEL and A KIE stay off HOL this autumn. Any move on Holland would end our understanding, and I would defend it. Keep your word and we both keep our centres.

Germany here. Fall 1906: F BEL, A KIE and A DEN all hold. I make no promise on Holland, which I may want back later, so don't treat it as permanent. I'm not moving on Norway or the North Sea this autumn. What are F NTH, F NOR and F LON doing? Keep them out of Belgium, Denmark and Kiel.

Germany here. Fall 1906: A SIL holds, and A BER, A KIE, A DEN and F BEL hold. Nothing moves toward Burgundy, Picardy, Munich or Brest. For Spring 1907 I'm weighing Bohemia, but only after Austria is pinned and I've told you first. Keep A BUR, A PAR and A MAR out of Belgium and Munich, and we'll talk about Belgium later.

Italy here. Our pact holds this Fall. A VEN stays out of Tyrolia, Trieste and Vienna, and F NAP and F TUN will not enter the Adriatic or Albania. A GRE and F AEG hold this Fall. I will tell you before any Ionian or Balkan change.

Italy here. Confirmed: A VEN, F NAP, F TUN and F AEG hold this Fall, and none will enter the Gulf of Lyon, the western Mediterranean or the Spanish coast. I have no move toward Piedmont planned. Keep F MAO out of Tunis and the Italian coast. I will tell you before any 1907 plans change.

Italy here. Our border stands: Greece and the Ionian are ours, Bulgaria, Constantinople and Smyrna are yours. A GRE, F AEG, F NAP and A VEN hold this Fall, so no move against you. Keep F BLA and A BUL out of the Aegean and Greece. We can discuss Austria again for 1907.

Russia here. For Fall 1906 A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SEV hold. None enters Galicia, Rumania or Ukraine. Keep your A BUD, A RUM, A VIE, F TRI and A SER in place as you describe, and our line stands. I will tell you before any Russian change in the south or north.

Russia here. Confirmed for Fall 1906: A WAR, A LVN and F SWE hold. No Russian unit enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI. Norway stays yours. Please keep your NTH and NWG out of the Baltic and Sweden in return, and tell me before any change in the north.

Russia here. Fall 1906: A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SWE hold. None enters Prussia, Berlin, Denmark or Kiel. Your A SIL is free to test Bohemia if you judge the moment right, but tell me first. I will not move on Galicia this autumn, so do not count on a Russian squeeze yet.

Russia here. Fall 1906: A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SEV hold. None enters Armenia, Ankara, Constantinople or Rumania, and F SEV stays on Sevastopol. Keep F BLA off Sevastopol. Tell me before A SMY or A BUL moves toward Constantinople or Serbia, and I will do the same.

Turkey here. Fall 1906: A BUL holds Bulgaria, F BLA holds the Black Sea, and neither enters Serbia or Rumania. Please keep A BUD, A RUM, A SER and F TRI out of Bulgaria, Greece and the Black Sea. Galicia is your affair, but tell me before any move that touches Rumania or Sevastopol.

Turkey to Italy: Our border stands. Greece and the Ionian are yours; Bulgaria, Constantinople and Smyrna are mine. F BLA stays out of the Adriatic and Aegean. I am not ready to commit my Balkan units against Serbia this Fall. Please keep F NAP and A VEN out of Greece, the Aegean and Bulgaria, and tell me your Fall orders for A GRE and F AEG.

notes.note: Fall 1906: all holds keep 5 SCs. Germany, Italy, England kept deals so far. Keep F MAO in Atlantic, no moves into BEL/MUN/PIC/BRE channel. Revisit BEL only if Germany commits to Austria/Russia and gives notice. Spring 1907: consider SPA/BRE empty-but-owned; watch German BEL.

Fall 1906: all hold to keep promises (France: no BUR/PIC/MUN/BRE; Austria: no BOH/TYR/SIL/MUN; Russia: no GAL/UKR/WAR/PRU, tell first). England asks no move on HOL; I made no promise there. Plan: if Russia takes Galicia/Rumania, Bohemia in 1907 after telling all. Kept so far: all.

Fall 1906: holding all. NTH supports HOL holding to deter Germany. Peace kept with France, Russia; Germany gave no word on HOL and may attack. No unowned centers reachable. Keep fleets out of Baltic and Channel. Watch Germany's A KIE/F BEL vs HOL. Convoy into DEN/BEL only if Germany leaves them empty.

Fall 1906: all hold to keep pacts (Austria: no Galicia/Rumania/Ukraine; Germany: no Prussia/Berlin/Denmark/Kiel; England: no Norway/NTH; Turkey: no Armenia/Ankara/CON/Rumania). No unowned centers. Austria, Germany, Turkey, England have kept terms. Next: consider F SWE to BAL for convoy; reassess Galicia only if Austria breaks pact; tell partners first.

Fall 1906: holding to keep pacts with Austria, Turkey, France intact. Turkey not ready to attack Serbia. Plan 1907: consider A GRE convoy via ION/AEG toward BUL/SMY if Turkey weakens; Austria remains the main threat. Watch France on PIE/TUN. Kept GRE, ION, Adriatic clauses.

Fall 1906: SER attacks BUL supported by RUM, breaking the Turkey pact. Austria needs growth, and Turkey is weakest. Watch CON/BLA counterattack and Italy's GRE; keep VIE/TRI/BUD defensive. Russia and Germany pacts still stand.

Fall 1906: all hold. No unowned SCs reachable. Pacts: Italy (Greece/Ionian theirs; BUL/CON/SMY mine), Russia (Black Sea line, F SEV off RUM, no ARM/ANK entry), Austria (no BUL/GRE entry). All have kept word so far. Ankara is empty; watch Russia via ARM. Next: consider A SMY to ANK if a Russian unit nears ARM. Revisit Serbia/Rumania only if Austria or Russia breaks faith.

messages.body: Austria here. A BUL now stands in Bulgaria, and I will not move it toward Constantinople this Spring. Turkey's A CON, A SMY and F BLA should stay out of Bulgaria, Serbia and Rumania. Tell me your Spring 1907 orders for A CON, A SMY and F BLA, and whether you will hold Ankara and Smyrna.

Austria here. Our pact stands. A SER, A RUM and A BUL will stay out of Greece and Albania this Spring, and F TRI stays out of the Adriatic. Please confirm A GRE, F AEG and F NAP stay out of Bulgaria, Serbia and the Adriatic. Tell me your Spring 1907 plans in the Ionian and Balkans.

Austria here. Our Galicia and Rumania line still stands. A RUM, A BUD, A VIE and A BUL will hold this Spring and not enter Galicia or Ukraine. Please confirm A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SEV stay out of Rumania and Galicia, and tell me your Spring 1907 plans for Sweden and Prussia.

England here. For Spring 1907 I hold A HOL with F NTH in support and will not move on BEL, DEN or KIE. Please confirm F BEL and A KIE will not attack HOL this spring, and tell me before any move toward Denmark or Holland. I'll keep my fleets out of the Baltic and your home waters.

England here. For Spring 1907 I hold F NOR, F NTH and F NWG. Please confirm A WAR, A LVN and F SWE stay out of NOR, NWG, NTH and EDI this spring, and tell me before any change in the north. I'll keep my fleets out of the Baltic and Sweden as agreed.

France here. Spring 1907: A BUR, A PAR, A MAR hold and F MAO stays in the Atlantic. Nothing enters Belgium, Munich or Picardy. Your A SIL toward Bohemia is fine by me. Give me notice before F BEL or A MUN moves. I may want to talk about Belgium once your eastern war is under way.

France here. Spring 1907: F BRE holds, F MAO stays in the Atlantic, and nothing enters the Channel, Picardy or Belgium. Please keep F LON, F NTH and your North Sea fleets off Brest and Channel waters. Tell me before any move near Norway or Denmark that touches my coast.

France here. Spring 1907: my armies hold in Burgundy, Paris, Marseille and Portugal, and F MAO stays away from Tunis and the Italian coast. Please keep F TUN, F NAP and F AEG out of the Gulf of Lyon and the Spanish coast. If your plans toward Austria or Turkey change, tell me first.

Germany to Russia: Spring 1907 I hold A SIL and F BEL, and stay out of Galicia, Ukraine, Warsaw, Prussia and Sweden. If you take Galicia and Rumania while Austria is pinned, I will move A SIL to Bohemia in Fall 1907 and tell you first. Please confirm A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SWE stay off Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel.

Germany to Austria: Spring 1907 I hold A SIL, MUN, BER, KIE, DEN and BEL, and I will not enter Bohemia or Tyrolia this spring. Russia is pressing your Galicia flank, so I want your Spring 1907 orders for VIE, TRI, BUD, RUM and SER in writing. Please tell me before any move toward Silesia or Munich.

Germany to France: Spring 1907 A BER, KIE, DEN and BEL hold, and nothing moves toward Burgundy, Picardy, Munich or Brest. Please keep A BUR, A PAR and A MAR out of Belgium and Munich. We can discuss Belgium once the eastern war is under way. Tell me your Spring 1907 orders first.

Italy to Turkey: For Spring 1907 I hold A GRE, F AEG, A VEN, F NAP and F TUN with no move toward Bulgaria or Smyrna. Austria leads with 6 centers, so let's plan Fall 1907 pressure on Serbia or Rumania together. Please confirm your Spring orders for A BUL, A SMY and F BLA, and that none enters the Aegean or Greece.

Italy to Austria: Spring 1907: A VEN, F NAP and F TUN hold, and F ION stays out of the Adriatic and Albania. Please confirm A SER, A RUM and F TRI stay out of Greece, Albania and the Adriatic this spring, and tell me your 1907 plans before any Balkan move.

Russia here, Spring 1907. A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SEV hold this spring, and none enters Galicia, Rumania or Ukraine. Please confirm A BUD, A RUM, A VIE, F TRI and A SER stay in place. Tell me before any Austrian move toward Galicia or Ukraine.

Russia here, Spring 1907. A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SWE hold, and none enters Prussia, Berlin, Denmark or Kiel. What are your Spring orders for A SIL and your western units? Tell me before any move toward Bohemia, and keep your armies off Warsaw and Sweden.

Turkey to Russia: Austria holds Bulgaria with A BUL and is our common enemy. This Spring I plan A CON to BUL and F BLA stays in the Black Sea, with no move onto SEV. Please hit Rumania from Galicia or Ukraine with A WAR and A LVN, and keep A MOS out of Armenia and Ankara. Confirm this so we both gain.

Austria here. Spring 1907: A RUM, A BUD, A VIE and A BUL will hold and will not enter Galicia or Ukraine. We expect A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SEV to stay out of Rumania and Galicia. I will tell you before any change in the south. What are your Sweden and Prussia plans this spring?

Austria confirms Spring 1907: A VIE, F TRI, A BUD, A RUM and A SER all hold. None moves toward Silesia, Bohemia, Tyrolia or Munich. We expect your A SIL, MUN, BER, KIE, DEN and BEL to hold as well. If Russian pressure forces a change, I will tell you first.

Austria here. Spring 1907: A SER, A RUM and F TRI will hold and stay out of Greece, Albania and the Adriatic. A BUL holds too. Please confirm A GRE, F AEG, F NAP, A VEN and F ION stay out of Bulgaria, Serbia, Trieste and the Adriatic. Tell me your Ionian plans before any move there.

England here. Confirmed for Spring 1907: F LON and F NTH stay out of the Channel, Brest, Picardy and Belgium, and I have no moves toward your coast. Our fleets hold NOR and HOL against Germany and Russia. Please keep F MAO out of the Channel and English waters. I'll tell you before any change near Spain or Portugal.

France here. Spring 1907: A BUR, A PAR, A MAR hold, F MAO stays in the Atlantic. Nothing enters Belgium, Munich or Picardy. Your Silesia push into Bohemia is fine by me. Give me notice before F BEL or A MUN moves. Once the eastern war is under way, let us discuss Belgium openly before anyone moves.

Germany here. Spring 1907: A SIL holds, F BEL holds, and A BER, A KIE, A DEN hold. I am not moving on Bohemia this spring. If you take Galicia and Rumania while Austria is pinned, I will tell you before any Fall move. Please confirm A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SWE stay off Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel.

Germany here. This spring F BEL, A KIE and A DEN all hold. I am not attacking Holland this spring, and no unit of mine moves toward Denmark, Edinburgh or Yorkshire. I will tell you before any change near your coast, and I still expect your fleets to stay out of Belgium, Denmark and Kiel.

Germany here. Spring 1907: A BER, A KIE, A DEN and F BEL hold, so nothing moves toward Burgundy, Picardy, Munich or Brest. Thanks for your holds on A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and F MAO. I will give you notice before any change to Belgium, and I ask the same before you move near Burgundy.

Italy to Austria: Our pact holds for Spring 1907. A VEN, F NAP and F TUN hold, and F ION stays out of the Adriatic and Albania. I have no plans against Serbia or Bulgaria this spring. Please keep F TRI out of ADR and ALB, and tell me before any Balkan move that touches Greece.

Italy to France: Confirmed for Spring 1907. A VEN, F NAP, F TUN and F AEG hold, and none will enter the Gulf of Lyon, the western Mediterranean or the Spanish coast. I have no plans against you. Please keep F MAO away from Tunis and the Italian coast, and tell me first if your Burgundy or Piedmont plans shift.

Russia here. Confirmed for Spring 1907: F SWE, A WAR and A LVN hold, and no Russian unit enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI. I will tell you before any change in the north. Please keep your fleets out of the Baltic and Sweden as agreed.

Russia here. Spring 1907: A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SWE hold. None enters Prussia, Berlin, Denmark, Kiel, Warsaw or Galicia. Bohemia stays open once Austria is clearly weakened. Tell me before A SIL moves, and keep it out of Galicia and Ukraine.

Russia here. Spring 1907: A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SEV hold, and none enters Galicia, Rumania or Ukraine. Your A RUM, A BUD, A VIE, F TRI and A SER should stay in place. I will warn you before any Russian change in the south.

Russia here. I will not move A WAR or A LVN into Rumania this spring, and A MOS stays out of Armenia and Ankara. F SEV stays on Sevastopol, so keep F BLA off it. If Austria stays weak in Bulgaria, we can talk again in the autumn.

Turkey here. Spring 1907: A CON, A SMY and F BLA all hold, so nothing enters Bulgaria, Serbia or Rumania this turn. I have noted your A BUL and your pledge not to move it toward Constantinople. Keep your SER, RUM and BUD where they are, and tell me your Fall orders before any Galicia or Black Sea move.

Turkey to Italy: Confirmed for Spring 1907. A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold. None enters Greece, the Aegean or the Ionian. Greece and the Ionian remain yours as agreed. I will keep watching Austria's A BUL and Russia. Please keep F NAP and A VEN ready against Trieste and the Adriatic for Fall 1907.

notes.note: Spring 1907: all units hold per promises to GER, ENG, ITA. No unowned SCs in reach. Germany kept off BUR/PIC/BEL/MUN so far; ENG and ITA kept deals. Revisit BEL only if Germany is committed vs Austria/Russia and gives notice first. Keep F MAO in Atlantic.

Spring 1907: all five hold to keep pacts with Russia (Gal/Ukr), Turkey (Bul/Gre), Italy (Adr/Alb/Gre), Germany (Boh/Tyr/Sil). No unowned centers. Russia, Germany, Italy have kept word so far. Revisit Galicia or Greece if a pact breaks.

Spring 1907: holding all units to honor pacts (Austria: no Galicia/Rumania/Ukraine; Germany: no Prussia/Berlin/Denmark/Kiel/Warsaw; England: no NOR/NTH/EDI; Turkey: no Armenia/Ankara/CON/Rumania). Spring 1907: held all units to keep pacts with Austria, Turkey, France. Turkey and Austria confirmed holds and Balkan clauses. Austria's F TRI and A SER stay out of Greece/Adriatic. Next: Fall 1907 consider F NAP to ION, then convoy options for A GRE if Turkey stays passive. Watch France on TUN/PIE and Austria in ADR.

Spring 1907: all hold to keep peace with France, Germany and Russia; all three confirmed no moves toward my coast. HOL held with NTH support. Germany says no attack on HOL this spring but may want it back. Next: consider convoy HOL to DEN via HEL only if Germany empties DEN/BEL and no one objects.

Spring 1907: all hold to keep promises to Austria (no SIL/MUN/BOH/TYR move), Russia (no PRU/BER/DEN/KIE entry; Bohemia only after Austria weakens, tell first), France (no BEL/MUN/BUR move), England (no HOL attack yet). Kept so far: all. Next: consider Bohemia in Fall 1907 after telling all.

Spring 1907: held all units to keep pacts with Austria, Italy and Russia. Austria kept SER/RUM/BUD quiet and A BUL pledged not toward CON. Italy keeps Greece/Ionian. Russia keeps off ANK/ARM/RUM. Turkey has only 3 SCs; attack on BUL needs convoy support. Reconsider Fall 1907 Balkan move if Austria breaks faith..

messages.body: Austria here, Fall 1907. I plan to hold A BUL, A RUM, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI this autumn, so nothing enters Bulgaria, Serbia or Rumania from my side. Please confirm A CON, A SMY and F BLA stay out of Bulgaria, Rumania and Serbia. What are your Fall orders, and would you hold Constantinople and Smyrna?
