Please confirm in writing that F BEL and A KIE will not attack HOL this autumn, and tell me before any move toward Denmark. If you keep your word, I'll keep my fleets out of the Baltic and your home waters.

England here. Fall 1907: F NOR, F NTH and F NWG hold, and I will keep them out of the Baltic and Sweden. Please confirm A WAR, A LVN and F SWE stay out of NOR, NWG, NTH and EDI this autumn, and tell me before any change in the north.

France here. Fall 1907: A BUR, A PAR and A MAR hold and F MAO stays in the Atlantic. Please confirm F BEL and A MUN stay put this autumn, and give me notice before any move near Belgium or Burgundy. Once your eastern war is clearly under way, let us talk openly about Belgium.

France here. Fall 1907: F MAO stays in the Atlantic, with no move into the Channel, Brest or Picardy. Please confirm F LON, F NTH and F NOR stay out of the Channel and Belgium this autumn. Tell me before any change in the North Sea that could touch my coast.

France here. Fall 1907: my armies hold in Burgundy, Paris, Marseille and Portugal, and F MAO stays away from Tunis and the Italian coast. Please keep F TUN, F NAP and F AEG out of the Gulf of Lyon and the Spanish coast. Tell me first if your plans toward Austria or Turkey change.

Germany here, Fall 1907. I am considering A SIL to BOH this autumn while Austria is stretched by your Galicia pressure. Will A WAR or A LVN take GAL this fall? Tell me your exact Fall orders before I commit. I keep BER, KIE, DEN and BEL off your Prussia and Warsaw lines.

Germany to Austria: I have seen no sign of your units leaving VIE, TRI or BUD. Please confirm your Fall 1907 orders in writing, and tell me if Russia moves into Galicia so we can discuss the Bohemia border before any unit moves.

Germany to England: I keep F BEL, A KIE and A DEN in place this autumn and make no move on Holland. Please confirm F NTH and A HOL stay put, and that your fleets stay out of Denmark and Kiel. I'd like the same notice from you before any move into the Channel or the North Sea.

Italy to Turkey: Austria now leads with 6 centers and its army in Bulgaria threatens you. For Fall 1907 I propose you attack A BUL and Serbia while A GRE moves toward Bulgaria via the Aegean with my support. Please confirm F BLA and A CON orders against Bulgaria, and that none of your units enter Greece or the Ionian.

Italy to Austria: Our pact holds this Fall. A VEN, F NAP and F TUN hold, and F ION stays out of the Adriatic and Albania. Please confirm A BUL and A RUM stay out of Greece and the Aegean, and tell me your Fall 1907 plans for Serbia and Bulgaria before any Balkan move.

Italy to France: Our pact stands for Fall 1907. A VEN, F NAP, F TUN and F AEG hold, and none will enter the Gulf of Lyon, the western Mediterranean or the Spanish coast. Please keep F MAO away from Tunis and the Italian coast, and tell me first if Piedmont or Burgundy plans change.

Russia here, Fall 1907. Austria is stretched on two fronts. I propose you move A SIL to BOH this autumn while I take GAL with A WAR, and A LVN moves up behind it. I will keep A MOS out of Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel. Please confirm your exact orders before I commit.

Russia here. Austria's A BUL and A RUM are exposed. If you take BUL with A CON this autumn, I will move A WAR to GAL and threaten RUM with A LVN. F SEV stays on Sevastopol, and I keep A MOS out of Armenia and Ankara. Confirm your Fall orders so we coordinate.

Russia here. Austria has kept its word in the south, but the other powers are restless. Tell me now whether A VIE and A BUD will hold this Fall, and whether you plan any move into Galicia or Ukraine. I will keep my agreed line unless you break it first.

Turkey to Austria: Fall 1907. Your A BUL now sits on a centre I consider mine by our old line. I plan to move A CON to BUL and F BLA to BUL(ec) this autumn to dislodge it. Tell me your Fall orders for A BUL, A RUM and A BUD. If you pull A BUL back to Serbia or Rumania, I will keep A CON out of Serbia and Rumania.

Turkey to Russia: Austria is overextended in the Balkans. I intend to attack Bulgaria this Fall with A CON and F BLA. Please pressure Rumania with A WAR or A LVN from Galicia or Ukraine, so Austria cannot spare units. Keep A MOS out of Armenia and Ankara, and keep F SEV off the Black Sea line. Do you agree?

Austria confirms Fall 1907: A VIE, F TRI and A BUD hold. None moves toward Bohemia, Tyrolia, Silesia or Munich. Please keep your A SIL, MUN, BER, KIE, DEN and BEL in place. If Russia moves into Galicia, I will tell you before any Austrian unit shifts north, and I expect you to do the same.

Austria confirms Fall 1907: A VIE, A BUD, A RUM, A BUL and F TRI all hold. No Austrian unit enters Galicia or Ukraine. Please confirm A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SEV stay out of Rumania and Galicia. Tell me before any Russian move toward Galicia, and I will do the same.

Austria confirms: F TRI holds and stays out of the Adriatic and Albania. A RUM and A BUL hold and will not enter Greece or the Aegean this Fall. Please keep A VEN out of Trieste, Tyrolia and Vienna, and F ION out of the Adriatic and Albania. Our pact stands.

Austria will hold A BUL this Fall, and A BUD, A RUM, A VIE and F TRI hold too. Bulgaria is Austrian and we will defend it. If A CON or F BLA moves into Bulgaria, Serbia or Rumania, Austria will treat it as an attack. Keep your units out of those areas and we can stay clear.

England here. Confirmed: F LON, F NTH and F NOR stay out of the Channel, Brest, Picardy and Belgium this autumn. We have no moves toward your coast. Please keep F MAO in the Atlantic and out of English waters, LVP and EDI as agreed. I will tell you before any change near Spain or Portugal.

England here. Confirmed: F NTH and A HOL hold this autumn with no move on Denmark, Kiel or Belgium, and my fleets stay out of the Baltic. I expect your F BEL, A KIE and A DEN to stay off Holland as you say. Any move on HOL or the North Sea would end our understanding, and I would defend it.

France to Italy: Confirmed for Fall 1907. A MAR, A BUR, A PAR and A POR hold, and F MAO stays away from Tunis and the Italian coast. Please keep A VEN, F NAP, F TUN and F AEG out of the Gulf of Lyon and the Spanish coast as agreed. I will tell you first if my Burgundy or Piedmont plans change.

Germany here. For Fall 1907 F BEL, A KIE and A DEN hold, and I make no move on Holland. Please keep F NTH supporting A HOL in place, and keep your fleets out of Denmark, Kiel and the Baltic. I'll give notice before any change near the Channel or North Sea.

Germany here. This Fall A BER, A KIE, A DEN and F BEL hold, and A MUN stays put. Please keep A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and F MAO in place as you've said. Belgium is not on the table for this autumn. We can talk about it once the eastern war is clearly under way.

Germany here. I am weighing A SIL to BOH, but only after A WAR has taken GAL. If A WAR does not reach GAL this fall, A SIL holds. Please keep A MOS, A LVN and F SWE off Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel, and tell me your exact orders before I commit.

Italy here. Confirmed for Fall 1907: A VEN, F NAP, F TUN and F AEG hold, and none will enter the Gulf of Lyon, the western Mediterranean or the Spanish coast. I have no move toward Piedmont or Burgundy this year. Please keep F MAO away from Tunis and the Italian coast. We can review our arrangement in 1908.

Russia here. Confirmed: no Russian unit enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI this autumn, and F SWE holds in Sweden. A WAR and A LVN will move south toward Galicia and Ukraine, not north. Please keep your fleets out of the Baltic and Sweden as agreed. I will tell you before any change in the north.

Russia here. I am open to pressing Austria with you this autumn. A WAR can go to GAL and A LVN moves up behind it. Your A SIL to BOH is the right idea if Austria stays stretched. I will keep A MOS out of Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel. Please confirm your exact orders before either of us commits.

Russia here. Austria is the common enemy, so I agree to pressure Rumania. A WAR can go to GAL and A LVN follows toward Rumania. F SEV stays on Sevastopol, and A MOS stays out of Armenia and Ankara. Keep F BLA off Sevastopol. Good luck taking Bulgaria. Tell me before any move toward Armenia.

Turkey here. I can't keep the Bulgaria peace. This Fall A CON will move to BUL and F BLA will support it from the Black Sea. Your A BUL is the target. Keep A RUM and A BUD out of Serbia and Rumania's Turkish side, and I'll keep A CON out of Serbia and Rumania.

Turkey to Russia: Yes, I attack A BUL this Fall with A CON and F BLA. Please move A WAR to GAL and A LVN toward RUM so Austria can't spare units for Bulgaria. Keep A MOS out of Armenia and Ankara, and F SEV off the Black Sea line. I'll stay out of Rumania and Sevastopol.

Turkey to Italy: I won't move into Greece or the Ionian, and I refuse A GRE moving into the Aegean toward Bulgaria. Greece and the Ionian remain yours as agreed. Keep F NAP and A VEN out of Greece, the Aegean and Bulgaria. I'll press Austria in Bulgaria from the east.

notes.note: Fall 1907: all holds keep 5 SCs, as promised to GER, ENG, ITA. Keep F MAO in Atlantic, no moves into BEL/PIC/BRE. Revisit BEL only if Germany commits east and gives notice. Watch German BEL and English North Sea fleets.

Fall 1907: all hold to keep peace with France, Germany, Russia. No unowned centers reachable. Germany and Russia confirmed no moves on HOL/NOR/NTH/EDI. Watch Germany's F BEL/A KIE/A DEN vs HOL. Convoy HOL to DEN via HEL only if DEN/BEL empty and no objection.

Fall 1907: all holds to keep pacts with Austria, Turkey, France. No unowned centers reachable. Austria (F TRI, A BUL) and Turkey agree Greece/ION stay Italian. Watch A BUL and France on TUN/PIE. Next: consider F NAP to ION then convoy A GRE if Turkey stays passive.

Fall 1907: holding all. RUM supports BUL hold to defend vs Turkey's CON+BLA attack (2 vs 2, defender holds). Keep Galicia/Ukraine off-limits per Russia pact; Italy pact holds (TRI out of ADR/ALB). Turkey announced attack on BUL; watch CON/BLA. Germany, Italy, Russia have kept word so far.

Fall 1907: all hold to keep promises to France (no BEL/MUN/BUR move), Austria (no BOH/SIL/MUN move), England (no HOL attack), Russia (no PRU/BER/DEN/KIE entry). Bohemia/Galicia are not SCs, so SIL->BOH gains nothing yet. Revisit Bohemia only after A WAR takes GAL and Austria weakens; tell all first. Kept so far: all.

Fall 1907: WAR to GAL breaks the no-Galicia pact with Austria to pressure Austria, with LVN filling WAR. Promised Turkey pressure on RUM and Germany a Galicia-first sequence; Germany's SIL to BOH only after GAL. Watch Austria retaliation and Germany's SIL vs WAR. Keep SWE and SEV home; F SEV stays off RUM and BLA.

Fall 1907: attacking BUL with A CON, F BLA supports CON to BUL. Austria broke its Bulgaria pact and Italy wants Greece quiet. Watch RUM/BUD support on BUL; Russia promised WAR to GAL. Keep SMY and ANK for defense.

messages.body: Austria here. A BUL is held by Austria and will be defended with A RUM supporting. A CON to BUL or F BLA support would be a direct attack and will be met. Your army at CON can instead take Greece or hold. Please reconsider and keep A CON and F BLA out of Bulgaria, Serbia and Rumania this Fall.

Austria here. Turkey plans A CON to BUL with F BLA support this Fall. I am holding BUL, RUM and BUD. Your Black Sea fleet at SEV is well placed to stop F BLA. Please confirm A WAR, A LVN, A MOS and F SEV stay out of Galicia and Rumania, and tell me your Fall plans for Sevastopol and the Black Sea.

Austria here. Turkey is threatening Bulgaria with A CON and F BLA this Fall. I hold A BUL, A RUM, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI. Our pact stands: please keep F ION and A GRE out of Albania and the Adriatic. If Turkey attacks Bulgaria, would you pressure Turkey in the Aegean?

England here. Spring 1908: I hold A HOL with F NTH in support and make no move on BEL, DEN or KIE. Please confirm F BEL, A KIE and A DEN stay off Holland this spring. Tell me now if you plan any move toward HOL or the North Sea, so we avoid a misunderstanding.

England here. Spring 1908: F NOR, F NTH, F NWG and F LON hold, and my fleets stay out of the Baltic and Sweden. Please confirm no Russian unit enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI this spring. Tell me before any change in the north, and say whether A WAR and A LVN are heading south.

France here. Spring 1908: A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and F MAO hold, nothing enters Belgium or Munich. Germany is strongest in the centre, so I want a clear plan. Tell me your Spring orders first, and whether you will stay off Belgium if you push into Austria or Russia this year.

Germany, Spring 1908. Before I commit, send your exact Spring orders for A GAL, A WAR, A MOS, F SWE and F SEV. I hold A SIL, A BER, A KIE, A DEN and F BEL this spring. Our understanding stands: no Russian entry into Prussia, Berlin, Denmark or Kiel. I will not enter Bohemia until Austria is clearly weakened, and I will tell you first.

Germany, Spring 1908. Russia has A GAL against your flank. I hold A SIL, MUN, BER, KIE, DEN and BEL and will not enter Bohemia or Tyrolia this spring. Please send your Spring 1908 orders for VIE, TRI, BUD, BUL and RUM in writing, and tell me before any unit moves north toward Silesia or Munich.

Italy to Turkey: Austria's A BUL and A RUM are the threat to both of us. I propose we attack Austria in Spring 1908: your F BLA and A CON hit Bulgaria and Rumania, while I move against Trieste and Vienna over the next turns. Please confirm your Bulgaria attack. I will keep A GRE and F AEG out of Bulgaria and Smyrna.

Italy to France: For Spring 1908 I hold A GRE, F AEG, A VEN, F NAP and F TUN, none entering the Gulf of Lyon or the Spanish coast. Please tell me whether your A BUR, A MAR or A PAR plan any move toward Piedmont or Tunis this year. I have no moves against you and would like the arrangement to continue.

Russia here. Our no-Galicia pact is over. A GAL is in place and I am pressing you in the south. Pull A BUL and A RUM back toward Bulgaria and Serbia now, and I will not take Vienna or Budapest while you do. Otherwise I will take Rumania this spring.

Russia here. A GAL is in position to strike Rumania this spring with A LVN following. Please take Bulgaria with A CON and F BLA. F SEV stays on Sevastopol and A MOS stays out of Armenia and Ankara. Confirm you will hold F BLA off Sevastopol.

Russia here. Austria is under pressure from A GAL. Bohemia is open for you now: A SIL to BOH this spring is fine with me. A MOS stays out of Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel. Please keep your units off Warsaw and Galicia.

Turkey here. Spring 1908: I am moving A CON and F BLA against Austria's A BUL in Bulgaria. Please move A WAR toward Galicia and A LVN toward Rumania to tie Austria down. Keep A MOS out of Armenia and Ankara, and F SEV off the Black Sea line. Please confirm your Spring orders.

Turkey here. Our Bulgaria pact has failed, so I am attacking A BUL this Spring with A CON and F BLA. If you pull A BUL back, I will keep out of Serbia and Rumania. Tell me your Spring orders for A BUL, A RUM and A BUD.

Turkey here. Greece and the Ionian stay yours, as agreed. I need F NAP and A VEN kept out of Greece, the Aegean and Bulgaria. Please press Austria in Trieste or Serbia this Spring, which helps us both. Please confirm your Spring orders.

Austria's answer is no. A BUL and A RUM stay where they are this Spring. Our pact is over only because you moved A GAL, and I will not withdraw from Bulgaria or Rumania under threat. An attack on RUM, BUD or VIE will be met with everything we have. Keep A WAR, A MOS and F SEV out of Rumania and Galicia, and we can still talk.

France here. Spring 1908: A BUR, A MAR and A PAR all hold, and none moves toward Piedmont or Tunis. My fleets stay out of the western Mediterranean. Please keep your Venice, Naples, Tunis and Aegean units out of the Gulf of Lyon and Spain as agreed. I'll tell you first if anything changes.

Germany here. Spring 1908: F BEL, A KIE and A DEN hold. I am not moving on Holland this spring. Keep F NTH supporting A HOL in place, and keep your fleets out of Denmark, Kiel and the Baltic. I will give you notice before any change near the North Sea or Channel.

Germany here. Spring 1908: A SIL moves to Bohemia against Austria, as I told you. Nothing moves toward Belgium, Munich, Burgundy or Brest. F BEL, A BER, A KIE and A DEN hold. Please keep A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and F MAO where they are, as you have said. We can discuss Belgium later.

Germany here. Spring 1908: A SIL moves to BOH while your A GAL presses Austria. I will not enter Galicia, Warsaw, Ukraine or Rumania. Please keep A MOS, A WAR and F SWE out of Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel. Tell me your exact orders for A GAL, A WAR and F SEV, and I will keep you informed.

Italy to Austria: Spring 1908, A GRE, F AEG, F NAP, F TUN and A VEN hold. F ION will not enter the Adriatic or Albania, and A GRE stays out of Albania. If Turkey attacks Bulgaria, I will not join it this Spring. We will discuss the Aegean before any move. Our pact stands.

Italy to Turkey: Confirmed for Spring 1908. F NAP and A VEN hold, and neither enters Greece, the Aegean or Bulgaria. A GRE and F AEG also hold. Greece and the Ionian stay Italian. Press Austria in Serbia or Rumania as you see fit. We will coordinate Adriatic moves against Austria later.

Russia here. Spring 1908: F SWE holds in Sweden. No Russian unit enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI. A WAR is heading south toward Ukraine, away from the North Sea, and A LVN is no longer in the north. Keep your fleets out of the Baltic and Sweden as agreed, and I will tell you before any change in the north.

Russia here. The no-Galicia pact is over. A GAL strikes Rumania this spring. Withdraw A BUL and A RUM toward Serbia and Bulgaria now, and I will not take Vienna or Budapest while you do. If you hold Rumania, expect a hard fight there.

Russia here. Spring 1908 orders: A GAL to RUM, A WAR to UKR, A MOS holds, F SWE holds, F SEV holds. None of my units enters Prussia, Berlin, Denmark, Kiel or Bohemia. Bohemia is yours to take when you judge Austria weak. Keep your units off Warsaw and Galicia, and tell me your Spring orders.

Russia here. Spring 1908: A GAL goes to Rumania, A WAR to Ukraine, A MOS holds, F SEV holds on Sevastopol. I will keep F BLA off my fleets' path and A MOS out of Armenia and Ankara. Take Bulgaria as you plan. Please keep F BLA off Sevastopol and stay out of Rumania.

Turkey here. Spring 1908: A CON and F BLA attack Bulgaria against your A BUL. I will not enter Serbia or Rumania. If you pull A BUL back out of Bulgaria, I will hold A CON and F BLA out of Bulgaria this turn, and we can talk about a new line.

Turkey here. Spring 1908: A CON and F BLA hit Bulgaria against Austria. Please keep A WAR and A LVN pressing Rumania, as you proposed. F SEV stays on Sevastopol, F BLA will not enter it, and I will keep out of Armenia and Rumania. Confirm your orders.

Turkey here. Agreed on Austria. Spring 1908: A CON and F BLA attack Bulgaria. Greece and the Ionian stay yours, and I will not move toward them. Please keep F NAP and A VEN out of Greece, the Aegean and Bulgaria, and press Trieste as you propose.

notes.note: Spring 1908: all holds to keep pacts with Austria, Turkey, France. Austria: no ION into ADR/ALB, no VEN into TRI/TYR/VIE. Turkey: GRE/ION Italian, NAP/VEN out of GRE/AEG/BUL. France: no Lyon/Spain moves. Watch Austria in Adriatic and France on TUN/PIE. Possible plan: F NAP to ION this Fall, then convoy A GRE. Recheck pacts before Fall.

Spring 1908: holding all with NTH supporting HOL to keep peace with Germany, Russia, France. No unowned centers reachable. Germany and Russia keeping word so far. Convoy HOL to DEN via HEL only if DEN/BEL empty and Germany agrees; HOL is the exposed unit.

Spring 1908: holding BUL with RUM support vs Turkey CON+BLA (tie holds). BUD supports RUM hold vs Russia GAL. VIE, TRI hold. Russia, Turkey, Germany pacts broken; Italy kept word. Revisit counterattack in Fall.

Spring 1908: GAL to RUM, supported by SEV, to strike Austria's RUM. WAR to UKR, MOS and SWE hold. Keep fleets out of the north and Baltic. Germany and Turkey have kept terms; Austria refused to withdraw from BUL and RUM. Next: reassess WAR back to Warsaw in Fall if Germany threatens it.

Spring 1908: A BUR moves to empty German MUN to grab a center while Germany fights Austria; broke my no-Munich word, so expect German response. Other units hold, keeping BRE MAR PAR POR SPA. Italy and England deals still in place. Watch German KIE/BER retaliation; if BUR is dislodged, retreat to BUR or MUN area.

Spring 1908: SIL to BOH as told to Russia and Austria-pressure plan; BEL, BER, DEN, KIE hold, keeping promises to France (no BEL/MUN/BUR), England (no HOL move), Russia (no PRU/BER/DEN/KIE entry). Watch Austria reply on BOH. No unowned centers; push on VIE later with Russia GAL pressure.

Spring 1908: CON to BUL supported by BLA (bounce risk vs A BUL + RUM support). SMY holds to defend Smyrna. Austria, Italy, Russia pacts: Italy keeps F NAP/A VEN out of Greece/Aegean/Bulgaria; Russia keeps F SEV and A MOS off Black Sea line and ANK/ARM. Check Austria's response and whether Italy presses Trieste.

messages.body: Austria here. A GAL striking Rumania ends our Galicia peace, but war helps neither of us. A RUM and A BUL will hold, and BUD and VIE stay defended. Withdraw A GAL to Galicia or Warsaw and we can talk about Rumania and Ukraine. Otherwise expect a hard fight.

Austria here. A CON and F BLA attacking A BUL is a direct attack on Austria. Bulgaria is held with A RUM support and will not fall. Withdraw A CON and F BLA from Bulgaria, and we can discuss a new line in the Aegean and Black Sea. Continuing means open war.

Austria here. Turkey is attacking Bulgaria with A CON and F BLA. Please keep your word on the Adriatic and Albania, and if you can, move F AEG or A GRE to pressure Constantinople or the Aegean. That would relieve our Bulgarian front. Please confirm your Fall orders.

England here. Fall 1908: I hold F NTH and A HOL and will not move on BEL, DEN or KIE. Please confirm F BEL, A KIE and A DEN hold this autumn with no attack on HOL. Any change from you should come to me first, and I'll give the same notice before moving my fleets.

England here. Fall 1908: F NOR, F NTH, F NWG and F LON hold, and my fleets stay out of the Baltic and Sweden. Please confirm no Russian unit enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI this autumn, and that A WAR and A LVN are moving south. Tell me before any change in the north.

France here. I moved A BUR to Munich in Spring, breaking my word, and I'm sorry for it. A MUN now holds. Germany's Silesia and Bohemia push is your business. Proposal: I keep A MUN and PAR, MAR, POR and F MAO hold, so my armies stay off Belgium and Kiel. In return, keep F BEL and your northern units out of Burgundy and Picardy. Will you accept?

Germany here. My A SIL is now in Bohemia, and I have said so openly. Austria has spent two years on a promise that held nothing. I am moving on VIE this autumn with A BOH. Withdraw your units from Vienna's defence and let us discuss Balkan centres as a separate matter.

Germany to Russia: A BOH strikes at Vienna this autumn. Keep A GAL and A RUM pressing Austria from the east so Vienna falls and Austria cannot recover. Our understanding stands: no Russian entry into Prussia, Berlin, Denmark or Kiel. Tell me your Fall orders for GAL, UKR and SWE.

Germany here. A MUN is sitting on a German supply centre, and our agreement on Munich ends there. Move A MUN out to Burgundy or Ruhr this autumn, or tell me your reason for staying. I hold F BEL, A BER, A KIE and A DEN and will not move toward Paris or Brest.

Italy to Turkey: Fall 1908 question. Are your F BLA and A CON attacking Bulgaria now? Austria's A BUL is what threatens us both. I will keep A GRE and F AEG out of Bulgaria and Smyrna, and F NAP and A VEN out of Greece and the Aegean, as agreed. Please confirm your orders before we move.

Italy to Austria: Our pact stands this Fall. A VEN, F NAP, F TUN and F AEG will not enter Trieste, Tyrolia, Vienna, Albania or the Adriatic, and A GRE stays out of Bulgaria and Serbia. Please confirm F TRI and A BUL stay out of Greece and the Ionian, and tell me your Fall 1908 plans.

Italy to France: Our arrangement holds for Fall 1908. F NAP, F TUN, A VEN and F AEG stay out of the Gulf of Lyon, Spain and Piedmont. Please confirm your A MUN, A POR and A MAR do not move toward Tunis or the Italian coast, and tell me first if your Burgundy or Piedmont plans change.

Russia here. A GAL and A UKR are set to strike RUM this Fall. Pull A RUM out to SER or BUL and I will not attack BUD, VIE or SER. Stay in RUM and I will take it. Tell me your answer before orders lock.

Russia here. Austria is stretched by my A GAL and A UKR. Your A SIL to BOH is fine with me. I will keep A MOS, F SWE and any Russian unit out of PRU, BER, DEN and KIE. Please confirm your exact Fall orders.

Russia here. F SEV holds on Sevastopol and A MOS stays out of Armenia and Ankara. Please keep F BLA off SEV and out of RUM. Are you still pressing Bulgaria this Fall? Tell me your exact orders so we do not clash.

Turkey here. Bulgaria is ours now: A BUL holds this Fall, and F BLA supports it. Your A SER retreated, so please don't move back into BUL. I'll keep out of Serbia and Rumania. Stay out of BUL and we can keep the Balkans quiet while we both deal with Russia and Italy.

Turkey here. This Fall A BUL holds and F BLA stays in the Black Sea. I will not move into Rumania, Sevastopol or Armenia. Please keep A MOS out of Armenia and Ankara, and F SEV off the Black Sea line. Tell me your Fall orders for A UKR and F SEV.

Austria confirms: F TRI holds this Fall and stays out of the Adriatic, Albania and Greece. A VIE and A BUD hold too. Turkey's A CON and F BLA are attacking Bulgaria, and I want Turkey pressed. Please move F AEG or A GRE against Constantinople or the Aegean, and keep F ION away from Albania. Our pact stands.

Austria's answer is no. A RUM holds this Fall, supported by A BUD, and I will not withdraw under threat. Your A GAL and A UKR attacking Rumania will be met with full force. Keep A WAR, A MOS and F SEV out of Galicia and Rumania, and BUD and VIE stay safe. If you pull back to Galicia or Warsaw, we can talk about Ukraine.

Austria is holding VIE with A VIE this Fall and BUD in support. Your A BOH moving on Vienna will meet a hard defence, and I will not withdraw my units from the capital. Keep A BOH out of Tyrolia and Vienna if you want a quiet border. Austria remains open to talks on the Balkans after this turn.

Austria will not accept Turkish units attacking Bulgaria. Withdraw A CON and F BLA from Bulgaria this Fall, or face open war. Your A BUL is a stolen centre and Austria will retake it. Stay out of Serbia and Rumania, and we can discuss a new line in the Aegean and Black Sea afterwards.

France here. I'm sorry I broke my Munich word in Spring. A MUN holds for now and I won't move it toward Belgium or Kiel. Your Silesia and Bohemia push is your affair. Keep F BEL, A BER, A KIE and A DEN off Burgundy, Picardy and Paris, and we can both focus east. Will you accept?

France to Italy: Confirmed. A POR and A MAR hold, and F MAO stays in the Atlantic away from Tunis and the Italian coast. A MUN is not moving toward Piedmont or Tunis. I have no plans against you this autumn. Please keep F NAP, F TUN, A VEN and F AEG out of the Gulf of Lyon and Spain, and tell me first if your plans change.

Germany to England: This autumn F BEL, A KIE and A DEN hold, and I am not moving on Holland. My army in Bohemia is aimed at Austria, not the North Sea. Keep F NTH and A HOL where they are, and tell me first if your fleets move toward Denmark, Kiel or Belgium.

Germany to France: A MUN sits on a German supply centre, and our agreement on Munich ends while it stays there. Move A MUN out to Burgundy or Ruhr this autumn. Until then I hold F BEL, A BER, A KIE and A DEN and will not move toward Paris or Brest.

Germany to Russia: A BOH strikes at Vienna this autumn. Keep A GAL and A RUM pressing Austria from the east so Vienna falls. Our understanding stands: no Russian entry into Prussia, Berlin, Denmark or Kiel. Send me your exact Fall orders for GAL, UKR and SWE.

Italy confirms our pact for Fall 1908. A VEN, F NAP, F TUN, F AEG and A GRE will not enter Trieste, Tyrolia, Vienna, Albania or the Adriatic. I am holding this Fall and will not move against Constantinople or Bulgaria. Please keep F TRI and A BUL out of Greece and the Ionian.

Russia here. Confirmed: no Russian unit enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI this autumn. F SWE holds in Sweden and A MOS stays in Moscow. Our northern armies are heading south toward Galicia and Ukraine, away from your fleets. Keep your fleets out of the Baltic and Sweden, and I will tell you before any change in the north.

Russia here. No. A GAL and A UKR strike Rumania this Fall and I will not stop. Pull A RUM out to SER or BUL and I will not attack BUD, VIE or SER. Hold Rumania and you will fight for it. Tell me your answer before orders lock, since that choice decides whether your Balkan centers survive.

Russia here. Agreed: no Russian unit enters PRU, BER, DEN or KIE this Fall. A MOS and F SWE hold. A GAL and A UKR are aimed at Rumania, not Warsaw or Galicia-to-Germany lines. Vienna is your target with A BOH, and I will not contest Bohemia. Keep your units off Warsaw and Sevastopol.

Russia here. F SEV holds on Sevastopol this Fall, and A MOS stays out of Armenia and Ankara. I expect F BLA to stay in the Black Sea and out of Sevastopol and Rumania, as you promised. A UKR is pressing Rumania, not your side of the Black Sea. Keep your word and we both gain.

Italy, Turkey here. Spring 1908 our A CON moved into Bulgaria and took it. This Fall A BUL holds and F BLA stays in the Black Sea. A SMY holds Smyrna. Greece and the Ionian remain yours as agreed. Please keep F NAP and A VEN out of Greece, the Aegean and Bulgaria, and let's press Austria in Trieste and Serbia together.

Austria, Turkey here. A BUL is now Turkish and will hold this Fall, with F BLA supporting from the Black Sea. Your A SER retreated, so please stay out of Bulgaria. I will not enter Serbia or Rumania. If you keep A RUM and A BUD on their side of the line, we can both focus on Russia and Italy.

Russia, Turkey here. This Fall A BUL holds and F BLA stays in the Black Sea. I will not move into Rumania, Sevastopol or Armenia. Please keep A MOS out of Armenia and Ankara, and F SEV on Sevastopol. Tell me your exact orders for A UKR and F SEV so we don't clash in the Black Sea.

notes.note: Fall 1908: holding all to keep peace with Germany, Russia, France. Germany and Russia have kept word so far. No unowned centers reachable. Next: consider convoy HOL to DEN via HEL only if DEN/BEL are empty and Germany agrees. Watch Germany's F BEL/A KIE/A DEN vs HOL.

Fall 1908: all hold. MUN held to take German Munich if it survives. Keeps BRE MAR PAR POR SPA. Italy's pact holding; England quiet. Germany wants MUN vacated; I broke Munich word in Spring. Offered Germany: I stay off BEL/KIE/BUR/PIC if F BEL and northern units stay off Burgundy/Picardy. Germany has not yet agreed. Watch German BOH/SIL/BER retaliation on MUN.

Fall 1908: kept pacts with Austria, Turkey, France. F NAP to ION (allowed by all pacts) to enable a future A GRE convoy. Watch Austria A BUL/F TRI and Turkey A BUL. France says A MUN/POR/MAR hold; F MAO away from Tunis.

Fall 1908: RUM holds with BUD and SER supporting against Russia GAL+UKR. VIE and TRI hold against Germany BOH and Italy pact. Russia, Germany, Turkey pacts broken. Italy kept word. Turkey took BUL; retake later via RUM/SER/BUD. Revisit counterattack in Spring 1909.

Fall 1908: A BUL holds, F BLA supports BUL holding, A SMY holds. Keeping Black Sea line. Promised Austria/Russia/Italy no entry to SER/RUM/SEV/ARM/ANK. Austria threatens BUL; Russia and Italy have kept word so far. Next: hold BUL, watch Austria RUM support.

Fall 1908: GAL to RUM with SEV and UKR support to take Austria's RUM; MOS to WAR to secure our empty center; SWE holds. Germany agreed no Russian entry into PRU/BER/DEN/KIE. Austria refused to withdraw. Turkey promised to keep BLA out of RUM/SEV. England kept north terms. Next: reassess BUD/VIE and retake or hold RUM.

Fall 1908: BOH to MUN dislodges French A MUN (retake German SC), BER and KIE support. BEL, DEN hold. Broke planned VIE attack, since Vienna is well defended. Promised England no move on HOL, France MUN/Belgium stance now hostile. Russia: no entry to PRU/BER/DEN/KIE, kept so far. Watch France retaliation from BUR.

messages.body: Austria here. A RUM holds this Spring, supported by A BUD and A SER. I will not withdraw under threat. Your A GAL and A UKR striking Rumania means a long fight with no gain for either of us. Pull A GAL back to Galicia and keep A WAR and A MOS out of Galicia and Rumania, and I will discuss a Ukraine line with you.

Austria here. A VIE holds with A BUD in support, and Vienna will not be given up. Your A BOH attacking Vienna will fail and cost you a unit. Withdraw A BOH to Silesia or Bohemia-free ground, keep out of Tyrolia, and we can agree a stable border before the next turn.

Austria here. Bulgaria is a stolen centre and I will retake it when I can. For now, I ask that A CON and F BLA turn against Russia's SEV or hold, and that you keep out of Serbia and Rumania. Continued pressure on Bulgaria means open war on the Balkan front.

England here, Spring 1909. I hold A HOL with F NTH supporting, and F NOR and F LON stay put. Please confirm F BEL, A KIE and A DEN stay off Holland this spring. If you plan any move toward HOL or the North Sea, tell me first so we avoid a misunderstanding.

England here, Spring 1909. F NOR, F NTH, F NWG and F LON hold, and my fleets stay out of the Baltic and Sweden. Please confirm no Russian unit enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI this spring, and that A WAR and A LVN are still heading south. Tell me before any change in the north.

France, Spring 1909: A MUN holds this turn, as you know it's a German centre and I'll be honest about it. I won't move it toward Belgium, Kiel or Berlin. Please keep F BEL, A BER, A KIE and A DEN off Burgundy, Picardy and Paris, and we can both focus east. Will you confirm?

France, Spring 1909: A MAR, A PAR, A POR and A BUR hold, and F MAO stays in the Atlantic, away from Tunis and Italy. Please keep F NAP, F TUN, A VEN and F AEG out of the Gulf of Lyon, Spain and Piedmont. I'll tell you first if my plans change.

Germany here. Spring 1909: my units hold: A MUN, A BER, A KIE, A DEN, F BEL. I will not enter Bohemia or Tyrolia this spring if A VIE and A TRI hold. Please send your Spring 1909 orders for VIE, TRI, BUD, SER and RUM in writing, and tell me if Russia moves on Galicia.

Germany here. Spring 1909: my units hold in BER, KIE, DEN, BEL and MUN. I will not enter Galicia, Warsaw, Ukraine or Rumania. Please keep A MOS, A WAR and F SWE out of Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel. Tell me your exact Spring orders for GAL, UKR, WAR, SEV and SWE.

Italy to Turkey: Spring 1909. Greece and the Ionian remain Italian, and my A GRE and F AEG stay out of Bulgaria and Smyrna. I'd like Turkey to press Austria through Serbia and Rumania. Please confirm your Spring 1909 orders and whether your fleets plan any move toward Greece or the Aegean.

Italy to Austria: My F ION stays out of the Adriatic and Albania, and A VEN stays out of Trieste, Tyrolia and Vienna. I am not moving against Bulgaria this Spring. Please confirm your Spring 1909 orders and tell me whether Austrian units plan any move toward Venice or Greece.

Italy to France: Our arrangement holds for Spring 1909. A VEN, F TUN and F ION will not enter the Gulf of Lyon, Spain or Piedmont. Please confirm that your Piedmont, Tunis and Mediterranean-coast units stay out of Italian waters this year, and tell me first if your plans change.

Russia here. Spring 1909: A GAL and A UKR strike RUM, and A WAR holds Warsaw. Your A BOH should press VIE, and I will not enter Bohemia or Vienna. Keep your units out of Galicia, Warsaw and Ukraine. Tell me your exact Spring orders so we can coordinate on Austria.

Russia here. Spring 1909: F SEV holds, and A UKR attacks RUM, not your side. Please keep F BLA out of Sevastopol and Rumania as promised, and A MOS stays out of Armenia and Ankara. Are A BUL and A SMY moving against Austria this Spring? Confirm your exact orders.

Turkey here. Bulgaria is held by our A BUL with F BLA support and will stay ours this Spring. I have no units moving into Serbia or Rumania. Pull A RUM and A SER back from Bulgaria's border and I will keep my fleets in the Black Sea. Let's end this dispute and focus on Russia and Italy.

Austria confirms our pact for Spring 1909. A VIE and F TRI hold, and A VEN stays out of Trieste, Tyrolia and Vienna. No Austrian unit moves toward Venice or Greece this spring. Please keep F ION out of the Adriatic and Albania, and tell me your Aegean plans against Turkey before any Greek move.

Austria here. A VIE, F TRI, A BUD, A SER and A RUM all hold this Spring. Your A BOH is attacking Vienna, which will fail and cost you a unit. Withdraw it to Silesia or Bohemia-free ground and keep out of Tyrolia. Then we can settle a stable border.

Austria will not accept Turkish units holding Bulgaria. A BUL is stolen and will be retaken. A SER and A RUM hold. Turn A CON and F BLA against Russia's SEV or hold, and stay out of Serbia and Rumania. Otherwise the Balkan front stays at war.

France here. Confirmed for Spring 1909: A MAR, A PAR, A POR and A BUR hold, and none enters Piedmont, Tunis or the Italian coast. F MAO stays in the Atlantic. Please keep F NAP, F TUN, A VEN and F ION out of the Gulf of Lyon, Spain and Piedmont as agreed. I will tell you first if my plans change.

Germany here. Confirmed for Spring 1909: F BEL, A KIE and A DEN hold, and I am not moving on Holland. Please keep F NTH supporting A HOL and keep your fleets out of Denmark, Kiel and the Baltic. I will give you notice before any change near the North Sea or Channel.

Germany here. Spring 1909: F BEL, A BER, A KIE, A DEN and A MUN all hold, so nothing moves toward Burgundy, Picardy, Paris or Brest. Please keep A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and F MAO out of Belgium and Munich. We can talk about Belgium once the eastern war is clearly under way.

Germany here. My Spring 1909 orders hold in BER, KIE, DEN, BEL and MUN. I will not enter Galicia, Warsaw, Ukraine or Rumania. Please keep A MOS, A WAR and F SWE out of Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel as agreed. Tell me your exact orders for GAL, UKR, WAR, SEV and SWE.

Germany here. I hold my units this Spring and will not enter Bohemia or Tyrolia while A VIE and A TRI hold. I have noted your word on Vienna. If you want a stable border, confirm your Spring orders for VIE, TRI, BUD, SER and RUM in writing and keep them clear of Silesia and Munich.

Italy to France: Confirmed for Spring 1909. A VEN and F TUN hold, and F ION stays out of the Gulf of Lyon, Spain and Piedmont. I have no plans against you this year. Please keep A MAR, A BUR, A PAR and F MAO out of Piedmont and Tunis, and tell me first if your plans change.

Russia here. Spring 1909: A GAL and A UKR strike RUM this spring, and A WAR holds Warsaw. I am not moving A WAR or A MOS into Galicia or Rumania. If A RUM, A BUD and A SER pull back to Serbia and Bulgaria, I will not attack BUD, VIE or SER this spring. Otherwise, expect a fight for Rumania.

Russia here. Confirmed for Spring 1909: no Russian unit enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI. F SWE holds in Sweden and A WAR holds Warsaw, heading south away from the North Sea. I will tell you before any change in the north. Please keep your fleets out of the Baltic and Sweden as agreed.

Russia here. Spring 1909 orders: A GAL and A UKR strike RUM, A WAR holds Warsaw, F SEV and F SWE hold. No Russian unit enters PRU, BER, DEN, KIE, BOH or VIE. Bohemia and Vienna are yours to take. I will not contest them, and I will keep my units out of Galicia-to-Germany lines.

Turkey to Austria: A BUL holds this Spring with F BLA in support, and I will not move into Serbia or Rumania. Pull A RUM and A SER back from the Bulgarian border and I will keep my fleets in the Black Sea. Let's stop the Balkan dispute and discuss a line in the Aegean later.

Turkey to Russia: F BLA will not enter Sevastopol or Rumania this Spring. A ANK, A SMY and A BUL hold, and I will not move toward Armenia. Please keep A MOS out of Armenia and Ankara, and keep A UKR on Rumania rather than the Black Sea coast. We can coordinate against Austria afterwards.

Turkey to Italy: Greece and the Ionian remain yours. This Spring A ANK, A SMY, A BUL and F BLA hold, and none enters the Aegean or Greece. Please keep F NAP and A VEN out of Greece, the Aegean and Bulgaria. I will press Austria through Serbia and Rumania when the moment is right.

notes.note: Spring 1909: holding all to keep peace. Germany (F BEL, A KIE, A DEN hold, no move on HOL), Russia (no move into NOR/NWG/NTH/EDI) and France have kept word so far. No unowned centers reachable. Next: consider convoy HOL to DEN via HEL only if DEN/BEL are empty and Germany agrees.

Spring 1909: all hold to keep 5 SCs; no unowned centers reachable. Germany and Italy have kept their deals so far. Keep F MAO in Atlantic, off Tunis/Italy. Watch German BEL/MUN and any move toward BUR/PIC/PAR. Revisit when unowned centers appear.

Spring 1909: holding RUM with BUD and SER support against Russia GAL/UKR. VIE and TRI hold against Germany BOH. Turkey's BUL is still a stolen centre to retake later. Italy and Germany have kept word so far. Russia has not withdrawn. Revisit BUL in Fall if Turkey's CON/BLA are off.

Spring 1909: holding BEL, BER, DEN, KIE; MUN to BOH to press Vienna per Russia's Bohemia promise. Kept word to France (no BUR/PIC/PAR), England (no HOL), Russia (no PRU/BER/DEN/KIE entry). Austria's VIE holds; watch Russian GAL/UKR vs RUM. Next: convoy A DEN once F BEL reaches NTH safely.

Spring 1909: UKR to RUM supported by GAL and SEV to test Austria's RUM (3 vs 3 likely bounce). WAR and SWE hold. Austria refused to withdraw. Germany and England kept north terms. Turkey kept BLA out of RUM/SEV. Keep WAR and SWE home. Reassess GAL/BUD/VIE if Austria weakens.

Spring 1909: all hold. F BLA supports A BUL holding. Pacts: Russia (no SEV/ARM/ANK entry, BLA off SEV/RUM), Italy (Greece/Ionian theirs, no Aegean entry), Austria dispute over BUL, no entry to SER/RUM. Next: hold BUL, watch Austria RUM/SER support and Russia A MOS near ARM.

Spring 1909: F AEG to CON to take empty Turkish center, breaking Turkey pact since Turkey is weakest. Other units hold for now. Watch Turkish ANK/BUL retaliation and Austria pact (VEN out of TRI/TYR/VIE, ION out of ADR/ALB). France pact holds.

messages.body: Austria here. Your A BOH is a direct threat to VIE and TRI, and both will be defended. Withdraw A BOH to Silesia now and I will keep my units out of Silesia and Munich. Tell me your Fall orders for BOH and MUN in writing before we lock.

Austria here. Your A GAL and A UKR have fought over RUM for two years with no gain. Pull A GAL back to Galicia and I will accept a Ukraine line with you. A RUM, A BUD and A SER will hold, and we both keep our centres. Tell me your Fall orders for GAL and UKR.

Austria here. A BUL is a stolen centre and I intend to retake it. Withdraw A BUL and F BLA from Bulgaria or face open war on the Balkan front. If you turn A CON and F BLA against Russia's SEV instead, I will keep A RUM and A SER out of your Aegean and Black Sea plans.

England to Russia: Germany is our common rival in the north. For Fall 1909, could your A WAR and A GAL pressure Germany's Silesia and Prussia while my fleets watch Kiel and Denmark? I keep F NOR and F NTH out of the Baltic and Sweden, and I'll tell you before any change. Please confirm A WAR's destination this autumn.

England to Germany: You have kept your word on Holland, and I want to keep that peace. Please tell me your plans for A DEN, A KIE and F BEL this autumn, and whether you'd accept the arrangement that my fleets stay out of Denmark and Kiel while you stay off Holland and the North Sea.

France here. Munich is empty and German-owned, and my A BUR is adjacent. I intend to take it this autumn unless you object. In return I'll keep A PAR and A MAR away from Belgium and Kiel, and I'll help hold Belgium from any Russian or English move.

France here. Brest and Spain are empty, and my F MAO sits nearby. Please confirm F NTH and F LON will not enter the Channel, Brest or Spain this autumn. I'll keep F MAO in the Atlantic and out of English waters.

France here. I'm keeping A MAR, A POR, A PAR and F MAO away from Tunis, Piedmont and the Italian coast. Please confirm F TUN and F NAP stay out of Spain and the Gulf of Lyon. Tell me if you plan any move toward Western Mediterranean centres.

Germany here. Fall 1909: A BOH moves to MUN to retake our centre, which is empty now. F BEL, A BER, A KIE and A DEN hold. Please keep A BUR out of Munich and Belgium this autumn, and I will keep my units out of Burgundy, Picardy and Paris.

Germany here. This autumn A BOH goes to MUN, not VIE, to retake our centre. Keep A WAR, A MOS and F SWE out of Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel as agreed. I will not enter Galicia, Warsaw, Ukraine or Rumania. Please press Austria in the south.

Germany here. This Fall my A BOH moves to Munich to retake a German centre, not to attack Vienna. Please keep your units out of Bohemia, Silesia and Munich, and tell me your Fall orders so we can settle the border calmly.

Italy to Turkey: My F AEG moved into CON in Spring and F CON holds it now. I know this broke our pact. I propose we settle: I hold CON this Fall, and I keep A GRE and F ION out of Smyrna, Bulgaria and the Aegean if A ANK and A BUL stay out of CON and Greece. Please confirm your Fall 1909 orders.

Italy to Austria: F CON is now mine, so Turkey's position has changed. Our Adriatic pact stands: A VEN, F ION and F TUN stay out of Trieste, Tyrolia, Vienna and Albania. Please confirm your Fall 1909 orders, and tell me whether A SER or A BUD plan any move toward Greece.

Russia here. This Fall A GAL and A UKR attack RUM, and A WAR and F SEV hold. Withdraw A RUM to SER or BUL now and A GAL and A UKR will stop at the border. Hold RUM and you lose BUD or SER to Germany and Turkey while we fight. Tell me your orders before they lock.

Turkey to Italy: Your F CON is sitting in my capital, which breaks our agreement. Withdraw it now. I am ordering A ANK to CON with F BLA and A BUL supporting, and I will hold Bulgaria and Smyrna. Let's talk about Greece and the Adriatic after you leave.

Turkey to Russia: A ANK and F BLA are attacking Constantinople this Fall because Italy's fleet is in it. Please keep A MOS out of Armenia and Ankara, and F SEV out of the Black Sea line. I am not moving toward Rumania or Sevastopol.

Turkey to Austria: Bulgaria stays Turkish and A BUL holds. I have no units moving into Serbia or Rumania. Keep A RUM and A SER off Bulgaria, and we can talk about a line once Italy's fleet is out of Constantinople.

Austria here. VIE, TRI and BUD hold this Fall, and we will not move north toward Bohemia, Silesia or Munich. Your A BOH moving to MUN is your business, but any move back into Bohemia or Tyrolia will meet resistance. Confirm your Fall orders for BOH and MUN in writing, and keep BER, KIE, DEN and BEL on their side of the line.

Austria's answer is no. A RUM holds this Fall, supported by A BUD and A SER, and I will not withdraw under threat. Pull A GAL and A UKR back to Galicia and Ukraine and I will discuss a Ukraine line. Keep A WAR and F SEV out of Galicia and Rumania. Otherwise you will fight for RUM with no gain.

Austria confirms our pact for Fall 1909. F TRI holds, A VIE holds, and no Austrian unit moves toward Venice, Albania or the Adriatic. A SER and A BUD hold this Fall and will not move toward Greece. Please keep A VEN, F ION and F TUN out of Trieste, Tyrolia, Vienna and Albania as you have promised.

Austria will not accept Turkish units holding Bulgaria. BUL is a stolen centre and I intend to retake it. Withdraw A BUL and F BLA from Bulgaria or face open war on the Balkan front. Turn A CON and F BLA against Russia's SEV instead, and A RUM and A SER will stay out of your Black Sea and Aegean plans.

England here. Confirmed for Fall 1909: F LON and F NTH will not enter the Channel, Brest or Spain this autumn. Both hold in place. Please keep F MAO out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI as agreed, and tell me before any change near Norway or the North Sea.

France here. I am moving A BUR to Munich this autumn. It is a German centre and it is empty, so I am taking it, and your A BOH move will bounce. I will not move A PAR or A MAR toward Belgium or Kiel. Keep F BEL, A BER, A KIE and A DEN off Burgundy, Picardy and Paris, and we can focus on Austria and Russia.

Germany here. This Fall A BOH moves to Munich, not Vienna. I will not move toward Vienna, Tyrolia or Trieste this autumn. Please keep your units out of Bohemia, Silesia and Munich, and we can settle a stable border after this turn.

Germany here. A BOH is moving to Munich this Fall to retake our centre, so A BUR must not move there. Keep A BUR, A PAR and A MAR out of Munich and Belgium, and I will keep F BEL, A BER, A KIE and A DEN off Burgundy, Picardy and Paris.

Germany here. I hold F BEL, A KIE and A DEN this Fall and will not move on Holland or the North Sea. I accept your arrangement: your fleets stay out of Denmark, Kiel and the Baltic, and mine stay out of your home waters. Tell me first if that changes.

Italy to France: Confirmed for Fall 1909. F TUN holds in Tunis, A VEN holds in Venice, and F ION stays out of the Western Mediterranean, Spain and the Gulf of Lyon. I have no move against your A MAR, A POR, A PAR or F MAO. Please keep them away from Tunis and Piedmont, and tell me first if your plans change.

Italy to Turkey: I accept that F CON broke our pact and I am willing to withdraw it this Fall to the Aegean, leaving Constantinople to you. In return, A GRE and F ION stay out of Smyrna, Bulgaria and the Aegean, and your A ANK, A BUL and F BLA stay out of Greece and the Ionian. Please confirm these orders before we move.

Russia here. A GAL and A UKR attack RUM this Fall, and A WAR holds Warsaw. Pull A RUM out to SER or BUL and I will stop at the border and not attack BUD, VIE or SER. If RUM holds, we fight there. Tell me your answer before orders lock.

Russia here. Confirmed: no Russian unit enters PRU, BER, DEN or KIE this Fall. A WAR holds Warsaw, F SWE holds, and A GAL and A UKR strike Rumania, not your lines. Press Austria in the south with A BOH. Keep your units out of Galicia and Warsaw as agreed.

Russia here. A WAR holds Warsaw this Fall, not Galicia or the north. A GAL and A UKR are fighting in Rumania. F SWE holds in Sweden. No Russian unit enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI. Keep your fleets out of the Baltic and Sweden. I will tell you before any change in the north.

Russia here. F SEV holds on Sevastopol and A UKR attacks RUM, not the Black Sea. Please keep F BLA out of SEV and RUM as promised. Good luck taking Constantinople. I have no units near Armenia or Ankara, and I will keep it that way while we both hold our word.

Turkey to Austria: Bulgaria is Turkish and A BUL holds this Fall with F BLA support. I am not moving into Serbia or Rumania. Keep A RUM and A SER off Bulgaria and out of the Black Sea, and we can discuss a line in the Aegean and against Russia once Italy's F CON is gone from Constantinople.

Turkey to Italy: Your F CON is in my capital and breaks our pact. This Fall A ANK moves to CON, supported by F BLA and A BUL. Withdraw F CON now. If it leaves, I will not enter Greece or the Ionian, and we can talk about the Adriatic. If it stays, expect it to be dislodged.

notes.note: Fall 1909: all holds, no unowned centers reachable. Germany, Russia and France kept word. Keep peace; F NTH supports nothing needed. Next: consider F NTH to HEL, then convoy HOL to DEN only if DEN/BEL empty and Germany agrees. Watch Germany's A KIE/A DEN/F BEL.

Fall 1909: A BUR to MUN to take empty German centre; Germany's BOH to MUN should bounce. MAR, PAR, POR, MAO hold, keeping off Belgium, Kiel, Tunis, Italy. Germany, England, Italy confirmed deals this turn. Watch Germany's reply on MUN and any move toward PAR/BUR. Next: hold BUR/MUN area, keep Atlantic and Spain quiet.

Fall 1909: hold RUM with BUD and SER support against Russia GAL+UKR. VIE and TRI hold vs Germany BOH (which says it goes to MUN). Turkey and Italy kept word so far. Retake BUL when Turkish units leave. Watch Russia's WAR support.

Fall 1909: F CON holds to keep Constantinople against Turkey's A ANK/F BLA/A BUL attack. Turkey broke pact by attacking CON; Austria and France confirmed holds. No unowned centers reachable. Hold GRE/ION/TUN/VEN to keep pacts. Consider withdrawing CON to AEG if dislodgement looks certain, to save the fleet. Recheck Turkey and Austria in Spring 1910.

Fall 1909: BOH to MUN to hold our centre, BER and KIE support. BUR to MUN should bounce, but I told France MUN was mine, so that broke my promise to them. BEL and DEN hold. Austria and Russia have kept their word so far; watch France at MUN and Russia at BER/KIE.

Fall 1909: GAL and UKR and SEV strike RUM (3v3 bounce expected), WAR and SWE hold. Keep promises: no Russian unit into PRU/BER/DEN/KIE, north and Baltic. Austria refuses to withdraw from RUM, so keep pressure. Next: check whether Austria's RUM holds and whether BUD/VIE weaken.

Fall 1909: A ANK attacks CON (Italy F CON) supported by A BUL and A SMY. F BLA supports BUL holding against Austria. Italy broke pact by moving F AEG into CON; wants it out. Keep Black Sea line off SEV/RUM, no ARM entry. Watch Austria vs BUL and Italy's F CON withdrawal.

messages.body: Austria here. Your A GAL and A UKR attacking RUM only trade units with no gain for either of us. Pull A GAL back to Galicia and keep A UKR out of Rumania, and I will hold a Ukraine line with you. Keep A WAR and F SEV out of Galicia and Rumania. Tell me your Spring orders before they lock.

Austria here. Bulgaria is a stolen centre and I intend to retake it. Withdraw A BUL and F BLA from Bulgaria now, or we fight on the Balkan front. If A CON and F BLA turn against Russia's Sevastopol instead, I will keep A RUM and A SER out of your Black Sea and Aegean plans.

Austria here. Our Adriatic pact stands: F TRI holds, and no Austrian unit moves toward Venice, Albania or Greece. Please keep A VEN, F ION and F TUN out of Trieste, Tyrolia, Vienna and Albania. Tell me your Spring orders for the Aegean and Constantinople so we do not collide while pressing Turkey.

England here, Spring 1910. My fleets hold NTH, NOR, LON and EDI, and A HOL stays put. Let's keep our arrangement: my fleets stay out of Denmark, Kiel and the Baltic, and yours stay off Holland and the North Sea. Please confirm A DEN, A KIE and F BEL hold this spring, and tell me first of any change.

England here, Spring 1910. My fleets hold NOR, NWG, NTH and LON, and stay out of the Baltic and Sweden. Please confirm no Russian unit enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI this spring, and that F SWE holds. Tell me before any change in the north.

France here, Spring 1910. I regret breaking my Munich word. A MUN is German again, and I will not attack it. Will you keep F BEL, A BER, A KIE and A DEN off Burgundy, Picardy and Paris? I will keep A BUR, A PAR and A MAR off Belgium and Kiel. Tell me before any move toward Burgundy.

France here, Spring 1910. A MAR, A PAR, A POR and A BUR hold, and F MAO stays in the Atlantic, away from Tunis and Italy. Please confirm F TUN, F NAP, A VEN and F ION stay out of the Gulf of Lyon, Spain and Piedmont this spring. I will tell you first if my plans change.

Germany here. A BUR to Munich bounced last Fall and A MUN is mine now. Munich stays German this spring. Pull A BUR back to Burgundy and keep A PAR, A MAR and A POR out of Belgium and Ruhr. Then I will keep F BEL and A KIE off Picardy and Paris. Will you confirm in writing?

Germany here. I hold A MUN, A BER, A KIE, A DEN and F BEL this spring and will not move into Bohemia, Silesia or Tyrolia. Keep your units out of Munich and Silesia and tell me your Spring orders for VIE, TRI, BUD and SER in writing, so we can settle a stable border.

Germany here. Russia has kept its word in the north and I will keep my units out of Galicia, Warsaw, Ukraine and Rumania. Let us both press Austria, which holds VIE, TRI, BUD, SER and RUM. Tell me your exact Spring 1910 orders for GAL, UKR, WAR and SWE so we coordinate.

Italy to Turkey: F CON has retreated to AEG and Constantinople is yours again. I will not move against CON, BUL or SMY this Spring. Please keep A CON, A BUL and F BLA out of Greece and the Ionian, and I will keep A GRE and F AEG out of your home centres. Can you confirm?

Italy to Austria: Our Adriatic pact still stands. A VEN, F ION and A GRE will not enter Trieste, Tyrolia, Vienna, Albania or Serbia this Spring. Please confirm F TRI and A SER will stay out of the Adriatic, Albania and Greece, and tell me if Austrian plans toward Venice change.

Russia here. The RUM fight has cost us both units for two years. Spring 1910 proposal: A RUM retreats to SER or BUD holds, and A GAL and A UKR stop at the Rumanian border. I will not attack BUD, VIE or SER this spring. Tell me your orders before they lock.

Russia here. I will keep A WAR, A GAL, A UKR and F SWE out of Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel, as agreed. Please confirm your Spring 1910 orders and that you will not enter Galicia, Warsaw or Ukraine. Press Austria in the south with A BOH while I fight for Rumania.

Spring 1911: all hold. Attacking RUM bounces (3v3) and would break Ukraine line and Turkey split. Kept promises to Germany, England, Turkey, Austria. Watch Austria RUM and Turkey; reassess Fall 1911 for a RUM/BUD opening if Austria weakens.

Spring 1911: BUR moves to MUN, opportunistic since German A MUN said it is leaving for Bohemia; this breaks my no-Munich promise. If BUR is bounced, I stay in BUR. Other units hold: MAO, MAR, PAR, POR. Italy and England have kept their deals so far. Germany's reply on MUN is the key risk; watch BEL and BUR.

Spring 1911: holding BUL with BLA support, CON and SMY hold. Pacts: Russia keeps SEV/UKR off Armenia/Ankara, BLA out of SEV/RUM. Italy keeps GRE/AEG/ION off CON/BUL/SMY. Austria pledged RUM/SER/BUD holds. Watch Austria attack on BUL and whether Italy moves west. Consider ANK occupation or Greece only if pacts break.

Spring 1911: held all units to keep pacts with Austria, Turkey, France. Plan: consider Fall pressure on Turkey's Aegean (AEG/GRE vs BUL/CON/SMY) with Austria's agreement. Watch Turkey A BUL/A CON for moves toward GRE/ION and Austria A SER for GRE. Austria and Turkey have kept their pledges so far.

messages.body: Austria here. For Fall 1911 I hold A RUM, A BUD, A SER, F TRI and A VIE, and I will not enter Galicia or Ukraine. Please confirm in writing that A GAL, A UKR, A WAR and F SEV will not strike Rumania or Galicia this autumn. If you keep your word, we both keep our centres.

England here, Fall 1911. I'm holding F LON, F NTH, F NOR and A HOL this autumn, so no move on Brest, Picardy, Belgium or Spain. Your A MUN now sits on a German centre. Please keep F MAO out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI as agreed, and tell me of any change near Belgium or Spain.

England here, Fall 1911. Your Munich is under French pressure, and I don't want to see you lose it. I'm holding HOL, NTH and NOR, with no move toward Belgium, Denmark or Kiel. Please confirm F BEL, A KIE and A DEN hold, and tell me your plans against France so we can coordinate.

England here, Fall 1911. Confirming my northern fleets F NOR, F NTH and F LON hold this autumn, with no move into the Baltic or Sweden. Please confirm no Russian unit enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI, and that F SWE holds. I'll tell you first of any change in the north.

France here. I broke my Munich word by moving A BUR to MUN this spring, and I regret the breach. I'm holding MUN this Fall and will not advance further toward Belgium, Ruhr or Kiel. Let's agree: you keep out of Burgundy and Picardy, and I'll offer to return MUN to you in Spring 1912 if you hold to that. Will you accept?

France here, Fall 1911. F MAO stays in the Atlantic this autumn, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI, as agreed. Please keep F LON and F NTH out of the Channel, Brest, Picardy and Spain. I'll tell you before any change near Spain or Portugal.

Germany here. France took Munich this spring with A BUR. My A BOH moves to Munich this Fall to retake it, so expect a clash there. Pull A MUN back to Burgundy or Ruhr now and I will not pursue into Burgundy, Picardy or Paris. Keep A PAR, A MAR and A POR off Belgium and the Ruhr.

Germany here. A BOH is leaving Bohemia for Munich this Fall, so I am no longer pressing Vienna from the north. Please keep your units out of Bohemia, Silesia and Munich, and tell me your Fall orders for VIE, TRI and BUD.

Italy to Austria: I plan to attack Turkey this Fall. A GRE moves toward Bulgaria with F AEG supporting, and F ION stays in the Ionian. Please confirm A SER and A RUM will not enter Greece or Bulgaria without telling me first. If Turkey collapses, we should agree on how to divide its centres.

Italy to Turkey: I intend to press your Aegean this Fall, with F AEG threatening Smyrna and A GRE moving toward Bulgaria. Your units are scattered. If you pull A SMY back toward Ankara and keep F BLA in the Black Sea, I will consider a truce and talk about Austria. Otherwise I will fight for Smyrna and Bulgaria.

Russia here, Fall 1911. Your A RUM, BUD and SER are still on the table. Tell me your exact Fall orders for RUM, BUD, SER and VIE. I will keep A GAL and A UKR out of Rumania only if A RUM holds or retreats to SER. Confirm in writing before orders lock.

Russia here. I am holding A WAR in Warsaw and F SWE in Sweden, with no Russian unit entering PRU, BER, DEN or KIE. Please confirm your Fall orders for MUN and BOH, and that no German unit enters Galicia or Warsaw. Let us plan Austria's centres together.

Russia here. F SEV holds, A UKR holds, and no Russian unit moves toward Armenia or Ankara this Fall. Please confirm F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM, and that A CON, A BUL and A SMY stay out of UKR. Tell me your Fall orders so we avoid any clash.

Turkey to Russia: Fall 1911 plan: A CON, A BUL and A SMY hold, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. Please confirm F SEV and A UKR stay off Armenia and Ankara, and tell me whether A WAR or A MOS will move south toward Ukraine or Armenia.

Turkey to Austria: BUL is held this Fall with F BLA support, and I will not enter Serbia or Rumania. Please confirm A RUM, A SER and A BUD hold as pledged. Any attack on Bulgaria means open war, and I would rather keep the Balkan line stable.

Turkey to Italy: I hold CON, BUL and SMY this Fall and will not enter Greece or the Ionian. Are F AEG and F ION moving west? Tell me before any Aegean move so we avoid a misunderstanding, and confirm your pledge to keep out of Constantinople, Bulgaria and Smyrna.

Austria here. Fall 1911: A RUM holds, supported by A BUD and A SER. No Austrian unit enters Galicia or Ukraine this autumn. In return, A GAL, A UKR, A WAR and F SEV must not enter Rumania, Galicia or Budapest. Any move against RUM ends our line, so keep your word.

Austria here. VIE, TRI and BUD hold this Fall, and no Austrian unit will move into Bohemia, Silesia or Munich. Please keep BER, KIE, DEN and BEL on your side of the line, and keep your Munich move away from Tyrolia and Vienna. We can settle a stable border after this turn.

Austria here. A SER and A RUM will not enter Greece this Fall, and I will not move toward Venice, Albania or Trieste. Bulgaria is a centre I intend to recover, so tell me before your A GRE enters it, and we can discuss how Turkish centres are divided once Constantinople falls.

Austria here. BUL is a stolen centre and I intend to retake it. Withdraw A BUL and F BLA to Constantinople or the Aegean and I will hold my Balkan line. If you keep BUL held with BLA support, I will attack it this autumn, and you cannot afford a second front.

England here. Confirmed: F LON, F NTH and F NOR stay out of the Channel, Brest, Picardy, Belgium and Spain this autumn. I am holding all units in place. Please keep F MAO in the Atlantic and out of English waters, LVP and EDI as agreed. If your plans change near Spain or Portugal, tell me first.

France here. Agreed: F MAO stays in the Atlantic this autumn, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I'll give notice before any move near Spain or Portugal. Please keep F LON, F NTH, F NOR and A HOL off Brest, Picardy, Belgium and Spain as you've said.

France here. A MUN holds this Fall and I will not move it toward Belgium, Ruhr or Kiel. I can't vacate it now, but I'll discuss returning it once Spring 1912 settles. Keep F BEL, A BER, A KIE and A DEN off Burgundy, Picardy and Paris, and your A BOH move to Munich will bounce.

Germany here. This Fall A BOH holds in Bohemia and F BEL, A BER, A KIE and A DEN hold. No German unit enters Galicia or Warsaw. Keep A WAR, A MOS and F SWE out of Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel. Press Vienna from the east and south, and we can split Austria's centres once VIE falls.

Germany here. Confirmed: F BEL, A KIE and A DEN hold this Fall, and I make no move on Holland or the North Sea. France now holds Munich, and I am weighing my options against it. I will tell you before any change near the Channel or Belgium.

Germany here. I will not attack Munich this Fall, and A BOH holds in Bohemia. I accept that MUN returns to Germany in Spring 1912 if your A BUR and A PAR, A MAR and A POR stay out of Burgundy, Picardy, Belgium and the Ruhr. Confirm the return in writing and I will keep my word.

Italy to Turkey: F AEG, F ION and A GRE hold this Fall. None of them moves toward Smyrna, Bulgaria or Constantinople. My earlier warning applies only if your A SMY, A BUL or F BLA moves toward Greece or the Aegean. Keep those units out of the Aegean and Ionian, and our border stands.

Russia here. Fall 1911: A GAL holds Galicia, A UKR holds Ukraine, A WAR and F SEV hold at home. I will not attack Rumania this autumn. Please keep your units on your side of the line and hold RUM, BUD, SER and VIE as you described. If you keep your word, we both keep our centres.

Russia confirms Fall 1911: no Russian unit enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI. F SWE holds in Sweden and my fleets stay out of the Baltic and North Sea. Keep your fleets out of the Baltic and Sweden as agreed, and I will tell you first of any change in the north.

Russia confirms Fall 1911: F SEV holds, A UKR holds, A WAR holds Warsaw, and no Russian unit moves toward Armenia or Ankara. Please keep F BLA out of SEV and RUM, and keep A CON, A BUL and A SMY out of Ukraine. We both do better if we keep our word.

Turkey to Italy: A CON, A BUL and A SMY hold this Fall, and F BLA stays in the Black Sea. I will not move into Greece or the Ionian. Your F AEG is the threat to Smyrna, so keep it out of SMY and CON. Confirm F AEG and F ION stay put this Fall, and we can discuss Austria afterwards.

Turkey to Russia: Confirmed. A CON, A BUL and A SMY hold this Fall, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. Please keep F SEV and A UKR off Armenia and Ankara, and tell me whether A WAR or A MOS moves south toward Ukraine or Armenia. Any move there breaks our split.

notes.note: Fall 1911: all hold, MUN held to keep it. Promised Germany to return MUN in Spring 1912 if A BUR/PAR/MAR/POR stay out of BUR, PIC, BEL, RUH. Germany agreed to hold A BOH. Italy and England kept deals. Watch Germany on MUN and England near BEL/PIC/SPA.

Fall 1911: A GRE to BUL supported by F AEG to attack Turkish BUL. ION, TUN, VEN hold to keep pacts with France and Austria. Austria asked to be told before GRE enters BUL; Turkey has kept CON/BUL/SMY holds. Next: take BUL if it falls, then split Turkish centres with Austria.

Fall 1911: all hold, keeping promises to Austria (no RUM attack), Turkey (SEV/UKR split), England and Germany (north and Baltic). Austria's RUM still supported by BUD and SER, so an attack would bounce. Reassess Spring 1912 for RUM/BUD if Austria weakens.

Fall 1911: holding all units to keep peace with Germany, Russia, France, who have all kept word. No unowned centers reachable. Next: watch Germany's stance on Munich vs France; consider convoy HOL to DEN via HEL only if DEN/BEL empty and Germany agrees.

Fall 1911: BOH to MUN retakes French-held German SC, supported by BER and KIE (3 vs 1). Broke my word to France (no MUN attack) and must concede it. Keep BEL, DEN, BER, KIE holding. Keep England and Russia promises (no HOL/NTH, no PRU/BER/DEN/KIE entry).

Fall 1911: all hold, keeping 5 centres. BUL attack from RUM with SER support only ties vs BLA-supported BUL, so no move. Russia GAL/UKR line and Italy Adriatic pact still kept. Turkey pledged no Serbia/Rumania entry. Retake BUL when Turkish units leave. Watch Russia RUM attack with SEV/GAL/UKR, and Italy GRE moving toward BUL.

Fall 1911: all hold, F BLA supports BUL holding against Austria. Italy threatens SMY via F AEG; Russia has kept word so far. Austria may attack BUL; hold the line and watch RUM/SER support. Consider expansion only if pacts break.

messages.body: Austria here. Spring 1911 has Italy pressing your Aegean, and Russia's GAL and UKR still face my RUM. I'm willing to keep my Balkan line if BUL is vacated. If A BUL and F BLA stay, I will attack BUL this Spring, so decide now.

Austria here. Your A GRE moving toward Bulgaria is a problem for me, since I intend to recover BUL. Tell me your Spring orders for GRE, AEG and ION. I will keep A SER and A RUM out of Greece, and I expect you to keep out of BUL and Rumania.

Austria here. Your A GAL, A UKR and A WAR are adjacent to my RUM. Confirm in writing that none of them enters Rumania or Budapest this Spring. I hold RUM with BUD and SER support and will not enter Galicia or Ukraine. Break this and the line ends.

England here, Spring 1912. France now holds Munich and is strong in the west. I propose we coordinate against France: you press from Munich and Burgundy while I keep my fleets ready for the Channel and Brest later. Please confirm F BEL, A KIE and A DEN hold this spring, and tell me your move first.

England here, Spring 1912. I hold F LON, F NTH, F NOR and A HOL this spring, with no move on Brest, Picardy, Belgium or Spain. Please confirm F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel and English waters, and tell me your plans for Spain and Portugal before any change.

England here, Spring 1912. My F NOR, F NTH and F LON hold, and no English fleet enters the Baltic, Sweden, NWG or EDI. Please confirm no Russian unit enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI this spring and that F SWE holds. Tell me first of any change in the north.

France here, Spring 1912. I'm holding A BUR in Burgundy this spring and will not move it toward Munich, Belgium or Ruhr. Tell me exactly where your units are and whether A BOH or any other German unit is moving to Munich. I'll decide on returning MUN once you confirm no moves into Burgundy, Picardy or Paris.

France here, Spring 1912. F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI, as agreed. Please confirm F LON, F NTH and F NOR stay off Brest, Picardy, Belgium and Spain this spring. I'll give you notice before any move near Spain or Portugal.

Germany here, Spring 1912. MUN is German and I hold it this spring, so please confirm in writing that A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and A POR stay out of Burgundy, Picardy, Belgium and the Ruhr. I will not move toward Paris or Burgundy. Tell me your Spring orders for A BUR and A MAR.

Germany here, Spring 1912. A MUN holds and F BEL, A BER, A KIE and A DEN hold. I will not enter Galicia, Warsaw or Ukraine. Please confirm A WAR, A MOS and F SWE stay out of Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel. What are your Spring orders for GAL, UKR and RUM? Let us agree on dividing Austria's centres.

Germany here, Spring 1912. I am holding Munich and Bohemia is not a threat to you this spring. Please confirm VIE, TRI and BUD stay out of Bohemia, Silesia, Munich and Tyrolia. Tell me your Spring orders for A SER, A RUM and F TRI so we can keep our border calm.

Italy here, Spring 1912. I intend A GRE to Bulgaria, with F AEG moving to support it, so you have notice as promised. I ask that A SER and A RUM stay out of Greece and Bulgaria this spring. Once Constantinople or Bulgaria falls, let's agree how the Turkish centres are split.

Italy here. My A GRE and F AEG are moving against Bulgaria and Smyrna this spring. Your best course is to pull A SMY back toward Ankara and keep F BLA in the Black Sea. If you do that, I will consider a truce and talk about how we divide the Balkans with Austria.

Russia here, Spring 1912. My A WAR holds Warsaw, A GAL and A UKR are in place, F SWE holds. Tell me your Spring moves against Austria in Bohemia and Galicia. I will not enter Prussia, Berlin, Denmark or Kiel. If Vienna falls, let us agree on splitting its centres.

Russia here, Spring 1912. I will keep F SEV and A UKR off Armenia and Ankara as agreed. Please confirm F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM, and that A CON, A BUL and A SMY stay out of Ukraine. Tell me your Spring orders so we avoid any clash.

Russia here, Spring 1912. Our old line on Rumania has held for years. If your A RUM, BUD and SER stay put, my A GAL and A UKR will not strike. Confirm your Spring orders in writing, and tell me whether your fleet or army is heading toward Galicia or Ukraine.

Turkey to Italy: My A CON, A BUL, A SMY and F BLA hold this Spring. I will not enter Greece or the Ionian. Your F AEG threatens Smyrna, so confirm in writing that F AEG, F ION and A GRE stay out of SMY, CON and BUL this Spring, and we keep the Aegean line.

Turkey to Austria: BUL stays Turkish and is held with F BLA support. I still have no plans for Serbia or Rumania. Please confirm A RUM, A SER and A BUD hold this Spring. Any attack on Bulgaria means open war, and you would face Turkey and Russia on two fronts.

Turkey to Russia: Our Armenia/Ankara/Sevastopol split still stands. Austria threatens Bulgaria and Rumania. Will your A GAL or A UKR pressure Austria's Rumania or Galicia this Spring? Tell me your Spring orders so we keep our word and avoid any clash in the Black Sea.

Austria here. A SER and A RUM will hold this Spring and stay out of Greece. Your A GRE moving into Bulgaria is a problem, since I intend to recover BUL. Tell me your exact GRE, AEG and ION orders now, and keep your units out of Trieste, Vienna, Tyrolia and Serbia.

Austria here. A RUM, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this Spring. I will not enter Galicia or Ukraine. Confirm in writing that A GAL, A UKR and A WAR do not enter Rumania or Budapest this Spring, and that F SEV stays out of Rumania. Break this and the line ends.

Austria here. VIE, TRI, BUD and SER hold this Spring, and RUM holds too. No Austrian unit moves into Bohemia, Silesia, Munich or Tyrolia. Please keep BER, KIE, DEN and BEL on your side of the line, and confirm in writing that your Spring moves stay away from Vienna and Trieste.

Austria here. A RUM, A SER and A BUD hold this Spring as pledged. BUL remains a centre I intend to recover, so if A BUL and F BLA stay, I will reassess in Fall. Keep your units out of Serbia and Rumania, and tell me if Italy's A GRE moves toward Bulgaria.

England here, Spring 1912. Confirmed: F LON, F NTH, F NOR and A HOL hold this spring, with no move on Brest, Picardy, Belgium or Spain. Please keep F MAO in the Atlantic and out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. If I ever change my plans near Spain or Portugal, I will tell you first, and I expect the same notice from you.

France here, Spring 1912. Confirmed: F MAO stays in the Atlantic this spring, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I'm holding A MAR, A PAR, A POR and A BUR, so no move toward Brest, Picardy, Belgium or Spain. Please keep F LON, F NTH and F NOR off those areas too. I'll give notice before any move near Spain or Portugal.

Germany here, Spring 1912. This spring F BEL, A KIE, A DEN, A BER and A MUN all hold. I will not enter Galicia, Warsaw, Ukraine or Rumania. Please keep A WAR, A MOS and F SWE out of Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel. Tell me your Spring orders for GAL, UKR and RUM, and we can discuss Austria's centres once Vienna is under pressure.

Germany here, Spring 1912. Confirmed: F BEL, A KIE and A DEN hold this spring, and I make no move on Holland or the North Sea. I am not ready to commit against France yet, so I will hold this turn. Keep your fleets out of Denmark, Kiel and the Baltic, and I will give notice before any change.

Germany here, Spring 1912. MUN is German and A MUN holds there this spring. Please confirm A BUR stays out of Munich, Burgundy's neighbours Belgium and Ruhr, and that A PAR, A MAR and A POR stay off Belgium and the Ruhr. I will not move toward Burgundy, Picardy or Paris. Tell me your Spring orders.

Italy here. A GRE to Bulgaria is aimed at Turkey, and I am not coming north of Greece. I will not move A SER or A RUM. Bulgaria should fall to whoever pressures Turkey hardest. Let's agree Austria takes Rumania-side centres later, and Italy keeps Greece, Smyrna and the Aegean. Keep F TRI out of the Adriatic.

Italy here. I cannot give written confirmation that F AEG stays out of Smyrna, since my moves are in motion. Pull A SMY back toward Ankara and keep F BLA in the Black Sea, and I will consider a truce and talk about the Balkans with Austria. Otherwise I will fight for Smyrna and Bulgaria.

Russia here. For Spring 1912, A GAL, A UKR and A WAR all hold. No Russian unit enters Rumania or Budapest this spring. I will not enter Galicia or Ukraine from your side either. Keep your RUM, BUD and SER units where they are and we both keep our centres.

Russia confirms Spring 1912: F SWE holds in Sweden, and no Russian unit enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI. Our fleets stay out of the Baltic and North Sea. Keep your F NOR, F NTH and F LON out of the Baltic and Sweden too, and I will tell you first of any change in the north.

Russia here, Spring 1912. A WAR holds Warsaw, A GAL and A UKR hold, and F SWE holds. No Russian unit enters PRU, BER, DEN or KIE. I will keep to that. Your Bohemia and Munich pressure on Vienna is your business. We can discuss Austria's centres once Vienna is under real threat.

Russia confirms Spring 1912: F SEV holds, A UKR holds, and no Russian unit moves toward Armenia or Ankara. Please keep F BLA out of SEV and RUM, and keep A CON, A BUL and A SMY out of Ukraine. Our split stands. I have no Spring move into Rumania planned, so Austria's RUM is not your concern from our side.

Turkey here. Italy's A GRE and F AEG moving on Bulgaria or Smyrna would break our pact. My A CON, A BUL, A SMY and F BLA hold this Spring and will not enter Greece or the Ionian. Confirm in writing that F AEG, F ION and A GRE stay out of SMY, CON and BUL. Then we can talk about Austria.

Turkey to Russia: Austria's A RUM and A SER threaten Bulgaria, and your A GAL and A UKR are the natural counter. Please press Rumania or Galicia this Spring so Vienna's units are tied down. Our Armenia, Ankara and Sevastopol split stands, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. Tell me your exact orders.
