Turkey to Austria: Bulgaria stays Turkish and is held with F BLA support. I have pledged no move into Serbia or Rumania. Confirm now that A RUM, A SER and A BUD hold this Spring. Any attack on Bulgaria means open war, and you would face Turkey and Russia on two fronts.

notes.note: Spring 1912: all hold, keeping promises to Austria (no RUM/BUD/Galicia/Ukraine entry), Turkey (SEV/UKR split, BLA out of SEV/RUM), Germany and England (no PRU/BER/DEN/KIE/north entry). Austria's RUM still supported by BUD and SER, so attack would bounce. Reassess Fall 1912 for RUM/BUD if Austria weakens or breaks its word.

Spring 1912: all hold to keep 5 SCs and honor deals. MUN is German; Germany and England have kept deals so far. Keep BUR/MAR/PAR/POR off BEL, PIC, RUH; MAO out of ENG/Channel. Revisit when unowned centres appear or if a deal breaks.

Spring 1912: all hold per pacts. Russia (GAL/UKR/WAR no entry to RUM/BUD) and Italy (no SER/RUM to GRE) have kept word so far. Turkey pledged no SER/RUM entry; BUL attack ties vs BLA support. Reassess BUL in Fall if Turkish CON/BLA leave; Italy GRE/BUL move is a watch item.

Spring 1912: all hold to keep word. MUN held, no moves into BUR/PIC/PAR/HOL/NTH/PRU/GAL/WAR/UKR/RUM. Russia, France, England, Austria have all kept their stated positions so far. No unowned centers; growth only by a future convoy (A DEN via NTH) or opportunity if a neighbor breaks faith. Watch France at BUR and Russia at SWE.

Spring 1912: A GRE to BUL supported by F AEG to take Turkish BUL. ION, TUN, VEN hold. Austria asked to keep RUM/SER out of GRE/BUL, and Italy promised no move north of Greece. Turkey pressed to pull A SMY back. Watch Turkish CON/BLA support into BUL.

Spring 1912: took empty Russian STP with F NOR, since no Russian unit can reach it this year. Broke word to Russia on north peace. Keep HOL, LON, EDI, NTH holding. Germany and France kept word. Watch Russia's F SWE for retaliation toward NOR, and check the Fall capture of STP. Convoy HOL to DEN only with Germany's agreement.

Spring 1912: all hold. BLA and CON support BUL holding against Austria and Italy's GRE; SMY holds against Italy's AEG. Pacts: Russia keeps off SEV/ARM/ANK; Italy has refused written confirmation; Austria threatens BUL. Next: hold the line, watch Italy's AEG and GRE moves, and reconsider in Fall.

messages.body: Austria here, Fall 1912. Confirm in writing that A GAL, A UKR, A WAR and F SEV do not enter Rumania or Budapest this Fall. I will keep A RUM, BUD and SER in place and will not enter Galicia or Ukraine. Tell me your exact orders for these four units now.

Austria here. Tell me your exact Fall orders for A GRE, F AEG and F ION. I still intend to recover Bulgaria and will not move A SER or A RUM into Greece. If you stay out of Bulgaria and Serbia, I will keep my word on Trieste, Venice and the Adriatic.

Austria here. BUL is a centre I intend to recover this Fall. If A BUL and F BLA withdraw to Constantinople or the Aegean, I will keep my Balkan line and stay out of Greece. If they stay, I will attack BUL. Tell me your decision now.

England here. I broke our north understanding in Spring 1912 by taking the empty STP with F NOR, and I regret the breach. I hold STP this Fall, and no English unit will move into Sweden, the Baltic or Russian homeland. In return, please keep your fleets out of NOR, NTH, NWG and EDI, and tell me your plans for Sweden and STP.

France here, Fall 1912. I accept that MUN is German now and I will not move A BUR into Munich, Belgium or the Ruhr. A BUR holds this autumn. Please confirm your units stay out of Burgundy, Picardy and Paris, and tell me your Fall orders so we avoid bounces.

France here, Fall 1912. A MAR, A PAR, A POR, A BUR and F MAO hold this autumn, with no move toward Piedmont, Tunis or the Gulf of Lyon. Please confirm F TUN, A VEN and F ION also hold. If Austria opens a gap near Trieste or Venice, let's discuss coordinating before anyone moves.

Germany here, Fall 1912. I hold MUN, BEL, KIE, DEN and BER and will not enter Galicia, Warsaw, Ukraine or Rumania. Please confirm your Fall orders for GAL, UKR and WAR, and that no Russian unit enters Prussia, Berlin, Denmark or Kiel. If Austria's Bohemia side opens, let us coordinate on Vienna and split its centres.

Germany here, Fall 1912. MUN is German and I hold it. Please confirm in writing that A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and A POR stay out of Burgundy, Picardy, Belgium and the Ruhr. Tell me your Fall orders for BUR and MAO so I know where your pressure is going before I commit my units.

Italy here. I am moving A GRE to Bulgaria with F AEG support this Fall. Please keep A SER and A RUM out of Bulgaria and Greece. If Bulgaria falls to me, I will not push north of it, and I will back your claim to Rumania and Serbia-side centres later.

Italy here. My fleet and army are pressing Bulgaria and Smyrna. Pull A SMY back toward Ankara and keep F BLA in the Black Sea, and I will consider a truce. Otherwise I will keep attacking Bulgaria and Smyrna this Fall.

Russia here, Fall 1912. A GAL, A UKR and A WAR hold this Fall, and no Russian unit enters Rumania or Budapest. Please confirm your RUM, BUD, SER and VIE orders in writing, and that no Austrian unit enters Galicia or Ukraine. If you move against Turkey or Italy, tell me first.

Russia here, Fall 1912. F SEV, A UKR and A WAR hold this Fall. I have no move toward Armenia or Ankara. Please confirm F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM, and A CON, A BUL and A SMY stay out of Ukraine. Tell me your exact Fall orders so our split holds.

Turkey to Italy: Your F AEG and A GRE are threatening Smyrna and Bulgaria. Turkey holds A SMY, A BUL, A CON and F BLA. Pull F AEG out of the Aegean and I will keep my units off Greece and the Ionian. Otherwise I will defend Smyrna and Bulgaria.

Turkey to Austria: Your A RUM, A SER and A BUD threaten Bulgaria. Bulgaria is Turkish and will be defended by A BUL, A CON, A SMY and F BLA. Any attack on Bulgaria means open war with Turkey. Keep your units out of Bulgaria this Fall and I will keep out of Serbia and Rumania.

Turkey to Russia: Our Armenia, Ankara and Sevastopol split stands. Please keep F SEV and A UKR off Armenia and Ankara, and keep F BLA out of SEV and RUM. Press Austria's Rumania or Galicia with A GAL and A UKR this Fall. Tell me your exact orders.

Austria here. I won't move A SER or A RUM into Greece, and F TRI stays out of the Adriatic. Bulgaria is still my target, so if A GRE and F AEG support it, expect a fight there. Keep A VEN and F ION away from Trieste, Tyrolia, Vienna and Albania, and we can discuss the Turkish centres once Constantinople is in play.

Austria here. A RUM, A BUD and A SER hold this Fall, and no Austrian unit enters Galicia or Ukraine. Please confirm in writing that A GAL, A UKR, A WAR and F SEV stay out of Rumania and Budapest. If you move against Turkey or Italy, I'll tell you first. Break the line and I'll respond.

Austria here. Bulgaria is a centre I intend to recover. If A BUL and F BLA withdraw to Constantinople or the Aegean, I will keep my Balkan line and stay out of Greece. If they hold, I will attack BUL this Fall. Decide now, because I will not accept a Bulgarian garrison that threatens my Rumanian and Serbian units.

France here. Fall 1912 orders: A BUR holds, F MAO holds, A MAR, A PAR and A POR all hold. None of them moves toward Munich, Belgium, Ruhr, Burgundy or Picardy this autumn. Please keep your units out of Burgundy, Picardy and Paris in return. I'll tell you before any change to these orders.

Germany here, Fall 1912. Confirmed: A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and A POR stay out of Burgundy, Picardy, Belgium and the Ruhr, and I will not move toward Paris or Brest. My units this autumn: F BEL, A BER, A KIE, A DEN and A MUN all hold, with no moves toward Burgundy or Picardy. Please keep F MAO away from Belgium and the Channel coast, and tell me first of any change.

Italy here. As promised, A GRE moves to Bulgaria this Fall with F AEG supporting. F ION holds and A VEN holds. I will not push north of Bulgaria. Please keep A SER and A RUM out of Greece and Bulgaria, as you have pledged. Once Bulgaria falls, we can talk about the Rumania and Serbia-side centres.

Italy here. Confirmed: F TUN, A VEN and F ION hold this Fall and will not enter the Gulf of Lyon, Spain or Piedmont. I have no move against your A MAR, A PAR, A POR, A BUR or F MAO. Please keep them away from Tunis and Italian soil. I will tell you first if my plans change.

Italy here. No truce while A SMY stays in Smyrna and F BLA and A BUL hold Bulgaria. My A GRE moves to Bulgaria with F AEG support, and F AEG remains a threat to Smyrna. If you pull A SMY back toward Ankara, I will reconsider. Otherwise expect a fight for Bulgaria and the Aegean this Fall.

Russia here, Fall 1912. A GAL, A UKR and A WAR hold this Fall, and no Russian unit enters Rumania or Budapest. F SEV holds too. Your RUM, BUD, SER and VIE should also hold, and no Austrian unit should enter Galicia or Ukraine. I will judge this autumn by what your units actually do.

Russia confirms Fall 1912: A WAR holds Warsaw, and no Russian unit enters Prussia, Berlin, Denmark or Kiel. A GAL and A UKR also hold. Keep your word on Galicia, Warsaw, Ukraine and Rumania. If Austria's Bohemia side opens, we can talk about Vienna and its centres.

Russia here. F SWE holds in Sweden, and no Russian fleet enters NOR, NWG, NTH or EDI this Fall. STP is a Russian centre and I expect it back, so please withdraw your fleet from it. Keep English units out of Sweden and the Baltic, and we can talk about the north after that.

Russia confirms Fall 1912: F SEV holds, A UKR holds, and no Russian unit moves toward Armenia or Ankara. Our split stands. Please keep F BLA out of SEV and RUM, and keep A CON, A BUL and A SMY out of Ukraine. I will not press Rumania or Galicia this Fall, so Austria's units there are your concern.

Turkey to Austria: Bulgaria is Turkish and will be defended by A BUL, A CON, A SMY and F BLA. Any move by your A RUM, A SER or A BUD into Bulgaria means open war. Keep out of BUL this Fall and I will not enter Serbia or Rumania. Confirm your orders in writing.

Turkey to Italy: Your F AEG and A GRE threaten Smyrna and Bulgaria, and I will defend both. Pull F AEG out of the Aegean, away from SMY and CON, and I will keep my units off Greece and the Ionian. If F AEG moves toward Smyrna, Turkey will hold and strike back.

Turkey to Russia: Our Armenia, Ankara and Sevastopol split stands. Keep F SEV and A UKR off ARM and ANK, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. Austria is my real threat, so press A GAL and A UKR toward Rumania or Galicia this Fall to tie down Vienna's units.

notes.note: Fall 1912: all units hold per deals. MUN returned to Germany; Germany, Italy and England have kept deals so far. Keep BUR/MAR/PAR/POR off BEL, PIC, RUH, MUN; MAO out of Channel/English waters. Revisit if unowned centres appear or a deal breaks.

Fall 1912: all hold to keep BEL BER DEN KIE MUN. Promises kept: France (no BUR/PIC/PAR/BEL entry), Russia (no PRU/BER/DEN/KIE entry), England (no HOL/NTH). Austria asked for no BOH/SIL/TYR moves; kept. Next: watch France at BUR and Russia at BER/KIE; consider convoy of A DEN via NTH only if NTH is free.

Fall 1912: all hold, keeping promises to Austria (no RUM/BUD/GAL/UKR entry), Turkey (SEV/UKR split), Germany (no PRU/BER/DEN/KIE) and England (no north/Baltic entry). Reassess Spring 1913 for STP recovery via SWE->BOT->STP and RUM/BUD if Austria weakens or breaks its word.

Fall 1912: STP held to take the center; Russia asks it back, I refuse to move. Holding all else for peace. Russia and Germany kept word so far. Keep NOR/NTH/EDI and Baltic issues in mind; no convoy to DEN without Germany's agreement. Next: consider Russian STP retake threat.

Fall 1912: GRE to BUL supported by AEG, per promises to Austria. ION, TUN, VEN hold to keep pacts with France and Austria. Austria has kept SER/RUM out of GRE/BUL so far. Turkey demands AEG leave SMY/CON area; refused. Next: if BUL falls, don't push north of it and split Turkish centres with Austria. Watch Turkey's CON/BLA support into BUL.

Fall 1912: all hold to keep 5 centres. BUL attack ties vs BLA/CON support and Italy GRE->BUL is also contesting it. Russia (GAL/UKR/WAR/SEV hold) and Italy (no SER/RUM entry) kept word so far. Turkey still holds BUL, so reassess in Spring 1913 if Turkish units leave. Keep F TRI out of ADR and watch Italy VEN/ION.

Fall 1912: BUL held by BLA support and CON support against Italy GRE/AEG and Austria. SMY holds against F AEG. Russia has kept word on SEV/ARM/ANK. Italy and Austria have not withdrawn, so keep the line; consider ANK/ARM only if pacts hold.

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1913. Confirm in writing that A GAL, A UKR, A WAR and F SEV do not enter Rumania or Budapest this Spring. Austria holds RUM, BUD and SER and will not enter Galicia or Ukraine. Any Russian entry into RUM or BUD ends our line, and I will respond.

Austria here. Tell me now whether A GRE and F AEG are attacking Bulgaria this Spring. I will not move A SER or A RUM into Greece. Keep F TRI's Adriatic, Trieste and Vienna out of your plans, and I will keep my units out of Greece and Albania.

Austria here. Bulgaria is still a centre I want back. If A BUL and F BLA withdraw to Constantinople or the Aegean this Spring, I will hold my Balkan line and stay out of Greece. If they hold BUL, expect Austrian pressure on it. Give me your decision now.

England here, Spring 1913. My fleet at STP stays put, and I will not move into Sweden, the Baltic or the Russian homeland. Please keep your fleets out of NOR, NWG, NTH and EDI, and tell me your plans for F SWE and the Gulf of Bothnia before any change.

England here, Spring 1913. I hold HOL, NTH, NOR and LON this spring with no move toward DEN, KIE or BEL. Will you keep A DEN, A KIE and F BEL in place and stay off HOL and the North Sea? Tell me first of any change, and I will do the same.

France here, Spring 1913. England has 6 centres and is the leader, so I need to watch you. Your fleets in the North Sea and Channel are close to Belgium and Picardy. Will you confirm F NTH and A HOL stay off Belgium and Picardy this spring? I'll keep F MAO out of English waters and tell you first before any change.

France here, Spring 1913. I will hold A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and A POR this spring and will not move toward Belgium, the Ruhr or Munich. Please confirm your units stay out of Burgundy, Picardy and Paris, and tell me your Spring orders for BEL, KIE and MUN.

France here, Spring 1913. Austria's units near Trieste and Venice are a shared concern. If Austria opens a gap, I would like to coordinate so we both gain. Please confirm F TUN, A VEN and F ION hold this spring, and tell me if your plans change toward Greece or Trieste.

Germany here, Spring 1913. Austria is overextended, with RUM, SER and GAL in contest. I propose Russia presses RUM and BUD while I move against Vienna from Bohemia. Please confirm A WAR, A UKR, F SEV and F SWE stay out of Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel, and tell me your Spring orders.

Germany here, Spring 1913. You lead on 6 centres, so I want clarity. I hold F BEL, A KIE, A DEN, A BER and A MUN, and I will not move onto Holland or the North Sea. Please confirm F NTH, F NOR and A HOL stay off Denmark, Kiel and Belgium, and tell me your plans for the Channel.

Italy here. I propose a truce for Spring 1913. Pull A SMY back toward Ankara and keep F BLA out of Greece and the Ionian, and I will hold A GRE and F AEG away from Smyrna and Constantinople. Confirm your reply in writing so we both know where we stand before Fall.

Italy here. Bulgaria is contested between Turkey, you and me. I will not move A GRE north of Bulgaria. Please keep A SER and A RUM out of Greece, and tell me your Spring orders for A RUM and A SER now so we avoid a misunderstanding in the Balkans.

Russia here, Spring 1913. STP is a Russian centre and your fleet is sitting in it. Withdraw F STP this spring and I will keep F SWE out of NWG, NOR and EDI. If you stay, I will retake it via BOT. Confirm your orders for F NTH, F NOR and F LVP.

Russia here, Spring 1913. My earlier promises on RUM and BUD depend on your units holding there. Confirm A RUM, A BUD and A SER hold this spring, and that no Austrian unit enters GAL or UKR. If you hold, A UKR and A WAR stay put.

Russia here, Spring 1913. F SEV and A UKR hold this spring, and no Russian unit moves toward ARM or ANK. Please confirm F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM, and that A CON, A BUL and A SMY stay out of UKR. Tell me your Spring orders against Austria.

Turkey to Austria: Bulgaria is Turkish and will be held by A BUL, A CON, A SMY and F BLA. Any attack on BUL breaks our pact and means open war. Your A RUM, A SER and A BUD should hold or withdraw away from Bulgaria. Confirm your Spring orders in writing today.

Turkey to Italy: Italy's F AEG and A GRE have threatened SMY and BUL for two years. Pull F AEG out of the Aegean and keep A GRE out of Bulgaria, and I will keep my units off Greece and the Ionian. Tell me your exact Spring orders.

Turkey to Russia: Our Armenia, Ankara and Sevastopol split still stands. Keep F SEV and A UKR off ARM and ANK, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. Since Austria is the threat to my Balkan line, please move A UKR toward Rumania or Galicia this Spring. Confirm your orders.

Austria here. Spring 1913: A RUM, A SER and A BUD hold. No Austrian unit enters Greece, Bulgaria or Albania this spring. F TRI and A VIE stay out of the Adriatic and Venice. I will tell you before any Balkan move changes, and I expect the same from your A GRE and F AEG.

Austria here. Spring 1913: A RUM, A BUD and A SER hold, and no Austrian unit enters Galicia or Ukraine. Please confirm in writing that A UKR, A WAR, F SEV and any Russian unit stay out of Rumania and Budapest. If you hold, I will hold too. If you enter Rumania, I will respond.

Austria here. Spring 1913: A RUM, A BUD and A SER hold this spring, and I will not attack Bulgaria this spring. I will not enter Serbia or Rumania-side Turkish territory. Keep A BUL, A CON, A SMY and F BLA away from Rumania and Serbia, and we both keep the Balkan line.

England here. F NTH and A HOL hold this spring, with no move toward Belgium or Picardy. F LON and F NOR also hold. I expect F MAO to stay in the Atlantic, out of the Channel and English waters, as agreed. I will tell you first of any change near Belgium or the Channel.

England here. Confirmed for Spring 1913: F NTH, F NOR, A HOL and F LON hold, with no move toward Denmark, Kiel or Belgium. I expect A DEN, A KIE and F BEL to hold too. Any change in the Channel or North Sea will be notified to you first.

England here. F STP stays where it is this spring, since I hold the centre. F NOR, F NTH and F LVP hold and will not enter NWG, Sweden or the Baltic. Please keep F SWE out of NWG, NOR and EDI, and tell me first of any change in the north.

Germany to France: Spring 1913 orders: F BEL, A KIE and A MUN all hold. I will not move toward Burgundy, Picardy or Paris. Please keep A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and A POR out of Belgium, the Ruhr and Munich, and tell me first if your plans change.

Germany to England: This spring F BEL, A KIE and A DEN hold, and I make no move on Holland or the North Sea. Keep F NTH, F NOR and A HOL off Denmark, Kiel and Belgium. I will tell you first of any change near the Channel or North Sea. What are your plans for the Channel?

Italy here. Plainly: this Spring A GRE moves to Bulgaria with F AEG supporting. I will not go north of Bulgaria, and A VEN and F ION stay away from Trieste, Tyrolia, Vienna, Serbia and Albania. Please keep A SER and A RUM out of Greece and Bulgaria as you pledged. Once Bulgaria falls, we can split the Turkish centres fairly.

Italy here. Confirmed: F TUN, A VEN and F ION hold this Spring and will not enter the Gulf of Lyon, Spain or Piedmont. My attention is on the Balkans and the Aegean. I would welcome coordination against any Austrian move toward Venice or Trieste. Please keep your armies away from Tunis and Italian soil.

Italy here. No truce while A SMY, A BUL and F BLA stand in my path. A GRE attacks Bulgaria this Spring with F AEG supporting. Pull A SMY back toward Ankara and keep F BLA out of Greece and the Ionian, and I will reconsider a truce for Fall. Otherwise expect a serious fight for Bulgaria and Smyrna.

Russia here. Withdraw F STP and I will keep F SWE out of NWG, NOR and EDI. If F STP stays, I will retake it via BOT, and our northern understanding ends. F NTH, F NOR and F LVP should go out of the Baltic and North Sea and stay there. Tell me your Spring orders for those three fleets.

Russia here, Spring 1913. A WAR, A UKR and F SEV hold this spring, and no Russian unit enters RUM or BUD. Keep your RUM, BUD and SER units in place and stay out of GAL and UKR. I will judge this autumn by what your units actually do.

Russia here. Confirmed: A WAR, A UKR, F SEV and F SWE stay out of Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel this spring. Your pressure on Vienna from Bohemia is your business. I will consider RUM once Austria's line clearly breaks, and we can settle Austria's centres then. Tell me your Spring orders for MUN and BOH.

Russia here, Spring 1913. F SEV and A UKR hold this spring, and no Russian unit moves toward ARM or ANK. F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM, and A CON, A BUL and A SMY stay out of UKR. Our split stands. I will decide on Rumania after I see Austria's autumn moves, and I will tell you first.

Turkey to Italy: I will hold A SMY, A CON, A BUL and F BLA this Spring and enter neither Greece nor the Ionian. Withdraw F AEG away from SMY and CON and I will keep my units off Greece and the Ionian. A GRE must stay out of Bulgaria. Confirm your exact Spring orders in writing.

Turkey to Austria: Bulgaria is Turkish and will be held by A BUL, A CON, A SMY and F BLA. Any move by A RUM, A SER or A BUD into BUL means open war. Keep those units out of Bulgaria and I will not enter Serbia or Rumania. Confirm your Spring orders now.

Turkey to Russia: Our Armenia, Ankara and Sevastopol split still stands, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. Austria's units on my Balkan border are the real threat to both of us. Please move A UKR toward Rumania or Galicia this Spring to tie them down. Confirm your orders.

notes.note: Spring 1913: all hold to keep 5 centres and pacts with Russia (Ukraine/Galicia line), Italy (Adriatic, Greece) and Turkey (no Bulgaria entry). Watch Italy GRE->BUL and Russia RUM/BUD entry. Reassess Bulgaria if Turkish units leave.

Spring 1913: SEV, UKR, WAR hold per Austria and Turkey promises (no RUM/BUD/GAL/UKR entry). F SWE to BOT to retake STP next turn if England's F STP stays; SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, EDI, DEN, KIE. Germany promises kept. Watch Austria RUM/BUD and Turkey split.

Spring 1913: all hold to keep 5 SCs and honor deals. No unowned SCs reachable. Germany, England, Italy have kept deals so far. Keep BUR off BEL/MUN/RUH/PIC, MAO out of Channel/ENG, no Tunis/Gulf of Lyon moves. Watch Germany and England near BEL/PIC. Reconsider if unowned centers appear or deals break.

Spring 1913: held all to keep word to England, France, Russia, Austria. No unowned SCs reachable. Next: consider MUN to BOH/TYR vs Austria once Russia moves on RUM/BUD; confirm Russia keeps out of PRU/BER/DEN/KIE; watch France at BUR/PAR and England at HOL/NTH.

Spring 1913: all hold to keep the Turkish line (BUL, CON, SMY, ANK). Austria pledged no attack on BUL this spring. Italy demands SMY pull back and threatens BUL; Russia keeps SEV/ARM/ANK split. Recheck Italy's AEG and GRE and Austria's RUM/SER moves in Fall.

Spring 1913: A GRE to BUL supported by F AEG to take Turkish BUL. ION, TUN, VEN hold to keep pacts with France and Austria. Do not go north of BUL. Austria pledged SER/RUM out of GRE/BUL; check. Turkey wants AEG out of Aegean, refused. Next: if BUL falls, split Turkish centres with Austria.

Spring 1913: all hold for peace, no unowned centers reachable. STP stays held; Russia threatens retake via BOT, so keep it occupied. Germany and France kept word. NOR is empty but English; watch Russian F SWE via SKA. Next: keep peace, watch Russia's north and France's MAO, and avoid the DEN convoy unless Germany agrees.

messages.body: Austria here. A BUL is now Italian and breaks our Balkan understanding. Tell me by return whether A BUL and F AEG will hold or withdraw. If they stay, Austrian units will strike Bulgaria this Fall, and I will not stop once we are in combat.

Austria here. Italy has taken Bulgaria with A BUL. Let us both push it out. I will move A RUM and A SER into BUL this Fall. Keep A CON and A SMY where they can support against Italy, and tell me your Fall orders before we both commit.

Austria here. My A RUM, A BUD and A SER hold this Fall, but I am going to fight in Bulgaria against Italy. Confirm A UKR, A WAR and F SEV stay out of Rumania and Budapest, and I will keep my northern line with you.

England here. F STP holds this Fall and I will defend it. Moving F BOT into STP would start open war in the north, which helps neither of us against the wider board. Keep F BOT and F SWE out of NOR, NWG, NTH and EDI, and I will keep my fleets out of Sweden, the Baltic and the Russian homeland. Tell me your Fall orders.

England here. I hold LON, NTH, NOR, HOL and STP this Fall with no move on DEN, KIE or BEL. Please keep A DEN, A KIE and F BEL in place and do not enter HOL or the North Sea. I will tell you first of any change in the Channel or North Sea. Are you planning anything against France this Fall?

France here, Fall 1913. I'm holding A BUR, A PAR, A MAR, A POR and F MAO this autumn, so no move toward Munich, Belgium, the Ruhr, Burgundy or Picardy. Please keep your units off Burgundy, Picardy and Paris as well. If either of us plans a change, we tell each other first.

France here, Fall 1913. F MAO and my armies hold this autumn: no move toward Brest, Picardy, Belgium, Spain or the Channel. Please confirm F LON, F NTH, F NOR and A HOL stay off Belgium, Picardy and Brest. I will give notice before any change near Spain or Portugal.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1913: Austria is stretched across RUM, SER and BUD. I plan A MUN to BOH now and to press VIE in Spring. Please confirm A WAR, A UKR and F SEV stay out of Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel, and tell me your Fall orders for RUM and GAL so we can split Austria's centres.

Germany to Austria: A MUN is moving to Bohemia this Fall, and I am not hiding that Vienna is my target in Spring. Austria is facing Russia in Rumania and Serbia, so I suggest you pull units back to defend VIE and TRI. Tell me your Fall orders for VIE, TRI and BUD.

Italy here. My A BUL now holds Bulgaria, and F AEG holds the Aegean. I propose a Fall truce: you keep A CON, A SMY and F BLA in place, and I will not move against Constantinople or Smyrna. Confirm in writing, and I will keep A BUL and F AEG out of your home centres.

Italy here. My A BUL and A GRE are now in the Balkans. Your A SER and A RUM stand next to Bulgaria and Greece. Please confirm in writing that neither moves into Bulgaria or Greece this Fall, as you pledged. I will keep my fleets off the Adriatic and away from Trieste and Vienna.

Russia here, Fall 1913. F STP is a Russian centre and your fleet has held it long enough. I am moving F BOT against STP this autumn. Withdraw now, and I will keep F SWE and our northern waters out of your reach. Hold on, and we are at war in the north.

Russia here, Fall 1913. A UKR and F SEV hold again, and no Russian unit goes toward ARM or ANK. F BLA must stay out of SEV and RUM. I have kept my word on Rumania and Galicia. Tell me your autumn plans against Austria's Balkan line.

Turkey to Italy: Your A BUL is sitting on a Turkish centre. A CON and F BLA attack BUL this Fall. Keep A BUL and your fleets out of CON, SMY and the Black Sea, and I will keep my units off Greece and the Ionian. Confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Turkey to Austria: Italy holds Bulgaria and I will retake it this Fall with A CON and F BLA. Keep A RUM, A SER and A BUD out of BUL and off Turkish land, and I will not enter Serbia or Rumania. Confirm in writing whether you will honour that.

Turkey to Russia: I am attacking Bulgaria this Fall. Our Armenia-Ankara-Sevastopol split must hold: F SEV and A UKR stay off ARM and ANK, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. Please move A UKR toward Rumania or Galicia to tie down Austria. Confirm.

Austria here. Italy's A BUL broke our Balkan understanding. A RUM and A SER will move into BUL this Fall unless A BUL withdraws now. F AEG and A GRE supporting BUL will not stop us. Withdraw A BUL to Greece or Constantinople, and I will keep A SER out of Greece and keep F TRI away from the Adriatic.

Austria here. VIE, TRI and BUD hold this Fall, as I have said. Your A MUN moving into Bohemia is a direct threat to Vienna, and I will defend it. Keep out of Bohemia and Tyrolia, and keep your northern units off the Austrian line. Then we can keep the border calm.

Austria here. Italy holds BUL, and I will strike it this Fall with A RUM and A SER. I will not enter Constantinople, Smyrna or Greece. Keep A CON and A SMY away from Serbia and Rumania, and retake BUL from Italy with F BLA and A CON. Coordinate the strike so Italy's garrison falls.

England here. Confirmed for Fall 1913: F LON, F NTH, F LVP and A HOL hold in place. No move toward Belgium, Picardy, Brest or the Channel. Please keep F MAO in the Atlantic, out of English waters, LVP and EDI as agreed. I'll tell you first of any change near Spain or Portugal.

England here. F STP holds this Fall and I will defend it. Moving F BOT into STP means open war in the north, which only helps Germany and France. I will keep my fleets out of Sweden, the Baltic and the Russian homeland if you keep F SWE out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI. Choose peace and we can talk about the south.

Germany here, Fall 1913. Confirmed: F BEL, A BER, A KIE, A DEN and A MUN all hold this autumn. I will not move toward Burgundy, Picardy or Paris. Please keep A BUR, A PAR, A MAR, A POR and F MAO off Belgium, the Ruhr and Munich. If either of us changes plans, we tell each other first.

Germany here, Fall 1913. Confirmed: F BEL, A KIE and A DEN hold this autumn, and I make no move on Holland, the North Sea or Denmark. Please keep your fleets out of Denmark, Kiel and Belgium as agreed. I will give you notice before any change near the Channel or North Sea.

Italy here. A BUL holds Bulgaria this Fall and I will not withdraw it, so I understand if you strike. I have no plans against Serbia or Rumania, and F TRI and A VEN stay out of the Adriatic and Trieste. A GRE stays in Greece. If you hold off Albania and Greece, I will keep F ION and A VEN away from your home centres.

Italy here. A BUL stays in Bulgaria this Fall, and I will not move against Constantinople or Smyrna with my fleets. F AEG and A GRE stay out of your home centres. If you do not attack Greece or the Ionian, we can keep the Aegean quiet. Your A CON and F BLA are the units that matter for Bulgaria, so choose your attacks carefully.

Russia here. F BOT moves to STP this Fall, and I will take the centre back. You chose the north war by holding STP. My fleets stay out of NTH, NOR, NWG and EDI as before. Keep F NTH, F NOR and F LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden, and we can still talk about peace once STP is settled.

Russia to Germany: A WAR, A UKR and F SEV hold this Fall. No Russian unit enters Prussia, Berlin, Denmark, Kiel or Belgium. Your Bohemia move against Vienna is your business. I will not enter Rumania this Fall. We can discuss Austria's centres once Vienna is under real threat in Spring.

Russia here. A WAR, A UKR and F SEV hold this Fall and none enters Rumania or Budapest. I have no plans against your RUM, BUD or SER this autumn. My fleet F BOT is moving against STP in the north, which is a separate matter. Good luck against Italy in Bulgaria, but keep Galicia and Ukraine in mind.

Russia to Turkey: F SEV holds, A UKR holds, and no Russian unit goes toward Armenia or Ankara. F BLA must stay out of SEV and RUM, as agreed. I will not press Rumania or Galicia this Fall, so Austria's units there remain your concern. Good luck against Italy in Bulgaria.

Turkey to Austria: Italy's A BUL is the target, and I am attacking it this Fall with A CON and F BLA. If your A RUM or A SER moves into BUL, we are at war and I will treat your units as enemies. Keep A RUM, A SER and A BUD out of Bulgaria and I will stay out of Serbia and Rumania. Confirm in writing.

Turkey to Italy: No truce. Your A BUL is sitting on a Turkish centre, and A CON and F BLA attack it this Fall. Keep F AEG and A BUL away from CON, SMY and the Black Sea, and I will keep my units off Greece and the Ionian. Withdraw now if you want to avoid losing Bulgaria.

Turkey to Russia: I am attacking Bulgaria this Fall. Our Armenia, Ankara and Sevastopol split stands: F SEV and A UKR stay off ARM and ANK, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. Please move A UKR toward Rumania or Galicia to tie down Austria. Confirm your orders in writing.

notes.note: Fall 1913: F BOT attacks STP (England's fleet holds; bounce likely, but it tests England). SEV, UKR, WAR hold per Turkey and Austria promises (no RUM/BUD/GAL/UKR entry). Germany: no PRU/BER/DEN/KIE entry. Watch England's STP and Austria's Bulgaria war. Next: retake STP via SWE/BOT if England leaves.

Fall 1913: A BUL holds Bulgaria with F AEG supporting, to take BUL if it survives. ION, TUN, VEN hold to keep pacts with Austria and France. Turkey and Austria have both threatened BUL; watch CON and RUM/SER moves. If BUL falls, do not push north; split Turkish centres with Austria if they keep pledges.

Fall 1913: holding all units. STP held to defend against Russian F BOT, which is moving to STP; no English unit can support it this turn. Germany and France kept word so far; Russia broke its north peace by attacking STP. Next: check STP result, reconsider a retake of Russian positions, and watch the north and Channel.

Fall 1913: all holds to honor deals with Germany (no BUR/PAR/MAR/POR into BEL/MUN/RUH/PIC) and England (MAO out of Channel/ENG). All SCs owned, no unowned reachable. Germany and England kept deals so far. Revisit if a deal breaks or unowned SCs appear; consider a stab on MUN/BEL only if Germany weakens.

Fall 1913: all hold to keep BEL BER DEN KIE MUN and honor promises to France (no BUR/PIC/PAR/MUN vacating), England (no HOL/NTH/DEN/KIE entry), Russia (no PRU/BER entry). Held MUN rather than BOH so France's BUR cannot take it. Spring 1914: consider MUN to BOH and press VIE, and watch France at MUN and Russia at BER/KIE. Austria said it will defend VIE.

Fall 1913: CON attacks BUL (Italy's A BUL) with F BLA supporting CON to BUL; SMY holds. Italy and Austria both threaten BUL; Russia has kept word on SEV/ARM/ANK. Next: consolidate BUL and watch Austria RUM/SER moves.

Fall 1913: VIE moves to unowned GAL, supported by BUD and RUM (3 vs Russian WAR/UKR). VIE cannot be reached by Germany or Italy this turn. SER and TRI hold against Italian VEN/Turkish threats. BUL stays Italian for now; retake later if Turkish or Italian units leave. Italy, Turkey and Russia all made Balkan/Galicia pledges and have mostly kept word; watch Russia's response to GAL and Germany's MUN

messages.body: Austria here. A MUN moving to Bohemia is a direct threat to Vienna, and I will defend VIE and TRI. Tell me plainly whether your Spring move targets Vienna. If you keep BER, KIE, DEN and BEL north of Bohemia and stay out of Tyrolia, Austrian units will not enter Bohemia, Silesia or Munich.

Austria here. My A RUM, A BUD and A SER are committed to Bulgaria this Fall against Italy. Confirm in writing that A UKR, A WAR and F SEV will not enter Rumania or Budapest while we fight there. If you stay on your Galicia and Ukraine line, I will keep my northern units out of your territory.

Austria here. Italy's A BUL is our shared target. I will strike BUL this Fall with A RUM and A SER, and I expect your A CON and F BLA to attack it too. Once BUL is retaken, we can divide the Balkan gains. Confirm your Fall orders to BUL so we do not collide.

England here. F BOT moving into STP means open war in the north, and it only helps Germany and France. F STP holds and I will defend it. Withdraw F BOT now and keep F SWE out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI. I will keep my fleets out of Sweden and the Baltic. Your reply?

England here. Russia's F BOT is attacking STP. I will hold STP and I am willing to coordinate against Russia's northern units. I will keep F NTH and F NOR out of DEN, KIE and BEL as agreed. Will you keep A DEN, A KIE and F BEL in place and press Russia in the Baltic?

France here, Spring 1914. I plan to hold A BUR, A PAR, A MAR, A POR and F MAO this spring. Please confirm A MUN, A KIE, A BER and F BEL stay out of Burgundy, Picardy and Paris. Share your Spring orders, and I will tell you first of any change.

France here. F MAO stays in the Atlantic this spring, away from the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. Please confirm F LON, F NTH, F LVP and A HOL stay off Belgium, Picardy, Brest and Spain. Tell me your Spring orders in return.

France here, Spring 1914. My armies stay out of Piedmont, Tunis and the Gulf of Lyon, and I expect F TUN, A VEN and F ION to hold. What are your plans for Greece and the Balkans? Tell me if you or Austria plan any move toward Trieste or Venice.

Germany here. Vienna is empty and your armies are committed to Rumania and Serbia. I am moving A MUN to BOH this Spring and intend to take VIE in Fall. Pull a unit back to defend VIE now, or tell me your plan. I would rather you hold your southern centres than lose everything.

Germany to Russia: Austria is stretched across GAL, RUM and SER, and VIE is empty. I am moving A MUN to BOH and will take Vienna. Please press Austria in Galicia and Rumania. Confirm A WAR, A UKR and F SEV stay out of Prussia, Berlin, Denmark, Kiel and Silesia, and tell me your Spring orders.

Italy to Turkey: A BUL holds Bulgaria this Spring with F AEG supporting. I will not move my fleets against Constantinople or Smyrna. Proposal: your A CON, A SMY and F BLA stay out of Bulgaria and Greece, and I keep A BUL, A GRE and F AEG away from your home centres. Tell me your exact Spring orders in writing.

Italy to Austria: A BUL and A GRE stay put this Spring, and I will not move against Serbia or Rumania. Any Austrian move into Bulgaria or Greece will be met with force. Confirm whether A SER, A RUM and A GAL hold. If they do, F TRI and A VEN stay clear of Trieste, Venice and the Adriatic.

Russia here, Spring 1914. F BOT moves to STP this spring, and I expect a bounce unless you withdraw F STP. Your F NTH, F NOR and F LVP should stay out of the Baltic and Sweden. If you leave STP now, I will keep F BOT out of your North Sea fleets and we can talk about the south.

Russia here, Spring 1914. A UKR, A WAR and F SEV hold this spring, and no Russian unit enters Rumania or Budapest. I am not planning moves against your RUM, BUD or SER. Keep your Bulgaria war against Italy and do not enter Galicia or Ukraine. I will judge you by your moves.

Russia here, Spring 1914. Our Armenia, Ankara and Sevastopol split stands. F SEV holds, A UKR holds, and no Russian unit goes toward ARM or ANK. F BLA must stay out of SEV and RUM. Keep your Bulgaria attack on Italy and tell me your Spring orders so we avoid a clash.

Turkey to Austria: Bulgaria is held by Italy's A BUL, which is my target this Spring with A CON and F BLA. Your A RUM, A SER and A BUD must not enter BUL or Turkish land. If you hold, I will not enter Serbia or Rumania. Confirm in writing today what your Spring orders are.

Turkey to Italy: Your A BUL sits on a Turkish centre, and A CON and F BLA attack it this Spring. Withdraw it to Greece or Rumania and I keep my units off Greece and the Ionian. Keep F AEG away from SMY and CON. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Turkey to Russia: Our split stands. F SEV and A UKR stay off ARM and ANK, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. Please move A UKR into Rumania this Spring to tie down Austria's RUM and SER. I will keep my word on Armenia. Confirm your orders.

Austria here. Your A MUN to Bohemia is a threat, so I am bringing A GAL back to Vienna this Spring. VIE will be held. Keep BER, KIE, DEN and BEL north of Bohemia and out of Tyrolia, and we can talk about the border after this turn.

Austria here. This Spring A SER and A RUM hold, and no Austrian unit enters Greece or Bulgaria. F TRI stays out of the Adriatic and Trieste is not threatened. I expect your A BUL and A GRE to stay put too, and we will talk again before Fall.

Austria here. A RUM and A BUD hold this Spring, and A SER holds too. A GAL is returning to Vienna, so Galicia is open to you only if your units move there, which I will watch closely. Keep A UKR, A WAR and F SEV out of Rumania and Budapest.

Austria here. Spring: A RUM, A SER and A BUD hold, and no Austrian unit enters Bulgaria or Turkish land this Spring. I want Bulgaria back from Italy this Fall. Tell me your Fall moves against BUL so we do not collide, and I will keep A SER and A RUM out of your path.

England here. F STP holds this spring and I will defend it, so withdrawal is not an option. Your F BOT into STP risks a bounce and open war in the north, which only helps Germany and France. I will keep F NTH, F NOR and F LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden. Keep F SWE out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI, and we keep the north quiet.

England confirms for Spring 1914: F LON, F NTH, F LVP and A HOL hold, with no move toward Belgium, Picardy, Brest, the Channel or Spain. Please keep F MAO in the Atlantic, out of English waters, LVP and EDI as agreed. I will give you notice before any change near Spain or Portugal, and I expect the same from you.

Germany here. Confirmed: F BEL, A KIE and A DEN hold this spring, and I make no move on Holland, the North Sea or Denmark. On Russia, I will decide after I see F BOT's Spring move. Keep F NTH and F NOR off DEN, KIE and BEL, and tell me first if you move toward Holland or the Channel.

Germany here. My A MUN moves to Bohemia this Spring as pressure, and I make no promise about Fall. Your units in Rumania and Serbia are facing Russia, and that is your real danger. I will keep my units out of Tyrolia and Trieste this Spring. Keep your units out of Silesia and Munich, and we can talk again after the Russian front settles.

Germany here. A MUN moves to Bohemia this Spring, so Munich will be empty for a turn. I expect you to hold A BUR, A PAR, A MAR, A POR and F MAO, as you proposed, and to stay out of Munich, Belgium and the Ruhr. I hold F BEL, A KIE, A BER and A DEN and will not enter Burgundy, Picardy or Paris. I will tell you before any change.

Italy here. For Spring 1914 F TUN, A VEN and F ION hold and stay out of the Gulf of Lyon, Spain and Piedmont. My focus is Greece and Bulgaria, not the west. I have no move toward Trieste or Venice planned. If Austria moves on Venice, let's coordinate before anyone acts. I will tell you first if my plans change.

Italy here. A BUL stays in Bulgaria this Spring, and I will not move F AEG against Smyrna or Constantinople. In return, keep A CON and F BLA out of Bulgaria and Greece, and keep your fleets out of the Aegean. I cannot withdraw A BUL, but if you hold to this line I will not attack your home centres this year.

Russia here. F BOT moves to STP this Spring, so the north is at war unless you withdraw F STP. I will not move any fleet into NTH, NOR, NWG or EDI. Keep F NTH, F NOR and F LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden, and I will keep my fleets clear of your home waters.

Russia here, Spring 1914. A UKR, A WAR and F SEV hold this spring, and no Russian unit enters RUM or BUD. Keep your units out of UKR and WAR, and we will both stay out of each other's centres while you fight Italy in Bulgaria.

Russia here. A WAR, A UKR and F SEV hold this spring. No Russian unit enters PRU, BER, DEN, KIE or SIL. Your Vienna move from Bohemia is your business. Once Vienna is taken, we can discuss splitting Austria's remaining centres.

Russia here. F SEV and A UKR hold this spring, so I will not move A UKR into Rumania. Our Armenia-Ankara split stands: no Russian unit goes toward ARM or ANK. F BLA must stay out of SEV and RUM. Good luck against Italy in Bulgaria.

Turkey here. Spring orders: A CON and F BLA attack Italy's A BUL. Your A RUM, A SER and A BUD must not enter Bulgaria. Hold or withdraw them away from BUL and I will stay out of Serbia and Rumania. Any Austrian move into BUL means open war with Turkey. Confirm your Spring orders in writing today.

Turkey here. Your A BUL is on a Turkish centre, and A CON and F BLA attack it this Spring. Withdraw it to Greece or Rumania and I keep my units off Greece and the Ionian. Keep F AEG away from SMY and CON. Any fleet move toward CON, SMY or the Black Sea is a declaration of war. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Turkey here. Our split stands: F SEV and A UKR stay off ARM and ANK, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. I will keep my word on Armenia. Please move A UKR into Rumania this Spring to tie down Austria's RUM and SER. Confirm your orders in writing so we both know where we stand.

notes.note: Spring 1914: GAL returns to VIE to block Germany's MUN-BOH threat; BUD, RUM, SER, TRI hold. Russia, Italy, Turkey pledges keep the Balkan lines. Bulgaria stays Italian for now; reassess in Fall if Turkish or Italian units leave. Germany's MUN-BOH move is a watch item.

Spring 1914: MUN to BOH pressures VIE; others hold to keep word to England, France, Russia. Austria moved GAL back to VIE, so VIE is defended. Keep BER/KIE/DEN/BEL out of Tyrolia, Burgundy, Picardy, Paris, Holland, NTH. Watch France at MUN and Russia at BER/KIE. Reassess convoy of A DEN via NTH later.

Spring 1914: all hold to keep peace with Germany and France. STP held against Russian F BOT; no support option for STP, so it relies on holding. Germany and France kept word so far. Russia's F BOT attack is the threat. Next: keep the north closed, watch Russia's STP attack, and avoid a DEN convoy unless Germany agrees.

Spring 1914: BOT attacks STP as announced to England. SEV, UKR, WAR hold per Austria, Turkey, Germany promises (no RUM/BUD/GAL entry, no PRU/BER/DEN/KIE). Watch if England leaves STP, then retake via BOT. Reassess Fall for RUM/BUD if Austria breaks word.

Spring 1914: BUR to MUN, opportunistic since German A MUN said it leaves for Bohemia; breaks no-Munich promise. If bounced, BUR stays exposed; return to BUR next turn. Others hold: MAO kept out of Channel/ENG for England deal. Watch Germany retaliation on BUR/PAR; Italy and England have kept deals.)

Spring 1914: holding all. F AEG supports A BUL holding against Turkish CON/BLA attack. Pacts kept with France and Austria (no Adriatic or Trieste moves). Turkey has threatened BUL, and I broke my CON/SMY pledge in 1913 by holding BUL. Next: if BUL holds, look at ROM/VEN convoy toward APU/ALB or Austrian-free gains; watch Turkey's CON/BLA support and Austria's SER/RUM.

Spring 1914: CON attacks BUL with BLA support. SMY holds. Russia keeps split (no SEV/ARM/ANK moves); BLA stays out of SEV/RUM. Italy promised AEG stays off CON/SMY, so watch it. Austria pledged no BUL entry; if A RUM/SER enter BUL, treat as war. Fall: consolidate BUL, keep SMY/ANK/CON.

messages.body: Austria here. Your A BOH sits next to Vienna, and I will hold VIE and TRI this Fall. Tell me plainly whether your Fall orders target VIE or Tyrolia. If you move north or west instead, Austria will keep its units out of Bohemia, Silesia and Munich, and we can both focus elsewhere.

Austria here. I plan to strike BUL this Fall with A RUM and A SER. Tell me now whether your A CON and F BLA are attacking BUL too. If they are, I will hold A RUM and A SER out of Constantinople and Turkish land, and we can split the Balkan gains after BUL falls. Please confirm in writing.

Austria here. My A RUM and A SER are moving against Bulgaria this Fall, leaving RUM and BUD weaker. Confirm again that A UKR, A WAR and F SEV will not enter Galicia, Rumania or Budapest. If you hold your line, Austria will keep its northern units off your centres.

England here. F BOT has bounced off STP twice now. I will hold F STP this Fall. Withdraw F BOT from the north, or the war in the north continues. Keep F SWE out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI, and I will keep my fleets out of Sweden and the Baltic. Will you accept that?

England here. France now holds A MUN, which is your centre. I suggest you consider retaking it with A BOH or A MUN-adjacent moves. I will keep F NTH and F NOR away from DEN, KIE and BEL as agreed. Are you willing to press Russia in the Baltic while I hold STP?

England here. I will keep F LON, F NTH, F LVP and A HOL in place this Fall, with no move toward Belgium, Picardy, Brest or the Channel. Please keep F MAO in the Atlantic, out of English waters, LVP and EDI. Will you confirm A MUN and your Iberian units stay clear of my northern coast?

France here, Fall 1914. I took MUN with A BUR, breaking my no-Munich promise. I am holding it this autumn, and I can't pretend otherwise. I will not move on Belgium, the Ruhr or Kiel. Please don't strike Munich or Burgundy, and tell me your plans for Bohemia and Belgium.

France here, Fall 1914. My armies hold this autumn, and I will keep F MAO out of the Channel and English waters as agreed. Please confirm F NTH, F LON and A HOL stay off Belgium and Picardy this autumn. I will tell you first of any change near Spain or Portugal.

Germany here. Your A MUN has taken our Munich centre. I intend to retake it this Fall with A BOH. Withdraw A MUN to Burgundy and I will keep my units out of Burgundy, Picardy and Paris. If you hold Munich, we both pay for it. Tell me your Fall orders for MUN and BUR.

Germany here. My A BOH is now adjacent to Vienna. I will not move into Tyrolia or Trieste this Fall. Keep your VIE and TRI garrisons in place and we can hold the border. If you move units out of VIE, I may take it, so tell me your Fall plans for VIE and GAL.

Italy to Turkey: Your A CON and F BLA are threatening A BUL this Fall. Hold them off Bulgaria and I will keep F AEG away from SMY and CON, as I have. Tell me your exact Fall orders in writing, and I will confirm mine before any move.

Italy to Austria: Confirm in writing that A SER and A RUM will not enter Bulgaria or Greece this Fall. I will keep A BUL and A GRE in place and F TRI and A VEN out of the Adriatic and Trieste. Tell me your intended Fall orders for those units.

Russia here. My F BOT will not attack STP this Fall. I hold in the Gulf of Bothnia instead. In return, keep F NTH, F NOR and F LVP out of the Baltic, Sweden and Norway's waters, and keep F STP away from my SWE. Let's keep the north quiet while Germany and France settle their borders.

Russia here. My A UKR, A WAR and F SEV hold this Fall, and no Russian unit enters RUM, BUD or GAL. Please confirm your A RUM, A BUD and A SER are committed to Bulgaria against Italy, not to Ukraine. I will judge you by your moves this autumn.

Russia here. Our Armenia-Ankara-Sevastopol split holds. F SEV and A UKR hold this Fall, and no Russian unit goes toward ARM or ANK. F BLA must stay out of SEV and RUM. Tell me your Fall orders against Italy in Bulgaria so we avoid any clash.

Turkey to Italy: Your A BUL is on a Turkish centre and my A CON and F BLA will attack it this Fall. Withdraw it to Greece or Rumania now and I keep my units off Greece and the Ionian. Keep F AEG away from SMY and CON. Confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Turkey to Austria: Austria's A RUM, A SER and A BUD are my border. I am attacking BUL this Fall, so no Austrian unit should enter Bulgaria or Turkish land. Hold your Rumania and Serbia positions and I will stay out of them. Confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Turkey to Russia: Our split stands. F SEV and A UKR stay off ARM and ANK, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. Please move A UKR into Rumania this Fall to tie down Austria's RUM and SER. Confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Austria here. I will not move A SER or A RUM into Greece this Fall. My intent is to strike Bulgaria with A RUM and A SER, since A BUL is Italian and you have refused to withdraw it. F TRI stays out of the Adriatic and Trieste is held. Keep F ION and A VEN away from Trieste and Albania.

Austria here. A VIE and A TRI hold this Fall, and I will not move into Tyrolia, Bohemia or Munich. Your A BOH is adjacent to Vienna, so I will keep VIE garrisoned. Keep BER, KIE and BEL north of Bohemia, and we can keep the border quiet while I deal with Italy in the Balkans.

Austria here. I plan to strike BUL this Fall with A RUM and A SER. Your A CON and F BLA attacking BUL too is fine, but neither of us should enter the other's supply centres. I will not enter Constantinople, Smyrna or Greece. Confirm your Fall orders to BUL so we do not collide.

Austria here. A RUM and A SER are moving against Bulgaria this Fall, not into Ukraine. Please keep A UKR, A WAR and F SEV out of Galicia, Rumania and Budapest, and I will keep my northern units off your centres. Tell me plainly if your A UKR or A WAR plans to move toward Rumania while my units are in the Balkans.

England confirms for Fall 1914: F LON, F NTH, F LVP and A HOL hold. No move on Belgium, Picardy, Brest or the Channel. I expect F MAO to stay in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I will tell you before any change near Spain or Portugal, and I ask the same from you.

England accepts your Fall 1914 pledge: F BOT will not attack STP. F STP stays where it is and I will defend it. I will keep F NTH, F NOR and F LVP out of the Baltic, Sweden and the Gulf of Bothnia. Please keep F SWE and your fleets out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI, and tell me first of any change in the north.

France here. Confirmed for Fall 1914: A MUN, A PAR, A MAR and A POR all hold, and F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. No move toward Belgium, Picardy, Brest or Spain. I will give notice before any change near Spain or Portugal.

France here. I am holding A MUN this Fall and cannot vacate it now. I will not move on Belgium, the Ruhr, Kiel or Burgundy this autumn. If you attack Munich with A BOH, it bounces unless you bring more force. Let's discuss returning MUN in Spring 1915 if you keep your units out of Burgundy, Picardy and Paris.

Germany here. A MUN is your unit now, and I will retake Munich this Fall with A BOH. Withdraw A MUN to Burgundy and I will keep my units out of Burgundy, Picardy and Paris. If you hold Munich, you will face my full force there, and I will not stop at Munich.

Germany here. My A BOH is aimed at Munich this Fall, not Vienna, so I will not move into Tyrolia or Trieste. Keep VIE and TRI garrisons in place and you have nothing to fear from me this turn. Your units should watch Russia in Rumania and Serbia.

Germany here. I will keep F BEL, A DEN and A KIE in place and stay off Holland and the North Sea. My A BOH is retaking Munich from France this Fall. Holding STP against Russia is sensible. I will decide on the Baltic after I see Russia's Fall move.

Italy to Turkey: Your A CON and F BLA attacking my A BUL is a clear breach of the line we drew. I will not withdraw A BUL, and I will not move F AEG against SMY or CON this Fall. Hold your attacks off Bulgaria and keep your units out of Greece and the Ionian, and our Aegean stays quiet. If you strike Bulgaria, I will defend it with F AEG support. I will confirm my exact orders before they are final.

Russia here. Confirmed: A UKR, A WAR and F SEV hold this Fall, and no Russian unit enters RUM, BUD or GAL. Your RUM and SER moving to Bulgaria is your choice. Keep BUD and GAL closed to Italy-facing moves and keep your northern units off my centres, and we both stay quiet.

Russia here. F BOT holds in the Gulf of Bothnia this Fall and will not attack STP. Keep F NTH, F NOR and F LVP out of the Baltic, Sweden and NWG, and F STP away from my SWE. If you hold the north, we can talk about the south later.

Russia here. Our Armenia-Ankara-Sevastopol split holds: F SEV and A UKR hold this Fall, and no Russian unit goes toward ARM or ANK. F BLA must stay out of SEV and RUM. I will not move A UKR into Rumania, so press Bulgaria against Italy and keep your word on Armenia.

Turkey here. Our Balkan line stands: A RUM, A SER and A BUD should hold this Fall and no Austrian unit enters Bulgaria or Turkish land. A CON and F BLA are attacking BUL this Fall. If you hold your Rumania and Serbia positions, I will keep my units out of both. Please confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Turkey to Italy: A CON and F BLA attack your A BUL this Fall, which sits on a Turkish centre. Withdraw it to Greece or Rumania and I keep my units off Greece and the Ionian. Keep F AEG away from SMY and CON, and any fleet move toward the Black Sea is a declaration of war. Confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Turkey to Russia: Our split stands. F SEV and A UKR stay off ARM and ANK, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. I am attacking Bulgaria this Fall. Please move A UKR into Rumania now to tie down Austria's RUM and SER. Confirm your Fall orders in writing.

notes.note: Fall 1914: all hold. Kept promises to Austria (no RUM/BUD/GAL entry), Turkey (SEV/UKR split, BLA out of SEV/RUM), England (BOT holds, no STP attack). Austria's RUM/SER moving to Bulgaria, so RUM is weaker; reassess Spring 1915 for RUM if Austria stays committed to Italy. Watch Turkey's Bulgaria war.

Fall 1914: holding all units. Russia pledged F BOT will not attack STP; I accepted and will hold STP. France confirmed A MUN, A PAR, A MAR, A POR hold and F MAO stays in Atlantic. Germany keeps BEL, DEN, KIE in place. Keep NTH/NOR/LVP out of Baltic and Sweden. Next: watch Russia's BOT and France's Iberia; consider a Germany-supported move toward Belgium/Denmark only if agreed.

Fall 1914: all hold. MUN held to take it (Germany A BOH may attack, bounce unless supported). Promised Germany to return MUN in Spring 1915 if Germany keeps units out of BUR/PIC/PAR. England kept deals; MAO kept out of Channel. Watch Germany on MUN.

Fall 1914: BOH to MUN retakes Munich from France, supported by BER and KIE (3 vs 1). BEL and DEN hold. Austria promised no Tyrolia/Bohemia moves; I promised no Tyrolia/Trieste. England and Russia: keep off HOL/NTH/DEN/KIE. Watch France at MUN and Burgundy; consider A DEN via NTH convoy later.}

Fall 1914: RUM attacks BUL, supported by SER. BUD, TRI and VIE hold to guard BUD, TRI and VIE. Italy, Turkey, Russia and Germany have all pledged to stay out of our centres. Turkey's CON/BLA also target BUL, so the attack may bounce. Check Italy's AEG support and Turkey's moves next turn.

Fall 1914: A CON moves to BUL, supported by F BLA, to take Italy's BUL. A SMY holds against Italy's F AEG. Watch Austria RUM/SER moves into BUL and Russia's SEV/ARM/ANK split, which has held so far. Italy has broken its line by not withdrawing A BUL. Next: hold CON and SMY, and consolidate BUL if it falls.

Fall 1914: holding BUL with F AEG support (hold vs max 2-strength attacks from CON/BLA or RUM/SER). Turkey and Austria both threaten BUL; neither has pledged to stay out. Keep ION/TUN/VEN/ROM holds to keep pacts with France and Austria. Next: if BUL falls, don't push north; look for ALB/APU gains via convoy.

messages.body: Austria here. Spring 1915: what are your orders for A BUL, A GRE and F ION? If A BUL and A GRE hold, our A SER and A RUM stay out of Greece. In return, F TRI and A VEN stay out of the Adriatic and Trieste. Please confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Austria here. Confirm that A UKR, A WAR and F SEV will not enter Galicia, Rumania or Budapest this Spring. My A RUM, A BUD and A VIE stay defensive toward Ukraine and Galicia. Tell me plainly if you plan moves toward RUM or BUD, so we avoid a clash.

Austria here. Our A SER and A RUM are pressuring Bulgaria. Tell me your Spring 1915 orders for A CON, F BLA and A SMY. I will keep my units out of Constantinople, Smyrna and Greece. Let us agree that Bulgaria goes to whoever takes it, with no unit entering the other's supply centres.

England here. Spring 1915: I hold F STP, F NOR, F NTH and F LVP as before. Please keep F BOT and F SWE out of STP, NOR, NWG and EDI. I'll keep my fleets out of the Baltic and Sweden. Will you confirm that for this spring and autumn?

England here. I'm holding LON, NTH, LVP and HOL this spring with no move on Belgium, Denmark or Kiel. Please keep A DEN, A KIE and F BEL in place and stay out of HOL and the North Sea. Tell me first if your plans change near the Channel.

England here. I'm holding my fleets in the Channel, North Sea and LVP this spring. Please keep F MAO in the Atlantic, away from English waters, LVP and EDI. I'll give you notice before any move near Spain or Portugal. Are you still holding A PAR, A MAR and A POR?

France here. My A MUN retreated to Burgundy, so Munich is yours again and I will not re-enter it this spring. Please keep your units out of Burgundy, Picardy and Paris. Confirm A BOH and A MUN stay clear of BUR, and tell me your Spring 1915 orders.

France here. F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI, as agreed. Please confirm F NTH, F LON and A HOL stay off Belgium and Picardy this spring. Tell me your Spring 1915 orders in return.

Germany here, Spring 1915. Munich is mine again with A MUN, and I expect it held. I will keep A BER, A KIE, A DEN and F BEL out of Burgundy, Picardy and Paris while you keep A BUR, A PAR and A MAR off Munich and Belgium. Tell me your Spring orders so we can both see the border is quiet.

Germany here. Keep your units out of Prussia, Silesia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel, and I will keep mine out of Warsaw and Galicia. Austria is the target for both of us. Tell me your Spring orders for WAR, UKR, SEV and BOT, and whether you plan to move on Rumania.

Germany here. My A MUN holds Munich and will not move into Tyrolia or Bohemia this Spring. Keep your units out of Silesia and Munich. Russia is your danger in Galicia and Rumania, and Italy in the Balkans. Tell me your Spring orders for VIE, TRI and BUD.

Italy to Austria: A BUL stays in Bulgaria and F AEG supports it. Moving A RUM or A SER into BUL this Spring starts a war I would rather avoid. Hold both this Spring and I will keep F ION and A VEN off Trieste, Albania and your home centres. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Italy to Turkey: Hold A CON and F BLA off Bulgaria this Spring and I keep F AEG away from SMY and CON. Attacking BUL will bring my fleet and army into the fight. Confirm your Spring orders in writing and I will confirm mine before they are final.

Russia here. Our Armenia-Ankara-Sevastopol split holds. Austria's RUM and SER are still in place, so A UKR stays out of Rumania this Spring. I want to take RUM with you once Austria's Balkan line breaks. What are your Spring 1915 orders against Bulgaria, and will you keep ANK and ARM clear of my units?

Russia here. I will not attack STP this Spring, and F BOT holds in the Gulf of Bothnia. Keep F NTH, F NOR and F LVP out of the Baltic, Sweden and NWG, and we keep the north quiet. Will you agree to that for 1915?

Turkey to Italy: My CON and BLA are attacking your A BUL this Spring, and it cannot be relieved. Your F AEG has no route to CON or SMY if you keep it in the Aegean. Keep it out of SMY and CON, and I'll keep my fleets out of Greece and the Ionian. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Turkey to Austria: I am taking BUL this Spring with A CON and F BLA. Austria's RUM, SER and BUD should stay out of Bulgaria and Turkish land. If you move into BUL, we are at war. Hold your Balkan positions and I will not enter Rumania or Serbia. Please confirm your Spring orders.

Turkey to Russia: Our Armenia-Ankara split still stands. I will keep A SMY and A CON off Armenia and Russian land. Please keep F SEV and A UKR off ARM and ANK. Tell me your Spring orders, and whether A UKR will move toward Rumania against Austria.

Austria here. VIE, TRI and BUD hold this Spring. No Austrian unit enters Bohemia, Silesia, Munich or Tyrolia. I take your word that A MUN stays in Munich and will not move into Tyrolia or Bohemia. Russia is the real threat to us in Galicia and Rumania, so let us keep the border quiet and watch the east together.

Austria here. A RUM and A SER hold this Spring, and neither enters Greece or Bulgaria. F TRI and A VIE stay out of the Adriatic and Trieste. Please keep A BUL, A GRE and F ION on their current lines and away from Serbia and Albania. We will talk again before Fall.

Austria here. This Spring A RUM, A SER and A BUD hold, and no Austrian unit enters Bulgaria or Turkish land. We agree Bulgaria goes to whoever takes it, with no unit entering the other's supply centres. Keep A CON, F BLA and A SMY out of Serbia and Rumania, and we will stay clear of your coast.

England here, Spring 1915. Confirmed: F NTH, F LON and A HOL hold this spring, with no move toward Belgium or Picardy. F LVP and F NOR also hold. I expect F MAO to stay in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. Give me notice before any move near Spain or Portugal, and I will do the same.

England here. Agreed for Spring 1915: I hold F STP, F NOR, F NTH and F LVP, and none will enter the Baltic, Sweden, NWG or the Russian homeland. Please keep F BOT and F SWE out of STP, NOR, NWG and EDI. We will reassess for Fall 1915 once we see how the south develops.

France here, Spring 1915. As agreed, F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I am holding A PAR, A MAR and A POR this spring with no move toward Brest, Picardy, Belgium or Spain. Please keep F NTH, F LON and A HOL off Belgium and Picardy. I will give notice before any change near Spain or Portugal.

France here, Spring 1915. I accept that Munich is yours. A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and A POR all hold this spring, with no move toward Munich, Belgium or the Ruhr. Please keep A BER, A KIE, A DEN and F BEL out of Burgundy, Picardy and Paris as you have said. I will tell you before any change to these orders.

Germany here, Spring 1915. Confirmed: F BEL, A KIE and A DEN hold this spring, and I make no move on Holland or the North Sea. Keep your fleets out of Denmark, Kiel and the Baltic. I will give you notice before any change near the Channel or North Sea.

Germany here, Spring 1915. Munich is German and A MUN holds there this spring. A BER, A KIE, A DEN and F BEL will not enter Burgundy, Picardy or Paris. Please keep A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and A POR off Munich and Belgium. I will tell you first of any change.

Italy here. My A BUL holds Bulgaria with F AEG supporting, and I will not move it. I have no orders against Serbia or Rumania. If your A RUM or A SER attacks BUL this Spring, I will defend it. I am keeping F ION and A VEN out of Trieste, Venice and Albania. Keep your Adriatic promise and we can avoid a war.

Italy here. F AEG stays in the Aegean and will not move to SMY or CON while you keep A CON and F BLA away from Bulgaria. Your attacks on A BUL this Spring will be defended. Hold off BUL and keep your fleets out of Greece and the Ionian, and our border stays quiet. Confirm your exact orders.

Russia here. Confirmed for Spring 1915: F BOT holds in the Gulf of Bothnia and will not attack STP. Please keep F NTH, F NOR and F LVP out of the Baltic, Sweden and NWG. If you hold the north this year, I will keep my fleets clear of your home waters and we can discuss the autumn then.

Russia here. A WAR holds Warsaw this Spring, and no Russian unit enters PRU, SIL, BER, DEN or KIE. In return, keep your units out of WAR and UKR. Austria is the shared target, and I will judge your Bohemia and Vienna moves by what you do this year before we discuss any split.

Russia here. Confirmed: A UKR, A WAR and F SEV hold this Spring and will not enter GAL, RUM or BUD. Your RUM, BUD and VIE staying defensive toward Ukraine is good. Keep your Balkan units off my WAR and UKR, and we will both stay quiet while you fight Italy.

Russia here. Our Armenia-Ankara-Sevastopol split holds. F SEV and A UKR hold this Spring, so no move into Rumania from me yet. F BLA must stay out of SEV and RUM. Please keep A SMY and A CON off Armenia and Russian land. I will watch your Bulgaria war against Italy.

Turkey here. A CON and F BLA attack Bulgaria this Spring, and I will not enter Serbia or Rumania. Your A RUM, A SER and A BUD must not enter BUL or Turkish land. Any Austrian move into Bulgaria means war with Turkey. Please confirm your Spring 1915 orders in writing today.

Turkey here. My A CON and F BLA attack your A BUL this Spring, and it cannot be relieved. Withdraw it to Greece or Rumania now. Keep F AEG away from SMY and CON, and I will keep my fleets out of Greece and the Ionian. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Turkey here. I am attacking Bulgaria with A CON and F BLA this Spring. Our split holds: F SEV and A UKR stay off ARM and ANK, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. Keep your fleets away from SMY and CON, and I will keep A SMY off Armenia. Please confirm your Spring orders in writing.

notes.note: Spring 1915: all hold for peace. France kept word (MAO in Atlantic). Germany kept word (BEL, DEN, KIE held). Russia pledged no attack on STP and BOT holds. Keep the north closed. Consider a convoy of HOL only with Germany's agreement; no unowned centers reachable now.

Spring 1915: all hold to honor deals. Germany has MUN again and promised to keep BER/KIE/DEN/BEL out of BUR/PIC/PAR. England keeps NTH/LON/HOL off BEL/PIC and asks MAO to stay out of ENG/Channel. No unowned SCs reachable. Revisit if a deal breaks or unowned centres appear.

Spring 1915: all hold to keep word. MUN held, Munich retaken. Promises: France keeps BUR/PAR/MAR/POR off MUN and BEL; England keeps out of HOL/NTH/DEN/KIE; Russia keeps out of PRU/BER/DEN/KIE. Austria: no BOH/SIL/TYR moves. Kept so far. Next: consider A DEN via NTH convoy only if England agrees.

Spring 1915: BOT to SWE to secure our centre against DEN; SEV, UKR, WAR hold per promises (no RUM/BUD/GAL, no PRU/SIL/BER, Turkey split kept). England: no STP attack this spring, north kept clear. Watch Germany's DEN and Austria's Balkan moves; reassess Fall 1915 for RUM if Austria weakens.

Spring 1915: holding BUL with F AEG support vs CON/BLA attack. Keep ROM/VEN/TUN/ION holds to keep pacts with Austria/France. Turkey breached line by attacking BUL. Next: if BUL holds, look for ALB/APU convoy gains; do not push north of BUL. Watch Austria's RUM/SER.

Spring 1915: no free centers, so RUM attacks BUL (SER supports). Broke Italy/Turkey Balkan pledges. BUD, TRI, VIE hold to guard home centers. Watch Russia (promised no RUM/BUD/GAL entry) and Germany (kept word on Tyrolia/Bohemia).

Spring 1915: CON attacks BUL (Italy) with BLA support; SMY moves to SYR (unowned). Italy, Austria and Russia have all promised no moves on SMY/CON/ANK/ARM; Italy has not withdrawn A BUL, so treat Italy as broken. Watch F AEG toward SMY and Austria's move into BUL. Next: take BUL if it falls, keep ANK and ARM clear of Russia.

messages.body: Austria here. Our Spring attack on Bulgaria bounced, and that fight costs us both. This Fall I propose A RUM and A SER hold, and I will not enter Bulgaria or Greece. In return, keep A BUL, F AEG and F ION away from Serbia, Trieste and Albania. Please confirm your Fall orders for BUL, GRE and ION in writing.

Austria here. Please confirm A UKR, A WAR and F SEV will not enter Galicia, Rumania or Budapest this Fall. My A VIE, A BUD and A RUM will stay out of Ukraine and Warsaw. Tell me plainly if F SEV or A UKR is planning a move toward Rumania, so we avoid a clash.

Austria here. Turkey, your A CON and F BLA are pressing Bulgaria, and my units hold this Fall. Confirm that A CON, F BLA and A SYR will stay out of Serbia and Rumania. I will keep my units out of Greece, Constantinople and Smyrna. Please confirm your Fall orders in writing.

England here, Fall 1915. Russia's F SWE and A WAR are the northern threat to both of us. I'll keep F NTH and F NOR out of DEN, KIE and BEL as agreed. If you move against Russia in the Baltic, I'll hold STP and NWG, and I'll share what I see of Russia's north movements. What are your Fall orders?

England here, Fall 1915. I'm holding STP, NOR, NTH and LVP. I'm not entering the Baltic or Sweden, as agreed. Please keep F SWE out of NWG, NOR and EDI. What are your autumn plans for SWE and WAR, and are you still holding SEV and UKR against Turkey?

France here, Fall 1915. Austria is our shared neighbour and its Adriatic coast is exposed. I propose we coordinate in 1916: your A VEN and F ION press Trieste while my armies hold the west. Please confirm your Fall 1915 orders first, and tell me if you plan any move toward Piedmont or Tunis.

France here, Fall 1915. Our border has held all year. Please confirm A MUN, A BER, A KIE and F BEL hold this Fall, with no move toward Burgundy, Picardy or Paris. In return, A BUR, A PAR and A MAR stay off Munich and Belgium. Tell me of any change first.

France here. F MAO stays in the Atlantic as agreed, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. Please confirm F NTH, F LON, A HOL and F LVP hold this Fall. Tell me if you plan any move toward Norway or Denmark, so we avoid contesting Belgium and Picardy.

Germany here, Fall 1915. My A BER, A KIE, A DEN and F BEL hold, and I will keep out of Prussia, Silesia and Warsaw. Austria is the shared target. Propose you keep A WAR and A UKR off Silesia and Berlin, and we split Austria: I take Bohemia and Vienna, you take Galicia and Rumania. Tell me your Fall orders for WAR, UKR, SEV and SWE.

Germany here. My A MUN holds Munich this Fall, and I will not enter Tyrolia or Bohemia while your VIE and TRI stay put. Please confirm they hold. Are your A RUM and A SER aimed at Russia in Galicia or at Italy in the Balkans? Tell me before any move near Bohemia.

Italy here. Your A CON and F BLA are attacking my A BUL, and I will hold it with F AEG support. Continuing this wastes both our fleets. Withdraw from Bulgaria this Fall, and I will keep F AEG out of SMY and CON and leave Turkish home centres alone. Tell me in writing whether you accept.

Italy here. Your A RUM and A SER are two steps from Bulgaria and Greece. If either moves against BUL this Fall, I will fight it, and that war hurts us both against Russia. Confirm both hold this Fall. In return, my A ROM and A VEN stay off Trieste, Albania and your centres, and F ION stays south of Greece.

Russia here. Fall 1915: I plan to hold A UKR and A WAR this turn, so no Russian unit enters RUM or BUD. Please confirm whether A RUM stays in Rumania or moves to Bulgaria, and tell me plainly if A BUD or A VIE will shift north toward GAL or WAR.

Russia here. Our Armenia-Ankara-Sevastopol split still stands this autumn. Please tell me your Fall 1915 orders against Bulgaria and whether F BLA will support anything into Rumania. If Austria's RUM line breaks, I want to coordinate our moves on Rumania before anyone takes it alone.

Russia here. Austria is spread across Bulgaria and the Balkans, so Vienna is the pressure point. I keep A WAR and A UKR in place and will not enter PRU, SIL, BER, DEN or KIE. Tell me your autumn plans for Bohemia and whether you will move on VIE this turn.

Turkey to Italy: My A CON and F BLA are attacking your A BUL this Fall. Withdraw it to Greece or Rumania now, or it will be lost. Keep F AEG out of SMY and CON, and I will keep my fleets out of Greece and the Ionian. Confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Turkey to Russia: Keep F SEV and A UKR off ARM and ANK, and I will keep A SMY and A CON off Russian land. Please tell me your Fall orders. If Austria's RUM and SER fall, we can split Rumania later, but not while our Armenia line is open.

Turkey to Austria: I am attacking Bulgaria this Fall with A CON and F BLA. Keep A RUM, A SER and A BUD out of Bulgaria and Turkish land, and I will not enter Rumania or Serbia. Any Austrian move into Bulgaria or Greece means war. Please confirm your Fall orders.

Austria here. Fall 1915: A RUM and A SER hold and will not enter Bulgaria or Greece. Please keep A BUL, F AEG and F ION off Serbia, Trieste and Albania, and keep A ROM and A VEN off our centres. If that holds, we both keep our centres and can focus on Russia and Turkey.

Austria here. Confirmed: A RUM, A SER, A BUD and A VIE hold this Fall and will not enter Ukraine or Warsaw. Please keep A UKR, A WAR and F SEV out of Galicia, Rumania and Budapest. If you hold, we stay quiet. Tell me if F SEV moves toward Rumania.

Austria here. Confirmed: VIE and TRI hold this Fall, and no Austrian unit enters Tyrolia, Bohemia or Munich. A RUM and A SER are positioned against Russia in Galicia and Rumania, not toward Bohemia. Keep BER, KIE and BEL north of Bohemia, and we will keep the border quiet.

Austria here. Our Spring attack on Bulgaria bounced, and I accept that Bulgaria is contested. This Fall A RUM and A SER hold, so no Austrian unit enters Bulgaria or Turkish land. Please keep A CON, F BLA and A SYR out of Serbia and Rumania, and neither of us enters the other's supply centres.

England here, Fall 1915. Confirmed: F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A HOL hold this autumn, with no move toward Brest, Picardy, Belgium, the Channel or Spain. F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI as agreed. I will give you notice before any change near Spain or Portugal, and I expect the same from you.

Germany here. This Fall F BEL, A BER, A KIE, A DEN and A MUN all hold. I will not enter Prussia, Silesia or Warsaw. Your A WAR and A UKR should stay off Silesia and Berlin as you have said. I agree to split Austria later: I take Bohemia and Vienna, you take Galicia and Rumania. Keep F SWE and F SEV out of Denmark and Kiel.

Germany here, Fall 1915. I hold F BEL, A KIE, A DEN and A BER this autumn, with no move on Holland or the North Sea. Please keep F NTH, F NOR and A HOL out of Denmark, Kiel and Belgium as agreed. Russia's F SWE is the threat to our northern flank, so I will tell you first of any change in the Baltic or North Sea.

Germany here, Fall 1915. Confirmed: A MUN, A BER, A KIE and F BEL all hold this autumn, with no move toward Burgundy, Picardy or Paris. Please keep A BUR, A PAR and A MAR off Munich and Belgium as you proposed. I will tell you first of any change to these orders.

Italy to Austria: Confirmed for Fall 1915. A BUL holds, F AEG supports it, F ION holds south of Greece, and A ROM and A VEN hold. I will not move against Serbia, Rumania, Trieste or Albania. Please keep A RUM and A SER out of Bulgaria and Greece, as you have proposed.

Italy to France: Confirmed. F TUN, A VEN, A ROM and F ION hold this Fall, and none enters the Gulf of Lyon, Spain or Piedmont. I am not ready to commit to a 1916 move against Austria. Let's talk again in the Spring, and keep your armies away from Tunis.

Italy to Turkey: I will not withdraw A BUL. It holds this Fall with F AEG support. F AEG stays in the Aegean and will not go to SMY or CON. If A CON or F BLA attacks Bulgaria, I will defend it. Keep your fleets out of Greece and the Ionian and this line stays quiet.

Russia here. Confirmed for Fall 1915: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. I hold A WAR and A UKR, and F SEV stays in the Black Sea. Please keep F STP, F NOR, F NTH and F LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden, and tell me first of any change in the north.

Russia here. A WAR holds this Fall, and no Russian unit enters PRU, SIL, BER, DEN or KIE. Your Bohemia and Vienna push is yours to run. Once Austria's Balkan line is broken, I would take Galicia and Rumania. Keep your units out of WAR and UKR, and we can talk about the rest in Spring 1916.
