Russia here. This Fall, A UKR, A WAR and F SEV hold, and no Russian unit enters GAL, RUM or BUD. I have no current plans to move on your centres. Keep your Balkan units off UKR and WAR, and we stay quiet while you fight Italy and Turkey's Bulgaria war.

Russia here. The Armenia-Ankara-Sevastopol split holds: F SEV and A UKR hold this Fall and will not go toward ARM or ANK. Please keep F BLA out of SEV and RUM, and keep A SMY and A CON off Russian land. If Austria's RUM and SER break, we can coordinate on Rumania.

Turkey here. I will not withdraw from Bulgaria. A CON and F BLA attack A BUL this Fall. Hold it or lose it. Keep F AEG out of SMY and CON, and I will keep my fleets out of Greece and the Ionian. Any move by F AEG toward SMY or CON means war.

Turkey here. Our Armenia-Ankara-Sevastopol split stands. F SEV and A UKR stay off ARM and ANK, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. A CON attacks Bulgaria this Fall and A SYR stays off Russian land. I will coordinate on Rumania only after the Austrian line breaks.

Turkey here. A CON and F BLA attack Bulgaria this Fall. Keep A RUM, A SER and A BUD out of Bulgaria and Turkish land, and I will not enter Rumania or Serbia. Any Austrian move into Bulgaria or Greece means war. Confirm your Fall orders in writing.

notes.note: Fall 1915: all hold to keep 5 SCs and honor deals with Germany (no BUR/PAR/MAR into BEL/MUN/RUH/PIC) and England (MAO out of ENG/Channel). No unowned SCs reachable. Italy noncommittal on 1916 Austria plan. Revisit if a deal breaks or unowned centres appear.

Russia proposed a Vienna/Bohemia split in Spring 1916; hold until Austria's Balkan line breaks. Next: consider F BEL to NTH to set up A DEN convoy, after checking England agrees.

Fall 1915: all hold to keep promises to Austria (no GAL/RUM/BUD), Germany (no PRU/SIL/BER/DEN/KIE), Turkey (SEV/UKR split) and England (no north/Baltic entry). No unowned centers reachable. Reassess Spring 1916 for RUM/GAL if Austria's Balkan line breaks.

Fall 1915: all hold to keep peace with Germany and France; Germany, France and Russia confirmed no moves on our centers. Russia's F SWE and A WAR are the northern threat; watch them. Next: check whether Russia keeps SWE out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI. No unowned centers reachable.

Fall 1915: all hold to keep 5 SCs. Bulgaria attack bounces against Italy and Turkey. Italy kept word so far; Russia says no RUM/BUD entry; Germany holds MUN. Watch Italy ROM/VEN near TRI and Russia UKR/WAR near GAL. Reassess Bulgaria if Turkish or Italian units leave.

Fall 1915: holding BUL with AEG support vs CON/BLA (equal strength, bounce). Holding ION/ROM/TUN/VEN to keep pacts with France and Austria. Turkey breached; Austria kept RUM/SER off BUL/GRE. Next: if BUL survives, consider AEG to SMY (empty Turkish centre) and ALB/APU convoys; Turkey may move A SYR back to SMY.

Fall 1915: A CON attacks Italy's A BUL with F BLA support; A SYR moves to SMY to hold our center. Italy's AEG support likely bounces the attack. Russia keeps the SEV/ARM/ANK split; Austria has kept RUM/SER out of BUL and Turkish land. Watch F AEG toward SMY/CON and Austria's Balkan moves. No unowned centers remain; take Italy's BUL if it falls.

messages.body: Austria here. Spring 1916: I propose A RUM and A SER hold, and we both leave Bulgaria alone until Turkey's position is clear. Please confirm A BUL, F AEG, F ION and A ROM/VEN stay off Serbia, Trieste and Albania. Tell me your orders in writing before we move.

Austria here. Please confirm A UKR, A WAR and F SEV hold this Spring and will not enter Galicia, Rumania or Budapest. My A VIE, A BUD and A RUM also hold. If you plan any move toward RUM or BUD, tell me now so we avoid a clash.

Austria here. Bulgaria is still contested, so I ask you to confirm A CON, F BLA and A SMY stay out of Serbia and Rumania this Spring. My A RUM, A SER and A BUD hold and will not enter Bulgaria or Turkish land. Confirm in writing what you intend in BUL.

England here, Spring 1916. Your F SWE and A WAR are the main northern threat. I'm holding STP, NOR, NTH and LVP and won't enter the Baltic or Sweden. Will you keep F SWE out of NWG, NOR and EDI this spring and confirm your Spring orders for WAR and UKR?

England here, Spring 1916. I'm holding HOL, LON, NTH and LVP with no move toward Belgium, Denmark or Kiel. Could we agree that Germany keeps F BEL and A DEN off the North Sea, and that I'll flag any Channel change first? Tell me your Spring plans against Russia.

France here, Spring 1916. Austria's Adriatic coast is open to us both. If you move A VEN to Trieste with F ION supporting, I will keep A PAR, A MAR and A BUR on the western border and not enter Tunis or the Gulf of Lyon. Will you commit to that plan this spring?

France here, Spring 1916. As agreed, F MAO stays out of the Channel and English waters. I will give notice before any move near Spain or Portugal. Please confirm F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A HOL keep off Belgium and Picardy this spring, and tell me your Spring orders.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1916: I propose we split Austria as agreed. I will move against Bohemia and Vienna. Keep A WAR and A UKR off Silesia, Berlin and Prussia, and move F SWE away from Denmark and Kiel. Please confirm your Spring orders for WAR, UKR, SEV and SWE, and whether you attack Rumania.

Germany to Austria: Our border understanding is ending. I intend to strike into Bohemia and Vienna this year, with Russia pressing Galicia. You should bring your forces back from the Balkans to defend VIE and TRI. If you want peace, tell me now what you will do with A RUM and A SER.

Italy to Austria: Your A RUM and A SER are next to BUL and GRE. My A BUL holds with F AEG support, and I will not move against Serbia or Trieste. Tell me now whether either army will move to Greece or Bulgaria this Spring. If they hold, F ION stays off Albania and Trieste.

Italy to Turkey: F AEG stays in the Aegean and will not go to SMY or CON. A BUL holds with support. Your A CON and F BLA have failed against it twice. Keep both away from Bulgaria this Spring, and I will keep my fleets out of Greece and the Ionian. Confirm your Spring 1916 orders in writing.

Italy to France: F TUN and F ION hold this Spring. I will not enter the Gulf of Lyon, Spain or Piedmont. Please keep A MAR and A POR away from Tunis and Italian soil. Tell me your Spring 1916 orders, and whether your plans include any move toward Italian territory.

Russia here. Spring 1916: A WAR and A UKR hold this turn. I will not enter PRU, SIL, BER, DEN or KIE. Once your Bohemia push against Austria is underway, I want Galicia and Rumania. Confirm your A MUN and A BER will stay off WAR and UKR, and tell me your Spring orders for BOH and VIE.

Russia here. Spring 1916: I propose we keep the Armenia-Ankara-Sevastopol split. F SEV and A UKR hold this turn. Tell me plainly whether A SMY, A CON or F BLA will move toward Rumania or Bulgaria this spring. I want to coordinate on Rumania once Austria's line breaks, not compete for it.

Turkey to Italy: Bulgaria is isolated, and A CON and F BLA will attack it this Spring. Withdraw A BUL to Greece or Rumania now and avoid a costly loss. In return, F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, and my fleets stay out of Greece and the Ionian. Please confirm in writing.

Turkey to Russia: Our Armenia-Ankara-Sevastopol split still holds. I will keep A SMY and A CON off ARM and ANK. Please keep F SEV and A UKR off ARM and ANK, and F BLA out of SEV and RUM. Tell me your Spring 1916 orders so we can avoid accidental clashes.

Turkey to Austria: Bulgaria is contested, and I am attacking Italy's A BUL this Spring. Please keep A RUM, A SER and A BUD out of Bulgaria and Greece, and I will keep A CON, F BLA and A SMY out of Serbia and Rumania. Please confirm your Spring 1916 orders.

Austria here. Your Spring letter ends our understanding, so I will answer with force. VIE and TRI are garrisoned, and A RUM and A SER hold this Spring against Russia. Any move into Bohemia, Tyrolia or Munich will be met with war. Keep BER, KIE and BEL out of Silesia and our centres, and we can discuss Russia later.

Austria here. This Spring A RUM and A SER hold and will not enter Bulgaria or Greece. Please keep A BUL, F AEG, F ION and A ROM/VEN off Serbia, Trieste and Albania. Turkey says it is attacking your A BUL, so that fight is yours. If you keep your word, Austria stays out of the Adriatic.

Austria here. A RUM, A SER and A BUD hold this Spring, and no Austrian unit enters Bulgaria or Turkish land. Since you are attacking Italy's A BUL, I hope that fight goes well for you. Keep A CON, F BLA and A SMY out of Serbia and Rumania, and we will both keep our centres.

England here, Spring 1916. Confirmed: F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A HOL all hold this spring, with no move toward Belgium, Picardy, Brest, the Channel or Spain. F EDI and F STP also hold. Please keep F MAO in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. If your Iberian plans change, give me notice first, as you have promised.

France here. My Spring 1916 orders: A MAR, A POR, A PAR and A BUR hold, and F MAO stays in the Atlantic. None of my units moves toward Tunis, Piedmont or Italian soil this spring. I can't yet commit to the Trieste plan, but I'll tell you before any change in the west.

Germany here, Spring 1916. F BEL, A KIE and A DEN hold this spring, and I make no move on Holland or the North Sea. A MUN moves to Bohemia against Austria. Keep F NTH, F NOR and A HOL off Denmark, Kiel and Belgium, and flag any Channel change to me first.

Germany to Russia: A MUN moves to Bohemia against Vienna, and A BER holds. I will not enter Galicia, Warsaw, Ukraine or Rumania. Keep A WAR and A UKR off Silesia, Berlin and Prussia, and move F SWE away from Denmark and Kiel. Galicia and Rumania remain yours once Austria's line breaks.

Italy here. A BUL holds this Spring with F AEG support, and I will not move against Serbia or Trieste. F ION and A VEN stay off Albania and Trieste while your A RUM and A SER hold and stay out of Bulgaria and Greece. Confirm your Spring 1916 orders for both armies in writing before anyone moves.

Italy here. F TUN and F ION hold this Spring, and I will not enter the Gulf of Lyon, Spain or Piedmont. Please keep A MAR, A POR and A PAR away from Tunis and Italian soil. Send me your Spring 1916 orders so we both know where our armies stand.

Italy here. I will not withdraw A BUL. It holds with F AEG support, and F AEG stays in the Aegean away from SMY and CON. Your A CON and F BLA have already failed against it twice. Keep both away from Bulgaria and out of Greece, and I will keep my fleets out of the Ionian.

Russia here. Confirmed: A UKR, A WAR and F SEV hold this Spring. No Russian unit enters GAL, RUM or BUD this Spring. I will tell you before any change toward RUM or BUD, and I expect the same from your A VIE, A BUD and A RUM.

Russia here. F SWE holds in Sweden this Spring and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. Please keep F NOR, F NTH and F LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden. A UKR and A WAR hold. I will tell you first of any change in the north.

Russia here. Spring 1916: A WAR and A UKR hold, and F SWE holds in Sweden, clear of Denmark and Kiel. I will not enter PRU, SIL, BER, DEN or KIE. Please keep A MUN and A BER off WAR and UKR. Once your Bohemia push starts, we can discuss Galicia and Rumania.

Russia here. Spring 1916: F SEV and A UKR hold, so the Armenia-Ankara-Sevastopol split stands. I will not enter ARM or ANK. Keep F BLA out of SEV and RUM, and keep A SMY and A CON off Russian land. Tell me plainly if A CON or A SMY heads for Rumania this Spring.

Turkey here. A CON and F BLA are attacking Italy's A BUL this Spring. Keep A RUM, A SER and A BUD out of Bulgaria and Greece, and I will keep A CON, F BLA and A SMY out of Serbia and Rumania. Any Austrian move into Bulgaria or Greece means war. Please confirm your Spring 1916 orders in writing.

notes.note: Spring 1916: holding SEV, UKR, WAR, SWE per promises to Austria, Germany, England, Turkey. Galicia/Rumania are the target once Austria's Balkan line breaks. Watch Germany's MUN-BOH push and Turkey's CON/SMY moves toward RUM. Keep F SWE out of NWG, NOR, EDI, DEN, KIE.

Spring 1916: all hold to keep 5 SCs and honor deals: Germany (no BUR/PAR/MAR into BEL/MUN/RUH/PIC), England (MAO out of ENG/Channel), Italy (no Tunis/Gulf of Lyon/Piedmont). All have kept deals so far. No unowned SCs reachable. Revisit if a deal breaks or unowned centres appear; consider Italy Trieste plan only if Italy commits.

Spring 1916: all hold to keep 5 SCs; no free centers. Germany threatens VIE/TRI via BOH/TYR; watch MUN. Italy and Turkey fighting over BUL; Russia promises no RUM/BUD entry. Break no pacts yet. Consider TRI/VIE support if Germany moves.

Spring 1916: all hold to keep peace. France (MAO, NTH/LON/LVP/HOL off Belgium) and Germany (BEL/DEN/KIE, no North Sea moves) kept word so far; Russia pledged SWE stays out of NWG/NOR/EDI. Next: watch Russian F SWE and A WAR; consider HOL->DEN convoy only if Germany agrees.

Spring 1916: MUN to BOH vs Austria as planned; Austria has broken the split and threatens war. BEL, BER, DEN hold; KIE supports DEN. Russia has kept WAR/UKR and stayed out of PRU/SIL/BER/DEN/KIE so far. England has kept north out of DEN/KIE/BEL. Watch F SWE near DEN and France near MUN. Next: take VIE/BOH if Austria stays weak; keep BER/KIE to hold home centers.

Spring 1916: A BUL holds with F AEG support against Turkish CON/BLA. Holding ION/ROM/TUN/VEN to keep pacts with France and Austria. Turkey and Austria keep pressing for BUL withdrawal; refused. Next: if BUL holds, look at ALB/APU convoys from ROM/VEN, and AEG to SMY once Turkish fleets are drawn off.

Spring 1916: CON attacks Italy's BUL with BLA support, SMY holds. Italy's AEG support likely bounces it again. Italy and Austria say they keep out of CON/SMY/RUM/SER. Russia keeps the SEV/ARM/ANK split. Next: keep SMY and ANK, and retake BUL if it falls.

messages.body: Austria here. Your Spring letter has left us little choice, but a costly war helps neither of us against Russia. Withdraw A BOH and A MUN from Bohemia and Tyrolia this Fall, and VIE and TRI will hold and stay defensive. Otherwise we fight. Tell me your Fall orders for BOH and MUN now.

Austria here. Germany has declared against us and threatens VIE and TRI through Bohemia. Russia and Austria both lose if Germany takes Bohemia and Galicia. Will you attack Germany in Silesia or Warsaw's northern front? In return, A UKR and A WAR stay away from GAL this Fall, and A RUM stays off Ukraine.

Austria here. With Germany now hostile, I need VIE and TRI safe, so I want to keep Italy quiet. Please confirm F ION, A VEN and A ROM stay off Trieste and Albania this Fall. Austria's A RUM, A SER and A BUD will stay out of Bulgaria and Greece while you contest BUL with Turkey.

England here, Fall 1916. I hold NTH, LON, HOL, LVP and EDI. I will not move on Belgium, Denmark or Kiel this autumn. Please keep F BEL, A DEN and A KIE out of Holland and the North Sea, and tell me before any move toward Norway or Sweden.

England here, Fall 1916. I hold STP, NOR, NTH and LVP and will not enter the Baltic or Sweden. Will F SWE stay out of NWG, NOR and EDI this autumn? If your Fall orders change for WAR or SWE, please tell me first so we keep the north quiet.

England here, Fall 1916. I keep F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A HOL off Belgium, Picardy and the Channel. Please keep F MAO in the Atlantic, out of English waters, LVP and EDI. Give me notice before any move near Spain or Portugal, and I will do the same.

France here, Fall 1916. Austria is weak, with five centres and units in Trieste and Vienna. I propose your A VEN moves to Trieste, with F ION or F ADR supporting, while my A PAR, A MAR and A BUR hold the west. I will not enter Tunis, the Gulf of Lyon or Piedmont. Will you confirm your Fall orders?

France here, Fall 1916. Our border has held all year and I want it kept that way. Please confirm A MUN, A BER, A KIE, A DEN, A BOH and F BEL will not enter Burgundy, Picardy, Paris or the Ruhr this autumn. I will keep A BUR, A PAR and A MAR off Munich and Belgium. Tell me of any change first.

Germany here, Fall 1916. Austria has broken our split and I am at war with it. I will press A BOH toward VIE. Please take Galicia and Rumania as agreed, and keep A WAR and A UKR out of Silesia, Prussia and Berlin. Tell me your Fall orders for WAR, UKR, SEV and SWE.

Germany here. Austria is now my enemy and holds TRI and VIE next to both of us. Could Italy push A VEN and your northern units into Trieste this year while I press Vienna from Bohemia? Tell me your Fall orders and whether you will attack TRI.

Germany here. We have not spoken, and I have no units near you. Austria holds RUM and SER, and Italy holds BUL, GRE and ROM. Are you planning anything against Italy or Austria this year? I would like to hear your Fall orders.

Italy to Turkey: Your A CON and F BLA have failed against Bulgaria twice, so further attacks only drain both our fleets. Proposal: stop attacking BUL this Fall, and I keep F AEG out of SMY and CON. Turkey can then focus its strength on Russia. Confirm in writing.

Italy to Austria: Our pact holds. A BUL and F AEG stay put, and I will not move against Serbia, Trieste or Albania. Please keep A RUM and A SER out of Bulgaria and Greece this Fall, and tell me your Fall 1916 orders in writing.

Russia here. Austria's Rumania is the prize. I propose we take RUM together this Fall: A UKR moves to GAL and F SEV supports or moves into RUM, and you bring A SMY or A CON toward Bulgaria or Rumania. Armenia and Ankara stay closed. Tell me your Fall orders by reply.

Russia here. Your Bohemia push against Vienna fits our split. I will keep A WAR and A UKR out of PRU, SIL, BER, DEN and KIE. In return, please keep A MUN and A BER off WAR and UKR, and tell me when Vienna is threatened so I can time my move into Galicia.

Turkey to Italy: F AEG has held BUL with support for two seasons, and that stalemate costs us both. I will keep A CON and F BLA attacking BUL this Fall. If F AEG moves to Greece or stays out of SMY and CON, my fleets stay out of Greece and the Ionian. Tell me your Fall 1916 orders.

Turkey to Russia: Our split holds. I will keep A SMY and A CON off ARM and ANK. Please keep F SEV and A UKR off ARM and ANK, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. Tell me plainly whether A UKR or F SEV moves toward RUM this Fall, so we avoid clashes.

Austria here. Fall 1916: A RUM, A SER and A BUD will stay out of Bulgaria and Greece while you contest BUL with Turkey. In return, please confirm in writing that F ION, A VEN and A ROM stay off Trieste, Vienna and Albania this Fall. Germany is hostile to us, so Austrian quiet on your Balkan front depends on your quiet on ours.

France here, Fall 1916. Agreed: F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI this autumn. My armies in BUR, PAR, MAR and POR hold, with no move toward Brest, Picardy, Belgium or Spain. I'll give you notice before any change near Spain or Portugal. Please keep F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A HOL off Belgium and Picardy as you've said.

Germany here. Your withdrawal offer comes too late. You broke our split and attacked my home border, so A BOH will press VIE this Fall. Pull your garrisons out of VIE and TRI and I will consider a peace line on the Balkans after Russia is dealt with.

Germany here. My F BEL, A DEN and A KIE hold this Fall, and I make no move on Holland or the North Sea. I have no plans against Norway or Sweden. I will tell you first if that changes, and I ask you to keep F NTH and F NOR away from DEN and KIE.

Germany here. I confirm that A BER, A KIE, A DEN and F BEL will not enter Burgundy, Picardy, Paris or the Ruhr this Fall. My war is with Austria in Bohemia. Keep your A BUR, A PAR and A MAR off Munich and Belgium, and we will both be safe.

Germany here. Austria has broken our split, so I am pressing A BOH against Vienna. Galicia and Rumania are yours to take as agreed. Keep A WAR and A UKR out of Silesia, Prussia and Berlin, and move F SWE clear of Denmark and Kiel. Please tell me your Fall orders for SEV and SWE.

Italy to France: I cannot agree to the Trieste plan this Fall. A VEN and F ION will hold, and I will not enter Tunis, the Gulf of Lyon, Spain or Piedmont. My Fall 1916 orders: A BUL, F AEG, F ION, A ROM and A VEN all hold. Let's talk again in Spring 1917 about the west and Austria.

Italy to Austria: Confirmed for Fall 1916. F ION, A VEN and A ROM hold. I will not move to Trieste or Albania this Fall. A BUL and F AEG also hold. Keep A RUM, A SER and A BUD out of Bulgaria and Greece, as agreed. Our pact stands while you hold your side.

Italy to Germany: I will not push A VEN into Trieste this Fall. My Fall 1916 orders are holds across the board in the Adriatic and Balkans. Austria's units are your problem in the north, and I will not stop you from pressing Vienna. Keep your fleets out of the Tyrrhenian and Ionian and we remain at peace.

Italy to Turkey: I will not withdraw A BUL, and F AEG holds with support. Your attacks have failed twice, so I propose a stop: no attack on BUL this Fall, and F AEG stays out of SMY and CON. Turkey can turn to Russia. If you keep your fleets out of Greece and the Ionian, this line stays quiet.

Russia here. Confirmed: F SWE holds in Sweden this Fall and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. Keep your fleets out of the Baltic and Sweden, and I will keep my northern units clear of your home waters. I'll tell you first if that changes.

Russia here. A WAR holds and will not attack Silesia or Prussia. A UKR is still deciding its Fall move, and I cannot promise it stays out of Galicia. Your Germany war is your own affair, and I will not join it in the north. Keep your Balkan units off UKR and WAR.

Russia here. A WAR and A UKR will not enter PRU, SIL, BER, DEN or KIE this Fall. Your Bohemia push against Vienna suits me. Keep A MUN and A BER off WAR and UKR, and Galicia and Rumania can be discussed once Vienna falls. I am not promising anything on Austria's southern line yet.

Russia here. The Armenia-Ankara-Sevastopol split stands: I will not enter ARM or ANK. F SEV holds in the Black Sea this Fall. A UKR may move toward Galicia, not Rumania, and I will not move a unit into RUM without telling you first. Keep F BLA out of SEV and RUM.

Turkey to Italy: I decline to stop. A CON and F BLA attack A BUL this Fall, and it cannot be relieved unless it withdraws to Greece or Rumania. F AEG keeps out of SMY and CON, and my fleets stay out of Greece and the Ionian. Withdraw A BUL and we can talk about peace.

Turkey to Russia: The Armenia-Ankara split holds. I will keep A SMY and A CON off ARM and ANK. A CON attacks Bulgaria this Fall, so I will not move toward Rumania now. Keep F SEV and A UKR off my land, and tell me plainly if A UKR enters RUM.

Turkey to Germany: My Fall orders are A CON and F BLA attacking Italy's A BUL, with A SMY holding. I have no plans against Austria now, and I hope you keep your forces away from the Black Sea and the Balkans. We have no conflicting interests yet.

notes.note: Fall 1916: all five SCs held, no unowned centres. Holding to honour deals: Germany (no BUR/PAR/MAR into BEL/MUN/RUH/PIC), England (MAO out of ENG/Channel). Italy declined Trieste plan; no move to Tunis/Piedmont. Revisit if a deal breaks or unowned centres appear; consider Belgium only if Germany weakens.

Fall 1916: holding all units for peace with France, Germany, Russia. No unowned centers reachable. Germany and France kept word. Russia pledged no Baltic/Sweden moves. Next: watch Russian F SWE and A WAR, and consider a HOL convoy only with Germany's agreement.

Fall 1916: all holds, F AEG supports A BUL holding against Turkish CON/BLA attacks. Pacts: Austria (no Trieste/Albania/Bulgaria moves by us), France (no Tunis/Gulf of Lyon/Spain/Piedmont). Turkey wants BUL withdrawn; refused. Watch Turkish fleets near Greece and Ionian. Next: if BUL holds, look at ALB/APU convoys from ROM/VEN, and AEG to SMY once Turkish fleets are drawn off.

Fall 1916: Germany A BOH threatens VIE. BUD supports VIE hold, VIE, TRI, RUM, SER hold to keep 5 SCs. Italy pact holding so far; Russia says UKR undecided, watch it. Keep Balkan units off BUL/GRE. Germany broke our split; no peace yet.

Fall 1916: BOH attacks VIE alone (no support available), BER/KIE/DEN/BEL hold to guard home centers. Promised Russia Galicia and Rumania once Vienna falls; Russia has kept WAR/UKR out of PRU/SIL/BER/DEN/KIE. England, France, Italy, Turkey kept peace so far. Austria broke split; at war. Next: keep pressing VIE, watch Russia on SIL/PRU.

Fall 1916: F SEV supports A UKR into RUM (Austrian center); SWE and WAR hold to keep centers. Broke earlier no-RUM promise to Turkey, so tell Turkey and Austria. Germany's GAL/RUM split still open. Watch Turkey's BLA and Germany's BOH push; keep SWE out of north.

Fall 1916: no valid convoy chain to BUL this turn, so all three units hold. Italy and Russia both proposed stabilizing. Russia keeps the SEV/ARM/ANK split and says A UKR is headed to GAL. Italy offers to keep F AEG off SMY/CON if I stop attacking BUL. Austria is still unanswered. Next: reassess BUL and RUM once convoy orders can be lined up.

messages.body: Austria here. Our units are VIE, TRI, BUD and SER, and none of them will attack Bohemia this Spring. Your A BOH is pressing VIE. I propose a standstill: you keep A BOH out of VIE and TRI, and we keep our Balkan units out of Silesia and Munich. Tell me your Spring orders for BOH before we both move.

Austria here. Germany's A BOH threatens VIE, and Galicia is next if they break through. I ask that A UKR does not enter Galicia this Spring, and that A WAR presses Silesia or Prussia against Germany. I will keep A BUD and A VIE out of Ukraine and Warsaw. Please confirm your Spring orders.

Austria here. Our Fall pact still holds. I need VIE and TRI safe while Germany attacks from Bohemia. Please keep F ION, A VEN and A ROM off Trieste and Albania this Spring, and confirm your Spring 1917 orders in writing. Austria will keep A SER and A BUD out of Bulgaria and Greece.

England here, Spring 1917. Your F SWE and A WAR remain the northern question. I'm holding STP, NOR, NTH and LVP and will not enter the Baltic or Sweden. Please confirm F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR and EDI this spring, and tell me your orders for WAR and MOS.

England here, Spring 1917. I keep NTH, LON, HOL and LVP off Denmark, Kiel and Belgium, as before. Please keep F BEL, A DEN and A KIE out of Holland and the North Sea. What are your Spring plans against Russia or Austria? I'll flag any change toward Norway first.

France to Italy, Spring 1917: Austria is down to four centres, so Trieste is open. Would you move A VEN to Trieste with F ION supporting? My A PAR, A MAR and A BUR will hold the west. I will not enter Tunis, the Gulf of Lyon or Piedmont. Please send your Spring orders first.

France to Germany, Spring 1917: Please confirm A MUN, A BER, A KIE, A DEN, A BOH and F BEL will not enter Burgundy, Picardy, Paris or the Ruhr this spring. In return, A BUR, A PAR and A MAR stay off Munich and Belgium. Tell me of any change first.

France to England, Spring 1917: F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. Please confirm F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A HOL keep off Belgium and Picardy. Tell me your Spring orders, and whether any unit heads toward Norway or Denmark.

Germany here. A BOH will take VIE unless you act. Offer: you keep TRI and BUD, cede VIE to me, and we both turn against Russia in Galicia. Tell me your Spring orders for VIE, TRI and the Balkan units before I move.

Germany to Russia: Galicia and Rumania remain yours once VIE falls, as agreed. Keep A WAR and A UKR out of SIL, PRU and BER, and keep F SWE away from DEN and KIE. What are your Spring orders for MOS, SEV and SWE?

Germany to France: My units stay east of MUN and BEL, and I will not enter BUR, PIC or PAR. Keep A BUR, A PAR and A MAR off MUN and BEL as agreed. Tell me first if you plan any move toward the Ruhr or Belgium this year.

Italy to Turkey: Spring 1917. Your A CON and F BLA have failed against A BUL twice, and further attacks only drain both our fleets. I propose a stop: no attacks on BUL this Spring, and F AEG stays out of SMY and CON. Confirm in writing, and tell me your Spring orders.

Italy to Austria: For Spring 1917, A BUL and F AEG hold, and F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold. I will not move to Trieste, Albania or Serbia. Please confirm that A RUM, A SER and A BUD stay out of Bulgaria and Greece, and send your Spring orders in writing.

Italy to France: I am holding this Spring. F TUN, F ION and A VEN stay put, and I will not enter the Gulf of Lyon, Spain or Piedmont. What are your Spring 1917 plans in the west, and do they include any move toward Tunis or Italian soil?

Russia here. I took RUM in Fall 1916 with F SEV support and broke my word to you on it. Our split stands: I will not enter ARM or ANK. Keep A CON and A SMY out of RUM and UKR, and tell me your Spring orders for BUL and SER.

Russia here. Austria is collapsing around Bohemia. I hold RUM and will move A WAR and A UKR toward GAL, not into Silesia, Prussia or Berlin. Keep A MUN and A BER off WAR and UKR. Tell me your Spring orders against VIE.

Russia here. I took RUM in Fall 1916, and I am not offering to return it. Your BUD, SER and VIE are under pressure from Germany and Italy. If you want terms, tell me what you can give for peace in GAL and what you will hold this Spring.

Turkey to Italy: Spring 1917 is a new season. I still want Bulgaria, but I'd rather trade than trade blows. Withdraw A BUL to Greece or Rumania, and my A CON and F BLA stay out of Greece and the Ionian while F AEG stays off SMY and CON. Tell me your Spring orders in writing.

Turkey to Russia: The Armenia-Ankara split still holds, and I will keep A SMY and A CON off ARM and ANK. Tell me plainly whether F SEV or A MOS moves toward Rumania or Ukraine this Spring so we avoid clashes in the Black Sea. I will keep F BLA out of SEV and RUM.

Austria will not cede VIE. A VIE holds with A BUD support this Spring, and TRI stays garrisoned. Your A BOH entering VIE or TRI means war on Bohemia. If you want a real deal, pull A BOH back to Bohemia and Munich stays closed to us; then we can discuss the Balkans later.

Austria confirms A SER and A BUD stay out of Bulgaria and Greece this Spring. In return, F ION, A VEN and A ROM must stay off Trieste, Albania and Serbia. Any move there ends our pact. Germany is pressing VIE, so I need your word in writing now, and I will give you the same.

Austria will not give up RUM as a peace term, but we can stop the bleeding. Keep A UKR out of GAL this Spring and I will keep A VIE and A BUD out of UKR and WAR. A WAR should press Silesia or Prussia against Germany, which helps both of us. Confirm in writing.

England here, Spring 1917. Confirmed: F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A HOL hold this spring, with no move toward Belgium, Picardy, Brest, the Channel or Spain. F NOR and F EDI also hold. F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I will give you notice before any change near Spain or Portugal, and I expect the same from you.

France to Italy: My Spring 1917 orders are A PAR, A MAR, A BUR and A POR holding, with F MAO in the Atlantic. None of them moves toward Tunis, the Gulf of Lyon or Piedmont. I cannot commit to Trieste this spring, but I'll consider it once I see your orders. Please send them first so we both know the board.

France to Germany: Confirmed. A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and A POR hold this spring, with no move toward Munich, Belgium or the Ruhr. Please keep A MUN, A BER, A KIE, A DEN, A BOH and F BEL out of Burgundy, Picardy, Paris and the Ruhr. I will tell you first of any change.

Germany here. A standstill is not enough. A BOH will take VIE this Spring unless you cede it. Give me VIE and keep TRI and BUD, and I will stop pressing you and turn my full weight against Russia in Galicia. Refuse, and you lose Vienna anyway.

Germany here. As agreed, Galicia and Rumania are yours once VIE falls. Keep A WAR and A UKR out of SIL, PRU and BER, and keep F SWE away from DEN and KIE. My A BER and A MUN stay off your WAR and UKR. Tell me your Spring orders for MOS, SEV and SWE so we both see the north is safe.

Germany here. F BEL, A DEN and A KIE hold this Spring, and I make no move on HOL or the North Sea. Please keep F NTH and F NOR away from DEN, KIE and BEL. I will tell you before any change toward Norway or the Channel. Russia's F SWE is the real northern threat, so I suggest we both watch it.

Germany here. Confirmed: A MUN, A BER, A KIE, A DEN and F BEL will not enter BUR, PIC, PAR or the Ruhr this Spring. Please keep A BUR, A PAR and A MAR off MUN and BEL as agreed. I will tell you first of any change in the west.

Italy to Austria: Spring 1917 orders: A BUL holds, F AEG supports it, F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold. I will not move to Trieste, Albania or Serbia. Keep A SER, A BUD and A RUM out of Bulgaria and Greece as agreed, and we both keep our centres.

Italy to France: I am not moving against Austria this Spring. F ION, A VEN and A ROM hold, and I will not enter Trieste, Albania, Tunis, the Gulf of Lyon, Spain or Piedmont. Keep your western armies away from Tunis and Italian soil, and tell me if your plans change.

Italy to Turkey: I will not withdraw A BUL. It holds with F AEG support, and F AEG stays out of SMY and CON. Your A CON and F BLA have failed against it twice. Stop attacking Bulgaria this Spring, and your fleets stay out of Greece and the Ionian. Turn your strength toward Russia.

Russia here. Spring 1917: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR moves south toward Galicia, away from the north. A MOS and F SEV stay on Russian land and in the Black Sea. Keep STP, NOR, NTH and LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden, and we keep the north quiet.

Russia here. A WAR moves toward Galicia this Spring, not Silesia or Prussia, so I am not joining Germany's northern war. I hold A RUM in Rumania, as I did last Fall, and I will not enter Budapest, Serbia or Vienna. Keep your units out of Galicia and Warsaw, and we can talk terms for peace.

Russia here. A WAR is moving toward Galicia, not into Silesia, Prussia or Berlin. F SWE holds in Sweden, clear of Denmark and Kiel. A MOS and F SEV stay on Russian land. Keep A MUN and A BER off WAR and MOS. Galicia is my objective now, and I will keep to our Austria split.

Russia here. F SEV holds in the Black Sea this Spring, and I will not enter Armenia or Ankara. A MOS and A RUM hold, so no Russian unit moves toward Bulgaria or Serbia. Keep A CON and A SMY out of Rumania and Ukraine, and keep F BLA out of Sevastopol and Rumania.

Turkey to Italy: Spring 1917. I will not withdraw my ideas on Bulgaria, but I accept a stop for this Spring: no attack on BUL from A CON or F BLA, provided F AEG stays out of SMY and CON and your fleets stay out of Greece and the Ionian. Withdraw A BUL to Greece or Rumania as a sign of good faith. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Turkey to Russia: Our Armenia-Ankara split holds on my side: A SMY and A CON stay off ARM and ANK. I will keep F BLA out of SEV and RUM. Taking RUM in Fall 1916 broke your word, so I need clarity. Tell me plainly your Spring 1917 orders for F SEV and A MOS, and whether either moves toward Rumania or Ukraine.

notes.note: Spring 1917: all units hold to keep 5 SCs and honor deals with Germany, England and Italy. No unowned SCs reachable without breaking deals. Germany, England and Italy have kept deals so far. Revisit if a deal breaks or unowned centres appear.

Spring 1917: all hold, BUD supports VIE to hold against Germany's BOH. Keep SER out of BUL/GRE per Italy pact. Russia took RUM and refuses to return it. Germany demands VIE; refused. Watch Italy ROM/VEN/ION near TRI and Russia UKR/WAR near GAL.

Spring 1917: all hold to keep peace with France, Germany, Russia. No unowned centers reachable. Russia says F SWE stays out of NWG/NOR/EDI; watch it. Consider HOL->DEN convoy only with Germany's agreement. Next: check Russian orders in Fall.

Spring 1917: BOH attacks VIE alone (unsupported, may bounce). Home units hold to keep promises to England, France, Russia. Russia keeps WAR/UKR out of PRU/SIL/BER/DEN/KIE. France keeps off MUN/BEL. Austria refused to cede VIE. Next: watch Russian F SWE and any VIE vacancy; consider BEL to NTH convoy for A DEN only if England agrees.

Spring 1917: holding BUL with AEG support, all others hold, per pacts. Turkey stop pact (no attacks on BUL, AEG out of SMY/CON) and Austria pact (no Trieste/Albania/Serbia, A SER/BUD/RUM out of BUL/GRE) still in force. France: no Tunis/Lyon/Spain/Piedmont. Watch Turkish fleets near GRE/ION. Next: ALB/APU convoys via ION/AEG; AEG to SMY if Turkish fleets leave.

Spring 1917: WAR moves to GAL, MOS fills WAR behind it; RUM, SEV, SWE hold to keep centers. Promised Germany GAL/RUM after VIE falls; Austria asked no UKR/GAL entry, so I flagged that WAR (not UKR) goes to GAL. Turkey's split holds. England: SWE stays out of north. Check Germany and Austria moves next turn.

Spring 1917: Italy refused to withdraw A BUL and broke the stop. A CON attacks BUL, supported by F BLA. A SMY holds. Russia broke its word on RUM. Keep the ARM/ANK split with Russia. Watch Italy's F AEG. Next: take BUL if it falls.

messages.body: Austria here. Proposal for Fall 1917: A BOH stays out of VIE and TRI, and Munich and Bohemia stay closed to us. Our A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI all hold. Neither of us takes the other's centres while we both fight Russia. Confirm A BOH's Fall order in writing.

Austria here. Let us stop the bleeding. A GAL and A RUM keep out of BUD, SER and VIE, and our units stay out of Ukraine and Warsaw. I will not attack Galicia. Tell me your Fall orders for A RUM and A GAL so we can both hold our centres.

Austria here. Our pact still stands. Please confirm in writing that F ION, A VEN and A ROM hold this Fall, and stay off TRI, ALB and SER. In return, A SER and A BUD stay out of BUL and GRE. Tell me your Fall orders so we both keep our centres.

England here, Fall 1917. Please confirm F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI this autumn, and tell me your orders for A WAR and A GAL. I hold STP, NOR, NTH and LVP and will not enter the Baltic or Sweden. If either of us plans a northern move, let's flag it first.

England here, Fall 1917. I hold NTH, LON, HOL, LVP and NOR with no move on Belgium, Denmark or Kiel. Please keep F BEL, A DEN and A KIE out of Holland and the North Sea, and tell me your Fall orders against Russia or Austria. I will flag any change toward Norway or Sweden first.

France here, Fall 1917. You have kept your word, and I will keep mine. Your war with Austria in Bohemia is yours to fight. Please tell me before any unit moves toward Belgium or Burgundy. If Germany's armies are fully committed east, I would like to discuss Belgium later in 1918.

France to Italy, Fall 1917: Austria is weakened and Trieste is open. Please tell me your Fall orders first. I will not enter Tunis, the Gulf of Lyon or Piedmont. If you move on Trieste or Albania, I am willing to discuss a joint plan against Austria's remaining centres.

Germany here, Fall 1917. A BOH will press VIE this Fall. Please confirm A WAR and A UKR stay out of SIL, PRU, BER, DEN and KIE, and that F SWE leaves the Denmark and Kiel area. Galicia and Rumania remain yours once VIE falls, as agreed. Tell me your Fall orders for MOS, SEV and SWE.
Germany here. This is my last offer. Vacate VIE this Fall and I will not enter TRI or BUD. Hold VIE and I take it anyway, and TRI and BUD will be next. Answer me before the orders are final.

Italy to Austria: Fall 1917. Our pact stands. A BUL holds with F AEG support, and F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold, so none of us moves toward Trieste, Albania or Serbia. Please confirm in writing that A SER, A BUD and A RUM stay out of Bulgaria and Greece, and send your Fall orders.

Italy to Turkey: Fall 1917. A BUL holds with F AEG support, and F AEG stays out of SMY and CON. Your attacks on BUL have failed three times. Keep A CON and F BLA out of Bulgaria and Greece, and keep your fleets out of the Ionian. Confirm in writing and turn your strength toward Russia.

Italy to France: Fall 1917. F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TUN hold, and I will not enter Spain, the Gulf of Lyon or Piedmont. Please confirm your Fall orders and that no western unit moves toward Tunis or Italian soil. I am open to talking about Austria once the west is settled.

Russia here. A WAR and A GAL hold this Fall, and neither enters Silesia, Prussia or Berlin. F SWE stays out of Denmark and Kiel. Your A BOH may take Vienna as agreed. Keep A MUN and A BER off WAR and MOS, and tell me your Fall orders for BOH and MUN.

Russia here. I will not enter ARM or ANK, and F SEV holds in the Black Sea. RUM stays Russian for now. Italy's BUL is your natural target, so push A CON and A SMY there. Keep F BLA out of SEV and RUM, and tell me your Fall orders for BUL and GRE.

Turkey to Italy: A BUL is cut off and I will keep attacking it. Withdraw A BUL to Greece now and I will hold A CON and F BLA out of Greece and the Ionian this Fall. Tell me your Fall 1917 orders for A BUL, F AEG and F ION in writing.

Turkey to Russia: Confirm that F SEV and A RUM will not move into Armenia, Ankara, or Bulgaria this Fall. I will keep A SMY and A CON off Armenia and Ankara and out of Ukraine. Tell me plainly your Fall 1917 orders for F SEV, A RUM and A MOS.

Turkey to Austria: Confirm that A BUD, A SER and A RUM stay out of Bulgaria and Greece this Fall. I will keep A CON, F BLA and A SMY out of Serbia and Rumania. Please send your Fall 1917 orders for A BUD, A SER and F TRI in writing.

Austria here. Confirmed for Fall 1917: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI all hold. A SER and A BUD stay out of BUL and GRE. A RUM is no longer ours, since Russia holds it, so I cannot promise anything about it. Please keep F ION, A VEN and A ROM off TRI, ALB and SER as you wrote. Any move there ends the pact.

Austria here. VIE stays garrisoned this Fall, with BUD and TRI holding and supporting. We will not vacate VIE. A BOH entering VIE or TRI means war on Bohemia, and I will strike Munich. Pull A BOH back to Bohemia and the border stays closed. Your choice decides whether we fight each other while Russia gains.

Austria here. Fall 1917 orders: A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold, and A VIE holds. A BUD and A SER will not enter BUL or GRE this Fall. A RUM is now Russian, so I cannot confirm it. Keep A CON, F BLA and A SMY out of Serbia and our centres, and we stay clear of your coast.

France here, Fall 1917. My orders are A PAR, A MAR, A BUR, A POR and F MAO all holding. None moves toward Tunis, the Gulf of Lyon, Spain or Piedmont. Your F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TUN holding works for me. Austria's Trieste is tempting for both of us, but I will only discuss a joint plan in Spring 1918 once we see how the west and Balkans settle. I will tell you first if anything changes.

Germany here. A BOH attacks VIE this Fall and I will not withdraw it. Your A VIE, A BUD and F TRI can still retreat to the Balkans or fight. I will not make a peace line before VIE is settled, so choose your moves carefully.

Germany here. F BEL, A DEN and A KIE hold this Fall, and I still plan no move into Holland or the North Sea. I have no plans against Norway or Sweden. I will flag any change in the north before it happens.

Germany here. A MUN, A BER, A KIE, A DEN and F BEL will not enter Burgundy, Picardy, Paris or the Ruhr this Fall. My war is with Austria in Bohemia. Keep A BUR, A PAR and A MAR off Munich and Belgium, and I will tell you first of any change.

Germany here. A BOH attacks VIE this Fall, as agreed. Galicia and Rumania remain yours once Vienna falls. Keep A WAR, A GAL and A UKR out of Silesia, Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel. Move F SWE away from Denmark and Kiel, and tell me your Fall orders for MOS and SEV.

Italy here. For Fall 1917, F ION, A VEN and A ROM hold, and I will not move to Trieste, Albania or Serbia while our pact stands. Keep A SER, A BUD and A RUM out of Bulgaria and Greece as agreed. A BUL and F AEG hold too. Austria's fleets and armies should stay away from Italian soil.

Italy here. I am not moving against Austria this Fall, so the Trieste plan is off for now. F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TUN hold, and I will not enter Spain, the Gulf of Lyon or Piedmont. Please keep your western armies away from Tunis and Italian soil, and tell me if your plans change.

Italy here. I will not withdraw A BUL. It holds with F AEG support, and F AEG stays out of SMY and CON. Your attacks on Bulgaria have failed three times. Keep A CON and F BLA out of Bulgaria and Greece, and keep your fleets out of the Ionian. Turn your strength toward Russia.

Russia here. Confirmed for Fall 1917: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR and A GAL hold this Fall, away from your northern waters. Please keep STP, NOR, NTH and LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden, and flag any northern move first.

Russia here. Fall 1917: A WAR and A GAL hold. Neither enters SIL, PRU, BER, DEN or KIE, and F SWE holds in Sweden, clear of Denmark and Kiel. Keep A MUN and A BER off WAR and MOS. Your BOH may press VIE as agreed. Tell me your BOH and MUN orders.

Turkey here. A BUL is cut off and we will keep attacking it this Fall with A CON and F BLA. I will not move into Greece or the Ionian. Withdraw A BUL to Greece or Rumania and I will hold both fleets off Greece this Fall. F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, or we are at war.

Turkey to Russia: Yes, our Armenia-Ankara split stands. A SMY and A CON will not enter ARM or ANK, and I will keep them out of Ukraine. Keep F SEV and A RUM out of ARM, ANK and BUL. Tell me plainly your Fall orders for F SEV, A RUM and A MOS, and whether any move toward Ukraine or Armenia.

notes.note: Fall 1917: all hold, keeping 5 SCs. Germany, England and Italy have kept their deals. No unowned SCs reachable without breaking deals. Revisit in Spring 1918 if Germany's east stays committed (Belgium), or if unowned centres appear.

Fall 1917: all hold per promises to Germany (GAL/WAR not into SIL/PRU/BER/DEN/KIE, SWE out of DEN/KIE, Germany's BOH takes VIE), Austria (no GAL/RUM entry into BUD/SER/VIE), Turkey (SEV/RUM split, no ARM/ANK/BUL), England (SWE out of north). Germany promised GAL/RUM after VIE falls; watch for it. Owe Turkey: RUM-BUL/SEV clarity. Next: consider F SEV to BLA to convoy RUM to CON/ANK if Turkey's posi

Fall 1917: VIE holds with BUD support against German A BOH; BUD, SER, TRI hold. Germany refuses to withdraw. Italy pact holding so far (no moves to TRI/ALB/SER). Russia took RUM. Turkey wants no Serbia/Rumania entry. Recheck Germany BOH and Italy ION/ROM/VEN next turn.

Fall 1917: all hold for peace. France kept MAO out of our waters, Germany and Russia confirmed no moves on our centers. No unowned centers reachable. Next: consider HOL->DEN convoy only if Germany agrees; watch Russian F SWE and A WAR.

Fall 1917: BOH attacks VIE alone per Russia deal (Galicia/Rumania to Russia once VIE falls). Home units hold to guard BEL/BER/DEN/KIE and keep promises to England, France, Russia. Watch F SWE near DEN/KIE and Austria's counterattack on BOH. Next: take VIE if vacated; keep MUN covered.

Fall 1917: holding BUL with AEG support vs Turkish CON/BLA attacks; ION/ROM/TUN/VEN hold per pacts. Austria and France kept their word so far; Turkey keeps attacking BUL and wants it withdrawn (refused). Next: if BUL survives, AEG to SMY or ALB/APU convoys.

Fall 1917: CON attacks BUL with BLA support (tie vs Italy's hold+AEG likely). SMY holds. Italy refuses to withdraw A BUL; Russia says it won't enter ARM/ANK. Austria says BUD/SER stay out of BUL/GRE. Keep ARM/ANK split and keep fleets off RUM/SEV. Next: retry BUL if Italy's AEG leaves.

messages.body: Austria here. Your A BOH is the main threat to us. Pull it back to Bohemia this Spring and we will hold VIE and TRI defensively, with no moves toward Munich or Bohemia. Otherwise we will strike where we can. Confirm your Spring order for A BOH in writing before orders lock.

Austria here. Your A GAL and A RUM are the threat to BUD and SER. Confirm that neither enters BUD, SER, VIE or TRI this Spring, and I will keep A VIE and A BUD out of Galicia and Ukraine. Tell me your Spring orders for GAL and RUM so we can both hold our centres.

Austria here. Our pact still stands. Please confirm F ION, A VEN and A ROM hold this Spring and stay off TRI, ALB and SER. In return, A SER and A BUD stay out of BUL and GRE. Tell me your Spring orders in writing so we both keep our centres.

England here, Spring 1918. I hold NTH, LON, HOL, LVP and NOR and have no moves on Belgium, Denmark or Kiel. Please tell me your Spring orders for BEL, DEN, KIE and BER. If you move against Sweden, I would prefer to coordinate, and I'll keep my fleets out of Skagerrak unless we agree otherwise. Keep F BEL and A DEN off Holland.

England here, Spring 1918. Confirm that F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI this spring, and that A WAR does not move toward Prussia or Germany. I hold STP, NOR, NTH and LVP and will not enter the Baltic or Sweden. Please send your Spring orders for SWE, WAR and SEV so we keep the north quiet.

France here, Spring 1918. Your armies are tied up with Austria in Bohemia. Please tell me your Spring orders for BEL, BOH, MUN and BER. I hold A BUR, A PAR and A MAR as agreed, with no move toward Munich or Belgium. If Germany's east stays committed, I'd like to discuss Belgium for Fall 1918.

France to Italy, Spring 1918: my A PAR, A MAR, A BUR, A POR and F MAO hold this spring, with no move toward Tunis, the Gulf of Lyon or Piedmont. Please send your Spring orders first. If Austria stays weak, I'm open to a joint plan against Trieste and Albania once the west is settled.

Germany here. A BOH attacks VIE this Spring, and I am not withdrawing it. Your best outcome is to retreat A VIE toward GAL or TYR now rather than lose the unit. If you hold VIE, A BUD and F TRI stay exposed. Tell me your Spring orders before the final order set.

Italy to Austria: Spring 1918. Our pact stands. A BUL holds with F AEG support, and F ION, A ROM and A VEN will not move to Trieste, Albania or Serbia. Confirm in writing that A SER and A BUD stay out of Bulgaria and Greece, and tell me your Spring orders for SER, TRI and VIE.

Italy to Turkey: I will keep A BUL holding with F AEG support this Spring, and F AEG stays out of SMY and CON. Stop your attacks on Bulgaria, and keep F BLA and A CON out of Greece and the Ionian. Turn your strength against Russia in Armenia and the Black Sea. Confirm in writing.

Italy to Russia: Are A RUM and A GAL aimed at Bulgaria or Greece this Spring? I will hold BUL with F AEG support and keep F ION, A ROM and A VEN in place. Keep F SEV out of the Mediterranean and Aegean, and we can both grow without fighting in the Balkans. Tell me your Spring orders.

Russia here, Spring 1918. A GAL and A WAR hold this Spring and will not enter Silesia, Prussia, Berlin, Denmark or Kiel. F SWE holds in Sweden. Keep A BOH, A MUN and A BER off WAR, MOS and RUM, and tell me your Spring orders for BOH and MUN so we keep the centres we agreed on.

Russia here. A GAL and A RUM hold this Spring. I will not enter BUD, SER or VIE, and I will not move into Galicia from the south. Keep A BUD, A SER and A VIE out of RUM, UKR and WAR, and tell me plainly what Austria plans against Germany's BOH this Spring.

Russia here. F SEV holds in the Black Sea this Spring, and A RUM holds. I will not enter ARM, ANK or BUL. Keep F BLA out of SEV and RUM, keep A CON and A SMY off RUM and UKR, and tell me your Spring orders for BUL and GRE so we avoid clashes.

Turkey to Italy: Spring 1918, I am asking directly. Will A BUL hold or move, and will F AEG and F ION stay away from SMY, CON and the Aegean? If you keep F AEG off SMY and CON, I will keep A CON and F BLA out of Bulgaria and Greece this Spring. Please confirm in writing.

Turkey to Russia: Please confirm your Spring 1918 orders for F SEV, A RUM and A WAR. I will keep A CON and A SMY off ARM and ANK and out of Ukraine, and F BLA out of SEV and RUM. Tell me plainly whether any Russian unit moves toward Armenia or Ankara this Spring.

Austria here. A VIE holds this Spring with A BUD support, and F TRI holds. Your A BOH moving into VIE will be bounced and will leave it exposed to our counterattack on BOH. Pull A BOH back to Bohemia and the border stays quiet. We will not move on Munich or Bohemia this Spring.

Austria here. Our pact stands. A SER, A BUD and F TRI hold this Spring, and none of them will enter BUL, GRE or ALB. Please keep F ION, A VEN and A ROM off TRI, ALB and SER as agreed. Any move there ends the pact at once.

Austria here. A VIE, A BUD and A SER hold this Spring and will not enter GAL, RUM, UKR or WAR. Our concern is German A BOH, which attacks VIE. Keep A GAL and A RUM out of BUD, SER, VIE and TRI, and we will keep quiet on your Galicia front.

Germany here. A BOH attacks VIE this Spring and will not withdraw. Holding VIE means losing the unit. Your best move is to retreat A VIE toward GAL or TYR now. I make no move toward Munich this Spring. Any deal on the Balkans comes after VIE is settled.

Germany to France: A BER, A KIE, A DEN and F BEL hold this Spring. A BOH attacks VIE. I have no move toward Burgundy, Picardy, Paris or the Ruhr, and A MUN stays empty. Keep A BUR, A PAR and A MAR off MUN and BEL as agreed. Fall Belgium talks are premature for now.

Germany here. F BEL, A DEN and A KIE hold this Spring, with no move on HOL or the North Sea. I make no move toward Norway or Sweden this Spring. Please keep F NTH and F NOR away from DEN, KIE and BEL. I will flag any change in the north before it happens.

Germany here. A GAL and A WAR holding is good. A BOH attacks VIE this Spring. Keep A WAR and A GAL out of SIL, PRU, BER, DEN and KIE. F SWE should leave the Denmark area, and I want that confirmed. Galicia and Rumania remain yours once VIE falls, as agreed.

Italy confirms for Spring 1918: F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold. We will not move to Trieste, Albania or Serbia while the pact stands. Please confirm in writing that A SER and A BUD stay out of Bulgaria and Greece, and send your Spring orders for SER, TRI and VIE so we can both keep our centres.

Italy's Spring 1918 orders: F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TUN hold. Our A BUL holds with F AEG support. We will not move toward Spain, the Gulf of Lyon or Piedmont. Please keep your western armies away from Tunis and Italian soil. We can revisit Austria later, once the west is settled and Austria's position is clearer.

Italy's Spring 1918 orders: A BUL holds with F AEG support. F AEG will stay out of SMY and CON, and our fleets will stay out of the Ionian and Greece. In return, keep A CON and F BLA out of Bulgaria and Greece this Spring. Your real gains lie against Russia in Armenia and the Black Sea, so turn your strength there.

Russia here. Confirmed for Spring 1918: A GAL and A RUM hold. Neither enters BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Please keep A BUD, A SER and A VIE out of RUM, UKR and WAR. On Germany's BOH, Austria should say plainly what it plans this spring, and I will tell you if my orders change.

Russia here. Confirmed: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI this Spring. A WAR will not move toward Prussia or Germany. Please keep STP, NOR, NTH and LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden. I will tell you first of any northern change.

Russia here. A RUM and A GAL hold this Spring. Neither is aimed at Bulgaria or Greece. F SEV holds in the Black Sea and will not enter the Mediterranean or Aegean. Keep your F AEG, F ION, A ROM and A VEN clear of Rumania and Ukraine, and we can both keep the peace in the Balkans.

Russia here. F SEV holds in the Black Sea this Spring, A RUM holds, and A WAR holds. I will not enter ARM, ANK or BUL. Keep F BLA out of SEV and RUM, and keep A CON and A SMY off RUM and UKR. If your plans change toward Bulgaria, tell me first so we avoid clashes.

Turkey here. Spring 1918: A CON and F BLA will not attack Bulgaria if F AEG and F ION stay out of SMY, CON and the Aegean, and no Italian fleet enters Greece. If you withdraw A BUL to Greece, I will consider a peace on Bulgaria. Confirm your Spring orders for AEG and ION in writing.

Turkey here. A CON, A SMY and F BLA will stay out of ARM, ANK and Ukraine this Spring, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. I expect the same from F SEV and A RUM, and no Russian unit into ARM, ANK or BUL. Tell me plainly if A WAR moves toward Galicia or Ukraine.

notes.note: Spring 1918: all hold to keep promises to Austria (no BUD/SER/VIE/TRI entry), Germany (no SIL/PRU/BER/DEN/KIE), Turkey (no ARM/ANK/BUL) and England (SWE out of north). No unowned centers reachable. Germany promised GAL/RUM after VIE falls; watch for it. Convoy idea via SEV-BLA deferred: leaves SEV open to Turkey.

Spring 1918: all holds, F AEG supports A BUL holding, per pacts with Austria, France, Turkey. Austria and Turkey want no Italian moves into TRI/ALB/SER or SMY/CON. Next: if pacts hold, consider AEG to SMY or ALB/APU convoys from ROM/VEN via ION/ADR.

Spring 1918: VIE holds with BUD support against German A BOH, which is a single attacker and should bounce. SER and TRI hold to keep centers. Italy pact holding; Russia says GAL/RUM hold. Germany keeps demanding VIE retreat, refused. Recheck BOH and Russian GAL/RUM next turn.

Spring 1918: A BUR moves to empty MUN (Germany's A BOH is fighting Austria; Germany said MUN stays empty). Breaks my no-MUN pledge, but MUN is a free centre. Other units hold. Watch Germany's reaction and be ready to defend BUR/PAR in Fall. Italy and England have kept their deals.

Spring 1918: held all for peace; no unowned centers. Germany (BEL/DEN/KIE hold) and Russia (SWE holds, no Baltic move) kept word. Convoy HOL->DEN needs Germany's agreement; revisit via NTH->HEL only if Germany agrees. Watch Russian F SWE and A WAR.

Spring 1918: VIE attack by BOH is unsupported and would bounce against BUD-supported A VIE, so BOH holds in Bohemia. Home units hold. No promises broken. Russia wants VIE/GAL split, Austria wants BOH pulled back; England and France told no moves on HOL/NTH, BUR/PAR/MAR. Revisit when a real support exists.

Spring 1918: holding all units. Attacks on BUL failed repeatedly; Italy and Russia both promised no moves on CON/SMY/ANK. Turkey has no unowned centers reachable. Next: watch Italian F AEG and Russian moves toward ARM/ANK, and consider BUL only if AEG leaves.

messages.body: Austria here. Your A BOH has attacked VIE for three seasons and will not die quietly. Order it back to Bohemia now and I will keep A VIE, A BUD and F TRI purely defensive, with no move toward Munich or Bohemia. If it attacks VIE again, I will strike Bohemia and Munich in return. Please confirm in writing.

Austria here. Your A GAL and A RUM are the only units able to reach BUD and SER this autumn. Confirm they hold and do not enter BUD, SER, VIE or TRI, and I will keep A VIE, A BUD and A SER out of RUM, UKR and WAR. Tell me your Fall orders in writing so we both keep our centres.

England here, Fall 1918. I hold NTH, LON, HOL, LVP and NOR, with no move on Belgium, Denmark or Kiel. Please tell me your Fall orders for BEL, DEN, KIE and BER, and confirm F BEL and A DEN stay off Holland and the North Sea. Any move toward Norway or Holland, I'll treat as a threat and tell you first.

England here, Fall 1918. I hold LON, LVP, NTH and HOL off Belgium and Picardy. Please keep F MAO out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI, and give me notice before any move near Spain or Portugal. What are your Fall orders for MAR, POR, PAR and MUN?

England here, Fall 1918. Please confirm F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI this autumn, and that A WAR does not move toward Prussia or Germany. I hold STP, NOR, NTH and LVP and will not enter the Baltic or Sweden. Tell me your Fall orders for SWE, WAR and GAL.

France here, Fall 1918. Our A BUR moved into MUN in Spring, and I know that broke my pledge. MUN is a free centre and I am holding it. Your A BOH is next to it, so I need your word: keep A BOH out of MUN this Fall. I will keep my armies out of BEL, the Ruhr and Berlin. Let us both stay out of each other's centres for the rest of 1918.

France to Italy, Fall 1918: my A PAR, A MAR, A POR and F MAO hold, and I am keeping my word on Tunis, the Gulf of Lyon and Piedmont. I have also moved A BUR into MUN, which is no threat to you. Please keep your F TUN and F ION away from Spain and the western Mediterranean. Tell me your Fall orders first.

Germany to France: A MUN is German supply and your army there broke our agreement. I will attack MUN this Fall with A KIE supported by A BOH. Move A MUN out now to BUR or RUH and I will not attack it, and your MUN claim will be void. Reply with your intentions.

Germany to Austria: I am moving A BOH to support A KIE into MUN, not into VIE. If you keep VIE and TRI quiet and do not strike Bohemia, I will not attack VIE this Fall. Confirm your Fall orders for VIE, BUD and TRI.

Germany to England: This Fall I am attacking MUN from KIE and BOH against French A MUN, not moving into HOL, NTH or NOR. My DEN and BEL stay put. Please confirm your Fall orders keep NTH, NOR and HOL away from DEN, KIE and BEL.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1918: F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold, and none will enter TRI, ALB or SER. Please confirm A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A VIE hold, and that none enters BUL or GRE. Our pact stands while both sides keep these orders.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1918: A BUL holds with F AEG support. F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, and F ION stays out of Greece. Please confirm A CON and F BLA stay out of BUL and GRE this Fall, and turn your strength against Russia.

Russia here, Fall 1918. A GAL and A WAR hold, and neither enters SIL, PRU, BER, DEN or KIE. F SWE holds in Sweden. Once VIE falls to your BOH, I expect GAL and RUM to be settled as agreed. Tell me plainly your Fall orders for BOH, MUN and BER so we avoid any clash.

Russia here. F SEV holds in the Black Sea, A RUM holds, and no Russian unit enters ARM, ANK or BUL. Please confirm F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM, and that A CON and A SMY stay off RUM and UKR. If you plan a move into BUL, tell me first.

Turkey to Italy: A BUL has no path to resupply, and I will keep attacking it with A CON and F BLA this Fall. Offer: if A BUL withdraws to Greece or Rumania, I keep both fleets out of Greece. If it holds, F AEG must stay away from SMY and CON. Please confirm in writing which you choose.

Turkey to Russia: I will keep A CON, A SMY and F BLA out of ARM, ANK and Ukraine this Fall. Please confirm F SEV and A RUM will not enter ARM, ANK or BUL, and that F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. Tell me plainly if A WAR or A RUM moves toward Bulgaria.

Turkey to Austria: Confirm A BUD, A SER and F TRI stay out of Bulgaria and Greece this Fall. I will keep A CON, F BLA and A SMY out of Serbia and Rumania. Any move by your units into Bulgaria or Greece would change our position.

Austria confirms Fall 1918 orders: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI all hold. None of them will enter BUL, GRE or ALB. Our pact stands while F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold and stay off TRI, ALB and SER. Any move there ends it at once.

Austria confirms: A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this Fall and will not enter BUL or GRE. We keep no units near Serbia's Turkish border beyond these holds. Please keep A CON, F BLA and A SMY out of SER and RUM as you promised, and we stay clear of your coast.

Austria confirms: A VIE holds with A BUD support, and F TRI holds. No Austrian unit enters Bohemia or Munich this Fall. If your A BOH stays out of VIE and TRI, we stay quiet. Any move into VIE will be met with a strike on BOH and MUN.

England to Germany: Confirmed. My fleets hold NTH, NOR and LON, A HOL holds, and LVP and EDI stay put. I make no move toward KIE, DEN, BEL or HOL-to-Germany this Fall. Your attack on French MUN is your business. I still expect F BEL and A DEN to stay off Holland and the North Sea, and I will tell you first of any change.

France here, Fall 1918. A MAR, A POR and A PAR all hold, and A MUN holds too. F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI, as agreed. I will give you notice before any change near Spain or Portugal. Please keep F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A HOL off Belgium and Picardy.

Germany: A BOH is moving to MUN this Fall, supporting A KIE, not into VIE. I will not attack VIE or TRI this Fall if your A VIE, A BUD and F TRI stay put and do not strike Bohemia. Confirm those holds in writing.

Germany: A MUN broke our agreement, so I attack it this Fall with A KIE, supported by A BOH. Move A MUN to BUR or RUH now and I will not attack it. Staying means losing it. Reply with your orders before they lock.

Germany: A BOH goes to MUN this Fall, not VIE. Galicia and Rumania stay yours as agreed. My A BER stays home, and I make no move toward WAR, SIL or PRU. Keep F SWE away from DEN and KIE, and confirm your Fall orders for GAL, WAR and SWE.

Germany: This Fall A KIE and A BOH attack MUN. My F BEL and A DEN hold in place. I am not moving into HOL, NTH or NOR. Please keep your fleets out of DEN, KIE and BEL, and confirm your Fall orders for NTH, NOR and HOL.

Italy to France: Fall 1918 orders are F TUN, F ION, A ROM, A VEN and A BUL holding, with F AEG supporting BUL. None of my units moves toward Spain, the Gulf of Lyon, Piedmont or Tunis. Your A MAR, A POR, A PAR and F MAO holds also work for me. Tell me if your plans change, especially anything aimed at Italian soil.

Italy to Turkey: I will not withdraw A BUL, and it holds with F AEG support. F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, and F ION stays out of Greece. Keep A CON and F BLA out of Bulgaria and Greece this Fall, and turn your strength against Russia. If you do, this line stays quiet. I cannot confirm more than that.

Russia here. A GAL and A RUM hold this Fall. Neither enters BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. I expect A VIE, A BUD and A SER to stay out of RUM, UKR and WAR. Please keep your Balkan units clear of my centres, and we can both hold ours.

Russia here. F SWE holds in Sweden this Fall and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR holds and will not move toward Prussia or Germany. Please keep STP, NOR, NTH and LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden, and tell me first of any northern change.

Russia here. F SEV holds in the Black Sea this Fall, A RUM holds, and no Russian unit enters ARM, ANK or BUL. I confirm F BLA must stay out of SEV and RUM, and A CON and A SMY off RUM and UKR. A WAR holds and is not moving toward Bulgaria. Tell me first if your plans change.

Turkey to Italy: Fall 1918. I will keep A CON and F BLA out of Bulgaria and Greece this Fall, provided F AEG stays out of SMY and CON and F ION stays out of Greece. Any Italian move into Greece or the Aegean-Smyrna line ends this. Confirm in writing your orders for AEG, ION and BUL.

Turkey to Russia: Confirm F SEV and A RUM will not enter ARM, ANK or BUL this Fall, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. I will keep A CON, A SMY and F BLA out of ARM, ANK and UKR. Tell me plainly if A WAR moves toward Galicia or Ukraine, so we avoid a clash.

notes.note: Fall 1918: all hold, keeping promises to Austria (no BUD/SER/VIE/TRI), Germany (no SIL/PRU/BER/DEN/KIE; GAL/RUM after VIE), Turkey (no ARM/ANK/BUL) and England (SWE out of north). Germany says BOH goes to MUN, so VIE stays Austrian. Reassess Spring 1919 for GAL/RUM expansion. Watch Turkey's BLA and Austria's Balkan moves.}

Fall 1918: all hold to keep 4 SCs. BUD supports VIE hold against Germany's BOH. Germany says BOH goes to MUN, not VIE. Italy and Turkey pacts hold; no Balkan moves. Russia's GAL/RUM hold. Watch BOH and RUM/GAL next turn.

Fall 1918: holding BUL with AEG support vs Turkish CON/BLA. ION/ROM/TUN/VEN hold per pacts with Austria, France, Turkey. Austria and France have kept their word. Turkey keeps attacking BUL and wants it withdrawn (refused). Next: if BUL survives, AEG to SMY or ALB/APU convoys.

Fall 1918: all hold. A MUN holds to keep the new centre; Germany (KIE+BOH) threatens it and I have no support option for MUN, so it may fall. Germany broke pledge on MUN intent; England and Italy have kept deals. Revisit in 1919: consider retaking MUN or Belgium, and watch Spain/Tunis.

Fall 1918: holding all for peace. No unowned centers. France kept MAO out of our waters; Germany and Russia kept word on Baltic/North Sea. Germany attacks MUN from KIE/BOH. Watch for broken promises; consider HOL convoy to DEN (NTH->HEL first) only if Germany weakens.

Fall 1918: BOH attacks MUN (French A MUN, unsupported, may bounce). Home units hold to guard BEL/BER/DEN/KIE. Promised France no move on BEL/BER; told Austria no move on VIE if it stays quiet; told Russia GAL/RUM stay theirs. Watch F NTH/A HOL vs KIE and whether France vacates MUN.

Fall 1918: CON attacks BUL with BLA support (16), SMY holds. Italy's A BUL with AEG support should bounce it. Italy and Russia kept their word on ANK/ARM/RUM/SEV. Austria kept BUD/SER/TRI out of BUL/GRE. Next: keep ANK/SMY/CON and retry BUL if AEG leaves.

messages.body: Austria here. Our pact stands. Please confirm F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold this Spring and stay off TRI, ALB and SER. Our A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A VIE hold and will not enter BUL, GRE or ALB. Please send your Spring orders in writing.

Austria here. Our A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this Spring and will not enter GAL, RUM, UKR or WAR. Please keep A GAL and A RUM out of BUD, SER, VIE and TRI as you promised. Send your Spring orders for GAL and RUM in writing so we can both keep our centres.

Austria here. With your A BOH disbanded, the old quarrel can end. We propose no Austrian moves into Bohemia or Munich, and no German move into VIE, TRI or BUD. Confirm in writing, and we can both focus on Russia and keep our centres.

England here, Spring 1919. Germany is now attacking French MUN, which is your business. Please confirm your Spring orders for BEL, DEN and KIE, and that no fleet enters NTH, NOR or HOL. I will keep my fleets off Denmark and Kiel and tell you first of any change in the north.

England here, Spring 1919. Please confirm F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI this spring, and that A WAR does not move toward Prussia or Germany. I hold STP, NOR, NTH and LVP and will not enter the Baltic or Sweden. Tell me your Spring orders for SWE, WAR and SEV.

France here, Spring 1919. I admit my A BUR moved into MUN and broke our pledge. I hold MUN now and will not move it to BUR or RUH. I will keep my armies out of BEL, RUH and BER. Please keep A KIE and A BOH out of MUN, and tell me your Spring orders first. A quiet border serves us both.

France here, Spring 1919. My A PAR, A MAR, A POR, A MUN and F MAO are in the west. I will keep them away from Tunis, the Gulf of Lyon and Piedmont. Please keep F TUN and F ION out of Spain and the western Mediterranean. Send me your Spring orders first, and tell me of any change.

Germany here. Your A MUN is adjacent to my A KIE and I need to know your Spring intentions. I will keep A BER, A DEN, A KIE and F BEL out of Burgundy, Ruhr and Picardy if A MUN stays out of Belgium and Kiel. Tell me your orders for MUN and BUR before they lock.

Germany here. With my Bohemian army gone, I want Denmark, Kiel and Berlin secure. Please confirm F SWE will not move into DEN, KIE or BAL toward Berlin, and that A WAR stays out of Silesia and Prussia. In return I will keep A BER and my northern units clear of Warsaw and Moscow. Tell me your Spring orders.

Germany here. I have only four centres and my northern fleet is thin. Please confirm F NTH and F NOR stay out of Denmark and Kiel this Spring, and that you will not move on HOL against my F BEL. I will keep F BEL and A DEN off Holland and the North Sea.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1919: A BUL holds with F AEG support and I will not withdraw it. F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, F ION stays out of Greece. Keep A CON and F BLA out of Bulgaria and Greece, and turn your strength against Russia in Armenia and the Black Sea. Please confirm in writing.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1919: F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold and stay off TRI, ALB and SER while our pact stands. Please confirm A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold, and none enters BUL or GRE. Tell me if your plans toward Rumania or Serbia change.

Italy to Russia, Spring 1919: I hold A BUL with F AEG support and keep my fleets out of the Black Sea. Are A RUM and A GAL aimed at Bulgaria or Greece this year? Keep F SEV out of the Aegean and Mediterranean and we can both grow without fighting in the Balkans.

Russia here. With BOH gone to MUN, VIE is open to nobody but Austria. Are you still moving on VIE, and what will your A BER and A MUN do this Spring? I will keep A GAL and A WAR off SIL, PRU, BER, DEN and KIE, and I want your plan on GAL and RUM before we move.

Russia here. Our Spring orders are A GAL and A RUM holding, with no entry into BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Please confirm your A VIE, A BUD and A SER stay out of GAL, RUM, UKR and WAR, and tell me whether Germany's MUN move changes your Vienna defence this Spring.

Russia here. F SEV holds, A RUM holds, and no Russian unit enters ARM, ANK or BUL this Spring. Italy holds BUL with F AEG support, so I am not contesting it. Please confirm F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM, and tell me if A CON or A SMY is heading toward Greece or Bulgaria.

Turkey to Italy: A BUL has no supply path and our attacks keep bouncing. Withdraw A BUL to GRE or RUM this Spring and I will keep A CON, F BLA and A SMY out of Greece and Bulgaria. If it holds, F AEG and F ION must stay out of SMY, CON and Greece. Confirm in writing which you choose.

Turkey to Russia: I am weighing a push into BUL against Italy. Will A RUM or A WAR move toward BUL, SER or GAL this Spring? If you stay out of BUL, I will keep A CON, A SMY and F BLA off ARM, ANK and UKR. Tell me plainly your Spring orders for F SEV, A RUM and A WAR.

Turkey to Austria: Your units have kept out of BUL and GRE. I ask that A SER and A BUD keep it that way while Italy's A BUL stays in place. I will keep A CON, F BLA and A SMY out of SER and RUM. Please confirm your Spring orders for A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A VIE.

Austria here. Our pact stands. A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this Spring and will not enter BUL, GRE or ALB. Please keep F ION, A ROM and A VEN holding and out of TRI, ALB and SER. Any move there ends the pact at once.

Austria here. Our Spring 1919 orders: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold. None will enter GAL, RUM, UKR or WAR. Germany's MUN move does not change our hold on VIE. Keep A GAL and A RUM out of BUD, SER, VIE and TRI as promised.
Austria confirms: A SER, A BUD and F TRI hold this Spring and will not enter BUL or GRE. Please keep A CON, F BLA and A SMY out of SER and RUM as you promised. We will stay clear of your coast.

England to Germany: Confirmed for Spring 1919. F NTH and F NOR will not move to Denmark or Kiel, and A HOL stays put with no move on Belgium. I make no commitment beyond this spring. Your F BEL and A DEN must stay off Holland and the North Sea. I will tell you first of any change.

France here, Spring 1919. My A MUN holds this spring and will not move to Burgundy or the Ruhr. A MAR, A PAR, A POR and A BRE also hold, with no move toward Belgium, Ruhr or Berlin. I see you disbanded BOH, so I take it your Bohemia front is gone. Keep A KIE and your other units out of Munich and Burgundy, and I will tell you before any change.

Germany here. I confirm F BEL, A DEN and A KIE hold this Spring, with no move into HOL, NTH or NOR. I am not moving toward Norway or Sweden. Please keep F NTH and F NOR out of DEN, KIE and BEL, and tell me first if that changes.

Germany here. A MUN is yours for now and I will not attack it this Spring. My A KIE, A BER, A DEN and F BEL will stay out of BUR, RUH, PIC and PAR. Please keep your armies out of BEL, RUH and BER, and tell me first of any change in the west.

Germany here. With BOH gone, I agree: no German move into VIE, TRI or BUD this Spring, and no Austrian move into BOH or MUN. Please keep your units out of Bohemia and Munich, and we can both watch Russia. I will confirm any change first.

Germany here. A BER holds this Spring and A DEN stays put. I will not move toward WAR, GAL, RUM or MOS. Please keep F SWE out of DEN, KIE and BAL, and keep A WAR out of SIL and PRU. Galicia and Rumania remain yours as agreed, and I will tell you first of any change.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1919: Confirmed. F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold this Spring and will not enter TRI, ALB or SER while our pact stands. I expect the same from A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A VIE, with none entering BUL, GRE or ALB. Any move there ends the pact.

Italy to France, Spring 1919: Confirmed. Our Spring orders are F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TUN holding, and A BUL holding with F AEG support. None of them moves toward Spain, the Gulf of Lyon, Piedmont or Tunis. Keep your western armies away from Tunis and Italian soil, and tell me if your plans change.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1919: A BUL holds with F AEG support and I will not withdraw it. F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, and F ION stays out of Greece. Keep A CON, F BLA and A SMY out of Bulgaria and Greece, and turn your strength against Russia. This line stays quiet only while both sides keep these orders.

Russia here. A GAL and A RUM hold this Spring, as stated. I expect A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI to stay out of GAL, RUM, UKR and WAR. Tell me plainly whether your Balkan units will move on SER or TRI this year, so neither of us is surprised.

Russia here. Confirmed: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI this Spring. A WAR does not move toward Prussia or Germany. F SEV holds in the Black Sea. Please keep STP, NOR, NTH and LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden, and flag any change first.

Russia here. A WAR and A GAL hold this Spring, and neither enters SIL, PRU, BER, DEN or KIE. F SWE holds. Your BOH went to MUN, so I need your plan for A MUN and A BER. Will either move toward WAR, MOS or BOH this year? Tell me plainly.

Russia here. A RUM and A GAL hold this Spring and are not aimed at Bulgaria or Greece. F SEV stays in the Black Sea and out of the Aegean and Mediterranean. Keep F AEG, F ION and A ROM clear of Rumania and Ukraine, and we can both keep the Balkans quiet.

Russia here. F SEV and A RUM hold this Spring. No Russian unit enters ARM, ANK or BUL. A WAR is not moving toward BUL, SER or GAL. Please keep F BLA out of SEV and RUM, and keep A CON and A SMY off RUM and UKR. Tell me first if you move on Bulgaria.

Turkey to Italy: Spring 1919. I will not withdraw my claim on Bulgaria, but I will not attack it this Spring if F AEG and F ION stay out of SMY, CON and Greece, and A BUL does not strike toward Constantinople. Confirm in writing that F AEG holds in the Aegean and F ION stays put. Any move into Greece or SMY ends this truce.

Turkey to Russia: This Spring I hold A CON, A SMY and F BLA off Armenia, Ankara and Ukraine, and F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM. Please confirm F SEV, A RUM and A WAR stay out of Bulgaria, Armenia and Ankara. If A WAR moves toward Galicia or Ukraine, tell me first so we avoid a clash.

notes.note: Spring 1919: all hold to keep 4 SCs. Pacts: Italy (no TRI/ALB/SER entry by them), Turkey (no BUL/GRE), Russia (GAL/RUM hold, no BUD/SER/VIE/TRI entry), Germany (no VIE/TRI/BUD entry, no BOH/MUN by us). All confirmed in writing so far. Watch Russian GAL/RUM and German MUN; reassess if anyone breaks.
