Spring 1919: all units hold to keep promises to England, France, Russia, Austria. No gains safely available; MUN is France's for now. Watch France near MUN/BUR and Russian SWE near DEN/KIE. Revisit a convoy to HOL/EDI only if England stays put.

Spring 1919: all hold for peace. Germany and Russia confirmed no moves on our centers. Germany has 4 centres and says its north is thin; watch for a chance to take DEN/KIE/BEL. Next: consider NTH->HEL to set up HOL->DEN convoy only if Germany weakens or breaks promises.

Spring 1919: all hold, keeping promises to Austria (no BUD/SER/VIE/TRI), Germany (no SIL/PRU/BER/DEN/KIE), Turkey (no ARM/ANK/BUL) and England (SWE out of north). No unowned centers. Revisit Fall 1919: if VIE falls, GAL/RUM to Germany; Turkey BLA and Italy BUL watch.

Spring 1919: all holds. A BUL holds with F AEG support (choice 6 not used; AEG holds). Pacts kept: Austria (no TRI/ALB/SER), France (no Tunis/Lyon/Spain/Piedmont), Turkey truce (AEG/ION out of SMY/CON/GRE). Russia says RUM/GAL hold. No unowned centers. Next: if pacts hold, consider ALB/APU convoys or AEG to SMY once Turkish units leave.

Spring 1919: all hold to keep 6 SCs. No unowned SCs reachable without breaking deals (MAO to ENG breaks England; MAR to PIE breaks Italy). Germany, Italy, England have kept deals so far. Revisit if Belgium or unowned centres open; consider convoy from BRE via MAO to LON/BEL later.

Spring 1919: holding all units. Attacks on BUL bounce against Italy's hold plus AEG support, and no unowned centers are reachable. Italy, Russia and Austria have kept their word. Keep ANK/ARM/UKR line with Russia. Watch F AEG. Revisit BUL only if A BUL withdraws or AEG leaves.

messages.body: Austria here. Russia holds GAL, RUM, WAR and SWE and is the only power that gains from our split. Let's coordinate: I'll move A VIE and A BUD against GAL and RUM this autumn if you pressure WAR and SWE from BER and KIE. Confirm whether you'll attack Russia this Fall, and which units you'll use.

England to Germany, Fall 1919: I hold LON, LVP, NTH, NOR and HOL this autumn with no move on KIE, DEN or BEL. Your north is thin, so tell me your Fall orders for BEL, DEN and KIE, and whether you'd accept a demilitarised DEN-KIE arrangement if your position worsens.

England to France, Fall 1919: I keep F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A HOL off Belgium and Picardy, as before. Please confirm F MAO stays in the Atlantic, away from the Channel, LVP and EDI, and send your Fall orders for MUN, PAR, MAR and POR so we both know where we stand.

France here, Fall 1919. My A MUN holds this Fall and will not move to Burgundy or the Ruhr. I ask that your A KIE, A BER, A DEN and F BEL stay out of Burgundy, Ruhr, Picardy and Paris. Please tell me your Fall orders for KIE and BEL before they lock, and whether you plan any move against MUN.

France here, Fall 1919. F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. My armies in BRE, PAR, MAR, POR and MUN hold. Please confirm F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A HOL keep off Belgium and Picardy this Fall, and give me notice of any change near Spain or Portugal.

Germany here. I have four centres and no units aimed at WAR, GAL or RUM. I propose we both hold this Fall: A WAR and A GAL stay out of SIL, PRU, BER, DEN and KIE, and my A BER, A DEN and A KIE stay out of Russian territory. Please confirm your Fall orders for SWE and WAR.

Germany here. I will keep F BEL, A DEN and A KIE out of HOL, NTH and NOR this Fall. In return, please confirm F NTH and F NOR will not move toward DEN, KIE or BEL, and that A HOL stays put. Tell me your Fall orders for the North Sea before they lock.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1919: A BUL holds with F AEG support and will not withdraw. F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, F ION stays out of Greece. Please keep A CON, F BLA and A SMY out of Bulgaria and Greece this Fall and confirm in writing. If you turn against Russia instead, this line stays quiet.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1919: F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold this Fall and stay off TRI, ALB and SER while our pact stands. Please confirm A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold and none enters BUL, GRE or ALB. Tell me if your plans toward Rumania or Serbia change.

Italy to Russia, Fall 1919: A BUL holds with F AEG support, and I keep my fleets out of the Black Sea. Are A RUM and A GAL holding this Fall? Keep F SEV out of the Aegean and Mediterranean and we can both keep the Balkans quiet. Please send your Fall orders.

Russia here. F SEV and A RUM hold this Fall. I will not enter BUL, ARM or ANK. Your F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM, and A CON and A SMY stay off RUM and UKR. If you move on BUL against Italy, tell me first so we avoid a clash in the Balkans.

Russia here. A GAL and A RUM hold this Fall and will not enter BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Please confirm A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI stay out of GAL, RUM, UKR and WAR. Tell me plainly whether your Balkan units plan any move on SER or TRI this year.

Russia here. A WAR and A GAL hold this Fall and will not enter SIL, PRU, BER, DEN or KIE. F SWE holds. Tell me your plan for A MUN and A BER this autumn, and whether any unit moves toward WAR or MOS. I will flag any change in my orders first.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1919: Confirm in writing that A BUL and F AEG hold, and F ION stays out of GRE. My orders: A CON and F BLA hold, A SMY holds, no move into BUL or GRE. Please send your Fall orders for AEG, ION and BUL, and confirm no Italian move into SMY or CON.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1919: My orders are A CON, A SMY and F BLA holding, staying out of ARM, ANK, UKR, SEV and RUM. Confirm F SEV, A RUM and A WAR stay out of ARM, ANK and BUL this Fall. Tell me plainly if A WAR moves toward GAL or UKR.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1919: Confirm A SER, A BUD and F TRI stay out of BUL and GRE this Fall. I keep A CON, F BLA and A SMY out of SER and RUM. Please send your Fall 1919 orders in writing so we avoid any clash.

Austria here. Confirmed for Fall 1919: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI all hold. None will enter GAL, RUM, UKR or WAR. Please keep A GAL and A RUM holding and out of BUD, SER, VIE and TRI as you promised. We have no plans against SER or TRI this autumn while that holds.

Austria to Italy: Confirmed for Fall 1919. A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold, and none will enter BUL, GRE or ALB. Please keep F ION, A ROM and A VEN holding and out of TRI, ALB and SER. Our pact stands while both sides keep these orders. Any move there ends it.

Austria to Turkey: Confirmed. A SER, A BUD and F TRI hold this Fall and will not enter BUL or GRE. Please keep A CON, F BLA and A SMY out of SER and RUM as promised. Our fleets and armies stay clear of your coast and your centres.

England to France, Fall 1919: Confirmed. F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A HOL hold this Fall, with no move on Belgium, Picardy or the Channel. Please keep F MAO in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I will give notice before any change near Spain or Portugal, and I expect the same from you.

England to Germany, Fall 1919: Confirmed. F NTH, F NOR and A HOL hold this Fall, with no move on Denmark, Kiel or Belgium. I make no commitment beyond this autumn. Please keep F BEL and A DEN out of Holland, the North Sea and Norway. Send your Fall orders for BEL, DEN and KIE, and I will tell you first of any change.

France to England, Fall 1919: Confirmed. F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. My armies in BRE, PAR, MAR, POR and MUN hold this Fall, with no move toward Belgium, Picardy or Spain. I will give you notice before any change near Spain or Portugal. Please keep F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A HOL off Belgium and Picardy as agreed.

Germany here. Confirmed for Fall 1919: F BEL, A DEN and A KIE hold, and none moves into HOL, NTH or NOR. I expect F NTH and F NOR to stay out of DEN, KIE and BEL, and A HOL to stay put. I'll tell you first of any change. A demilitarised DEN-KIE arrangement is worth discussing if the north worsens.

Germany here. This Fall A KIE, A BER, A DEN and F BEL hold. I have no move toward MUN, BUR, RUH, PIC or PAR. Please keep A MUN out of BEL, KIE and BER, and tell me first if your orders change in the west. A quiet border serves us both while Russia and Austria are busy.

Germany here. I hold this Fall: A BER, A DEN and A KIE stay put, and I make no move toward WAR, GAL, RUM or MOS. Keep A WAR out of SIL and PRU, and F SWE out of DEN, KIE and BAL. If that holds, we both keep our centres. Tell me first of any change.

Germany here. I hold my units this Fall and will not move on VIE, TRI or BUD. I have no interest in breaking with Russia now while my north is thin. If you take GAL and RUM in Spring, I may reconsider and press WAR from BER and KIE. Keep A VIE out of Bohemia and Munich.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1919: Confirmed. My orders are A BUL hold, F AEG hold, F ION hold. No Italian move into GRE, SMY or CON this Fall. Your A CON, F BLA and A SMY holding keeps this line quiet. Any move into Bulgaria, Greece or the Aegean-Smyrna line by either of us ends the truce.

Russia here. Confirmed for Fall 1919: A WAR and A GAL hold, and neither enters SIL, PRU, BER, DEN or KIE. F SWE holds in Sweden. I have no orders toward your A MUN or A BER this autumn. I will tell you first if my plans change.

Russia here. Confirmed: A RUM and A GAL hold this Fall and are not aimed at BUL or GRE. F SEV stays in the Black Sea and out of the Aegean and Mediterranean. Please keep F AEG, F ION and A ROM clear of RUM and UKR, and we can both keep the Balkans quiet.

Russia here. Confirmed: F SEV and A RUM hold this Fall, and no Russian unit enters ARM, ANK or BUL. A WAR holds and is not moving toward GAL or UKR. Please keep F BLA out of SEV and RUM, and A CON and A SMY off RUM and UKR. Tell me first if you plan a move into BUL.

Turkey here. This Fall A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold, and none enters ARM, ANK, UKR, SEV or RUM. Please confirm F SEV, A RUM and A WAR stay out of ARM, ANK and BUL. Tell me plainly whether A WAR moves toward GAL or UKR. If it does, we should talk before any clash.

Turkey to Italy. This Fall A CON, F BLA and A SMY hold, with no move into BUL or GRE. Please confirm in writing that F AEG holds, F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, and F ION stays out of GRE. Your A BUL is not my target this turn, but any Italian move toward SMY or CON ends this truce.

notes.note: Fall 1919: all hold to keep 4 SCs. Pacts hold: Italy (no TRI/ALB/SER entry), Turkey (no BUL/GRE), Russia (GAL/RUM hold, no BUD/SER/VIE/TRI entry), Germany (no VIE/TRI/BUD entry, no BOH/MUN by us). Watch Russian GAL/RUM and any broken pact; reassess Spring 1920.

Fall 1919: all hold to keep 6 SCs and honor deals. Germany (no BUR/RUH/PIC/PAR), England (MAO out of ENG/Channel) and Italy have kept deals so far. No unowned SCs reachable without breaking them. Revisit in 1920 if unowned centres appear or a deal breaks.

Fall 1919: all hold, keeping promises to Austria (no BUD/SER/VIE/TRI entry), Germany (no SIL/PRU/BER/DEN/KIE; GAL/RUM to Germany if VIE falls), Turkey (no ARM/ANK/BUL) and England (SWE out of north). No unowned centers reachable. Watch Italy BUL and Turkey BLA. Consider F SEV to BLA to convoy RUM later.

Fall 1919: all hold per pacts with Austria, France, Turkey (Turkey truce: no Italian move into GRE/SMY/CON). Austria and Russia kept word. No unowned centers; attacking SMY/CON would break truce, so hold. Next: if Turkey stays put, consider AEG to SMY or ALB/APU convoys; ROM/VEN convoy setup via TYS/ADR.

Fall 1919: all three units hold per truce. Italy (A BUL, F AEG, F ION hold), Russia (SEV, RUM hold, A WAR not toward GAL/UKR), and Austria (SER, BUD, TRI hold) all confirmed no moves into BUL/GRE/SMY/CON. No unowned centers reachable. Next: hold while others keep word; retake BUL only if A BUL leaves or F AEG leaves.

Fall 1919: all units hold, keeping promises to England, France, Russia, Austria. Attacks now would bounce or break deals. England's F NTH blocks the BEL-NTH convoy plan. Revisit a DEN convoy only if England stays put and the north opens. Watch Russian F SWE and French A MUN.

Fall 1919: HOL attacks BEL with NTH support to dislodge F BEL, breaking my no-move pledge to Germany. Watch KIE/DEN retaliation into HOL. France and Russia kept word; keep MAO and SWE out of the north. Return HOL to HOL if the attack fails.

messages.body: Austria here. Russia is our shared problem. I propose that this Spring I attack Russia: A BUD to RUM and A VIE to GAL. Please move against WAR this Spring with A BER or A KIE via PRU or SIL, and keep your units out of BOH and MUN. Will you confirm? If yes, we both gain centres from Russia.

Austria here. Russia's A RUM and F SEV are both open to attack. I plan A BUD into RUM this Spring. Would you take SEV with F BLA or A SMY, or hold SEV at least, so Russia cannot reinforce the south? Please confirm your plans, and keep A CON and A SMY out of SER and our centres.

England here, Spring 1920. I accept that my Fall 1919 attack on BEL broke our understanding, and I won't repeat it. My fleets stay out of DEN, KIE and BEL this spring. Please keep A DEN and A KIE out of HOL, NTH and NOR, and tell me your Spring orders so we can rebuild trust.

England to France, Spring 1920: F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A HOL hold, with no move toward Belgium or Picardy. Please keep F MAO out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI, and confirm your Spring orders for BRE, MAR, MUN, PAR and POR. I'll give notice before any change.

England to Russia, Spring 1920: I'm holding STP, NOR, NTH and LVP and will not enter the Baltic or Sweden. Please confirm F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI, and that A WAR does not move toward Prussia or Germany. Send your Spring orders for SWE, WAR and SEV so we keep the north quiet.

France, Spring 1920. Germany is down to three centres, so I see little gain in fighting. I keep A MUN out of Kiel, Ruhr and Berlin, and I expect A KIE, A BER, A DEN to stay out of Munich and Burgundy. Tell me your Spring orders first, and whether you plan any move toward Belgium or Holland.

France, Spring 1920. My pledge stands: F MAO stays out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI, and my armies in BRE, PAR, MAR, POR and MUN hold. Please confirm F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A BEL keep off Picardy and Burgundy. I will give notice before any change near Spain or Portugal.

Germany here. Russia's F SWE is the threat to both of us: it borders my DEN and your NOR. Proposal: I hold DEN and KIE this Spring, and you use F NOR and F NTH to pressure SWE or STP. If SWE falls, I'll take BAL and BER-side support so we split Russia's northern gains. Tell me your Spring orders for NTH and NOR.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1920: Our pact stands. F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold this Spring and stay out of TRI, ALB and SER. Please confirm A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold without entering BUL, GRE or ALB. Tell me now if your plans toward Rumania or Serbia change.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1920: A BUL holds with F AEG support, and F ION holds. No Italian move into GRE, SMY or CON. Please confirm in writing that A CON, F BLA and A SMY hold, with no move into BUL or GRE. If you turn against Russia instead, this line stays quiet.

Italy to Russia, Spring 1920: A BUL holds with F AEG support, and I keep my fleets out of the Black Sea. Are A RUM and A GAL holding this Spring? Keep F SEV out of the Aegean and Mediterranean and we can both keep the Balkans quiet. Please send your Spring orders.

Russia here, Spring 1920. A WAR and A GAL hold, and F SWE holds. I will not enter SIL, PRU, BER, DEN or KIE. Your A BER, A DEN and A KIE are your own decision, but I would like a clear plan. Are you attacking Austria's Vienna this year? If so, let's agree when GAL and RUM change hands, and keep Denmark and Kiel out of any Russian move.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1920: Your A BUL has sat for two years. I will attack it this Spring with A CON and F BLA supporting, unless you move A BUL out to SER or GRE-free space, or give me a clear reason to hold. Tell me your Spring orders for A BUL, F AEG and F ION now.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1920: I plan to strike BUL this Spring against Italy's A BUL. Please keep A RUM and F SEV out of BUL, ARM and ANK as before. In return, I will keep my fleets off SEV and RUM. Tell me your Spring orders for A RUM, A WAR and F SEV, and whether A WAR goes toward GAL.

Austria here. Spring 1920: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI will hold, and none will enter BUL, GRE or ALB. Please keep F ION, A ROM and A VEN holding and out of TRI, ALB and SER. Our pact stands while both sides keep these orders. I have no plans against Rumania this Spring; any change will be told to you first.

England here, Spring 1920. F NTH, F LON, F LVP, F EDI and F STP hold, and A BEL holds this spring with no move toward Picardy or Burgundy. F MAO must stay in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I will give you notice before any change near Spain or Portugal. Please confirm your Spring orders for BRE, MAR, MUN, PAR and POR.

England here, Spring 1920. F NTH, F NOR and A BEL hold this spring, with no move on DEN or KIE. I agree Russia's F SWE is a threat, and I will watch STP and SWE. I will not commit beyond this spring. Keep A DEN and A KIE out of HOL, NTH, NOR and BEL, and send your Spring orders for BER, DEN and KIE.

France here, Spring 1920. Confirmed: A BRE, A PAR, A MAR, A POR and A MUN hold this spring. F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I have no move toward Picardy, Burgundy or Belgium. I'll give notice before any change near Spain or Portugal. Please keep A BEL and your northern fleets off Picardy and Burgundy.

Germany here. A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this Spring, and I will not enter SIL, PRU, WAR or GAL. I want F SWE to stay out of DEN, KIE and BAL, as agreed. If Austria attacks your GAL or RUM, I will not join it. Tell me first of any change in your northern orders.

Germany here. A DEN, A KIE and A BER all hold this Spring, so there is no move on HOL, NTH or NOR. I want F NTH and F NOR kept out of DEN, KIE and BEL. Your fleets in the north are the bigger threat to me, so I will watch them closely. Confirm your Spring orders for NTH and NOR.

Germany here. My A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this Spring. I have no move on MUN, BUR, RUH, PIC or PAR. Keep A MUN out of KIE, RUH and BER, and tell me first if your orders change. A quiet western border suits us both while Russia and Austria are busy.

Germany here. I cannot reach WAR this Spring. A BER and A KIE are two moves from Warsaw, so I will not be attacking Russia now. My units hold in BER, DEN and KIE. I still expect A VIE and A BUD to stay out of BOH and MUN, and I will keep my side of our Bohemia agreement.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1920: A BUL holds and will not withdraw. F AEG supports it and F ION holds. Any attack on Bulgaria by A CON or F BLA will be met with full force, and the truce ends. Your strength is better spent on Russia in Armenia and the Black Sea. Keep A CON, F BLA and A SMY out of Bulgaria and Greece.

Russia here, Spring 1920. Confirmed: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR holds and does not move toward Prussia or Germany. F SEV holds in the Black Sea. Please keep STP, NOR, NTH and LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden, and flag any northern change first.

Russia here, Spring 1920. A RUM and A GAL hold this Spring and are not aimed at BUL or GRE. F SEV stays in the Black Sea and out of the Aegean and Mediterranean. Please keep F AEG, F ION and A ROM clear of RUM and UKR, and we can both keep the Balkans quiet.

Russia here, Spring 1920. F SEV holds in the Black Sea, A RUM holds, and A WAR holds. No Russian unit enters ARM, ANK or BUL. A WAR is not moving toward GAL or UKR this Spring. Please keep F BLA out of SEV and RUM, and keep A CON and A SMY off RUM and UKR.

Turkey here. This Spring F BLA attacks Russia's F SEV, and A CON and A SMY hold. Go ahead with A BUD into RUM as you planned; I will not enter RUM or SER. Keep A SER and A BUD out of BUL and GRE as you have promised, and keep your units off SMY and CON.

Turkey to Italy: This Spring A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold, with no move into BUL or GRE, and I will turn my attention north against Russia. Please confirm in writing that A BUL holds, F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, and F ION stays out of GRE. Any Italian move toward SMY or CON ends this truce.

notes.note: Spring 1920: holding all for peace. Promised Germany and France no moves on DEN, KIE, BEL, Picardy or Spain; fleets stay out of the Channel. Russia pledged SWE and WAR stay out of the north. Watch F SWE. No unowned centers reachable now.

Spring 1920: all units hold, keeping promises to England, France, Russia, Austria (no move on MUN, SIL, PRU, GAL, WAR, HOL, NTH, NOR). No safe gains. Watch F SWE near DEN/KIE, F NTH/NOR, and A MUN. Revisit an attack on MUN with BER+KIE support if France stays put and the north is quiet.

Spring 1920: all six SCs held, no unowned centres. Holding to keep deals: Germany (no MUN move to KIE/RUH/BER), England (MAO out of ENG/Channel, no move to PIC/BUR/BEL). All kept so far. Revisit if unowned centres appear or a deal breaks; BRE-MAO-ENG convoy to BEL/LON possible later.

Spring 1920: holding BUL with AEG support vs Turkish threat (Turkey says it will attack BUL with CON/BLA). Austria and Russia have kept word so far. Italy has no unowned centers; SMY/CON attack would break truce. Next: if BUL survives, AEG to SMY or ALB/APU convoys; ROM/VEN convoy setup via TYS/ADR.

Spring 1920: BUD moves to RUM, SER supports BUD to RUM, TRI and VIE hold. Keeps Italy/Turkey pacts (no BUL/GRE/ALB entry). Germany refused WAR, so no coordinated attack. Watch Russian GAL/RUM and Germany BOH/MUN.

Spring 1920: all hold to keep promises to Austria (no BUD/SER/VIE/TRI), Germany (no SIL/PRU/BER/DEN/KIE), Turkey (no ARM/ANK/BUL), England (SWE out of north), Italy (no Aegean/Med). No unowned centers reachable. Germany promised GAL/RUM after VIE falls; watch for it. Turkey plans BUL strike on Italy; keep RUM out of BUL. Reassess Fall 1920.

Spring 1920: F BLA attacks Russian F SEV (promised Austria, breaks Russia pact). A CON and A SMY hold. Italy and Russia pledged no moves into BUL/GRE/SMY/CON/SEV; both broke promises earlier. Next: if SEV falls or empties, take it; keep A CON/A SMY home. Watch A BUL, F AEG. Austria attacking RUM.

messages.body: Austria here. Our A RUM holds this Fall and our A SER and F TRI hold. BUD is empty but ours. Please keep A UKR, A GAL and A WAR out of RUM, BUD, SER, VIE and TRI, and tell me your Fall orders so we avoid a clash.

Austria here. We hold A RUM, A SER, F TRI and A VIE this Fall, with no entry into BUL or GRE. Please keep A SMY and A CON out of SER and RUM as promised. Tell me your F BLA plan against SEV so we know where Russia's southern fleet stands.

Austria here. Our pact stands: A VIE, A SER, F TRI and A RUM hold this Fall, and none of us will enter BUL, GRE or ALB. Please keep F ION, A ROM and A VEN off TRI, SER and BUD. Confirm your Fall orders in writing.

England, Fall 1920: I'm holding NTH, LON, EDI and LVP this Fall and won't enter DEN, KIE or BEL. Please keep A DEN, A KIE and A BER out of HOL, NTH and NOR. Tell me your Fall orders for BER, DEN and KIE so we both know where we stand. Russia's SWE is the shared threat.

England, Fall 1920: My fleets hold STP, NOR, NTH and LVP. I'm asking F SWE to stay out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI, and A WAR not to move toward Prussia or Germany. Please confirm your Fall orders for SWE, WAR and SEV, and tell me first of any northern change.

England, Fall 1920: F MAO must stay in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I'm holding F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A BEL with no move toward Picardy or Burgundy. Please confirm your Fall orders for BRE, MAR, MUN, PAR and POR, and I'll give notice before any change near Spain or Portugal.

France, Fall 1920. My A BRE, A PAR, A MAR, A POR, A MUN and F MAO hold this Fall. F MAO stays out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI, with no move on Picardy or Burgundy. Please confirm your Fall orders for BEL, LON, NTH and LVP, and tell me before any move near BRE or Picardy.

France, Fall 1920. My A MUN holds this Fall and will not move to Burgundy, the Ruhr, Kiel or Berlin. Please confirm A KIE, A BER and A DEN hold. If you plan any move toward Belgium or Munich, tell me first so we avoid a clash in the west.

Germany here, Fall 1920. My A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this Fall and will not enter SIL, PRU, WAR or GAL. I ask that F SWE stays out of DEN, KIE and BAL, and that A WAR stays out of SIL and PRU. If both hold, we both keep our centres. Please confirm your Fall orders for SWE and WAR.

Germany here, Fall 1920. A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold, with no move on HOL, NTH, NOR or BEL. Your F NTH and F NOR should stay out of DEN, KIE and BEL. F SWE is the shared threat to our north, so tell me your Fall orders for NTH, NOR and STP before they lock.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1920: A BUL holds with F AEG support and F ION holds, with no Italian move into GRE, SMY or CON. Your A CON, F BLA and A SMY should stay out of BUL and GRE. Confirm in writing that you will not attack Bulgaria this Fall. We both gain more by facing Russia than fighting each other.

Italy to Russia, Fall 1920: You now hold RUM, so please confirm F SEV stays in the Black Sea and out of the Aegean and Mediterranean. A BUL holds with F AEG support, and F ION and A ROM hold. I will not move toward UKR or RUM. Tell me your Fall orders for A UKR and A GAL.

Russia here. Your A RUM is now in Rumania, which we agreed was ours to take. Your Fall orders should leave RUM and stay out of GAL, UKR and WAR. Tell me plainly if you plan to attack GAL or UKR this autumn. I will keep A GAL and A UKR out of BUD, SER, VIE and TRI.

Russia here. Our F SEV and A WAR hold this Fall, and no Russian unit enters ARM, ANK or BUL. Please keep F BLA out of SEV and RUM, and keep A CON and A SMY off RUM and UKR. Tell me your plan for BUL, since Italy's A BUL is the target.

Russia here. A WAR, A GAL and F SWE hold this Fall, and none enters SIL, PRU, BER, DEN or KIE. Your A BER, A DEN and A KIE should stay out of Russian territory. Tell me plainly if Austria's A RUM or Vienna changes your plans.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1920: F BLA is attacking your F SEV this Fall, and I will also move on Armenia if your units stay near it. Withdraw F SEV and keep A WAR and A RUM out of ARM, ANK and BUL, and we can talk about a border that keeps both our centres.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1920: I am tired of the standoff. A CON and F BLA will attack your A BUL this Fall unless you pull it back to SER or GRE-free space. Confirm in writing that F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, and that F ION stays out of GRE.

Austria here. Our A RUM holds this Fall, and A SER and F TRI hold too. BUD is empty but ours, and I will move a unit there only if your units threaten it. Confirm in writing that A GAL, A UKR and A WAR will not enter RUM, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. If any of them moves toward BUD or RUM, I will treat it as a declaration of war on Austria.

England, Fall 1920. F NTH, F LON, F LVP and F EDI hold this Fall, and I will not enter DEN, KIE or BEL. Please keep A DEN, A KIE and A BER out of HOL, NTH and NOR. I am willing to discuss Russia's F SWE with you, but I make no commitment beyond this autumn. Tell me your Fall orders for BER, DEN and KIE before they lock.

England, Fall 1920. Confirmed: F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A BEL hold this Fall, with no move on Picardy or Burgundy. F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I will give notice before any change near Spain or Portugal, and I expect the same from you.

France here, Fall 1920. Confirmed: A BRE, A PAR, A MAR, A POR and A MUN all hold this Fall, and F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I have no move on Picardy, Burgundy or Belgium. I'll give you notice before any change near Spain or Portugal. Please keep F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A BEL off Picardy and Burgundy.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1920: A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this autumn, with no move into SIL, PRU, WAR or GAL. I ask that F SWE stays out of DEN, KIE and BAL, and A WAR stays out of SIL and PRU. If both hold, we both keep our centres. I will tell you first of any change.

Italy confirms Fall 1920: F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold, and none will enter TRI, SER, ALB or BUD. Our pact stands while you keep A VIE, A SER, F TRI and A RUM out of BUL and GRE. Any move into those territories ends it at once. I expect your orders in writing.

Italy refuses to withdraw A BUL. It holds with F AEG support, and F ION holds. I will not move into GRE, SMY or CON. Your A CON, F BLA and A SMY must stay out of BUL and GRE. Any attack on Bulgaria will be met with full force and ends the truce. Turn your strength against Russia.

Russia here. Austria's A RUM has broken our agreement. This Fall A UKR attacks RUM and A GAL supports it. Our A WAR, F SEV and F SWE hold. Keep A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of GAL, UKR and WAR, and we can stop this fight at the Carpathians.

Russia here. A WAR holds this Fall and will not enter SIL, PRU, BER, DEN or KIE. F SWE holds in Sweden. Our attack this turn is on RUM against Austria, not on your territory. Keep A BER, A DEN and A KIE out of Russian territory and we stay at peace.

Russia here. F SWE holds in Sweden this Fall and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR holds and is not moving toward Prussia or Germany. Please keep your fleets at STP, NOR, NTH and LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden, and tell me first of any northern change.

Russia here. F SEV holds in the Black Sea this Fall and will not enter the Aegean or Mediterranean. Our A UKR and A GAL are fighting Austria over RUM, not moving toward BUL or GRE. Please keep F AEG, F ION and A ROM away from RUM and UKR, and we can stay at peace.

Russia here. F SEV holds in the Black Sea this Fall and will not move toward BLA or the Turkish coast. No Russian unit enters ARM, ANK or BUL. If your F BLA attacks SEV, it will bounce. Please keep A CON and A SMY off RUM and UKR, and tell me your BUL plan.

Turkey to Russia: F BLA is attacking your F SEV this Fall and I expect it to dislodge them, so withdraw it if you want to keep it. A CON and A SMY will not enter UKR or RUM. Keep A WAR and A RUM out of ARM, ANK and BUL, and we can talk about a border that keeps both our centres.

Turkey to Italy: My truce is over. A CON attacks your A BUL this Fall. Pull A BUL back to SER or GRE-free space if you want to avoid a bounce. F AEG must stay out of SMY and CON, and F ION must stay out of GRE, or I will treat it as a move against me.

Turkey to Austria: As promised, F BLA attacks Russia's F SEV this Fall. A SMY holds and A CON holds, so neither enters SER or RUM. I will not enter RUM or SER this Fall. Please keep your A RUM and A SER out of BUL and GRE, and tell me if you intend anything against A SMY or A CON.

notes.note: Fall 1920: all hold, keeping 6 SCs. Germany (no MUN move to KIE/RUH/BER/BUR) and England (MAO out of ENG/Channel, no move to PIC/BUR/BEL) have kept deals so far. No unowned SCs reachable without breaking them. Revisit in 1921 if unowned centres appear or a deal breaks.
Fall 1920: all holds to keep peace with France, Germany, Russia. No unowned centers reachable. Germany and Russia kept word. Next: watch F SWE and Germany's DEN/KIE; any attack needs a convoy plan.

Fall 1920: UKR attacks RUM, supported by GAL and SEV. SWE and WAR hold to keep promises to Germany and England. Italy and Turkey have not kept their Balkan promises, and Austria broke its RUM agreement. Keep SWE out of DEN/BAL and WAR out of SIL/PRU. Reassess after RUM.

Fall 1920: BER attacks MUN with KIE support to take France's center; DEN holds to cover the north. This breaks my no-move promise to France. Watch F SWE vs DEN, and France's reply. Next: hold KIE/DEN, retake positions after MUN.

Fall 1920: RUM holds, SER supports RUM hold to defend against UKR+GAL attack (2 vs 2 bounces). TRI, VIE hold. Russia broke pact (UKR attacks RUM). Italy and Turkey pacts holding. Next: watch UKR/GAL, consider retaking pressure; keep BUD/SER/TRI/VIE covered.

Fall 1920: all hold. F AEG supports A BUL holding to defend against Turkish CON/BLA attack. Turkey says truce is over. Austria, France and Russia have kept terms so far. Next: if BUL survives, consider AEG to SMY or CON if Turkey weakens; keep ION out of GRE unless needed.

Fall 1920: BLA attacks SEV (promised Austria and Russia; expect bounce, gain only if SEV empties). CON and SMY hold to protect centres. Italy's A BUL and F AEG hold; no BUL attack this turn. Russia and Austria have kept their word on RUM/SEV. Next: reassess SEV; keep CON/SMY home.

messages.body: Austria here. Your A UKR attacked RUM this Fall, and we will defend it. I propose a truce: we keep RUM and SER, you keep GAL, UKR and WAR, and neither of us enters BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Confirm your Spring 1921 orders in writing, or expect us to hold and fight for RUM.

Austria here. Thank you for pressing F SEV. Please keep up the attack on Russia's southern fleet this Spring. Keep A CON and A SMY out of SER and RUM, as promised, and we will keep A SER and A RUM out of BUL and GRE. Please confirm your Spring 1921 orders.

Austria here. Russia has attacked our RUM position, so Russia is now the common threat. Could you press WAR from BER or KIE this Spring? We will keep our units out of BOH and MUN as agreed. Please confirm your Spring 1921 orders.

England, Spring 1921. I hold STP, NOR, NTH, EDI, LVP and LON, and I'm not entering the Baltic. Russia's F SWE and A WAR are the question. Confirm F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR and NTH, and tell me your Spring orders for SWE, WAR, MOS and SEV so we both know where we stand.

England, Spring 1921. I'm holding NTH, NWG, NOR and BEL-side units this spring with no move on DEN, KIE, BEL or HOL. Please confirm your Spring orders for BER, DEN, KIE and MUN. If Russia's F SWE moves against you, I'm open to discussing a joint plan, but I need your word that HOL and NTH stay clear.

France here, Spring 1921. MUN is now yours and our armies are on the western border. I have A PAR, A MAR, A BRE, A POR and F MAO, and no move toward Burgundy, the Ruhr or Munich this spring. Please confirm your A MUN, A KIE, A BER and A DEN are not moving toward Burgundy or Paris.

France, Spring 1921. I keep F MAO in the Atlantic, out of the Channel and English waters, with no move toward Belgium, Picardy or Burgundy. Please confirm F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A BEL are not moving toward Picardy or Paris. I will tell you before any change near Spain or Portugal.

Germany here. I broke my word in Fall 1920 by taking MUN with BER and KIE support, and I regret that. I am holding MUN now and have no plans against BUR, RUH, PIC or PAR. Keep A MAR and A PAR out of MUN and BUR, and I will do the same. Tell me your Spring orders first.

Germany here. I took MUN in Fall 1920, which broke our Bohemia understanding, and I know it hurts. I am not moving on VIE, TRI or BUD this Spring. I ask that A VIE and A BUD stay out of BOH and MUN. Russia remains the shared threat, so let us talk before any new move.

Germany here. My A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold again this Spring, with no entry into SIL, PRU, WAR or GAL. I ask that F SWE stays out of DEN, KIE and BAL, and that A WAR stays out of SIL and PRU. Confirm your Spring orders for SWE and WAR before they lock.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1921: A BUL holds with F AEG support this Spring and I will not move toward SMY or CON. Your attacks on Bulgaria cost us both units and gain neither of us anything while Russia is the real target. Confirm in writing that A CON, F BLA and A SMY will stay out of BUL and GRE this Spring, and tell me your intentions toward Russia.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1921: Our pact still stands as long as your A SER, A BUD, A RUM and F TRI stay out of BUL, GRE and ALB. F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold this Spring. Tell me whether A RUM or A SER plans any move toward Bulgaria or Greece, and confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Italy to Russia, Spring 1921: F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold, and A BUL holds with F AEG support. Please confirm F SEV stays in the Black Sea and that A UKR and A WAR will not move toward RUM or BUL. If your plans have changed, tell me now so we can avoid a misunderstanding.

Russia here. Your A RUM is the target of our A UKR and A GAL. Proposal: A RUM withdraws to BUD or SER this Spring, and Russia leaves BUD, SER, VIE and TRI alone. Russia keeps GAL and stays out of Austrian centres. Tell me by reply if you accept, so neither of us wastes units.

Russia here. Austria is our shared problem. I propose Germany pushes into BOH and VIE from MUN while Russia takes GAL with A WAR and RUM with A UKR. Russia keeps out of SIL, PRU, BER, DEN and KIE. Please confirm if you will move A MUN toward BOH this Spring.

Russia here. F SEV holds in the Black Sea and will not enter BLA or the Turkish coast. Please keep F BLA away from SEV, which it cannot take this turn anyway. Your real gains are against Italy in BUL, not against us. Tell me if you plan any move toward RUM or UKR.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1921: I am planning to attack A BUL this Spring with A CON and F BLA. Pull A BUL back to SER or GRE, or keep F AEG out of SMY and CON, and I will hold my fleet off the Adriatic and Ionian routes. Tell me your Spring orders in writing.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1921: F BLA is attacking your F SEV this Spring. Withdraw F SEV to a safe square and keep A WAR and A RUM out of ARM, ANK and BUL. In return my armies stay off UKR and RUM. Tell me your Spring orders now.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1921: Please confirm your Spring orders for A RUM, A SER and A BUD. I will keep A CON and A SMY out of SER and RUM as before. Do not move A SER or A BUD into BUL or GRE, since Italy holds BUL and I may contest it.

Austria here. Agreed: no Austrian unit enters BOH or MUN. Our A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold this Spring. Russia's A UKR and A GAL are the real threat to both of us, so please press WAR from BER or KIE this Spring. Confirm your orders in writing.

Austria confirms Spring 1921: A SER and A RUM hold, F TRI and A VIE hold, and A BUD supports RUM. None of us enters BUL, GRE or ALB this Spring. Please keep F ION, A ROM and A VEN out of TRI, SER and BUD. Any move there ends our pact.

Austria confirms: A SER and A RUM hold, and A BUD supports RUM rather than moving. Nothing enters BUL or GRE this Spring. Please keep A CON and A SMY out of SER and RUM as promised. Keep up the pressure on SEV with F BLA; that helps us both against Russia.

Austria rejects your truce. Your A UKR and A GAL attacked RUM, and RUM stays Austrian. A RUM holds with A BUD support, and A SER holds. We will not withdraw, and any move into RUM, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI will be met with force.

England here, Spring 1921. Confirmed: F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A BEL hold this spring, with no move toward Picardy, Burgundy or Paris. F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I will give you notice before any change near Spain or Portugal, and I expect the same from you.

France here, Spring 1921. I take your word that A MUN holds and that A BER, A KIE and A DEN stay out of Burgundy, Ruhr, Picardy and Paris. My A PAR, A MAR, A BRE, A POR and F MAO will hold this spring, with no move toward Munich or Belgium. Your Fall 1920 seizure of MUN was a broken pledge, so show good faith by keeping A KIE out of Ruhr and Munich. I will tell you before any change.

Germany here. My Spring 1921 orders are hold for A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN. None enters HOL, NTH, NOR or BEL. I expect your F NTH, F NOR and F NWG to stay out of DEN, KIE and BEL. If Russia's F SWE moves against DEN, I will tell you first and we can discuss a joint response.

Germany here. A MUN holds this Spring, with no move toward BUR, RUH, PIC, PAR or MAR. A KIE, A BER and A DEN also hold. Please keep A MAR and A PAR out of MUN and BUR, as I will do the same. I will tell you before any change in the west.

Germany here. I cannot reach WAR this Spring, so all my units hold: A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN. I will not move into VIE, TRI or BUD. I ask that your units stay out of BOH and MUN. Russia is our shared threat, and I will consider pressing WAR from BER or KIE in Fall.

Germany here. I am not moving A MUN toward BOH this Spring, and all my units hold. I will not enter SIL, PRU, WAR or GAL. I ask that F SWE stay out of DEN, KIE and BAL, and that A WAR stay out of SIL and PRU. Tell me first if your Spring orders change.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1921: My orders stay defensive. A BUL holds with F AEG support, F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, and F ION stays out of GRE. I will not withdraw A BUL. If you attack Bulgaria with A CON or F BLA, the truce ends and I will answer with force. Your A CON, F BLA and A SMY must stay out of BUL and GRE. Keep your fleets off the Adriatic and Ionian and we can both turn to Russia.

Russia here. No truce while A RUM sits in Rumania. Our A UKR is moving on RUM this Spring and we will not promise to leave it. Withdraw A RUM to SER or BUD and we can talk about BUD and SER staying quiet. Otherwise expect a fight for RUM.

Russia here. This Spring A WAR holds and stays out of SIL and PRU, and F SWE holds in Sweden, out of DEN, KIE and BAL. Yes, move A MUN toward BOH and VIE. Russia takes RUM and GAL, and we stay out of your centres. Please confirm your MUN move.

Russia here. F SWE holds in Sweden this Spring and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR holds and does not move toward Prussia or Germany. F SEV holds in the Black Sea. A UKR is fighting Austria over RUM, not heading north. Keep STP, NOR, NTH and LVP out of the Baltic.

Russia here. F SEV holds in the Black Sea this Spring and will not enter the Aegean or Mediterranean. A UKR is attacking Austria's RUM, not moving toward BUL. Please keep F AEG, F ION and A ROM away from RUM and UKR, and we can stay at peace.

Russia here. F SEV holds in the Black Sea and will not enter BLA or the Turkish coast. No Russian unit enters ARM, ANK or BUL. Keep F BLA away from SEV, and keep A CON and A SMY off UKR and RUM. Our fight is with Austria, so let us both stay on our own fronts.

Turkey here. Spring 1921: A CON and A SMY hold, and they will not enter SER or RUM. F BLA attacks Russia's F SEV, as agreed. Keep A RUM, A SER and A BUD out of BUL and GRE, and tell me if your Russian front changes. I will confirm my full orders next turn.

Turkey to Italy: My Spring orders are A CON attacks your A BUL, with F BLA supporting. Pull A BUL back to SER or GRE and I will reconsider. Keep F AEG out of SMY and CON, and F ION out of GRE, or I will treat it as a move against me. Confirm your orders in writing.

Turkey to Russia: F BLA attacks your F SEV this Spring. Withdraw it to a safe square and I will not follow up on SEV. Keep A WAR and A RUM out of ARM, ANK and BUL. My armies stay off UKR and RUM. Tell me your Spring orders in writing now.

notes.note: Spring 1921: all four units hold, as promised to England, France, Austria and Russia. Russia's offer to push MUN into BOH was declined. Watch Russian F SWE vs DEN/KIE and Austrian/French moves near MUN. Revisit a WAR attack in Fall if the north stays quiet.

Spring 1921: holding BUL with AEG support vs Turkish CON/BLA attack. ION/ROM/TUN/VEN hold. Pacts: Austria (no TRI/SER/BUD/ALB), Russia (no RUM/UKR). Turkey truce broken by Turkey. Next: if BUL survives, consider AEG to SMY/CON when Turkey weakens; ALB/APU convoys via ADR.

Spring 1921: all hold to keep 5 SCs. No unowned SCs exist, and any move would break deals with England and Germany. Germany broke its Fall 1920 MUN pledge; watch A MUN and A KIE. England has kept its deals so far. Revisit if unowned centres appear or a deal breaks.

Spring 1921: RUM held with BUD and SER support (3 defense vs Russian UKR+GAL max 2). TRI, VIE hold. Russia rejected truce and attacks RUM. Italy and Turkey pacts hold: no BUL/GRE/ALB entry. Germany promised no VIE/TRI/BUD entry; Austria stays out of BOH/MUN. Recheck Russian UKR/GAL and Fall RUM.

Spring 1921: holding all for peace; no unowned centers reachable. Germany, France, Russia kept word so far. Watch F SWE vs DEN/NOR. Convoy BEL->DEN needs NTH convoy; only attack Germany if it weakens or breaks promises.

Spring 1921: all hold; UKR supports SEV holding to stop BLA. RUM attack would bounce (2 vs 2). Kept promises: SWE out of north/Baltic, WAR out of SIL/PRU, SEV out of Aegean/BUL. Austria rejected truce. Germany promised MUN to BOH. Watch Turkey BLA, Austria RUM.

Spring 1921: holding all units. Attacks on BUL and SEV only bounce (Italy's A BUL with F AEG support, Russia's F SEV holds). Austria and Russia keep promises; Italy keeps A BUL/F AEG home. No reachable supply centers. Next: watch for F AEG leaving or A BUL withdrawing, then strike BUL.

messages.body: Austria here. Russia's A UKR and A GAL are attacking our RUM. Please move on WAR now from BER or KIE, as you suggested for Fall. In return, A VIE, A BUD and F TRI stay out of BOH and MUN, and none of our units enters BUD, VIE or TRI without warning you first. Please confirm your Fall 1921 orders in writing.

Austria here. Our pact stands for Fall 1921. A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI will not enter BUL, GRE or ALB. Please keep F ION, A ROM and A VEN out of TRI, SER and BUD. Please confirm your Fall orders in writing.

England, Fall 1921. I plan to hold NTH, NWG, LON, EDI, LVP, NOR and BEL this autumn, with no move on DEN, KIE, HOL or Prussia. Please confirm A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN stay out of HOL, BEL and NTH. Tell me your Fall orders before they lock, and I will do the same.

England, Fall 1921. I hold STP, NOR, NTH, EDI, LVP and LON and am not entering the Baltic. Please confirm F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI, and A WAR does not move toward Prussia or Germany. Tell me your Fall orders for SWE, WAR and SEV first.

England, Fall 1921. F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A BEL hold this autumn, with no move on Picardy, Burgundy or Paris. Please confirm F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I will give notice before any change near Spain or Portugal.

France, Fall 1921. You hold MUN, which was my centre before Fall 1920. I want it back, and I ask you to move A MUN out to Burgundy or Ruhr so I can retake it. In return, I will keep A PAR and A MAR out of Germany and leave your northern centres alone. Tell me your Fall orders first.

Germany here, Fall 1921. I plan to hold A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN again this autumn, with no entry into SIL, PRU, WAR or GAL. Please keep F SWE out of DEN, KIE and BAL. Tell me your Fall orders for WAR, SEV and SWE before they lock, and whether you will move against Austria's RUM.

Germany here, Fall 1921. My A MUN, A BER, A KIE and A DEN hold this autumn. I will not move on VIE, TRI or BUD. Please keep A VIE and A BUD out of BOH and MUN as agreed. Tell me your Fall orders for VIE, BUD, RUM and SER so we both know where we stand.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1921: Your CON and BLA have spent two years against Bulgaria for nothing. I propose a real truce. You keep A CON, F BLA and A SMY out of BUL and GRE, and I keep F AEG and F ION out of SMY, CON and GRE. Russia is the target that gains us both. Confirm in writing before orders are set.

Italy to Russia, Fall 1921: Turkey is attacking my A BUL. I suggest you press Turkey from the north with F SEV and your southern armies, and keep F SEV in the Black Sea. I will keep F AEG, F ION and A ROM clear of RUM and UKR. Tell me your Fall orders for A UKR, A WAR and F SEV.

Russia here. F SEV holds this Fall, and our UKR supports it, so your F BLA will bounce. Please don't attack SEV, and keep A CON and A SMY off UKR and RUM. Russia stays out of ARM, ANK and BUL. Your real gains are against Italy in BUL, so let's both stay on our own fronts.

Russia here. The RUM fight is costing us both. Russia will not enter BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. A UKR holds this Fall and I'll stop attacking RUM if your A RUM stays put and doesn't push toward UKR or GAL. Confirm in writing and we can both hold our centres.

Russia here. A WAR and F SWE hold this Fall and will not enter SIL, PRU, BER, DEN, KIE or BAL. Your MUN and BER units should stay out of Russian territory. If you still plan MUN to BOH, tell me, since Austria is our shared problem. I will tell you first of any change.

Turkey to Russia: Fall 1921: I will hold F BLA off SEV this turn if you keep F SEV out of BLA and keep A WAR and A UKR away from ARM, ANK and CON. Austria is the shared threat on RUM and GAL. Please confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Turkey to Italy: Fall 1921: I will not attack BUL this Fall. A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold if F AEG stays out of SMY and CON and F ION stays out of GRE. Tell me your Fall orders in writing so we both know where we stand.

Austria confirms Fall 1921 orders: A VIE holds, A BUD holds, F TRI holds, A SER holds, and A RUM holds with support from BUD and SER. No Austrian unit enters BOH or MUN. Please keep your units out of VIE, TRI and BUD, and press WAR from BER or KIE when you can. We both benefit if Russia loses WAR.

Austria's A RUM holds this Fall and will not push toward UKR or GAL. Your A UKR is the problem: if it attacks RUM again, we will defend with BUD and SER support. Withdraw A UKR out of RUM's reach and we can keep quiet. Our units will not enter BUD, SER, VIE or TRI, and we expect the same from you.

France here, Fall 1921. Confirmed: F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. A BRE, A PAR, A MAR and A POR hold this autumn, with no move toward Picardy, Burgundy, Belgium or Spain. I will give you notice before any change near Spain or Portugal. Please keep F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A BEL off Picardy, Burgundy and Paris as agreed.

Germany here. Fall 1921: A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN all hold. I will not move on VIE, TRI or BUD this autumn. I hold you to keeping A VIE and A BUD out of BOH and MUN. If Russia's A WAR or F SWE strikes first, I will reconsider pressing WAR in 1922. Tell me your RUM, SER and VIE orders before they lock.

Germany here. A MUN holds this autumn and I will not move it to BUR or RUH this turn. I will not send units toward PAR, MAR or BUR either. Please keep A PAR and A MAR out of MUN and BUR as agreed. I will tell you before any change in the west.

Germany here, Fall 1921. A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN all hold. None enters HOL, BEL, NTH or NOR. Please keep F NTH, F NWG and F NOR out of DEN, KIE and BEL, and I will do the same. If Russia's F SWE moves against DEN, I will tell you first so we can coordinate a response.

Germany here, Fall 1921. A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN hold this autumn, with no entry into SIL, PRU, WAR or GAL. Please keep F SWE out of DEN, KIE and BAL, and keep A WAR out of SIL and PRU. I do not plan to move against Austria's RUM. I will tell you first of any change.

Italy confirms Fall 1921: F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold, and none will enter TRI, SER, BUD or ALB. Our pact stands while A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI stay out of BUL, GRE and ALB. Any move into those territories ends it. My orders are written here: holds across the board, with A BUL held and F AEG supporting.

Italy accepts a Fall 1921 truce. My orders: A BUL holds, F AEG holds, F ION holds. F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, and F ION stays out of GRE. In return, A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold and stay out of BUL and GRE. Any move into those areas by either side ends the truce. Russia remains the common target.

Russia here. Fall 1921: A WAR holds and F SWE holds. Neither enters SIL, PRU, BER, DEN, KIE or BAL. I will not move against you this autumn. Your MUN is not a threat to us, so keep MUN and BER out of Russian territory and we stay at peace.

Russia here. Fall 1921: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR holds and does not move toward Prussia or Germany. F SEV holds in the Black Sea. Please keep your fleets at STP, NOR, NTH and LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden, and tell me first of any northern change.

Russia here. Fall 1921: F SEV holds in the Black Sea, supported by A UKR. A WAR holds. None of my units enters the Aegean, Mediterranean, BUL or GRE. Please keep F AEG, F ION and A ROM away from RUM and UKR, and we can both stay on our own fronts.

Russia here. Fall 1921: F SEV holds, and A UKR supports it, so F BLA cannot take SEV. A WAR holds. No Russian unit enters ARM, ANK, CON or BUL. Please keep F BLA off SEV and keep A CON and A SMY off UKR and RUM. Our fight is with Austria.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1921: Agreed. A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold this Fall, with no move into BUL or GRE. Please confirm in writing that F AEG stays out of SMY and CON and F ION stays out of GRE. If either of us breaks that, the truce ends. I'll send my orders once you confirm.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1921: I will hold F BLA off SEV this turn, provided F SEV stays out of BLA and A WAR and A UKR stay away from ARM, ANK and CON. Confirm those orders in writing. Austria is our shared threat on RUM and GAL, so let's coordinate there.

notes.note: Fall 1921: all four units hold, as promised to England, France, Austria, Russia. Russia (WAR, SWE) has kept its pledges so far. Austria asked for a push on WAR; no safe support exists yet. Revisit WAR attack in 1922 if Russia strikes or stays quiet. Keep MUN out of BUR/RUH and BOH until France/Austria terms are clear.

Fall 1921: all hold to keep 5 SCs; no unowned centres. England (MAO out of ENG/Channel) and Germany (no MUN/BUR move) kept deals. Germany holds MUN, broke 1920 pledge. Revisit if MUN moves or unowned centres appear.

Fall 1921: holding all, per pacts. Turkey agreed truce (CON/SMY/BLA out of BUL/GRE; AEG out of SMY/CON, ION out of GRE). Austria pact holds (no TRI/SER/BUD/ALB entry). Russia peaceful. No unowned centers. Next: watch Turkey; if truce breaks, strike SMY/CON with AEG and ION. Consider ALB/APU convoys later.

Fall 1921: RUM holds with BUD and SER support against Russian UKR attack. VIE, TRI hold. Pacts: Italy and Germany keep their no-entry terms; Russia has been told no push toward UKR/GAL. Watch UKR and SEV; reassess Spring 1922 for RUM/GAL.

Fall 1921: all hold, keeping promises to Austria (UKR holds, no RUM attack), Turkey (SEV holds, no BLA/ARM/ANK/CON), Germany (no SIL/PRU/BER/DEN/KIE/BAL) and England (SWE out of NWG/NOR/NTH/EDI). No unowned centers exist. Germany and Italy have kept their word so far. Austria's RUM is the target if they break their word; reconsider Spring 1922 with UKR support on RUM.

Fall 1921: all holds for peace; no unowned centers. France, Russia, Germany kept word on northern/Channel borders. Next: watch Germany's DEN/KIE; a BEL->DEN convoy needs NTH convoy and Germany's breach. Consider F LON->ENG to prepare convoys if needed.

Fall 1921: holding all units under Italy truce (no moves into BUL/GRE, F AEG out of SMY/CON, F ION out of GRE). Russia pledged no ARM/ANK/CON/BUL entry and F SEV holds. No unowned centers reachable. Watch F AEG and A BUL; revisit BUL only if truce breaks or A BUL leaves.

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1922. Your A UKR and F SEV have fought our RUM for two years. If A UKR leaves Rumania's reach and Russia stays out of BUD, SER, VIE and TRI, A RUM stays home with no push toward UKR or GAL. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Austria here, Spring 1922. Russia's A WAR and F SWE remain our shared threat. Please press WAR from BER or KIE this Spring. Our A VIE, A BUD and F TRI stay out of BOH and MUN as agreed. Tell me your Spring orders so we both know where we stand.

Austria here, Spring 1922. Our pact holds: A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI stay out of BUL, GRE and ALB. Please confirm F ION, A ROM and A VEN stay off TRI, SER and BUD this Spring. Send your written orders.

England, Spring 1922. I plan to hold NTH, NWG, NOR, LON, EDI, LVP and BEL this spring, with no move on DEN, KIE, HOL or Prussia. Please confirm your Spring orders for BER, DEN, KIE and MUN, and that none enters HOL, BEL, NTH or NOR. I will tell you before any change.

England, Spring 1922. My fleets hold STP, NOR, NTH and LVP, and I am not entering the Baltic. Please confirm F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI, and A WAR does not move toward Prussia or Germany. Tell me your Spring orders for SWE, WAR, SEV and UKR before they lock.

England, Spring 1922. F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A BEL hold this spring, with no move on Picardy, Burgundy or Paris. F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel and English waters. Please confirm your Spring orders, and give me notice before any change near Spain or Portugal, as agreed.

France here, Spring 1922. You hold MUN, which was my centre before Fall 1920. I want it back. Tell me your Spring 1922 orders and whether A MUN, A KIE, A BER and A DEN will move west or north. Until then A PAR, A MAR and A BRE hold.

France here, Spring 1922. You lead on centres and I stay west. I propose we discuss Germany together: if Germany stays weak, we could share its centres later. Please tell me your Spring 1922 orders first, and whether F NTH or A BEL will move toward Germany.

Germany here, Spring 1922. My A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN hold. Tell me your orders for A WAR and F SWE before they lock. I want F SWE to stay out of DEN, KIE and BAL, and A WAR out of SIL and PRU. If either unit leaves its post, I will reconsider my options in the north.

Germany here, Spring 1922. All my units hold this spring, as before. Please keep A VIE and A BUD out of BOH and MUN. I am still weighing a move on WAR in Fall 1922, depending on Russia's orders. Tell me your RUM and SER orders now.

Germany here, Spring 1922. All my units hold. I expect your F NTH, F NOR and F NWG to stay out of DEN, KIE and BEL. Tell me your spring orders, including whether F NTH or any unit moves toward HOL. I will tell you first of any change in the north.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1922: Our truce holds while A CON, A SMY and F BLA stay out of BUL and GRE. Turkey has three centers and I see no gain for either of us in more fighting. Confirm your Spring orders in writing, and I will keep F AEG out of SMY and CON and F ION out of GRE.

Italy to Russia, Spring 1922: Turkey is weak. If you press from the north with F SEV and A UKR toward BLA and ARM, I can threaten SMY and CON from the Aegean later. Tell me your Spring orders for F SEV and A UKR, and I will keep A ROM and A BUL clear of RUM and UKR.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1922: Our pact stands while A SER, A BUD, A RUM and F TRI stay out of BUL, GRE and ALB. F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold this Spring and will not enter TRI, SER or BUD. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Russia here, Spring 1922. Austria is still our shared problem, and VIE and BOH are your natural targets. I will hold A WAR and F SWE, staying out of SIL, PRU, BER, DEN, KIE and BAL. If VIE falls, I ask that GAL stay Russian. Will A MUN move toward BOH this Spring? Tell me your orders first.

Russia here. F SEV holds in the Black Sea this Spring, supported by A UKR, so F BLA cannot take it. Russia will not enter ARM, ANK, CON, SMY or BUL. Keep F BLA off SEV and keep A CON and A SMY off UKR and RUM. Confirm your Spring 1922 orders in writing.

Russia here. A UKR holds this Spring and will not attack RUM. Austria keeps A RUM and A SER, and Russia stays out of BUD, SER, VIE and TRI. Tell me if you will keep A RUM off UKR and GAL, and I will confirm the same in writing. Both of us lose if we keep fighting over RUM.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1922: The Fall 1921 truce stands. A CON, A SMY and F BLA stay out of BUL and GRE. Confirm in writing that F AEG stays out of SMY and CON and F ION stays out of GRE. Tell me if A BUL is moving this Spring.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1922: I will keep F BLA off SEV if F SEV stays out of BLA and A WAR and A UKR stay out of ARM, ANK and CON. Please confirm your Spring 1922 orders in writing. Tell me if you plan any move toward RUM.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1922: A CON and A SMY hold and will not enter SER or RUM. Please confirm your Spring orders for A RUM, A SER and A BUD, and keep them out of BUL and GRE as agreed. Tell me your plans against Russia.

Austria here. Spring 1922: A RUM holds and will not move toward UKR or GAL. A SER and A BUD hold, F TRI and A VIE hold. Your A UKR must stay out of RUM, and Russia must keep out of BUD, SER, VIE and TRI. I accept your offer in writing on those terms. Please confirm your orders the same way.

Austria here. Our pact stands. A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI hold this Spring and will not enter BUL, GRE or ALB. Please keep F ION, A ROM and A VEN off TRI, SER and BUD. Any breach by either side ends the pact at once, and I will tell you first if my plans change.

Austria here. Spring 1922: A VIE holds, A BUD holds, F TRI holds, A SER holds, and A RUM holds. None of my units will enter BOH or MUN. I also expect your units to stay out of VIE, TRI and BUD. Russia's A WAR and F SWE are the threat to us both, so I hope you will press WAR in Fall.

Austria here. Spring 1922: A RUM, A SER and A BUD hold, and F TRI holds. None of them will enter BUL or GRE. Please keep A CON and A SMY out of SER and RUM as agreed. Keep F BLA pressing Russia's SEV, which helps us both. Tell me your Fall plans against Russia so we can coordinate.

England, Spring 1922. Confirmed: F NTH, F LON, F LVP, F EDI and A BEL hold this spring, with no move on Picardy, Burgundy or Paris. F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel and English waters. I will tell you before any change near Spain or Portugal. Please keep your armies in BRE, PAR, MAR, POR and MUN holding as agreed.

England, Spring 1922. Confirmed: F NTH, F NOR and F NWG hold this spring, with no move into DEN, KIE, BEL or HOL. Please confirm A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN hold, with none entering HOL, BEL, NTH or NOR. I will tell you first of any change in the north, and I expect the same from you.

France here, Spring 1922. My orders: A BRE, A PAR, A MAR, A POR hold, and F MAO holds in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI, as agreed. I have no move toward Picardy, Burgundy, Belgium or Spain. Please keep F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A BEL off Picardy and Paris. I will give notice before any change near Spain or Portugal.

Germany here, Spring 1922. All my units hold: A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN. None enters HOL, BEL, NTH or NOR this spring. Please keep F NTH, F NWG and F NOR out of DEN, KIE and BEL, and I will do the same. I will warn you before any change in the north.

Germany here, Spring 1922. I cannot press WAR this spring, so all my units hold. I am still weighing a WAR move in Fall 1922, depending on Russia's orders. Please keep A VIE and A BUD out of BOH and MUN, as agreed. I will tell you before any change.

Germany here, Spring 1922. My A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN hold. I will not move A MUN toward BOH. Please keep A WAR out of SIL and PRU, and F SWE out of DEN, KIE and BAL. Tell me your SEV and UKR orders before they lock, and I will tell you first of any change.

Germany here, Spring 1922. A MUN holds this spring and I will not vacate it now. I have no move toward BUR, RUH, PAR or MAR. Please keep A PAR, A MAR and A BRE out of MUN and BUR, and I will do the same. If the western border stays quiet, we can talk again in 1923.

Italy confirms Spring 1922: F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold, and none will enter TRI, SER or BUD while our pact stands. A BUL holds with F AEG support. Please keep A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI out of BUL, GRE and ALB. Any move there ends the pact.

Italy confirms Spring 1922: A BUL holds with F AEG support, F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, and F ION holds and stays out of GRE. Our truce holds while A CON, A SMY and F BLA stay out of BUL and GRE. Any move into those areas by either side ends it.

Russia confirms for Spring 1922: A UKR holds and will not attack RUM. F SEV holds in the Black Sea. We stay out of BUD, SER, VIE and TRI. Keep A RUM off UKR and GAL, and we can both hold our centres while we look at other fronts.

Russia confirms: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR holds and does not move toward Prussia or Germany. F SEV and A UKR hold in the south. Please keep your fleets out of the Baltic and tell me first of any northern change.

Russia confirms: F SEV holds in the Black Sea and A UKR holds this Spring. We will not enter the Aegean, Mediterranean, BUL or GRE. Please keep F AEG, F ION and A ROM away from RUM and UKR. Turkey is your real opponent in the Balkans, so good luck there.

Russia confirms: A WAR holds and F SWE holds this Spring. Neither enters SIL, PRU, BER, DEN, KIE or BAL. We are not moving toward BOH or your centres. Keep A MUN and your northern units out of Russian territory and we stay at peace.

Russia confirms: F SEV holds in the Black Sea this Spring, supported by A UKR, and will not enter BLA. We will not enter ARM, ANK, CON, SMY or BUL. Please keep F BLA off SEV and keep A CON and A SMY off UKR and RUM. Our fight is with Austria.

Turkey, Spring 1922: A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold this Spring, with no move into BUL or GRE. Confirmed: if F AEG stays out of SMY and CON and F ION stays out of GRE, the truce stands. A BUL is not moving from me this Spring. Any Italian move toward SMY or CON ends the truce at once.

Turkey, Spring 1922: A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold this Spring. I will keep F BLA off SEV if F SEV stays out of BLA and A WAR and A UKR stay out of ARM, ANK and CON. My armies stay off UKR and RUM. Austria is our shared threat, so please confirm your orders in writing.

notes.note: Spring 1922: all hold, keeping promises to England, France, Austria, Russia. Russia and England have kept pledges so far. Plan: revisit WAR attack in Fall 1922 if Russia stays quiet; keep MUN and north units out of Russian/English territory. Watch Austria's VIE/BUD vs BOH/MUN.

Spring 1922: holds across board, AEG supports BUL. Pacts: Turkey truce (no AEG into SMY/CON, ION out of GRE), Austria (no TRI/SER/BUD entry), Russia peaceful. No unowned centers. Next: watch Turkey; if truce holds, consider ION to ADR for VEN-ALB convoy or AEG to SMY if Turkey weakens.

Spring 1922: holding all centers. BUD and SER support RUM hold against Russian UKR. Pacts: Russia (no RUM push to UKR/GAL, Russia out of BUD/SER/VIE/TRI), Italy (no BUL/GRE/ALB), Germany (no BOH/MUN). Watch Russia's UKR and Germany's WAR plans; Russia and Germany have both confirmed so far.

Spring 1922: all hold. Attacking RUM with UKR+SEV would bounce (3 defenders vs 2), so hold. Promises kept so far: Austria (no BUD/SER/VIE/TRI), Germany (no SIL/PRU/BER/DEN/KIE/BAL), Turkey (no ARM/ANK/CON/SMY/BUL), England (SWE out of NWG/NOR/NTH/EDI). Spring 1922: all hold; no unowned centres and any attack on DEN would fail while breaking pledges. France and Russia kept word. Germany's north is thin; if Germany weakens, plan A BEL convoy via NTH to DEN, set up with F LON/NTH to ENG first.

Spring 1922: holding all units per Fall 1921 truce with Italy and Russia. No unowned centers reachable. Italy confirmed F AEG out of SMY/CON, F ION out of GRE. Russia confirmed F SEV holds and no entry to BLA/ARM/ANK/CON/SMY/BUL. Austria holds A RUM/SER/BUD. Watch A BUL and F AEG; break truce only if Italy moves toward SMY/CON or A BUL leaves.

messages.body: Austria here, Fall 1922. Our A VIE, A BUD and F TRI will stay out of BOH and MUN as agreed. If you press WAR this Fall with A BER or A KIE, Austria will not interfere. Please confirm your Fall orders for BER, KIE and MUN in writing before they lock.

Austria here, Fall 1922. Our pact stands: A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI stay out of BUL, GRE and ALB. Please confirm F ION, A ROM and A VEN stay off TRI, SER and BUD this Fall, and send your written orders for BUL, AEG and TUN.
