France, Fall 1922. My A PAR, A MAR and A BRE stay out of Germany this autumn. Munich is still my former centre, and I want it back when the time is right. Please tell me your Fall 1922 orders first, and whether A MUN, A KIE or A BER will move west or north.

France, Fall 1922. England leads on centres, so I want a clear understanding. My F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel and English waters. Please keep F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A BEL off Picardy, Burgundy and Paris. Tell me your Fall 1922 orders first.

Germany here, Fall 1922. I am weighing moves against Austria, not Russia. Will A WAR and F SWE hold again this fall? I will keep A BER, A DEN and A KIE out of Russian territory. Tell me your SEV and UKR orders before they lock, and I will tell you first of any change.

Germany here, Fall 1922. My units stay put this fall: A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN hold. I still want A VIE and A BUD kept out of BOH and MUN. Tell me your VIE, BUD and TRI orders before they lock, and what you plan against Russia's WAR.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1922: Our pact stands. F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold this Fall and will not enter TRI, SER or BUD. Please keep A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI out of BUL, GRE and ALB. Tell me now if your Fall plans change.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1922: Our truce stands. F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, and F ION stays out of GRE, while your A CON, A SMY and F BLA stay out of BUL and GRE. Please send your Fall orders, and tell me if you plan any move toward BUL.

Italy to Russia, Fall 1922: F ION, A ROM and A VEN are holding and will not enter RUM or UKR. Please confirm F SEV, A UKR and A WAR stay out of the Aegean, Mediterranean, BUL and GRE this Fall, and send me your Fall orders.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1922: A WAR and F SWE hold again, and neither enters SIL, PRU, BER, DEN, KIE or BAL. Austria is still our shared problem. If VIE falls, I'd take GAL and RUM while you take BOH and VIE. Tell me your A MUN and northern orders before they lock.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1922: F SEV holds, supported by A UKR, and will not enter BLA. We stay out of ARM, ANK, CON, SMY and BUL. Keep F BLA off SEV and your armies off UKR and RUM. Italy is the threat to your Balkan holdings, so press BUL and GRE if you can.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1922: I hold A CON, A SMY and F BLA this Fall and will not attack SEV while F SEV holds with A UKR support. Please tell me your Fall orders in writing. If Austria moves on RUM or GAL, I'd like Russia to hold SEV and WAR, and I'll keep my armies off UKR.

Austria here, Fall 1922. This fall A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold, and no Austrian unit enters BOH or MUN. We will not interfere if you press WAR with A BER or A KIE. Please confirm your BER, KIE and MUN orders in writing before they lock, and keep your units out of VIE, TRI and BUD.

Austria confirms Fall 1922: A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI hold, and none of us enters BUL, GRE or ALB. Our pact stands while F ION, A ROM and A VEN stay off TRI, SER and BUD. Any breach ends it at once. Please confirm your Fall orders in writing.

England here, Fall 1922. My orders: F NTH, F LON, F LVP, A BEL and F EDI all hold this autumn, with no move on Picardy, Burgundy or Paris. I keep my word and expect F MAO to stay in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I will give you notice before any change near Spain or Portugal, and I expect the same from you.

France here, Fall 1922. Yes, unchanged: A BRE, A PAR, A MAR and A POR hold, and F MAO holds in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I will give you notice before any change near Spain or Portugal. Please keep F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A BEL off Picardy, Burgundy and Paris.

Germany here. My A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN all hold this Fall, so there is no move on WAR yet. I cannot reach WAR this turn anyway, since it needs SIL or PRU first. I will keep to our agreement on BOH and MUN. Please keep A VIE, A BUD and F TRI out of BOH and MUN, and tell me your RUM and SER orders.

Germany here. Fall 1922: A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN all hold. None enters HOL, BEL, NTH or NOR. I expect your fleets to stay out of DEN, KIE and BEL. I will warn you before any change in the north.

Germany here. A MUN holds this Fall and I have no move toward BUR, RUH, PAR or MAR. Please keep A PAR, A MAR and A BRE out of MUN and BUR, and I will do the same. If the western border stays quiet, we can talk again in 1923.

Germany here. Fall 1922: A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN all hold, so I am not moving toward SIL, PRU or WAR this turn. Please keep A WAR and F SWE out of SIL, PRU, DEN, KIE and BAL, as agreed. I will tell you first of any change in the north.

Italy here, Fall 1922. Our pact stands. F ION, A ROM and A VEN hold this Fall and will not enter TRI, SER or BUD. Please keep A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI out of BUL, GRE and ALB, and send your written Fall orders. Any breach ends the pact at once.
Russia confirms Fall 1922: A UKR holds, F SEV holds, A WAR holds. Russia will not enter BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Keep A RUM holding and off UKR and GAL, as agreed, and we both keep our centres.

Russia confirms: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR holds and does not move toward Prussia or Germany. F SEV and A UKR hold in the south. Please keep your northern fleets out of the Baltic.

Russia confirms: A WAR and F SWE hold this Fall. Neither enters SIL, PRU, BER, DEN, KIE or BAL. F SEV and A UKR hold in the south. Keep A MUN and your northern armies out of Russian territory and we stay at peace.

Russia confirms Fall 1922: F SEV, A UKR and A WAR hold. None of them enters the Aegean, Mediterranean, BUL or GRE. Please keep F ION, F AEG and A ROM away from RUM and UKR, as agreed. We stay on our own fronts.
Russia confirms: F SEV holds, supported by A UKR, and will not enter BLA. We will not enter ARM, ANK, CON, SMY or BUL. Keep F BLA off SEV and your armies off UKR and RUM. A WAR holds and stays north.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1922: A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold this Fall, with no move into BUL or GRE. I expect F AEG to stay out of SMY and CON and F ION out of GRE, as agreed. If either of us moves against those areas, the truce ends. Any Italian move toward SMY or CON will be answered at once.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1922: A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold this Fall, and F BLA will not attack SEV while F SEV holds and stays out of BLA. My armies stay off UKR and RUM. If Austria moves on RUM or GAL, I would like Russia to hold SEV and WAR. Please confirm your orders in writing.

notes.note: Fall 1922: all hold to keep 5 SCs (BUD RUM SER TRI VIE). Pacts: Italy (no BUL/GRE/ALB entry by us), Germany (no BOH/MUN by us), Russia (RUM holds, no UKR/GAL). Watch Russian UKR attack on RUM and Italian pact breaches. Reassess Spring 1923.

Fall 1922: holding all units to keep promises to England, France, Austria, Russia. WAR is unreachable this turn (needs SIL/PRU first). Russia and Austria have kept pledges; England and France quiet. Next: consider a WAR push via SIL/PRU in 1923 if Russia stays quiet; keep MUN out of BUR/BOH unless terms change.

Fall 1922: LON moves to ENG to set up a future A BEL convoy. Others hold for peace. Germany, France and Russia kept word. Breaking the peace would only be worth it if Germany's north weakens. Next: consider convoying BEL to DEN via NTH only if Germany breaks its word.

Fall 1922: all hold, keeping 5 SCs. No unowned SCs; any move breaks England (BEL/PIC) or Germany (MUN/BUR) deals. England and Germany have kept deals so far. Revisit if unowned centres appear, MUN vacates, or a deal breaks. Possible later: BRE via MAO to ENG convoy.

Fall 1922: pacts hold with Austria, Russia, Turkey; no breaches so far. No unowned centers. F TUN to TYS sets up ROM convoy to TUN next turn. Keep AEG/ION off SMY/CON/GRE while Turkey holds. Watch for Turkish move toward BUL.

Fall 1922: all hold to keep promises to Austria, Germany, Turkey, England, Italy. Attacking RUM now would bounce vs BUD/SER support and leave SEV open to Turkey. Watch for Austria support weakening; then SEV+UKR on RUM. Austria and Germany have kept word so far.

Fall 1922: holding all units under truce with Italy (no BUL/GRE entry; F AEG out of SMY/CON, F ION out of GRE) and Russia (F SEV holds with A UKR support, no BLA entry). Italy and Russia kept words so far. Attacking BUL now would bounce (2v2 vs A BUL + F AEG). Revisit BUL if A BUL leaves or F AEG leaves; watch Italy for any move toward SMY/CON.

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1923. Our pact stands as long as F ION, A ROM and A VEN stay off TRI, SER and BUD. Italy holds BUL and GRE is open. Are you planning anything against Turkey or Greece this spring? I will keep A RUM, A SER and A BUD out of BUL and GRE if you confirm your Spring orders in writing.

England, Spring 1923. My F NTH, F NWG and F NOR hold this spring with no move into DEN, KIE, BEL or HOL. Please confirm A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN hold again, with none entering HOL, BEL, NTH or NOR. I will warn you first of any change in the north.

England, Spring 1923. I am holding STP, NOR, NTH and LVP and staying out of the Baltic. Please confirm F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI, and A WAR does not move toward Prussia or Germany. Tell me your Spring orders for SWE, WAR and SEV before they lock.

England, Spring 1923. F NTH, F LON, F LVP, F EDI and A BEL hold this spring, with no move on Picardy, Burgundy or Paris. F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel and English waters. Please confirm your A BRE, A PAR, A MAR and A POR orders hold and give notice of any change near Spain or Portugal.

France here, Spring 1923. Munich is still German, and I want it back. Tell me your Spring 1923 orders first. If A MUN moves, I will consider keeping my armies out of Germany. If it stays, my A PAR, A MAR and A BRE stay out of MUN and BUR this spring.

France, Spring 1923. My F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel and English waters. Please confirm your Spring orders and that F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A BEL stay off Picardy, Burgundy and Paris. Any change near Spain or Portugal, I will tell you first.

France to Italy, Spring 1923: my A PAR, A MAR, A POR, A BRE and F MAO hold. I still have no move toward Tunis, the Gulf of Lyon or Piedmont. Please send your Spring orders first, and keep F TUN and F ION out of the western Mediterranean.

Germany here, Spring 1923. I want to grow, and Austria is the target for both of us. I will keep A MUN out of Russian land and BOH unless Austria breaks. Tell me your A WAR, F SWE and southern orders now. Will WAR stay with you, and will you press GAL or RUM against Austria?

Germany here, Spring 1923. Our agreement holds: no Germany unit enters VIE, TRI or BUD. Austria has been reliable, so I may move against Russia later. Tell me your VIE, BUD, TRI and SER orders now, and whether you will move against Italy or Russia this year.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1923: Our pact stands. Please confirm in writing that A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI stay out of BUL, GRE and ALB this Spring. Italy's F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS will not enter TRI, SER or BUD. Tell me now if your plans toward Albania or Greece change.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1923: Our truce stands while A CON, A SMY and F BLA stay out of BUL and GRE. Italy's A BUL holds with F AEG support. Please send your Spring orders in writing. If you plan any move toward BUL, tell me now, since it changes where F AEG and F ION go.

Italy to Russia, Spring 1923: Please confirm F SEV, A UKR and A WAR stay out of the Aegean, Mediterranean, BUL and GRE this Spring. Italy's F ION, A ROM and A VEN will not enter RUM or UKR. Send me your Spring orders, and tell me whether Turkey is your target in the Black Sea.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1923: Austria is our shared problem. I propose we coordinate: you press VIE and BOH with A MUN and your southern armies, and I take RUM and GAL with A UKR and F SEV once VIE is threatened. A WAR and F SWE stay out of SIL, PRU, BER, DEN, KIE and BAL as before. Tell me your Spring orders for A MUN before they lock.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1923: I have kept my word on BUD, SER, VIE and TRI, and I still expect RUM to stay off UKR and GAL. But Germany is pressing you, and I would rather not fight over RUM. Tell me your Spring orders for A RUM, A BUD and A VIE, and whether you can keep your word on UKR.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1923: The Fall 1922 truce stands while A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold. Tell me whether A BUL or F AEG moves this Spring, and confirm in writing that F AEG stays out of SMY and CON and F ION stays out of GRE. Any move toward SMY or CON ends the truce.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1923: Austria holding RUM and SER is our shared problem. I propose you press Austria while I keep A CON, A SMY and F BLA off SEV, UKR and WAR. Please confirm your Spring 1923 orders in writing and tell me whether A UKR or F SEV moves toward RUM.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1923: Please confirm your orders for A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI. Our agreement stands: A CON and A SMY stay out of SER and RUM. I am considering pressure on Italy's BUL, and I need your assurance that Austria will not contest the Black Sea coast.

Austria confirms Spring 1923: A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold, and no Austrian unit enters BOH or MUN. Our pact stands while Germany keeps out of VIE, TRI and BUD. Russia's A WAR is a fair target for you. I will tell you before any change in my plans.

Austria confirms Spring 1923: A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI hold, and none of them enters BUL, GRE or ALB. Our pact stands while F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS stay off TRI, SER and BUD. Any breach ends it at once.

Austria: A RUM holds this Spring and will not move toward UKR or GAL. A BUD and A VIE hold. Your A UKR must stay out of RUM. Keep your word on BUD, SER, VIE and TRI and we stay at peace. Confirm your UKR and SEV orders in writing.

Austria confirms Spring 1923: A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI hold. None of them enters BUL or GRE. Keep A CON and A SMY out of SER and RUM as agreed. Austria has no interest in the Black Sea coast, so press Italy's BUL as you see fit. We will keep our word.

England here, Spring 1923. Confirmed: F NTH, F LON, F LVP, F EDI and A BEL all hold this spring, with no move toward Picardy, Burgundy or Paris. F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel and English waters. I expect your A BRE, A PAR, A MAR and A POR to hold as you've said. I will give you notice before any change near Spain or Portugal, and I expect the same from you.

France here, Spring 1923. Confirmed: A BRE, A PAR, A MAR and A POR hold this spring, and F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I have no move on Picardy, Burgundy, Belgium or Spain. Please keep F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A BEL off Picardy, Burgundy and Paris, and I will give notice before any change near Spain or Portugal.

Germany, Spring 1923. A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN all hold this spring. None enters HOL, BEL, NTH or NOR. I expect your F NTH, F NWG and F NOR to stay out of DEN, KIE and BEL. I will warn you before any change in the north.

Germany, Spring 1923. A MUN holds this spring, and A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold too. I have no move toward BUR, RUH, PAR or MAR. Please keep A PAR, A MAR and A BRE out of MUN and BUR, and I will do the same. I will tell you before any change in the west.

Germany, Spring 1923. A MUN holds this spring, so I am not moving toward BOH now. A BER, A DEN and A KIE also hold. Please keep A WAR out of SIL and PRU and F SWE out of DEN, KIE and BAL. I am open to discussing Austria in Fall once we see how Vienna moves.

Italy confirms Spring 1923: F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS hold, and none will enter TRI, SER or BUD. Our pact stands while A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI stay out of BUL, GRE and ALB. Any breach by either side ends it at once. I have no plan against Greece this spring.

Italy to France: Spring 1923 orders are F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS holding, and A BUL holding with F AEG support. None of my units will enter Spain, the Gulf of Lyon, Piedmont or Tunis this spring. Please keep your western armies away from Tunis and Italian soil, and tell me if your plans change.

Italy to Turkey: Our truce stands. A BUL holds this spring with F AEG in support. F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, and F ION stays out of GRE, while your A CON, A SMY and F BLA stay out of BUL and GRE. Any move toward SMY or CON by either side ends the truce. Send your written Spring orders.

Russia to England, Spring 1923: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR holds and is not moving toward Prussia or Germany. F SEV and A UKR hold in the south. I expect the same from you: STP, NOR, NTH and LVP stay out of the Baltic and Sweden.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1923: A WAR and F SWE hold this Spring, and neither enters SIL, PRU, BER, DEN, KIE or BAL. F SEV and A UKR also hold. Press Austria at VIE and BOH as you planned. Once VIE is threatened, I will move on RUM and GAL. Keep A MUN out of Russian land.

Russia to Italy, Spring 1923: Confirmed. F SEV, A UKR and A WAR hold this Spring and will not enter the Aegean, Mediterranean, BUL or GRE. Please keep F ION, F AEG and A ROM out of RUM and UKR, as agreed. Turkey is your Balkan rival, and I am staying out of that fight this turn.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1923: F SEV holds, supported by A UKR, and will not enter BLA. A WAR holds. Russia will not enter ARM, ANK, CON, SMY or BUL. Keep A CON, A SMY and F BLA off SEV, UKR and WAR. Our target is Austria's RUM, not your armies.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1923: The Fall 1922 truce stands. My A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold this Spring, with no move into BUL or GRE. I confirm F AEG must stay out of SMY and CON and F ION out of GRE. A BUL is not moving from me this Spring. Any move toward SMY, CON or GRE by either side ends the truce at once.

notes.note: Spring 1923: all hold for peace. No unowned centers reachable. Germany, France, Russia kept word. Watch Germany's DEN/KIE; convoy BEL->DEN via NTH/ENG only if Germany breaks word.

Spring 1923: all hold to keep 5 SCs. Pacts hold: Italy (no TRI/SER/BUD entry by them; no BUL/GRE/ALB by us), Turkey (no BUL/GRE by us), Germany (no VIE/TRI/BUD entry; no BOH/MUN by us), Russia (RUM holds, no UKR/GAL push). Reassess Fall 1923 and watch Russian UKR and Italian breaches.

Spring 1923: BER moves to SIL, supported by MUN, to open the route toward WAR. DEN and KIE hold. Promises kept: no move into VIE/TRI/BUD (Austria), no entry into HOL/BEL/NTH/NOR (England), MUN stays out of Russian land. Watch Russian WAR/SWE response and Austria's BOH/MUN pledge.

Spring 1923: all hold, keeping 5 SCs and deals with England and Germany. No unowned SCs reachable. England and Germany kept deals so far; Germany holds MUN. Revisit: consider A PAR to BUR toward MUN if Germany's MUN weakens, or if unowned centres appear.

Spring 1923: UKR attacks RUM, supported by SEV, to take the center. SEV stays in SEV to guard it. SWE and WAR hold. Broke word to Austria on RUM. Watch Turkey BLA on SEV and Austrian/German retaliation on GAL. Germany keeps its word so far.

Spring 1923: holding all units to keep Italy and Russia truces; no unowned centers reachable. Italy's A BUL/F AEG and F ION are unchanged. Russia says it targets Austria's RUM. Austria confirmed RUM/SER/BUD/TRI hold and no move into BUL/GRE. Break truce only if Italy moves toward SMY/CON or A BUL leaves, then strike BUL.

Spring 1923: all hold to keep Turkey, Austria, Russia pacts. Turkey truce: AEG out of SMY/CON, ION out of GRE. Austria: no TRI/SER/BUD entry. No unowned centers. Next: if Turkey's CON/SMY are weakened, strike with BUL+AEG; watch Austria breaking pact.

messages.body: Austria here. Your A RUM is sitting on a centre that was ours until this spring, and our A GAL is now adjacent. I propose you move A RUM to UKR this Fall and we both avoid a costly fight. Confirm in writing, and I'll keep A GAL out of UKR and RUM's neighbours, and keep A BUD and A SER off Russian ground.

Austria here. Our pact on VIE, TRI and BUD still holds. Russia has moved onto RUM, and our A GAL is exposed. Tell me your Fall orders for WAR and SIL. If you press Russia, Austria will not block you, but I need your word that no German unit enters BOH or MUN toward GAL.

England here, Fall 1923. My fleets hold NTH, NWG, LON, EDI, LVP, ENG and BEL stays home. I'm not moving toward DEN, KIE or HOL. Please confirm A DEN, A KIE, A MUN and A BER hold this autumn, with no entry into BEL, HOL, NTH or NOR. I'll warn you first of any change in the north.

England, Fall 1923. My fleets at STP, NOR, NTH and LVP stay out of the Baltic and Sweden. Please confirm F SWE holds and stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI, and A WAR does not move toward Prussia or Germany. What are your Fall orders for SWE, WAR and SEV? I'll tell you first of any northern change.

England, Fall 1923. F NTH, F LON, F LVP, F EDI and A BEL hold, with no move toward Picardy, Burgundy or Paris. F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel. Please confirm A BRE, A PAR, A MAR and A POR hold this Fall. I'll give notice before any change near Spain or Portugal.

France, Fall 1923. A PAR, A MAR, A BRE and A POR all hold this autumn, so no move toward MUN or BUR. Please confirm A MUN holds too. If Germany's eastern front pulls A MUN away, I want to talk first about a joint arrangement on Munich and Burgundy.

France, Fall 1923. My A BRE, A PAR, A MAR, A POR and F MAO all hold this autumn, with no move into Belgium, Picardy or the Channel. Please confirm F NTH, F LON, F LVP, F EDI and A BEL hold too, with no move toward Picardy, Burgundy or Paris. I will give notice before any change.

Germany here, Fall 1923. My A SIL is adjacent to WAR and I am considering an attack on WAR. Before I decide, tell me your A WAR, F SWE, F SEV and A RUM orders. If WAR stays with you and your fleets stay out of BAL and BER, I may hold SIL this turn. I will not move into Russian land without warning.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1923: Our truce stands while your A CON, A SMY and F BLA stay out of BUL and GRE. My F AEG stays out of SMY and CON and F ION stays out of GRE. I am holding BUL with F AEG support. Tell me your Fall orders now, and confirm you will not move on BUL or GRE this turn.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1923: Our pact stands. My F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS hold and will not enter TRI, SER or BUD. Please confirm A RUM is gone and that A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A GAL stay out of BUL, GRE and ALB this Fall. Send your written Fall orders.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1923: A RUM is now ours after the spring fight, and I won't pretend otherwise. I propose we stop here. Russia stays out of BUD, SER, VIE and TRI, and you keep A GAL, A BUD and A SER out of RUM, UKR and WAR. Tell me your Fall orders for GAL, BUD and VIE.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1923: F SEV holds this Fall, and I will not enter BLA, ARM, ANK, CON, SMY or BUL. Keep F BLA and your armies off SEV, UKR and RUM. I am watching Austria in the west and need your word on the Black Sea.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1923: Tell me in writing whether A BUL and F AEG move this Fall. The truce holds only while F AEG stays out of SMY and CON and F ION stays out of GRE. I will keep A CON, A SMY and F BLA off GRE, but I am reassessing BUL if A BUL leaves.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1923: Please confirm your Fall orders in writing, including whether F SEV and A UKR move toward RUM. I am keeping A CON, A SMY and F BLA off SEV, UKR and WAR. Austria's RUM is the target we share, so let us coordinate the attack.

Austria here. Our pact stands. A GAL, A SER, A BUD and F TRI will not enter BUL, GRE or ALB this Fall, and we will keep out of those areas while you keep F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS off TRI, SER and BUD. Any breach ends it at once. My written Fall orders will follow.

Austria here. RUM is Austrian ground and we will not accept it as a Russian gain. Withdraw A RUM to UKR this Fall and keep F SEV out of the Rumanian coast, and we will not push into UKR or WAR. Refuse, and we will fight for RUM. Tell me your answer in writing.

England here, Fall 1923. Confirmed: F NTH, F LON, F LVP, F EDI and A BEL hold this autumn, with no move toward Picardy, Burgundy, Paris or the Channel. F MAO must stay in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. Your A BRE, A PAR, A MAR and A POR holding suits us both. I will give notice before any change near Spain or Portugal.

France here, Fall 1923. Confirmed: A BRE, A PAR, A MAR, A POR and F MAO all hold this autumn, with no move into Belgium, Picardy, Burgundy, the Channel, English waters, LVP or EDI. Please keep F NTH, F LON, F LVP, F EDI and A BEL holding too. I will give you notice before any change near Spain or Portugal.

Germany here. Our pact on VIE, TRI and BUD stands. No German unit enters VIE, TRI or BUD. A MUN holds this Fall and will not enter BOH. My A SIL is pressing Russia at WAR, and I will not move toward GAL. Keep your units out of MUN and BOH as agreed.

Germany here. A DEN, A KIE and A MUN hold this Fall. None of my units enters BEL, HOL, NTH or NOR. My A SIL is operating against Russia in the east, not the north. Please keep your fleets out of DEN, KIE and Prussia's coast, and I will warn you first of any change.

Germany here. A MUN holds this Fall and will not move to BUR, RUH or PAR. I have no plans against MAR or your western armies. Please keep A PAR, A MAR, A BRE and A POR out of MUN and BUR as well. If the western border stays quiet, we can speak again in 1924.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1923: My orders are A BUL hold, F AEG hold, F ION hold. F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, and F ION stays out of GRE. I am holding BUL with F AEG support. I cannot promise more than that. Your A CON, A SMY and F BLA must stay out of BUL and GRE this Fall. If you move on BUL, the truce ends.

Russia to England, Fall 1923: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR holds and is not moving toward Prussia or Germany. F SEV holds in the Black Sea. Please keep your fleets at STP, NOR, NTH and LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden as agreed.

Russia to Austria: A RUM stays where it is this Fall. I will not move it to UKR. Russia keeps out of BUD, SER, VIE and TRI. Your A GAL must not enter RUM, UKR or WAR. If you keep to that, we can both hold our centres and look elsewhere.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1923: A WAR holds and F SWE holds in Sweden. Neither enters SIL, PRU, BER, DEN, KIE or BAL. F SEV holds and A RUM holds. I am not moving into German land. Please keep A SIL off WAR and keep your fleets out of the Baltic. Austria is the real target.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1923: F SEV holds this Fall. I will not enter BLA, ARM, ANK, CON, SMY or BUL. A RUM holds and is not moving toward UKR. Keep F BLA and your armies off SEV, UKR and RUM. Please confirm you will hold your current positions too.

Italy, Turkey here. This Fall A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold, with no move into BUL or GRE. Your F AEG must stay out of SMY and CON and F ION out of GRE. If A BUL leaves Bulgaria or F AEG moves toward the Aegean coast of Turkey, I will reassess the truce at once. Confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Russia, Turkey here. A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold this Fall, and none enters SEV, UKR, WAR or RUM. Keep F SEV out of BLA and your armies out of ARM, ANK and CON. Austria's RUM is the shared target. Send your Fall orders in writing, including whether A UKR or F SEV moves toward RUM.

notes.note: Fall 1923: A RUM holds to keep the centre; F SEV supports RUM holding against Austria. SWE and WAR hold to keep promises to England and Germany. Austria rejected truce, so watch GAL/BUD/SER. Turkey has kept word so far; keep SEV defended.

Fall 1923: holding all 5 SCs (BRE MAR PAR POR SPA). No unowned SCs exist. England and Germany have kept deals so far (no moves into Picardy/Burgundy/Paris/MUN). Revisit if unowned centres appear, A MUN vacates, or a deal breaks. Possible later: BRE via MAO to ENG convoy.

Fall 1923: all holds for peace. No unowned centers reachable. France, Germany, Russia kept word. Germany's A SIL is attacking Russia, not us. Watch Russia's SWE/WAR and Germany's north. Convoy plans only if Germany breaks its word.

Fall 1923: all hold, keeping pacts with Turkey, Austria, Russia. No unowned centers. Turkey's truce is conditional and it is reassessing BUL. Watch for Turkish moves on BUL/GRE. If CON/SMY weaken, strike with AEG and BUL. Keep ION off TRI/SER/BUD.

Fall 1923: all hold. No support exists for SIL-WAR, and WAR holds, so an attack would bounce. Keep pacts: no German unit into VIE/TRI/BUD, no entry into BEL/HOL/NTH/NOR, keep BOH/MUN clear for Austria. Russia (WAR, SWE) and England have kept pledges. Revisit WAR when a support is available.

Fall 1923: GAL to RUM, supported by BUD and SER, to retake RUM (3 vs max 2 Russian defense). Keep BUD, SER, TRI, VIE on their centres. Pacts: Italy (no TRI/SER/BUD entry; we stay out of BUL/GRE/ALB), Germany (no VIE/TRI/BUD entry; no BOH/MUN by us), Russia broke trust by holding RUM. Check results and Russian WAR/SEV moves next turn.

Fall 1923: holding all units. Attacking BUL would bounce (A BUL + F AEG support) and break the Italy truce. Russia holds SEV and keeps out of BLA, ARM, ANK, CON, SMY, BUL. Italy keeps F AEG out of SMY/CON and F ION out of GRE. Next: strike BUL only if A BUL leaves or F AEG moves; otherwise keep the truce.

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1924. Your A RUM retreated to UKR, so RUM is ours again. Please confirm in writing that A UKR and F SEV will not enter RUM, SER, BUD or GAL this spring. We will keep A RUM, A BUD and A SER off Russian ground if you do the same.

Austria here, Spring 1924. Our pact on VIE, TRI and BUD still stands. Please tell me your Spring orders for WAR and SIL, and confirm no German unit enters BOH or MUN toward GAL or VIE. Austria will hold VIE, TRI and BUD and keep off Russian ground.

Austria here, Spring 1924. Our pact stands. Please confirm your F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS will stay off TRI, SER and BUD this spring. We will keep A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI out of BUL, GRE and ALB. Tell me your plans for Turkey or Greece.

England, Spring 1924. My fleets hold NTH, NWG, NOR, LON, EDI, LVP and ENG, with none moving into DEN, KIE, BEL or HOL. Please confirm A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN hold this spring, and tell me before any change in the north or Baltic.

England, Spring 1924. I keep STP, NOR, NTH and LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden. Please confirm F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI, and A WAR does not move toward Prussia or Germany. What are your Spring orders for SWE, WAR and SEV?

England, Spring 1924. My fleets stay in the North Sea, Channel and Atlantic, with no move toward Picardy, Burgundy, Paris, Spain or Portugal. Please confirm your A BRE, A PAR, A MAR, A POR and F MAO hold this spring, and give me notice before any change near the Channel.

France, Spring 1924. England leads with 7 centres and is the threat to us both. I will hold A PAR, A MAR, A BRE and A POR this spring. If A MUN moves east in a later season, I would like to discuss taking Burgundy and Munich together. Please tell me your Spring 1924 orders first.

Germany here, Spring 1924. My A SIL is adjacent to WAR and I may attack it this year. Tell me your A WAR, F SWE and A RUM orders now. If WAR moves out or holds without support for you, I will keep A SIL out of WAR and stay clear of your northern coast.

Germany here, Spring 1924. Our pact on VIE, TRI and BUD stands, and A MUN will not enter BOH. Tell me your Spring orders for VIE, BUD, TRI, RUM and SER. I am watching Russia at WAR and RUM, and I want to hear your plans before they lock.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1924: Our truce holds while your A CON, A SMY and F BLA stay out of BUL and GRE. My A BUL holds and F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, F ION stays out of GRE. Tell me your Spring orders now, and whether you plan any move toward Bulgaria or Greece this year.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1924: Our pact stands. My F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS will not enter TRI, SER or BUD while A RUM, A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A GAL stay out of BUL, GRE and ALB. Please send your written Spring orders so we can confirm them.

Italy to Russia, Spring 1924: Our understanding stands. My F ION, A ROM and A VEN will not enter RUM or UKR. Please confirm F SEV, A UKR and A WAR stay out of the Aegean, Mediterranean, BUL and GRE this Spring, and tell me your Spring orders.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1924: F SEV and A UKR will hold this Spring and stay out of BLA, ARM, ANK, CON, SMY and BUL. Please keep F BLA and your armies off SEV, UKR and RUM. Tell me your Spring orders, and whether you will move against Austria's Balkan centres.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1924: A WAR and F SWE hold again this Spring and stay out of SIL, PRU, BER, DEN, KIE and BAL. Austria is our shared target. Tell me your A SIL and A MUN orders, and whether you will press VIE and BOH while I take GAL and RUM.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1924: I see no profit in another costly fight over RUM. Let us agree that A UKR, F SEV and A WAR hold and do not enter RUM, GAL or BUD. Confirm your A RUM and A GAL orders in writing, and tell me whether you will keep your fleets away from Russian waters.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1924: Our truce has held, but Turkey needs growth. Tell me in writing whether A BUL and F AEG stay home this Spring. If A BUL withdraws or F AEG moves toward SMY or CON, I will act against Bulgaria at once. I will keep A CON, A SMY and F BLA out of GRE while the truce stands.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1924: Your army has retreated to UKR, so Austria's RUM is open. I propose F BLA to RUM this Spring while your A UKR and F SEV take the Rumanian land. Confirm in writing whether you will move against RUM. My A CON and A SMY stay off SEV, UKR and WAR.

Austria here, Spring 1924. Our pact stands: no Austrian unit enters BOH or MUN, and we hold VIE, TRI and BUD. Our spring orders are holds in VIE, BUD and TRI, with A RUM and A SER holding too. Please keep your units out of VIE, TRI, BUD and GAL, and tell me your Fall plans for WAR before they lock.

Austria here, Spring 1924. Our pact stands. A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI hold this spring and will not enter BUL, GRE or ALB. Please confirm F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS hold off TRI, SER and BUD. Any breach by either side ends the pact at once.

Austria here. I accept no Russian claim to RUM, but I will hold A RUM this spring and keep it off UKR and GAL if A UKR, F SEV and A WAR do not enter RUM, GAL or BUD. Confirm that in writing. Russian fleets stay out of the Rumanian coast, and we will keep A BUD and A SER off Russian ground.

France here, Spring 1924. Confirmed: A BRE, A PAR, A MAR and A POR hold this spring, and F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I have no move toward Picardy, Burgundy, Belgium or the Channel. I will give you notice before any change near the Channel, and I expect the same from you.
Germany confirms Spring 1924: A MUN holds and will not enter BOH. A SIL holds too. No German unit enters VIE, TRI or BUD, and our pact stands. I will warn you before any change toward GAL or VIE.

Germany confirms Spring 1924: A DEN, A KIE and A MUN hold. None enters BEL, HOL, NTH or NOR. I expect your fleets to stay out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic. I will warn you first of any change in the north.

Germany confirms Spring 1924: A SIL holds, and A MUN holds. Neither enters Russian land this spring. I have no attack on WAR planned now. Keep your fleets out of BAL and the German coast, and we stay at peace for now.

Germany confirms Spring 1924: A MUN holds and will not move to BUR or RUH. I have no move toward PAR, MAR or your western armies. Please keep A PAR, A MAR, A BRE and A POR out of MUN and BUR. We can talk again in Fall.

Italy confirms Spring 1924: F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS hold, and none will enter TRI, SER or BUD while A RUM, A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A GAL stay out of BUL, GRE and ALB. Any breach by either side ends the pact at once. My written orders are holds across the board this Spring.

Italy to Turkey: This Spring A BUL holds, F AEG holds, and F ION holds. F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, and F ION stays out of GRE. Our truce stands while A CON, A SMY and F BLA stay out of BUL and GRE. Any move toward those areas by either side ends it. I have no plans against Bulgaria this Spring.

Russia here. A UKR, F SEV and A WAR hold this Spring and will not enter RUM, GAL or BUD. Your A RUM holds in RUM and I will not contest it this turn. Keep A GAL out of WAR and UKR, and keep your fleets out of Russian waters, and we stay at peace.

Russia here. F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR holds and is not moving toward Prussia or Germany. F SEV holds in the Black Sea. Keep STP, NOR, NTH and LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden, as agreed, and I will tell you first of any change.

Russia here. A WAR holds this Spring and F SWE holds in Sweden. Neither enters SIL, PRU, BER, DEN, KIE or BAL. If A SIL moves into WAR, I will defend it. Keep A SIL off WAR and your fleets out of the Baltic, and press Austria at VIE and BOH as planned.

Russia confirms: F SEV holds, A UKR holds, and A WAR holds this Spring. None of them enters the Aegean, Mediterranean, BUL or GRE. Please keep F ION, F AEG and A ROM out of RUM and UKR as agreed. We stay on our own fronts.

Russia here. F BLA cannot enter RUM, since Rumania is landlocked, so that proposal is impossible. F SEV and A UKR hold this Spring and will not enter BLA, ARM, ANK, CON, SMY or BUL. Keep your armies and F BLA off SEV, UKR and WAR, and we can both hold.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1924: The truce stands for now. A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold this Spring, with no move into BUL or GRE. Keep F AEG out of SMY and CON and F ION out of GRE. I am not moving on BUL this Spring, but I will reassess if A BUL leaves or F AEG moves toward my coast.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1924: I have not decided on F BLA to RUM this Spring, so do not count on it. A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold. Send your written orders for A RUM, A UKR and F SEV, and tell me whether Russia will move against RUM this Fall. Keep your armies off ARM, ANK and CON.

notes.note: Spring 1924: all hold, keeping 5 SCs (BRE MAR PAR POR SPA). No unowned SCs; any move breaks England or Germany deals. England and Germany have kept deals so far. Revisit if unowned centres appear, MUN vacates, or a deal breaks. Possible later: BRE via MAO to ENG convoy.

Spring 1924: holding all per pacts. Turkey truce (AEG out of SMY/CON, ION out of GRE; Turkey out of BUL/GRE), Austria (no TRI/SER/BUD entry), Russia (no RUM/UKR). All have kept terms so far. Next: if Turkey weakens, strike SMY/CON with AEG and BUL; consider TRI if Austria breaks pact.

Spring 1924: all hold, keeping promises to Austria (no RUM/GAL/BUD), Germany (no SIL/PRU/BER/DEN/KIE/BAL), England (SWE out of NWG/NOR/NTH/EDI) and Italy/Turkey (no Balkan/Black Sea incursions). Austria's RUM is still a target if they break terms. Watch Turkey BLA and Germany's A SIL.

Spring 1924: holding for peace; no unowned centers. France, Germany, Russia kept word. Watch Germany's DEN/KIE and Russia's SWE. Consider convoy BEL->DEN via NTH/ENG only if Germany weakens or breaks word.

Spring 1924: all hold, keeping pacts with Austria (no entry to BOH/MUN/VIE/TRI/BUD), England (no entry to BEL/HOL/NTH/NOR) and Russia (SIL off WAR). Germany is at 4 SCs and must grow: look for a Fall 1924 WAR attack with support, or a west/Ruhr move if France or England breaks pacts. Watch Russia's WAR/SWE.

Spring 1924: all hold to keep 5 SCs (BUD RUM SER TRI VIE). Pacts: Italy (no TRI/SER/BUD entry by them; we stay out of BUL/GRE/ALB), Germany (no VIE/TRI/BUD entry; no BOH/MUN by us), Russia (UKR/SEV/WAR not into RUM/GAL/BUD; RUM holds). Watch Russian UKR attack on RUM and any Italian or German breach. Reassess Fall 1924.

Spring 1924: holding all units. Truces: Italy (no BUL/GRE entry; F AEG out of SMY/CON; F ION out of GRE) and Russia (no BLA/ARM/ANK/CON/SMY/BUL entry). Russia says F BLA cannot enter RUM (landlocked). No unowned centers reachable. Next: watch A BUL and F AEG; strike BUL if Italy breaks truce or A BUL leaves. Consider F BLA to SEV only if Russia's F SEV vacates.

messages.body: Austria here, Fall 1924. Our Spring agreement stands: I hold A RUM, A BUD, A SER, F TRI and A VIE this autumn. Please confirm A UKR, F SEV and A WAR hold and do not enter RUM, GAL or BUD. Tell me your Fall orders for WAR and SEV in writing before they lock, so we stay at peace.

Austria here, Fall 1924. Our pact stands. I will keep A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI out of BUL, GRE and ALB. Please confirm F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS stay off TRI, SER and BUD this autumn. Tell me your Fall orders in writing so we can both check them.

Austria here, Fall 1924. Our pact on VIE, TRI and BUD still stands, and no Austrian unit will enter BOH or MUN. Please confirm A MUN and A SIL do not enter VIE, TRI, BUD or GAL this Fall. Tell me your Fall orders for SIL and MUN before they lock.

England, Fall 1924. My fleets hold NTH, NWG, NOR, LON, EDI, LVP and ENG this autumn, with none moving into DEN, KIE, BEL or HOL. Please confirm A DEN, A KIE, A MUN and A BER hold, and tell me before any change to your northern or Baltic plans for 1925.

England, Fall 1924. My fleets at STP, NOR, NTH and LVP stay out of the Baltic and Sweden this autumn. Please confirm F SWE holds and stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI, and that A WAR does not move toward Prussia or Germany. I will warn you before any northern change.

England, Fall 1924. My fleets hold in the North Sea, Channel and Atlantic, with no move toward Picardy, Burgundy, Paris, Spain or Portugal. Please confirm A BRE, A PAR, A MAR, A POR and F MAO hold, with F MAO staying out of the Channel and English waters. I will give notice before any change.

France, Fall 1924. I hold A PAR, A MAR, A BRE and A POR, and I will not move toward MUN or BUR this autumn. If your eastern front pulls A MUN away in a later season, let's agree in advance how Munich and Burgundy are split. Please tell me your Fall 1924 orders first.

France, Fall 1924. My western armies hold, with no move toward Tunis, the Gulf of Lyon or Piedmont. Austria's Balkan and Tyrolean positions are the natural target for you, not my coast. Please send your Fall 1924 orders first, and keep F TYS and F ION out of Spain and Portugal.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1924: My A SIL stays put this turn and does not enter WAR. Tell me your A WAR, F SWE and F SEV orders. If Russia keeps WAR and the Baltic quiet, I will hold, and we can coordinate against Austria's Galicia and Bohemia later.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1924: Our pact on VIE, TRI and BUD stands, and A MUN and A SIL hold this turn. Russia is pressing you in GAL and RUM. Tell me your Fall plans now, and whether Austria will keep BOH and MUN closed to every power other than Germany.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1924: Our truce stands while A CON, A SMY and F BLA stay out of BUL and GRE. My A BUL holds, F AEG stays out of SMY and CON, and F ION stays out of GRE. Tell me your Fall orders in writing, and confirm you will not move on Bulgaria this Fall.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1924: Our pact stands. My F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS hold and will not enter TRI, SER or BUD. Please confirm A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI stay out of BUL, GRE and ALB this Fall, and send your written Fall orders.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1924: A WAR and F SWE hold this Fall and stay out of SIL, PRU, BER, DEN, KIE and BAL. Please confirm A SIL will not enter WAR. If it does, I will defend WAR. Tell me your Fall orders for SIL and MUN. I am willing to keep our northern border quiet while we both face Austria.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1924: Our RUM dispute has cost us both. A UKR, F SEV and A WAR hold this Fall and will not enter RUM, GAL or BUD. Confirm in writing that A RUM, A BUD, A SER and A VIE stay off UKR, WAR and SEV. Tell me whether A RUM or A VIE moves this Fall.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1924: F SEV and A UKR hold this Fall. I will not enter BLA, ARM, ANK, CON, SMY or BUL. Please confirm F BLA stays out of SEV and UKR and your armies stay off RUM and WAR. Tell me your Fall orders for A CON and A SMY so we both keep our positions.

Turkey here. Turkey needs Bulgaria to survive. This Fall I will attack A BUL with F BLA and A CON, with A SMY supporting. Your truce ends now. If you pull A BUL out or move F AEG toward SMY or CON, tell me before Fall orders, and we can talk about Greece instead.

Turkey to Russia: I am moving on Bulgaria this Fall, so my F BLA and A CON leave SEV, UKR and WAR alone. Keep F SEV and A UKR out of BLA, ARM, ANK and CON. Hold SEV and we stay at peace. Tell me your Fall orders in writing.

Turkey to Austria: Italy's BUL is my target this Fall, not your Balkan centres. Please keep A RUM, A SER and A BUD out of BUL and GRE, and keep your armies out of the Black Sea coast. In return, Turkey will not enter RUM or SER while our agreement stands.

Austria confirms Fall 1924: A VIE, A BUD, F TRI, A RUM and A SER all hold. No Austrian unit enters BOH or MUN. Our pact stands, and I expect no German unit to enter VIE, TRI or BUD. Keep A MUN and A SIL out of GAL, as you agreed.

Austria confirms Fall 1924: A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI hold and will not enter BUL, GRE or ALB. Please keep F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS off TRI, SER and BUD. Any breach by either side ends the pact at once.

Austria here. A RUM, A BUD, A SER and A VIE all hold this Fall and will not move to UKR, WAR or SEV. Confirm that A UKR, F SEV and A WAR stay out of RUM, GAL and BUD. Keep your fleets out of the Rumanian coast, and we stay at peace.

Austria agrees: A RUM, A SER and A BUD hold and will not enter BUL or GRE. Please keep A CON and A SMY out of SER and RUM as agreed, and keep F BLA off the Rumanian coast. Pressure on Italy's BUL is your affair, and Austria will not contest the Black Sea.

France to England, Fall 1924: Confirmed. A BRE, A PAR, A MAR, A POR hold this fall, and F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel, English waters, LVP and EDI. I will give you notice before any change near the Channel, Spain or Portugal. Please keep your fleets in the North Sea and Channel off Picardy and Burgundy as agreed.

Germany to England, Fall 1924: A DEN, A KIE and A MUN hold this autumn. I have no fleets in the north, and no German unit enters BEL, HOL, NTH or NOR. BER is currently empty, so I cannot hold it. I will warn you before any change in the north or Baltic for 1925, and I ask the same of your fleets toward DEN and KIE.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1924: A MUN and A SIL hold this Fall, and neither enters VIE, TRI, BUD or GAL. Our pact on VIE, TRI and BUD stands. Please keep your units out of BOH and MUN as agreed. I will tell you before any change to my plans for 1925.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1924: A SIL holds this turn and will not enter WAR. I have no fleets in the Baltic and none move toward BAL. Please keep A WAR and F SWE out of SIL, PRU, BER, DEN and KIE. If we both stay disciplined, we can face Austria and England later. Tell me your F SEV and A RUM plans.

Germany to France, Fall 1924: A MUN holds this Fall and will not move to BUR or RUH. Please keep A PAR, A MAR, A BRE and A POR out of MUN and BUR as well. I cannot promise how Munich will be divided, since my eastern plans are still open. We can speak again next year, before any change in the west.

Italy here. Our pact stands. My F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS hold this Fall and will not enter TRI, SER or BUD. Please keep A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI out of BUL, GRE and ALB. Any breach ends the pact at once.

Italy to France: Our F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS hold this Fall. None of them moves toward Spain, Portugal, the Gulf of Lyon, Piedmont or Tunis. Please keep MAO, MAR and your western armies away from Tunis and Italian soil, and tell me if your plans change.

Italy to Turkey: If you attack A BUL, you break the truce and face my A BUL and F AEG defending Bulgaria. I hold this Fall: A BUL holds, F AEG holds, F ION holds. Stay out of BUL and GRE and I will stay out of SMY and CON. Attack, and we fight.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1924: A UKR, F SEV and A WAR hold this Fall and will not enter RUM, GAL or BUD. I expect A RUM, A BUD, A SER and A VIE to stay off UKR, WAR and SEV. A RUM and A VIE are yours to move as you choose, but any move toward UKR or WAR ends our truce.

Russia to England, Fall 1924: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR holds and is not moving toward Prussia or Germany. Keep STP, NOR, NTH and LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden as agreed, and warn me before any northern change.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1924: A WAR and F SWE hold this Fall and stay out of SIL, PRU, BER, DEN, KIE and BAL. If A SIL enters WAR, I will defend it. Keep your fleets out of the Baltic. Tell me if MUN or SIL plans to move against Austria's BOH or GAL, so we can coordinate.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1924: F SEV and A UKR hold this Fall. We will not enter BLA, ARM, ANK, CON, SMY or BUL. Good luck against Bulgaria. Keep F BLA and your armies off SEV, UKR and WAR, and we both stay at peace in the Black Sea.

Turkey here. The truce is over. This Fall A CON and F BLA attack Bulgaria with A SMY in support. If A BUL and F AEG stay in place, you will meet real force. Withdraw A BUL now and I will offer Greece to you instead, with F AEG kept well away from SMY and CON.

Turkey to Russia: As I said, I am attacking Bulgaria this Fall with A CON, F BLA and A SMY. None of my units enters SEV, UKR, WAR or RUM. Please hold F SEV and A UKR, keep out of BLA, ARM, ANK and CON, and tell me your Fall orders in writing so we avoid a misunderstanding.

notes.note: Fall 1924: holding all 5 SCs (BRE MAR PAR POR SPA). No unowned SCs, so no reachable gains without breaking England/Germany deals. England and Germany kept deals so far; Germany holds MUN. Italy asks us to keep away from Tunis and Italian soil; we have kept that. Revisit if unowned centres appear or a deal breaks.

Fall 1924: all hold to keep promises to Austria (no RUM/GAL/BUD), Germany (no SIL/PRU/BER/DEN/KIE/BAL), England (SWE out of NWG/NOR/NTH/EDI), Turkey (SEV holds, no BLA/ARM/CON/SMY). Attacking RUM would bounce vs BUD/SER support. Watch Austria RUM/VIE and Turkey BLA. Austria and Germany kept word so far; Italy and Turkey broke Balkan terms before. Reconsider RUM attack if Austrian support weakens.

Fall 1924: all hold to keep 5 SCs (BUD RUM SER TRI VIE). Pacts: Italy (no TRI/SER/BUD entry by them; we stay out of BUL/GRE/ALB), Germany (no VIE/TRI/BUD entry; no BOH/MUN by us), Russia (no UKR/WAR/SEV entry by us; RUM/GAL/BUD closed to them), Turkey (no RUM/SER entry). Watch Russian UKR and Italian breaches. Reassess Spring 1925.

Fall 1924: all hold to keep pacts. Austria: no entry to BOH/MUN/VIE/TRI/BUD/GAL. England: no entry to BEL/HOL/NTH/NOR. Russia: SIL stays off WAR, no Baltic fleets. France: MUN not to BUR/RUH. Holding BER empty is safe since no rival can reach it. Watch for any broken pact; reconsider a WAR attack only with support.

Turkey broke truce, attacking BUL (CON+BLA, SMY support). AEG supports BUL hold; 2v2 tie holds. Austria pact and Russia pact: keep TRI/SER/BUD and RUM/UKR off limits. Watch Turkey on GRE; hold posture this turn.

Fall 1924: no unowned centers, so holding all for peace this turn. France, Germany and Russia have kept word. Watch Germany's BER (empty) and Russia's SWE. Attack only if a rival breaks its pledges; otherwise plan a BEL->DEN convoy via NTH/ENG.

Fall 1924: attacking BUL with F BLA (to BUL/EAST) supported by A CON; A SMY holds. Expect a bounce vs A BUL + F AEG. Italy truce ended. Russia (SEV, UKR) and Austria (RUM, SER, BUD) agreed to stay out of Black Sea/BUL. Revisit GRE if BUL stays defended.

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1925. A RUM, A BUD, A SER and A VIE hold this spring and will not enter UKR, WAR or SEV. I need the same from you: A UKR, F SEV and A WAR must not enter RUM, GAL or BUD. Confirm in writing and tell me your Spring orders for UKR, WAR and SEV.

Austria here, Spring 1925. Our pact stands. A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI hold and stay out of BUL, GRE and ALB. Please confirm F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS stay off TRI, SER and BUD this spring, and send your written Spring orders for BUL and GRE.

England, Spring 1925. Your BER is empty and your DEN, KIE and MUN are exposed to Russia's SWE and WAR. Please confirm your units hold and none enter BEL, HOL, NTH or NOR. My fleets stay out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic. Tell me first if your plans change.

England, Spring 1925. My fleets at STP, NOR, NTH and LVP stay out of the Baltic and Sweden. Please confirm F SWE and A WAR hold this spring and do not move toward Norway, Prussia or Germany. Tell me first of any northern change in your plans.

England, Spring 1925. My fleets stay in the North Sea, Channel and Atlantic, away from Picardy, Burgundy, Paris, Spain and Portugal. Please confirm A BRE, A PAR, A MAR, A POR and F MAO hold, with F MAO out of the Channel and English waters. I will give notice before any change.

France, Spring 1925. England leads with 7 centres and is the real threat to us both. I hold A PAR, A MAR, A BRE and A POR this spring. I propose we discuss a joint plan against England: you keep A MUN and your north quiet, and I will move on Belgium only if England attacks your side. Which Spring orders are you planning?

Germany, Spring 1925. A SIL holds this spring and will not enter WAR. BER is empty, and I will not leave it open to you. Please confirm A WAR and F SWE do not move toward BER, DEN, KIE or BAL this season. Tell me your Spring orders for WAR, SWE and SEV before they lock.

Germany, Spring 1925. A MUN holds and will not enter BOH or GAL. Our pact on VIE, TRI and BUD stands. Tell me your Spring orders, especially any move toward BOH or MUN, and whether Russian pressure on GAL and RUM is still building.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1925: Your Fall attack on A BUL failed to take it, and I will keep A BUL and F AEG in place. Pulling your fleet and army back from BUL this Spring stops the bloodshed. I will keep F ION out of Greek waters and stay clear of SMY and CON while your units stay off BUL and GRE. Tell me your Spring orders.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1925: Our pact stands on my side: F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS will not enter TRI, SER or BUD. I expect A RUM, A SER, A BUD and F TRI to stay out of BUL, GRE and ALB this Spring. Confirm your Spring orders in writing so we can both check them.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1927: If RUM falls, I want SER for Turkey with A CON moving through BUL once Italy is weakened, and BUD goes to you. Please keep F SEV out of BLA and CON, and confirm your Fall orders for WAR and UKR in writing so we avoid bounces.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1927: Your A SER and A BUD are the only units able to pressure Italy's BUL and GRE. I propose you lift the no-BUL/GRE clause this Fall and attack Italy with me. In return Turkey keeps A CON and A SMY away from your RUM, SER and BUD.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1927: Our truce has held, but Austria and Russia are both pressing me. Confirm in writing that A BUL and F AEG will hold this Fall and that F AEG stays off SMY and CON. If you want a future split, Turkey is open to talking about Tunis and the western Med in exchange.

Austria confirms Fall 1927: A RUM, A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI all hold. None enters BUL, GRE or ALB. We expect F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS to stay off TRI, SER and BUD. Any breach by either side ends our pact at once.

Austria here. I see A UKR, F SEV, A WAR and F SWE, so I take it GAL has withdrawn. Our Fall orders are holds on RUM, SER, BUD, VIE and TRI. We will not enter UKR, WAR, SEV or GAL. Keep A UKR out of RUM, BUD and SER, and we will keep the peace.

Austria to Germany, Fall 1927: A BUD, A RUM, A SER, A VIE and F TRI all hold. No Austrian unit enters BOH or MUN, and I expect none of yours to enter VIE, TRI or BUD. Our pact stands. Russia's pressure on RUM is ours to hold, and I will hold it.

Austria cannot lift the no-BUL/GRE clause this Fall. A RUM, A SER and A BUD hold, as agreed. Our units are needed to defend against Russia on RUM. Keep A CON and A SMY out of SER and RUM, and keep F BLA off the Rumanian coast. Let us talk again in Spring.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1927: A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN all hold this autumn. None of my units enters WAR, SWE, GAL or the Baltic. I expect the same from you: A WAR and F SWE must stay out of BER, DEN, KIE and the Baltic. Any move there ends our pact, so keep your word and we can both focus on Austria.

Germany to England, Fall 1927: A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN hold. No German unit enters BEL, HOL, NTH, NOR or the North Sea this autumn. I ask that your fleets stay out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic. I will warn you before any northern change. Your Russian targets are your own business.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1927: Our pact stands. My Fall orders are F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS holding, none entering TRI, SER or BUD. Keep A BUD, A RUM, A SER, A VIE and F TRI out of BUL, GRE and ALB. Any breach ends it at once.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1927: I will not move into RUM, SER or BUD this autumn, and A UKR, A WAR and F SEV hold. Keep your armies out of UKR, WAR, SEV and GAL and we stay at peace. Pull A RUM back from our border if you want that to last into 1928.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1927: A WAR and F SWE hold this autumn. I will not enter BER, DEN, KIE, BOH or SIL. Keep your units out of WAR, SWE and GAL in return. Please confirm MUN and VIE stay on Austria, not on Russian ground.

Russia to England, Fall 1927: F SWE holds and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR and A UKR hold on our southern front, aimed at Austria, not you. Keep STP, NOR, NTH and LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden, and warn me before any northern change.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1927: In writing: F SEV holds and will not enter BLA, ARM, ANK, CON, SMY or BUL. A UKR and A WAR hold this autumn, and neither enters RUM or the Balkans. Keep F BLA out of SEV and your armies out of UKR and WAR. SER and BUD can be discussed after RUM falls.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1927: A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold this Fall, with nothing entering BUL or GRE. Please keep A BUL and F AEG in place and F AEG away from SMY and CON. Tunis and the western Med remain open for a future split. Any move against Greece or our fleets ends the truce.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1927: A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold this Fall, with no entry into SEV, UKR, WAR or RUM. Please keep F SEV out of BLA and CON, and confirm F SEV holds. Once RUM falls, I want SER and A CON through BUL later, with BUD for you as agreed. Confirm your WAR and UKR orders in writing.

Fall 1927: UKR to RUM supported by SEV, since Austrian RUM holds with no support. Taking RUM gives 5 SC. WAR and SWE hold to keep Germany and England terms. messages.body: Austria, Spring 1928: Your A UKR, F SEV and A WAR are massed against RUM. I will hold RUM, SER, BUD and VIE and will not enter UKR, WAR, SEV or GAL. Please keep A UKR out of RUM this spring. A move into RUM will be met with force. Tell me your Spring orders in writing.

Austria, Spring 1928: My RUM must hold against Russia's A UKR, so I cannot spare units against Italy this spring. Keep A CON and A SMY out of SER and RUM as agreed. If Turkey presses Italy's BUL from the south, Austria may join in Fall once RUM is secure. What are your Spring orders?

Austria, Spring 1928: Our pact still stands. Please confirm F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS will not enter TRI, SER or BUD this spring. Austria's A BUD, A RUM, A SER, A VIE and F TRI hold and will not enter BUL, GRE or ALB. Send your Spring orders in writing.

England to France, Spring 1928: Please confirm A BRE, A PAR, A MAR, A POR and F MAO hold this spring, with F MAO out of the Channel and English waters. A BEL holds and stays off Picardy and Burgundy. I will give notice before any change near Spain or Portugal.

France to Germany, Spring 1928: My armies hold this spring: A PAR, A MAR, A BRE, A POR and F MAO. England leads with 7 centres, and Germany and France are both stuck at 4 and 5. Are you willing to plan a joint move on England's Belgium and Holland in 1928-29? Please tell me your Spring 1928 orders and whether A MUN stays put.

France to Italy, Spring 1928: My units hold this spring: A BRE, A PAR, A MAR, A POR and F MAO. None moves toward Tunis, the Gulf of Lyon or Italian soil. Please confirm that F TYS, F ION and A ROM stay away from Spain, Portugal and the western Mediterranean this year, and tell me your Spring 1928 orders.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1928: My A SIL and A BER hold this spring, and A DEN and A KIE hold too. Please confirm A WAR and F SWE stay out of BER, DEN, KIE and the Baltic, and tell me your Spring orders in writing. Russia has 4 centres and Austria is the bigger threat to us both.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1928: MUN is German and empty, and I want it kept that way. Please confirm no Austrian unit enters MUN, BOH or SIL this spring, and tell me your Spring orders for VIE, BUD, TRI, RUM and SER. I will keep my units out of VIE, TRI and BUD.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1928: Our truce still stands. A BUL and F AEG will hold this Spring, and F AEG stays off SMY and CON. Please confirm A CON, A SMY and F BLA stay out of BUL and GRE. Tell me your Spring 1928 orders first, and whether you plan any move against Greece or my Aegean fleet.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1928: Our pact holds. F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS will not enter TRI, SER or BUD this Spring. Please keep A BUD, A RUM, A SER, A VIE and F TRI out of BUL, GRE and ALB. Send your Spring 1928 orders in writing before we both move.

Russia, Spring 1928. A UKR and F SEV hold this spring, and A WAR stays out of GAL. We still want Austria out of UKR, WAR, SEV and GAL. Keep A RUM, BUD, SER and VIE on their own squares and we stay at peace.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1928: Austria is our shared problem. Tell me your Spring orders for MUN, BOH and VIE. If you press Austria from the west, I can pressure RUM and GAL from the east. Keep A BER, DEN and KIE out of WAR and SWE.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1928: F SEV holds and stays out of BLA, ARM, ANK, CON, SMY and BUL. Confirm your Spring orders for CON, SMY and BLA. Once RUM falls, I accept BUD for Russia and SER for Turkey, with neither army entering the other's centers.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1928: A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold this Spring, with nothing entering BUL or GRE. Please confirm A BUL and F AEG hold, and F AEG stays off SMY and CON. Tunis and the western Med stay open for a future split if you keep the truce. Tell me your Spring orders in writing.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1928: A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold this Spring, with no entry into SEV, UKR, WAR or RUM. Please confirm in writing that F SEV holds and does not enter BLA or CON, and state your orders for WAR and UKR so we avoid bounces. SER and BUD can be discussed once RUM falls.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1928: Please confirm A RUM, A SER and A BUD hold this Spring, with none entering BUL or GRE. Turkey's A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold and stay out of SER and RUM while our agreement stands. Tell me your Fall 1928 plans for RUM against Russia.

Austria confirms Spring 1928: A BUD, A RUM, A SER, A VIE and F TRI all hold. None enters BUL, GRE or ALB. Please keep F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS out of TRI, SER and BUD. Any breach ends our pact at once.
Austria confirms: no Austrian unit enters MUN, BOH or SIL this spring. Our A VIE, A BUD, F TRI, A RUM and A SER all hold. I expect no German unit to enter VIE, TRI or BUD. Our pact stands.

Austria holds this spring: A RUM, A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay put. I will not enter UKR, WAR, SEV or GAL. Your A UKR is massed against RUM, so please keep it out of RUM, SER and BUD. Any move into RUM will be met with force.

Austria confirms Spring 1928: A RUM, A SER and A BUD hold, and none enters BUL or GRE. Please keep A CON, A SMY and F BLA out of SER and RUM as agreed. RUM must stay secure against Russia first. We can talk about Italy again in Fall.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1928: A SIL, A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring. I will not enter WAR, SWE or GAL. Please confirm A WAR and F SWE stay out of BER, DEN, KIE and the Baltic. Austria is our shared target, and I will tell you before any move toward BOH or VIE.

Germany to France, Spring 1928: No German unit enters BUR or RUH this spring, and I cannot commit to a joint plan against England yet. Keep A PAR, A MAR, A BRE and A POR out of Munich and Burgundy. We can discuss Belgium and Holland in Fall, before any western change.

Italy to France, Spring 1928: Confirmed. F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS hold this spring. None moves toward Spain, Portugal, the Gulf of Lyon, Piedmont or Tunis. Your A BRE, A PAR, A MAR, A POR and F MAO holds work for me. Tell me at once if your western plans change, especially any move through MAO toward Iberia or the Mediterranean.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1928: Our pact holds. F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS hold this spring and will not enter TRI, SER or BUD. Please keep A BUD, A RUM, A SER, A VIE and F TRI holding, out of BUL, GRE and ALB, as you confirmed. Any breach by either side ends the pact at once.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1928: Truce holds. A BUL and F AEG hold this spring, F AEG stays off SMY and CON, and F ION stays out of GRE. Please keep A CON, A SMY and F BLA out of BUL and GRE. Tunis and the western Med are not for trade. Any move into BUL or GRE ends the truce.

Russia, Spring 1928: A UKR and F SEV hold this spring, and A WAR stays out of GAL. I will not move on RUM now. Keep A RUM, BUD, SER and VIE on their squares and keep your units out of UKR, WAR, SEV and GAL, and we stay at peace.

Russia to England: F SWE holds in Sweden this spring and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR and A UKR hold on our southern front. Please keep STP, NOR, NTH and LVP fleets out of the Baltic and Sweden, and warn me before any northern change.

Russia to Germany: A WAR and F SWE hold this spring, and neither enters BER, DEN, KIE or the Baltic. Confirm your MUN, BOH and VIE orders. If you press Austria from the west, I will pressure RUM and GAL from the east. Keep A BER, DEN and KIE out of WAR and SWE.

Russia to Turkey: F SEV holds and will not enter BLA, ARM, ANK, CON, SMY or BUL. A UKR and A WAR hold, and neither enters RUM. Please confirm CON, SMY and F BLA hold and stay out of SEV. Once RUM falls, BUD for Russia and SER for Turkey stands.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1928: Confirmed. A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold this Spring, and nothing enters BUL or GRE. I expect A BUL and F AEG to hold, with F AEG kept off SMY and CON. Tunis and the western Med remain open for talks if the truce holds through the year.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1928: A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold this Spring, with no entry into SEV, UKR, WAR or RUM. Please confirm in writing that F SEV holds and does not enter BLA or CON. Send your WAR and UKR orders so we avoid bounces. SER and BUD can be discussed once RUM falls.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1928: Confirmed. A CON, A SMY and F BLA hold this Spring and stay out of SER and RUM. I expect A RUM, A SER and A BUD to hold, with none entering BUL or GRE. Tell me your Fall 1928 plans for RUM against Russia once the Spring results are in.

Please confirm F SWE will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI, and tell me whether A WAR or A UKR will move against Germany or Austria this spring. I want warning before any northern move.

France to Germany, Spring 1930: I accept the Belgium and Holland split in principle. Belgium is mine, Holland yours. I will not move toward BUR or RUH and will keep my armies out of MUN. Please confirm A KIE's Spring 1930 move in writing, and keep your units off BEL and BUR until we agree the details.

France to England, Spring 1930: My armies hold this spring, and F MAO stays out of the Channel and your waters. I have not decided on Belgium. I will give you notice before any move toward BEL, and I expect the same courtesy from you for Picardy and Burgundy.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1930: A SIL, A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring, and I still keep our pact on WAR, SWE and GAL. Please keep A WAR and F SWE out of BER, DEN, KIE and the Baltic. Austria is weakest at RUM and SER, so pressing there suits us both. Tell me your Spring orders for WAR, SWE and UKR.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1930: Our pact on VIE, TRI and BUD holds, and no German unit enters them this spring. Russia is massing on RUM and WAR, so you need to hold. Please confirm no Austrian unit enters MUN, BOH or SIL, and tell me your Spring orders for RUM and SER.

Germany to France, Spring 1930: My units hold this spring: A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A SIL. No German unit enters BUR, RUH, BEL or HOL. Please keep your armies out of MUN and BUR. I am still open to a split of Belgium and Holland, but only after my northern position with England is settled. Tell me your Spring orders for BRE and PAR.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1930: The truce stands while A CON, A SMY and F BLA stay out of BUL and GRE. Your position is weak, with only ANK and CON left. Tell me your Spring 1930 orders in writing and whether you plan any move toward BUL or Italian SMY. Any move into BUL or GRE ends the truce at once.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1930: Our pact stands. Please confirm A BUD, A RUM, A SER, A VIE and F TRI stay out of BUL, GRE and ALB this spring, and send me your Spring 1930 orders. My F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS will stay off TRI, SER and BUD. Any breach ends it at once.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1930: A UKR, F SEV and A WAR hold this spring. Withdraw A RUM to BUD or SER now, and both of us keep our centers and avoid a costly fight. Your real threat is Turkey in the Balkans, not Russia.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1930: A WAR and F SWE hold this spring. Please move A SIL or MUN toward BOH to press Austria's VIE from the west. Confirm A BER, A DEN and A KIE stay off WAR and SWE. I will announce any Fall RUM move first.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1930: Turkey now holds only ANK and CON, and our SYR army is gone. I will keep A CON and F BLA out of BUL and GRE this spring if A BUL and F AEG hold. Please confirm your Spring 1930 orders in writing and say whether F AEG or F ION moves toward SMY, CON or GRE.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1930: Turkey holds only ANK and CON. Since you are striking RUM, I propose you press Austria's RUM and BUD while A CON and F BLA stay out of SEV, UKR, WAR, RUM and SER. Once Austria weakens, Turkey would like SER. Please confirm your Spring 1930 orders in writing.

Austria confirms Spring 1930: A BUD, A RUM, A SER, A VIE and F TRI all hold. None enters BUL, GRE or ALB. Our pact stands as long as your F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS stay off TRI, SER and BUD. Any breach ends it at once.

Austria will not withdraw from RUM. A RUM, A BUD and A SER hold this spring and will repel any move into them. Keep A UKR, F SEV and A WAR out of RUM, BUD, SER and GAL, and we both keep our centers. State your Spring orders in writing.

Austria confirms: no Austrian unit enters MUN, BOH or SIL this spring. A RUM, A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold. I expect no German unit to enter VIE, TRI or BUD. Our pact stands. Russia's massing on RUM and WAR is a shared threat, so let us watch WAR together.

England, Spring 1930: Confirmed. A BRE, A PAR, A MAR, A POR and F MAO may hold, and our fleets and A BEL hold too. I have no move toward Picardy or Burgundy. Please give notice before any move toward Belgium, and I will do the same before any move near Spain, Portugal or the Channel.

France to England, Spring 1930: Confirmed. A BRE, A PAR, A MAR, A POR hold this spring, and F MAO stays in the Atlantic, out of the Channel and your waters. I have not decided on Belgium. I will give you notice before any move toward BEL, and I expect the same notice from you before any move toward Picardy or Burgundy.

France to Germany, Spring 1930: Understood. I hold this spring, and I will keep A PAR, A MAR, A BRE and A POR out of MUN and BUR. In principle I accept Belgium for me and Holland for you, but the details must wait until you settle your northern position with England. Please give me notice before any move toward HOL or BEL, and I will do the same.

Germany to England, Spring 1930: A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A SIL all hold this spring. No German unit enters BEL, HOL, NTH or NOR, and none moves toward the Baltic against you. Please keep F NTH, F NWG and F ENG out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic, and warn me before any northern change.

Germany to France, Spring 1930: My units hold this spring: A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A SIL. No German unit enters BUR, RUH, BEL or HOL. I am open to a Belgium and Holland split, but only once my northern position with England is settled. Keep your armies out of MUN and BUR. Tell me your Spring orders for BRE and PAR.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1930: A SIL, A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring, and I keep our pact on WAR, SWE and GAL. Please keep A WAR and F SWE out of BER, DEN, KIE and the Baltic. Any move toward BOH or VIE must wait while my Austrian pact stands. Confirm your WAR, SWE and UKR orders.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1930: My orders are A BUL holds, F SMY holds, F ION holds. No move toward CON or GRE this spring. Keep A CON and F BLA out of BUL and GRE and the truce stands. Any move into BUL or GRE will end it at once, and I will not let SMY be taken.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1930: A UKR, F SEV and A WAR hold this spring, so there is no move into RUM, BUD or SER. Keep your armies off UKR, WAR, SEV and GAL and we both keep our centers. Turkey is the real threat to your Balkan front, so watch your south.

Russia to England, Spring 1930: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR and A UKR hold this spring, aimed at no one in the north. Keep STP, NOR, NTH and LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden, and I will warn you before any northern change.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1930: A WAR and F SWE hold this spring, and neither enters BER, DEN, KIE or the Baltic. Please move A SIL toward BOH to press Austria's VIE from the west. Confirm A BER, A DEN and A KIE stay off WAR and SWE. I will announce any Fall move first.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1930: A UKR and A WAR hold this spring, and F SEV stays out of BLA, CON, SMY, ANK and BUL. Please keep A CON and F BLA out of SEV, UKR, WAR and RUM. Turkey's SER claim is noted for later, once Austria's northern position is settled. Confirm in writing.

Turkey's Spring 1930 orders in writing: A CON holds and F BLA holds. Nothing enters BUL or GRE from us. Please keep A BUL and F AEG holding, with F AEG off SMY and CON, and F ION out of GRE. Any move against CON or BLA ends the truce at once.

notes.note: Spring 1930: all hold to keep 5 SCs. No unowned centers in reach. Pacts: Russia (no RUM/BUD/SER entry; we stay out of UKR/WAR/SEV/GAL) - Russia says it holds, watch RUM. Italy (no TRI/SER/BUD entry; we stay out of BUL/GRE/ALB) - kept so far. Germany (no VIE/TRI/BUD entry; no MUN/BOH/SIL by us) - kept. Turkey (no RUM/SER entry) - Russia warns Turkey is the real Balkan threat; watch south. Reassess

Spring 1930: all hold as pledged to France, Germany, Russia. All have kept word so far. No unowned centers reachable. Watch Germany's DEN/KIE and Russia's SWE/WAR. Plan BEL->DEN convoy via NTH/ENG only if Germany breaks word or weakens DEN. Keep fleets out of Baltic.

Spring 1930: all hold, keeping 5 SCs. No unowned SCs reachable without breaking deals. England and Germany have kept holds. Belgium split with Germany (me BEL, them HOL) accepted in principle, pending their northern settlement. Give notice before any BEL/PIC move. Keep out of MUN, BUR, Tunis.

Spring 1930: KIE to HOL (England center; France accepted Holland for Germany). BER, DEN, SIL hold to keep pacts with Austria, Russia. Watch England reaction and whether DEN can convoy later. Next: take HOL, then consider Fall moves on RUM/WAR if pacts break.

Spring 1930: all hold. Turkey has only A CON and F BLA; a BUL to CON with SMY support ties at 2 vs 2 and breaks truce, so no strike. Pacts with Austria and Turkey are intact. Revisit CON if Turkey weakens; watch Austria on BUL/GRE/ALB and keep SMY protected.

Spring 1930: UKR to RUM supported by SEV, a real strike on Austria's RUM. WAR and SWE hold. Promises kept so far: SWE out of Baltic/DEN/NOR/NTH/EDI; WAR out of SIL/BER/DEN/KIE; SEV out of BLA/CON/SMY. Austria and Turkey have claimed holds but are massed. Germany and England have kept terms. Next: if RUM falls, press BUD/SER; watch Turkey BLA and Germany SIL.

Spring 1930: holding ANK and CON. Italy (A BUL, F SMY, F ION) and Russia promise no entry into CON/BLA/ANK; Italy says it will not move on CON or GRE. Italy has broken nothing yet. A BUL holds, so a strike on BUL would bounce; strike only if BUL is vacated. Keep the truces and watch F SMY, which threatens CON. Russia's SER claim is noted for later.

messages.body: Austria here. Your A RUM is in a square I now claim. A GAL and A BUD will move to RUM this autumn, with A SER supporting. Withdraw A RUM to UKR or BESS now and avoid losing a unit. Keep F SEV and A WAR off GAL, BUD and SER and we can both keep our centers.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1930: I am retaking RUM from Russia this autumn with A GAL, A BUD and A SER. Please keep A CON, F BLA and any other Turkish units out of SER, BUD and RUM. I will keep my units out of BUL and GRE if you keep yours clear of my centers. Please confirm.

England to Germany, Fall 1930: Your A HOL is in Holland, which is my supply center and breaks the no-entry pledge on HOL and NTH. Withdraw it this autumn and I'll keep F NTH out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic. If it stays, I will act to take HOL back. Please answer before orders lock.

England to France, Fall 1930: I hold all my fleets and A BEL this autumn, with no move toward Picardy, Burgundy, Paris or the Channel. Please confirm your Fall 1930 orders for A PAR, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO hold, and give me notice before any move toward BEL or the Channel.

France to England, Fall 1930: My A PAR, A MAR, A BRE, A POR and F MAO are holding this autumn, and I have no move against BEL or the Channel. Please confirm A BEL and your fleets stay out of Brest, Picardy and the Bay of Biscay. I will give notice before any change in the west.

France to Germany, Fall 1930: My armies hold this autumn and none enters MUN, BUR or RUH. Holland remains yours in principle, Belgium mine once England's position is clear. Please confirm A HOL, A KIE and A SIL stay off BEL and BUR this year, and tell me your Fall orders.

Germany to England, Fall 1930: A KIE is in HOL, so Holland becomes mine this autumn as we discussed with France. I will not move into BEL, NTH or NOR. Please keep F NTH, F NWG and F ENG out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic, and tell me your Fall orders for NTH and LON.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1930: A SIL, A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold, and I keep our pact on WAR, SWE and GAL. Please keep A WAR and F SWE out of BER, DEN, KIE and the Baltic. Tell me your Fall orders for WAR, SWE and RUM, since Austria's RUM and SER are the obvious target.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1930: Our pact on VIE, TRI and BUD holds, and no German unit enters them. MUN, BOH and SIL stay out of your reach while you keep your armies away from them too. Please confirm your Fall orders for RUM, SER and GAL, and whether you will hold against Russia.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1930: Your fleet and army are isolated with only CON and BLA left. I suggest you accept a quiet end: keep A CON and F BLA out of BUL and GRE, and I will hold BUL, AEG and SMY. Confirm your Fall orders in writing before I lock mine.
