Italy to Austria, Fall 1930: Our pact stands. My F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS will stay off TRI, SER and BUD. Please confirm A SER, A BUD and A GAL stay out of BUL, GRE and ALB this autumn, and send me your Fall 1930 orders.

Italy to France, Fall 1930: I have no move toward Spain, Portugal, the Gulf of Lyon or Tunis. Please confirm F MAO and A MAR stay away from TUN and Italian soil this autumn, and tell me your Fall 1930 orders first.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1930: A RUM holds and we hold it this autumn. Your GAL army should not enter RUM, and I will not move into BUD, SER or VIE. Let's both keep our centers. Confirm in writing that A GAL and A BUD stay off RUM and UKR this Fall.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1930: F SEV holds in the Black Sea and will not enter BLA, CON, SMY or BUL. Please confirm A CON and F BLA stay out of SEV, RUM and UKR this autumn. Turkey's SER claim is for after Austria is weakened. Tell me your Fall orders.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1930: A RUM and A WAR hold, and F SWE holds. Please move A SIL toward BOH this Fall to press Austria's VIE from the west. Confirm A BER, A DEN and A KIE stay off WAR and SWE. Tell me your Fall orders for SIL and MUN.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1930: Turkey holds A CON and F BLA this autumn and stays out of SEV, RUM, WAR and UKR. Austria's RUM and SER are your target, and I will not contest them. Once RUM falls, I ask that Russia leave SER and BUL to Turkey, with no support into CON or ANK. Please confirm in writing.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1930: A CON and F BLA hold this autumn and nothing enters BUL, GRE or SMY from us. Italy's A BUL and F SMY hold as agreed? Please confirm your Fall 1930 orders in writing, and tell me whether F ION or A NAP moves toward GRE or CON. Any move against CON ends the truce at once.

Austria here. Your A RUM is in a square we claim, and we are taking it back this autumn: A GAL moves to RUM with A SER supporting. Withdraw A RUM to UKR or BESS now and avoid losing a unit. Keep F SEV and A WAR off GAL, BUD, SER and VIE, and our fight stays in RUM alone.

Austria to Germany, Fall 1930: Our pact on VIE, TRI and BUD holds. A VIE and F TRI hold, and A BUD holds. A GAL is attacking Russian RUM with A SER support, not moving toward anything of yours. Keep your armies out of VIE, TRI, BUD and SER, and we stay friends. I will watch WAR and SIL with you.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1930: Our pact stands. A SER is moving to RUM in support of A GAL, so it leaves the Balkan south. A BUD holds and none of our units enters BUL, GRE or ALB. Please keep F ION, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS off TRI, SER and BUD. Any breach ends the pact at once.

England to France, Fall 1930: Confirmed, I hold all fleets and A BEL this autumn. Germany's A KIE has moved into HOL, which breaks its pledge. I will not move toward Picardy, Burgundy or Paris, but I ask you to tell me before any move near BEL or the Channel. Please keep your A PAR, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO holding.

England to Germany, Fall 1930: Your A HOL breaks your pledge on HOL and NTH, and HOL is my supply center. Withdraw it to KIE or elsewhere this autumn and I will keep F NTH out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic. If it stays, I will act to retake HOL. Answer before orders lock.

France, Fall 1930: Confirmed. A PAR, A MAR, A BRE, A POR and F MAO all hold this autumn, with no move toward BEL or the Channel. I will give you notice before any change near Belgium, as promised. Please give me the same notice before any move toward Picardy, Burgundy or Brest.

France to Italy, Fall 1930: Confirmed. F MAO and A MAR hold this autumn, and none of my units moves toward Tunis, the Gulf of Lyon, Piedmont or Italian soil. I will tell you before any change in the west or Mediterranean. Please keep F TYS, F ION and A ROM away from Spain and Portugal.

Germany to England, Fall 1930: A HOL holds in Holland this autumn and I will not move it against your fleets. I will not enter BEL, NTH or NOR. Keep F NTH, NWG and ENG out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic, and I will do the same. Any move against HOL from your side will end our understanding.

Germany to France, Fall 1930: A HOL holds this autumn. I have no move on BEL, BUR or RUH, and my armies stay out of MUN. Belgium stays open for you once England's position is clear. Keep A PAR, BRE and MAR away from MUN and BUR, and I will do the same.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1930: A SIL, BER, DEN and HOL hold. I keep our pact on WAR, SWE and GAL, and no German unit goes to BER, DEN, KIE or the Baltic against you. My Austrian pact limits any move on BOH or VIE for now. I need your WAR, SWE and RUM orders before I decide more.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1930: Confirmed in writing. A BUL holds, F SMY holds, and F ION holds this autumn. Nothing from Italy enters CON, BLA or GRE. Keep A CON and F BLA out of BUL and GRE and the truce stands. Any move into BUL, GRE or SMY ends it at once.

Russia to Austria: A RUM holds this Fall, and I will not move into BUD, SER or VIE. Your GAL army moving into RUM would be a direct attack, and we will resist it. Keep A GAL, A BUD and any other Austrian unit out of UKR, WAR and SEV, and we can both keep our centers.

Russia to Germany: A WAR and F SWE hold this Fall, and neither enters BER, DEN, KIE or the Baltic beyond Sweden. I have no Fall move toward SIL, MUN or BOH to announce yet. Keep A BER, DEN and KIE out of WAR and SWE, and tell me whether you will press Austria's BOH or VIE.

Russia to Turkey: F SEV holds this Fall and will not enter BLA, CON, SMY or BUL. Keep A CON and F BLA out of SEV, UKR, WAR and RUM. SER and BUL are not promised to anyone yet; we will discuss them once Austria's position is settled. Please confirm your orders in writing.

Turkey confirms in writing: A CON and F BLA hold this autumn, and neither enters SEV, RUM, WAR, UKR or SER. Please keep F SEV out of BLA and CON, and keep your armies out of ANK and BUL. We take no position on your RUM strike. SER and BUL can be discussed once Austria is weaker.

Turkey confirms: A CON and F BLA hold this Fall, and nothing from Turkey enters BUL, GRE or SMY. Your F SMY sits next to CON, so please keep it off CON and ANK, and keep F ION out of GRE. Confirm your A BUL and F SMY hold, and the truce stands while both sides hold.

Turkey confirms Fall 1930: A CON and F BLA hold. We will not enter SER, BUD, RUM, BUL or GRE. Your RUM retake is your affair. Please keep A GAL, A BUD and A SER out of ANK, CON and the Black Sea, and tell me if your plans change so our truce holds.

notes.note: Fall 1930: all hold, keeping 5 SCs (BRE MAR PAR POR SPA). No unowned SCs. England and Germany kept holds; Germany's A HOL breaks no France deal yet but Belgium split is still unsettled. Italy confirmed no Tunis move. Keep out of BEL, BUR, MUN, Tunis. Revisit if unowned SCs appear or England/Germany break deals.

Fall 1930: A HOL holds to take Holland after Fall, despite England's threat; England and Russia pacts unbroken so far. BER to KIE to cover our center. DEN and SIL hold to keep pacts with Austria and Russia. Watch England on HOL and Russia on WAR/SWE; revisit striking if pacts break.

Fall 1930: A HOL is in my center HOL, breaking Germany's pledge. A BEL moves to HOL, supported by F NTH, to retake it. Other fleets hold. Keep F NTH out of DEN, KIE, Baltic. Watch Germany's counterattack and France/Russia pledges; they have kept word so far.

Fall 1930: holding CON and BLA. Truces: Italy (A BUL, F SMY hold), Russia (F SEV holds), Austria (RUM retake is theirs). Italy and Russia have confirmed in writing; Austria's RUM/SER plans are its own. Italy's A BUL and F SMY must stay put or BUL/SMY attack becomes possible. Watch F SMY next to CON.

Fall 1930: GAL attacks RUM with SER and BUD support to retake it from Russia. Holding TRI and VIE. Italy and Germany have kept pacts so far. Turkey confirmed it will not enter SER/BUD/RUM. Russia's RUM hold is the test; reassess Spring 1931.

Fall 1930: A RUM holds and F SEV supports it to resist Austrian GAL/SER attack. WAR and SWE hold to protect WAR and SWE centers. Germany pact on WAR/SWE kept. Austria and Turkey claim holds, watch BUD/SER/GAL. Next: reposition SEV-BLA convoy to move RUM army toward ANK/CON/ARM if RUM holds.

Fall 1930: all hold to keep pacts with Austria, Turkey, France. Turkey is weak (ANK, CON only), but BUL->CON with SMY support ties 2v2 vs CON+BLA, so no strike. Watch Turkey's CON/BLA and Austria on BUL/GRE/ALB. Revisit CON if Turkey weakens; keep SMY protected.

messages.body: Austria here. A RUM now holds and we will defend it. Your A UKR, F SEV and A WAR must not move into RUM, BUD, SER or GAL this spring. Confirm in writing that A UKR attacks nothing of ours. Otherwise we both lose units for no gain. Our fight should stay out of Galicia and Ukraine.

Austria to Italy: Your A BUL now sits next to our A SER. Our pact says no Austrian unit enters BUL, GRE or ALB, and none does. Please confirm A BUL and your southern fleets stay out of SER, BUD and TRI this spring. Tell me your Spring 1931 orders for BUL and GRE.

England to Germany, Spring 1931: Holland is ours now, with A HOL holding there. Your unit has retreated to RUH, which I appreciate. I hold NTH, NWG, ENG and LON this spring and stay out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic. Please keep A DEN, A KIE and A SIL out of HOL, BEL and NTH, and tell me your spring orders.

England to France, Spring 1931: A HOL and A BEL are mine, and I'm holding them this spring. I have no move toward Picardy, Burgundy, Paris or the Channel. Please keep A PAR, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO holding, and give me notice before any move near BEL or the Channel.

England to Russia, Spring 1931: F SWE, F SEV and A WAR should not give Germany's SIL or DEN an opening while I hold my northern fleets. Please confirm F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI, and tell me whether A WAR will hold or strike SIL this spring.

France to England, Spring 1931: As promised, notice: I may move A BRE to Picardy this autumn and aim at Belgium if A BEL leaves. This spring A PAR, A MAR, A BRE, A POR and F MAO all hold. Please confirm your Belgium plans and keep F ENG and F LON away from Brest and Picardy.

France to Germany, Spring 1931: My armies hold this spring: A PAR, A MAR, A BRE, A POR, F MAO. I will give notice before any move toward BEL or HOL. Please confirm A HOL and your other units stay out of BUR and MUN, and tell me your Spring 1931 orders.

Germany to England, Spring 1931: My A RUH was dislodged from Holland last autumn and sits in the Ruhr now. I have no move into HOL, BEL, NTH or NOR this spring. Keep F NTH, F NWG and F ENG out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic, and I will keep A DEN and A KIE home. What are your Spring orders for NTH and HOL?

Germany to Russia, Spring 1931: A SIL, A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring, and my pact on WAR, SWE and GAL stands. Please confirm A UKR and A WAR stay out of BER, DEN, KIE and the Baltic. Tell me your Spring orders for WAR, SWE and RUM so we both know where the front is.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1931: Our truce stands. My A BUL, F SMY and F ION hold this spring and nothing from Italy enters CON, BLA or GRE. Please confirm in writing that your A CON and F BLA hold, with nothing entering BUL, GRE or SMY. Any move against those lines ends the truce at once.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1931: Our pact stands. My F ION, A ROM, A VEN, F TYS and A NAP stay off TRI, SER, BUD and VIE. Please confirm your units, including A RUM and A SER, stay out of BUL, GRE and ALB this spring, and send me your Spring 1931 orders before I lock mine.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1931: A UKR, F SEV and A WAR hold this spring. Your A RUM, BUD and SER are now massed against me. Keep your armies out of UKR, SEV and WAR, and I will not move into RUM, BUD, SER or VIE. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1931: F SEV holds in the Black Sea and will not enter BLA, CON, SMY or BUL. Please keep A CON and F BLA out of SEV and UKR. Tell me your Spring orders, and whether you plan to move against Austria's SER this year.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1931: A WAR and F SWE hold this spring, and neither enters BER, DEN, KIE or the Baltic. Please confirm A BER, A DEN and A KIE stay off WAR and SWE. Are A SIL and MUN moving toward BOH or holding? Tell me your Spring orders.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1931: A CON and F BLA hold this spring, and nothing from Turkey enters BUL, GRE or SMY. Please confirm A BUL, F SMY and F ION hold, and that F SMY stays off CON and ANK. Any move against CON or BLA ends the truce at once.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1931: A CON and F BLA hold, staying out of SEV, UKR, WAR and RUM. Please confirm F SEV holds and does not enter BLA, CON or SMY. Once Austria's RUM and SER are settled, I ask that SER and BUL be discussed before any Russian move south.

Austria confirms Spring 1931: A RUM, A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI all hold this spring. None enters BUL, GRE or ALB. Our pact stands as long as your F ION, A ROM, A VEN, F TYS, A NAP and A BUL stay out of TRI, SER, BUD and VIE. Any breach ends it at once.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1931: A RUM, A BUD and A SER hold this spring, and we will not move into UKR, WAR, SEV or GAL. Keep A UKR, F SEV and A WAR out of RUM, BUD and SER, and we both keep our centers. Confirm your holds in writing.

England to Germany, Spring 1931: This spring F NTH, F NWG, F ENG, F LON, F LVP, F EDI, F STP/NORTH, A HOL and A BEL all hold, with no move toward DEN, KIE or the Baltic. Please keep A DEN, A KIE, A BER and A SIL out of HOL, BEL, NTH and NOR as you pledged, and tell me before any northern change.

England to France, Spring 1931: Thank you for the notice. This spring A HOL, A BEL and all our fleets hold, and F ENG and F LON stay put. I will give you notice before any move toward Picardy or Belgium. Please keep A BRE and A PAR out of the Channel and English waters, and tell me before any autumn move toward Picardy.

France, Spring 1931. Notice as promised: I may move A BRE toward Picardy and then Belgium this autumn if A BEL leaves. This spring A PAR, A MAR, A BRE, A POR and F MAO hold. Please confirm your Belgium plans, and keep F ENG and F LON away from Brest and Picardy. I expect you to give me the same notice before any move toward Picardy or Burgundy.

Germany to England, Spring 1931: Understood, Holland is yours. My A RUH will not enter HOL, BEL, NTH or NOR. A DEN, A KIE and A SIL hold this spring and stay out of the North Sea. Keep F NTH, F NWG and F ENG out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic, and warn me before any northern change.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1931: A SIL, A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring, and our pact on WAR, SWE and GAL stands. I will not move toward BOH or VIE yet. Keep A UKR and A WAR out of BER, DEN, KIE and the Baltic. Tell me your RUM plans before Fall.

Germany to France, Spring 1931: Holland is now England's, so the Belgium split is off for this year. My A RUH holds in the Ruhr and will not enter BUR, BEL or MUN. Please keep your armies out of MUN and BUR, and give me notice before any move toward the Low Countries.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1931: Our pact stands. My F ION, A ROM, A VEN, F TYS and A NAP will not enter TRI, SER, BUD or VIE this spring. Please keep A RUM, A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of BUL, GRE and ALB. Send your Spring 1931 orders in writing before I lock mine. Any breach ends it at once.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1931: Our truce stands. A BUL, F SMY and F ION hold this spring, and nothing from Italy enters CON, BLA or GRE. Keep A CON and F BLA out of BUL, GRE and SMY, and the truce holds. I will confirm my next orders in writing once you send yours.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1931: A UKR, F SEV and A WAR hold this spring, and A UKR attacks nothing of yours. I will not move into RUM, BUD, SER or VIE. Keep your armies out of UKR, SEV, WAR and GAL and we both keep our centers. Turkey is the bigger danger to your Balkan front.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1931: A WAR, F SWE and A UKR hold this spring. None of them enters BER, DEN, KIE or the Baltic. I have no move toward SIL or BOH this spring. Please keep A SIL, A DEN and A KIE off WAR and SWE, and tell me if Austria's pact changes.

Russia to England, Spring 1931: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR holds and will not strike SIL this spring. F SEV holds in the Black Sea. Keep your STP, NOR, NTH and LVP fleets out of the Baltic and Sweden, and I will warn you before any northern change.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1931: F SEV holds this spring and will not enter BLA, CON, SMY or BUL. A UKR and A WAR hold and stay out of RUM. Please keep A CON and F BLA out of SEV, UKR and WAR. SER and BUL can be discussed once Austria's northern position is settled.

Turkey confirms in writing: A CON and F BLA hold this Spring. Nothing from Turkey enters BUL, GRE or SMY. Please keep A BUL, F SMY and F ION holding, with F SMY off CON and ANK. Any Italian move against CON or BLA ends the truce at once.

Turkey confirms: A CON and F BLA hold this Spring, and neither enters SEV, UKR, WAR or RUM. Please keep F SEV out of BLA and CON, and keep your armies out of ANK and BUL. Once Austria's RUM and SER are settled, let us discuss SER and BUL before any Russian move south.

notes.note: Spring 1931: all hold; BUD and SER support RUM hold vs Russian UKR/SEV/WAR. Pacts: Russia (no RUM/BUD/SER/VIE entry; we stay out of UKR/WAR/SEV/GAL), Italy (no TRI/SER/BUD/VIE entry; we stay out of BUL/GRE/ALB), Germany (no VIE/TRI/BUD entry), Turkey (no RUM/SER entry). All kept so far. No unowned centers in reach. Reassess Fall 1931; watch Russia on RUM.

Spring 1931: all hold for peace, no unowned centers reachable. France, Germany, Russia kept word so far. Watch Germany's DEN/KIE and Russia's SWE/WAR. Consider HOL->DEN convoy via NTH only if Germany breaks word.

Spring 1931: all hold, keeping 5 SCs. No unowned SCs reachable. England kept holds (A HOL, A BEL, fleets). Germany kept out of MUN/BUR. Italy kept away from Tunis. Gave England notice of possible autumn A BRE to PIC then BEL if A BEL leaves. Next: check for unowned SCs; autumn notice before any move.

Spring 1931: all hold to keep pacts with Austria (no TRI/SER/BUD/VIE entry) and Turkey (no CON/BLA/GRE entry). Turkey has only A CON and F BLA; BUL to CON with SMY support ties 2v2, so no strike. Austria and Turkey have kept terms. Revisit CON if Turkey weakens; watch Austria on BUL/GRE/ALB.

Spring 1931: UKR strikes RUM, supported by SEV. A bounce costs nothing. WAR and SWE hold for the Germany and England terms. Austria has broken terms by massing on RUM/BUD/SER. Turkey has kept its holds. Next: if RUM falls, press BUD/SER; keep the Baltic quiet.

Spring 1931: RUH attacks HOL with KIE support, breaking my England pledge; England's HOL is their center. DEN and SIL hold. Watch England's NTH on DEN/KIE and Russia's WAR/SWE pact. If HOL falls, consider a Fall retreat to KIE.

Spring 1931: holding CON and BLA as planned. Italy (A BUL, F SMY, F ION) and Russia have kept their truces so far. Strike BUL only if A BUL vacates. Watch F SMY next to CON and Austria's RUM/SER moves. Revisit a BUL attack in Fall 1931 if the truce holds.

messages.body: Austria to Russia, Fall 1931: A RUM, A BUD, A SER, A VIE and F TRI hold this autumn, and we will not enter UKR, WAR, SEV or GAL. Please confirm A UKR, F SEV and A WAR hold and stay out of RUM, BUD, SER and VIE. Mutual holds keep both our centers.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1931: Your A BUL sits next to our A SER, so I need certainty. Please confirm A BUL, F ION, A ROM, A VEN, F TYS and A NAP stay out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE this autumn. Austria enters none of BUL, GRE or ALB. Send your Fall orders.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1931: Please confirm A CON and F BLA stay out of SER, RUM, BUD and VIE this autumn. Austria holds RUM, SER, BUD, VIE and TRI, and enters none of BUL, GRE or ALB. Tell me your Fall 1931 orders so our truce holds.

England to Germany, Fall 1931: Your A HOL is sitting in my center Holland, and that breaks your pledge. I am ordering A BEL to HOL with F NTH support to retake it. Withdraw A HOL to KIE or elsewhere now and I will keep F NTH out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic. Otherwise we are at war in the Low Countries.

England to France, Fall 1931: Holland is contested. I am moving A BEL to HOL with F NTH support this autumn, not toward Picardy or Belgium. Please keep A BRE and A PAR out of BEL and the Channel, and I will keep F ENG and F LON off Brest and Picardy.

France to England, Fall 1931: Your A BEL is still in Belgium and the retreat from HOL is noted. My A PAR, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO will hold this autumn. I will not move toward Picardy or Belgium unless I give you notice first. Please confirm A BEL stays put and tell me your Fall 1931 orders for the Channel.

France to Germany, Fall 1931: Holland is now contested, and your A HOL is there. My armies hold this autumn and none enters MUN, BUR or RUH. Please confirm your A HOL, A KIE, A SIL and A DEN stay out of Belgium and Burgundy this year, and tell me your Fall 1931 orders.

Germany to England, Fall 1931: My A HOL is in Holland and I know your claim. Proposal: if your F NTH and F ENG stay out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic this autumn, I will not support any attack on HOL, and I will withdraw A HOL out of Holland in Spring 1932. Tell me your Fall orders for NTH, ENG and HOL before they lock.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1931: Our pact on WAR, SWE and GAL stands. A DEN, A KIE and A SIL hold, and none of them enters WAR, SWE or the Baltic. Please confirm A WAR, F SWE and A UKR stay out of BER, DEN and KIE. Tell me your Fall orders for WAR, SWE and RUM so we both know the front.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1931: Our pact on VIE, TRI and BUD holds, and no German unit enters them. A SIL holds, and no German unit enters MUN or BOH this autumn. Russia is a threat on RUM and WAR. Please tell me your Fall orders for SER, RUM and BUD.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1931: My A BUL, F SMY and F ION hold this autumn, and nothing from Italy enters CON, BLA or GRE. Please confirm in writing that A CON and F BLA hold, with nothing entering BUL, GRE or SMY. Any move against those lines ends our truce at once.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1931: Our pact stands. My F ION, A ROM, A VEN, F TYS, A NAP and A BUL will not enter TRI, SER, BUD or VIE this autumn. Please confirm A RUM, A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of BUL, GRE and ALB, and send your Fall 1931 orders first.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1931: My A UKR, A WAR and F SEV hold this Fall, and F SWE holds in Sweden. I will not move into GAL, BUD, SER or RUM. Please confirm your Fall orders in writing, and keep your armies out of UKR, WAR and SEV. Neither of us gains from a war in the Ukraine.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1931: A WAR, F SWE and A UKR hold this Fall. None enters BER, DEN, KIE or the Baltic beyond Sweden. Please confirm A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A SIL stay off WAR and SWE, and tell me your Fall orders for SIL and MUN.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1931: F SEV holds in the Black Sea and will not enter BLA, CON, SMY or BUL. Please keep A CON and F BLA out of SEV and UKR. Tell me your Fall orders, and whether you intend to move on Austria's SER this year.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1931: Please confirm in writing that A BUL, F SMY and F ION hold this Fall as agreed. Turkey holds A CON and F BLA, with nothing entering BUL, GRE or SMY. Tell me if your plans toward GRE or CON change, so our truce holds while we both hold.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1931: Please send your Fall 1931 orders for A RUM, A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI. Turkey holds A CON and F BLA, staying out of SER, RUM, BUL and GRE. Please keep your units out of ANK, CON and the Black Sea, as agreed.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1931: Confirmed. A RUM, A BUD, A SER, A VIE and F TRI all hold this autumn. Austria will not enter UKR, WAR, SEV or GAL. Please keep A UKR, F SEV and A WAR holding, and out of RUM, BUD, SER and VIE. Mutual holds keep both our centers.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1931: Our pact stands. A RUM, A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI all hold, and no Austrian unit enters BUL, GRE or ALB. Please keep F ION, A ROM, A VEN, F TYS, A NAP and A BUL out of TRI, SER, BUD and VIE, as you have stated. Any breach ends it.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1931: Confirmed. A RUM, A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold, and none of us enters BUL or GRE. Please keep A CON and F BLA out of SER, RUM, BUD and VIE, and out of ANK and the Black Sea as agreed. Our truce holds while yours does.

Austria to Germany, Fall 1931: Our pact holds. A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold, and no Austrian unit enters MUN, BOH or SIL this autumn. I expect no German unit to enter VIE, TRI or BUD. A RUM and A SER hold against Russia. We will watch WAR together.

France, as noticed: A BEL is moving to HOL this autumn with F NTH support. It is not a move on Picardy or Belgium, and BEL will be empty afterward. Please keep A BRE and A PAR out of BEL and the Channel. F ENG and F LON stay off Brest and Picardy. Thank you for keeping your word.

Germany, I cannot accept. Your A HOL breaks your pledge, and HOL is my supply center, so A BEL moves to HOL with F NTH support this autumn. If you withdraw A HOL to KIE now, I will keep F NTH out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic. Otherwise we are at war in the Low Countries.

France to England, Fall 1931: Your move of A BEL to HOL is your business in the north, and I will not enter Belgium this autumn. A PAR, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO hold. I will give you notice before any move toward Picardy or Belgium. Please keep F ENG and F LON off Brest and Picardy, and tell me your Spring 1932 plans for BEL.

Germany to England: A HOL stays in Holland this autumn and will hold. A KIE can support it, so an attack from BEL with NTH support would bounce. I am not moving on BEL or NOR. Keep F NTH and F ENG out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic, and we can both avoid a costly Low Countries war.

Germany to France: Holland is not negotiable this autumn, and A HOL stays. Belgium stays open for you once England's position is clear, but I cannot give you BEL while English units sit there. I will keep my armies out of MUN and BUR, and I ask the same of you.

Germany to Russia: Our pact on WAR, SWE and GAL stands. A DEN, A KIE and A SIL are holding and will not enter WAR, SWE or the Baltic. Please keep A WAR, F SWE and A UKR out of BER, DEN and KIE. Tell me your Fall orders for RUM and WAR before I decide more.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1931: Our pact stands. My F ION, A ROM, A VEN, F TYS, A NAP and A BUL will not enter TRI, SER, BUD or VIE this autumn. Please keep A RUM, A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of BUL, GRE and ALB. My written orders follow once yours arrive. Any breach ends the pact at once.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1931: Our truce stands. A BUL, F SMY and F ION hold this autumn, and nothing from Italy enters CON, BLA or GRE. Your A CON and F BLA must hold and stay out of BUL, GRE and SMY. Any move against those lines ends the truce at once. Send your Fall orders in writing and I will confirm mine.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1931: Confirmed. A UKR, F SEV and A WAR hold this autumn. I have no orders into RUM, BUD, SER, VIE or GAL. Keep your armies out of UKR, WAR and SEV and we both keep our centers. Turkey remains the real danger to your Balkan front.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1931: A WAR, F SWE and A UKR hold this autumn, and none enters BER, DEN, KIE or the Baltic. Our pact stands. Please keep A DEN, A KIE and A SIL off WAR and SWE. I will announce any move toward SIL or MUN before it locks.

Turkey confirms in writing for Fall 1931: A CON and F BLA hold. Neither enters SER, RUM, BUD, VIE, BUL or GRE. Your RUM, SER, BUD, VIE and TRI are yours to hold. Please keep your units out of ANK, CON and the Black Sea, as agreed. Send your Fall 1931 orders so we can confirm the truce.

notes.note: Fall 1931: all five units hold to keep 5 SCs. Pacts: Russia (no RUM/BUD/SER/VIE entry; we stay out of UKR/WAR/SEV/GAL) - kept so far, watch RUM. Italy (no TRI/SER/BUD/VIE entry; we stay out of BUL/GRE/ALB) - kept so far. Germany (no VIE/TRI/BUD entry; no MUN/BOH/SIL by us) - kept. Turkey (no RUM/SER entry) - kept; Turkey asked us to stay out of ANK/CON/Black Sea. Reassess Spring 1932; watch Turkey

Fall 1931: all hold, keeping 5 SCs. No unowned SCs reachable. England's A BEL moves to HOL, leaving BEL empty; Germany refuses BEL and keeps HOL. Promises kept so far. Next: consider convoying A BRE to BEL in Spring 1932 via F MAO to ENG, after notice to England.

Fall 1931: holding A HOL to take Holland; KIE supports HOL holding; DEN and SIL hold to keep pacts with Austria and Russia. England threatens HOL with BEL and NTH support. Next: if HOL falls, consider a retreat to KIE; watch Russia on WAR/SWE and England's NTH on DEN/KIE.

Fall 1931: all hold to keep MOS, SEV, SWE, WAR. RUM strike bounces vs BUD/SER support, so no attack. Austria, Germany and Turkey all say they hold; keep pacts. Watch Germany SIL and Turkey BLA/SER. Retry RUM only if Austrian supports weaken.

Fall 1931: A BEL to HOL with F NTH support (195) to retake HOL from Germany's broken pledge; may bounce vs KIE support. Other fleets hold. Keep NTH out of DEN/KIE/Baltic. France has kept word; Germany broke pledge by staying in HOL. Watch for Germany counterattack on BEL and Russia's SWE/WAR.

Fall 1931: all hold to keep pacts with Austria and Turkey. CON attack ties 2v2 (A CON + F BLA), so no strike. Austria and Turkey have kept terms so far. Revisit CON if Turkey weakens; watch Austria on BUL/GRE/ALB.

Fall 1931: broke truce with Italy to strike BUL. A CON to BUL, supported by F BLA (CON to BUL). Risk: Italian retaliation on CON from F SMY. Austria and Russia have kept their truces. Next: hold BUL if taken, keep CON/ANK covered, and watch F SMY.

messages.body: Austria to Italy, Spring 1932: Our pact stands and I will hold A RUM, A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI. Your A BUL is the unit I watch most. Will you confirm it stays out of SER and BUD this spring, and tell me your plans for GRE and ALB so we avoid a clash?

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1932: Our truce holds. A RUM, A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold this spring. Please confirm your new army in CON and F BLA stay out of SER, RUM, BUD and VIE, and out of BUL and GRE. Tell me if your plans include Russia in the Black Sea.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1932: Our holds stand. A RUM, A BUD and A SER hold, and we will not enter UKR, WAR, SEV or GAL. Please confirm A UKR, F SEV and A WAR hold this spring and stay out of RUM, BUD, SER and VIE. Turkey is building up, so we both benefit from calm in the south.

England to Germany, Spring 1932: A HOL is still in my center Holland, which breaks your pledge. Withdraw it to KIE or elsewhere this spring and I will keep F NTH and F ENG out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic. If it stays, A BEL moves to HOL with F NTH support and we fight in the Low Countries. Tell me your choice now.

England to France, Spring 1932: As noticed, A BEL moves to HOL this spring with F NTH support, not toward Picardy or Belgium. BEL will be empty afterward. Please keep A BRE and A PAR out of BEL and the Channel, and F MAO away from ENG. Please share your Spring 1932 orders for BRE, PAR and MAR.

France to England, Spring 1932: Notice as promised. A PAR moves to Picardy this spring, and A BRE stays put. I aim for Belgium in autumn, since BEL is empty after your A BEL left for HOL. I will not enter Burgundy or the Channel. Please keep F LON and F ENG away from Picardy and Brest, and tell me your Spring 1932 plans.

France to Germany, Spring 1932: Belgium is now empty since England's A BEL left for Holland. I plan to take it this autumn and will move A PAR to Picardy first. I have no move on Holland, Burgundy or Munich. Please keep A HOL, A KIE and A MUN out of Belgium and Burgundy, and tell me your Spring 1932 orders.

Germany to England, Spring 1932: A HOL holds and A KIE holds. I will not move on BEL or NTH this spring. Please keep F NTH and F ENG out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic, and tell me your Spring orders for BEL and NTH so we avoid a costly Low Countries war.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1932: A DEN, A KIE and A SIL hold, and our pact on WAR, SWE and GAL stands. Please keep A WAR, F SWE and A UKR out of BER, DEN and KIE. Tell me whether A RUM or A WAR moves against Austria this spring.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1932: Our truce holds. My F SMY, F ION and A GRE will not enter CON, ANK, BUL or BLA this spring. Please confirm your A CON, A BUL and F BLA stay out of GRE and SMY, and send your Spring 1932 orders in writing first.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1932: Our pact stands. My A VEN, A ROM, A NAP and F ION will not enter TRI, VIE, BUD or SER this spring. Please confirm A BUD, A SER, A RUM, A VIE and F TRI stay out of GRE, ALB and BUL, and send your Spring 1932 orders first.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1932: A UKR, F SEV and A WAR hold this spring. I will not enter RUM, BUD, SER or VIE while your armies stay out of UKR, SEV and WAR. Tell me your Spring orders for RUM and GAL, and confirm in writing that you will not attack UKR or WAR.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1932: F SEV holds in the Black Sea and will not enter BLA, CON, SMY or BUL. Please confirm A CON and F BLA stay out of SEV and UKR. Tell me your Spring orders and whether you plan to move on Austria's SER or RUM this year.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1932: A WAR, F SWE and A UKR hold this spring, and none enters BER, DEN, KIE or the Baltic. Our pact on WAR and SWE stands. Please confirm A SIL, A DEN and A KIE stay off WAR and SWE, and tell me your Spring orders for SIL and MUN.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1932: Our truce is broken by my strike on BUL, which I now hold with A BUL. I will not move on GRE or SMY if F SMY stays off CON and ANK and A GRE and F ION stay out of BUL. Tell me your Spring orders and whether you will attack BUL or CON.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1932: I hold A CON, A BUL and F BLA this spring. I ask that F SEV stays out of BLA and CON and that your armies stay out of ANK and BUL. Turkey will turn against Austria's SER and RUM, not your positions. Please confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Austria confirms Spring 1932: A RUM, A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI all hold. No Austrian unit enters BUL, GRE or ALB this spring. Please keep your A VEN, A ROM, A NAP and F ION out of TRI, VIE, BUD and SER, and keep your A BUL out of SER and BUD. I'll watch your GRE and ALB moves closely and will tell you my plans for later seasons before they are locked.

Austria confirms Spring 1932: A RUM, A BUD and A SER hold, and we will not enter UKR, WAR, SEV or GAL. Please confirm your A UKR, F SEV and A WAR hold and stay out of RUM, BUD, SER and VIE. If you hold as stated, we both keep our centers and Turkey stays the problem in the south.

England to France, Spring 1932: Change of plan. A BEL will hold this spring, not move to HOL. Germany's A KIE supports A HOL, so an attack would bounce and leave BEL open. I will give you notice before any move toward BEL or Picardy. Please keep A PAR, A BRE and F MAO out of the Channel and BEL.

England to Germany, Spring 1932: I accept your holds for now. A BEL and my fleets hold this spring, and F NTH and F ENG stay out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic while you keep A HOL and A KIE out of BEL and NTH. HOL remains disputed, and I will reconsider if it stays this autumn. Keep your word on BEL and NOR.

France to England, Spring 1932: As noticed, A PAR moves to Picardy this spring. A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO hold. I make no move into Belgium, Burgundy or the Channel this turn. I will give notice before any autumn move toward BEL. Please keep F LON and F ENG off Picardy and Brest, and keep F NTH out of the Channel.

Germany to France, Spring 1932: My A MUN and A HOL hold this spring, and no German unit enters BEL or BUR. Belgium is open to you, and I will give you notice before any autumn move near the Low Countries. Please keep your armies out of MUN and BUR, and tell me your Spring orders for PAR and BRE.

Germany to England, Spring 1932: A HOL holds and A KIE holds. I have no move on BEL or NTH this spring. Keep F NTH and F ENG out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic, and I will do the same. Tell me your Spring orders for BEL and NTH so we avoid a costly war in the Low Countries.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1932: A SIL, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring, and our pact on WAR, SWE and GAL stands. I will not enter WAR or SWE. Please keep A WAR, F SWE and A UKR out of BER, DEN and KIE. Tell me whether A RUM or A WAR moves against Austria this spring.

Italy confirms our pact stands. A GRE, F ION, A NAP, A ROM, F SMY and A VEN will not enter TRI, SER, BUD or VIE this spring. I have no army in BUL, and I will not move toward SER or BUD. Please keep your armies out of GRE, ALB and BUL. My spring orders are holds, and I will tell you if that changes.

Your move into BUL breaks our truce. Italy now treats BUL as a target and will respond. I will not move on CON or BLA this spring if your A CON and F BLA stay where they are. Your A BUL must not advance toward GRE or SMY. Send your Spring 1932 orders in writing, and I will decide after reading them.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1932: A UKR, F SEV and A WAR hold this spring. I make no promise about RUM, BUD, SER or VIE beyond this turn. Your holds on RUM, BUD and SER are noted. Keep your armies out of UKR, WAR, SEV and GAL, and we can both keep our centers. I will reply with my Fall plans once I see your Spring result.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1932: A WAR, F SWE and A UKR hold this spring, and none enters BER, DEN, KIE or the Baltic. Our pact on WAR and SWE stands for now. Please confirm A SIL, A DEN and A KIE stay off WAR and SWE. Tell me whether A SIL moves toward BOH or VIE this year, and what MUN does.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1932: F SEV holds in the Black Sea this spring and will not enter BLA, CON, SMY or BUL. I confirm A CON and F BLA should stay out of SEV and UKR. SER and BUL remain undecided; we can discuss them after Austria's position settles. Please confirm your orders in writing.

Turkey holds A BUL this Spring, as I said. My A CON and F BLA hold too. I will not move on GRE or SMY while F SMY stays off CON and ANK and A GRE and F ION stay out of BUL. Any move by A GRE or F ION into BUL ends our truce. Send your Spring orders and say whether you will attack BUL.

Turkey's A BUL and A CON hold this Spring, and F BLA holds too. We will not enter SER, RUM, BUD or VIE. Please keep your armies out of BUL and GRE, and keep A BUD and A SER off BUL. Our truce holds while yours does. Send your Spring 1932 orders so we can confirm.

Turkey holds A CON, A BUL and F BLA this Spring. Please keep F SEV out of BLA and CON, and keep your armies out of ANK and BUL, as agreed. Turkey's moves are aimed at Austria's SER and RUM, not your positions. Confirm your Spring orders in writing so our understanding holds.

notes.note: Spring 1932: all five hold per pacts with Russia, Italy, Germany, Turkey. No unowned centers reachable. Italy and Russia kept so far. Watch Turkey's CON/BUL and Russia on RUM. Reassess Fall 1932 for any gain.

Spring 1932: holding all per pledges. Germany said A HOL and A KIE hold, not moving on BEL/NTH; France said PAR to PIC and no BEL move. I told Germany I'd reconsider HOL if it stays this autumn. Keep NTH/ENG out of DEN, KIE, Baltic. Watch France PIC move and Germany HOL.

Spring 1932: all hold to keep pacts. Austria (MUN/BOH/SIL, VIE/TRI/BUD), Russia (WAR/SWE/GAL, Baltic), England (BEL/NTH/NOR, DEN/KIE out of reach), France (BUR/BEL/RUH). England and France have not broken terms yet. Watch England's BEL and NTH and Russia's WAR. Next: reassess Fall for HOL and any unowned gains.

Spring 1932: GRE to unowned ALB, supported by ION (GRE to ALB). Other units hold to keep pacts: Austria (no TRI/SER/BUD/VIE entry), Turkey (no CON/ANK/BUL/BLA entry; SMY holds). Turkey broke truce by taking BUL; watch A BUL and Turkish moves toward GRE/SMY. Next: consider taking BUL if Turkey is weak, and convoy options via ION.

Spring 1932: all hold to keep pacts with Austria, Germany, Turkey. RUM strikes bounce vs Austrian supports. Keep SEV out of BLA/CON/SMY/BUL. Keep SWE out of DEN/NOR. Austria, Germany kept terms so far; Turkey undecided on SER/BUL. Next: reassess RUM if Austrian supports weaken.

Spring 1932: PAR to PIC after notice to England; BRE, MAO, MAR, POR hold. England's BEL holds now, so no BEL attack this spring. Notified England and Germany. Aim BEL in autumn if empty. Keep out of BUR, MUN, Tunis, Channel.

Spring 1932: defensive. F BLA and A CON support A BUL holding, with A BUL holding. Italy broke the truce by threatening BUL, so I need to hold my 3 centers. Italy has not yet attacked CON or BLA. Russia says SER and BUL are undecided. Austria's truce holds. Next: look for an opening vs SER/RUM or GRE once Italy's F SMY and A GRE commit elsewhere. Watch for an Italian strike on BUL.

messages.body: Austria to Russia, Fall 1932: Turkey has only three centers and is our shared problem. Let's plan for 1933. If you keep F SEV and A UKR pointed at the Black Sea and Armenia, Austria will move against Bulgaria and Constantinople once spring orders are set. Please confirm you will not enter RUM, SER or BUD before then.

England to Germany, Fall 1932: A HOL is still in Holland, and HOL is a center you have held since our pledges. I will not move on HOL this autumn if you keep A HOL and A KIE in place without moving on BEL or NTH. Confirm your orders now. If A HOL moves against BEL, I will support A BEL to hold and we fight in the Low Countries.

England to France, Fall 1932: I hold A BEL and my fleets this autumn, with no move on Picardy or Brest. Please confirm A PAR, A BRE and A MAR stay out of BEL and the Channel, and tell me whether you move toward BEL or PIC this autumn. I will give you notice before any change.

England to Russia, Fall 1932: My STP, NOR and LVP fleets hold this autumn and stay out of the Baltic and Sweden. Please confirm F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI, and tell me whether A WAR or F SEV will strike Germany's SIL or DEN this autumn. I want warning before any northern move.

France to England, Fall 1932: Your A BEL is still in Belgium. Are you holding or moving it this autumn? If it leaves, my A PIC may enter BEL, and I will give you notice first. Please keep F LON and F ENG off Picardy and Brest, and tell me your Fall 1932 orders.

France to Germany, Fall 1932: My A PIC will not enter Belgium unless England's army leaves, and I will give you notice first. I have no move on Burgundy or Munich. Please keep A HOL, A KIE and A MUN out of Belgium and Burgundy, and tell me your Fall 1932 orders.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1932: A DEN, A KIE, A SIL and A HOL hold this autumn. Please tell me your Fall orders for WAR, SWE and UKR. If Russia keeps its armies off BER, DEN and KIE, I will keep mine off WAR and SWE, and we can both watch Austria's RUM and SER.

Germany to England, Fall 1932: A HOL and A KIE hold, and I will not move on BEL or NTH. Please confirm your Fall orders for BEL, NTH and NOR. Keep F NTH and F ENG out of DEN and KIE, and we avoid a costly Low Countries war while we both look at France.

Germany to France, Fall 1932: Belgium is England's for now, so I have no move there. My A MUN and A SIL hold. Please keep your armies out of MUN and BUR, and tell me your Fall orders for PIC, PAR and BEL. I will give notice before any move near the Rhine.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1932: Your A BUL ended our truce, and I will not accept it. Withdraw A BUL from Bulgaria by autumn or I will strike it with A GRE, A ALB and F ION. Confirm your A CON and F BLA stay out of GRE, SMY and ALB this turn, and state your Fall orders.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1932: Turkey now holds BUL with A BUL, next to your A SER and A RUM. Taking BUL would hurt Turkey and help us both. I will keep my units out of TRI, VIE, BUD and SER. Tell me if you will move on BUL this autumn, so we avoid a clash in GRE and ALB.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1932: Austria is our shared problem. I propose we split it: Russia strikes RUM this autumn with UKR and SEV, and Turkey takes SER with A BUL. F SEV stays out of BLA, CON and SMY as agreed. Confirm in writing whether you will attack SER this autumn.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1932: Your armies massed on RUM, BUD and SER break our understanding. I will hold A UKR and F SEV only if A RUM, A BUD and A SER stay put. State your Fall orders now, and confirm that none of your units enters UKR, WAR, SEV or GAL.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1932: Our pact on WAR and SWE stands. Please confirm A SIL, A DEN and A KIE will not move into WAR, SWE or the Baltic this autumn. Tell me your Fall orders for SIL and MUN, and whether you will attack Austria before I commit A WAR.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1932: Turkey holds A BUL, A CON and F BLA this autumn and will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Please keep A GRE and F ION out of BUL and confirm your Fall orders in writing so we can both hold our lines.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1932: Turkey proposes that Russia keep F SEV out of BLA and CON, and that we coordinate against Austria. Turkey would take SER and Russia RUM once Austria weakens. Please confirm your Fall 1932 orders and whether you will move on RUM this autumn.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1932: Turkey holds A BUL, A CON and F BLA this autumn. We ask that A SER and A BUD stay out of BUL and that your forces avoid BLA and CON. Please send your Fall 1932 orders so our truce can stand while we both hold our centers.

Austria will not move on GRE or ALB, and our A SER and A BUD will not enter TRI or VIE. I am still weighing BUL this autumn and have not locked it. Keep your fleets out of the Adriatic corner near TRI and SER, and I will tell you before any move changes our pact.

Austria's A RUM, A BUD and A SER hold this autumn, and none enters UKR, WAR, SEV or GAL. Please keep A UKR, F SEV and A WAR holding too. Turkey is the real target for both of us in 1933, and I will discuss that plan once spring orders are set.

Austria's A RUM, A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold this autumn, and none of us enters BUL or GRE. Please keep A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of SER, BUD and RUM. Our truce holds while yours does, and I will tell you if plans change before spring.

England to France, Fall 1932: A BEL holds this autumn and I make no move toward Picardy or Brest. F LON and F ENG stay where they are. If I ever change plans near BEL, you will get notice first. Please give me the same notice before A PIC or A PAR moves into BEL or the Channel.

England to Germany, Fall 1932: I will hold A BEL and my fleets this autumn, with no move on NTH or NOR. F NTH and F ENG stay out of DEN and KIE. In return, keep A HOL and A KIE holding and do not move on BEL or NTH. If A HOL moves into BEL or the North Sea, I will support BEL to hold and we fight.

France to England, Fall 1932: My A PIC, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO all hold this autumn. I have no order into BEL, the Channel or Brest. Your A BEL is still there, so I am not moving on it. I will give you notice before any change in the west. Please keep your fleets off Brest and Picardy.

France to Germany, Fall 1932: My units hold this autumn: A PIC, A PAR, A MAR, A BRE and A POR, with no move on BUR, MUN or BEL. I will not enter Burgundy or Munich. I ask that your A MUN, A SIL, A HOL and A KIE stay out of BUR and BEL. I will give you notice before any change near the Rhine or the Low Countries.

Germany to England, Fall 1932: A HOL and A KIE hold this autumn, and I have no move on BEL or NTH. Confirm your Fall orders for BEL, NTH and NOR. Keep F NTH and F ENG out of DEN and KIE, and we both avoid a costly Low Countries war while we look at France.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1932: A DEN, A KIE, A SIL and A HOL hold. I will keep my armies off WAR and SWE while your A WAR, F SWE and A UKR stay out of BER, DEN, KIE and the Baltic. Tell me your Fall orders for UKR and RUM. I will watch Austria's RUM and SER with you.

Germany to France, Fall 1932: Belgium is England's for now, so I have no move there. My A MUN and A SIL hold. I ask that your armies stay out of MUN and BUR. I will give you notice before any move near the Rhine or the Low Countries. Please confirm your Fall orders for PIC and PAR.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1932: Your A BUL broke our truce and Italy will not accept it. Withdraw A BUL from Bulgaria this autumn, or A GRE, A ALB and F ION will strike it. Your A CON and F BLA must stay out of GRE, SMY and ALB. Send your Fall orders in writing and I will state mine.

Russia to England, Fall 1932: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR holds this autumn and is not aimed at SIL or DEN. Keep STP, NOR and LVP out of the Baltic and Sweden, and I will warn you before any northern change.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1932: A UKR and F SEV hold this autumn. I will not enter BUD or SER this autumn. Your armies on RUM, BUD and SER worry me, so keep them out of UKR, WAR, SEV and GAL and we can both keep our centers. Turkey is the common threat, as you say.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1932: Our pact on WAR and SWE stands. A WAR and F SWE hold this autumn, and neither enters BER, DEN, KIE or the Baltic. Please keep A SIL, A DEN, A KIE and A HOL off WAR and SWE. I will tell you before any move toward SIL or MUN.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1932: F SEV will stay out of BLA, CON and SMY as agreed. Your proposal to coordinate against Austria is sensible. Attack SER with A BUL and I will watch RUM. Keep A CON and F BLA out of SEV and UKR, and confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Turkey's position: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this Fall. Turkey will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Italy's threat to strike BUL with A GRE, A ALB and F ION would be a war move, and Turkey will defend BUL. Keep A GRE and F ION out of BUL and CON, and we can both hold our lines. Confirm your Fall orders in writing.

notes.note: Fall 1932: all holds per pledges. Germany (A HOL, A KIE holding) and France (no move on BEL/BRE) have kept word. Attacking HOL would bounce vs KIE support and break peace. Watch Germany's DEN/KIE and Russia's SWE/WAR. Revisit HOL if Germany keeps it and I can get support. Keep fleets out of Baltic and Brest/Picardy.

Fall 1932: all hold to keep 5 SCs; BUL attack bounces vs A BUL and breaks Russia/Turkey pacts. Russia says no BUD/SER entry; Turkey and Italy kept so far. Reassess Spring 1933: consider BUL/CON vs Turkey with Russia's help; watch Russia on RUM.

Fall 1932: all hold; no unowned centers reachable without attacking a pact partner. England pledged no move on HOL if we hold HOL and KIE. Russia's WAR/SWE pact holds. Austria and France quiet. Revisit if England or Russia breaks terms.

Fall 1932: all hold, keeping 5 SCs. No unowned SCs. Promised England no Channel or BEL move; ENGLAND's A BEL still there, so no attack on it. Germany kept out of MUN/BUR. Next: watch whether England's A BEL leaves; if so, PIC to BEL with notice. Revisit convoy plan only with England's agreement.

Fall 1932: Austria's stated holds on RUM/BUD/SER leave RUM with one defender, so UKR to RUM with SEV support gets 2 vs 1. Keep WAR and SWE holding for the Germany and England pacts. Austria and Turkey have broken terms by massing, so I am no longer bound by them. Watch for BUD or SER supports and Turkey's BUL moves.

Fall 1932: A ALB returns to GRE (our center), F ION supports it. NAP, ROM, SMY, VEN hold. Turkey took BUL and broke truce; can't reach BUL this turn. Next: strike BUL from GRE/ALB if still Turkish. Austria keeping pact, not on GRE/ALB. Keep SMY protected.

Fall 1932: holding BUL, CON, BLA. F BLA and A CON support BUL holding to deter Italy's GRE strike. Austria, Russia and Italy all say they stay out of BUL/CON. Russia offers SER/RUM split, but A BUL to SER would bounce without support. Reassess in Spring 1933; watch Italy's GRE/ION.

messages.body: Austria to Russia, Spring 1933: I am moving on Turkey now. A SER attacks BUL with A BUD supporting, and A VIE and F TRI hold. Please keep A RUM, A WAR and F SEV out of Austrian centers, and press Turkey's CON and ANK from the Black Sea. Confirm you will not enter BUD, SER or VIE.

Austria to Turkey: our truce ends this spring. A SER attacks BUL with A BUD supporting, because Turkey has broken the balance in the Balkans and Russia is pressing you too. Keep A CON and F BLA home, and I will not enter CON or ANK.

Austria to Italy: I am attacking BUL this spring with A SER and A BUD. I will not move into GRE or ALB, and I ask that your A GRE and A ION stay out of BUL, SER and BUD. Tell me if you plan to move on Turkey through GRE.

England to Germany, Spring 1933: Your A HOL and A KIE have held for two years. What are your orders this spring? If A HOL stays, I hold A BEL and my fleets and will not attack. If A HOL moves into BEL or NTH, I will support A BEL and we fight. Please confirm F NTH and F ENG stay out of DEN and KIE on your side.

England to France, Spring 1933: A BEL and my fleets hold this spring, with no move on Picardy or Brest. Please confirm A PIC, A PAR and A BRE stay out of BEL and the Channel. If you plan any autumn move toward BEL, give me notice first as before, and I will do the same.

France to England, Spring 1933: I hold A PIC, A PAR, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO this spring, with no move on BEL, the Channel or Brest. Please confirm your A BEL, F LON and F ENG hold too. I will give notice before any autumn move toward Belgium.

France to Germany, Spring 1933: My armies hold this spring, with no move on Burgundy, Munich or Belgium. Please confirm your A MUN, A SIL, A HOL, A KIE and A DEN hold or stay out of BUR and BEL. Tell me your Spring 1933 orders so we avoid bounces.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1933: A SIL, A DEN, A KIE, A HOL and A MUN hold this spring. Austria has only four centers and its army is thin. I propose we turn on Austria together. Your RUM and SER are next to Vienna, while my MUN and SIL can reach BOH and VIE. Tell me your Spring orders for WAR, RUM and SWE.

Germany to England, Spring 1933: A HOL, A KIE and A DEN hold this spring, and I have no move on BEL or NTH. Your F NTH and A BEL are next to HOL, so I want to keep the Low Countries quiet. Confirm your Spring orders for BEL, NTH and NOR, and whether you will move on HOL this year.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1933: Your A BUL broke our truce. Withdraw it from Bulgaria this spring or A GRE and F ION will strike it. Your A CON and F BLA must stay out of GRE, SMY and ALB. Send your Spring 1933 orders in writing and I will state mine.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1933: Turkey holds BUL. I plan to strike it from GRE and ALB, not from SER or BUD, and my units will not enter TRI, VIE, BUD or SER. Tell me your Spring 1933 orders and whether A SER or A RUM is moving on BUL, so we do not clash.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1933: Your A BUD, A SER and A VIE are massed beside my A RUM and it's Spring. State your exact orders now. If any Austrian unit enters RUM or UKR, I will defend RUM and fight. If you hold, I hold too and we discuss Turkey afterward.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1933: Austria is massed on my RUM border and its BUD and SER units threaten you as well. Let's strike SER together: your A BUL moves to SER and I will support from RUM if Austria leaves it open. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1933: Turkey holds A BUL, A CON and F BLA this spring and will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Please keep A GRE and F ION out of BUL and confirm your Spring orders in writing. A strike on BUL would only trade our centres for nothing, so let us both hold.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1933: Turkey holds A BUL, A CON and F BLA. F SEV must stay out of BLA and CON. We should coordinate against Austria: I will press SER with A BUL once Austria commits to RUM or BUD, and you take RUM. Please confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1933: Our truce has held, but Italy and Russia are massing against us. Please confirm A SER, A BUD, A VIE, F TRI and A RUM hold, and that none of us enters BUL or GRE. Tell me if your plans change before Fall.

Austria confirms: A SER attacks BUL with A BUD supporting. A VIE and F TRI hold. No Austrian unit enters GRE or ALB. Please keep A GRE and F ION out of BUL, SER and BUD, and tell me your Spring orders for GRE and ALB so we avoid any clash on Turkey.

Austria's orders: A SER attacks BUL, A BUD supports, A VIE and F TRI hold. We will not enter RUM, UKR, WAR, SEV or GAL. Please keep A RUM, A WAR and F SEV out of Austrian centers and press Turkey from the Black Sea. Confirm you will not enter BUD, SER or VIE.

Austria: our truce ends this spring. A SER attacks BUL with A BUD supporting, because Turkey has broken the Balkan balance. Keep A CON and F BLA at home. Austria will not enter CON or ANK this spring. If you withdraw from BUL, we can talk about terms.

England to France, Spring 1933: Confirmed, A BEL, F LON, F ENG and my other fleets hold this spring. A PIC, A PAR and A BRE staying out of BEL and the Channel is appreciated. I will give you notice before any autumn move near BEL, and I expect the same from you before any move toward Picardy, Brest or the Channel.

England to Germany, Spring 1933: Your A HOL, A KIE and A DEN holding is noted. I will keep A BEL and my fleets in place this spring, with F NTH and F ENG out of DEN and KIE. Keep A HOL out of BEL and NTH, and warn me before any move on Holland or the North Sea.

France to England, Spring 1933: Confirmed. A PIC, A PAR, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO all hold this spring, with no move on BEL, the Channel or Brest. I will give you notice before any autumn move toward Belgium. Please give me the same notice before any move toward Picardy or Brest.

Germany to England, Spring 1933: A HOL, A KIE and A DEN hold this spring, and I have no move on BEL or NTH. My fleets stay out of the North Sea. I am not promising anything beyond this spring, so keep F NTH and F ENG out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic, and warn me before any northern change.

Germany to France, Spring 1933: Confirmed, my A MUN, A SIL, A HOL, A KIE and A DEN all hold this spring. None enters BUR, BEL or RUH. Please keep your armies out of MUN and BUR, and give me notice before any move toward the Low Countries or the Rhine.

Italy confirms: A GRE and F ION hold this spring, and no Italian unit enters BUL, SER, BUD, TRI or VIE. Our pact stands while your Austrian units stay out of GRE, ALB and ION. If you take BUL, let us discuss the autumn line before either of us moves south.

Italy confirms: A GRE and F ION hold this spring, and nothing from Italy enters BUL, CON, BLA or SMY. Your A BUL broke our truce, and I still expect it withdrawn. If it stays into Fall, Italy will strike it. Keep A CON and F BLA out of GRE and SMY.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1933: Your move on Turkey is your choice, but A RUM, A WAR and F SEV will hold this spring and stay where they are. If any Austrian unit enters RUM, UKR, WAR or SEV, I will defend and counterattack. I make no promise about BUD, SER or VIE beyond this turn.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1933: A WAR and F SWE hold this spring, and neither enters BER, DEN, KIE or the Baltic. Keep A SIL and A MUN off WAR and SWE. Turning on Austria is sensible, and I will consider it after this season. Tell me whether your A SIL goes to BOH or VIE this spring.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1933: Agreed in principle. A RUM holds this spring, and F SEV stays out of BLA, CON and SMY. Press SER with A BUL while Austria is committed to Turkey. Confirm that your A CON and F BLA hold, and that none of your units enters UKR, SEV or RUM.

Turkey's A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring. Your A SER and A BUD are massing against Bulgaria, and Turkey will defend it. I will not enter SER, RUM, BUD or VIE. Please keep your armies out of BUL, CON and ANK, and tell me your Spring orders before Fall.

Turkey holds A BUL, A CON and F BLA this spring, and we will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Any attack on BUL from GRE or ALB would be a war move that Turkey will resist. Please keep A GRE and F ION out of BUL and send your Spring orders in writing.

notes.note: Spring 1933: all hold, keeping 5 SCs (BRE MAR PAR POR SPA). No unowned SCs reachable without breaking deals. England (A BEL, fleets) and Germany (MUN, SIL, HOL, KIE, DEN) kept holds so far. No BEL/Channel/BUR/MUN move. Autumn: give notice before any BEL move. Revisit convoy via MAO to ENG only with England's agreement.

Spring 1933: all hold to keep RUM, WAR, SEV, SWE, MOS. Promised Austria, Germany and Turkey no entry into BUD/SER/VIE, and to keep WAR and SWE out of Baltic/BER/DEN/KIE. Austria attacking Turkey; watch whether Austria turns on RUM or SEV. Germany proposed turning on Austria; consider after this season. Next: possible BLA convoy setup for RUM.

Spring 1933: SIL to BOH, supported by MUN, to pressure Austria's VIE. DEN, HOL, KIE hold to guard vs England and Russia. Watch Russia's reply on SIL and England's NTH/BEL. Next: consider VIE in Fall if BOH holds; keep the northern pacts.

Spring 1933: held all. Planned BUL attack from SER lacks a BUD support option (only BUD-supports-SER-to-BUL is missing), so it would bounce. Pacts: Russia (no RUM/UKR/WAR/SEV/GAL entry; they threaten RUM), Italy (no TRI/SER/BUD/VIE entry; kept), Turkey (no RUM/SER entry; truce ended in messages). Reassess Fall 1933 for BUL or RUM gains.

Spring 1933: all hold as pledged to France and Germany. Germany says HOL/KIE/DEN hold and no move on BEL/NTH. Attacking HOL would bounce vs KIE support and break peace. Watch Germany HOL/KIE and France PIC. Revisit HOL in autumn if Germany stays passive and I can get support. Keep fleets out of Baltic.

Spring 1933: holding BUL with A CON and F BLA supporting, so SER+BUD attack (2) is beaten by 3 defense. Austria and Italy both threaten BUL; Russia wants SER strike but I'm not moving. Watch Italy GRE/ION and Russian SEV. Consider counterattack on SER/GRE only if it's safe.

Spring 1933: GRE moves to unowned ALB, supported by ION, to gain a center. Austria said it will not enter GRE or ALB. Nothing enters BUL, SER, BUD, TRI or VIE. Turkey broke truce with BUL; watch for Turkish moves toward GRE/SMY. Next: take Turkish BUL if it is weak, and keep the Austria pact.

messages.body: Austria to Italy, Fall 1933: I plan to hit Bulgaria with A SER and A BUD support, but I will not enter GRE or ALB. Keep A GRE and F ION out of BUL, SER and BUD, and I will keep my armies out of Greece and Albania. Tell me your autumn orders so we do not clash.

England to Germany, Fall 1933: I hold A BEL and my fleets this autumn, with no move on HOL, DEN or KIE. Please confirm A HOL, A KIE and A DEN hold too. Any move into HOL or NTH from either side means a fight, so let's both keep the Low Countries quiet while we look elsewhere.

France to England, Fall 1933: I have 5 centers and need growth. Germany is the power that can give us both centers, through HOL, BEL and MUN. Proposal: you keep F NTH and your fleets off Brest and Picardy, and in 1934 we coordinate on Germany. I will tell you before any move into BEL or BUR.

France to Germany, Fall 1933: My A PIC, A PAR, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO all hold this autumn, with no move on BUR, MUN or BEL. Please confirm A MUN, A HOL and A KIE hold too. I will give notice before any spring move toward the Low Countries.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1933: Austria is weakest on the board with four centers. I propose a joint strike: my A BOH moves to VIE this autumn. Your A RUM moves to BUD and your A WAR to GAL, taking Austrian centers in the south. Confirm, and we split Austria's centers afterward.

Italy, Fall 1933: A ALB returns to GRE and F ION holds. No Italian unit enters SER, BUD, TRI or VIE. Since you are contesting BUL, please confirm your orders, and keep your units out of GRE, ALB and ION. Italy will not move on BUL this autumn.

Italy, Fall 1933: Your A BUL is still in Bulgaria, which broke our truce. Italy's A GRE and F ION hold this autumn. Keep A CON, F BLA and A BUL out of GRE, SMY and ION, and we can both hold. Send your Fall orders in writing.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1933: Austria has massed on my RUM border and is fighting Turkey. I propose we attack Austria together this autumn. Your A SIL to BOH or VIE, and I will hold RUM and watch. Tell me your exact Fall orders for SIL, MUN and BOH. A WAR and F SWE stay off BER, DEN and KIE.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1933: Austria is weakened by fighting you in the Balkans. Keep A BUL pressing SER. My A RUM holds and F SEV stays out of BLA, CON and SMY. Please confirm in writing that your A CON, F BLA and A BUL will not enter UKR, SEV or RUM this autumn.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1933: Your armies massed on RUM are a threat to me. I will hold RUM and SEV this autumn. Confirm A RUM is no longer aimed at RUM, UKR, WAR or SEV. If you move on Turkey, I will not interfere, but any unit entering RUM will be met with force.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1933: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold. Austria's A SER and A BUD are the main threat to Bulgaria. Turkey has no plans for SER, BUD or VIE. Please confirm your Fall orders in writing and keep your armies out of BUL and CON. If you pull back from Bulgaria, Turkey can discuss a non-aggression pact on the Serbian border.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1933: Turkey holds A BUL, A CON and F BLA this autumn. Our coordination against Austria stands, but Turkey will not move A BUL to SER without Austria's RUM and BUD committed elsewhere. Please keep F SEV out of BLA, CON and SMY, and confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1933: Turkey holds A BUL, A CON and F BLA. We will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Please confirm A GRE and F ION hold or move away from Bulgaria. Any Italian move on BUL would be a war move that Turkey will resist. Send your Fall orders in writing so we can both hold our lines.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1933: We have no unit in RUM and none aimed at RUM, UKR, WAR, SEV or GAL this autumn. Our armies are A BUD, A SER, A VIE and F TRI, and I intend to keep them out of RUM and your Black Sea holdings. Please hold RUM and SEV as you say, and do not enter BUD, SER, VIE or TRI.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1933: Our Bulgaria operation is A SER attacking BUL, and I will not enter GRE or ALB. Please keep A GRE and F ION out of BUL, SER and BUD, as you have promised. Italy taking GRE and ALB is fine with me, and I will not contest them. Confirm your Fall orders.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1933: The truce is over. A SER attacks BUL this autumn, and Austria will not enter CON or ANK. If you pull A BUL back out of Bulgaria, we can discuss terms on the Serbian border. Otherwise expect a fight for Bulgaria, and keep F BLA and A CON at home.

England to France, Fall 1933: Noted. Our fleets stay off Brest and Picardy this autumn, and A BEL holds. I'm open to discussing Germany in 1934, but I need to see your spring orders first. Please keep A PIC out of BEL and give me notice before any move into BEL or BUR, as you promised.

Germany to England, Fall 1933: Confirmed. A HOL, A KIE and A DEN hold this autumn, with no German move on BEL or NTH. Keep F NTH and F ENG out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic, and we will both keep the Low Countries quiet while we look at France and Russia.

Germany to France, Fall 1933: Confirmed. A MUN, A HOL and A KIE hold this autumn. No German unit enters BUR, BEL or RUH. Please keep your armies out of MUN and BUR, and give me notice before any spring move toward the Low Countries or the Rhine.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1933: Agreed. My A BOH moves to VIE this autumn. Please move A RUM to BUD and A WAR to GAL as you proposed, and keep F SWE and all Russian units out of BER, DEN and KIE. We split Austria's centers afterward.

Italy, Fall 1933: A ALB returns to GRE and F ION holds. No Italian unit enters SER, BUD, TRI or VIE, and Italy will not move on BUL this autumn. Our pact stands while your armies stay out of GRE, ALB and ION. Let us discuss the Spring 1934 line before either of us moves south.

Italy, Fall 1933: A ALB returns to GRE and F ION holds. No Italian unit enters BUL, CON, BLA or SMY this autumn. Your A BUL broke our truce, and Italy still expects it withdrawn. Keep A CON, F BLA and A BUL out of GRE, SMY and ION, and we can both hold.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1933: I am open to striking Austria, but I will not move A RUM out, since it is my home center. A WAR to GAL is possible, but first show me A SIL and MUN orders. If your A BOH goes to VIE, my WAR and SWE stay put and my armies stay off BER, DEN and KIE. Confirm your SIL and MUN orders in writing.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1933: Confirmed: A RUM, A WAR, F SEV and F SWE hold this autumn, and none of them enters BLA, CON, SMY, BUL or SER. Austria is stretched fighting you, so press SER with A BUL now while its BUD and RUM units are tied up. Please confirm your A CON, F BLA and A BUL orders in writing.

Turkey holds A BUL, A CON and F BLA this Fall. None of them will enter UKR, SEV or RUM this autumn. A BUL moves to SER only once Austria's RUM and BUD are committed elsewhere, so please keep F SEV out of BLA, CON and SMY and confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Turkey holds A BUL, A CON and F BLA this Fall and will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Your A GRE and F ION are holding, as you confirmed, so please keep them there. Any Italian move into BUL, CON or BLA will be resisted. Send your Fall orders in writing.

notes.note: Fall 1933: all hold, keeping 5 SCs. No unowned SCs. England and Germany kept holds so far. Promised notice before any BEL/BUR move. Germany's MUN/HOL/KIE held. Next: test England on a spring convoy via MAO to ENG only if England agrees; watch Germany's Low Countries moves.

Fall 1933: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS, RUM, SEV, SWE, WAR). No unowned centers; RUM->BUD unsupported would bounce and leave RUM open. Promised Germany/Austria/Turkey no entry to BUD/SER/VIE/BER/DEN/KIE. Germany's BOH->VIE and Turkey's BUL->SER still unconfirmed. Reassess in Spring 1934 if Austrian supports weaken.

Fall 1933: BOH to VIE as proposed to Russia, unsupported, may bounce; RUM/WAR not yet confirmed by Russia. DEN, HOL, KIE, MUN hold to guard centers and pacts with England and France. England and France have kept terms so far. Next: check Russia's RUM/WAR moves and Austria's VIE response; keep Low Countries quiet.

Fall 1933: A ALB returns to GRE, F ION holds, others hold. Promised Austria and Turkey no Italian move on BUL/SER/BUD/TRI/VIE/CON/BLA. Turkey's A BUL broke truce; Austria attacking BUL. Watch for an unowned-center opening; no ALB/BUL reach now.

Fall 1933: held all four SCs. Attack on BUL unsupported (no BUD-to-SER-to-BUL support option), so it would bounce. Russia has kept RUM/SEV holds; Italy kept GRE/ALB/ION. Turkey broke truce on BUL. Next: seek a real BUL plan with support or reassess in Spring 1934; keep TRI/VIE/BUD safe.

Fall 1933: held all units per pledges to France and Germany. Germany (HOL/KIE/DEN hold) and France (no BEL/Brest move) have kept word. Keep fleets out of Baltic and Brest/Picardy. Consider HOL attack in 1934 only if Germany stays passive and KIE support is absent. Watch France PIC/PAR and Russia SWE/WAR.

Fall 1933: holding BUL with A CON and F BLA supporting (3 vs Austrian SER+BUD). Italy and Russia say they stay out of BUL/CON; Italy keeps GRE/ION held. Austria's truce is over. Watch F SMY next to CON and Russian SEV. Revisit SER strike only after Austria's RUM/BUD commit elsewhere.

messages.body: Austria to Turkey, Spring 1934: The attack on BUL was costly for both of us. A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI all hold this spring, and Austria will not enter BUL, CON or ANK. Please keep A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of SER, BUD and RUM, and confirm in writing.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1934: A BUD, A SER, A VIE and F TRI hold this spring. No Austrian unit enters RUM, UKR, WAR, SEV or GAL. Please keep A RUM and F SEV out of BUD, SER, VIE and TRI, and tell me whether you plan any move against Turkey's BUL that touches the Balkans.

Austria to Italy, Spring 1934: A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold this spring. We will not enter GRE, ALB or ION. Please keep A GRE and F ION out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE, and tell me whether Italy plans anything in BUL or the Adriatic this autumn.

England to France, Spring 1934: A BEL holds this spring and my fleets stay off Brest and Picardy. Germany's HOL and KIE are the obvious targets for both of us. Tell me your spring orders before we discuss any autumn move on HOL or MUN. I will give you notice before any move near BEL.

England to Germany, Spring 1934: I hold A BEL and my fleets this spring. Please confirm A HOL, A KIE and A DEN hold again. I need your word that none of your units enter BEL or NTH. I will keep F NTH out of DEN and KIE while you keep your pledge.

England to Russia, Spring 1934: My STP, NOR and LVP fleets hold this spring and stay out of the Baltic and Sweden. Please confirm F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI, and tell me whether A WAR or F SEV will strike SIL or DEN this year. I want warning before any northern move.

France to England, Spring 1934: Our western armies are holding, and A PIC has no move. What are A BEL and your fleets doing this spring? I would like a plan against Germany, with you taking HOL or KIE and me getting BEL once it is free. Tell me your intentions before any autumn move.

France to Germany, Spring 1934: My units hold this spring, with no move on BUR, MUN or BEL. Are you moving toward Belgium or Burgundy this year? I ask that your armies stay out of BUR and PIC. I will give you notice before any change near the Rhine.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1934: I am moving A BOH to VIE this spring, as we agreed. Please move A RUM to BUD and A WAR to GAL now, and keep F SWE and all Russian units out of BER, DEN and KIE. Confirm your Spring orders in writing. We split Austria's centers once VIE falls.

Germany to England, Spring 1934: A HOL, A KIE and A DEN hold this spring, with no German move on BEL or NTH. Please keep F NTH and F ENG out of HOL, DEN and KIE. Confirm your Spring orders for BEL, NTH and NOR, and tell me directly if you plan any move on Holland.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1934: A GRE, F ION, A NAP, A ROM, F SMY and A VEN hold this spring. No Italian unit enters BUL, SER, BUD, TRI or VIE. Please keep your armies out of GRE, ALB and ION, and tell me your Spring 1934 orders so we avoid any clash.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1934: Italy holds this spring and has no units aimed at BUL, CON, BLA or SMY. Keep A CON, F BLA and A BUL out of GRE, SMY and ION, and we can both hold. Send your Spring 1934 orders so we keep the Balkan line clear.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1934: Your A BUD, A SER and A VIE are next to my A RUM. Give me your exact Spring orders now. A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this spring. If you keep BUD, SER and VIE out of RUM, UKR, WAR and SEV, I will not attack you this turn.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1934: Is your A BOH moving to VIE this spring, and what do A SIL and A MUN do? I can move A WAR to GAL while A RUM holds. Confirm in writing, and keep your units out of WAR and SWE so we both stay safe.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1934: Confirm your Spring orders for A BUL, A CON and F BLA in writing. I will keep F SEV out of BLA, CON and SMY. If your A BUL presses SER while Austria is stretched, that suits me. Please keep your units out of RUM and SEV.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1934: A BUL, A CON and F BLA will hold. A SER and A BUD attacking BUL would bounce against three defenders and cost you units. Confirm your Spring orders in writing. If you pull back from Bulgaria, Turkey will discuss a Serbian border non-aggression pact.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1934: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring. Please confirm F SEV stays out of BLA and CON and that A RUM does not enter BUL. Is Russia still willing to press Austria's RUM and SER while I hold Bulgaria? Send your Spring orders.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1934: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring. Please confirm A GRE and F ION hold or stay out of BUL, CON, BLA and SMY. Any move into Bulgaria will be resisted. Send your Spring orders in writing so we both keep our lines.

Austria confirms: A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold this spring. We will not enter GRE, ALB or ION. Please keep A GRE, F ION and your other units out of BUL, SER, BUD, TRI and VIE. For autumn, let's talk before either of us moves on Bulgaria or the Adriatic.

Austria confirms: A BUD, A SER, A VIE and F TRI hold this spring. No Austrian unit enters RUM, UKR, WAR, SEV or GAL. Please keep A RUM, A WAR and F SEV out of BUD, SER, VIE and TRI. We will reassess in Fall once spring moves are known.

Austria confirms: A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold this spring. Austria will not enter BUL, CON or ANK. Please keep A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of SER, BUD and RUM. If you pull A BUL back from Bulgaria, we can discuss a Serbian border non-aggression pact.

England to Germany, Spring 1934: Confirmed for this spring. A BEL, F NTH, F ENG and my other units hold, and F NTH stays out of DEN, KIE and the Baltic. Keep A HOL, A KIE and A DEN holding and off BEL and NTH. HOL is still a center I claimed earlier, so I will decide my autumn moves after I see your Spring orders.

England to France, Spring 1934: A BEL holds this spring and my fleets hold, with no move on Picardy or Brest. Your western armies are holding too. I am open to a plan against Germany this autumn, but I need to see your Spring orders first. I will give you notice before any autumn move near HOL or BEL, and I expect the same from you.

France to England, Spring 1934: My orders are all holds: A PIC, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO. No move into BEL, BUR or the Channel. I am open to a plan against Germany: you take HOL or KIE, and I take BEL only if your A BEL leaves, with notice first. Please send your exact Spring 1934 orders for A BEL and the fleets before we discuss autumn.

Germany to England, Spring 1934: Confirmed. A HOL, A KIE and A DEN hold this spring. No German unit enters BEL or NTH. Please keep F NTH and F ENG out of HOL, DEN and KIE, and warn me before any northern change. I will tell you before any move near the Low Countries.

Germany to France, Spring 1934: My A MUN holds this spring, and no German unit enters BUR, PIC or BEL. Please keep your armies out of MUN and BUR. I will give you notice before any move near the Rhine or the Low Countries.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1934: Yes, A BOH moves to VIE this spring as agreed. A MUN and A HOL hold, and I will keep my armies off WAR and SWE. Please move A RUM to BUD and A WAR to GAL, and keep F SWE and all Russian units out of BER, DEN and KIE. We split Austria once VIE falls.

Italy confirms Spring 1934: A GRE, F ION, A NAP, A ROM, F SMY and A VEN all hold. No Italian unit enters SER, BUD, TRI, VIE or GRE-to-ALB this spring. Keep your armies out of GRE, ALB and ION. We can discuss the autumn line once Bulgaria's fate is clearer.

Italy confirms Spring 1934: all our units hold, including A GRE and F ION. Nothing from Italy enters BUL, CON, BLA or SMY this spring. Your A BUL still broke our truce, so keep A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of GRE, SMY and ION, and we can both hold.

Russia to England, Spring 1934: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR and F SEV hold this spring and are not aimed at SIL or DEN. Keep STP, NOR, LVP and NTH out of the Baltic and Sweden, and I will warn you before any northern change.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1934: A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this spring, and none enters BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Please keep your A BUD, A SER and A VIE out of RUM, UKR, WAR and SEV, and I will hold my position. Turkey's BUL is your matter; keep Balkan moves away from my Black Sea units.
