Russia to Germany, Spring 1934: A WAR and F SWE hold this spring, and A RUM holds too, so I cannot move to BUD or GAL yet. Confirm your A BOH to VIE in writing and show me A SIL and A MUN orders. Keep your armies off WAR and SWE and out of the Baltic, and we will talk again in Fall.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1934: F SEV stays out of BLA, CON and SMY, and A RUM holds, so it will not enter BUL. I will not attack your Balkan positions this spring. Keep A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of UKR, SEV and RUM, and we can discuss pressure on Austria's SER in Fall.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1934: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring. Turkey will not enter SER, BUD, VIE, RUM or TRI. Austria's A SER and A BUD bouncing on BUL would cost you two units. Pull A SER and A BUD back from BUL and Turkey will discuss a Serbian border non-aggression pact.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1934: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold. Turkey has no units aimed at GRE, SMY, ION or ALB. Please keep A GRE and F ION in place this spring. Any Italian move into BUL or CON would be a war move, and Turkey will resist it.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1934: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold. F SEV stays out of BLA and CON, as agreed, and no Turkish unit enters RUM or SEV. Press Austria's RUM and SER from your side while I hold Bulgaria. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

notes.note: Spring 1934: all hold to keep 4 SCs. Attack on BUL bounces vs 3 defenders, so no move. Pacts: Russia (no BUD/SER/VIE/TRI entry; we stay out of RUM/UKR/WAR/SEV/GAL), Italy (no TRI/SER/BUD/VIE entry; we stay out of GRE/ALB/ION), Turkey (no BUL/CON/ANK entry; offers Serbian border NAP if A BUL pulls back). Watch Russia on RUM and Turkey on SER. Reassess Fall 1934.

Spring 1934: all hold, keeping 5 SCs. No unowned SCs. England's A BEL and fleets hold; Germany's MUN holds, no BUR/BEL/PIC entry. Promises kept so far. Next: give England and Germany notice before any autumn move on BEL or HOL. Consider a spring convoy via MAO to ENG only with England's agreement.

Spring 1934: all hold. Germany's BOH->VIE pact unverified; Germany keeps asking RUM->BUD and WAR->GAL, which would bounce vs BUD. Austria kept no-entry terms so far. Turkey holding BUL/CON/BLA. Watch Germany for betrayal on WAR/SWE. Reassess in Fall if VIE falls or Austrian supports weaken.

Spring 1934: holding for peace. No unowned centers. HOL attack would bounce vs KIE support and break pledges. Germany and France kept word. Russia pledged SWE stays out of NWG/NOR/NTH/EDI. Revisit HOL in autumn only if Germany stays passive and KIE support is absent. Keep fleets out of Baltic/Brest/Picardy.

Spring 1934: holding BUL (A BUL hold, F BLA and A CON support BUL holding) against Austrian SER+BUD threat. Italy and Russia say they stay out of BUL/CON/BLA. Austria says it will not enter BUL/CON/ANK but its SER/BUD are a threat. Italy still upset about BUL. Next: reassess Fall 1934; consider SER strike only if Austria's RUM/BUD are committed.

Spring 1934: BOH to VIE as promised to Russia; likely bounces vs A VIE, so watch for Austria vacating VIE. Russia refused RUM->BUD and WAR->GAL, so the BUD/VIE split is off. Keep the England and France pacts. England has been steady but is eyeing HOL. Russia's WAR/SWE pact is unbroken. Next: reassess after Fall; avoid SWE and BEL attacks.

Spring 1934: all hold to keep pacts with Austria and Turkey. No unowned centers reachable (ALB is not a center). Turkey broke truce with BUL and is weakest (3 centers). Consider striking BUL/CON in Fall if Austria stays out of GRE/ALB. Watch Austria on SER/BUD and Turkey on CON/BLA.

messages.body: Austria to Russia, Fall 1934: I hold A BUD, A SER, A VIE and F TRI this autumn and will not enter RUM, UKR, WAR, SEV or GAL. Please confirm your RUM, WAR and SEV holds are defensive and that none of your units enters BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. If you plan any move toward Galicia or Hungary, tell me now so we avoid a clash.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1934: Our BUL attacks bounced last year and cost us both. I propose a concrete deal: A BUL moves out to RUM or stays in place only if you accept my terms. Simplest offer: Turkey keeps BUL and CON, Austria keeps out of CON and ANK, and we agree a Serbian border non-aggression pact now. Confirm in writing.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1934: I hold A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI this autumn and stay out of GRE, ALB and ION as agreed. Please confirm A GRE and F ION stay out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE. Tell me whether Italy plans anything against Bulgaria or the Adriatic this autumn so we avoid any clash.

England to Germany, Fall 1934: I'm holding A BEL, F NTH, F ENG and my other fleets this autumn. Will A HOL, A KIE and A DEN hold again? Tell me directly if any German unit moves toward BEL or NTH, and I'll do the same.

England to France, Fall 1934: My fleets stay off Brest and Picardy and A BEL holds. Please confirm A PIC and A BRE will not enter BEL or the Channel this autumn. What are your Fall orders? I'll give you notice before any move near HOL.

England to Russia, Fall 1934: My STP, NOR and LVP fleets hold and stay out of the Baltic. Please confirm F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI this autumn, and tell me whether A WAR or F SEV will strike Germany's SIL or DEN.

France to England, Fall 1934: My orders this autumn are all holds, with no move on BEL, BUR or the Channel. Are A BEL and your fleets staying put? If A BEL leaves Belgium, I would like to move A PIC to BEL, and I will give you notice first. In return, I ask that your fleets stay off Brest and Picardy.

France to Germany, Fall 1934: My armies hold this autumn, with no move on BUR, MUN or BEL. Please confirm A MUN, A HOL and A KIE hold or stay out of Burgundy and Belgium. I will give you notice before any change near the Rhine or the Low Countries.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1934: Austria still holds VIE, so our Spring plan failed. Let's coordinate now. I will hold A BOH and A MUN this autumn, no move into SIL or GAL. Please move A WAR to GAL and keep F SWE out of the Baltic. Next spring we split Austria: I take VIE and TRI, you take BUD, SER and RUM.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1934: Our pact is over unless you show me otherwise. I am preparing to strike VIE with A BOH, and Russia is pressing GAL and BUD. Withdraw A VIE to TYR or GAL, or give up VIE and I may spare your southern centers. Tell me your Fall orders for VIE, BUD and TRI.

Germany to England, Fall 1934: I hold A HOL, A KIE and A DEN this autumn, with no German move on BEL or NTH. Please confirm F NTH stays out of HOL, KIE and DEN, and tell me your Fall orders for BEL, NTH and NOR. Any move on HOL means war, so give me your word.

Italy, Fall 1934: Austria's A SER and any BUL attack are your business, but tell me your exact Fall orders. Italy's A GRE and F ION stay out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE. If Bulgaria falls to you, I expect you to keep your armies out of GRE and ALB, as before.

Italy, Fall 1934: Turkey has broken truce by holding A BUL, and I am watching it closely. Give me your Fall orders in writing. If A BUL, A CON and F BLA stay out of GRE, SMY and ION, Italy holds this autumn. Any move toward GRE or SMY will be answered.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1934: Austria still holds VIE, so your A BOH has not moved in. Confirm in writing that BOH to VIE is ordered this autumn, and show me your SIL and MUN orders. A RUM will not move to BUD until VIE falls. Keep your armies off WAR, SWE and the Baltic.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1934: Austria's SER and BUD are the Balkan prize while Austria is stretched. Your A BUL can press SER now. F SEV, A RUM and A WAR will stay out of BUL, BLA, CON and SMY. Confirm your A BUL, A CON and F BLA orders in writing.

Russia to England, Fall 1934: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR holds and is not aimed at SIL or DEN. Keep your STP, NOR and LVP fleets out of the Baltic and I will warn you before any northern change.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1934: I am considering A BUL to SER this autumn while Austria's BUD and RUM are stretched. Please move A RUM against Austria's RUM or BUD, keep F SEV out of BLA and CON, and confirm your Fall orders in writing. Tell me what you plan to do with A WAR.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1934: Your A SER and A BUD still threaten BUL. Confirm in writing whether they will hold or move this autumn. If they pull back out of Serbia's border with Bulgaria, Turkey will stay defensive and not enter SER or BUD. Turkey's A BUL, A CON and F BLA will hold.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1934: Please confirm A GRE and F ION hold or move away from Bulgaria. Turkey has no units aimed at GRE, SMY or ION this autumn. Keep your fleets out of BLA and CON, and we can both keep our Balkan lines stable while we focus elsewhere.

Austria will not withdraw from VIE. A VIE holds, A BUD supports it, and F TRI and A SER hold. If A BOH attacks VIE, we will defend it. Our pact is broken by your move, not ours. Russia's pressure on GAL and BUD is your concern too. Consider where your units will stand.

Austria confirms this autumn: A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI all hold. We stay out of GRE, ALB and ION. Please keep A GRE and F ION out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE. I have no plans against Bulgaria this autumn. Tell me if Italy moves on Turkey in Bulgaria, so we can coordinate.

Austria proposes a Serbian border non-aggression pact now. A SER and A BUD hold this autumn and will not enter BUL or CON. You keep A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of SER, BUD and RUM. Confirm in writing and we both stay defensive against Russia and Italy.

England to France, Fall 1934: A BEL holds this autumn and my fleets hold too, with no move on Brest, Picardy or the Channel. I expect A PIC and A BRE to stay out of BEL and the Channel. I will give you notice before any move near HOL, and I ask the same from you.

England to Germany, Fall 1934: A BEL, F NTH, F ENG and my other fleets hold this autumn, with no move on HOL, DEN or KIE. Please keep A HOL, A KIE and A DEN holding and out of BEL and NTH, as you pledged. I will warn you before any change in the Low Countries.

England to Russia, Fall 1934: My STP, NOR and LVP fleets hold this autumn and stay out of the Baltic and Sweden. Please keep F SWE out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI as you pledged. Tell me before A WAR or F SEV moves against Germany, and I will do the same.

France to England, Fall 1934: My orders this autumn are all holds: A PIC, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO. A PIC will not enter BEL or the Channel while your A BEL stays in Belgium, and I will give you notice before any change. Please keep your fleets off Brest and Picardy, and tell me your Spring 1935 plan against HOL or KIE.

Confirmed: A HOL, A KIE and A DEN hold this autumn, with no German move on BEL or NTH. My fleets stay out of the North Sea. Keep F NTH and F ENG out of HOL, KIE and DEN, and warn me before any northern change. I will do the same toward your Low Countries units.

Confirmed: A MUN holds this autumn, and no German unit enters BUR, PIC or BEL. Please keep your armies out of MUN and BUR. Belgium is England's for now. If they vacate it, you will hear from me before any move near the Rhine or the Low Countries.

Our Fall orders: A BOH and A MUN hold, with no move into SIL or GAL. Your A WAR to GAL is your decision. Keep F SWE out of the Baltic and off BER, DEN and KIE. Next spring we split Austria: I take VIE and TRI, you take BUD, SER and RUM. I will hold you to that.

Italy confirms for Fall 1934: A GRE and F ION hold, and no Italian unit enters SER, BUD, TRI, VIE or ALB. Our pact stands. Bulgaria is Turkish and Italy's business is with Turkey's fleet and armies, so we will talk again before Spring 1935 before either of us moves on BUL.

Italy's Fall 1934 orders: A GRE and F ION hold. No Italian unit enters BUL, CON, BLA or SMY. Your A BUL still broke our truce, and it should leave Bulgaria before Spring 1935. Keep A CON, F BLA and A BUL out of GRE, SMY and ION, and we can both hold for now.

Russia to England, Fall 1934: F SWE holds in Sweden this autumn and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR holds and is not aimed at SIL or DEN. I will give you warning before any change in the north. Keep your STP, NOR and LVP fleets out of the Baltic.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1934: My A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this autumn and none of them enters BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. I expect the same from your A BUD, A SER, A VIE and F TRI, which must not enter RUM, UKR, WAR, SEV or GAL. Any move toward Galicia will be answered.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1934: I will not move A WAR to GAL while Austria holds VIE and our Spring plan has failed. Show me written orders for BOH to VIE and A MUN first. F SWE stays out of the Baltic and BER, DEN, KIE. Let us discuss the Austrian split again in Spring.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1934: F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold this autumn and will not enter BUL, BLA, CON or SMY. I am not moving against your Balkan units. If your A BUL presses SER, I will not interfere, but keep your units out of RUM and SEV.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1934: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this autumn. Turkey will not enter SER, BUD, VIE, RUM or TRI. Your A SER and A BUD are the only threat to BUL. Move both out of the Bulgaria border, or hold without attacking, and I will sign a Serbian border non-aggression pact in writing.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1934: Turkey has no units aimed at GRE, SMY or ION. A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold. Please keep A GRE and F ION where they are this autumn. Any Italian move into BUL, CON or BLA would be a war move that Turkey will resist. I am willing to keep our Balkan lines stable.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1934: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this autumn. Please keep F SEV out of BLA and CON, and move A RUM against Austria's RUM or BUD. I am still weighing whether A BUL should press SER, and that depends on Austria's moves. What will A WAR do this autumn? Confirm your orders in writing.

notes.note: Fall 1934: all holds, keeping 5 SCs. No unowned SCs reachable. England's A BEL holds; England and Germany kept holds. Promised no BEL/BUR/Channel move without notice. Next: if A BEL leaves, PIC to BEL with notice to England. Watch Italy/Tunis for opportunity.

Fall 1934: holding all units per pledges to France, Germany and Russia. All three have kept word so far. No unowned centers. HOL attack on BEL->HOL would bounce vs KIE support and break peace. Revisit HOL only if Germany's KIE support is gone. Keep fleets off Brest, Picardy, Baltic.

Fall 1934: all hold to keep MOS, RUM, SEV, SWE, WAR. No unowned centers; BUD/SER attacks bounce vs Austrian supports. Germany still hasn't shown BOH->VIE in writing; Austria and Turkey keep promising no entry. Reassess in Spring 1935 if VIE falls or Austrian supports weaken.

Fall 1934: all three units hold. A SER attack bounces without support, so no move into SER. Italy and Russia say they stay out of BUL/CON/BLA; Austria offers a SER non-aggression pact if A BUL/A CON stay out of SER/BUD/RUM. Watch A SER/A BUD and F SMY. Revisit a SER strike in Spring 1935 only if Austria's units move away.

Fall 1934: A GRE holds, F ION to AEG to set up convoy of GRE to CON/SMY next turn. Pacts with Austria and Turkey kept, no moves on BUL. Turkey's A BUL broke truce; strike BUL/CON only with real support. Watch Austria on SER/BUD and Turkey on GRE/SMY/ION.

Fall 1934: holding all five. BOH holds, supported by MUN, to defend against Austria. KIE supports HOL. VIE attack bounces without BOH-VIE support. England has promised no move on HOL, DEN or KIE; watch for F NTH or the Low Countries. Russia has refused BUD/GAL. Next: Spring 1935, consider VIE if Austria weakens. Keep BOH and MUN defended.

Fall 1934: all hold; BUD supports VIE holding to defend against Germany's BOH threat. Russia pledged no BUD/SER/VIE/TRI entry, Italy pledged no SER/BUD/TRI/VIE entry, Turkey pledged no SER/BUD entry; Germany broke the pact by threatening VIE. Watch RUM->BUD. Consider BUL plans only with real support in Spring 1935.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Spring 1935: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI are all defending. Germany's A BOH is the threat to VIE. Confirm in writing that no German unit enters VIE, TRI, BUD or SER this year. In return, A VIE and A BUD stay out of MUN, BOH and SIL. If you'd rather fight Russia on the north side, we can both benefit.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1935: I hold A BUD, A SER, A VIE and F TRI, and none enters RUM, GAL, WAR or SEV. Confirm your A RUM and F SEV won't enter BUD, SER, VIE or TRI this spring. If you move on Bulgaria or Turkey, tell me first so our Balkan orders don't clash.

England to Germany, Spring 1935: My A BEL, F NTH, F ENG and northern fleets will hold this spring. Will A HOL, A KIE and A DEN also hold? Please tell me directly before any German unit moves toward BEL or NTH, and I will do the same toward your Low Countries.

England to France, Spring 1935: A BEL and my fleets hold this spring with no move on Brest, Picardy or the Channel. Please confirm A PIC and A BRE stay out of BEL and the Channel. What are your Spring 1935 orders, and what is your plan against Germany? I will give notice before any move near HOL.

England to Russia, Spring 1935: My STP, NOR and LVP fleets hold and stay out of the Baltic and Sweden. Please confirm F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI this spring. Are A WAR and F SEV holding, or do you plan any move against Germany's SIL or DEN? I want warning first.

France to England, Spring 1935: My armies and F MAO hold this spring, with no move on BEL, BUR, PIC or the Channel. A PIC will not enter BEL while your A BEL stays. Please confirm your fleets stay off Brest and Picardy, and tell me your Spring 1935 orders for A BEL and the North Sea fleets before I consider any change.

France to Germany, Spring 1935: My units hold this spring, with no move on BUR, MUN, BEL or the Rhine. Please confirm A MUN, A HOL, A KIE and A BOH stay out of BUR and PIC. Tell me your Spring 1935 plans before any move near the Low Countries, and I will give you notice of any change first.

France to Italy, Spring 1935: My F MAO, A MAR and A POR hold this spring, with no move toward Tunis, the Gulf of Lyon or Italian soil. Please confirm F AEG, F SMY and A NAP stay out of Spain, Portugal and the western Mediterranean. I will tell you before any change in the west.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1935: I am ordering A BOH to VIE now, and A MUN holds. Please move A RUM to BUD and A WAR to GAL this spring as agreed. Once VIE falls I take TRI, and you take BUD, SER and RUM. Keep F SWE out of BER, DEN and KIE, and confirm your orders in writing.

Germany to England, Spring 1935: I am turning my attention to Austria this year. My A DEN, A HOL and A KIE hold, and no German unit enters BEL or NTH. Keep F NTH and F ENG out of HOL, DEN and KIE, and confirm your Spring orders for BEL, NTH and NOR.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1935: Turkey is our shared problem. I propose we strike Bulgaria together this autumn: your A SER to BUL and my A GRE to BUL, with F AEG supporting from the Aegean. Then we split the Balkans peacefully. Tell me your Spring orders first, and whether you agree.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1935: Your A BUL has broken our truce and we both know it. Withdraw it from Bulgaria this spring and I will keep A GRE and F AEG out of BUL, CON and BLA. Refuse, and Italy will treat your Balkan position as a target. Tell me your Spring orders in writing.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1935: I propose we both strike Austria now. If your A BUL moves to SER this spring, my A RUM can take BUD, so Austria cannot hold both. Send your exact orders in writing. My F SEV stays out of BLA and CON.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1935: Show me written orders for A BOH to VIE this spring. If VIE falls, I will move A RUM toward BUD. Keep your armies out of WAR and SWE and away from the Baltic, and I will keep F SWE out of BER, DEN and KIE.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1935: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring. Please keep F SEV out of BLA and CON. I suggest A RUM and A WAR press Austria from the north, with A RUM hitting BUD or staying ready to take it if Austria's units move. Turkey will not enter RUM or SEV. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1935: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold. Turkey has no plans against Austria while your A SER and A BUD stay out of BUL and CON. Confirm in writing that both hold or move away from Bulgaria this spring, and Turkey will keep its Balkan units defensive.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1935: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring. Turkey has no units aimed at GRE, SMY or ION. Please keep A GRE and F ION where they are. Any move by Italy into BUL, CON or BLA would be a war move. I propose we both focus on Austria and Russia and keep the Balkans stable.

Austria to Italy, Spring 1935: A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI all hold this spring. I am open to discussing a Bulgaria plan for autumn, but only after Turkey's position is clearer. Keep A GRE and F ION out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE as before, and we will talk again before Fall orders.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1935: A SER and A BUD hold this spring and will not enter BUL or CON. Please keep A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. If that holds, Austria will sign the Serbian border non-aggression pact in writing before Fall.

England to France, Spring 1935: My orders are all holds this spring: A BEL, F LON, F EDI, F LVP, F NTH and the rest. I expect A PIC and A BRE to stay out of BEL and the Channel as you have pledged. I will give you notice before any change near HOL or BEL, and I ask the same from you.

England to Germany, Spring 1935: Confirmed. A BEL, F NTH, F ENG and my other units hold this spring, with no move on HOL, DEN or KIE. Good luck against Austria. Keep A HOL, A KIE and A DEN out of BEL and NTH, and I will warn you before any change in the Low Countries.

France to England, Spring 1935: My spring orders are all holds: A PIC, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO. I make no move on BEL, the Channel or Brest. Your A BEL holds, so A PIC stays put. I agree on a plan against Germany, but I need your autumn intentions for HOL and KIE first. I will give you notice before any autumn move toward Belgium.

Germany to Austria: No written pact this spring. A BOH is moving to VIE now, and I will not confirm otherwise. Withdraw A VIE to GAL or TYR, or hold it and fight. Your A BUD and A SER will be judged by what they do next. Choose carefully.

Germany to France: A MUN holds this spring, and no German unit enters BUR, PIC or BEL. Keep your armies out of MUN and BUR, and I will keep my word. I will not move toward the Low Countries while England holds BEL, and I will tell you first if that changes.

Germany to England: Confirmed. A DEN, A HOL and A KIE hold this spring, and no German unit enters BEL or NTH. My attention is on Austria. Keep F NTH and F ENG out of HOL, DEN and KIE, and send me your Spring orders for BEL, NTH and NOR.

Germany to Russia: A BOH is ordered to VIE this spring, and A MUN holds. Please move A RUM to BUD and A WAR to GAL now as agreed. Once VIE falls I take TRI, and you take BUD, SER and RUM. Keep F SWE out of BER, DEN and KIE, and confirm in writing.

Italy to France, Spring 1935: Confirmed. F AEG, F SMY and A NAP hold this spring, with no move toward Spain, Portugal or the western Mediterranean. Please keep your F MAO and A MAR away from Tunis and Italian soil. I will tell you before any change in the Mediterranean.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1935: Your A BUL still sits in Bulgaria against our truce. Withdraw it this spring. Italy holds this spring: A GRE and F AEG stay put, and no Italian unit enters BUL, CON or BLA. If A BUL remains into Fall, Italy will reassess its Balkan position.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1935: Confirmed. A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this spring and none enters BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Keep A BUD, A SER, A VIE and F TRI out of RUM, UKR, WAR, SEV and GAL, and we will both see how the Balkans develop.

Russia to England, Spring 1935: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR and F SEV hold this spring and are not aimed at SIL or DEN. Keep STP, NOR, LVP and NTH out of the Baltic and I will warn you before any change in the north.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1935: Austria still holds VIE, so A RUM will not move to BUD and A WAR will not move to GAL this spring. F SWE stays out of BER, DEN and KIE. Once VIE falls, we can talk about BUD and SER. Keep your armies out of WAR and SWE.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1935: A RUM and A WAR hold this spring, and F SEV stays out of BLA and CON. I will not attack your Balkan units. If your A BUL moves to SER, send written orders first and we will coordinate Fall moves. Turkey must keep units out of RUM and SEV.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1935: Bulgaria is not a truce breach. A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring and Turkey will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Keep A GRE and F AEG out of BUL, CON and BLA, and we both hold. Any Italian move into Bulgaria or the Black Sea will be resisted. Send your Spring orders in writing.

notes.note: Spring 1935: all holds, keeping 5 SCs (BRE MAR PAR POR SPA). Promised England no BEL/Channel/Brest move; A PIC stays out of BEL while England's A BEL holds. Promised Germany no BUR/MUN move. Promised Italy no Tunis move. All three have kept holds so far. Next: ask England for autumn HOL/KIE plan; watch for A BEL leaving, then PIC to BEL with notice.

Spring 1935: holding all units per pledges to France, Germany and Russia. All have kept word so far. Germany is fighting Austria; HOL attack would bounce vs KIE support and break pledges. Revisit HOL in Fall 1935 if Germany's KIE/DEN are drawn away. Keep fleets out of Baltic and Brest/Picardy.

Spring 1935: BOH to VIE unsupported, likely bounce; MUN, KIE, DEN, HOL hold. Pledges to Russia (BUD/SER/RUM split) and England (no move on BEL/NTH; Low Countries quiet) and France (no BUR/PIC) remain. Watch England's F NTH and Russia's F SWE. Consider MUN support on VIE next turn if VIE empties.

Spring 1935: all hold; BUD supports VIE to stop Germany's BOH threat (only one attacker can reach VIE). Germany broke pact, Russia and Turkey pledged no BUD/SER/VIE/TRI entry, Italy's Bulgaria proposal not agreed. Keep 4 SCs; reassess Fall 1935 for Turkey/Italy.

Spring 1935: all hold; no unowned centers reachable, and attacking BUL now would bounce. Turkey (A BUL) broke truce but keeps the Balkans quiet. Austria and I discussed a joint Fall 1935 strike on BUL (A SER to BUL, A GRE to BUL with F AEG support). Austria wants to talk first. France is keeping MAO, MAR and POR out of Tunis. Next: set up convoy GRE via AEG and coordinate with Austria before Fall.

Spring 1935: all hold to keep 5 centers. Germany's BOH->VIE is unverified; Germany keeps asking RUM->BUD and WAR->GAL, which would bounce. Austria and Turkey promise no entry to RUM/SEV. England's fleets hold and stay out of the Baltic. Reassess in Fall 1935 if VIE falls or Austrian supports weaken.

Spring 1935: holding BUL, CON, BLA. Attacks on SER or RUM bounce without support, and an empty BUL would be taken by GRE. Italy, Russia and Austria all say they stay out of BUL/CON. Austria offered an SER pact if A SER and A BUD stay out of BUL/CON. Watch RUM/SER for a chance to strike in Fall.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Fall 1935: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI all hold this autumn and will defend. Your A BOH entering VIE would be an act of war. Tell me your Fall orders for BOH, MUN and SIL. We can both gain more by fighting Russia than by fighting each other.

England to Germany, Fall 1935: My A BEL and northern fleets hold this autumn with no move on HOL, KIE or DEN. Your A HOL, A KIE and A DEN are still in place, and you said your attention is on Austria. If you move those units south, tell me first so we both know where we stand.

England to France, Fall 1935: My units hold this autumn, with no move on BEL, PIC, BRE or the Channel. I want your word that A PIC and A BRE stay out of BEL and the Channel. What are your plans for Spain and Portugal, and will you move against Italy or Germany?

France to England, Fall 1935: Are A BEL and your fleets holding again this autumn? If A BEL leaves Belgium, I would like to move A PIC to BEL, with notice to you first. Tell me your autumn orders for HOL and KIE, and whether you will support a Belgian arrangement.

France to Germany, Fall 1935: My armies hold this autumn, with no move on BUR, MUN or BEL. Please confirm your A MUN, A HOL, A KIE and A BOH stay out of BUR and PIC. Tell me your autumn plans for Austria, so I know where your focus lies.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1935: A BOH attacks VIE this autumn, supported by A MUN. Austria's south is weakening. I will keep A MUN, DEN, KIE and HOL out of WAR, SWE and GAL. Please keep F SWE out of BER, DEN and KIE, and tell me whether A RUM moves on BUD this autumn or holds.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1935: A BOH is moving on VIE with MUN support, and you cannot hold it alone. Withdraw A VIE to GAL or TYR and I will leave your remaining centers alone this autumn. Otherwise you will lose VIE and I will press TRI. Tell me your orders now.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1935: I propose the joint strike on Bulgaria now. Your A SER to BUL, my A GRE to BUL, and F AEG supports from the Aegean. Afterwards we split the Balkans: you take BUL and SER-side gains, I take GRE-side and CON later. Tell me your Fall orders in writing before we commit.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1935: Your A BUL is still in Bulgaria against our truce. Withdraw it now or Italy and Austria will take it. Tell me your Fall orders in writing. If you move A CON or F BLA toward GRE or SMY, expect a full Italian response.

Italy to Russia, Fall 1935: Please confirm F SEV, A RUM and A WAR stay out of BUL, GRE and the Aegean this autumn. I will keep F AEG, A GRE and F ION out of RUM and UKR. If Turkey's Black Sea position weakens, I would like to hear your plans before you move.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1935: Send written orders now. I need A BOH to VIE confirmed before any Russian move. If VIE falls, A RUM can go to BUD, but A WAR will not enter GAL while Austria holds. F SWE stays out of BER, DEN and KIE. Confirm your Fall orders and whether A MUN holds.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1935: Your A BUL to SER is your decision. If Austria's BUD empties, I may take it with A RUM, so we split Austria. Send your exact Fall orders in writing. F SEV stays out of BLA and CON, and A RUM stays put unless BUD opens. Keep your units out of RUM and SEV.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1935: Austria's A SER and A BUD are my target this autumn. Turkey will move A BUL to SER only if your A RUM hits BUD or takes RUM's Austrian pressure. Please confirm in writing that A RUM attacks BUD and F SEV stays out of BLA and CON.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1935: Turkey keeps A CON and F BLA out of GRE, SMY and ION. I ask you to keep A GRE and F AEG out of BUL and CON this autumn. If we both hold our Balkan lines, Turkey will not enter GRE. Confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Austria declines the Bulgaria strike this autumn. Our A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold, since Germany's A BOH threatens VIE and we cannot leave the Balkan line open. Keep A GRE and F ION out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE as agreed. We can revisit Bulgaria in Spring 1936 once the northern threat is settled.

Austria will not withdraw from VIE. A VIE holds with A BUD supporting, and any move from BOH into VIE will be defended and is an act of war. Our A SER and F TRI also hold. Your MUN and BOH are not our targets. Let us both turn toward Russia on RUM and WAR instead of fighting each other.

England to France, Fall 1935: A BEL holds this autumn, along with all my fleets. I will not move on Picardy, Brest or the Channel. If I ever plan to vacate BEL, you will hear from me first, and I expect the same notice from you before A PIC moves. Your Spain and Portugal plans are your own business, but I want your word that A BRE and A PIC stay out of the Channel.

France to England, Fall 1935: My orders this autumn are all holds: A PIC, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO. I have no plans against Spain or Portugal, and no move on BEL, the Channel or Brest. A PIC stays out of BEL while your A BEL holds, and you will get notice before any change. Please keep your fleets off Brest and Picardy, and send me your autumn HOL and KIE plan before we discuss Germany.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1935: No withdrawal. A BOH attacks VIE this autumn with A MUN in support, and you cannot hold it alone. Pull A VIE back to GAL or TYR and I will leave your remaining centers alone. Hold and you lose VIE, and I will press TRI next.

Germany to England, Fall 1935: My A HOL, A KIE and A DEN stay where they are this autumn, and no German unit enters BEL or NTH. My main move is against Austria in the south. Keep F NTH and F ENG out of HOL, KIE and DEN, and I will do the same toward your Low Countries.

Germany to France, Fall 1935: A MUN holds this autumn and supports nothing toward BUR, PIC or BEL. My army moves are against Austria in the south. Keep your armies out of MUN and BUR, and I will give you notice before any move near the Rhine or Belgium.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1935: A BOH attacks VIE with A MUN support this autumn. If VIE falls, A RUM may take BUD as agreed. A WAR should stay out of GAL for now. Keep F SWE out of BER, DEN and KIE, and confirm your orders in writing.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1935: Your A BUL is still in Bulgaria, which broke our truce. Withdraw it this autumn or Italy and Austria will take it. My A GRE and F AEG hold this turn, and nothing enters BUL, CON or BLA from Italy. Keep A CON and F BLA out of GRE, SMY and ION and we can talk further.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1935: My orders are A RUM, A WAR and F SWE holding this autumn, with A MOS holding too. A RUM will not move to BUD while Austria holds VIE. Show me your written A BOH to VIE and A MUN orders. Keep your armies out of WAR, SWE and the Baltic, and away from BER, DEN and KIE.

Russia to Italy, Fall 1935: F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold this autumn. None of them enters BUL, GRE, the Aegean or the Mediterranean. Please keep F AEG, A GRE and F ION out of RUM and UKR, as agreed. If Turkey's Black Sea position changes, I will tell you before I move.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1935: F SEV stays out of BLA and CON, and A RUM holds this autumn. I will not move against your Balkan units. Your A BUL to SER is your decision. I am not committing A RUM to BUD yet. Keep your units out of RUM and SEV, and we will talk again in Spring.

Turkey keeps A CON and F BLA out of GRE, SMY and ION this autumn, and A BUL holds in Bulgaria. Italy should keep A GRE and F AEG out of BUL and CON, and we both hold. Confirm in writing. Any Italian move into BUL, CON or BLA will be resisted.

Turkey's A BUL moves to SER only if your A RUM attacks BUD this autumn. Otherwise A BUL holds. Please confirm A RUM to BUD in writing, and that F SEV stays out of BLA and CON. Turkey keeps its units out of RUM and SEV.

notes.note: Fall 1935: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS, RUM, SEV, SWE, WAR). No unowned centers reachable; RUM->BUD would bounce vs Austrian supports. Promised Germany/Austria/Turkey no entry to BUD/SER/VIE/BER/DEN/KIE, and WAR/SWE out of GAL/BER/DEN/KIE. Germany's BOH->VIE still unverified in writing; Turkey's A BUL->SER depends on my RUM->BUD (declined). Reassess Spring 1936 if VIE falls.

Fall 1935: all holds, keeping 5 SCs. No unowned SCs reachable. England's A BEL still holds, so PIC stays out of BEL. Germany kept MUN out of BUR. Italy kept off Spain/Tunis. Promises kept so far. Next: if A BEL leaves, PIC to BEL with notice to England. Consider Tunis only if Italy breaks.

Fall 1935: holding all. BUD supports VIE to tie Germany's BOH+MUN attack (VIE holds at 2v2). Declined Italy's Bulgaria strike; will revisit Spring 1936. Germany broke pact with BOH threat; Russia and Turkey pledged no BUD/SER/VIE/TRI entry. Italy kept GRE/ION out so far. Watch Germany on TRI/VIE and RUM.

Fall 1935: held all units per pledges to France, Germany, Russia. All have kept word. Germany fighting Austria; HOL attack would bounce vs KIE support. Revisit HOL if Germany's KIE/DEN leave. Keep fleets out of Baltic and Brest/Picardy.

Fall 1935: all holds. Austria declined the BUL strike, and a solo GRE->BUL would bounce against Turkish support. No unowned centers. Turkey's A BUL still breaks truce; Italy may strike BUL in Spring 1936 with Austria if Germany's threat to VIE is settled. Keep A GRE and F AEG out of RUM/UKR; Russia and Austria kept their pledges. Watch Turkish moves to GRE/SMY/ION.

Fall 1935: BOH to VIE unsupported would bounce (MUN cannot support it), so BOH holds. Austria refused to withdraw. Russia refuses BUD/GAL split; England and France quiet. Next: look for a supported VIE attack, and keep Low Countries and Baltic pacts.

Fall 1935: all units hold. A SER strike alone bounces without support and no support option reaches SER, so no attack. Russia says A RUM holds and F SEV stays out of BLA/CON, but has not committed to BUD. Italy and Austria keep threatening BUL. Russia's BUD promise is unconfirmed; watch for an empty BUD and reassess in Spring 1936.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Spring 1936: Your A BOH and A MUN have pressed VIE twice. I will defend VIE with A BUD support. Withdraw BOH from VIE's border and I will keep A VIE and A BUD out of MUN, BOH and SIL. Otherwise we fight, and Russia gains from our quarrel. Answer before Spring orders are final.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1936: Germany's BOH and MUN are aimed at VIE and TRI. I hold A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI and will not enter RUM, GAL, WAR or SEV. Can we coordinate against Germany in the north? Confirm your A RUM and F SEV stay out of BUD, SER, VIE and TRI.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1936: A SER and A BUD hold this spring and will not enter BUL or CON. Confirm A BUL, A CON and F BLA stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. If that holds, I will sign the Serbian border non-aggression pact in writing now.

England to Germany, Spring 1936: Are A HOL, A KIE and A DEN staying put this spring? My A BEL and northern fleets hold, with no move on HOL, KIE or DEN. If any of those units leave for Austria, tell me first so we both know where we stand before autumn.

England to France, Spring 1936: My A BEL and fleets hold this spring, with no move on PIC, BRE or the Channel. Please confirm A PIC, A BRE and F MAO stay out of BEL and the Channel. Give me notice before any move toward Belgium, and I will do the same.

France, Spring 1936: My orders stay defensive, with A PIC, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO holding. Will A BEL stay in Belgium this spring? If it leaves, I want to move A PIC to BEL, and I will give you notice first. Please confirm your fleets stay out of the Channel-Brest area and tell me your plans for Germany.

France, Spring 1936: I hold all my armies and have no move on BUR, MUN or BEL. Your focus against Austria suits both of us. Please confirm A MUN, A BOH and your Low Countries units stay out of Burgundy and Picardy this year, and tell me if your plans for Belgium change.

France, Spring 1936: My F MAO and A MAR hold this spring, with no move toward Tunis or Italian soil. Please confirm F AEG, F SMY and A NAP stay out of Spain, Portugal and the western Mediterranean. If you plan any move toward Tunis or the Ionian, tell me first so we avoid confusion.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1936: Austria's VIE is isolated. I propose A RUM to BUD and A WAR to GAL now, as agreed, with Russia taking BUD, SER and RUM once VIE falls and me taking TRI. Keep F SWE out of BER, DEN and KIE. Send your Spring orders for WAR, RUM and SWE in writing.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1936: Your VIE cannot hold against my BOH and Russia's pressure. Withdraw A VIE to GAL or TYR and I will leave your core alone this year. Otherwise I will attack VIE and press TRI. Tell me your choice before orders are set.

Germany to England, Spring 1936: My A HOL, A KIE and A DEN hold this spring, and no German unit enters BEL or NTH. Keep F NTH and F ENG out of HOL, KIE and DEN. Please tell me your Spring orders for BEL, NTH, NOR and LVP.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1936: Germany's pressure on VIE is your problem, but Turkish A BUL is a sitting target. I propose we take it now: your A SER to BUL and my A GRE to BUL, with F AEG supporting. Tell me your Spring orders in writing before we commit.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1936: Your A BUL has broken our truce for two years. Withdraw it to CON or give up Bulgaria. If it stays, Italy and Austria will attack it this turn. Confirm your Spring orders in writing, and keep A CON and F BLA out of GRE and SMY.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1936: Show me your written orders now. If A BOH moves to VIE with A MUN support, I will consider A RUM to BUD only if VIE is empty or Austria's BUD support is gone. A WAR stays out of GAL. F SWE stays out of BER, DEN and KIE.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1936: Confirm your exact orders. If A BUL moves to SER, Austria must split its forces. I will hold A RUM and F SEV this spring, keep out of BLA and CON, and take BUD in Fall if Austria leaves it open. Keep your units out of RUM and SEV.

Russia to Italy, Spring 1936: F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold this spring and stay out of BUL, GRE, the Aegean and Mediterranean. Keep F AEG, A GRE and F ION out of RUM and UKR as agreed. Tell me your spring plans against Turkey before you move.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1936: Austria's BUD is the key target. I propose A RUM to BUD this spring. If BUD falls, A BUL moves to SER in Fall, not before. Confirm in writing that A RUM attacks BUD and F SEV stays out of BLA and CON. Turkey keeps units out of RUM and SEV.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1936: Your A SER and A BUD have been holding against us for two years, and Russia is pressing from RUM. Tell me your Spring orders now. If both units hold or leave Bulgaria's border, Turkey keeps A BUL, A CON and F BLA defensive and will not enter SER or BUD.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1936: Italy's A GRE and F AEG are close to our CON and BLA. I ask you to keep them out of BUL and CON this spring. Turkey will not enter GRE or SMY while we both hold. Please confirm your Spring orders in writing, and tell me whether F AEG moves.

Austria to Italy, Spring 1936: A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI all hold this spring. Germany's BOH is pressing VIE, so I cannot open a Bulgaria front now. Keep A GRE and F ION out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE as agreed. We can revisit BUL in Fall once VIE is secure.

Austria to Germany, Spring 1936: A VIE holds, with A BUD supporting. Austria will not withdraw from VIE. Any German unit entering VIE, BUD, TRI or SER is an act of war. Keep A BOH and A MUN out of VIE and I will keep my units out of MUN, BOH and SIL. Answer now.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1936: A SER and A BUD hold this spring and will not enter BUL or CON. Confirm in writing that A BUL, A CON and F BLA stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. If you do, Austria signs the Serbian border non-aggression pact this turn.

England to France, Spring 1936: A BEL holds this spring, and so do my fleets, with no move toward Brest, Picardy or the Channel. I will give you notice before any change in Belgium. Your A PIC and A BRE should stay out of BEL and the Channel while we keep talking. Any plan against Germany will wait until I see your autumn orders.

England to Germany, Spring 1936: My A BEL, F NTH, F LON, F EDI, F LVP and northern units all hold this spring, with no move on HOL, KIE or DEN. Please keep A HOL, A KIE and A DEN out of BEL and NTH as you have pledged. If any of those units head south toward Austria, tell me first.

France to England, Spring 1936: Confirmed. A PIC, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO hold this spring, with no move into BEL or the Channel. I will give you notice before any autumn move toward Belgium. Please keep your fleets off Brest and Picardy, and tell me before any move that threatens HOL or BEL.

Germany to England, Spring 1936: My A HOL, A KIE and A DEN hold this spring, and no German unit enters BEL or NTH. Please keep F NTH and F ENG out of HOL, KIE and DEN. Send me your Spring orders for BEL, NTH, NOR and LVP so we both know where we stand.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1936: Withdrawal is your last chance. A VIE to GAL or TYR and I leave your core alone this year. If A VIE holds, I attack it and press TRI. Your choice must be made before orders are final.

Germany to France, Spring 1936: A MUN holds this spring and I have no move on BUR, PIC or BEL. Keep your armies out of MUN and BUR, and I will give you notice before any change near the Rhine or the Low Countries.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1936: My proposal stands: A RUM to BUD and A WAR to GAL now, with Russia taking BUD, SER and RUM once VIE falls and me taking TRI. Keep F SWE out of BER, DEN and KIE. Send your Spring orders for WAR, RUM and SWE in writing.

Italy to France, Spring 1936: Confirmed. F AEG, F SMY and A NAP hold this spring, with no move toward Spain, Portugal or the western Mediterranean. Please keep F MAO and A MAR away from Tunis and Italian soil. I will tell you before any change in the Mediterranean.

Italy to Russia, Spring 1936: Confirmed. A GRE, F AEG and F ION hold this spring and stay out of RUM and UKR. Turkey's A BUL has broken our truce for two years, so Italy is weighing its options in the Balkans. I will tell you before any move toward BUL or CON. Keep F SEV and A WAR out of the Balkans.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1936: A GRE and F AEG hold this spring, and no Italian unit enters BUL, CON or BLA this turn. Your A BUL is still in Bulgaria against our truce. Withdraw it to CON this spring or Italy will reassess. Keep A CON and F BLA out of GRE and SMY.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1936: Confirmed. A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this spring, and none enters BUD, SER, VIE, TRI, GAL or UKR. Keep your A BUD, A SER, A VIE and F TRI out of RUM, UKR, WAR, SEV and GAL. If Germany moves on VIE or TRI, we can talk about coordinating then.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1936: No written orders I can trust yet. A RUM holds and will not go to BUD, and A WAR stays out of GAL. F SWE stays out of BER, DEN and KIE. Your A BOH and A MUN are your own business. Any move by your units into WAR or SWE will be met with force.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1936: A RUM will not attack BUD this spring, and A RUM and F SEV hold. F SEV stays out of BLA and CON. Your A BUL to SER is your own decision. Keep your units out of RUM and SEV, and any Turkish move into the Black Sea will be answered.

Turkey's Spring 1936 orders: A BUL holds, A CON and F BLA hold. Turkey will not enter SER, BUD, VIE, TRI or RUM this turn. Austria's A SER and A BUD must hold or leave Bulgaria's border. If both hold, I will consider the Serbian non-aggression pact in Fall. Confirm your orders in writing.

Turkey's Spring 1936 orders: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold. We will not enter GRE or SMY. Please keep A GRE and F AEG out of BUL, CON and BLA this turn. Tell me whether F AEG moves. If Italy holds, Turkey will keep its Balkan units defensive and focus on Austria and Russia.

notes.note: Spring 1936: all holds, keeping 5 SCs (BRE MAR PAR POR SPA). No unowned SCs reachable. England, Germany and Italy have kept their holds so far. Promises: no BEL/Channel/BUR/MUN move; no Tunis move. Next: if England's A BEL leaves, PIC to BEL with notice. Watch for unowned SCs.

Spring 1936: BUD supports VIE hold against German BOH+MUN; SER and TRI hold. Germany has repeatedly threatened VIE, and Russia and Turkey have pledged no entry into BUD/SER/VIE/TRI. Italy wants a BUL strike, which I declined until VIE is secure. Revisit BUL in Fall 1936 if VIE holds. Watch Germany on VIE and Russia on RUM.

Spring 1936: holding all units per pledges to France, Germany, Russia. All have kept word. No unowned centers. Revisit HOL only if Germany's KIE support is gone. Keep fleets off Brest, Picardy, Baltic.

Spring 1936: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS, RUM, SEV, SWE, WAR). Promised no entry to BUD/SER/VIE/TRI/GAL; RUM->BUD refused. Germany still no written BOH->VIE proof; Germany keeps pushing RUM->BUD and WAR->GAL. Austria pledged no entry to RUM/SEV/WAR. Turkey's BUL->SER is their call. Watch Germany on WAR/SWE. Reassess if VIE falls or Austrian supports weaken.

Spring 1936: BOH attacks VIE unsupported; may bounce, takes VIE if Austria vacates. MUN, DEN, HOL, KIE hold to keep England/France pledges. Russia has refused RUM->BUD and WAR->GAL; keep the Baltic and Low Countries quiet. Austria refuses to withdraw from VIE.

Spring 1936: holding BUL with BLA and CON supporting. No support can reach SER, so attacking SER would bounce. Italy and Austria threaten BUL; Russia holds RUM/SEV. Austria's SER pact unconfirmed. Keep defensive, watch Fall for an empty BUD or SER.

Spring 1936: all hold. Austria declined a joint BUL strike again, so a solo GRE->BUL would bounce against Turkish support. Pacts kept with France, Russia, Turkey, Austria. Turkey's A BUL still breaks truce. Next: look for a Fall strike on BUL/CON if Austria commits, and watch Turkish moves to GRE/SMY/ION.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Fall 1936: Your BOH and MUN keep pressing VIE, and that only feeds Russia. Pull BOH out of VIE's reach and I will hold A VIE, A BUD and A SER defensively. Attacking me gains you little while Russia gathers in the east. Tell me your Fall orders now.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1936: Germany's BOH and MUN are still aimed at VIE and TRI. I will keep A RUM, WAR and SEV out of my sight lines if you keep your units out of BUD, SER, VIE and TRI. Confirm your Fall orders and whether you will hold RUM and SEV.

England to Germany, Fall 1936: My units hold this autumn with no move on HOL, KIE or DEN. Your A HOL, A KIE and A DEN are still in place. Are you keeping them there while you fight Austria? If you plan to move any of them, tell me first so we both know where we stand before 1937.

England to France, Fall 1936: My A BEL and fleets hold this autumn, with no move toward PIC, BRE or the Channel. Please confirm your A PIC, A BRE and F MAO stay out of BEL. I will give you notice before any change in the Low Countries, and I ask the same before any move toward the Channel.

France, Fall 1936: A PIC, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO hold again this autumn, with no move into BEL or the Channel. Your A BEL is still in place, so I will not move on it without notice first. Please tell me your autumn plans for the North Sea and any move toward HOL.

France, Fall 1936: F MAO and A MAR hold this autumn, with no move toward Tunis or Italian soil. I ask the same from F AEG, F SMY and A NAP: no move toward Spain, Portugal or the western Mediterranean. Please confirm, and tell me first if your Ionian or Tunis plans change.

France, Fall 1936: My armies hold this autumn, with no move on BUR, MUN or BEL. Please confirm A MUN, A BOH and your Low Countries units stay out of Burgundy and Picardy. I will give you notice before any change. Your focus on Austria suits both of us.

Germany, Fall 1936: Pressing VIE with A BOH has cost us both. Propose a truce: A BOH holds this autumn and I leave VIE, BUD, SER and TRI alone. In return, A VIE and A BUD hold, and neither of us gives Russia an opening. Confirm in writing before orders are final.

Germany, Fall 1936: Let us stop the Russia-Germany quarrel. Germany holds BER, DEN and KIE and keeps F SWE out of range. Please hold A WAR, A RUM and F SWE this autumn, and I will not move toward WAR, SWE or the Baltic. Send your Fall orders in writing so we can both trust them.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1936: Turkey's A BUL is still in Bulgaria and Germany is busy with you in the north. Let's strike BUL this autumn: your A SER to BUL, my A GRE to BUL, F AEG supporting. Please confirm your Fall orders in writing before I commit.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1936: Withdraw A BUL to CON this autumn or Italy and Austria will attack it. Keep A CON and F BLA out of GRE and SMY. Confirm your Fall orders in writing. Italy's A GRE and F AEG hold this turn and will not enter BUL or CON.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1936: Your A BOH and A MUN are not my concern, but A WAR stays put and F SWE stays out of BER, DEN and KIE. I will not support any move into BUD. If you want Russian help against Austria, state your Fall orders for BOH and MUN in writing first.

Turkey, Fall 1936: A BUL holds, A CON holds, F BLA holds. Turkey will not enter RUM or SEV. If Austria leaves BUD open, I ask A RUM to take BUD and F SEV to stay out of BLA and CON. Please confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Austria, Fall 1936: Turkey proposes a clear border. A BUL and A CON hold this autumn and do not enter SER, BUD, VIE, TRI or RUM. In return, A SER and A BUD must not enter BUL or CON. Confirm in writing and we both can focus on Russia and Italy.

Austria accepts your truce. If A BOH holds this autumn, A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI will all hold, and we will not enter BOH, MUN or SIL. Both sides should keep Russia in view. This is written confirmation from Austria.

Austria cannot commit to striking BUL this autumn. Germany's pressure on VIE is still live, and A SER must stay to hold our line. Let's revisit a joint BUL plan in Spring 1937 once the northern front is settled. Keep A GRE and F ION out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE.

Austria confirms A SER and A BUD hold this autumn and will not enter BUL or CON. Please keep A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. If that holds, Austria will sign the Serbian border non-aggression pact in writing now.

England to France, Fall 1936: Confirmed, A PIC, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO holding is what I want to see. A BEL holds this autumn, and my fleets stay out of Brest and the Channel approaches. I will give you notice before any change in the Low Countries, and I expect the same from you before any move on BEL, PIC or the Channel.

France to England, Fall 1936: Confirmed. A PIC, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO hold this autumn, with no move into BEL or the Channel. I will give notice before any change in the Low Countries. We have held the same line for years, so Spring 1937 needs a concrete plan. Tell me your Spring 1937 orders for A BEL and your North Sea fleets.

Germany to England, Fall 1936: My A HOL, A KIE and A DEN hold this autumn, and no German unit enters BEL or NTH. I will give you notice before any move from the Low Countries or Denmark. Keep F NTH and F ENG out of HOL, KIE and DEN, and tell me your Fall orders for BEL, NTH and LVP.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1936: Agreed. Hold A WAR, A RUM and F SWE this autumn, and I will not move toward WAR, SWE or the Baltic. My A BOH and A MUN are aimed at Austria, not you. Send your Fall orders in writing so we can both trust them.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1936: I accept in principle. A BOH holds this autumn, and I leave VIE, BUD, SER and TRI alone this year if A VIE, A BUD and A SER hold as you said. Confirm in writing. If you move against BOH or MUN, the truce ends.

Germany to France, Fall 1936: A MUN holds this autumn, and no German unit enters BUR, PIC or BEL. My armies stay out of your Burgundy and Picardy. I will give you notice before any change near the Rhine or the Low Countries. Please keep your armies out of MUN and BUR.

Italy to France, Fall 1936: Confirmed for this autumn. F AEG, F SMY and A NAP hold, with no move toward Spain, Portugal or the western Mediterranean. Please keep F MAO and A MAR away from Tunis and Italian soil. I will tell you before any change in the Mediterranean.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1936: Confirmed. A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this autumn. None of my units enters BUD, SER, VIE, TRI or GAL. Keep your A BUD, A SER, A VIE and F TRI out of RUM, UKR, WAR, SEV and GAL. I am open to coordinating against Germany's BOH and MUN if they strike VIE or TRI, so let's share orders once moves are known.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1936: No written orders from you have shown BOH or MUN is not aimed at Austria's VIE or TRI, and I will not move toward BUD. A WAR holds, A RUM holds, F SWE holds. Any German unit entering WAR, SWE, RUM or SEV will be met with force. Keep your armies out of the Baltic approaches to SWE.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1936: A RUM will not attack BUD this autumn. A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold. F SEV stays out of BLA and CON. Your A BUL to SER is your decision, but keep your units out of RUM and SEV, and any Turkish move into the Black Sea will be answered.

Turkey will not withdraw from Bulgaria. A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this Fall and we will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Keep A GRE and F AEG out of BUL, CON and BLA, and both our lines stay stable. Any Italian move into Bulgaria or the Black Sea will be resisted. Let us both focus on Austria and Russia.

notes.note: Fall 1936: holding all. Austria truce: BOH holds, I leave VIE/BUD/SER/TRI alone if they hold. Russia: hold WAR/RUM/SWE, no move to Baltic. England: HOL/KIE/DEN hold, no BEL/NTH. France: MUN holds, no BUR/PIC. Recheck Austria's truce and Russia's written orders in Spring 1937.

Fall 1936: all hold. No unowned centers. Austria declined BUL strike again; solo GRE->BUL bounces vs Turkish CON/BLA support. Kept pacts with France, Russia, Turkey, Austria. Turkey refuses to withdraw A BUL. Next: convoy setup via F AEG to ION; revisit BUL only with Austrian support.

Fall 1936: holding for peace. France and Germany have kept pledges. HOL attack bounces vs KIE support. Revisit HOL only if KIE support leaves. Consider convoy plan with NTH/LON to reach DEN/HOL in 1937 if Germany stays passive.

Fall 1936: holding BUL with BLA and CON supporting. Austria and Russia said they keep SER/BUD/RUM quiet, but Austria's SER pact is unsigned. Italy threatens BUL. Watch for an empty BUD or SER and reassess in Spring 1937.

messages.body: Austria here. Spring 1937 is the time for Bulgaria. I propose A SER to BUL with your A GRE to BUL and F AEG supporting, taking Turkey's BUL this spring. Afterwards we split the gains and keep GRE, ION, SER, BUD, TRI and VIE free of each other. Confirm your orders in writing before we commit.

Austria here. Our truce stands: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold, and we stay out of BOH, MUN and SIL. Please keep A BOH and A MUN out of VIE, BUD, SER and TRI. Confirm in writing that your orders this spring match the truce.

Austria here. Please confirm your A RUM, A WAR and F SEV stay out of BUD, SER, VIE and TRI this spring, as agreed. Are you planning anything against RUM or Germany? I will keep my units out of RUM, GAL, WAR and SEV while Germany's BOH is in play.

England to France, Spring 1937: I'll keep A BEL and my North Sea fleets holding this spring, with no move toward PIC, BRE or the Channel. Please confirm A PIC, A BRE and F MAO stay out of BEL. Any change from either of us gets notice first, and I'd like your autumn plans for Spain or Burgundy.

France to England, Spring 1937: As you asked for a concrete plan, here it is. My armies hold. If your A BEL ever leaves Belgium, I will give you notice before A PIC moves in. Please confirm A BEL holds this spring and your fleets stay out of the Channel and Brest approaches.

France to Germany, Spring 1937: My A PIC, A BRE and A MAR hold this spring with no move on BUR, MUN or BEL. Please confirm your Spring 1937 focus is still Austria and that no German unit moves toward Burgundy, Picardy or Belgium.

France to Italy, Spring 1937: My F MAO, A MAR and A POR hold this spring with no move toward Tunis or Italian soil. Please confirm F AEG, F SMY and A NAP stay out of Spain, Portugal and the western Mediterranean, and tell me about any Ionian or Tunis plans first.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1937: Austria's truce holds, so my BOH and MUN are not aimed at WAR, RUM or SWE. Please send your Spring orders for WAR, RUM and SWE in writing. I will keep A BER, DEN and KIE out of the Baltic approaches to SWE. Once Austria's position is clear, let us discuss a split of its centers.

Germany to England, Spring 1937: A HOL, KIE and DEN hold this spring, and no German unit enters BEL or NTH. Please confirm F NTH and F ENG stay out of HOL, KIE and DEN. Tell me your Spring orders for BEL, NTH, NOR and LVP so we both know where we stand.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1937: Turkey's A BUL is still in Bulgaria and Germany's pressure is in the north. I propose we strike BUL now: your A SER to BUL and my A GRE to BUL, with F AEG supporting. Please confirm your Spring 1937 orders in writing before I commit.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1937: Withdraw A BUL to CON this spring, or Italy and Austria will attack Bulgaria. If it withdraws, Italy keeps A GRE and F AEG out of BUL, CON and BLA. Confirm your Spring 1937 orders in writing.

Italy to Russia, Spring 1937: Please confirm F SEV, A RUM and A WAR stay out of BUL, GRE, the Aegean and the Mediterranean this spring. I will keep F AEG, A GRE and A VEN out of RUM and UKR. Tell me your Spring 1937 orders.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1937: Your A BOH and A MUN are free to take Austrian VIE and TRI. I ask that A WAR, F SWE and your fleets stay out of WAR, SWE, RUM and SEV, and that you name your Spring orders for BOH and MUN in writing so I can plan around them.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1937: Germany's BOH and MUN threaten your VIE and TRI. Keep A RUM and F SEV out of your units' reach and I will keep A WAR and F SEV out of BUD, SER, VIE and TRI. Tell me your Spring orders so neither of us is caught by surprise.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1937: Are you moving A GRE or F AEG this spring? Turkey holds A BUL, A CON and F BLA. If Italy keeps out of BUL, CON and BLA, Turkey will not enter GRE or SMY. Please confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1937: Will A RUM or F SEV move this spring? Turkey holds A BUL, A CON and F BLA and will not enter RUM or SEV. If Russia keeps F SEV out of BLA and CON, we can both focus on Austria and Italy. Please confirm your orders.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1937: Are A SER and A BUD holding this spring? Turkey keeps A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. Sign the Serbian pact in writing and keep both units out of BUL and CON.

Austria agrees: this spring A SER moves to BUL, with your A GRE to BUL and F AEG supporting. Both of us attack Turkey's BUL together. Confirm your orders in writing now. Afterwards, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay put, and no Italian unit enters SER, BUD, TRI or VIE.

Austria confirms our pact. Our A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold, and no Austrian unit enters RUM, GAL, WAR or SEV. Please confirm A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold and do not enter BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Germany's BOH is our shared threat, so we should coordinate if it moves on VIE.

Austria confirms A BUD and A VIE hold this spring and will not enter BUL, CON, RUM or TRI. We will sign the Serbian border non-aggression pact in writing this turn. Please keep A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM as you have pledged.

England to France, Spring 1937: Confirmed. A BEL holds this spring, and my fleets (F NTH, F LON, F EDI, F LVP, F STP/NORTH) hold too. No English move on Picardy, Brest or the Channel. I expect A PIC, A BRE and F MAO to stay out of BEL and the Channel. Any change from either side gets notice first.

England to Germany, Spring 1937: Confirmed. A BEL, F NTH, F LON, F EDI, F LVP and F STP/NORTH all hold this spring. No English move on HOL, KIE, DEN or NOR. Keep A HOL, A KIE and A DEN holding and out of BEL and NTH, as you pledged. I will give you notice before any northern change.

France to England, Spring 1937: Confirmed. A PIC, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO all hold this spring, with no move into BEL or the Channel. I have no plans against Spain or Burgundy this spring. Please keep your fleets off Brest and Picardy, and send your autumn plan before we discuss any change.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1937: Our truce stands. A BOH and A MUN hold this spring, and we will not enter VIE, BUD, SER, TRI, BOH or MUN. Keep your A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI holding as agreed. I will tell you first if that changes.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1937: My A BER, DEN and KIE stay out of the Baltic approaches to SWE, and A BOH and A MUN hold this spring. I will not move toward WAR, RUM, SWE or SEV. Once Austria's position is clear, we can discuss a split. Send your written orders in time.

Germany to France, Spring 1937: A MUN holds this spring, and no German unit moves toward BUR, PIC or BEL. My focus remains Austria in the south. Keep your armies out of MUN and BUR, and I will give you notice before any change near the Rhine or the Low Countries.

Italy declines the BUL strike this spring. A SER and A GRE both attacking BUL gives only 2 strength against a held A BUL, with A CON and F BLA supporting, so it would bounce and waste both units. A GRE holds and F AEG holds. Let's revisit in Fall, after I see whether Turkey withdraws. Keep your SER, BUD, TRI and VIE free of my units.

Confirmed for Spring 1937. F AEG, F SMY and A NAP hold, with no move toward Spain, Portugal or the western Mediterranean. Please keep F MAO and A MAR away from Tunis and Italian soil. I will tell you before any change in the Mediterranean.

Italy's Spring 1937 orders: A GRE and F AEG hold. No Italian unit enters BUL, CON or BLA this turn. Your A BUL is still in Bulgaria against our truce. Withdraw it to CON this spring and Italy keeps out of your Balkan line. Keep A CON and F BLA out of GRE and SMY.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1937: A WAR, A RUM, F SWE and F SEV hold this spring. Your BOH and MUN are your affair against Austria. I expect your BER, DEN and KIE to stay out of the Baltic approaches to SWE. Any German unit entering WAR, SWE or RUM will be met with force.

Russia to Italy, Spring 1937: Confirmed. F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold this spring and stay out of BUL, GRE, the Aegean and the Mediterranean. Please keep F AEG, A GRE, A VEN and F ION out of RUM and UKR. Tell me before any move toward BUL or CON.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1937: Confirmed. A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this spring, and none enters BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Keep your A BUD, A SER, A VIE and F TRI out of RUM, UKR, WAR, SEV and GAL. Germany's BOH and MUN are the real threat, so watch them closely.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1937: A RUM and F SEV hold this spring. F SEV stays out of BLA and CON. I am not attacking BUD this turn. Keep your A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of RUM and SEV, and we can both focus on Austria and Italy.

Turkey's Spring 1937 orders are A BUL, A CON and F BLA all holding. We will not enter GRE, SMY or ION this spring. Turkey will not withdraw from Bulgaria, but we have no move against you. If A GRE and F AEG hold and stay out of BUL, CON and BLA, Turkey will keep its units defensive and focus on Austria and Russia. Any Italian move into those provinces will be resisted.

Spring 1937: all hold. A BUL strike bounces (2 vs held BUL with CON/BLA support), so no attack. Austria proposed SER->BUL, which would leave it bouncing alone. Revisit in Fall if Turkey withdraws A BUL. Kept pacts with France, Russia, Turkey, Austria. Keep GRE/SER/TRI/VIE separated.

Spring 1937: holding BUL with BLA supporting and CON supporting. Italy and Austria say they stay out of BUL/CON/BLA; Russia holds RUM/SEV. No unowned centers. Watch GRE/SMY and SER/BUD. Reassess Fall 1937.

Spring 1937: all hold, keeping 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). No unowned centers reachable. Austria and Italy have kept no-entry terms; Germany's BOH/MUN still unverified in writing. Turkey holds BUL/CON/BLA. Watch Germany on WAR/SWE. Reassess Fall 1937 if VIE falls or Austrian supports weaken.

Please keep A BOH and A MUN out of VIE, BUD, SER and TRI this autumn. Confirm in writing that your Fall orders match, and tell me first if Russia's pressure changes your plans.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1937: Please confirm A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this autumn and do not enter BUD, SER, VIE, TRI or GAL. Austria's A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold and will not enter RUM, GAL, WAR or SEV. Germany's BOH and MUN remain our shared concern; tell me if they move on VIE or TRI.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1937: Is the Bulgaria strike still on? If Turkey's A BUL is still there, I can move A SER to BUL with your A GRE to BUL and F AEG supporting. Confirm your Fall orders in writing first. Without your written confirmation, A SER holds, as it would bounce alone.

England to Germany, Fall 1937: My units hold this autumn, with no move on HOL, KIE, DEN or NOR. Please confirm A HOL, A KIE and A DEN stay put and out of BEL and NTH. If you plan any change in the Low Countries or Denmark this autumn, tell me first, and I will do the same before any northern move.

England to Russia, Fall 1937: My STP, NOR, LVP and NTH fleets hold and stay out of the Baltic and Sweden. Please confirm F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI this autumn. Are A WAR and F SEV holding, or do you plan any move against Germany's SIL or DEN? I want warning before any change.

France to England, Fall 1937: My A PIC, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F ENG hold this autumn, with no move into BEL. Your A BEL is the only Low Countries unit in question. Please state your Fall 1937 orders for A BEL and your fleets now, and give me notice before any change to Belgium or the Channel.

France to Italy, Fall 1937: My F MAO, A MAR and A POR hold this autumn with no move toward Tunis or Italian soil. Please confirm F AEG, F SMY and A NAP stay out of Spain, Portugal and the western Mediterranean this autumn, and tell me first about any Tunis or Ionian plans.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1937: A BOH and A MUN hold this autumn, and A BER, DEN and KIE stay out of the Baltic approaches to SWE. Austria is isolated. Once its position breaks, let us agree a split of its centers. Send your Fall orders for WAR, RUM, SWE and SEV in writing.

Germany to England, Fall 1937: A HOL, KIE and DEN hold this autumn, and no German unit enters BEL or NTH. Please confirm F NTH and F ENG stay out of HOL, KIE and DEN. Tell me your Fall orders for BEL, NOR and LVP so we both know where we stand.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1937: A SER to BUL alone bounces against held BUL with CON and BLA support. My A GRE and F AEG hold this fall. Let's prepare a Spring 1938 strike: A SER and A GRE both into BUL, F AEG supporting. Confirm you will keep A SER ready and stay out of GRE and ION.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1937: Your A BUL is still in Bulgaria against our truce. Withdraw it to CON this fall and Italy keeps A GRE and F AEG out of BUL, CON and BLA. If it stays, Austria and I will strike in Spring 1938. Confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1937: Please name your Fall orders for BOH, MUN, BER, DEN and KIE in writing. My A WAR, A RUM, F SWE, F SEV and A MOS hold. Russia to Austria, Fall 1937: My A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this autumn, and none of my units enters BUD, SER, VIE, TRI or GAL. Germany's BOH and MUN remain the threat. Tell me your Fall orders and whether you can hold VIE and TRI, so we both know where the other stands.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1937: F SEV holds and stays out of BLA and CON. A RUM and A WAR hold. Please confirm in writing that your A BUL, A CON and F BLA will not enter RUM or SEV this autumn. Any Turkish move into the Black Sea will be answered.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1937: Our A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this autumn. Turkey will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Please confirm F AEG and A GRE stay out of BUL, CON and BLA, and that Italy's A VEN and A ROM stay away from the Balkans. Let us both focus on Austria.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1937: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold. Turkey will not enter RUM or SEV. Austria's SER and BUD are the open targets for both of us. Confirm F SEV stays out of BLA and CON, and tell me whether A RUM will move on BUD or SER this autumn.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1937: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this autumn. We have kept our word since 1936. Sign the Serbian border pact in writing now, and keep A SER and A BUD out of BUL and CON. Tell me your plans for TRI and VIE.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1937: Confirmed. Our A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this autumn, and no Austrian unit enters RUM, GAL, WAR or SEV. Please keep A RUM, A WAR and F SEV out of BUD, SER, VIE, TRI and GAL. If Germany's BOH moves on VIE or TRI, I will tell you at once and we can coordinate.

Austria to Germany, Fall 1937: Our truce stands. A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold, and we will not enter BOH, MUN or SIL. Please keep A BOH and A MUN out of VIE, BUD, SER, TRI and SIL, as you have pledged. Any move against those centres ends the truce, and I will say so before acting.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1937: I cannot commit A SER to BUL while Turkey's BUL is held with CON and BLA support, since it would only bounce. Let's keep talking. I will not promise a Spring 1938 strike yet. Our SER, BUD, TRI and VIE stay put, and I expect no Italian unit to enter them.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1937: Austria confirms A SER and A BUD will not enter BUL or CON. Our A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this autumn. Please keep A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. If that holds, I will sign the Serbian border non-aggression pact in writing now.

England to France, Fall 1937: A BEL holds this autumn, and so do my fleets F NTH, F ENG, F LON, F EDI, F LVP and F STP/NORTH. I have no move on PIC, BRE or the Channel. Please keep A PIC, A BRE and your fleets out of BEL and the Channel as agreed, and give me notice before any change.

England to Germany, Fall 1937: Confirmed, my units hold this autumn with no move on HOL, KIE, DEN or NOR. Please keep A HOL, A KIE and A DEN in place and out of BEL and NTH, as you pledged. If your plans change, tell me first and I will do the same before any northern move.

Germany to England, Fall 1937: Confirmed. A HOL, A KIE and A DEN hold this autumn, and no German unit enters BEL or NTH. Please keep F NTH and F ENG out of HOL, KIE and DEN. I will give notice before any change in the Low Countries or Denmark. Send your Fall orders for BEL, NOR and LVP in writing.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1937: My A BOH and A MUN hold this autumn, and A BER, DEN and KIE stay out of the Baltic approaches to SWE. I will not move toward WAR, RUM, SWE or SEV. Once Austria's position breaks, we can discuss a split. Please confirm in writing that A WAR, A RUM, F SWE and F SEV hold.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1937: Our truce stands this autumn. A BOH and A MUN hold, and I will not enter VIE, BUD, SER, TRI or SIL. Please keep A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI holding as agreed. I will tell you first if Russia's pressure changes my plans.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1937: Agreed that a lone A SER to BUL bounces against held BUL with CON and BLA support, so we should not attack this autumn. My A GRE and F AEG hold. Let's aim for a joint Spring 1938 strike: your A SER to BUL, my A GRE to BUL, F AEG supporting. I will confirm Spring orders in writing before we commit. Keep A SER ready and your units out of GRE and ION.

Italy to France, Fall 1937: Confirmed. F AEG, F SMY and A NAP hold this autumn, with no move toward Spain, Portugal or the western Mediterranean. I ask that F MAO and A MAR stay away from Tunis and Italian soil, and that you tell me first about any Tunis or Ionian plans. I will inform you before any change in the Mediterranean.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1937: Your A BUL has sat in Bulgaria against our truce for two years. If it withdraws to CON this autumn, Italy keeps A GRE and F AEG out of BUL, CON and BLA. If it stays, Austria and Italy will strike in Spring 1938. Keep F BLA and A CON out of GRE, SMY and ION. Confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Russia to England, Fall 1937: F SWE holds in Sweden this autumn and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR and F SEV hold and are not aimed at SIL or DEN. Keep STP, NOR, LVP and NTH out of the Baltic, and I will warn you before any change in the north.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1937: Confirmed. A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this autumn. None of my units enters BUD, SER, VIE, TRI or GAL. Keep your A BUD, A SER, A VIE and F TRI out of RUM, WAR, SEV and GAL, and tell me if Germany's BOH or MUN strikes VIE or TRI.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1937: I will not send written orders in advance, and I expect no move from BER, DEN or KIE toward SWE or the Baltic approaches. A WAR, A RUM, F SWE and F SEV hold this autumn. Any German unit entering WAR, SWE, RUM or SEV will be met with force. Austria is your affair.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1937: F SEV holds and stays out of BLA and CON. A RUM holds this autumn, and I am not attacking BUD or SER now. Keep your A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of RUM and SEV. Any Turkish move into the Black Sea will be answered. Your Austria plans are your own decision.

Turkey's Fall 1937 orders: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold, and we stay out of RUM and SEV. For Spring 1938 I propose A BUL to SER, supported by your A RUM from RUM, which hits Austria's weakest Balkan center. Tell me if you agree, and keep F SEV out of BLA and CON.

Turkey's Fall 1937 orders: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold. We will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Please confirm F AEG and A GRE stay out of BUL, CON and BLA, and that A VEN and A ROM stay away from the Balkans. Turkey's Balkan units are defensive while Austria is our shared target.

notes.note: Fall 1937: all hold per Germany/Russia/Turkey pacts. BUD supports VIE holding against German BOH/MUN. No Austrian unit enters BOH, MUN, SIL, RUM, GAL, WAR, SEV, BUL, CON. Italy BUL strike not agreed; revisit only with written Italian confirmation and Turkey's BUL weakening.

Fall 1937: all hold. Unsupported BOH-VIE would bounce (no support can reach VIE from MUN). Fall 1937: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). No unowned centers; RUM->BUD would bounce without support. Germany, Austria, Turkey, Italy have kept no-entry terms so far. Fall 1937: all units hold per pledges to France (BEL, Channel) and Germany (HOL/KIE/DEN, no BEL/NTH entry). Both have kept word. Russia confirmed SWE stays out of NWG/NOR/NTH/EDI. No unowned centers. HOL attack bounces vs KIE support. Revisit if KIE support leaves; consider convoy via NTH to DEN/HOL. Keep fleets off Brest/Picardy/Baltic.

Fall 1937: all hold. Attacks on SER/GRE bounce without support. Promises: Italy/Austria/Russia say they stay out of BUL/CON/BLA; Italy demands A BUL withdraw to CON. Russia has F SEV/A RUM holding. Watch for empty SER/BUD/GRE and reassess Spring 1938.

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1938. Does our truce hold? A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold, and we stay out of BOH, MUN and SIL. Confirm in writing that your A BOH and A MUN stay out of VIE, BUD, SER and TRI this spring. If you plan otherwise, tell me first.

Austria here. Are you still planning a Spring 1938 strike on BUL? A SER to BUL alone bounces against CON and BLA support. I will commit only if you confirm in writing that A GRE and F AEG move to BUL with me, and that no Italian unit enters SER, BUD, TRI or VIE.

Austria here. Our pact stands: A SER and A BUD will not enter BUL or CON, and A VIE and F TRI hold. Please confirm A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring and stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. I will then sign the Serbian pact in writing.

England to Germany, Spring 1938: My units hold this spring, with no move on HOL, KIE, DEN or NOR. Please tell me your Spring 1938 orders for HOL, KIE, DEN and BEL, and whether A KIE will still support HOL. If you plan any move into the Low Countries, I want notice first.

England to France, Spring 1938: My A BEL and northern fleets hold this spring, with no move toward PIC, BRE, the Channel or MAO. Please confirm A PIC, A BRE and F ENG stay out of BEL and the North Sea. Give me notice before any change, and tell me your plans for Spain or Burgundy.
