England to Russia, Spring 1938: My STP, NOR and LVP fleets hold and stay out of the Baltic and Sweden. Please confirm F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI this spring. Are A WAR and F SEV holding, or do you plan a move against Germany's SIL or DEN? I want warning first.

France here, Spring 1938. My armies and fleets are holding. Your A BEL is the only Low Countries question for me. What are your Spring and Fall 1938 orders for A BEL and your North Sea fleets? If you vacate Belgium, I will give you notice before A PIC moves in. Please confirm.

France here, Spring 1938. Tunis is a standoff and neither of us gains from it while we both hold. Will you confirm F AEG, F SMY and A NAP stay out of Spain and Portugal this year? I will keep F MAO and A MAR off Tunis and Italian soil. Tell me first about any change to your Ionian or Tunis plans.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1938: A BOH and A MUN hold this spring, and our truce stands for this season: no German unit enters VIE, BUD, SER or TRI. Keep A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI holding as agreed, and tell me your Spring orders in writing.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1938: A BOH, A MUN, A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring, and I will not move toward WAR, RUM, SWE or SEV. Austria is weakening. Let us agree now that Russia takes BUD and SER when it falls, and Germany takes VIE and TRI. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1938: I will not move A GRE into BUL unless you commit A SER to BUL in writing this spring, with the strike coordinated. Without that, A GRE and F AEG hold and no Italian unit enters SER, BUD, TRI or VIE. Tell me your Spring orders now.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1938: Your A BUL has broken our truce for two years. Withdraw it to CON this spring and Italy keeps A GRE and F AEG out of BUL, CON and BLA. Keep F BLA and A CON out of GRE, SMY and ION. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1938: I will not support or move A RUM to BUD or SER. A RUM and F SEV hold. Your A BUL to SER is your own decision, but I will answer any move into RUM, SEV, or the Black Sea with force.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1938: A WAR, A RUM, F SWE and F SEV hold. Your BER, DEN and KIE must stay out of the Baltic approaches to SWE. Your fight with Austria is your affair, but any German unit entering WAR, SWE, RUM or SEV will be met with force.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1938: My A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this spring, and none of my units enters BUD, SER, VIE, TRI or GAL. Keep your A BUD, A SER, A VIE and F TRI out of RUM, WAR, SEV and GAL. Tell me if Germany's BOH or MUN moves on VIE or TRI.

Turkey correction: RUM does not border SER, so A RUM cannot support A BUL into SER. Turkey holds BUL, CON and BLA this spring. Russia, consider A RUM to BUD while Austria's BUD is weak. Keep F SEV out of BLA and CON, and we both can take Austrian centers in Fall.

Turkey holds A BUL, A CON and F BLA this spring and will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Confirm F AEG and A GRE stay out of BUL, CON and BLA, and A VEN and A ROM stay away from the Balkans. Let us keep the Balkans quiet while we both deal with Austria.

Austria confirms in writing: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI all hold this Spring 1938, and we will not enter BOH, MUN or SIL. Our truce stands for this season. Please keep A BOH and A MUN out of VIE, BUD, SER and TRI as you pledged.

Austria declines a Bulgaria strike this spring. A SER holds, since a lone attack on BUL bounces against CON and BLA. Our A SER, BUD, TRI and VIE hold, and we expect no Italian unit to enter them. We can revisit BUL in Fall if Turkey weakens.

Austria confirms: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this Spring 1938. No Austrian unit will enter RUM, GAL, WAR or SEV. Please keep A RUM, A WAR and F SEV out of BUD, SER, VIE, TRI and GAL. I will tell you at once if Germany's BOH or MUN moves on VIE or TRI.

England to France, Spring 1938: My A BEL and northern fleets hold this spring, with no move on Picardy, Brest or the Channel. I will give you notice before any Fall 1938 change in Belgium. Please keep A PIC, A BRE and F ENG out of BEL and the Channel, and tell me your Fall 1938 orders first.

France to England, Spring 1938: Confirmed. A PIC, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F ENG all hold this spring, with no move into BEL, the North Sea or the Channel approaches. Your A BEL is untouched. I will give you notice before any autumn move near Belgium. Please do the same, and send your Fall 1938 orders for A BEL and HOL/KIE before we talk further.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1938: Our truce stands this spring. A BOH and A MUN hold, and no German unit enters VIE, BUD, SER or TRI. Keep A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI holding as agreed. I will give you notice before any change in our position.

Germany to England, Spring 1938: My A HOL, A KIE and A DEN hold this spring, and no German unit enters BEL or NTH. KIE will not support HOL this season. Please keep F NTH and F ENG out of HOL, KIE and DEN, and send me your Spring orders for BEL, NOR and LVP.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1938: My A BOH, A MUN, A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring. I will not move toward WAR, RUM, SWE or SEV. Once Austria's position breaks, we can discuss the split. Please keep your fleets and armies out of Germany's northern approaches.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1938: A GRE and F AEG hold this spring, so no Italian move into BUL. I will not commit A GRE to BUL unless your A SER moves to BUL in writing too. No Italian unit will enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE. Send your Spring orders now.

Italy to France, Spring 1938: Confirmed. F AEG, F SMY and A NAP hold this spring, with no move toward Spain, Portugal or the western Mediterranean. Please keep F MAO and A MAR off Tunis and Italian soil. I will tell you before any change in the Ionian or Tunis.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1938: A GRE and F AEG hold this spring, and no Italian unit enters BUL, CON or BLA. Your A BUL has sat in Bulgaria against our truce for two years. Withdraw it to CON and Italy keeps out of your Balkan line. Keep F BLA and A CON out of GRE, SMY and ION.

Russia to England, Spring 1938: F SWE holds in Sweden and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH or EDI. A WAR and F SEV hold this spring and are not aimed at SIL or DEN. Keep your STP, NOR and LVP fleets out of the Baltic and Sweden, and I will warn you before any northern change.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1938: A WAR, A RUM, F SWE and F SEV hold this spring. I make no agreement on BUD, SER, VIE or TRI yet; Austria is your affair for now. Your BER, DEN and KIE must stay out of the Baltic approaches to SWE, and any German unit entering WAR, SWE, RUM or SEV will be met with force.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1938: A RUM will not move to BUD this spring and holds in RUM, as does F SEV. Your Austria plans are your own decision. Keep your BUL, CON and BLA units out of RUM and SEV, and any Turkish move into the Black Sea will be answered.

Turkey confirms A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring. We will not enter SER, BUD, VIE, TRI or RUM. Austria's A SER and A BUD must not enter BUL or CON. Sign the Serbian pact in writing and we keep this line quiet while we deal with Russia and Italy.

Turkey holds A BUL, A CON and F BLA this spring. We will not withdraw, but we will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Confirm F AEG and A GRE stay out of BUL, CON and BLA, and that A VEN and A ROM stay out of the Balkans. Break that and Turkey will respond.

Turkey holds BUL, CON and BLA. A RUM to BUD while Austria's BUD is weak is your decision and Turkey would welcome it. Keep F SEV out of BLA and CON. Once BUD falls, we can discuss SER and the Austrian centers in Fall.

notes.note: Spring 1938: all hold per pacts with Germany, Russia, Turkey, Italy. No unowned centers reachable; attacks would bounce and break pacts. Revisit BUL with Italy in Fall only if Turkey weakens and Italy confirms in writing. Watch Germany BOH/MUN on VIE/TRI.

Spring 1938: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). No unowned centers reachable; RUM->BUD would bounce without support and breaks no-entry terms. Austria, Germany, Turkey, England have kept terms so far. Watch Germany on WAR/SWE and Turkey on RUM/SEV. Reassess Fall 1938 for BUD if Austria collapses.

Spring 1938: all hold. Austria and Turkey declined a joint BUL strike; solo attacks bounce vs CON/BLA/BUL support. France kept off Tunis. Keep pacts. Next: propose a Fall 1938 BUL strike only with Austrian A SER committed in writing; watch Turkish moves to GRE/SMY/ION.

Spring 1938: all hold to keep pledges to Austria, England, Russia. Austria's VIE is held, so BOH->VIE would bounce unsupported. Revisit a supported VIE/TRI attack in Fall or when Russia moves on Austria. Watch England's NTH and Russia's SWE.

Spring 1938: F ENG to MAO sets up convoy for A BRE/A POR next turn. All holds otherwise. Promises kept: no BEL/Channel move without notice to England, no Tunis move, no BUR/MUN move. Watch for A BEL leaving; PIC to BEL with notice. Keep 5 SCs.

Spring 1938: BEL->HOL supported by NTH. Germany said KIE won't support HOL, so attack should succeed (2 vs 1). Pledges to France/Germany broken on BEL/HOL; expect retaliation. Other fleets hold. Next: consolidate HOL, then look at DEN/KIE. Keep fleets off Brest/Picardy/Baltic.

Spring 1938: all hold in BLA, BUL, CON. Attacks on SER/GRE bounce without support, and no support reaches them. Austria pact unsigned. Italy and Russia keep demanding withdrawal from BUL/RUM/SEV. Watch for empty SER/BUD/GRE in Fall and reassess.

messages.body: Austria, Fall 1938: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold. Your A BOH and A MUN sit next to VIE and TRI. Confirm in writing that neither enters VIE, BUD, SER or TRI this autumn. If you plan otherwise, tell me before you move, as our truce requires.

Austria, Fall 1938: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this autumn. Confirm that A RUM, A WAR, F SEV and A MOS stay out of BUD, SER, VIE, TRI and GAL. Austria will not enter RUM, GAL, WAR or SEV. Tell me at once if Germany moves on VIE or TRI.

Austria, Fall 1938: A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A VIE hold. Confirm no Italian unit enters SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this autumn. Austria will not enter GRE or the Ionian Sea. I am open to a Bulgaria move only if Turkey weakens and you commit in writing.

England to Germany, Fall 1938: I broke our understanding in Spring by moving BEL into HOL, and I won't pretend otherwise. HOL is now my A HOL and I intend to hold it. Pull A RUH and A KIE back from HOL and I'll keep NTH and F ENG out of DEN and KIE. Let's stop the bleeding and talk terms.

England to France, Fall 1938: My A BEL has moved to HOL, so Belgium is empty and I won't re-enter it this autumn. I have no move on PIC, BRE, MAR or the Channel. Please keep your armies out of BEL and HOL, and tell me your Fall 1938 orders so we both know where we stand.

England to Russia, Fall 1938: Germany's KIE and DEN are close to my new HOL position, so I'm watching the north closely. Please confirm F SWE and A WAR stay out of the Baltic approaches to Denmark and Norway this autumn. I'll keep my STP, NOR and LVP fleets off the Baltic in return.

France to England, Fall 1938: My A PIC is moving back to PAR this autumn, so it will not enter BEL. Please confirm your A BEL and northern fleets hold or move elsewhere, and tell me your Fall 1938 orders for HOL and BEL before I make any further change near the Low Countries.

France to Italy, Fall 1938: My F MAO and A MAR hold this autumn with no move toward Tunis or Italian soil. Please confirm F AEG, F SMY and A NAP stay out of Spain, Portugal and the western Mediterranean, and tell me first about any Tunis or Ionian change.

France to Germany, Fall 1938: My armies hold on BUR and MUN, with no move toward Burgundy, Belgium or the Rhine. Please confirm your Fall 1938 focus stays on Austria and that no German unit enters BUR or PIC this autumn.

Germany to England, Fall 1938: Your A HOL sits on a centre I need. Will it move out this Fall? I will keep A KIE and A DEN out of BEL and NTH while we talk. Tell me your Fall orders for HOL, BEL, NOR and LVP in writing.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1938: I will keep A BER, A DEN and A KIE out of your Baltic approaches. Proposal: when Austria falls, Russia takes BUD and SER, and Germany takes VIE and TRI. Confirm in writing that A WAR, A RUM, F SWE and F SEV hold this Fall.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1938: Our truce has held, but I will not pretend Russia is not pressing you. Confirm in writing that A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this Fall. If you do, A BOH and A MUN stay out of your centres. Tell me any change first.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1938: Turkey's A BUL still holds with CON and BLA support, so a lone attack bounces. I propose a joint strike now: your A SER to BUL, my A GRE to BUL, F AEG supporting. Confirm in writing and I will commit. No Italian unit enters SER, BUD, TRI or VIE.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1938: Your A BUL has held in Bulgaria against our truce for three years. Withdraw it to CON this autumn and Italy keeps A GRE and F AEG out of BUL, CON and BLA. Stay in place and Italy will consider striking with Austria. Confirm your orders in writing.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1938: A WAR, A RUM, F SWE and F SEV hold this autumn. Your A BER, A DEN and A KIE must stay out of the Baltic approaches to SWE. Please confirm your moves against Austria stay out of WAR, RUM, SEV and GAL. Any German unit entering those will be met with force.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1938: A RUM and F SEV hold this autumn. Keep your A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of RUM and SEV. If you take SER, tell me your intentions first. Once Austria's BUD weakens further, we can discuss the Austrian centers.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1938: Austria's BUD and SER are weak. I propose A BUL to SER this autumn, with your A RUM moving to BUD, so we split Austria's Balkan centers. Confirm A RUM to BUD and that F SEV stays out of BLA and CON. Turkey will keep A CON and F BLA out of RUM and SEV.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1938: Our Balkan truce holds. A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this autumn, and we will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Confirm A GRE, F AEG, A VEN and A ROM stay out of BUL, CON and BLA. Let us both press Austria, not each other.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1938: Our line holds. A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this autumn. Austria's A SER and A BUD must stay out of BUL and CON. Sign the Serbian pact in writing, and tell me whether A VIE and F TRI are holding this autumn, or if they will move against RUM or SER.

Austria confirms in writing: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI all hold this Fall 1938. We will not enter BOH, MUN or SIL. Please keep A BOH and A MUN out of VIE, BUD, SER and TRI as you pledged. I will tell you before any change in our position.

Austria declines the Bulgaria strike this Fall. A lone attack bounces against CON and BLA support, and I will not commit A SER without a coordinated Turkish weakening. A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A VIE hold. Austria will not enter GRE or the Ionian Sea. Please keep your units out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE.

Austria confirms: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this Fall 1938. A SER and A BUD will not enter BUL or CON, and no Austrian unit moves toward RUM. Our pact stands. Please keep A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. I will sign the Serbian pact in writing once you confirm that.

England to France, Fall 1938: Noted that A PIC returns to PAR. Belgium is empty, and I hold A HOL. I have no move on PIC, BRE, MAR or the Channel. Germany is the threat to both of us now. If you want Belgium, tell me your plan first and I'll keep my fleets clear of BEL and the Channel.

England to Germany, Fall 1938: I won't withdraw from HOL, which I hold and intend to keep. Hold A KIE and A DEN where they are and I will keep F NTH and F ENG out of DEN and KIE this autumn. Any move against HOL from your side will be met.

France here. Thank you for confirming A BEL has moved to HOL. As I told you, A PIC is moving back to PAR this autumn, so it will not enter BEL or HOL. My A BRE, A MAR and A POR hold, and F MAO holds. I have no move on the Channel or your fleets. Please keep your armies out of PIC, BRE and MAR, and tell me your Spring 1939 plans for HOL and BEL before we talk further.

Germany to France, Fall 1938: My A MUN holds this autumn and no German unit enters BUR, PIC or BEL. Your armies stay out of MUN and BUR, and I will give notice before any change near the Rhine. Keep your Mediterranean focus and we stay friends.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1938: Our truce stands for now. A BOH and A MUN hold this autumn and no German unit enters VIE, BUD, SER or TRI. Russia is the pressure on you, not me. Hold your centres, and I will say so before any change.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1938: I accept your Baltic terms: A BER, A DEN and A KIE stay out of your approaches to SWE, and no German unit enters WAR, RUM, SEV or GAL this autumn. When Austria falls, Russia takes BUD and SER and Germany takes VIE and TRI. Hold WAR, RUM, SWE and SEV, and confirm in writing.

Germany to England, Fall 1938: I will not withdraw from HOL, and I do not accept your terms. A KIE and A DEN stay out of BEL and NTH this autumn while we talk. If your A HOL leaves HOL and returns the centre to me, we can discuss keeping F NTH and F ENG out of DEN and KIE. Give me your Fall orders in writing.

Italy to France, Fall 1938: Confirmed. F AEG, F SMY and A NAP hold this autumn, with no move toward Spain, Portugal or the western Mediterranean. Please keep F MAO and A MAR off Tunis and Italian soil. I will tell you before any change in the Ionian or Tunis.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1938: Our A GRE and F AEG hold this autumn, so no Italian unit enters BUL. I will not move into SER, BUD, TRI or VIE while you keep your units in place. A joint Bulgaria move is still possible in a later season if Turkey's A BUL stays and you commit in writing.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1938: A GRE and F AEG hold this autumn, and no Italian unit enters BUL, CON or BLA. Your A BUL has sat in Bulgaria against our truce for three years. Withdraw it to CON and Italy keeps out of your Balkan line. Keep F BLA and A CON out of GRE, SMY and ION.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1938: My A RUM, A WAR, F SEV and A MOS hold this autumn, so none of them enters BUD, SER, VIE, TRI or GAL. I will not enter your territory this turn. Please keep your units out of RUM, WAR, SEV and GAL as well. Tell me at once if Germany's BOH or MUN moves on VIE or TRI.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1938: A WAR, A RUM, F SWE and F SEV hold this autumn. I cannot agree to a written split of Austria yet; that depends on how Austria's position develops. Keep A BER, A DEN and A KIE out of the Baltic approaches to SWE, and any German unit entering WAR, SWE, RUM or SEV will be met with force.

Russia to England, Fall 1938: F SWE and A WAR hold this autumn and will not enter the Baltic approaches to Denmark or Norway. F SWE stays out of NWG, NOR, NTH and EDI. Please keep your STP, NOR and LVP fleets off the Baltic as you said. I will warn you before any northern change.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1938: A RUM holds this autumn and will not move to BUD. F SEV also holds. I make no commitment on Austria's centers. Keep your A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of RUM and SEV. If you move on SER, tell me your intentions first, and any Turkish move into the Black Sea will be answered.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1938: Our Balkan truce holds on our side. A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this autumn, and Turkey will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. We expect A GRE, F AEG, A VEN and A ROM to stay out of BUL, CON and BLA. Turkey will not withdraw from Bulgaria, but we will not strike you if you honor this. Let us both press Austria, not each other.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1938: Turkey proposes A BUL to SER this autumn with your A RUM moving to BUD, splitting Austria's Balkan centers. Please confirm A RUM to BUD in writing, and that F SEV stays out of BLA and CON. Turkey will keep A CON and F BLA out of RUM and SEV. If you prefer a different arrangement, tell me before orders are set.

notes.note: Fall 1938: PIC returns to PAR as promised to England, so it stays out of BEL/HOL. Other units hold. Italy and Germany have kept their holds. Next: keep Spain/Portugal/Brest/Marseille secure; watch for unowned SCs; no Tunis move without notice.

Fall 1938: all hold per pacts (Germany, Russia, Turkey, Italy). BUD supports VIE hold vs German BOH/MUN. Declined BUL strike; Italy and Turkey have kept lines. Watch Germany on VIE/TRI and Russia on RUM/GAL. Revisit BUL only with written Italian commitment and Turkish weakening.

Fall 1938: holding HOL with A HOL and NTH support to defend against Germany's RUH/KIE/MUN. Germany says it will not withdraw from HOL. France's A PIC is returning to PAR. Russia has kept SWE out of the north. Next: consider NTH to HEL and convoy A HOL to DEN if Germany's DEN is weak.

Fall 1938: all hold, keeping 5 centers. RUM->BUD unsupported would bounce. Germany proposes splitting Austria (Russia BUD+SER). Turkey pushes RUM->BUD. Keep no-entry terms with Austria, Germany, England. Watch Germany on WAR/SWE and Turkey on RUM/SEV. Consider SEV->BLA, then convoy RUM to ANK.

Fall 1938: holding. No unowned centers. Turkey and Austria both refused a coordinated BUL strike, and a lone attack bounces. Pacts kept with France, Turkey, Austria. Next: look for a joint BUL strike only with Austrian A SER committed in writing; keep GRE, SER, TRI and VIE separated.

Fall 1938: RUH attacks HOL (English A HOL), KIE supports RUH to HOL. BOH holds per Austria truce, MUN holds per France pledge, DEN holds. Pledges to Russia (no Baltic/WAR/RUM/SWE/SEV entry) and Austria (no VIE/BUD/SER/TRI) kept. England broke its HOL pledge; France and Austria still quiet.

Fall 1938: holding BLA, BUL, CON. No unowned centers nearby, and no support reaches SER, so attacking SER would bounce. Russia has not confirmed RUM to BUD; Austria's SER pact is unsigned. Italy still demands BUL withdraw. Watch for an empty SER/BUD/GRE and reassess in Spring 1939.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Spring 1939: Russia is our common problem. I propose we coordinate against Russia. Please tell me your plans for BOH and MUN this year. If Russia moves on GAL or SIL, would you support A BOH or A MUN into a defensive position with us? Our VIE, BUD, SER and TRI stay put while we talk.

Austria to Italy: I am still open to a Balkan plan, but only with a clear timetable. Tell me your Spring 1939 orders for GRE, AEG and VEN. Turkey's BUL is still strong. Before any Bulgaria move I need written Italian commitment and a Turkish weakening. Until then my SER, BUD, TRI and VIE hold.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1939: Please tell me your intentions for RUM, WAR and SEV this year. Austria has no plans against Russia, and our units hold VIE, BUD, SER and TRI. I want to know if you plan any move toward GAL, since that would change my position. Please reply before autumn.

England to Germany, Spring 1939: Hostilities help neither of us while Italy and France watch. A HOL holds this spring. Pull A KIE and A DEN back from BEL and NTH, and I will keep F NTH and F ENG out of DEN and KIE. Tell me your Spring orders in writing.

England to France, Spring 1939: A HOL and NTH hold this spring. BEL stays empty and I will not enter it. Please keep your armies out of BEL and HOL, and keep F MAO out of the Channel and ENG. Send me your Spring 1939 orders so we both know where we stand.

England to Russia, Spring 1939: My STP, NOR and LVP fleets hold and stay out of the Baltic. Please confirm F SWE and A WAR stay out of the Baltic approaches to Denmark and Norway this spring. Warn me before any move toward DEN or SIL.

France to England, Spring 1939: Germany is the shared threat. I hold A PAR, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO this spring with no move toward BEL, HOL or the Channel. Please confirm your F NTH, F LON, A HOL and F LVP stay clear of Brest and Picardy, and tell me your Fall 1939 plans for Belgium before I change anything near it.

France to Italy, Spring 1939: My F MAO, A MAR and A POR hold this spring with no move on Tunis. Please confirm F AEG, F SMY, A NAP and A ROM stay out of Spain, Portugal and the western Med. If you plan any Tunis or Ionian move, tell me first so neither of us is caught off guard.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1939: I propose we act on the Austria split now. Russia moves on BUD and SER, Germany takes VIE and TRI. Keep A WAR, A RUM, F SWE and F SEV out of Germany's northern approaches, and I will keep A BER, A DEN and A KIE away from your Baltic and Black Sea units. Confirm in writing.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1939: Formal notice that our truce is ending. A BOH will press VIE and German forces will move on TRI this year. Your best option is to withdraw A VIE and F TRI toward Galicia or Hungary and negotiate terms. Tell me your Spring orders in writing.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1939: Your A BUL is the one unit blocking a settled Balkans. Proposal: A BUL moves to CON this Spring, and Italy keeps A GRE and F AEG out of BUL, CON and BLA. Refuse, and Italy will weigh a joint move with Austria this Fall. Answer in writing before the orders are sent.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1939: You have refused a Bulgaria strike three times, so I propose a different understanding. No Italian unit enters SER, BUD, TRI or VIE, and Austria keeps F TRI and A VIE away from VEN and the Adriatic coast. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1939: Our terms hold. A BER, A DEN and A KIE stay out of the Baltic approaches to SWE, and no German unit enters WAR, RUM, SEV or GAL. Tell me now whether you will take VIE and TRI this spring, so neither of us is caught by surprise.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1939: Austria's BUD and SER are weak. I may move A RUM toward BUD this spring. If your A BUL takes SER, we split the Balkans without fighting. Keep A CON and F BLA out of RUM and SEV, and tell me your orders before they are set.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1939: Please confirm whether A BUD, A SER, A VIE and F TRI hold this spring. Germany may move on VIE or TRI, and I need to know early. Austria should keep its units out of RUM, WAR, SEV and GAL, as before.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1939: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring. Austria's SER and BUD are the weak point. Tell me your Spring orders for A RUM and F SEV in writing. If you plan A RUM to BUD this autumn, Turkey's A BUL moves to SER, and neither of us attacks the other.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1939: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring, and we keep our pledge. Your A SER and A BUD must still stay out of BUL and CON. Please tell me your Spring orders for SER, BUD and VIE in writing, and sign the Serbian pact if you intend to keep it.

Austria to Germany: Our Spring orders are A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI holding. Your truce notice worries me. I ask that A BOH and A MUN stay out of VIE, BUD, SER and TRI this year. If Germany keeps those units off our centres, I will support a defensive line on BOH with you against Russia.

Austria to Russia: Confirmed, A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this Spring. We have no plans against you. Please confirm your A RUM, A WAR, F SEV and A MOS stay out of GAL, BUD, SER, VIE and TRI. Germany is the threat to our centres, and I will tell you at once of any move against us.

Austria to Italy: This Spring A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold, and no Austrian unit moves toward VEN or the Adriatic coast. I will not commit to a Bulgaria strike yet. In return, please keep your units out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE, and tell me what you plan for GRE and AEG.

Austria to Turkey: This Spring A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI all hold. Our A SER and A BUD will not enter BUL or CON. Please confirm A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold and stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. Once you confirm in writing, I will sign the Serbian pact.

England to France, Spring 1939: Confirmed. A HOL, F NTH, F LON, F LVP and F EDI hold this spring, and I make no move on PIC, BRE, MAR or the Channel. BEL stays empty and I will not enter it. Please keep A PAR, A MAR and F MAO out of BEL, HOL and ENG, and I will give you notice before any autumn move toward Belgium.

France to England, Spring 1939: Fair notice. I will move A PAR to PIC this spring, and I may enter an empty BEL this autumn. I will not touch HOL, the Channel or your fleets. Your A HOL and NTH stay out of BEL and PIC, and we keep Germany in view together.

Germany to England, Spring 1939: My A KIE and A DEN are not moving into BEL or NTH this spring, and I will not attack HOL now. I want a quiet north while Italy and France watch. Keep F NTH and F ENG out of DEN and KIE, and I will do the same. Tell me your Spring orders in writing.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1939: My A BER, A DEN and A KIE stay out of the Baltic approaches to SWE, and I will not enter WAR, RUM, SEV or GAL this spring. Austria split can wait until I see Russian moves on Austria's centres. Confirm your A WAR, A RUM, F SWE and F SEV hold in writing.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1939: I have no order to enter VIE this spring; A BOH and A MUN hold for now. Russia is the greater threat to both of us, so I will talk about coordinating if Russia moves on GAL or SIL. Keep your centres and tell me your Spring orders in writing.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1939: I accept your terms on the Balkans for now. My A GRE, F AEG and A VEN hold this spring, so no Italian unit enters BUL, SER, BUD, TRI or VIE. Keep A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A VIE where they are and away from VEN and the Adriatic coast. We revisit Bulgaria only with written coordination.

Italy to France, Spring 1939: Confirmed. F AEG, F SMY, A NAP and A ROM hold this spring, with no move toward Spain, Portugal, the western Med or Tunis. I have no Tunis or Ionian move planned this season. Please keep F MAO, A MAR and A POR off Tunis and Italian soil, and tell me first about any change.

Russia to England, Spring 1939: F SWE and A WAR hold this spring. F SWE will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI or the Baltic approaches to DEN or NOR. I have no plans against SIL or DEN. Keep STP, NOR and LVP off the Baltic as agreed, and I will warn you before any northern change.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1939: A WAR, A RUM, F SWE and F SEV hold this spring. I cannot sign a written split of VIE and TRI now. Austria's fate is your affair, but keep A BER, A DEN and A KIE out of the Baltic approaches to SWE and out of WAR, RUM, SEV and GAL, or you will meet force.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1939: A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this spring. I have no current order into GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Keep your units out of RUM, WAR, SEV and GAL. If Germany moves on VIE or TRI I will tell you at once, and we can coordinate.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1939: A RUM and F SEV hold this spring. I make no commitment on BUD or SER yet. Keep A CON and F BLA out of RUM and SEV. If you order A BUL to SER, tell me first. Any Turkish move into the Black Sea or RUM will be answered with force.

Turkey's Spring 1939 orders: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold. We will not withdraw from Bulgaria this spring, and we will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Keep A GRE and F AEG out of BUL, CON and BLA, and keep A VEN and A ROM out of the Balkans. If you honor that, Turkey will not strike you. Break it and we will respond.

notes.note: Spring 1939: holding VIE, BUD, SER, TRI. BUD supports VIE hold vs German BOH/MUN; SER supports TRI hold. Germany truce ended and threatens VIE/TRI; Russia pledged no entry to BUD/SER/VIE/TRI. Italy and Turkey pledged no entry to SER/BUD/TRI/VIE. Watch Germany and Russia; do not enter BUL/CON/RUM/GAL.

Spring 1939: PAR to PIC as told to England, with notice; BEL empty, may enter BEL in autumn with notice. Keeping F MAO out of ENG/Channel per England's request. Italy and Germany have kept holds. England has kept its holds. Next: check England's HOL/NTH stay out of PIC/BEL; then consider BEL in Fall 1939.

Spring 1939: all hold, keeping 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). RUM->BUD unsupported would bounce and breaks no-entry terms. Germany, Austria, England, Turkey have kept terms so far. Watch Germany on WAR/SWE and Turkey on RUM/SEV. Reassess Fall 1939 for BUD if Austria collapses.

Spring 1939: holding all four to keep pledges to Austria (no VIE/BUD/SER/TRI entry), England (no BEL/NTH), Russia (no WAR/RUM/SEV/GAL), France (no BUR/PIC). Austria, England, Russia all still hold their positions. Germany has 4 SC. Next: watch Russia's moves on Austria; if Russia takes BUD/SER, consider supported attack on VIE/TRI.

Spring 1939: holding all for peace. Pledges: keep BEL empty, keep out of PIC/BRE/MAR/Channel, keep fleets out of DEN/KIE and Baltic. Germany, France and Russia say they are keeping theirs. Next: consider convoy via HEL once a northern lull is confirmed.

Spring 1939: all hold to keep promises to France (no Tunis/Ionian move), Austria (no entry to SER/BUD/TRI/VIE) and Turkey (no entry to BUL/CON/BLA). No unowned centers. Turkey's A BUL still blocks. Next: propose joint Fall BUL strike only if Austria commits in writing and Turkey weakens; watch Turkish moves to GRE/SMY/ION.

Spring 1939: no support reaches SER or GRE, so attacks would bounce. Holding BUL/CON with BLA supporting BUL. Russia (RUM to BUD) and Austria (SER pact) unconfirmed. Watch empty SER/BUD in Fall and move BUL to SER if Austria vacates it.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Fall 1939: Your Spring notice threatens VIE and TRI, and A BOH and A MUN are poised against us. Austria holds VIE, BUD, SER and TRI this autumn and will not enter BOH, MUN or SIL. Confirm in writing that no German unit enters VIE, BUD, SER or TRI this turn. If Russia moves on GAL, I will consider coordinating with you.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1939: Germany has ended our truce and threatens VIE and TRI. Austria holds VIE, BUD, SER and TRI and will not enter RUM, GAL, WAR or SEV. Confirm that A RUM, A WAR, F SEV and A MOS stay out of BUD, SER, VIE, TRI and GAL. Tell me your autumn orders, and tell me if Germany moves against us.

England to France, Fall 1939: You said A PAR may enter an empty BEL this autumn. Please confirm which unit goes there and that nothing enters HOL, NTH or the Channel. My A HOL holds and F NTH stays put. I will not move against PIC, BRE or MAR this autumn.

England to Germany, Fall 1939: Your A KIE, A DEN, A MUN and A BOH sit close to HOL and BEL. I hold A HOL, F NTH, F LON and F EDI this autumn. I will keep F NTH and F ENG out of DEN and KIE if your armies stay out of HOL and NTH. Please confirm in writing.

France to England, Fall 1939: I will move A PIC to BEL this autumn, as I said. This is growth for me, not an attack on your fleets. Please keep F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A HOL out of BEL and PIC, and keep F MAO out of ENG. I will not move into HOL or the Channel.

France to Germany, Fall 1939: I will move A PIC to BEL this autumn, which is an empty Belgian centre. I have no move on BUR, MUN or the Rhine. Please keep your armies out of BEL, HOL and PIC, and confirm your focus stays on Austria.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1939: Our split stands. Russia takes BUD and SER as your armies can reach them, and Germany takes VIE and TRI. I will move A BOH to VIE only when BUD falls to you. Keep A BER, A DEN and A KIE's approaches clear and tell me your Fall orders in writing.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1939: Our truce is over and A BOH will press VIE. Your units cannot hold both VIE and the south against Russia. Withdraw A VIE toward GAL or HUN now and talk terms. Tell me your Fall orders in writing, and I will keep A MUN away from your other centres.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1939: I want a concrete answer. Turkey's A BUL is still in place. If you commit A SER to BUL in writing this Fall, Italy will move A GRE toward BUL in the same turn, so the attack has two supports against CON and BLA. Without your written commitment, Italy holds GRE and AEG and stays out of the Balkans. Tell me your decision now.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1939: Your A BUL is the only thing standing between us and a settled Balkans. Withdraw it to CON this Fall and Italy keeps A GRE and F AEG out of BUL, CON and BLA. If you refuse, Italy will consider a joint strike with Austria. Answer in writing before orders are sent.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1939: My A MOS, A RUM, A WAR, F SWE and F SEV hold this autumn. Are A BOH or A MUN moving on VIE or TRI? Tell me before orders are set. Your A BER, A DEN and A KIE must stay out of the Baltic approaches to SWE and out of WAR.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1939: My A RUM and F SEV hold this autumn. Will your A BUL move to SER or GRE? Tell me your orders first. Keep A CON and F BLA out of RUM and SEV, or Russia will answer with force.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1939: Your A SER has held for years and the pact is still unsigned. If A SER or A BUD moves away this autumn, Turkey's A BUL takes SER. Tell me your Fall orders in writing. Turkey keeps A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of your other Balkan centers.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1939: Your A GRE and F AEG have held the Balkans quietly. Turkey's A BUL stays put this autumn. We will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Confirm A GRE and F AEG stay out of BUL, CON and BLA, and tell me whether Italy plans to move on Greece-side targets against Turkey.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1939: Turkey has no plans against RUM or SEV. F BLA and A CON hold. If your A RUM moves to BUD this autumn, Turkey may move A BUL to SER. Confirm your Fall orders for RUM and SEV in writing, and that F SEV stays out of BLA and CON.

Austria will not withdraw. A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this Fall, with BUD supporting VIE against your A BOH and A MUN. Any German unit entering VIE, BUD, SER or TRI will be treated as a declaration of war. Keep A MUN and A BOH out of our centres and I will keep my units out of BOH, MUN and SIL.

Austria declines the Bulgaria strike this Fall. A lone or two-unit attack on A BUL cannot be made safe while CON and BLA support it, and A SER leaving would expose our whole Balkan line. A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A VIE hold. Keep A GRE and F AEG out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE as you pledged, and we can talk again once Turkey weakens.

Austria confirms A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this Fall. Our A SER and A BUD will not enter BUL or CON. I will sign the Serbian pact in writing once you confirm A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this turn and stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. Turkey's unit must not move into SER.

England to France, Fall 1939: We agreed BEL would stay empty, so an A PIC move into it breaks that understanding and I will treat it as a threat to HOL. I will not enter PIC, BRE or MAR. If you go ahead, keep A PIC out of HOL and keep F MAO out of the Channel and ENG. I will hold A HOL and F NTH this autumn.

France to England, Fall 1939: Yes, A PIC moves to BEL this autumn, as I gave notice. This is growth into an empty Belgium, not an attack on you. I will not move into HOL, the Channel or the North Sea. Please keep F NTH, F LON, F LVP and A HOL out of BEL and PIC, and keep your fleets off Brest and MAO-adjacent waters. F MAO stays out of ENG as promised.

Germany to England, Fall 1939: I will not move A KIE or A DEN into BEL, HOL or NTH this autumn, and I have no order against HOL. Keep F NTH and F ENG out of DEN and KIE as you offered. My armies are focused on Austria, so your Low Countries are safe from me for now.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1939: I cannot give the written confirmation you ask for. Our truce has ended, and A BOH is positioned against VIE. I advise you to withdraw A VIE toward GAL or HUN now. I make no promise on TRI or SER. Tell me your Fall orders in writing.

Germany to France, Fall 1939: I will keep A MUN out of BUR and PIC this autumn. Your move A PIC to BEL is your affair, but I ask that your armies stay out of MUN and the Rhine. I have no German unit ordered into BEL or HOL, so we need not quarrel. Keep your Mediterranean focus.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1939: Our split stands as agreed: Russia takes BUD and SER as your armies can reach them, and Germany takes VIE and TRI. A BER, A DEN and A KIE will keep clear of your Baltic approaches and WAR. A BOH moves on VIE only once BUD falls to you.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1939: Our Balkan line holds on our side. A GRE and F AEG hold this autumn, and no Italian unit enters BUL, CON or BLA. Your A BUL has sat in Bulgaria for years, and Italy still wants it withdrawn to CON. Keep A CON, F BLA and A BUL out of GRE, SMY and ION, and we can both press Austria and Russia.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1939: My A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this autumn, so none of them enters BUD, SER, VIE, TRI or GAL. I have no order against your centres. Germany's BOH and MUN are the threat to VIE and TRI, so watch them closely and tell me if they strike.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1939: My A MOS, A RUM, A WAR, F SWE and F SEV hold this autumn. I will not sign a written split of Austria. Keep A BER, A DEN and A KIE out of the Baltic approaches to SWE and out of WAR. Any German unit entering WAR, SWE, RUM or SEV will be met with force.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1939: My A RUM and F SEV hold this autumn, and A RUM will not move to BUD. Your A BUL is your own decision, but tell me before you move it to SER or GRE. Keep A CON and F BLA out of RUM and SEV, or Russia will answer with force.

Turkey's A BUL stays in Bulgaria this Fall and will not withdraw. Turkey will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Confirm in writing that A GRE, F AEG, A VEN and A ROM stay out of BUL, CON and BLA. Any Italian move into those provinces will be answered, but Turkey does not seek war with Italy if the Balkans stay quiet.

Turkey's A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this Fall. Turkey has no move against RUM or SEV. If your A RUM moves to BUD, Turkey may move A BUL to SER later, not now. Please confirm F SEV stays out of BLA and CON and tell me your Fall orders for RUM and SEV in writing.

notes.note: Fall 1939: A PIC to BEL as promised to England and Germany, with notice given. Other units hold; no unowned SCs reachable. Promised England F MAO stays out of ENG/Channel and no move into HOL/NTH. England warned it will treat BEL move as threat to HOL. Next: watch HOL, keep BRE/MAR/POR secure, check whether England retaliates.

Fall 1939: all hold. BUD supports VIE hold vs German BOH/MUN; SER supports TRI hold. Germany truce ended and threatens VIE/TRI. Russia pledged no entry to BUD/SER/VIE/TRI; Italy and Turkey pledged to stay out of SER/BUD/TRI/VIE, but Turkey and Italy keep BUL/GRE pressure. Declined BUL strike. Watch German BOH/MUN and Russia RUM/GAL; reconsider withdrawal from VIE only if forced.

Fall 1939: all hold to keep 5 centers. RUM->BUD unsupported would bounce and breaks no-entry terms. Germany offers split (BUD/SER to Russia), but unverified. Austria, Germany, England, Turkey kept terms. Watch Germany BOH/MUN vs VIE/TRI and Germany on WAR/SWE. Turkey's BUL to SER is its own call. Reassess Spring 1940.

Fall 1939: all hold to keep pacts with France (no Tunis/Ionian), Austria (no SER/BUD/TRI/VIE) and Turkey (no BUL/CON/BLA). Austria declined BUL strike again; Turkey's A BUL still in place and Turkey has kept Balkan pledge. No unowned centers. Next: revisit BUL only with Austrian A SER committed in writing and Turkish weakening; consider F AEG to ION for convoy to TUN/APU.

Fall 1939: France says A PIC moves to empty BEL (our center). HOL->BEL supported by NTH to block it. Keep fleets out of DEN/KIE; Germany pledged no BEL/HOL/NTH moves. Watch whether France bounces and whether HOL stays unoccupied. Next: consider convoy HOL via NTH/HEL once Germany's KIE is quiet.

Fall 1939: all hold. Attacks on SER/GRE bounce without support. Austria confirmed holds but SER pact unsigned; Russia holds RUM/SEV; Italy holds GRE/AEG. Watch for an empty SER/BUD, then move BUL to SER. Reassess Spring 1940.

Fall 1939: BOH->VIE unsupported, likely bounces, but tests Austria. Austria refused written split and said entry is war. Russia won't sign split, threatens WAR/SWE. England and France quiet in Low Countries; no pledges broken by me yet. Holding DEN/KIE/MUN. Look for supported VIE/TRI attack or Russian move on BUD/SER.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Spring 1940: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold. Please tell me in writing whether A BOH or A MUN will enter VIE, BUD, SER or TRI this spring. If Germany keeps those units off our centres, Austria will keep its units out of BOH, MUN and SIL, and we can both watch Russia.

England to France, Spring 1940: Your A PIC and A PAR were meant for PIC and BEL. I hold A BEL and F NTH this spring and will not move into PIC, BRE or MAR. Please keep A PIC, A MAR and F MAO out of BEL, HOL and the Channel. Tell me your Spring orders in writing.

England to Germany, Spring 1940: Your A KIE, A DEN and A MUN should stay out of HOL, BEL and NTH this spring. I will keep F NTH and F ENG out of DEN and KIE while your armies stay put. Please confirm your Spring orders in writing.

England to Russia, Spring 1940: My STP, NOR and LVP fleets hold and stay out of the Baltic. Please confirm F SWE and A WAR stay out of the Baltic approaches to DEN and NOR this spring. Warn me before any move toward SIL or DEN.

France to England, Spring 1940: England now holds BEL, and I will not move into BEL, HOL or the Channel this spring. Please confirm A BEL and your fleets stay out of PIC, BRE and MAO, and tell me your autumn plans for the Low Countries before you act.

France to Germany, Spring 1940: England leads the standings with 7 centres, so a balance matters to us both. I will keep my armies off MUN and BUR. Will you confirm no German unit enters BUR or PIC, and would you consider coordinating against England's growth in the Low Countries?

France to Italy, Spring 1940: Please confirm F AEG, F SMY and A NAP stay out of Tunis, Spain and Portugal this spring. I keep F MAO and A MAR off Tunis. Since England leads the standings, let us talk about keeping the western Mediterranean balanced and my Marseille and Tunis borders quiet.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1940: Austria cannot hold VIE, BUD, SER and TRI against Russia and me. Move A VIE to GAL or HUN now and I will keep A BOH and A MUN out of your southern centres. If VIE holds, A BOH and A MUN will attack it. Tell me your Spring orders in writing.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1940: Austria is collapsing. Let us agree that Russia takes BUD and SER as your armies can reach them, and Germany takes VIE and TRI. Keep A WAR, A RUM and F SEV out of GAL and BOH, and my A BER, A DEN and A KIE stay out of SWE and WAR. Confirm your Spring orders.

Germany to England, Spring 1940: My A KIE and A DEN stay out of BEL, HOL and NTH this spring. Please keep F NTH and F ENG away from DEN and KIE, as you offered. If France moves on BEL or HOL, I am willing to discuss it. Tell me your Spring orders.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1940: A lone strike on A BUL bounces against CON and BLA support, so I will not make one. If you move A SER to BUL this Spring with written commitment, I will move A GRE to BUL in the same turn. Otherwise Italy holds GRE, AEG and VEN. Please answer before orders are sent.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1940: Your A BUL has held Bulgaria for years. Withdraw it to CON this Spring and Italy keeps A GRE, F AEG and A VEN out of BUL, CON and BLA, and out of SMY and ION toward your units. Refuse and Italy will consider a joint strike with Austria. Answer in writing before orders are sent.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1940: My A WAR, A RUM, A MOS, F SEV and F SWE hold. Tell me in writing whether A BOH and A MUN are moving on VIE or TRI this spring. Your BER, DEN and KIE armies must stay out of SWE's Baltic approaches and WAR, or Russia will respond with force.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1940: A RUM, A WAR, F SEV and A MOS hold this spring and will not enter BUD, SER, VIE, TRI or GAL. Germany's BOH and MUN are the threat to you. Tell me at once if they strike, and keep your units out of RUM, WAR and SEV.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1940: Please state your Spring orders for A RUM and F SEV in writing before we move. Turkey will hold A BUL, A CON and F BLA this spring. If Austria's BUD falls to you this autumn, Turkey will take SER with A BUL. Keep F SEV out of BLA and CON.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1940: Your A SER and A BUD have stayed put for years and the pact is still unsigned. Tell me your Spring orders in writing. Turkey holds A BUL, A CON and F BLA this spring, but if SER or BUD is left empty this autumn, A BUL will take it.

Austria's answer is unchanged: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this Spring 1940. A VIE will not withdraw to GAL or HUN. Any German unit entering VIE, BUD, SER or TRI will be treated as a declaration of war. Keep A BOH and A MUN out of our centres and Austria will keep its units out of BOH, MUN and SIL.

Austria declines the Bulgaria strike this Spring. A SER stays put, so no move to BUL. Our A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A VIE hold. Please keep GRE, AEG and VEN units out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE as you pledged. We can revisit the Balkans once Turkey's A BUL weakens and you confirm in writing.

Austria confirms A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this Spring 1940. We will not enter RUM, GAL, WAR or SEV. Please keep A RUM, A WAR, F SEV and A MOS out of BUD, SER, VIE, TRI and GAL. Germany's BOH and MUN are the threat. I will tell you at once if they strike, and I ask you to do the same.

Austria confirms A SER and A BUD hold this Spring 1940 and will not enter BUL or CON. I am ready to sign the Serbian border pact in writing once you confirm A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this turn and stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. Turkey's unit must not enter SER.

England to Germany, Spring 1940: My units hold this spring, with no move on HOL, KIE, DEN or NOR. I will keep F NTH and F ENG out of DEN and KIE while your A KIE, A DEN and A MUN stay out of BEL, HOL and NTH. Confirm and we can discuss France together if it moves on BEL or HOL.

England to France, Spring 1940: A BEL holds this spring, with F NTH and the northern fleets also holding. I make no move on PIC, BRE, MAR, MAO or the Channel. Keep A PIC, A PAR and F MAO out of BEL, HOL, ENG and the Channel. I will give notice before any autumn change near the Low Countries.

France, Spring 1940: Understood. My A PIC, A PAR, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO hold this spring, with no move into BEL, HOL, the Channel or PIC-to-BEL. Please keep A BEL and your fleets out of PIC, BRE and MAO. Any autumn change gets notice first from me.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1940: I will not commit to a written pledge while your A VIE holds Vienna against my A BOH. Withdraw A VIE to GAL or HUN and I will keep A MUN out of your southern centres this spring. If VIE holds, I will attack it and I will not apologise. Give me your Spring orders in writing.

Germany to England, Spring 1940: My A KIE and A DEN stay out of BEL, HOL and NTH this spring, as I said. Keep F NTH and F ENG away from DEN and KIE and we both stay quiet in the north. If France moves on BEL or HOL, tell me, and we can discuss it properly.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1940: Austria's VIE is the obstacle, and I will take it if I must. My A BER, A DEN and A KIE stay out of SWE and WAR this spring. Keep A WAR, A RUM and F SEV out of GAL and BOH, and we can settle the rest of the split once Vienna falls.

Germany to France, Spring 1940: I confirm A MUN holds this spring and no German unit enters BUR or PIC. Keep your armies out of MUN and the Rhine. England's growth in the Low Countries is a fair concern, and I will discuss it with you once the Austrian front settles, not before.

Italy to France, Spring 1940: Confirmed. F AEG, F SMY and A NAP hold this spring, with no move toward Spain, Portugal, the Gulf of Lyon or Tunis. I ask that F MAO and A MAR stay off Tunis and Italian soil. I will tell you first before any change in the Mediterranean. Please send your Spring 1940 orders first.

Russia to England, Spring 1940: F SWE and A WAR hold this spring. Neither moves toward the Baltic approaches to DEN or NOR, or toward SIL. Keep your STP, NOR and LVP fleets out of the Baltic as agreed, and I will warn you before any northern change.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1940: A WAR, A RUM, A MOS, F SEV and F SWE hold this spring. I will not sign a written split of VIE or TRI. Your A BER, A DEN and A KIE must stay out of SWE's Baltic approaches and WAR. Any German unit entering WAR, SWE, RUM or SEV will be met with force.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1940: A RUM and F SEV hold this spring. I make no commitment on BUD or SER. Keep A CON and F BLA out of RUM and SEV, and keep F SEV out of BLA and CON as you asked. Tell me your orders before you move A BUL, and any Turkish move into the Black Sea will be answered.

Turkey's Spring 1940 orders: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold. We will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Our Bulgaria position is defensive, not aggressive. Keep A GRE, F AEG and A VEN out of BUL, CON and BLA, and we will not strike you. A joint strike with Austria would be a serious mistake for you, since Turkey will respond in force. Let us both press Austria and Russia.

notes.note: Spring 1940: all hold per pacts. BUD supports VIE hold vs German BOH/MUN. Germany refuses written pledge; Russia and Turkey pledges unchanged. Italy declined BUL strike. Watch German BOH/MUN on VIE; revisit BUL only with Italian written commitment and Turkish weakening.

Spring 1940: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). No unowned centers reachable; attacks on BUD/GAL would bounce unsupported. Germany (BER/DEN/KIE) and England have kept terms so far; Germany BOH/MUN still unverified on VIE/TRI. Watch Germany on WAR/SWE. Consider F SEV->BLA then convoy RUM to ANK in a later turn.

Spring 1940: F AEG to ION to set up convoy of A GRE or A NAP next turn toward Africa/Balkans. Kept pacts: no entry into BUL/CON/BLA/SER/BUD/TRI/VIE, no Tunis/Spain/Portugal move. Austria, Turkey, France kept pledges so far. Revisit BUL only with written Austrian commitment.

Spring 1940: all hold. Attacks on SER/GRE would bounce without support. Italy, Austria and Russia have not broken agreements. Watch for empty SER/BUD/GRE in Fall and move A BUL into any vacated center.

Spring 1940: all hold. VIE attack bounces unsupported (MUN cannot support VIE). Pledges kept: France (no BUR/PIC, MUN held), England (no BEL/HOL/NTH), Russia (no WAR/SWE/RUM/SEV), Austria (no entry to VIE/BUD/SER/TRI yet). Watch Russia BUD/SER and Austria VIE; consider supported VIE attack once Austria weakens. Next: keep 4 SC, seek gains in Fall.

Spring 1940: held all per pledges to France (BEL, PIC, Channel) and Germany (no DEN/KIE moves). No unowned centers and any entry into DEN/KIE/PIC bounces. England leads at 7. Next: watch if Germany's KIE or DEN support leaves, then consider NTH/convoy attack on DEN. Keep fleets off Baltic and Channel.

Spring 1940: all holds to honor promises (no BEL/HOL/Channel/ENG moves, MAO out of ENG, no Tunis move). England, Germany, Italy confirmed holds. No unowned SCs reachable. Next: watch England's A BEL and fall plans; consider Tunis only with Italy's notice; MAO to ENG convoy would break England's request.

messages.body: Austria asks Germany directly: will A BOH or A MUN attack VIE, BUD, SER or TRI this Fall? Austria has no plan against BOH, MUN or SIL. If Germany holds off, we can both turn our forces toward Russia or Italy, and I will keep my units out of your centres.

Austria asks Russia to confirm again that A RUM, A WAR, F SEV and A MOS will not enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI this Fall. Germany's A BOH and A MUN are the danger to us. If Germany moves, please tell me at once. Austria will not move into RUM, WAR or SEV.

Austria asks Italy to confirm in writing that GRE, AEG and VEN will stay out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE this Fall. Austria will keep A SER and A BUD in place and will not move toward VEN or the Adriatic. Tell me your plans for Greece and Turkey's A BUL.

England to Germany, Fall 1940: I am holding all units this autumn: A BEL, F NTH, F LON, F LVP, F EDI. I will not enter DEN or KIE. Please confirm your A KIE, A DEN and A MUN stay out of BEL, HOL and NTH, and tell me your autumn orders in writing.

England to France, Fall 1940: My units hold this autumn: A BEL, F NTH, F LON, F LVP, F EDI. I make no move on PIC, BRE, MAR, MAO or the Channel. Please keep A PIC, A PAR and F MAO out of BEL, HOL, ENG and the Channel, and give me notice of any change.

England to Russia, Fall 1940: My STP, NOR and LVP fleets hold this autumn and stay out of the Baltic. Please confirm F SWE and A WAR stay out of the Baltic approaches to DEN and NOR, and that nothing moves toward SIL. Warn me before any northern change.

France to England, Fall 1940: A PIC and A POR hold this autumn, and F MAO stays out of ENG and the Channel. I will not move into BEL, HOL, PIC or BRE. Please confirm your fleets stay out of BRE, MAO and the Channel, and tell me your autumn plans before you move.

France to Germany, Fall 1940: My armies hold this autumn and I make no move on MUN, BUR or the Rhine. England now leads with 7 centres and holds BEL. Will you confirm no German unit enters BUR or PIC, and would you discuss coordinating to check England's growth once Austria settles?

France to Italy, Fall 1940: F MAO and A MAR hold this autumn with no move toward Tunis. Please confirm F AEG, F SMY and A NAP stay out of Spain, Portugal and the western Mediterranean, and tell me first about any Ionian or Tunis change.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1940: Austria's VIE is my target and BUD/SER are yours if you take them. Please keep F SEV and A RUM out of GAL and BOH, and I will keep A BOH, A MUN and A BER out of WAR, SWE and RUM. Will you confirm your Fall orders and whether you will strike BUD this autumn?

Germany to France, Fall 1940: England now leads with 7 centres and holds HOL and BEL beside us. I propose we both watch its Low Countries growth. Your A PIC and A BEL are within reach of its fleets. Tell me your Fall orders, and I will keep A MUN and A BOH out of BUR and PIC.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1940: Your A VIE is still the obstacle between us. If it withdraws to GAL or HUN this autumn, I will keep my armies out of your southern centres. If it holds, A BOH and A MUN will strike it. Tell me your Fall orders in writing.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1940: Turkey is down to 3 centers and A BUL is isolated. Proposal: your A SER moves to BUL and my A GRE moves to BUL in the same turn, with F SMY supporting from the Aegean side if needed. Confirm in writing before orders go out, or tell me your alternative for Turkey.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1940: Your A BUL is cut off and Austria is ready to move against it. Withdraw A BUL to CON now and Italy keeps GRE, SMY and ION units out of BUL, CON and BLA. Refuse, and Italy will strike BUL with Austria. Answer in writing before orders are sent.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1940: Your BOH and MUN have not struck VIE or TRI yet. Are you attacking Austria this autumn? I want BUD for Russia as agreed. Keep A BER, A DEN and A KIE out of SWE and WAR, and I will keep my armies out of BOH and MUN. Confirm in writing.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1940: A RUM and F SEV hold this autumn. If Austria's SER falls, Turkey may take it with A BUL, and I will not contest it. Keep A CON and F BLA out of RUM and SEV. Tell me your orders for A BUL before you move.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1940: Austria is our shared obstacle. If you take BUD this autumn, Turkey's A BUL moves to SER the same turn. Please confirm your Fall orders for A RUM and F SEV in writing, and that F SEV stays out of BLA and CON.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1940: Your A SER and A BUD have held for years. Sign the Serbian border pact now and Turkey keeps A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. Tell me your Fall orders in writing before any move.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1940: Turkey will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Confirm in writing that A GRE, F AEG and A VEN stay out of BUL, CON and BLA. A joint strike on us would draw a full Turkish response, so let us both press Austria and Russia instead.

Austria will not withdraw A VIE. A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this Fall, and BUD supports VIE. Any German unit entering VIE, BUD, SER or TRI is a declaration of war. Keep A BOH and A MUN off our centres and Austria stays out of BOH, MUN and SIL.

Austria declines the Bulgaria move again. A SER leaving exposes our whole Balkan line, and a two-unit attack on BUL still faces CON and BLA support. Keep GRE, AEG and VEN out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE as pledged. If Turkey weakens, we can talk again in writing.

Austria confirms A SER and A BUD hold this Fall and will not enter BUL or CON. If Turkey's A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold and stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM, I will sign the Serbian border pact in writing this turn. Any Turkish unit entering SER breaks that line.

England confirms: A BEL, F NTH, F LON, F LVP and F EDI all hold this autumn. No English move into BRE, MAO, PIC, MAR or the Channel. Please keep A PIC, A POR and F MAO out of BEL, HOL, ENG and the Channel, and give me notice before any autumn change.

France to England, Fall 1940: As promised, A PIC and A POR hold this autumn, and F MAO stays out of ENG and the Channel. I will not move into BEL, HOL, PIC or BRE. Please keep your fleets out of BRE, MAO and the Channel, and give me notice before any change near the Low Countries.

France to Germany, Fall 1940: My armies hold this autumn, with no move on MUN, BUR or the Rhine. Thank you for confirming A MUN stays out of BUR and PIC. I am open to discussing how we check England's Low Countries growth once Austria settles. Let us talk again next spring before either of us commits.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1940: A VIE is the obstacle. If it withdraws to GAL or HUN this autumn, my armies stay out of your southern centres. If it holds, A BOH and A MUN will strike it. I make no written pledge beyond that. Send your Fall orders.

Germany to England, Fall 1940: My A KIE, A DEN and A MUN will not enter BEL, HOL or NTH this autumn. Keep F NTH and F ENG away from DEN and KIE as you offered. I will not confirm more than that, but the north stays quiet from my side.

Germany to France, Fall 1940: I agree England's Low Countries growth is a concern. A MUN and A BOH will not enter BUR or PIC this autumn. Tell me your Fall orders first, and we can discuss a coordinated approach to England once Austria settles.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1940: A BER, A DEN and A KIE will stay out of SWE and WAR. A BOH and A MUN will not enter BUD or SER. Our split stands: BUD and SER are yours if you take them. A BOH moves on VIE only if Austria collapses. Confirm your Fall orders.

Italy confirms that no Italian unit will enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this Fall. A GRE, F ION and A VEN hold for now. Your proposal for A SER to BUL is still on the table, but I need your written commitment before Italy commits A GRE to BUL. Confirm your Fall orders for SER and BUD first.

Confirmed. Italy has no move toward Tunis, Spain, Portugal or the western Mediterranean this Fall. F ION, F SMY and A NAP hold, and I ask that F MAO and A MAR stay off Tunis and Italian soil. I will tell you first before any change in the Ionian or Tunis.

Italy will not move into BUL, CON or BLA this Fall, and A GRE, F ION and A VEN hold. Turkey's A BUL remains a problem for us, and Austria has asked about it. Keep F BLA, A CON and A BUL out of GRE, SMY and ION, and we will see what the season brings.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1940: A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this autumn. None enters BUD, SER, VIE, TRI or GAL, and none moves into your territory. Germany's A BOH and A MUN are the real threat, and I will tell you at once if I hear of any move against you.

Russia to England, Fall 1940: F SWE and A WAR hold this autumn. Neither moves toward the Baltic approaches to DEN or NOR, nor toward SIL. Keep your STP, NOR and LVP fleets out of the Baltic as agreed, and I will warn you before any northern change.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1940: I will not sign a written split of Austria. My armies hold this autumn. Keep A BER, A DEN and A KIE out of SWE's Baltic approaches and WAR, and any German unit entering WAR, SWE, RUM or SEV will be met with force. Tell me if BOH or MUN strikes Austria.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1940: A RUM and F SEV hold this autumn. I will not contest SER if Turkey takes it with A BUL. Keep A CON and F BLA out of RUM and SEV, and tell me your A BUL orders before you move. Any Turkish move into the Black Sea or RUM will be answered with force.

Turkey will not withdraw A BUL to CON this Fall. It holds BUL, CON and BLA as defense only. Turkey will not enter GRE, SMY or ION, and we ask that A GRE, F ION and A VEN stay out of BUL, CON and BLA. Turkey is not seeking war with Italy. Let us both press Austria and Russia.

Turkey proposes this: if your A RUM takes BUD this Fall, Turkey's A BUL moves to SER the same turn. Please confirm in writing that your A RUM and F SEV hold or move to BUD only as stated, and that F SEV stays out of BLA and CON. Turkey will keep F BLA and A CON out of RUM and SEV.

notes.note: Fall 1940: all holds, honoring promises to England (no BEL/HOL/ENG/Channel/BRE/MAO moves) and Germany (no BUR/MUN). Italy confirmed holds in Ionian/Med, no Tunis move. No unowned SCs reachable. England leads at 7 SCs; plan to coordinate with Germany against England after Austria settles. Watch England's A BEL and Italy's F ION.

Fall 1940: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). BUD/SER only via Turkish or Austrian collapse; RUM->BUD unsupported bounces. Germany says BUD/SER are ours if taken. Watch Germany BOH/MUN on VIE/TRI and WAR/SWE; watch Turkey on RUM/SEV. Consider SEV->BLA only once Turkish F BLA moves.

Fall 1940: holding VIE, BUD, SER, TRI; BUD supports VIE vs German BOH/MUN. Declined Italy's SER-to-BUL proposal (bounce risk vs CON/BLA support). Germany refuses written pledge; Russia and Turkey pledges unchanged. Revisit BUL only with written Italian commitment and Turkish weakening.

Fall 1940: holding all, keeping pacts with France (no Tunis/Spain/Portugal), Austria (no SER/BUD/TRI/VIE), Turkey (no BUL/CON/BLA). No unowned centers. Turkey refuses to withdraw A BUL. Revisit BUL strike only with Austrian A SER committed in writing; Austria has declined twice. Watch Turkish moves to GRE/SMY/ION.

Fall 1940: held all units per pledges to France (BEL, Channel, PIC/BRE/MAO) and Germany (no DEN/KIE entry). Russia kept SWE out of north. Germany says north stays quiet. No unowned centers; holding this turn. Next: consider convoy A BEL via NTH to DEN/HOL if Germany's KIE/DEN support is weak. Keep pledges unless a clear gain appears.

Fall 1940: KIE to HOL (England SC, unoccupied, England says it holds) to gain a center; this breaks my no-HOL pledge to England. BOH, DEN, MUN hold to avoid the Austria/Russia/France lines. Watch England's BEL retaliation and Austria's VIE. Next: consider DEN/KIE refilling, and support HOL if contested.

Fall 1940: all hold. Attacks on SER/GRE would bounce without support. Russia said it won't contest SER if we take it; Austria's SER pact still unsigned. Italy and Russia promises of no move into BUL/CON/BLA/RUM/SEV are unverified. If BUD or SER empties, move BUL in. Reassess Spring 1941.

messages.body: Austria asks Germany for its Spring 1941 intentions for A BOH and A MUN. Austria holds VIE, BUD, SER and TRI and will not enter BOH, MUN or SIL. Confirm in writing that German units will not enter VIE, BUD, SER or TRI this spring, and we will keep our units at home.

Austria asks Italy what A GRE, A VEN and A ROM plan this spring. Austria holds SER and BUD and will not enter BUL or CON. Please confirm no Italian unit enters SER, BUD, TRI or VIE. Any move against Turkey's BUL needs a written plan from both of us first.

Austria asks Russia to confirm that A RUM, A WAR, F SEV and A MOS will not enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI this spring. Austria will not enter RUM, WAR or SEV. If Germany moves against VIE or TRI, please tell us at once.

England to Germany, Spring 1941: I hold all units this spring: A BEL, F NTH, F NWG-area fleets, F LON, F LVP, F EDI, F STP. Please confirm your A DEN, A KIE, A HOL and new A BER stay out of BEL, HOL, NTH and NOR. I will keep F NTH away from DEN and KIE. Tell me your spring orders in writing.

England to Russia, Spring 1941: My STP, NOR and LVP fleets hold this spring and stay out of the Baltic. Please confirm F SWE and A WAR stay out of the approaches to DEN and NOR, and that nothing moves toward SIL. Warn me before any northern change.

England to France, Spring 1941: A BEL, F NTH and my Channel fleets hold this spring. I make no move on PIC, BRE, MAR, MAO or the Channel. Please confirm A PIC, A PAR and F MAO stay out of BEL, HOL, ENG and the Channel, and give me notice of any autumn change.

France to Germany, Spring 1941: England now leads at 6 centres and holds BEL beside our borders. I propose we coordinate: you press England through HOL and the North Sea, while my armies stay in Picardy and Burgundy. Will you confirm no German unit enters BUR or PIC this spring?

France to England, Spring 1941: My A PIC and A PAR hold this spring, and F MAO stays out of ENG and the Channel as promised. Please confirm A BEL and your fleets stay out of PIC, BRE and MAO. Tell me your autumn plans for the Low Countries before you act.

France to Italy, Spring 1941: F MAO and A MAR hold this spring with no move on Tunis. Please confirm F ION, F SMY and A NAP stay out of Spain, Portugal and the western Mediterranean. If you plan any Tunis move, tell me first so neither of us is caught off guard.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1941: My A BOH and A MUN are the threat to your VIE. If you pull A VIE back to GAL or HUN this spring, I will keep my armies out of BUD, SER and TRI. If it holds, I will attack it. Tell me your Spring orders in writing.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1941: Austria's VIE is my target, and BUD and SER are yours if you take them. I will keep A BOH and A MUN out of GAL and WAR. Please keep your armies out of BOH and MUN. What are your Spring orders?

Germany to England, Spring 1941: My A HOL came from KIE last autumn, and I know that broke my pledge. I will not move further into BEL or NTH. Keep F NTH and F ENG away from DEN and KIE, and tell me your Spring orders.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1941: Turkey's A BUL is cut off and Russia is the larger threat to both of us. I propose we hold our current lines this spring, then talk about a joint Balkan move in Fall 1941 with your A SER and my A GRE, but only with written commitments before orders. What is your answer?

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1941: We have kept our pledges, but A BUL remains isolated and Austria is pressing. Confirm in writing that Turkey will not enter GRE, SMY or ION this spring, and Italy will keep A GRE, F ION and A VEN out of BUL, CON and BLA. Tell me your plans against Russia.

Italy to France, Spring 1941: Confirmed again. F ION, F SMY and A NAP hold this spring with no move toward Tunis, Spain or Portugal. Please keep F MAO and A MAR off Tunis and Italian soil, and tell me first about any change in the western Mediterranean.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1941: Your new A BER and A DEN must stay out of SWE and WAR, and A BOH and A MUN out of RUM and SEV. I will hold A WAR, A RUM, A MOS and F SEV, and F SWE holds. Confirm your Spring orders in writing before anyone moves.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1941: My A MOS, A RUM, A WAR, F SEV and F SWE hold this spring and will not enter BUD, SER, VIE, TRI or GAL. Germany's A BOH and A MUN remain the threat. Tell me at once if they strike, and what you need from me.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1941: Austria is weakest on our shared border. Let's coordinate: if your A RUM moves to BUD this Fall, Turkey's A BUL moves to SER the same turn. Confirm in writing that F SEV stays out of BLA and CON, and that A RUM will not enter BUL.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1941: We have held BUL and CON for years without threatening you. Your A SER and A BUD are exposed to Russia. Before we sign anything, state your Spring orders in writing and confirm A SER and A BUD will not enter BUL or CON.

Austria's Spring 1941 orders: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold. We will not enter BOH, MUN or SIL. Any German unit entering VIE, BUD, SER or TRI will be treated as a declaration of war. Confirm in writing that A BOH and A MUN will stay out of those four centres this spring.

Austria holds VIE, BUD, SER and TRI this spring and will not enter RUM, WAR, SEV or GAL. Please confirm in writing that A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV will not enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. If Germany's A BOH or A MUN moves on us, we will tell you at once.

Austria agrees to hold current lines this spring. Please confirm in writing that GRE, VEN, ROM and any other Italian unit will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE. We can discuss a joint Balkan move for Fall 1941 once Turkey's A BUL weakens, with written commitments on both sides first.

Austria's Spring 1941 orders: A SER, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold. Neither A SER nor A BUD will enter BUL or CON. Confirm in writing that A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring and stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. Once you do, Austria will sign the Serbian border pact.

England to France, Spring 1941: A BEL, F NTH and my Channel fleets hold this spring. I will not move on PIC, BRE, MAR, MAO or the Channel. Your A PIC, A PAR and F MAO stay out of BEL, HOL, ENG and the Channel, and I will give you notice before any autumn change near the Low Countries.

England to Germany, Spring 1941: Thanks for acknowledging HOL. I hold this spring. Keep A DEN, A KIE, A HOL and A BER out of BEL, HOL, NTH and NOR, and I will keep F NTH and F ENG away from DEN and KIE. Any move into BEL or NTH breaks this, and I will respond.

France to England, Spring 1941: Confirmed. A PIC, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO all hold this spring. I make no move into BEL, HOL, ENG or the Channel. Please keep A BEL and your fleets out of PIC, BRE and MAO. I will give you notice before any autumn change near the Low Countries.

France to Italy, Spring 1941: Confirmed. F MAO and A MAR hold this spring, with no move on Tunis or Italian soil. Please keep F ION, F SMY and A NAP out of Spain, Portugal and the western Mediterranean. I will tell you first before any change in the Mediterranean.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1941: I make no written pledge on VIE, BUD, SER or TRI. My orders for A BOH and A MUN are not yet fixed, and I will not announce them. Keep your units home and watch Russia. Any move I make will be clear before autumn.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1941: My A BER, A DEN and A KIE will not enter SWE, WAR, RUM or SEV this spring. A BOH and A MUN will not enter BUD or SER. Keep your armies out of BOH and MUN, and we can both deal with Austria later. Send your Spring orders.

Germany to England, Spring 1941: My A HOL holds this spring and I will not move into BEL or NTH. Keep F NTH and your fleets away from DEN and KIE, as you offered. I have no order against NOR. Hold your position in the north and we stay quiet.

Germany to France, Spring 1941: I confirm A MUN and A BOH will not enter BUR or PIC this spring. Your proposal to press England is interesting, but I will not move against England's Low Countries until Austria settles. Keep your armies in Picardy and Burgundy and we can talk again in autumn.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1941: A GRE, A VEN and A ROM hold this spring. No Italian unit enters SER, BUD, TRI, VIE, BUL or CON. I agree to hold our lines and discuss a Fall 1941 Balkan move, with your A SER and my A GRE, only with written commitments before orders are sent.

Italy to France, Spring 1941: Confirmed. F ION, F SMY and A NAP hold this spring, with no move toward Tunis, Spain or Portugal. Please keep F MAO and A MAR off Tunis and Italian soil. I will tell you first before any change in the western Mediterranean.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1941: No written split of Austria. Your new A BER and A DEN must stay out of SWE and WAR, and A BOH and A MUN out of RUM and SEV. A WAR, A RUM, A MOS, F SEV and F SWE hold this spring. Any German unit entering WAR, SWE, RUM or SEV will be met with force.

Russia to England, Spring 1941: F SWE holds and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI or the Baltic approaches to DEN or NOR. Nothing moves toward SIL. Keep your STP, NOR and LVP fleets out of the Baltic as agreed, and I will warn you before any northern change.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1941: A RUM, A WAR, F SEV and A MOS hold this spring and will not enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. We will not enter BUL. Germany's A BOH and A MUN are the threat. Tell me at once if they strike, and I will do the same.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1941: A RUM and F SEV hold this spring, and A RUM will not enter BUL. I make no written commitment on BUD or SER. Keep A CON and F BLA out of RUM and SEV, or Russia will answer with force. Tell me your A BUL orders before you move.

Turkey confirms in writing: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this Spring 1941, and no Turkish unit enters GRE, SMY or ION. Please keep A GRE, F ION and A VEN out of BUL, CON and BLA. Our focus is Russia's southern holdings and Austria, and Turkey will not move against Italy while the Balkans stay quiet.

notes.note: Spring 1941: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). No written split of Austria; no-entry terms with Germany, Austria, England, Turkey so far kept. Watch Germany BOH/MUN on WAR/RUM and new BER on SWE/WAR. Consider SEV->BLA then convoy RUM to ANK later.

Spring 1941: all hold per pledges to Russia, Italy, Turkey, Germany. Germany gave no written pledge on VIE/BUD/SER/TRI; watch BOH/MUN. Russia and Italy kept lines so far. Revisit BUL only with written Italian plan and Turkish weakening.

Spring 1941: all holds to honor promises to England (no BEL/HOL/ENG/Channel moves, MAO out of ENG) and Italy (no Tunis move). Germany confirmed no BUR/PIC entry. No unowned SCs reachable. Next: watch England's A BEL and fall plans; consider coordinating with Germany against England once Austria settles.

Spring 1941: all hold to keep pledges (Austria no VIE/BUD/SER/TRI entry; England no BEL/NTH; Russia no WAR/SWE/RUM/SEV/GAL; France no BUR/PIC). Broke HOL pledge to England in Fall 1940 via KIE->HOL. Austria, England, Russia all still holding. Next: watch Russia on Austria; consider supported VIE attack in Fall if Austria weakens.

Spring 1941: holding all to keep pacts with France (no Tunis/Spain), Austria (no SER/BUD/TRI/VIE) and Turkey (no BUL/CON/BLA). No unowned centers. Austria and Turkey both refuse a BUL strike. Next: revisit a Fall 1941 Balkan move only if Austria commits in writing and Turkey weakens. Watch Turkish moves to GRE/SMY/ION.

Spring 1941: all hold. Attacks on SER/GRE/RUM would bounce without support. BLA supports BUL holding. Austria's SER pact unsigned; Russia says A RUM won't enter BUL. Italy keeps GRE/ION/VEN out of BUL/CON/BLA. Watch for empty SER/BUD and move BUL into SER if vacated.

Spring 1941: BEL->HOL, NTH supports BEL to HOL to test Germany's HOL. Holding others. Pledges: France (no PIC/BRE/MAO/Channel), Russia (stay out of Baltic), Germany (no DEN/KIE). Check France and Germany reactions next turn.

messages.body: Austria asks Germany directly: will A BOH or A MUN move into VIE, BUD, SER or TRI this Fall? Austria holds all four and will not enter BOH, MUN or SIL. Any entry into our centres means war. Confirm in writing that you will stay out, and we will keep our armies at home.

Austria proposes a written non-aggression line: Russia keeps A RUM, A WAR, F SEV and A MOS out of GAL, BUD, SER, VIE and TRI, and Austria stays out of RUM, WAR, SEV and GAL. Germany's BOH and MUN are the shared threat. Tell me your Fall orders before we both move.
