Austria confirms it will keep A SER and A BUD out of BUL and CON this Fall. Please confirm in writing that no Italian unit, including A GRE, A VEN and A ROM, enters SER, BUD, TRI or VIE. Any Balkan move against Turkey needs both written commitments first.

England to Germany, Fall 1941: A HOL is staying put this autumn and F NTH will support it. Any move from KIE, MUN or BER into HOL is a direct attack on us. Your HOL centre is retreating, so please confirm your autumn orders in writing and keep A DEN and A KIE out of NTH and BEL.

England to France, Fall 1941: BEL is empty and is my supply centre. Please keep A PIC and A PAR out of BEL and HOL this autumn. I will keep my fleets out of PIC, BRE and MAO. Tell me your autumn orders before you move near the Low Countries.

France to England, Fall 1941: Belgium is empty and England's centre, but I have not occupied it. Your A HOL and F NTH are close to my PIC. I will give notice now: A PIC goes to BEL this autumn unless you give me a concrete reason to hold. I will keep F MAO out of ENG and the Channel.

France to Germany, Fall 1941: I intend A PIC to BEL this autumn, taking England's empty centre. I ask that A MUN and A BOH stay out of BUR and PIC, and that you press England through HOL and the North Sea. Tell me your autumn orders so we avoid a clash.

France to Italy, Fall 1941: F MAO will move to WES this autumn, a step toward the western Mediterranean, but I still make no move on Tunis. Please confirm F ION and F SMY stay out of WES and TUN, and tell me first if you plan any move there.

Germany to England, Fall 1941: Your A HOL sits on my former centre. I may retake it with A KIE this autumn unless you withdraw. Keep F NTH and F LON away from DEN and KIE, and I will keep A DEN out of NTH and BEL. Tell me your Fall orders.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1941: A BOH and A MUN will strike VIE this autumn, supported. Withdraw A VIE to GAL or HUN and I stay out of BUD, SER and TRI. If it holds, Austria loses its capital. Tell me your Fall orders in writing.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1941: I am taking VIE this autumn, not BUD or SER, which remain yours if you take them. Keep your armies out of BOH and MUN, and I will keep A BER, A DEN and A KIE out of SWE and WAR. Tell me your Fall orders.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1941: A GRE, F ION, F SMY, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN all hold this Fall. No Italian unit enters SER, BUD, TRI or VIE. I'm open to a written Balkan plan only if Turkey's A BUL weakens. Tell me your Fall orders for A SER and A BUD first.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1941: Italy keeps its pledge. A GRE, F ION and A VEN hold, and no Italian unit enters BUL, CON or BLA. Please confirm in writing that F SMY and F ION stay clear of Turkish waters and that no Turkish unit enters GRE, SMY or ION this Fall.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1941: My A WAR, A RUM, A MOS, F SEV and F SWE hold this autumn. Your BER, DEN and KIE must stay out of SWE and WAR. Please confirm your Fall 1941 orders for BOH and MUN, and say whether either will enter GAL, RUM or SEV.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1941: A RUM and F SEV hold this autumn and A RUM will not enter BUL. Keep A CON and F BLA out of RUM and SEV. Tell me your A BUL and CON orders before you move, and I will tell you mine.

Turkey asks Austria to state its Fall 1941 orders in writing. Turkey's A BUL, A CON and F BLA will hold and stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. Austria's A SER and A BUD must not enter BUL or CON. Let's sign the Serbian border pact now. If SER or BUD is left empty, A BUL will take it.

Turkey asks Russia for its Fall 1941 orders for A RUM and F SEV in writing. Turkey's F BLA and A CON will not enter RUM or SEV this autumn. Please confirm F SEV stays out of BLA and CON, and A RUM stays out of BUL. If BUD or SER empties, Turkey's A BUL moves in.

Turkey asks Italy to confirm in writing that A GRE, F ION and A VEN stay out of BUL, CON and BLA this Fall. Turkey will hold BUL, CON and BLA and will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Keeping the Balkan theatre quiet lets both of us press Austria and Russia.

Austria will not withdraw A VIE. VIE, BUD, SER and TRI hold this Fall, with BUD supporting VIE. Any German unit entering VIE, BUD, SER or TRI is a declaration of war. Your A BOH and A MUN should stay out of Austria's centres. Austria stays out of BOH, MUN and SIL.

Austria holds A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A VIE this Fall. No joint Balkan move this Fall. Please confirm in writing that A GRE, F ION, F SMY, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE. We can revisit Turkey in spring if Turkey's A BUL weakens.

Austria's Fall 1941 orders: A SER and A BUD hold, and neither enters BUL or CON. Austria will sign the Serbian border pact once you confirm in writing that A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this turn and stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM.

England to Germany, Fall 1941: A HOL holds with F NTH support, and that is my final position on HOL. If A KIE or A MUN moves into HOL, it bounces and you lose the army. I will keep F NTH and F LON out of DEN and KIE while your armies stay out of HOL, BEL and NTH. Confirm your autumn orders in writing.

England to France, Fall 1941: A PIC into BEL breaks our understanding, and I will treat it as a direct threat to HOL. A HOL and F NTH will hold and contest BEL. Keep A PIC, A PAR and F MAO out of BEL, HOL and the Channel. If you want a deal, offer me a concrete option for PIC and I will consider it.

France to England, Fall 1941: As I gave notice, A PIC moves to BEL this autumn. Belgium is empty and I need a centre to hold my position. I will not move into HOL, NTH, ENG or the Channel, and F MAO stays out of ENG. Keep A HOL and F NTH out of BEL and PIC, and let us focus on Germany's KIE and DEN in 1942.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1941: My A BOH and A MUN are moving toward VIE this autumn, and VIE is my target. If A VIE withdraws to GAL or HUN, I will not enter BUD, SER or TRI this autumn. If it holds, it will be attacked. I will not confirm more in writing.

Germany to England, Fall 1941: I will not move A DEN into NTH or BEL, and I ask that F NTH and F LON stay away from DEN and KIE. A KIE holds this autumn. Your A HOL is a matter we can revisit in Spring. Keep your fleets home and we stay quiet in the north.

Germany to France, Fall 1941: A MUN and A BOH will not enter BUR or PIC this autumn. Your A PIC to BEL is your affair, provided your armies stay out of BUR, MUN and the Rhine. I still want to discuss England's Low Countries growth in Spring, so tell me your Spring plans first.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1941: My A BER, A DEN and A KIE will not enter SWE, WAR, RUM or SEV this autumn. A BOH and A MUN will not enter BUD or SER. Your BUD and SER claims stand. Please keep your armies out of BOH and MUN, and tell me your Fall orders in writing.

Italy confirms in writing that no Italian unit enters SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this Fall. A GRE, F ION, F SMY, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN all hold. Italy will not enter BUL or CON either. Any Balkan move against Turkey must wait for a later written plan from both of us.

Italy confirms that A GRE, F ION and A VEN hold this Fall and no Italian unit enters BUL, CON or BLA. F SMY also holds. We expect Turkey to keep A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of GRE, SMY and ION as you have pledged. Italy is focused on Russia and Austria.

Italy confirms F ION and F SMY will not enter WES or TUN this Fall. A NAP holds too. Italy has no move on Tunis. Please tell me before your fleet moves past WES toward TYS or TUN, and keep F MAO and A MAR off Italian soil and Tunis.

Russia confirms A RUM, A WAR, F SEV and A MOS all hold this Fall. None will enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Austria's units are not threatened by us. Germany's A BOH and A MUN remain the danger. Tell me at once if they strike VIE or TRI, and we will coordinate.

Russia's A WAR, A RUM, A MOS, F SEV and F SWE all hold this Fall. Your A BER, A DEN and A KIE must stay out of SWE and WAR. Keep A BOH and A MUN out of RUM, SEV and GAL, and we have no quarrel. We will not sign a split of Austria.

Russia's A RUM and F SEV hold this Fall, and A RUM will not enter BUL. Keep A CON and F BLA out of RUM and SEV, and any Turkish move there will be answered with force. Tell me your A BUL and CON orders before you move. Our orders are as stated.

Turkey's A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this Fall, as I said. We have no move on RUM or SEV. Your A RUM staying out of BUL is noted. Austria's BUD and SER are the open targets, so tell me your Fall orders for A RUM and F SEV in writing before Spring 1942 moves are set.

Turkey confirms: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this Fall, and no Turkish unit enters GRE, SMY or ION. Please keep A GRE, F ION and A VEN out of BUL, CON and BLA as you have pledged. Turkey wants the Balkans quiet while we deal with Austria and Russia.

notes.note: Fall 1941: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). Germany says it takes VIE, not BUD/SER; BUD/SER only via Austrian collapse. Germany BOH/MUN still a threat to WAR/RUM. Austria and Turkey want written no-entry terms, which I have kept. Watch Germany on WAR/SWE and Turkey on RUM/SEV.

Fall 1941: holding VIE/BUD/SER/TRI; BUD supports VIE hold vs German BOH/MUN. No written German pledge; Germany threatens VIE. Italy and Turkey pledged no entry to SER/BUD/TRI/VIE; Turkey wants a Serbian border pact, not signed. Russia pledged no entry to our centres. Watch German BOH/MUN and Russia GAL/RUM. Revisit BUL only with written Italian plan and Turkish weakening.

Fall 1941: A PIC to BEL as given notice to England and Germany (empty English SC). England threatened to contest with HOL/NTH. BRE, MAO, MAR, POR hold; no ENG/Channel/Tunis moves. Italy confirmed no WES/TUN moves. Germany agreed no BUR/PIC entry. Watch whether England's HOL/NTH hit BEL; next spring consider coordinating against Germany's KIE/DEN with Germany.

Fall 1941: BOH attacks VIE unsupported (no support option exists for VIE); BER, DEN, KIE, MUN hold to keep SCs. Broke HOL pledge to England in 1940. England's A HOL is holding with NTH support; Austria says VIE/BUD/SER/TRI entry = war. Russia's pledges on WAR/SWE/RUM/SEV have held. Next: consider supported VIE attack in Spring with MUN.

Fall 1941: holding BLA, BUL, CON. Attacks on SER/GRE/RUM would bounce without support. No Turkish support reaches them. Italy, Austria, Russia have all confirmed holds. Watch for empty SER/BUD/GRE in Fall and move BUL in if vacated. Pact with Austria still unsigned.

Fall 1941: pacts kept with Austria, Turkey, France. F ION to TYS sets up a possible convoy; others hold. No unowned centers. Watch Turkish moves to GRE/SMY/ION and French moves to WES/TUN. Revisit Balkan move only with written Austrian commitment.

Fall 1941: NTH to BEL to bounce France's PIC (BEL unsupported). A HOL holds unsupported vs KIE alone (1v1 bounce). Germany says KIE holds; France threatened PIC->BEL. Watch for MUN/KIE moves into HOL and French support into BEL. Keep fleets out of DEN/KIE and Channel.

messages.body: Austria asks Germany for its Spring 1942 orders in writing. Our A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI will hold. Germany has no need to enter VIE, BUD, SER or TRI, and we will not enter MUN or BOH. Confirm that A MUN and A KIE stay out of our four centres, and Austria will keep its armies at home and watch Russia in the east.

Austria proposes we keep our written line for Spring 1942: Russia keeps A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV out of GAL, BUD, SER, VIE and TRI, and Austria stays out of RUM, WAR, SEV and GAL. Germany's units are the shared threat. Tell me your Spring orders first, and if Germany moves on VIE or TRI, tell me at once.

Austria is still ready to sign the Serbian border pact. Confirm in writing that A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring and stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. Our A SER and A BUD hold and will not enter BUL or CON. Once you confirm, I will sign the pact.

England to France, Spring 1942: A PIC into BEL would bounce against my A HOL and F NTH support, and I will not cede BEL. Withdraw A PIC and A PAR from the Low Countries, and I will keep my Channel fleets out of BRE, PIC and MAR. Tell me your spring orders now.

England to Germany, Spring 1942: A HOL is held with F NTH support. Any move from KIE, MUN or BER into HOL is an attack and will bounce. Keep A DEN and A KIE out of NTH and BEL, and I will keep my fleets away from DEN and KIE. Confirm your spring orders in writing.

England to Russia, Spring 1942: My STP, NOR and LVP fleets stay out of the Baltic. Confirm F SWE and A WAR stay out of the approaches to DEN and NOR, and that nothing moves toward SIL. Warn me before any northern change.

France to England, Spring 1942: A PIC is in Picardy and BEL is contested. I propose we split the Low Countries: you keep HOL and your fleets out of BRE, PIC and MAO, and I hold BEL without entering HOL or NTH. Please confirm your A BEL and F NTH will not move on PIC or BRE this spring.

France to Germany, Spring 1942: England is pressing BEL and HOL, and holds 7 centres. Let us coordinate. Press England through HOL and the North Sea, or Denmark-side, while my armies stay in Picardy and Burgundy. Please confirm A MUN and A KIE will not enter BUR or PIC this spring.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1942: I have 4 centres and no BOH unit now. My A MUN will move toward BOH, not BUD or SER. Your armies should stay out of BOH and MUN. Let us both pressure Austria, and tell me your Spring orders so we avoid a clash.

Germany to England, Spring 1942: A HOL is still yours, and I will not move A KIE or A DEN into HOL, BEL or NTH this spring. Keep F NTH and your fleets away from DEN and KIE. Tell me your Spring orders so we both stay clear.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1942: I hold A GRE, A NAP, A ROM, F SMY, F TYS and A VEN this spring, and no Italian unit enters SER, BUD, TRI or VIE. Turkey's A BUL is the target. Tell me your Spring orders for A SER and A BUD before I commit to any Fall strike on BUL.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1942: Your BER, DEN and KIE must stay out of SWE and WAR. I will hold WAR, SWE, RUM and SEV this spring. Tell me your Spring orders for MUN and any unit near BOH, and whether either will enter GAL, RUM or SEV. I will answer in writing.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1942: A RUM will not enter BUL this spring, and F SEV holds. Keep F BLA and A CON out of RUM and SEV, or Russia will answer with force. Send me your Spring orders for A BUL and CON before you move, and I will send mine.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1942: My A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this spring and will not enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Germany's BOH and MUN are the threat to you. Tell me your Spring orders and whether Germany has moved on VIE or TRI.

Turkey intends to move A BUL to SER this Spring and keep A CON and F BLA holding. Russia's A RUM can threaten BUD while Austria is weak. Tell me in writing whether A RUM will enter BUD or support anything into SER. Turkey will not enter RUM or SEV, and asks F SEV to stay out of BLA and CON.

Austria to Italy, Spring 1942: A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A VIE hold this spring. I will not move toward BUL or VEN. Italy's units must stay out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE, as pledged. I will not commit A SER to a Fall strike on BUL in writing yet. Tell me your Fall plan for GRE and Turkey's BUL first, and confirm A VEN and A ROM stay clear of our centres.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1942: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this spring. Austria will not enter RUM, GAL, WAR or SEV. Please keep A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV out of GAL, BUD, SER, VIE and TRI as you pledged. Germany's BOH and MUN units have not moved on VIE or TRI so far, and I will tell you at once if they do.

England rejects the split. BEL is our centre and stays ours. Your A PIC moving into BEL will meet F NTH and A HOL in support of a defence, so it will bounce. Withdraw A PIC from the Low Countries and we can talk about the Channel and Iberia. I will keep my fleets out of BRE, PIC, MAR and MAO while you do the same.

England confirms A HOL holds this spring with F NTH support. Any move from KIE, MUN or BER into HOL is an attack and will bounce. I will keep F NTH and our fleets away from DEN and KIE while your A DEN and A KIE stay out of NTH and BEL. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

France to England, Spring 1942: I will not move A PIC into BEL this spring, so it holds in Picardy and there is no bounce. I will not enter HOL or NTH, and F MAO stays out of ENG and the Channel. Please keep A HOL and F NTH off PIC, BRE and MAR, and keep your fleets out of MAO. Tell me your Fall 1942 plan for BEL before either of us moves.

Germany's A MUN moves to BOH this spring, not into any Austrian centre. A KIE and A DEN hold at home. I will not enter VIE, BUD, SER or TRI this spring. Keep your units at home and watch Russia in the east.

A KIE and A DEN hold this spring and will not enter HOL, BEL or NTH. A MUN moves to BOH only. I will keep my fleets' lanes clear of your fleets. Keep F NTH and your fleets away from DEN and KIE, and we stay quiet.

My A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring and will not enter SWE, WAR, RUM or SEV. My A MUN moves to BOH, not GAL, RUM, SEV, BUD or SER. Keep your armies out of BOH and MUN, and we will both press Austria. Send your Spring orders in writing.

A MUN moves to BOH this spring, and no German unit enters BUR, PIC or the Rhine. A KIE holds at home. Keep your armies in Picardy and Burgundy. I will discuss England's Low Countries growth with you in autumn once Austria settles. Tell me your Spring orders.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1942: WAR, SWE, RUM and SEV all hold this spring. Your BER, DEN and KIE must stay out of SWE and WAR, and MUN and BOH must stay out of RUM and SEV. Moving MUN toward BOH is your business, but do not enter GAL, RUM or SEV. Confirm your MUN orders in writing.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1942: My A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this spring and will not enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Germany's BOH and MUN are the threat. Tell me your Spring orders. If German units move on VIE or TRI, I will tell you what I know at once.

Russia to England, Spring 1942: F SWE and A WAR hold this spring. F SWE will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI or the Baltic approaches to DEN or NOR, and nothing moves toward SIL. Keep your STP, NOR and LVP fleets out of the Baltic as agreed. I will warn you before any northern change.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1942: A RUM will not enter BUL this spring, and F SEV holds. I have no written commitment on BUD or SER, and I will not contest SER if your A BUL takes it. Keep F BLA and A CON out of RUM and SEV, or Russia answers with force. Send your A CON and F BLA orders when set.

Turkey confirms A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring. We will not enter SER, BUD, VIE, TRI or RUM. Sign the Serbian border pact in writing and we keep this line quiet. Any Austrian unit entering BUL or CON breaks the pact, and Turkey will answer.

Turkey's A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring. We have no move on RUM or SEV. Please confirm in writing that A RUM stays out of BUL and F SEV stays out of BLA and CON. If Austria's BUD or SER empties in the Fall, Turkey's A BUL moves in. Tell me your Fall orders first.

notes.note: Spring 1942: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). No unowned centers reachable; attacks on BUD/SER would bounce unsupported. Germany, Austria, England, Turkey have kept no-entry terms so far. Watch Germany BOH/MUN on WAR/RUM and VIE/TRI; watch Turkey on RUM/SEV. Consider SEV->BLA later once Turkish F BLA moves.

Spring 1942: all four hold. No unowned centers nearby; GAL/ALB aren't centers. Pledges kept by Russia, Italy, Turkey, Germany so far. Watch German BOH/MUN on VIE/TRI and Russia RUM/GAL. Revisit BUL only with written Italian plan and Turkish weakening; Turkey pact unsigned.

Spring 1942: all holds. PIC kept out of BEL as promised to England (no bounce). MAO kept out of ENG/Channel per promise. No unowned SCs. England rejected split; BEL contested. Germany says no BUR/PIC entry; A MUN to BOH. Next: watch England's HOL/NTH and Germany's Fall plans; consider BEL only if England weakens.

Spring 1942: all four units hold to keep BER, DEN, KIE, MUN. No unowned centers are reachable, and KIE->HOL would attack England's unit. MUN->BOH promise to Russia/France/Austria was dropped to keep MUN. Pledges: England (no HOL/BEL/NTH) kept; France (no BUR/PIC) kept; Russia kept; Austria kept. Watch Austria and Russia in Fall.

Spring 1942: holding HOL with NTH support against Germany's KIE/DEN and France's PIC. Keep pledges: fleets out of DEN/KIE, Channel, PIC/BRE/MAO. Germany and Russia kept quiet. France wants BEL, which I refuse. Next: consider NTH to HEL convoy of A HOL toward DEN if Germany stays passive.

Spring 1942: SMY to AEG and TYS to ION set up convoys of A GRE/A NAP toward CON/Africa for a later strike. Pledges kept: no entry to BUL/CON/BLA/SER/BUD/TRI/VIE, no Tunis move. Austria declined a written BUL strike. Turkey and France have kept pledges so far.

Spring 1942: all hold. No support reaches SER, GRE, RUM or SMY, so attacks would bounce. Austria, Russia and Italy have kept their pledges. Watch for SER or BUD to empty in Fall and move A BUL in. Pact with Austria still unsigned.

messages.body: Austria asks Germany for its Fall 1942 orders in writing. Austria's A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI will hold. Confirm that A BOH, A MUN and A KIE will not enter VIE, BUD, SER or TRI. If you move east or north instead, Austria is willing to discuss a stable border.

Austria asks Italy for its Fall 1942 plan. We hold VIE, BUD, SER and TRI. Will A GRE, A VEN and A ROM stay out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE? If Italy wants to press Turkey in the Balkans, tell us first so we can judge the risk to SER.

Austria is ready to sign the Serbian border pact now. Our A SER and A BUD hold this Fall and will not enter BUL or CON. Confirm in writing that A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold and stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM, and I will sign.

England to France, Fall 1942: A PIC is still next to BEL, and I will hold BEL and HOL with F NTH and A HOL. Keep A PIC, A PAR and F MAO out of BEL, HOL, NTH, ENG and the Channel. I will keep my fleets out of BRE, MAR, POR and MAO. Tell me your Fall orders for PIC now.

England to Germany, Fall 1942: A HOL holds with F NTH support, and any move from KIE, MUN or BER into HOL or BEL will bounce. I will keep F NTH and F LON away from DEN and KIE. Confirm in writing that A DEN and A KIE stay out of NTH, BEL and HOL this autumn.

England to Russia, Fall 1942: My STP, NOR and LVP fleets stay out of the Baltic and hold this autumn. Please confirm F SWE and A WAR stay out of the approaches to DEN, NOR and NWG, and that nothing moves toward SIL. Warn me before any northern change.

France to Germany, Fall 1942: England leads with 7 centres and rejected any split of the Low Countries. I propose we act together this autumn. I can move A PIC to BEL while you press HOL and the North Sea from KIE and DEN. Tell me your Fall orders now so we don't collide.

France to England, Fall 1942: I will keep A PIC in Picardy this autumn and make no move into BEL, HOL, NTH or the Channel. My F MAO stays out of ENG. Please confirm A HOL, F NTH and A BEL hold, and that your fleets stay out of BRE, PIC and MAO.

France to Italy, Fall 1942: F MAO is heading to WES, but I still have no move on Tunis. Please confirm F ION, F SMY and A NAP stay out of WES, TUN and Spain. I will tell you before any change in the western Mediterranean.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1942: My A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN will not enter SWE, WAR, RUM, SEV, GAL, BUD or SER this autumn. I ask the same: keep your armies out of BOH and MUN. Tell me your Fall orders in writing so neither of us wastes units on the other.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1942: My units stay on BER, DEN, KIE and MUN this autumn, and none will enter VIE, BUD, SER or TRI. Keep your armies out of BOH and MUN and hold your centres. Send your Fall orders, and we can both turn to Russia.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1942: Turkey has held its pledges, and so has Italy. Before I write Fall orders, tell me plainly whether A BUL, A CON or F BLA will move this autumn, and whether any unit heads toward GRE, SMY or ION. I will confirm my position in writing once I hear your answer.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1942: A BUL is still the obstacle in the Balkans. Austria's A SER and A BUD are the only units that can strike it this autumn. Tell me whether you will commit A SER to a BUL attack in writing, and what your Fall orders are, before I decide whether Italy acts in the Balkans.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1942: Please send your Fall orders for A MUN, A BOH and any unit near VIE or TRI in writing. Russia's WAR, RUM, SEV, MOS and SWE hold this Fall and will not enter GAL, BUD or SER. Confirm your armies stay out of SWE, WAR, RUM and SEV, and we can plan the Austrian centres together.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1942: A RUM stays out of BUL and SER this Fall, and F SEV holds. Send your Fall orders for A BUL and A CON in writing. If Austria's BUD or SER empties, let us agree who takes it before either of us moves, so we do not bounce each other.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1942: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this Fall. Please state in writing your Fall orders for A RUM and F SEV, and confirm neither enters BUL, CON or BLA. Turkey will not enter RUM or SEV. If Austria vacates SER, I will move A BUL there and keep it out of your path.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1942: A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this Fall, and no Turkish unit enters GRE, SMY or ION. Please confirm A GRE, F ION, F AEG and A VEN stay out of BUL, CON and BLA. Tell me your Fall orders for A GRE and F AEG in writing before we both move.

Austria holds VIE, BUD, SER and TRI this Fall, with BUD supporting VIE. We will not enter BOH, MUN or KIE. Your statement that BER, DEN, KIE and MUN stay put is welcome. Please confirm in writing that no German unit enters VIE, BUD, SER or TRI, and we can both turn to Russia.

Austria holds VIE, BUD, SER and TRI this Fall. A SER will not move to BUL on present terms. Please confirm in writing that GRE, VEN, ROM and NAP stay out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE. If Italy plans action against Turkey, tell us first so we can assess the risk to SER.

England to France, Fall 1942: Noted. A HOL and F NTH will hold this autumn, and I will keep my fleets out of BRE, PIC, MAR, POR and MAO. BEL is England's centre and I will re-occupy it only with notice. Please keep A PIC out of BEL and HOL, and F MAO out of ENG and the Channel, as you promised. Germany remains the shared concern.

France to England, Fall 1942: Confirmed. A PIC holds in Picardy this autumn, and F MAO stays out of ENG and the Channel. I make no move into BEL, HOL, NTH, BRE or POR. Please confirm your A HOL, F NTH and F LON stay out of PIC, BRE, MAR, POR and MAO. I will give notice before any change near the Low Countries.

Germany to England, Fall 1942: My A DEN and A KIE hold this autumn and will not enter NTH, BEL or HOL. A BER and A MUN hold too. Keep F NTH and F LON away from DEN and KIE, and we stay quiet in the north.
Germany to Austria, Fall 1942: Confirmed. A KIE, A DEN, A BER and A MUN all hold this autumn. None will enter VIE, BUD, SER or TRI. Keep your armies out of BOH and MUN and we can both watch Russia.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1942: My A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN will not enter SWE, WAR, RUM, SEV or GAL this autumn. Keep your armies out of BOH and MUN, and let's both keep our borders quiet while we deal with Austria.

Germany to France, Fall 1942: My units hold this autumn, and no German unit enters BUR, PIC or the Rhine. Your move on BEL is your affair, but I will not press HOL this autumn. Keep your armies out of MUN and BUR, and we can talk again in Spring.

Italy confirms A GRE, A VEN, A ROM and our fleets hold this Fall. No Italian unit enters SER, BUD, TRI or VIE. Italy makes no written commitment on Bulgaria yet. Keep your A SER and A BUD where they are and we can revisit spring once the Turkish position is clearer.

Italy confirms F ION, F AEG, A NAP and A ROM hold this Fall. No Italian move toward WES, TUN or Spain. I ask that F MAO stays out of Tunis and Italian soil. I will tell you first before any change in the Ionian or Tunis.

Italy confirms A GRE, F AEG and F ION hold this Fall, and no Italian unit enters BUL, CON or BLA this Autumn. Please confirm no Turkish unit enters GRE, SMY or ION. We will keep the Balkans quiet for now, but Turkey's A BUL is watched closely.

Russia to England, Fall 1942: Confirmed. F SWE and A WAR hold this autumn and will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI or the Baltic approaches to DEN. Nothing moves toward SIL. Please keep your STP, NOR and LVP fleets out of the Baltic as agreed. I will warn you before any northern change.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1942: Our WAR, RUM, SEV, MOS and SWE hold this autumn. We will not enter GAL, BUD or SER this turn. Please keep A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN out of SWE, WAR, RUM and SEV, and send your written Fall orders for MUN and BOH so we can avoid any clash.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1942: A RUM stays out of BUL and SER this autumn, and F SEV holds. Please keep F BLA and A CON out of RUM and SEV, or Russia will answer with force. Send your written Fall orders for A BUL and A CON. If Austria's BUD or SER empties, let us agree the claim before either of us moves.

Turkey confirms A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this Fall, and no Turkish unit enters GRE, SMY or ION. Please keep A GRE, F ION, F AEG and A VEN out of BUL, CON and BLA. Our Fall orders stay defensive. We will confirm any change in writing before moving.

Turkey confirms A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this Fall and will not enter SER, BUD, VIE, TRI or RUM. Sign the Serbian border pact in writing this turn, with A SER and A BUD holding and neither entering BUL or CON. Turkey will then keep its line quiet.

Turkey notes your A RUM stays out of BUL and SEV holds. Turkey's A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this Fall and will not enter RUM or SEV. Please confirm in writing that F SEV stays out of BLA and CON and that A RUM does not enter BUL, and state your A RUM and F SEV orders.

notes.note: Fall 1942: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). No safe unowned centers; BLA is occupied by Turkish F, so SEV->BLA convoy plan is off. Germany, England, Austria, Turkey have kept no-entry terms so far. Watch Germany BOH/MUN on WAR/RUM and Turkey on RUM/SEV. Reassess Spring 1943.

Fall 1942: all four hold per pledges. Germany, Italy and Turkey have kept their pledges so far, and Russia has not broken its pledge on our centres. No unowned centres are reachable. Keep the Turkey pact unsigned until Turkey commits in writing. Watch German BOH/MUN and Russia RUM/GAL. Revisit BUL only with a written Italian plan and Turkish weakening.

Fall 1942: holding all units per pledges. A HOL holds with F NTH support; BEL is ours, and France (PIC holds) and Germany (DEN/KIE hold) both confirmed no moves into our Low Countries. Russia confirmed F SWE/A WAR hold and no SIL moves. Keep fleets out of Baltic, DEN/KIE, BRE/PIC/MAO/MAR/POR. Next: consider NTH->HEL convoy of A HOL toward DEN if Germany stays passive; no unowned centers exist, so

Fall 1942: all four hold, keeping BER DEN KIE MUN. No unowned centers reachable; KIE->HOL would hit England's A HOL and bounce. Pledges to England, Austria, Russia, France kept (no entry to BUR/PIC, VIE/BUD/SER/TRI, SWE/WAR/RUM/SEV/GAL). Watch Austria and Russia. Next: look for a Spring 1943 move to unowned or weakly held centers.

Fall 1942: all holds to honor promises (PIC holds, no BEL/HOL/NTH/ENG/Channel moves, MAO out of ENG, no Tunis move). England and Italy confirmed holds. Germany said no BUR/PIC entry and no HOL push this autumn. Next: watch England's BEL plans and Germany's Spring stance; MAO may head to WES only after telling Italy.

Fall 1942: all hold, as pledged to Russia, Italy and Austria. No support reaches SER, so an attack would bounce. Italy and Russia have kept pledges. Watch for BUD or SER to empty in Fall and move A BUL in, after agreeing the claim with Russia. Pact with Austria still unsigned.

Fall 1942: GRE attacks BUL (57), F AEG supports GRE to BUL (15). Pledges to Turkey/Austria broken; expect retaliation at GRE/SER. If BUL falls, hold it and rebuild. Watch Austrian SER/BUD and Turkish GRE/SMY/ION moves. Other units hold.

messages.body: Austria proposes action now, not a pact alone. Italy's A BUL is weak and Turkey has only ANK and CON. This spring: A SER moves to BUL, A CON and F BLA move to BUL to dislodge Italy. Austria then signs the Serbian pact and keeps A SER out of CON. Confirm in writing today.

Austria asks Russia to keep A RUM, A WAR, F SEV and A MOS out of GAL, BUD, SER, VIE and TRI this spring, as pledged. Austria is considering a move against Bulgaria in the south, which does not touch Russia. Confirm your Spring 1943 orders in writing.

Austria confirms it will not enter VEN, ROM, NAP or GRE. Italy's A BUL is the target of our Balkan plans. Confirm in writing that no Italian unit enters SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this spring, and that A GRE and A VEN stay out of our centres.

England to France, Spring 1943: A PIC has been at the BEL border for years. Please confirm in writing that A PIC holds this spring and does not move to BEL or HOL, and that F MAO stays out of ENG and the Channel. In return, A HOL, F NTH and our fleets stay out of BRE, PIC, MAR, POR and MAO. What are your Spring orders?

England to Germany, Spring 1943: Please confirm that A DEN, A KIE and A MUN hold or stay out of NTH, BEL and HOL this spring. I will keep F NTH, F LON and our other fleets away from DEN and KIE. If your focus is further east, tell me, so we both know where our forces are going.

England to Russia, Spring 1943: My STP, NOR and LVP fleets stay out of the Baltic this spring. Please confirm F SWE and A WAR hold or stay out of the approaches to DEN, NOR and NWG, and that nothing moves toward SIL. Warn me before any northern change.

France to Germany, Spring 1943: England still holds 7 centres and BEL is its weak point. I propose that I take BEL this autumn with A PIC while you press HOL and NTH from KIE and DEN. Tell me your Spring orders first. My armies will stay out of MUN and BUR.

France to England, Spring 1943: I have kept A PIC, F MAO and A BRE out of your waters as promised. Tell me your Spring 1943 orders for BEL, HOL and NTH. I will hold my fleets out of ENG, the Channel and MAO while you keep your fleets out of BRE, PIC, MAR and POR.

France to Italy, Spring 1943: F MAO and A MAR hold this spring with no move on Tunis or Italian soil. Please confirm F ION, F SMY and A NAP stay out of WES, TUN, Spain and Portugal. I will tell you first before any western Mediterranean move.

Germany to Russia: Austria is the weak point and holds only four centres. I propose we split it. My A MUN and A BOH take VIE this spring, while your armies strike BUD and SER from Galicia and Rumania. I will keep out of WAR, SWE, RUM and SEV. Confirm in writing whether you agree.

Germany to France: England holds seven centres and is the leader. Your A PIC to BEL is fine with me. I will keep my armies out of BUR and PIC, and I ask that you keep yours out of MUN and the Rhine. Tell me your Spring orders in writing.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1943: Our Fall 1942 strike took BUL, and Italy broke its pledge to you. You now hold only ANK and CON. Italy will not enter CON or ANK this spring. Keep F BLA and A CON out of BUL, GRE and SMY, and tell me your Spring 1943 orders in writing.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1943: BUL is now Italian and we intend to hold it. Austria's A SER and A BUD must stay out of BUL. Italy keeps out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE. Please confirm in writing your Spring 1943 orders for A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A VIE.

Italy to Russia, Spring 1943: Italy holds BUL and GRE now. Please keep F SEV, A RUM and A WAR out of BUL, GRE and the Aegean. Italy will keep F ION, F AEG and A VEN out of RUM, UKR and SEV. Tell me your Spring 1943 orders before you move.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1943: My A WAR, A RUM, F SEV, A MOS and F SWE hold. Please confirm in writing that A BER, A DEN, A KIE stay out of SWE and WAR, and that A MUN and A BOH do not enter RUM, SEV or GAL. Tell me your Spring orders for MUN and BOH first.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1943: Please state your Spring orders for A RUM and F SEV in writing. Turkey's A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring and will not enter RUM or SEV. Confirm A RUM stays out of BUL and F SEV stays out of BLA. If Austria's SER or BUD empties, let us agree who takes it before either of us moves.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1943: Tell me your Spring orders for A GRE, F AEG, F ION and A VEN in writing. Turkey's A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring and will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Please keep your units out of BUL, CON and BLA. I am willing to discuss a split of Austrian territory if Italy keeps its word.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1943: Turkey's A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring and will not enter SER, BUD, VIE, TRI or RUM. Sign the Serbian border pact in writing now, with A SER and A BUD holding and neither entering BUL or CON. Otherwise Turkey keeps its options open on the Balkan line.

Austria confirms A SER and A BUD hold this spring and no Austrian unit enters BUL or CON. We reject any move into Italian-held VEN, ROM, NAP or GRE. Italy must keep its units out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE. Austria will judge any Balkan move by what Italy actually does with A GRE and A VEN.

Austria will sign the Serbian border pact once you confirm in writing that A BUL, A CON and F BLA hold this spring and stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. If you want to pressure Italy's A BUL, tell us your plan first and we can discuss it, but nothing is signed yet.

England to France, Spring 1943: My orders are A HOL hold, F NTH hold, and no English move into BEL, PIC, BRE, MAR, POR or MAO this spring. Please keep A PIC holding and out of BEL and HOL, and keep F MAO out of ENG and the Channel. If you break that, I will treat it as a threat to HOL and BEL.

France to England, Spring 1943: Confirmed. A PIC, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO all hold this spring. I will keep my fleets out of ENG, the Channel and MAO, and make no move into BEL, HOL or NTH. Please keep A HOL, F NTH and your fleets out of BRE, PIC, MAR, POR and MAO. I will give notice before any autumn change.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1943: Confirmed in writing. My A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold and stay out of SWE and WAR. My A MUN and A BOH move to VIE this spring, not GAL, RUM, SEV, BUD or SER. Your armies take BUD and SER from Galicia and Rumania. Keep your units out of BOH and MUN, and send your Spring orders.

Germany to England, Spring 1943: My A DEN, A KIE and A MUN hold this spring and will not enter NTH, BEL or HOL. My focus is east, on Austria's VIE. Keep F NTH, F LON and your fleets away from DEN and KIE, and we stay quiet in the north. My orders are as stated.

Germany to France, Spring 1943: Your A PIC to BEL in autumn is acceptable to me. My armies stay out of BUR and PIC, and I ask that yours stay out of MUN and the Rhine. My Spring effort is against Austria in the east, not the Low Countries. I will send written Spring orders once they are set.

Italy's spring orders: A BUL holds, F AEG and F ION hold, and A NAP, A ROM and A VEN hold. No Italian unit will enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this spring. Keep your own units out of BUL, GRE and VEN, and we can talk again in the fall.

Italy confirms F AEG, F ION and A NAP hold this spring, with no move toward WES, TUN, Spain or Portugal. Please keep F MAO and A MAR off Tunis and Italian soil, and tell me before any western Mediterranean change.

Italy holds A BUL, A NAP, A ROM, A VEN, F AEG and F ION this spring. We will not enter CON, ANK or BLA this turn. Turkey should keep A CON and F BLA clear of BUL, GRE and SMY. Turkey's offer to discuss Austria is worth hearing in the fall.

Russia to England, Spring 1943: Confirmed. F SWE and A WAR hold this spring. Neither enters NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI, DEN, SIL or the Baltic approaches to DEN or NOR. Keep your STP, NOR and LVP fleets out of the Baltic as agreed. I will warn you before any northern change.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1943: I have not agreed to any split of Austria. My A WAR, A RUM, F SEV, A MOS and F SWE hold this spring. Your A BER, A DEN and A KIE must stay out of SWE and WAR. Send your MUN and BOH orders first, and I will answer after seeing them.

Russia to Italy, Spring 1943: Confirmed. F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold this spring and will not enter BUL, GRE, the Aegean, the Ionian or the Mediterranean. Please keep F ION, F AEG and A VEN out of RUM, UKR and SEV as agreed. I will tell you before any move toward the Balkans.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1943: My A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this spring. None of them will enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Germany's MUN and BOH are the threat to you, not us. Good luck against Bulgaria. Tell me at once if German units move toward VIE or TRI.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1943: F SEV holds this spring and will not enter BLA or CON. A RUM will not enter BUL this spring. Please keep F BLA and A CON out of RUM and SEV, or Russia will answer with force. If Austria's SER or BUD empties, we can discuss the claim before either of us moves.

Turkey rejects your demand. Italy's strike took BUL in Fall 1942, breaking your pledge. Withdraw A BUL from Bulgaria now or face a Turkish response. Keep A GRE, F AEG, F ION and A VEN out of CON, BLA and ANK. Confirm your Spring 1943 orders in writing.

Turkey will strike Italy's A BUL this spring, but not with A SER moving in. A CON attacks BUL, supported by F BLA. Your A SER should support A CON into BUL from SER. Turkey will not enter SER or BUD afterward. Sign the Serbian pact in writing now and we proceed.

notes.note: Spring 1943: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). No safe unowned centers; no split of Austria agreed. Germany, England, Austria, Turkey, Italy kept no-entry terms so far. Watch Germany BOH/MUN on WAR/RUM and VIE/TRI; watch Turkey on RUM/SEV. Reassess Fall 1943.

Spring 1943: all hold. BUD supports SER hold. Turkey's BUL/CON/BLA attack plan and Italy's BUL claim are unreliable; no written Turkish pact signed and no Italian pledge on BUL. Russia and Germany pledges on VIE/BUD/SER/TRI still standing. Revisit BUL only with firm written commitments.

Spring 1943: all hold per pledges to France (no BEL/PIC/Channel moves), Germany (no DEN/KIE entry), Russia (stay out of Baltic). All parties confirmed holds. No unowned centers. Next: if Germany stays passive, consider NTH to HEL then convoy A HOL to DEN. Watch for any German move into HOL/BEL.

Spring 1943: all holds. Kept promises to England (PIC out of BEL/HOL, MAO out of ENG/Channel) and Italy (no WES/TUN). Germany agreed no BUR/PIC entry. Autumn: consider PIC to BEL only with notice to England; watch England's HOL/NTH.

Spring 1943: MUN to BOH to set up VIE. BER, DEN, KIE hold. Austria and Russia pledges were not kept by my move to BOH; watch Austria on VIE. England/France no action from me. Next: refill MUN from BER or KIE in Fall, and push BOH to VIE if Austria stays weak.

Spring 1943: F AEG attacks CON with A BUL supporting. F ION to GRE guards our empty centre against Austrian SER. NAP, ROM, VEN hold. Turkey and Austria broke-or-threaten pacts after BUL fell; treat both as hostile. Russia confirmed no Balkan move. Next: check whether CON falls, then reassess Turkey.
Turkey: A CON attacks BUL (Italy's A BUL), supported by F BLA. Austria pact unsigned; Italy and Russia pledges of no CON/BLA entry, watch AEG to CON. If BUL is taken, hold it and reassess.

messages.body: Austria asks Turkey for its Fall 1943 orders in writing. Austria's A SER and A BUD will hold. Will A BUL, F BLA and the CON fleet stay out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE? If Turkey wants BUL back, tell us your plan first so we can judge the risk.

Austria asks Italy for its Fall 1943 plan. Will F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN stay out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE? Austria holds all four this turn. Tell us before any move against Turkey in the Balkans, since our SER is exposed.

Austria asks Russia to confirm its Fall 1943 orders in writing. Please keep A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV out of GAL, BUD, SER, VIE and TRI as pledged. Austria holds all four centres this turn and will do the same toward Russia.

England to Germany, Fall 1943: I am holding A HOL, F NTH, F LON and F EDI this autumn. Please confirm A BER, A KIE, A DEN and A BOH stay out of HOL, BEL and NTH, and that no fleet enters the North Sea. I will keep my fleets away from DEN and KIE. Tell me if your autumn focus changes.

England to France, Fall 1943: My units hold this autumn: A HOL, F NTH, F LON, F LVP. I will not enter BEL, PIC, BRE, MAR, POR or MAO. Please confirm A PIC stays out of BEL and HOL, and F MAO stays out of ENG and the Channel. I will give notice before any change in the Low Countries.

England to Russia, Fall 1943: My F STP/NORTH, F LVP and F NTH hold this autumn and stay out of the Baltic. Please confirm F SWE and A WAR stay out of NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI and the approaches to DEN, and that nothing moves toward SIL or STP. Warn me before any northern change.

France to England, Fall 1943: As promised, I give notice that A PIC will move to BEL this autumn. My other units stay out of ENG, the Channel, NTH, HOL and MAO. Please keep A HOL and F NTH out of BRE, PIC, MAR and POR, and do not contest BEL.

France to Germany, Fall 1943: A PIC moves to BEL this autumn as we agreed. My armies stay out of BUR, MUN and the Rhine. Please keep your armies out of BUR and PIC, and tell me your Fall orders so we don't collide in the Low Countries.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1943: My A BOH attacks VIE this autumn and A MUN moves up behind it. Austria's southern centres BUD and SER are weak. Your armies in Galicia and Rumania can take them. I will keep A BER, A DEN and A KIE out of SWE and WAR. Confirm you will stay out of BOH and MUN.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1943: Our earlier pledges no longer hold. A BOH attacks VIE this autumn. If A VIE retreats to TYR or GAL, Austria keeps its other centres and I will not press BUD or SER this turn. If A VIE holds, expect a fight for Vienna.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1943: Your A BUL is in Bulgaria, which is now an Italian centre. F CON stays in Constantinople this turn. Withdraw A BUL to a non-Italian area, or hold it and face our F GRE and F AEG. Confirm your orders in writing, and we will keep F BLA out of GRE and SMY.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1943: A SER and A BUD should not move into BUL or GRE while Turkey holds the Balkans. Italy's F GRE and A NAP will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this turn. Confirm your Fall orders for A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A VIE in writing.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1943: I reject any split of Austria. A WAR, A RUM, F SEV, A MOS and F SWE hold this autumn. Your A BER, A DEN and A KIE must stay out of SWE and WAR, and A BOH must not enter GAL, RUM or WAR. Send your Fall orders for BOH and MUN first.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1943: A RUM and F SEV hold this autumn, and A RUM will not enter BUL. Keep F BLA and A BUL out of RUM and SEV, and I will keep out of BLA and CON. Send your written Fall orders for A BUL and F BLA before either of us moves.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1943: Your F CON sits on a Turkish home centre and your AEG and CON history breaks our pacts. Withdraw F CON or it will be attacked. Our A BUL and F BLA hold this Fall and will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Confirm your Fall orders for F CON, F GRE and A NAP in writing.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1943: Our A BUL and F BLA hold this Fall. We will not enter SER, BUD, VIE, TRI or RUM. Please keep A SER and A BUD out of BUL and CON, and state your Fall orders in writing. The Serbian pact stands if you keep your word.

Austria's Fall 1943 orders: A VIE holds, with A BUD supporting. Austria will not retreat VIE to TYR or GAL. Your A BOH attacking VIE alone should bounce against that hold. Any German unit entering BUD, SER or TRI will be treated as war. Do not expect Austria to hand you Vienna.

Austria's Fall 1943 orders: A SER and A BUD hold. Neither will enter BUL or GRE. Austria holds VIE, TRI, SER and BUD and asks the same in return: F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN must not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE. Confirm in writing and we keep the line quiet.

Austria will not sign the Serbian pact on words alone. Our A SER and A BUD hold this Fall. Confirm in writing that A BUL, F BLA and the CON fleet stay out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE, and state your Fall orders. If you keep your word, Austria will then sign.

England to France, Fall 1943: BEL is England's centre and I will not accept A PIC entering it. If A PIC moves to BEL, I will move A HOL into BEL with F NTH support, and that will bounce or cost you the unit. Hold A PIC this autumn and I will keep my fleets out of BRE, MAR, POR and MAO. Give me your answer in writing before orders.

France to England, Fall 1943: Understood. A PIC holds this autumn and does not enter BEL or HOL. F MAO stays out of ENG and the Channel. A BRE, A MAR and A POR also hold. Please keep A HOL and F NTH out of BRE, PIC, MAR, POR and MAO, and keep your fleets out of BEL. Germany remains our shared concern.

Germany to England, Fall 1943: My A BOH attacks VIE and A KIE moves to MUN to back it up. I will not enter HOL, BEL or NTH. My A BER and A DEN hold. Keep F NTH, F LON and F EDI away from DEN and KIE, and we stay quiet in the north.

Germany to France, Fall 1943: Your A PIC to BEL is fine with me. My A KIE moves to MUN this autumn, and no German unit enters BUR, PIC or the Rhine. Please keep your armies out of MUN and the Rhine as agreed. Our Low Countries deal stands.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1943: I will not split Austria with you. My A BOH attacks VIE and A KIE moves to MUN, neither entering GAL, RUM, SEV or WAR. My A BER and A DEN stay out of SWE and WAR. Keep your armies out of BOH and MUN and we stay clear.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1943: F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN hold this turn and none enters SER, BUD, TRI or VIE. I will not move against Austria this fall. Please confirm your A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A VIE hold in writing, and that A SER stays out of BUL and GRE.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1943: F CON stays in Constantinople this turn as a defensive position, and F GRE holds. Italy will not enter BUL, SMY or BLA this fall. Keep F BLA out of GRE and SMY, and withdraw A BUL to a non-Italian area so we can talk about the Balkans in writing before Spring 1944.

Russia confirms F SWE and A WAR hold this Fall. Neither will enter NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI, SIL or the Baltic approaches to DEN. Keep your STP, NOR and LVP fleets out of the Baltic as agreed, and I will warn you before any northern change.

Russia confirms A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this Fall. None will enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Germany's A BOH is the threat to VIE, so please watch it closely. Tell me at once if it moves toward GAL or WAR.

Russia rejects any split of Austria. Our A WAR, A RUM, F SEV, A MOS and F SWE hold this Fall. Your A BER, A DEN and A KIE must stay out of SWE and WAR, and A BOH must not enter GAL, RUM or WAR. Send your BOH and MUN orders first.

Turkey's A BUL and F BLA hold this Fall. Your SER and BUD must not enter BUL or CON, and we will not enter SER, BUD, VIE, TRI or RUM. Italy's F CON is the real threat to both of us. Sign the Serbian pact now and state your Fall orders in writing so we can coordinate against Italy.

Italy, your F CON is sitting on a Turkish home centre and it must withdraw. Turkey's A BUL and F BLA hold this Fall and will not enter GRE, SMY or ION. Confirm in writing your Fall orders for F CON, F GRE and A NAP. If F CON leaves Turkish waters, Turkey keeps its Balkan line quiet.

Turkey's A BUL, F BLA and CON holds stand this Fall. We will not enter RUM or SEV. Please keep A RUM out of BUL and F SEV out of BLA as pledged. Italy's F CON threatens us both, and I suggest we agree a plan against it. Send your written Fall orders for A RUM and F SEV.

notes.note: Fall 1943: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). Rejected Germany's split of Austria. Kept no-entry terms with England, Austria, Turkey, Germany so far. Watch Germany BOH/MUN on WAR/RUM/VIE and Turkey on RUM/SEV. Reassess Spring 1944.

Fall 1943: holding BUD, SER, TRI, VIE. BUD supports VIE hold vs German A BOH. Pledges from Russia, Italy, Turkey so far unbroken; Germany broke pledge. Turkey pact unsigned; no Austrian move into BUL/CON. Watch Turkey BUL/F BLA, Italy F GRE. Revisit only with firm written commitments.

Fall 1943: PIC to BEL with notice given to England and Germany. England threatened HOL+NTH to bounce it but said it holds HOL. Germany agreed (no BUR/PIC/MUN). BRE, MAR, POR, MAO hold, keeping promises to England (no ENG/Channel/MAO moves) and Italy (no Tunis/WES). Watch whether England's HOL and NTH hold or strike BEL; if PIC bounces, rebuild with MAO to ENG for convoy options.

Fall 1943: F CON holds CON and supports GRE to BUL to dislodge Turkish A BUL. GRE attacks BUL. NAP, ROM, VEN hold. Turkey threatens CON; Austria pledges quiet. Check results; if BUL taken, reinforce GRE and keep CON.

Fall 1943: BOH withdraws to MUN instead of attacking VIE (Austria holds with BUD support, so the attack would bounce). BER, DEN, KIE hold. No unowned SCs reachable. Pledges: no entry to BUR/PIC (France), HOL/BEL/NTH (England), SWE/WAR/RUM/SEV/GAL (Russia), BUD/SER/TRI (Austria). Germany has 4 SCs and needs to find gains next turn.

Fall 1943: BLA moves to CON, supported by A BUL (choice 47), to dislodge Italy's F CON. A BUL stays in BUL to keep the centre. Italy has broken pacts before; Austria still unsigned. Watch RUS F SEV in BLA and Italian F GRE/AEG moves into BUL. Russia pledged to stay out of BLA/CON.

Fall 1943: A HOL to BEL with F NTH support to bounce France's threatened A PIC->BEL; BEL is my center. Held EDI, LON, LVP, STP. Germany has said KIE moves to MUN, so KIE may be open for later. Keep fleets out of DEN/KIE and Russia's Baltic. Next: check whether France's PIC moved; consider HOL to KIE or NTH to HEL convoy if the north stays quiet.

messages.body: Austria: your A BOH attacked VIE last autumn, breaking your pledge. VIE and BUD are holding this spring with BUD supporting. Withdraw A BOH from the Austrian border and send no units into VIE, BUD, SER or TRI, and Austria will not move on BOH or MUN. Tell me your Spring 1944 orders in writing.

Austria: Germany is pressing us from BOH and may move on GAL or WAR. Please confirm your Spring 1944 orders in writing and keep A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV out of GAL, BUD, SER, VIE and TRI. If Germany attacks you, Austria will tell you what it sees at once.

England to France, Spring 1944: BEL is England's centre and my A HOL and F NTH will hold it. Your A PIC must not enter BEL or HOL. I will keep F LON and my fleets out of BRE, PIC, MAR, POR and MAO. Confirm your spring orders in writing before we both move.

England to Germany, Spring 1944: Please confirm A KIE, A DEN and A BER stay out of HOL, BEL and NTH this spring. My fleets stay out of DEN and KIE. Your focus east on Austria is your business. If you plan a move toward the North Sea, tell me first so we avoid a misunderstanding.

England to Russia, Spring 1944: Please confirm F SWE and A WAR hold or stay out of NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI, DEN and the approaches to SIL. My STP, NOR and LVP fleets stay out of the Baltic. Warn me before any northern change.

France to England, Spring 1944: A PIC now holds BEL after last autumn's move, and I intend to keep it there. Please keep A HOL and F NTH out of BEL, BRE, PIC, MAR, POR and MAO. My fleets stay out of ENG and the Channel. Tell me your Spring orders in writing.

France to Germany, Spring 1944: BEL is held by my army and I will not give it up. I ask that your armies stay out of BUR, PIC and the Rhine, as agreed. Please send me your Spring orders so we avoid any collision in the Low Countries.

France to Italy, Spring 1944: I still plan no move on Tunis or Italian soil this spring. Please confirm F ION, F SMY and A NAP stay out of WES, TUN, Spain and Portugal. I will tell you first before any western Mediterranean change.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1944: My A MUN and A KIE hold this spring and will not enter BOH or Austrian centres. Austria keeps VIE, BUD, SER and TRI if its units stay out of BOH, MUN and KIE. Confirm in writing, and we can both watch Russia.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1944: Austria holds four centres and blocks us both. I propose we split it: Russia takes BUD and SER from Galicia and Rumania, while Germany takes VIE and TRI from the north. Tell me your Spring orders so we avoid collisions.

Germany to England, Spring 1944: My A DEN and A KIE hold and will not enter NTH, HOL or BEL. Are your F NTH and F LON staying in the North Sea this spring? I want to keep our northern lanes clear and avoid any misunderstanding.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1944: Your A BUL is isolated and Italy's F CON and F GRE are positioned against it. Withdraw A BUL from Bulgaria now and Italy will not enter BUL, SMY or BLA this spring. Hold it and we will attack. Confirm your Spring orders in writing before we move.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1944: Let us settle the Balkans. Italy's F GRE and A NAP will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this spring. Austria's A SER and A BUD must not enter GRE or BUL. Confirm your Spring 1944 orders for A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A VIE in writing.

Italy to Russia, Spring 1944: Please confirm F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold this spring and stay out of BUL, GRE, the Aegean and the Mediterranean. Italy will keep F CON, F GRE and A VEN out of RUM, UKR and SEV. Tell me your Spring 1944 orders before you move.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1944: Italy's F CON and A GRE threaten us both. I propose F SEV and A RUM hold this spring and stay out of BLA, CON and BUL. If Italy's fleets leave CON, we agree a joint plan to retake it. Please confirm your Spring 1944 orders for A BUL and F BLA in writing.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1944: My A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this spring and will not enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Germany remains the threat to you. Please confirm your Spring 1944 orders and tell me at once if German units move toward VIE or TRI.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1944: Your F CON sits on our home centre. Withdraw it to the Aegean this spring or Turkey's F BLA will move to CON, supported by A BUL. If you withdraw, A BUL stays out of GRE and SMY. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1944: F BLA is moving against Italy's F CON. Keep F SEV out of BLA and CON, and A RUM out of BUL, as pledged. We will not enter RUM or SEV. Once CON is settled, let us discuss the Austrian SER and BUD claim before either of us moves. State your Spring orders in writing.

Austria confirms in writing: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this spring, and none will enter BOH, MUN or KIE. Germany's A MUN and A KIE holding is noted, but your autumn attack on VIE broke trust. Pull all German units out of BOH and keep them out of Austrian centres, and we can keep the line quiet.

Austria confirms its Spring 1944 orders: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold. Austria will not enter GAL, RUM, WAR or SEV. Germany's A BOH is the threat to VIE; if it moves toward GAL or WAR we will tell you at once. Please keep A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV out of GAL, BUD, SER, VIE and TRI as pledged.

Austria confirms Spring 1944: A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A VIE hold. Neither A SER nor A BUD will enter GRE or BUL. Italy's F GRE and A NAP staying out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE is welcome; please confirm that in writing. Austria will judge any Italian move toward VEN or ROM by what it actually does.

France, you moved A PIC into BEL last autumn after promising not to, and BEL is England's centre. I will not accept it. Withdraw A BEL this spring to PIC or BUR, or my A HOL and F NTH will attack BEL and dislodge you. Keep your fleets out of the Channel and MAO as promised.

Germany, F NTH and F LON stay in the North Sea this spring and will not enter DEN or KIE. Keep A DEN, A KIE and A BER out of HOL, BEL and NTH, and we stay quiet in the north. Any move toward HOL or NTH changes that. Confirm your spring orders in writing.

France to England, Spring 1944: To correct my last note, A PIC is still in Picardy, and your A BEL holds Belgium. I will hold A PIC, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO this spring, with no move into BEL, HOL, NTH, ENG or the Channel. Please keep A BEL, A HOL and your fleets out of PIC, BRE, MAR, POR and MAO. Germany is the shared concern.

Germany to England, Spring 1944: Confirmed. A BER, A DEN and A KIE all hold this spring and will not enter NTH, HOL or BEL. I will not move into the North Sea. Keep F NTH, F LON and your other fleets out of DEN and KIE, and we stay quiet in the north.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1944: Confirmed. A MUN and A KIE hold this spring. No German unit will enter VIE, BUD, SER, TRI or BOH. Keep your armies out of MUN and KIE, hold your centres, and we can both watch Russia in the east.

Germany to France, Spring 1944: Confirmed. No German unit will enter BUR, PIC or the Rhine this spring. A MUN and A KIE hold. Your A BEL hold is your affair. Please keep your armies out of MUN and the Rhine as agreed, and we keep the Low Countries deal.

Italy to France, Spring 1944: F ION, F SMY and A NAP hold this spring, with no move toward WES, TUN, Spain or Portugal. Keep F MAO and A MAR off Tunis and Italian soil. I will tell you before any western Mediterranean change.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1944: I will not withdraw F CON to the Aegean or accept a Balkan standoff on your terms. Your A BUL is the target. Withdraw A BUL out of Bulgaria, and Italy will not enter BUL, SMY or BLA this spring. Stay in BUL and F CON and F GRE hold Constantinople and strike. Keep F BLA out of CON and SMY.

Russia confirms F SWE and A WAR hold this spring. Neither will enter NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI, DEN, SIL or the Baltic approaches to DEN or NOR. We will not move toward SIL. Keep your STP, NOR and LVP fleets out of the Baltic as agreed, and I will warn you before any northern change.

Russia confirms A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this spring. None will enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Germany is the threat to you. If German units move toward VIE, TRI, GAL or WAR, I will tell you at once.

Russia rejects any split of Austria, as before. Your A BER, A DEN and A KIE must stay out of SWE and WAR, and your BOH must not enter GAL, RUM or WAR. Our A WAR, A RUM, F SEV, A MOS and F SWE hold this spring. Keep your units out of our centres.

Russia confirms F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold this spring and will not enter BUL, GRE, the Aegean, the Ionian or the Mediterranean. Please keep F CON, F GRE, A VEN and F ION out of RUM, UKR and SEV as agreed. I will tell you before any move toward the Balkans.

Russia confirms F SEV holds this spring and will not enter BLA or CON. A RUM will not enter BUL. Keep F BLA and A BUL out of RUM and SEV. Italy's F CON is the shared threat, and we can discuss CON once it is vacated. Please confirm your Spring 1944 orders in writing.

Turkey's F BLA will move to CON this spring, supported by A BUL, unless your F CON withdraws to the Aegean. If it leaves, A BUL stays out of GRE and SMY and Turkey keeps the Balkans quiet. Stay out of CON and BLA, and I will confirm my Spring orders once I see your move.

Turkey agrees: your A RUM and F SEV hold this spring, and A RUM stays out of BUL. Our F BLA is moving against Italy's F CON. Keep F SEV out of BLA and CON, as pledged. Once CON is settled, let us discuss the Austrian SER and BUD claim before either of us moves. State your Spring orders in writing.

notes.note: Spring 1944: all four hold, keeping BER DEN KIE MUN, as pledged to England, France, Austria. No unowned SCs reachable; moving breaks pledges. Watch Austria/Russia for Fall; seek gains when a pledge lapses.

Spring 1944: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). Pledges kept: no entry into GAL/BUD/SER/VIE/TRI, BUL, BLA, CON, NOR/NTH/DEN. Germany wants an Austria split; rejected. Turkey: F BLA vs Italian F CON; SEV stays out of BLA as pledged. Watch Germany BOH/MUN on WAR/RUM.

Spring 1944: all four hold per pledges. No unowned centres reachable; RUM/BUL/GRE are pledged or Russian/Turkish/Italian. Germany (MUN/KIE hold) and Italy (F GRE, A NAP) pledged to stay out of our centres; Russia pledged the same. Watch German BOH and Russian GAL/WAR. Revisit only with firm written commitments.

Spring 1944: all holds. Kept promises: no ENG/Channel/MAO moves for fleets, no Tunis move. England demands A BEL withdrawal, unanswered; PIC holds, not entering BEL. Germany says no BUR/PIC/Rhine entry. Italy confirmed holds. Watch England's HOL/NTH vs BEL and reconsider after Fall.

Spring 1944: Holding all units. F NTH supports A BEL holding against France's PIC, which France has said it will hold. Germany and Russia have confirmed holds and no northern moves. Keep fleets out of DEN/KIE and the Baltic. Next: check whether France's A PIC leaves PIC or BEL; then consider A HOL/BEL to a convoy toward DEN if Germany stays passive.

Spring 1944: F CON supports GRE into BUL to dislodge Turkish A BUL and keep CON held. NAP, ROM, VEN hold to honor Austria and France pacts. Turkey, Austria, Russia pacts strained; Turkey hostile. Keep ROM/VEN out of Austrian centers. Next: if BUL taken, reinforce GRE and keep CON.

Spring 1944: F BLA moves to CON, supported by A BUL (choice 43), to dislodge Italy's F CON. A BUL stays in BUL to keep the centre. Russia pledged to keep F SEV and A RUM out of BLA, CON, BUL. Italy keeps threatening BUL. Austria pact still unsigned; discuss SER/BUD after CON settles.

messages.body: Austria here. Your A BOH is no longer on the board, which is good. Confirm in writing that your A MUN, A KIE and A BER will not enter BOH, TYR or any Austrian centre this autumn. Austria will keep A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI holding and will not enter BOH or MUN. Are you willing to give that pledge again?

Austria here. Please confirm your Fall 1944 orders in writing: A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV holding, with no entry into GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Austria will hold its centres and will not enter GAL, RUM, WAR or SEV. Tell me at once if any Russian unit moves toward RUM or GAL.

Austria here. Your F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN have held their pledges so far. Please confirm in writing that none will enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this autumn, and that A VEN will not move to TRI. Austria will keep A SER and A BUD out of GRE and BUL in return.

England to France, Fall 1944: A BEL is England's centre and I will not accept any French unit entering it. Confirm in writing that A PIC holds or withdraws away from BEL and HOL this autumn, and that your fleets stay out of ENG, the Channel and MAO. Otherwise I will treat any move into BEL as hostile.

England to Germany, Fall 1944: Please confirm A BER, A DEN and A KIE stay out of NTH, HOL and BEL this autumn, and that no German unit enters the North Sea. My F NTH and F LON stay out of DEN and KIE. Tell me plainly if your autumn plans change, especially toward HOL or Scandinavia.

France to Germany: England is the leader at 7 centres and its Low Countries are exposed. Proposal for Fall 1944: your A KIE or A DEN strikes HOL, and I will move A PIC against BEL, dislodging England's army there. We split the Low Countries, and neither of us attacks the other. Confirm in writing before orders.

France to England: Your A BEL and HOL/NTH are now the heart of my concern. I will not attack HOL or NTH this autumn and will keep F MAO out of ENG and the Channel. Please keep your fleets out of BRE, PIC, MAR, POR and MAO. I want a written assurance that A BEL stays out of PIC.

Germany to England, Fall 1944: I am moving A KIE to HOL this autumn. Your HOL is empty of units, and I need centres to survive. Your A BEL, F NTH and F LON are not my target. Keep your fleets out of DEN and BER and we can avoid further clashes.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1944: My A KIE is moving west to HOL, and my A MUN, A DEN and A BER will stay out of SWE, WAR, RUM and SEV. Keep your armies out of BOH and MUN and we need not fight. Confirm your Fall orders so neither of us wastes units.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1944: Your A BUL is the target this turn. F CON and F GRE will strike into BUL. Withdraw A BUL to Serbia or Greece and keep F BLA out of CON and SMY. If Turkey stays out of Italian waters, we can talk about a settlement later.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1944: Italy's F GRE and A NAP will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this turn. We are contesting Bulgaria with Turkey, not Austria. Keep your A SER and A BUD out of GRE and keep to your own centres, and we stay at peace.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1944: I still reject any split of Austria. Our A WAR, A RUM, F SEV, A MOS and F SWE hold this autumn. Please confirm A BOH and A MUN will not enter GAL, RUM or WAR, and that your northern armies stay out of SWE. Tell me your Fall orders first.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1944: A RUM and F SEV hold this autumn. A RUM will not enter BUL, and F SEV stays out of BLA and CON. If Italy's F CON is vacated or sunk, we can coordinate on CON. Please confirm your Fall orders for A BUL and F BLA in writing before either of us moves.

Russia to Italy, Fall 1944: F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold this autumn and stay out of BUL, GRE, the Aegean and the Mediterranean. Please tell me your Fall intentions for F CON, F GRE and A VEN, and confirm they stay out of RUM, UKR and SEV. I will warn you before any move toward the Balkans.

Turkey's F BLA moves to CON this Fall, supported by A BUL, unless F CON leaves Turkish waters. Withdraw F CON to AEG now. If it does, Turkey keeps A BUL out of GRE and SMY and stays out of ION. Confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Turkey's F BLA attacks CON this Fall with A BUL support. Please keep F SEV and A RUM out of BLA, CON and BUL as pledged. Once CON is settled, we can discuss SER and BUD. Send your Fall orders in writing so we both move with clear information.

Austria confirms in writing that A SER and A BUD will not enter GRE or BUL this Fall, and both hold. Italy's F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN must not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE, and must not move to TRI from VEN. Keep to your own centres and we stay at peace. Austria will judge any Italian move toward our centres by what it actually does.

England to Germany, Fall 1944: Your KIE to HOL move is an attack on England. A BEL will move to HOL with F NTH support, so your army should bounce. F NTH and F LON will not enter DEN or KIE. Keep your other armies out of HOL, BEL and NTH, and we can return to a quiet north next year.

England to France, Fall 1944: I confirm our fleets stay out of ENG, the Channel and MAO, and that F NTH and F LON stay out of BRE, PIC, MAR and POR. I will not move any English unit into PIC. My A BEL is moving to HOL to meet the German threat, so keep A PIC out of BEL. Any French unit entering BEL will be treated as hostile.

France to England, Fall 1944: Confirmed in writing. A PIC holds this autumn and will not enter BEL or HOL. F MAO stays out of ENG and the Channel. A BRE, A MAR and A POR also hold. Please keep A BEL out of PIC and BRE, and your fleets out of MAO, POR and MAR. Germany remains our shared concern.

Germany to England: My A KIE moves to HOL this autumn, since HOL is empty and I need centres. A BER, A DEN and A MUN will not enter NTH, BEL or the North Sea. Your F NTH, F LON and A BEL are not my target. Keep your fleets out of DEN and BER and we avoid clashes.

Germany to Russia: Confirmed. A MUN, A DEN and A BER will not enter SWE, WAR, RUM, SEV, GAL or BOH this autumn. I am moving A KIE west to HOL, away from your borders. I will not split Austria with you. Keep your armies out of MUN and BER and we stay clear.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1944: Confirmed in writing. A MUN, A KIE and A BER will not enter BOH, TYR or any Austrian centre this autumn. A KIE moves west to HOL only. Your VIE, BUD, SER and TRI are not my target. Keep your armies out of MUN and BOH and we can watch Russia.

Germany to France, Fall 1944: Agreed in part. A KIE moves to HOL this autumn, and I will not press BEL. Your A PIC may take BEL as you wish. A MUN and A BER will not enter BUR, PIC or the Rhine. Please keep your armies out of MUN and the Rhine, and we keep the Low Countries split.

Italy confirms in writing: F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this Fall, and A VEN will not move to TRI. Our Fall moves target Turkey in Bulgaria only. Keep A SER and A BUD out of GRE and BUL, as you pledged, and we stay at peace.

Italy confirms: F CON, F GRE and A VEN will not enter RUM, UKR or SEV this Fall. Our Fall action is aimed at Turkey's A BUL in Bulgaria, not at your Black Sea or Rumanian positions. I will warn you before any move beyond the Balkans. Keep F SEV, A RUM and A WAR out of BUL, GRE and the Aegean as agreed.

Italy will not withdraw F CON to the Aegean. Your A BUL is the target this Fall: F CON and F GRE strike into BUL. Withdraw A BUL to Serbia or Greece now and Italy will not enter BUL, SMY or BLA this turn. Keep F BLA out of CON and SMY, or face our response.

Russia confirms for Fall 1944: A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold. None will enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. We will not enter GAL, RUM, WAR or SEV from your side either. Germany's A BOH is your real threat, so watch it. If any Russian unit moves toward RUM or GAL, I will tell you first.

Russia rejects any split of Austria. Our A WAR, A RUM, F SEV, A MOS and F SWE hold this Fall. Keep A BER, A DEN, A MUN and A BOH out of SWE, WAR, RUM, SEV and GAL. Your A KIE moving to HOL is fine if it stays west. Send your written Fall orders for BOH and MUN so we can confirm.

Russia confirms for Fall 1944: A RUM and F SEV hold. A RUM will not enter BUL, and F SEV stays out of BLA and CON. Your F BLA attack on CON is your affair, but keep F BLA and A BUL out of RUM and SEV. Once CON is vacated or settled, we can discuss SER and BUD.

Turkey's orders this Fall: F BLA moves to CON, supported by A BUL, unless your F CON withdraws to the Aegean. If F CON leaves Turkish waters, A BUL stays out of GRE and SMY and Turkey stays out of ION. Withdraw F CON and we can talk about a settlement.

Turkey confirms: A BUL and F BLA are moving against Italy's F CON this Fall. Our units will not enter RUM or SEV. Please keep F SEV out of BLA and CON and A RUM out of BUL as pledged. Once CON is settled, let us discuss SER and BUD before either of us moves.

notes.note: Fall 1944: all holds, honoring promises to England (no ENG/Channel/MAO moves, PIC out of BEL/HOL) and Italy (no WES/TUN). Germany agreed A KIE to HOL and no BUR/PIC/MUN entry. England's BEL move to HOL is unconfirmed; watch if England breaks its PIC pledge. Reconsider BEL only if England vacates it.

Fall 1944: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). Pledges kept with Austria, Germany, Italy, Turkey, England: no entry into GAL/BUD/SER/VIE/TRI, BUL, BLA, CON, BOH/MUN, NOR/NTH/DEN. Germany says A KIE goes west to HOL. Turkey and Italy both say they will hit CON/BUL, not RUM/SEV. Watch Germany BOH/MUN on WAR/RUM. Reassess Spring 1945; SEV->BLA convoy plan only if CON is vacated.

Fall 1944: A BEL moves to HOL with F NTH support to bounce Germany's KIE->HOL. Other fleets hold. Pledges: France keeps PIC out of BEL/HOL; Germany keeps A BER/DEN/KIE out of NTH/HOL/BEL, but KIE->HOL breaks it. Keep fleets out of DEN/KIE, Channel, MAO. Next: retake BEL if needed.

Fall 1944: all four hold. Every move available is an attack on a rival center that would bounce against holds plus support (RUM via SEV support, BUL via BLA). Pledges from Germany, Russia, Italy, Turkey on our centers are standing. Watch German BOH/MUN and Russian RUM/GAL. Revisit only with firm written commitments.

Fall 1944: all four hold keeping BER DEN KIE MUN. KIE->HOL would bounce vs England's BEL+NTH support, so dropped it. Pledges kept: England (no HOL/BEL/NTH entry), France (no BUR/PIC), Russia (no SWE/WAR/RUM/SEV/GAL), Austria (no BOH/TYR/Austrian SCs). Watch England's HOL and Austria's VIE; seek gains only when a pledge lapses.

Fall 1944: GRE attacks BUL with CON supporting to dislodge Turkish A BUL and keep CON safe from BLA. NAP, ROM, VEN hold per Austria pledge. Austria and Russia have kept pledges so far; Turkey hostile and threatening CON. Next: if BUL taken, reinforce GRE and keep CON. Revisit ION/TUN options only with France agreement.

Fall 1944: F BLA moves to CON, supported by A BUL (choice 43). Italy has refused to withdraw F CON and threatens BUL. Russia keeps pledging A RUM and F SEV out of BUL, BLA and CON. Austria pact still unsigned. Discuss SER/BUD with Russia after CON settles.

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1945. Our A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this spring. Your A MUN, A KIE and A BER held your pledge last autumn. Will you confirm in writing that no German unit enters BOH, TYR or our centres this spring? We will keep out of MUN and BOH.

Austria here. Our A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this spring, and we will not enter GAL, RUM, WAR or SEV. Please confirm your A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold, with no entry into GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Tell me at once if Germany moves toward GAL or WAR.

Austria here. Our A SER and A BUD hold this spring and will not enter GRE or BUL. Please confirm your F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE, and that A VEN stays out of TRI. Tell me your plans for Bulgaria and Turkey.

England to Germany, Spring 1945: Your A KIE moved to HOL last autumn and my A BEL bounced it. I will not accept German units in HOL, BEL or NTH. Confirm in writing that A KIE, A DEN and A BER hold or withdraw away from HOL and BEL this spring. My F NTH and F LON will not enter DEN or KIE if you keep that promise.

England to France, Spring 1945: My A BEL and A HOL hold. Your A PIC must not enter BEL or HOL, and your fleets must stay out of ENG, the Channel and MAO. Confirm your spring orders in writing. Any French move into BEL will be treated as hostile, and I will defend it with F NTH support.

France to Germany, Spring 1945: England has 7 centres and its Low Countries are the weak point. I propose we split it. My A PIC takes BEL this spring. If HOL is vacated, your A KIE or A DEN takes it. Confirm in writing before orders, and keep your armies out of BUR, PIC and the Rhine.

France to Italy, Spring 1945: We are both at 5 to 7 centres and need growth. I propose we stop sharing the western Mediterranean. I will take Tunis when the moment suits me, and you keep Greece and the Balkans. Tell me your Spring orders first so neither of us collides.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1945: Austria's A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI have held the line for a year. Tell me your Spring 1945 orders for VIE, BUD and TRI, and whether any unit will enter BOH, TYR or MUN. My A MUN, A KIE, A DEN and A BER will hold unless you move first.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1945: Your A WAR, A RUM, F SEV, A MOS and F SWE have held for a year. I will keep A BER, A DEN, A MUN and A KIE out of SWE, WAR, RUM, SEV and GAL. Send your Spring 1945 orders, and confirm your units will stay out of BOH and MUN.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1945: Enough bloodshed over Bulgaria. Withdraw A BUL to Serbia or Rumania this spring and F BLA stays out of CON and SMY. Italy then leaves BUL, BLA and SMY alone, and F CON and F GRE hold. Confirm in writing before I order.

Italy to Russia, Spring 1945: Please confirm F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold this spring and stay out of BUL, GRE and the Aegean. Italy keeps F CON, F GRE and A VEN out of RUM, UKR and SEV. Tell me your orders before you move, since Turkey's Balkan position is unsettled.
