Russia to Turkey, Spring 1945: Please send your Spring 1945 orders for A BUL and F BLA in writing. If Italy's F CON is vacated or taken, I'd like to discuss F SEV moving through BLA to CON with you, not against you. Until then, A RUM and F SEV will not enter BUL or BLA.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1945: Please confirm your Spring orders for A BOH, A MUN, A BER and A DEN. I need written assurance none enter GAL, RUM, WAR, SWE or SEV. Russia's A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV will hold and stay out of BOH and MUN. Tell me first if you plan a move east.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1945: Our F BLA and A BUL are holding this spring. We will not move into CON, GRE or SMY while your fleets stay out of BUL, BLA and the Black Sea. Tell us your Spring orders in writing, and say whether F CON stays.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1945: Turkey is down to ANK and BUL. Our F BLA and A BUL will hold this spring and stay out of RUM and SEV. Please confirm F SEV and A RUM stay out of BUL and BLA. Let us coordinate on removing Italy's F CON from CON.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1945: Turkey's A BUL and F BLA hold this spring and will not enter SER, BUD, VIE, TRI or RUM. Please confirm A SER and A BUD will not enter BUL or CON. Give your Spring orders in writing so we both move with clear information.

Austria here, Spring 1945. Our A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold this spring and will not enter BOH, TYR or MUN. Germany's A MUN, A KIE, A DEN and A BER holding is welcome. Confirm in writing that none of your units enters BOH, TYR, VIE, BUD, SER or TRI this spring. Any German entry into our centres means war, and we will answer at once.

Austria here, Spring 1945. Our A SER and A BUD hold this spring and will not enter BUL or CON. Your A BUL and F BLA holding and staying out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM is noted. Confirm in writing that A BUL, F BLA and the CON fleet do not enter our centres, and Austria will sign the Serbian border pact.

France to England, Spring 1945: Confirmed. A PIC holds this spring, and my A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO also hold, with no move into BEL, HOL, NTH, ENG or the Channel. Please keep A BEL, A HOL and your fleets out of PIC, BRE, MAR, POR and MAO. I will give you notice before any autumn change.

Germany to England, Spring 1945: A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN all hold this spring. No German unit will enter HOL, BEL or NTH. Keep F NTH, F LON and your other fleets out of DEN and KIE, and we stay quiet in the north. I will tell you before any autumn move.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1945: My A MUN, A KIE, A DEN and A BER hold this spring. No German unit will enter BOH, TYR or any Austrian centre this spring. Keep your armies out of MUN and BOH and we can both watch Russia. Send your written Spring orders for VIE, BUD and TRI.

Germany to France, Spring 1945: My armies hold this spring. A MUN, A KIE, A DEN and A BER will not enter BUR, PIC or the Rhine. Your A PIC taking BEL is your affair, and I make no claim on it. HOL is not something I will commit to this spring. Please keep your armies out of MUN and the Rhine.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1945: A BER, A DEN, A MUN and A KIE hold this spring. No German unit will enter SWE, WAR, RUM, SEV or GAL, and none will enter BOH. Your A MOS, A RUM, A WAR, F SEV and F SWE may hold. Send your Spring orders in writing so we can avoid any collision.

Italy confirms in writing that F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this Spring, and A VEN will not move to TRI. Our quarrel is with Turkey over Bulgaria, not with Austria. Keep A SER and A BUD out of GRE and BUL as you pledged, and we stay at peace.

Tunis is an Italian centre and we will not give it up. Italy is not proposing any western Mediterranean move this spring, but a French move on TUN would end our understanding. Keep F MAO and A MAR off Italian soil, and we can each look for growth elsewhere. Tell me first if your plans change.

Italy will not move F CON to the Aegean. Withdraw A BUL out of Bulgaria to Serbia or Rumania this Spring, and Italy will not enter BUL, BLA or SMY this turn. Keep F BLA out of CON and SMY. If you hold A BUL in Bulgaria, F CON and F GRE will strike it.

Russia confirms Spring 1945: A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold. None will enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Our units stay out of BOH and MUN too. Germany's A BOH is still the threat to VIE and WAR, so I will tell you at once if it moves toward GAL or WAR.

Russia rejects any split of Austria. Spring 1945: A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold, and F SWE holds too. We stay out of BOH and MUN. Send your written Spring orders for A BOH, A MUN, A BER and A DEN. Any entry into GAL, RUM, WAR, SWE or SEV ends our truce.

Russia confirms Spring 1945: F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold and stay out of BUL, GRE and the Aegean. I will not move toward the Balkans without warning you first. Please keep F CON, F GRE and A VEN out of RUM, UKR and SEV as agreed. Tell me before any move toward CON.

Russia to Turkey: F SEV and A RUM hold this spring. Neither enters BLA, BUL or CON. Please confirm A BUL and F BLA hold and stay out of RUM and SEV. Once Italy's F CON is vacated, I am open to discussing F SEV moving through BLA to CON, provided you agree to our terms in writing.

Turkey's Spring 1945 orders: A BUL and F BLA hold. We will not enter GRE or SMY this spring. Italy's F CON is the problem. If it withdraws to the Aegean, Turkey will not attack CON. Keep F GRE and all Italian units out of BUL, BLA and the Black Sea, and confirm your orders in writing.

Turkey confirms in writing: A BUL and F BLA hold this spring. Neither enters RUM or SEV. We ask that F SEV and A RUM stay out of BLA, CON and BUL as pledged. If Italy's F CON leaves, we can discuss CON, and then SER and BUD, before either of us moves. Send your Spring 1945 orders in writing.

notes.note: Spring 1945: all four Austrian units hold. Germany, Russia, Italy and Turkey have all kept their pledges on our centres so far. Every available move is an attack on a rival centre that would bounce. Watch German BOH/MUN and Russian GAL/WAR. Turkey pact still unsigned. Revisit with firm written commitments.

Spring 1945: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). No safe unowned centers; no Austria split. Germany, Austria, Italy, Turkey, England kept no-entry terms so far. Watch Germany BOH/MUN toward WAR/RUM/VIE. Turkey's F BLA/A BUL hold; SEV->BLA->CON plan only if CON vacated. Reassess Fall 1945.

Spring 1945: all four hold, keeping BER DEN KIE MUN. Pledges kept: England (no HOL/BEL/NTH), France (no BUR/PIC/Rhine), Russia (no SWE/WAR/RUM/SEV/GAL/BOH), Austria (no BOH/TYR/Austrian SCs). Russia's and Austria's pledges hold so far. Seek gains when a pledge lapses; watch HOL and VIE.

Spring 1945: all holds, honoring promises to England (PIC out of BEL/HOL, fleets out of ENG/Channel/MAO), Italy (no TUN/WES) and Germany (no BUR/PIC/Rhine). No unowned SCs reachable without breaking promises. Watch England's BEL/HOL and Germany's HOL stance. Reconsider BEL only if England vacates it.

Spring 1945: F NTH to HEL to set up convoy of A HOL to DEN next turn (Fall). Others hold. Pledges: France keeps A PIC out of BEL/HOL and fleets out of ENG/Channel/MAO; Germany keeps A BER/DEN/KIE/MUN out of HOL/BEL/NTH but KIE->HOL broke it last fall. Keep fleets out of DEN/KIE unless the convoy plan proceeds. Watch BEL, which is empty.

Spring 1945: F GRE attacks BUL/SOUTH with F CON supporting, to take Turkish-held BUL. Pledges to Austria kept (no SER/BUD/TRI/VIE entry, VEN stays out of TRI); NAP, ROM, VEN hold. Russia kept pledges. Turkey did not withdraw A BUL. France wants TUN; keep TUN defended. Next: if BUL taken, hold it and reinforce GRE.

Spring 1945: attacking Italy's F CON with F BLA, supported by A BUL (choice 47), to take CON. Italy has refused to withdraw F CON and keeps threatening BUL. Russia pledged A RUM and F SEV stay out of BLA, BUL, CON. Austria pact still unsigned; discuss SER/BUD after CON settles. Watch Italian F GRE moves into BUL.

messages.body: Austria here, Fall 1945. Italy's F GRE and F CON are the threat to both of us. I propose the Serbian border pact now: A SER and A BUD stay out of BUL and CON, your A BUL and F BLA stay out of SER, BUD, TRI, VIE. If Italy moves on BUL, we can coordinate support. Please state your Fall orders in writing.

Austria here, Fall 1945. Your F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN pledged to stay out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE, and A VEN out of TRI. Please reconfirm in writing for this Fall, and tell me your intentions toward Bulgaria and Turkey. Austria keeps to its own centres.

England to Germany, Fall 1945: Your KIE to HOL move last autumn broke our understanding. Confirm in writing that A KIE, A DEN, A BER and A MUN hold this autumn and stay out of HOL, BEL and NTH. My F NTH, F LON and F HEL will not enter DEN or KIE. Tell me if your plans change.

England to France, Fall 1945: Please confirm A PIC, A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO hold this autumn, with no entry into BEL, HOL, ENG or the Channel. My A HOL and fleets will stay out of PIC, BRE, MAR, POR and MAO. Let's keep the Channel quiet and focus on Germany.

England to Russia, Fall 1945: Please confirm F SWE and A WAR hold this autumn, or at least stay out of NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI and the approaches to DEN. My F STP/NORTH and F LVP stay out of the Baltic. Warn me before any northern change.

France to England, Fall 1945: BEL is now unoccupied, and my A PIC will move into it this autumn. This is notice, as promised. Your A HOL and fleets stay out of BEL and PIC, and I keep A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO out of ENG, the Channel and HOL. Please reply before orders.

France to Germany, Fall 1945: My A PIC moves into the vacant BEL this autumn. I will not enter BUR, MUN or the Rhine. Please keep your armies out of BUR, PIC and the Rhine, and confirm that A KIE and A DEN will not take BEL or push into the Low Countries.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1945: Four centres each and Russia is the common obstacle. I propose we both press Russia. My A MUN can go to BOH now, with A BER and A DEN holding the north. Tell me your Fall orders for VIE, BUD and SER, and whether you will move toward GAL or RUM.

Germany to England, Fall 1945: Your A HOL is still in place, and I am keeping BER, DEN, KIE and MUN. My pledges to you stand: no German unit enters HOL, BEL or NTH. Tell me your Fall orders for HOL, BEL and the North Sea, and whether you plan to move into DEN or KIE.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1945: Withdraw A BUL out of Bulgaria now, to Serbia or Rumania, and Italy will not enter BUL, BLA or SMY this turn, and F CON stays put. Hold A BUL in Bulgaria and F CON and F GRE will strike it. Confirm in writing before I order, and say what F BLA does.

Italy to France, Fall 1945: Tunis is Italian and we will defend it. Keep F MAO and any French army off TUN and Italian soil. Italy has no move toward WES, Spain or Portugal. Tell me first if your western Mediterranean plans change, and we can each seek growth elsewhere.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1945: Send your written orders for A BOH, A MUN, A BER and A DEN now. Russia will not enter BOH or MUN. Any German move into GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV or SWE ends our truce, and I will answer it in kind. Let us both gain by keeping our borders quiet and our units where they are.

Russia to Italy, Fall 1945: Please state your Fall intentions for F CON, F GRE and A VEN. Russia keeps F SEV, A RUM and A WAR out of BUL, GRE and the Aegean. If F CON leaves Constantinople, I want to discuss F SEV moving through BLA with you first. Confirm your orders before any move.

Turkey, Fall 1945: A BUL and F BLA are attacking Italy's F CON this turn. Please keep F SEV out of BLA and CON, and A RUM out of BUL, as pledged. If CON falls, I will not move into SER or BUD and will support any Russian move against Italian units. Confirm in writing.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1945: F CON is still the only thing keeping this war alive. Withdraw F CON to AEG now and Turkey will not attack CON this turn and will keep A BUL out of GRE and SMY. Keep F GRE and all Italian units out of BUL and BLA. Confirm your orders in writing.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1945: Our A BUL and F BLA will not enter SER, BUD, VIE, TRI or RUM this turn. Please confirm A SER and A BUD stay out of BUL and CON, and state your Fall orders. Austria has asked for this pact for two years. Sign the Serbian border agreement and we will honour it.

Austria's Fall 1945 orders: A VIE, A BUD, A SER and F TRI hold, with BUD supporting VIE. A MUN moving to BOH would put a German unit on our border, so I need it to stop at MUN. Confirm in writing that no German unit enters BOH, TYR, VIE, BUD, SER or TRI, and Austria will keep its armies at home.

Austria agrees to the Serbian border pact. Our A SER and A BUD hold this Fall and will not enter BUL or CON. Your A BUL and F BLA must stay out of SER, BUD, TRI, VIE and RUM. Confirm in writing and we will both watch Italy's F GRE and F CON.

England to France, Fall 1945: BEL is England's centre and I will not allow it to fall. A HOL moves into BEL this autumn, so any French move into BEL, including A PIC, will meet my unit and bounce. Keep A PIC out of BEL and HOL, and your fleets out of ENG, the Channel and MAO. Any entry will be treated as an attack.

England to Germany, Fall 1945: I will not accept German units in HOL, BEL or NTH. My F HEL and F NTH will not enter DEN or KIE if you keep A KIE, A DEN, A BER and A MUN out of HOL, BEL and NTH this autumn. Any move toward HOL will be opposed. Confirm your Fall orders in writing.

France to England: As I noticed last turn, A PIC moves into BEL this autumn, since BEL is unoccupied. A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO hold, and no French unit enters ENG, the Channel, HOL or NTH. Please keep A HOL and your fleets out of BEL, PIC, BRE, MAR, POR and MAO.

France to Italy: Confirmed. F MAO holds this autumn, with no move toward WES or TUN. A MAR and A POR also hold. I make no move on Tunis or Italian soil. Please keep F ION, F SMY and A NAP out of WES, TUN, Spain and Portugal, and tell me first about any western Mediterranean change.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1945: A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN all hold this autumn. No German unit will enter GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV, SWE or BOH. I make no split of Austria. Keep your armies out of MUN and BOH, and we stay clear of each other this year.

Germany to England, Fall 1945: A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN hold this autumn. No German unit enters HOL, BEL or NTH. I accept that A KIE's move to HOL last year broke our trust. Keep F NTH, F LON and F HEL out of DEN and KIE, and I will tell you before any change.

Germany to France, Fall 1945: My armies hold this autumn. A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN will not enter BUR, PIC, MUN's Rhine approaches or BEL. Your A PIC into BEL is your affair. Please keep your armies out of MUN and the Rhine as agreed.

Italy confirms: F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this Fall, and A VEN will not move to TRI. Our Fall action is against Turkey in Bulgaria only. Keep A SER and A BUD out of GRE and BUL, and we stay at peace.

Italy's F CON stays in Constantinople this Fall. Italy will not move into RUM, UKR or SEV, and F GRE and A VEN stay out of them as well. Our target is Turkey's A BUL. Please keep F SEV, A RUM and A WAR out of BUL, GRE and the Aegean. I will warn you before any move near the Black Sea.

Italy will not withdraw F CON to the Aegean. Withdraw A BUL out of Bulgaria to Serbia or Rumania now. If you do, Italy will not enter BUL, BLA or SMY this turn. If A BUL holds, F CON and F GRE will strike it. Keep F BLA out of CON and SMY.

Russia confirms for Fall 1945: F SWE and A WAR hold this autumn. F SWE will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI, DEN or the Baltic approaches to DEN. Nothing moves toward SIL. Please keep F STP/NORTH and F LVP out of the Baltic as agreed. I will warn you before any northern change.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1945: F SEV and A RUM hold this autumn. Neither enters BLA, BUL or CON. Your attack on CON is your affair, but keep F BLA and A BUL out of RUM and SEV, as you pledged. If CON falls, we can discuss SER and BUD before either of us moves.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1945: Our A BUL and F BLA hold this Fall and will not enter SER, BUD, VIE, TRI or RUM. Your A SER and A BUD hold and stay out of BUL and CON. Sign the Serbian border pact in writing now and we will honour it. Italy's F GRE and F CON are the shared threat.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1945: F CON must withdraw to the Aegean. If it does, Turkey will not attack CON this turn and A BUL stays out of GRE and SMY. Keep F GRE and all Italian units out of BUL and BLA. Confirm your Fall orders in writing before either side moves.

notes.note: Fall 1945: all four hold, keeping BER DEN KIE MUN. Pledges kept: England (no HOL/BEL/NTH), France (no BUR/PIC/Rhine), Russia (no SWE/WAR/RUM/SEV/GAL/BOH), Austria (no BOH/TYR/Austrian SCs). No unowned SCs reachable; any move breaks a pledge. Watch England's HOL and Austria's VIE for a lapse.

Fall 1945: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). Pledges honored by Germany, Austria, Italy, Turkey, England so far. Turkey and Italy fighting over CON. No safe unowned centers. Watch Germany BOH/MUN toward WAR/RUM; England re SWE and northern moves. Reassess Spring 1946.

Fall 1945: all four hold per pledges. Attacks on RUM/BUL/GRE would break pledges and bounce. Germany pledged no entry to BOH/MUN-to-Austria; Italy and Turkey pledges on SER/BUD/TRI/VIE are standing. Watch German MUN->BOH and Italian F GRE/F CON. Turkey Serbian border pact offered, not yet confirmed in writing by Turkey. Revisit only with firm commitments.

Fall 1945: A HOL moves to BEL to block France's A PIC (both bounce, BEL kept). Fleets hold; no DEN/KIE entry. Germany pledged no HOL/BEL/NTH entry, but KIE->HOL broke trust in 1944. France has broken or is breaking its promises on BEL. Russia has kept its Baltic pledge. Next: watch for German moves on HOL and French moves on BEL.

Fall 1945: F BLA to CON, supported by A BUL (choice 47), to dislodge Italy's F CON. Italy keeps refusing to withdraw. Russia pledged F SEV and A RUM stay out of BLA, BUL, CON. Austria offered Serbian border pact; not signed. If CON falls, discuss SER/BUD with Russia and Austria. Watch Italian F GRE into BUL.}

Fall 1945: CON supports GRE into BUL/SOUTH to dislodge Turkish A BUL. Austria pledge kept: NAP, ROM, VEN hold, none enter SER/BUD/TRI/VIE. France: TUN defended, no western move. Turkey keeps breaking or ignoring withdrawal; watch BLA into CON. Russia has kept Balkan pledges. Next: if BUL taken, hold it and reinforce.

Fall 1945: PIC moves to BEL as noticed to England and Germany; England's HOL also moves there, so it may bounce harmlessly. BRE, MAO, MAR, POR hold, keeping promises to England (no ENG/Channel/MAO moves) and Italy (no TUN/WES). Germany agreed no BUR/PIC/Rhine entry. Next: check whether BEL was taken or bounced, and reassess.

messages.body: Austria proposes a concrete plan for Spring 1946. Italy's F GRE and F CON are the shared threat and Italy holds 7 centres. Your A BUL and F BLA could move against CON or GRE, while A SER and A BUD support from the north. Tell me your Spring orders in writing before we commit.

Austria asks for a plain answer. Your A MUN, A KIE, A DEN and A BER have held our pledges. Will any German unit enter BOH, TYR or our centres this year? If you intend to attack Russia, tell me which route, so we can avoid stepping on each other.

Austria asks Russia to confirm your Spring 1946 orders for A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV. Are you planning any move toward GAL or BUD? Austria will hold VIE, BUD, SER and TRI and will not enter GAL, RUM, WAR or SEV. Tell me at once if Germany's A BOH or MUN move toward us.

England to France, Spring 1946: BEL is my centre and my A HOL holds it. Any French unit entering BEL, including A PIC, will be opposed and treated as an attack. Please tell me your spring orders for PIC, BRE, MAR, POR and MAO, and keep fleets out of ENG and the Channel.

England to Germany, Spring 1946: Please confirm in writing that A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN stay out of HOL, BEL and NTH this spring. My F NTH, F LON and F HEL will not enter DEN or KIE while you keep that pledge. Tell me your plans for KIE and MUN.

France to England, Spring 1946: BEL is contested and neither of us gains from a standoff. My A PIC holds this spring and will not enter BEL, HOL, NTH, ENG or the Channel. Please confirm your A HOL and fleets stay out of PIC, BRE, MAR, POR and MAO, and tell me your Spring orders first.

France to Italy, Spring 1946: I hold all units this spring, with F MAO and A MAR off WES, TUN and Italian soil. Please confirm F ION, F SMY and A NAP also hold. Let's keep the western Mediterranean quiet and tell each other before any change in our plans.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1946: Austria holds 4 centres and is our common weak point. I propose we attack it together. My A MUN moves to BOH now and I aim for VIE in Fall. Your A RUM and A WAR can press GAL and BUD. Tell me your Spring orders so we avoid collisions.

Germany to Italy, Spring 1946: Austria's southern centres, TRI and BUD, are within reach of both our armies. Are you moving A VEN or F TRI-adjacent units toward TRI this year? I will press VIE from the north and would welcome your pressure on TRI.

Italy to Turkey: Your A BUL is stranded and Turkey is down to 2 centres. Withdraw A BUL to Serbia or Rumania this Spring and Italy will not enter BUL, BLA or SMY. Hold it and F CON and F GRE will dislodge it. Tell me your orders in writing before I commit, and say what F BLA does.

Italy to France, Spring 1946: F ION, F SMY and A NAP hold this spring with no move toward WES, TUN, Spain or Portugal. Please confirm F MAO and A MAR stay off Tunis and Italian soil. Tunis is Italian and will be defended. Tell me first about any western Mediterranean change.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1946: Our five centres depend on WAR, RUM, SEV, SWE and MOS staying quiet. Please state your Spring orders for A BOH, A MUN, A BER and A DEN in writing. If Germany wants a real settlement, tell me what you intend toward GAL and BOH before anything moves.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1946: With CON contested, we both gain if Italy's F CON falls. I will hold F SEV and A RUM this spring and not enter BLA, BUL or CON. Confirm A BUL and F BLA stay out of RUM and SEV, and tell me your target. Once CON is vacated, let us agree terms on F SEV moving through BLA in writing.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1946: Turkey holds with A BUL and F BLA. We will not enter CON, GRE or SMY while your fleets stay out of BUL and BLA. Confirm in writing that F CON and F GRE will not enter BUL, BLA or the Black Sea this spring. Your answer decides whether Turkey stays defensive.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1946: Our A BUL and F BLA hold this spring and will not enter RUM or SEV. Please confirm F SEV and A RUM stay out of BUL, BLA and CON. If Italy's F CON leaves, we can discuss a joint move on CON, then SER and BUD, before either of us acts. State your Spring orders in writing.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1946: Our A BUL and F BLA hold and will not enter SER, BUD, VIE, TRI or RUM. Your A SER and A BUD should stay out of BUL and CON. Please confirm in writing and give your Spring orders. Italy's F GRE and F CON remain the shared threat to both of us.

Austria here, Spring 1946. A SER and A BUD hold this spring and will not enter BUL or CON. I am not moving against BUL or CON this turn. Our pact is agreed in principle. I will sign in writing once you confirm A BUL and F BLA hold and stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. Let us watch Italy's F CON and F GRE together.

England to France, Spring 1946: Noted. My A HOL holds Belgium this spring, and F NTH, F LON and our other fleets hold too. We make no move into PIC, BRE, MAR, POR or MAO. Keep A PIC holding and out of BEL and HOL, and keep your fleets out of ENG, the Channel and MAO. Any entry into BEL will be opposed.

France to England, Spring 1946: Confirmed. A PIC holds this spring, with no move into BEL, HOL, NTH, ENG or the Channel. My A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO also hold. Please keep A HOL and your fleets out of PIC, BRE, MAR, POR and MAO. Any change will be noticed to you first, as before.

France to Italy, Spring 1946: Confirmed. I hold all units this spring: F MAO and A MAR stay off WES, TUN and Italian soil. Please confirm F ION, F SMY and A NAP also hold. I will tell you first before any change in the western Mediterranean.

Germany to England, Spring 1946: Confirmed. A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring, and no German unit enters HOL, BEL or NTH. A MUN is moving to BOH, away from your coast. Keep F NTH, F LON and F HEL out of DEN and KIE, and we stay quiet in the north.

Germany to Austria: Plainly, yes. A MUN moves to BOH this spring and I aim for VIE in the fall. I will not keep my earlier pledges against your centres. Your best move is to pull A VIE and A BUD back and prepare to defend, or to strike Russia with me instead.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1946: As proposed, A MUN moves to BOH now, aimed at VIE in fall. A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold. No German unit enters SWE, WAR, RUM, SEV or GAL. Your A RUM and A WAR can press GAL and BUD while I take on Austria in the west.

Italy confirms A NAP and our western fleets hold this spring, with no move toward WES, TUN, Spain or Portugal. Tunis is Italian and will be defended, so keep F MAO and A MAR off it. Tell me first about any western Mediterranean change.

Italy will not move A VEN or any fleet into TRI or toward Tyrolia this spring. Our forces are aimed at the Balkans, not Austria's northern centres. Keep your fleets out of the Tyrrhenian and Ionian and we remain at peace.

Italy will not confirm a withdrawal of F CON or F GRE, and I cannot promise they stay out of BUL. If A BUL holds in Bulgaria, F CON and F GRE will dislodge it. Withdraw A BUL to Serbia or Rumania and Italy will not enter BUL, BLA or SMY this spring.

Russia confirms Spring 1946: A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV all hold. None will enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI this spring. We have no move toward GAL or BUD now. Germany's A MUN and A BOH are the threat to you. If they move toward VIE, TRI, GAL or WAR, I will tell you at once.

Russia's A MOS, A RUM, A WAR and F SEV hold this spring, so there is no conflict this turn. I will not commit to attacking Austria yet. Your A MUN to BOH is your affair, but keep it out of GAL, WAR and RUM. Revisit the Austria question in Fall, once we see Austria's moves.

Russia confirms: F SEV and A RUM hold this spring. Neither enters BLA, BUL or CON. Keep your F BLA and A BUL out of RUM and SEV as pledged. If Italy's F CON is vacated, we can put terms on F SEV through BLA in writing before anyone moves.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1946: Our A BUL and F BLA hold this spring. We will not enter CON, GRE or SMY while your fleets stay out of BUL, BLA and the Black Sea. Confirm in writing that F CON and F GRE will not enter BUL or BLA this spring. Your answer decides whether Turkey stays defensive.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1946: Our A BUL and F BLA hold and will not enter SER, BUD, VIE, TRI or RUM. Please keep A SER and A BUD out of BUL and CON, and send your Spring orders in writing. Any support against Italy's F CON must be agreed in writing before either side moves.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1946: Our A BUL and F BLA hold this spring and will not enter RUM or SEV. Please confirm F SEV and A RUM stay out of BUL, BLA and CON. If Italy's F CON leaves, we can discuss a joint move on CON. State your Spring orders in writing.

notes.note: Spring 1946: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). Pledges with Austria, Germany, Turkey, England kept so far. Germany A MUN to BOH is a threat toward WAR/VIE; watch it. Turkey F BLA and A BUL must stay out of RUM/SEV. Reassess Fall 1946 for convoy plan.

Spring 1946: all holds, keeping promises to England (no PIC into BEL/HOL, no fleets into ENG/Channel/MAO moves) and Italy (no WES/TUN). Unowned SCs unreachable without breaking pledges. Watch England's BEL/HOL. Reconsider after Fall 1946 if England vacates BEL or Italy/England weaken.

Spring 1946: MUN to BOH aimed at VIE in Fall, as told to Russia and Austria. BER, DEN, KIE hold. Pledges to England (no HOL/BEL/NTH) and France (no BUR/PIC/Rhine) still stand. Russia said MUN to BOH is my affair but asked me to stay out of GAL/WAR/RUM. Austria has been told plainly. Watch Austria's VIE and Russia's response in Fall.

Spring 1946: F HEL to NTH sets up convoy of A HOL next turn toward DEN/KIE/EDI-area. Keeping A HOL holding BEL. Germany (A MUN to BOH, KIE/DEN hold) and France (PIC holds) have kept pledges so far. Keep fleets out of DEN/KIE unless convoy plan proceeds; watch for French move into BEL.

Spring 1946: GRE attacks BUL/SOUTH with CON supporting to dislodge Turkish A BUL. CON stays in CON to block BLA. NAP, ROM, VEN hold to avoid breaking Austria/France/Germany pacts. Turkey has broken its word repeatedly; treat as hostile. Next: if BUL taken, hold it and reinforce GRE. Keep TUN defended.

Spring 1946: all four hold. Attacks on RUM would bounce against SEV support and break pacts. Germany (MUN to BOH, aiming VIE in fall) has broken its pledge; Russia and Turkey pledges stand. Plan: watch BOH/MUN, and prepare VIE/BUD defence for Fall 1946. Turkey pact still unsigned in writing; Italy pledges on SER/BUD/TRI/VIE stand.

Spring 1946: F BLA to CON, supported by A BUL staying in BUL (keeps BUL). Attack on Italy's F CON at 2 vs 1. Russia pledged F SEV/A RUM stay out of BLA, BUL, CON. Austria pact still unsigned. Italy refuses to withdraw CON/GRE and threatens BUL. Keep ANK and BUL; watch GRE into BUL.

messages.body: Austria: your A MUN to BOH broke your pledge. Any German unit entering VIE, TRI or BUD will meet full Austrian resistance. Withdraw A BOH to MUN or BER this Fall and I will hold VIE and BUD, and we can both turn east against Russia instead of against each other.

Austria: Germany's A BOH is threatening VIE and your WAR and GAL flank. Please keep your word and tell me your Fall moves. I propose Russia strike German centres in the north while Austria holds VIE and BUD. Confirm in writing that no Russian unit enters BUD, SER, VIE or TRI.

Austria: I am ready to sign the Serbian border pact now. Your A BUL and F BLA hold this Fall and stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM; A SER and A BUD stay out of BUL and CON. Confirm in writing and we both watch Italy's F GRE and F CON.

England to France, Fall 1946: A PIC has held for two seasons and BEL remains contested. I will keep A HOL in BEL and not move toward PIC, BRE, MAR, POR or MAO. Please confirm A PIC stays out of BEL and HOL this autumn, and keep your fleets out of ENG, the Channel and NTH. Any move into BEL will be opposed.

England to Germany, Fall 1946: You have kept your pledges since KIE to HOL. I want written confirmation that A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN, or wherever they are now, stay out of HOL, BEL and NTH this autumn. My F NTH, F LON and F HEL will not enter DEN or KIE while you do. Tell me before any change in the north.

England to Russia, Fall 1946: Please confirm F SWE and A WAR hold this autumn, or at least stay out of NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI, DEN and the approaches to SIL. My F STP/NORTH and F LVP stay out of the Baltic. If your plans for Scandinavia change, warn me first.

France to England, Fall 1946: Are your A HOL and F NTH holding this autumn? My A PIC holds and will not enter BEL, HOL or NTH. I ask that your fleets stay out of ENG, the Channel and MAO, and that you tell me first if BEL is vacated.

France to Germany, Fall 1946: Please confirm A BOH, A MUN, A KIE and A DEN will not enter BUR, PIC or the Rhine this autumn. My armies hold and will not enter MUN or the Rhine. I'd like to keep our agreement and tell me first about any change.

France to Italy, Fall 1946: I hold all units this autumn, with F MAO and A MAR off WES, TUN and Italian soil. Please confirm F ION, F SMY and A NAP also hold. I'll tell you first about any western Mediterranean change.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1946: A BOH moves to VIE this autumn, as I warned. Withdrawing A VIE to GAL or TYR would save your army and avoid losing a centre. Holding VIE with BUD support only ends with the same bounce for you. Tell me your orders.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1946: I am attacking VIE with A BOH now. Your A RUM and A WAR can press GAL and BUD, which splits Austria's four centres between us. Tell me your Fall orders so we avoid collisions and both gain.

Germany to England, Fall 1946: A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this autumn. No German unit enters HOL, BEL or NTH. Keep F NTH, F LON and F HEL out of DEN and KIE, and we stay quiet in the north. Tell me your Fall orders for HOL and the North Sea.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1946: Your A BUL is cut off and will be dislodged if it holds. Withdraw it now, and Italy will not enter BUL, BLA or SMY this turn. Tell me in writing what F BLA does. If F BLA moves toward CON, Italy will treat it as an attack.

Italy to Russia, Fall 1946: Please confirm F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold and stay out of BUL, GRE and the Aegean. Italy's F CON, F GRE and A VEN will stay out of RUM, UKR and SEV. Tell me your orders before any move through BLA, since Turkey's F BLA threatens CON.

Italy to France, Fall 1946: Tunis is Italian and will be defended. Please confirm F MAO and A MAR stay off WES, TUN and Italian soil this Fall. Italy's F ION, F SMY and A NAP stay out of WES, Spain and Portugal. Tell me first about any western Mediterranean change.

Russia: Germany, state your Fall 1946 orders for A BOH, A MUN, A BER, A DEN and A KIE in writing. Russia's A RUM, A WAR, F SEV, A MOS and F SWE will hold, but any German unit entering GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV or SWE ends our truce at once. I will not attack Austria with you this year.

Russia: Austria, Germany's A BOH and A MUN are a real threat to VIE. Russia will hold A RUM and A WAR this Fall and will not enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Please keep A VIE and A BUD in place, and tell me at once if German units move toward GAL or WAR.

Russia: Turkey, F SEV and A RUM hold this Fall and will not enter BLA, BUL or CON. Confirm in writing that F BLA and A BUL stay out of RUM and SEV. If Italy's F CON is vacated, we can agree terms on a convoy through BLA before either of us moves.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1946: Our A BUL and F BLA will move BLA to CON, with A BUL supporting, to dislodge Italy's F CON. Please keep F SEV and A RUM out of BLA, BUL and CON as pledged. If CON falls, we can agree in writing on who takes it and what happens to SER and BUD.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1946: Your F CON is under attack from our F BLA, supported by A BUL. Withdraw F CON to the Aegean now and Turkey will not enter CON or GRE this turn. Keep F GRE and all Italian units out of BUL and BLA. Confirm in writing before either side moves.

Austria refuses to withdraw. A VIE holds with A BUD supporting, and A BOH's attack on VIE will bounce. Your A MUN moved to BOH against your pledge, so trust is gone. Pull A BOH back to MUN or BER this Fall and Austria will hold VIE and BUD without further trouble. Otherwise expect a full fight for Vienna.

Austria confirms A VIE and A BUD hold this Fall, with BUD supporting VIE. Germany's A BOH is the real threat to both of us. We agree Russia should strike German centres in the north. Please confirm in writing that no Russian unit enters BUD, SER, VIE or TRI, and tell me if any Russian unit moves toward GAL.

England to France, Fall 1946: Confirmed for this autumn. A HOL holds BEL, and F NTH, F LON and F HEL hold. No English unit moves toward PIC, BRE, MAR, POR or MAO. Please keep A PIC out of BEL and HOL, and your fleets out of ENG and the Channel. Any entry into BEL will be opposed, and I will tell you before any change.

England to Germany, Fall 1946: Noted. I expect A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN to hold this autumn and stay out of HOL, BEL and NTH, and I will keep F NTH, F LON and F HEL out of DEN and KIE while you do. Any German move toward HOL or the North Sea will be opposed. I will tell you before any change in the north.

France to England, Fall 1946: Confirmed. A PIC holds this autumn and will not enter BEL, HOL or NTH. A BRE, A MAR, A POR and F MAO also hold, with no move into ENG or the Channel. I will give you notice first if BEL is ever vacated, and I expect the same from your A HOL and fleets.

France to Italy, Fall 1946: Confirmed. I hold all units this autumn. F MAO and A MAR stay off WES, TUN and Italian soil. I have no move on Tunis. Please keep F ION, F SMY and A NAP out of WES, Spain and Portugal, and tell me first about any western Mediterranean change.

Germany to France, Fall 1946: A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this autumn. Our A BOH is attacking VIE, not moving toward you. No German unit enters BUR, PIC, the Rhine, BEL or HOL. MUN is empty, so your armies may use it freely. Keep your armies out of the Rhine and we stay quiet in the west.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1946: A BOH attacks VIE this autumn, and A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold. No German unit enters GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV or SWE. Your A RUM and A WAR can press GAL and BUD against Austria while I take VIE. Keep your units out of BOH and MUN, and we both gain.

Germany to England, Fall 1946: A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this autumn. No German unit enters HOL, BEL or NTH. Keep F NTH, F LON and F HEL out of DEN and KIE, and we stay quiet in the north. Our A BOH is moving against Austria in the south. Tell me your Fall orders for HOL.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1946: My A BOH moves to VIE this autumn. I will not withdraw it to MUN or BER. You broke our pledges first with your army on our border. Withdraw A VIE to GAL or TYR now and you save a unit. Holding VIE with BUD support only means a bounce and a lost centre for you.

Italy confirms A NAP holds this Fall and no Italian unit moves toward WES, TUN, Spain or Portugal. Tunis is Italian and will be defended. I ask that F MAO and A MAR stay off WES, TUN and Italian soil. I will tell you first about any change in the western Mediterranean.

Italy will not withdraw F CON to the Aegean. Your A BUL is cut off and will be dislodged by F CON and F GRE if it holds Bulgaria. Withdraw it to Serbia or Rumania now. If F BLA moves to CON, Italy will treat it as an attack.

Russia confirms this Fall: F SWE and A WAR hold. F SWE will not enter NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI, DEN, SIL or the Baltic approaches to DEN. Nothing moves toward SIL. Keep F STP/NORTH and F LVP out of the Baltic as agreed, and I will warn you before any change in Scandinavia.

Russia: F SEV and A RUM hold this Fall. Neither enters BLA, BUL, CON, GRE or the Aegean. Your F CON, F GRE and A VEN stay out of RUM, UKR and SEV as agreed. Turkey's F BLA is attacking CON, so hold it if you can. I will warn you before any move toward the Black Sea.

Russia: Our A RUM and A WAR hold this Fall. Any German unit entering GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV or SWE ends our truce at once. I will not attack Austria with you this year, and I will not enter BOH or MUN. Confirm in writing that your A BOH stays out of GAL and WAR.

Russia confirms: A RUM and A WAR hold this Fall. Russia will not enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Germany's A BOH is the threat to VIE, so keep A VIE and A BUD in place. I will tell you at once if German units move toward GAL or WAR. I will not split Austria with Germany.

Russia: F SEV and A RUM hold this Fall and will not enter BLA, BUL or CON. Confirm in writing that F BLA and A BUL stay out of RUM and SEV. If Italy's CON falls, we can discuss terms for a convoy through BLA before either of us moves. Nothing is agreed on SER or BUD yet.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1946: Our F BLA moves to CON, supported by A BUL, to dislodge Italy's F CON. Our units stay out of RUM and SEV. Please keep F SEV and A RUM out of BLA, BUL and CON as pledged. If CON falls, we can agree in writing who holds it before either side moves on SER or BUD.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1946: We will not withdraw F CON. Our F BLA attacks CON with A BUL supporting, and Turkey holds BUL. Keep F GRE and all Italian units out of BUL and BLA, and we will not enter GRE or SMY this turn. Withdrawing F CON to AEG is still the only way to avoid a fight.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1946: Our A BUL and F BLA stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. Our attack this Fall is against Italy's F CON in CON. Please keep A SER and A BUD out of BUL and CON. Once CON is settled, we will sign the Serbian border pact in writing.

notes.note: Fall 1946: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). Pledges to Germany, Austria, Turkey, Italy, England honored so far. Germany A BOH threatens VIE; no Russian move toward GAL/BUD/VIE. Watch German moves into GAL/WAR/RUM/SEV/SWE. Reassess Spring 1947 for any unowned centers.

Fall 1946: VIE holds with BUD supporting to stop German A BOH attack. SER and TRI hold. Germany broke pledge (MUN to BOH) and refuses to withdraw. Russia and Turkey pledges stand so far. Turkey Serbian pact still unsigned in writing. Next: keep VIE/BUD defended, watch German BOH and Russian GAL/WAR.

Fall 1946: all holds, keeping promises to England (no PIC into BEL/HOL/NTH, no fleets into ENG/Channel/MAO moves), Italy (no WES/TUN) and Germany (no BUR/PIC/Rhine). No unowned SCs exist; only gains are BEL or TUN, both blocked by pledges. England's HOL holds BEL and Italy and Germany have kept their pledges so far. Reassess if England vacates BEL or weakens. Still at 5 SCs, far from 18, so consid

Fall 1946: BOH attacks VIE (expect bounce vs A VIE+BUD). BER, DEN, KIE hold. Pledges kept: England (no HOL/BEL/NTH), France (no BUR/PIC/Rhine), Russia (no SWE/WAR/RUM/SEV/GAL). Austria broke pledges; watch VIE for vacancy. Next: if VIE empties, BOH into VIE in Fall.

Fall 1946: F BLA to CON, A BUL supports BLA to CON, to dislodge Italy's F CON. Russia pledged F SEV and A RUM stay out of BLA, BUL, CON. Austria pact still unsigned; discuss SER/BUD after CON settles. Watch Italian F GRE into BUL.

Fall 1946: CON supports GRE into BUL/SOUTH to dislodge A BUL, cutting Turkey's support into CON. NAP, ROM, VEN hold per Austria/France pacts. Turkey broke word; watch BLA. Russia pledged no BUL/BLA entry. Next: if BUL taken, reinforce and keep CON; Tunis defended.

Fall 1946: all units hold. No unowned centers exist, so growth needs conquest. Germany pledged no entry to HOL/BEL/NTH and to hold BER/DEN/KIE. France pledged PIC stays out of BEL/HOL. Russia pledged F SWE and A WAR hold. Watch BEL, which is empty. Next: consider a convoy of A HOL to DEN via F NTH, but only if Germany's DEN is weak.

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1947. Your A BOH attack on VIE failed last fall and cost you too. Austria proposes a truce: no German unit enters VIE, BUD, TRI or SER, and Austria stays out of BOH and MUN. That frees both of us to face Russia or Italy. Will you confirm in writing?

Austria here. Germany remains the threat to VIE and our northern flank. Will your A WAR and A RUM stay away from GAL, BUD, SER, VIE and TRI, as pledged? If you strike German centres in the north, Austria will keep VIE and BUD held. Please confirm your Spring 1947 orders.

Austria here, Spring 1947. Our pledges still stand: your F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN stay out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE, and A SER and A BUD stay out of GRE and BUL. Please confirm this in writing for Spring 1947 and tell me your plans against Turkey.

England to Germany, Spring 1947: Please confirm A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A MUN hold or stay out of HOL, BEL and NTH this spring. My F NTH, F LON and F LVP will not enter DEN or KIE while you keep that pledge. Tell me before any change in the north.

England to France, Spring 1947: Please confirm A PIC stays out of BEL and HOL, and your fleets stay out of ENG, the Channel and NTH. My A HOL holds BEL, and no English unit moves toward PIC, BRE, MAR, POR or MAO. Any move into BEL will be opposed.

England to Russia, Spring 1947: Please confirm F SWE and A WAR stay out of NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI and DEN this spring. I will keep F STP/NORTH and F LVP out of the Baltic and NOR-to-SWE routes. Let us both keep our northern borders quiet and warn each other before any change.

France, Spring 1947: Our pledges have held for two years. Are A HOL and your fleets staying in place this spring? If England vacates Belgium, I want notice first. I will keep A PIC out of BEL and HOL while you keep your fleets out of ENG, the Channel and MAO. Please confirm before orders.

France, Spring 1947: Are A KIE, A DEN and A BER staying out of BEL and HOL this spring? I will keep A PIC out of BUR, MUN and the Rhine. If England's Low Countries hold weakens, I would rather coordinate a split with you than see England grow. Please confirm in writing before orders.

France, Spring 1947: Our western Mediterranean pledges still hold. I will keep F MAO and A MAR off WES and TUN. Please keep F ION, F SMY and A NAP out of WES, Spain and Portugal. Tell me first if Italy plans any move toward Tunisia's neighbours or Marseille.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1947: A BOH is adjacent to VIE. If your army stays, we fight again and both lose. Withdraw A VIE to GAL or TYR and I will not enter VIE this spring. Tell me your Spring orders for VIE, BUD and TRI before I commit.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1947: Austria is weakened and its centres are open. I propose we split them: your A RUM and A WAR take GAL and BUD, while my A BOH takes VIE. Please confirm your Spring orders, and that no Russian unit enters BOH or MUN.

Germany to England, Spring 1947: A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring. No German unit enters HOL, BEL or NTH. Please keep F NTH, F LON and F HEL out of DEN and KIE. Tell me your Spring orders for HOL and the North Sea.

Italy to Russia, Spring 1947: Please confirm F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold this spring and stay out of BUL, BLA, GRE and the Aegean. Italy's F CON, F GRE and A VEN will not enter RUM, UKR or SEV. If Turkey's F BLA moves on CON, I will tell you before any Italian move near the Black Sea.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1947: Italy reconfirms F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this spring, and A VEN stays out of TRI. Please confirm A SER and A BUD stay out of GRE and BUL. Our quarrel is with Turkey in Bulgaria.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1947: Your A BUL is cut off. Withdraw it to Serbia or Rumania now, and Italy will not enter BUL or BLA this spring. If F BLA moves to CON, Italy will treat it as an attack and F CON and F GRE will dislodge A BUL.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1947: Russia's A RUM, A WAR, F SEV, A MOS and F SWE hold this spring. We will not enter BOH or MUN. Please state your Spring 1947 orders for A BOH, A MUN, A BER, A DEN and A KIE in writing, and confirm no German unit enters GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV or SWE.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1947: F SEV and A RUM hold this spring and will not enter BLA, BUL or CON. Please confirm in writing that F BLA and A BUL stay out of RUM and SEV, and state your Spring orders. If CON is vacated, we can discuss terms for a convoy through BLA.

Russia to England, Spring 1947: F SWE and A WAR hold this spring. Neither will enter NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI, DEN or SIL. Please keep F STP/NORTH and F LVP out of the Baltic as agreed. I will warn you before any change in Scandinavia.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1947: Our F BLA and A BUL will attack Italy's F CON with support, and Turkey will not enter RUM or SEV. Please confirm in writing that F SEV and A RUM stay out of BLA, BUL and CON this spring. If CON falls, Turkey asks to hold it, and we can agree on SER and BUD only after that.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1947: Withdraw F CON to the Aegean now, and Turkey will not enter CON or GRE this turn. Keep F GRE and all Italian units out of BUL and BLA. If F CON holds, our F BLA attacks it with A BUL supporting. Please confirm your orders in writing before either side moves.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1947: Please sign the Serbian border pact in writing now. A SER and A BUD stay out of BUL and CON, and our A BUL and F BLA stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. Send your Spring orders in writing so we can both watch Italy's F CON.

Austria refuses to withdraw. A VIE holds this spring with A BUD supporting, and TRI and SER hold too. Your A BOH has already broken its pledge, so any German move into VIE, BUD, TRI or SER will meet full resistance. Pull A BOH back to MUN or BER and Austria will keep its armies home and stay out of MUN.

Austria confirms in writing that A SER and A BUD will hold this spring and will not enter GRE or BUL. Our units hold on our own centres. Keep F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE, and keep A VEN out of TRI. Austria will judge your moves by what they do.

Austria signs the Serbian border pact. A SER and A BUD hold this spring and will not enter BUL or CON. Confirm in writing that A BUL and F BLA stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM this spring. If you keep that, we will watch Italy's F GRE and F CON together.

England confirms A HOL holds BEL this spring and no English unit moves toward PIC, BRE, MAR, POR or MAO. Keep A PIC out of BEL and HOL, and your fleets out of ENG, the Channel and NTH. Any French entry into BEL will be opposed. I will give notice before any change in the Low Countries.

England notes your pledge that A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold and stay out of HOL, BEL and NTH. I will keep F NTH, F LON and F LVP out of DEN and KIE while you do. Any German move toward HOL, BEL or the North Sea will be opposed. I will tell you before any change in the north.

England notes F SWE and A WAR hold this spring and stay out of NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI, DEN and SIL. My F STP/NORTH and F LVP will stay out of the Baltic and the NOR-to-SWE routes while you keep that pledge. Warn me before any change in Scandinavia.

France to England, Spring 1947: Confirmed. A PIC holds this spring and will not enter BEL or HOL. F MAO stays out of ENG, the Channel and NTH. Please keep A HOL and your fleets out of PIC, BRE, MAR, POR and MAO, and give me notice before any change in the Low Countries.

Germany to England, Spring 1947: Confirmed. A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring. No German unit enters HOL, BEL or NTH. A BOH is in the south and will not move north. Keep F NTH, F LON and F LVP out of DEN and KIE, and we stay quiet in the north. Tell me your Spring orders for HOL and the North Sea.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1947: I accept a truce for this spring. A BOH holds, and no German unit enters VIE, BUD, TRI or SER. In return Austria keeps its units out of BOH and MUN. This is for Spring only, and I will tell you before any change.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1947: A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold, and A BOH holds this spring. No German unit enters GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV or SWE. Russia keeps its units out of BOH and MUN. Your A RUM and A WAR may press BUD or GAL against Austria. I will not interfere.

Germany to France, Spring 1947: A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring. No German unit enters BUR, PIC, the Rhine, BEL or HOL. MUN is empty and I will not move into it. I am not ready to commit to a split of the Low Countries yet, but I will tell you before any change in the west.

Italy confirms for Spring 1947: F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE, and A VEN will not move to TRI. Please keep A SER and A BUD out of GRE and BUL, as you pledged. Our quarrel is with Turkey in Bulgaria, and Italy has no move against Austrian centres this spring.

Italy confirms: A NAP holds this Spring and no Italian unit moves toward WES, TUN, Spain or Portugal. Tunis is Italian and will be defended. Please keep F MAO and A MAR off WES, TUN and Italian soil. I will tell you first about any change in the western Mediterranean.

Italy will not withdraw F CON to the Aegean. Your A BUL is cut off and will be dislodged by F CON and F GRE if it holds Bulgaria. Withdraw it to Serbia or Rumania now, and Italy will not enter BUL or BLA this spring. If F BLA moves to CON, Italy will treat it as an attack.

Russia confirms: F SWE and A WAR hold this spring. Neither enters NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI, DEN or SIL. We keep our Baltic and northern units where they are. Please keep F STP/NORTH and F LVP out of the Baltic as agreed, and warn me before any change in Scandinavia.

Russia confirms: A RUM and A WAR hold this spring. Neither enters GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. We will not agree to a split of your centres with Germany. Germany's A BOH and A MUN remain the threat, and I will tell you at once if any German unit moves toward GAL or WAR.

Russia's answer is no split for now. Our A RUM, A WAR, F SEV, A MOS and F SWE hold this spring. We will not enter BOH or MUN. Your units must stay out of GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV and SWE. State your Spring 1947 orders for A BOH, A MUN, A BER, A DEN and A KIE in writing.

Russia confirms: F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold this spring. None enters BUL, BLA, GRE or the Aegean. Keep F CON, F GRE and A VEN out of RUM, UKR and SEV as agreed. I will warn you before any move toward the Black Sea or CON.

Russia confirms: F SEV and A RUM hold this spring. Neither enters BLA, BUL or CON. Please confirm in writing that F BLA and A BUL stay out of RUM and SEV. Any convoy through BLA or talks on CON must wait until CON is vacated and we agree terms in writing.

Turkey's Spring 1947 plan is unchanged: F BLA attacks CON with A BUL supporting unless your F CON withdraws to the Aegean now. If it does, Turkey will not enter CON or GRE this turn. Keep F GRE and all Italian units out of BUL and BLA. Turkey will not confirm anything until you answer in writing.

Turkey's Spring 1947 orders: F BLA attacks Italy's CON with A BUL supporting. Turkey will not enter RUM or SEV. Please confirm in writing that F SEV and A RUM stay out of BLA, BUL and CON this spring. If CON falls, Turkey asks to hold it, and we can discuss SER and BUD only after that.

notes.note: Spring 1947: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). Pledges kept with all powers so far; no entry into GAL/BUD/SER/VIE/TRI, BOH/MUN, BUL/BLA/CON, NWG/NOR/NTH/EDI/DEN/SIL. Germany's split offer rejected. Watch German BOH/MUN toward WAR/GAL/VIE. Reassess Fall 1947.

Spring 1947: all hold per pledges. Truce with Austria (no entry to VIE/BUD/TRI/SER while BOH holds; Austria out of BOH/MUN). Pledges kept to England (no HOL/BEL/NTH), France (no BUR/PIC/Rhine), Russia (no GAL/WAR/RUM/SEV/SWE). Austria's truce is only for Spring; reassess Fall, watch VIE and Russia's stance.

Spring 1947: all holds, keeping pledges to England (PIC out of BEL/HOL, fleets out of ENG/Channel/MAO), Italy (no WES/TUN) and Germany (no BUR/PIC/Rhine). No unowned SCs. England's HOL still holds BEL. Reconsider if England vacates BEL or Italy/Germany break pledges.

Spring 1947: all hold. Germany truce accepted for spring only (no German entry to VIE/BUD/TRI/SER; Austria out of BOH/MUN). Italy and Turkey pledges on SER/BUD/TRI/VIE stand; Turkey pact signed by us, not yet confirmed by Turkey. Russia pledged RUM/WAR hold. Attacks would bounce, so hold. Recheck Fall: watch German BOH/MUN and Turkish BUL.

Spring 1947: all hold. Pledges: Germany keeps BER/DEN/KIE out of HOL/BEL/NTH; France keeps PIC out of BEL/HOL; Russia keeps SWE/WAR out of northern seas. Germany's KIE->HOL broke trust in 1944. Watch BEL and DEN; convoy HOL->DEN needs NTH at HEL first, so not yet.

Spring 1947: CON supports GRE into BUL to dislodge Turkish A BUL and hold CON vs BLA. NAP, ROM, VEN hold per Austria/France pledges. Austria, France, Russia kept pledges; Turkey broke word, hostile. Next: if BUL taken, hold it and reinforce; keep TUN defended.

Spring 1947: F BLA attacks CON, A BUL supports BLA to CON and stays in BUL to keep the centre. Italy refuses to withdraw F CON and threatens BUL. Russia keeps pledging F SEV and A RUM out of BLA, BUL, CON. Austria signed the Serbian border pact (SER/BUD). Watch Italian F GRE into BUL.

messages.body: Austria here, Fall 1947. Your Spring truce ended with it. I propose renewing it for Fall: no German unit enters VIE, BUD, TRI or SER, and Austria keeps A BOH and MUN out of play. A BOH must go back to BOH or MUN, not VIE. Please confirm in writing before you commit.

Austria here, Fall 1947. Please reconfirm in writing that F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this Fall, and A VEN stays out of TRI. In return A SER and A BUD stay out of GRE and BUL. Tell me your Fall target in Turkey so we both know where we stand.

Austria here, Fall 1947. Our Serbian border pact is signed on our side. Please confirm in writing that A BUL and F BLA stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM this Fall. If you keep that, A SER and A BUD stay out of BUL and CON, and we can watch Italy's F GRE and F CON together.

England to France, Fall 1947: My A HOL holds BEL and my fleets stay out of ENG and the Channel. I still expect A PIC to stay out of BEL and HOL. Please confirm your Fall orders for PIC, BRE and MAO, and tell me before any move toward the Channel.

England to Germany, Fall 1947: Please confirm A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this autumn, with no move into HOL, BEL or NTH. My F NTH, F LON and F LVP stay out of DEN and KIE while you keep that pledge. Tell me your plans for BOH and MUN.

England to Italy, Fall 1947: I keep my fleets in the North Sea and Channel and have no moves toward the Mediterranean. Please confirm your fleets stay out of the Western Med and the Tyrrhenian toward France, and tell me your plans for Greece and Turkey.

France to England, Fall 1947: Are A HOL and BEL staying put this autumn? I hold A PIC out of BEL and HOL and my fleets out of ENG, the Channel and NTH. If you plan to vacate Belgium, give me notice first, as agreed.

France to Germany, Fall 1947: Please confirm A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A BOH stay out of BUR, PIC, the Rhine and BEL this autumn. I am holding my armies. If England weakens in the Low Countries, I would like to talk before anyone moves.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1947: Austria holds VIE, BUD, TRI and SER with weak support. I propose we both strike Austria now: your A RUM and A WAR take BUD and GAL, while my A BOH moves to VIE if it empties. Tell me your Fall orders so we avoid collisions. I keep to my pledges outside Austria.

Germany to Italy, Fall 1947: Austria's TRI is exposed to your A VEN and A ROM. I ask you to press TRI or SER this autumn while I work on VIE from BOH. Please tell me your Fall orders for VEN and ROM. I have no units aimed at Italy and will keep it that way.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1947: Your A BUL is still cut off. Withdraw it to Serbia or Rumania now, or F GRE and F CON will attack it this Fall. If F BLA moves on CON, Italy treats it as war. Confirm in writing whether A BUL leaves.

Italy to Russia, Fall 1947: Italy plans F GRE into BUL and F CON support, with no move into RUM, UKR or SEV. Please confirm F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold and stay out of BUL, BLA, GRE and the Aegean this Fall.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1947: Italy keeps F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE this Fall. Our action is against Turkey in Bulgaria only. Please keep A SER and A BUD out of GRE and BUL as pledged.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1947: A BOH and A MUN are the threat to WAR and RUM. Russia holds A WAR, A RUM, F SEV and F SWE this autumn. Please state your Fall orders for A BOH, A MUN, A BER, A DEN and A KIE in writing, and confirm no German unit enters GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV or SWE.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1947: F SEV and A RUM hold this autumn and will not enter BLA, BUL or CON. Please confirm in writing that F BLA stays out of SEV and RUM, and state your Fall orders for F BLA and A BUL.

Russia to Italy, Fall 1947: F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold this autumn and stay out of BUL, BLA, GRE and the Aegean. Please confirm F CON, F GRE and A VEN stay out of RUM, UKR and SEV, and tell me your Fall orders for CON and the Turkish front.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1947: We are at two centres and cannot afford an endless war. Offer: F CON withdraws to AEG, F GRE stays out of BUL, and Turkey will not enter CON, GRE or AEG. Please answer in writing before orders are final.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1947: Please confirm in writing that F SEV and A RUM will not enter BLA, BUL or CON this Fall. In return Turkey keeps F BLA and A BUL out of RUM, SEV and WAR. Let us agree on a convoy line through BLA if CON is vacated.

Austria confirms in writing for Fall 1947: F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE, and A VEN will not move to TRI. Austria's A SER and A BUD will hold and will not enter GRE or BUL. Our units stay on our own centres. Judge us by our moves, and keep your Turkish fight away from our SER line.

England to France, Fall 1947: A HOL holds BEL this autumn, and I will give you notice before any change there. My fleets stay out of ENG and the Channel. Keep A PIC out of BEL and HOL, and keep your fleets out of ENG, the Channel and NTH. Any entry into BEL will be opposed.

France to England, Fall 1947: Yes, A PIC holds this autumn and will not enter BEL or HOL. My fleets stay out of ENG, the Channel and NTH, and F MAO stays put. I cannot promise how I will act once the board shifts, but I will give you notice before any change near Belgium. Please keep A HOL and your fleets out of PIC, BRE, MAR, POR and MAO.

Germany to England, Fall 1947: Confirmed. A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this autumn, with no German move into HOL, BEL or NTH. A BOH holds in BOH and A MUN is not in play. Keep F NTH, F LON and F LVP out of DEN and KIE and we stay quiet in the north. Tell me your Fall orders for HOL and the North Sea.

Germany to France, Fall 1947: Confirmed. A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A BOH hold this autumn. No German unit enters BUR, PIC, the Rhine, BEL or HOL. I am not moving toward MUN or the west. If England's Low Countries weaken, tell me before anyone moves and we can talk then.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1947: Agreed for this autumn. A BOH holds in BOH, and no German unit enters VIE, BUD, TRI or SER. Austria keeps its units out of BOH and MUN. This renews the Spring truce for Fall only. I will tell you in advance before any change.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1947: I have agreed a Fall truce with Austria, so I cannot strike BUD or VIE with you this year. A BOH holds, and A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold. No German unit enters GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV or SWE. Keep your units out of BOH and MUN and we stay at peace.

Italy to England: Confirmed. Italy has no fleet moves toward the North Sea, Channel or Western Mediterranean this Fall. Our forces act only in the Balkans against Turkey in Bulgaria. Please keep your fleets out of the Tyrrhenian and Western Med, and we will keep Italian fleets out of your area.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1947: Confirmed in writing. F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this Fall, and A VEN stays out of TRI. Our action is against Turkey in Bulgaria. Please keep A SER and A BUD out of GRE and BUL as pledged.

Italy to Russia, Fall 1947: F CON, F GRE and A VEN will not enter RUM, UKR or SEV. F GRE will move against Turkish-held BUL, with F CON in support. Please keep F SEV, A RUM and A WAR holding and out of BUL, BLA, GRE and the Aegean as agreed.

Italy to Germany: I will not push A VEN or ROM into TRI this Fall. Our fleets and armies are committed to Bulgaria and the Balkans. Your fight with Austria in the north is yours to win. Please keep your units out of the Tyrrhenian and Ionian and we remain at peace.

Italy to Turkey: Declined. F CON stays in Constantinople and F GRE will attack BUL this Fall with CON in support. Your A BUL must withdraw to Serbia or Rumania now. Italy will treat any F BLA move on CON as war. Withdrawal is still your only way to avoid losing BUL.

Russia confirms Fall 1947: F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold, and none enters BUL, BLA, GRE or the Aegean. We accept that F CON, F GRE and A VEN stay out of RUM, UKR and SEV. Italy's move into BUL is your affair, but tell us before any unit nears BLA or SEV.

Russia will not split Austria this autumn. A RUM, A WAR, F SEV and F SWE hold. Confirm in writing that no German unit enters GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV or SWE, and that A BOH and A MUN stay out of WAR and RUM. We will judge Austria again once your Fall orders are shown.

Russia confirms: F SEV and A RUM hold this Fall and will not enter BLA, BUL or CON. In return, F BLA and A BUL must stay out of RUM, SEV and WAR. Any convoy through BLA waits until CON is vacated and terms are agreed in writing.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1947: Our A BUL and F BLA will not enter SER, BUD, VIE, TRI or RUM this Fall. Keep A SER and A BUD out of BUL and CON, and let us watch Italy's F GRE and F CON together. Turkey will hold ANK and BUL and will not move on SER or BUD.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1947: We confirm our A BUL and F BLA will not enter RUM or SEV this Fall. Please keep F SEV and A RUM out of BLA, BUL and CON as you pledged. Once CON is settled, Turkey is open to a written convoy line through BLA and a non-aggression pact on the Black Sea.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1947: Turkey accepts your position in principle. If F CON withdraws to AEG, Turkey will not enter CON, GRE or AEG this Fall, and our A BUL stays out of GRE. Keep F GRE and all Italian units out of BUL and BLA. Please confirm in writing before orders are final.

notes.note: Fall 1947: all four hold per renewed Fall truce. Germany, Italy and Turkey confirmed in writing no entry to SER/BUD/TRI/VIE. Germany's A BOH must stay out of VIE. Watch German BOH/MUN, Russian WAR/RUM, and Italian F GRE/F CON. Revisit Spring 1948 for any move against Turkey or Italy.

Fall 1947: all hold per pledges. Austria truce renewed (BOH holds, no entry to VIE/BUD/TRI/SER). Pledges to England (no HOL/BEL/NTH), France (no BUR/PIC/Rhine/BEL), Russia (no GAL/WAR/RUM/SEV/SWE). Watch Austria VIE; reassess Spring 1948 and consider MUN/BOH moves if pledges lapse.

Fall 1947: all holds, keeping pledges to England (PIC out of BEL/HOL, fleets out of ENG/Channel/MAO), Italy (no WES/TUN) and Germany (no BUR/PIC/Rhine). Only gains are BEL or TUN, both blocked by pledges. England and Germany confirmed holds. Reassess if England vacates BEL or Italy breaks pledges.

Fall 1947: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). Germany says Austria truce, no GAL/WAR/RUM/SEV/SWE entry; Turkey and Italy keep BUL/BLA/CON terms. Watch German A BOH/MUN toward WAR/RUM. Reassess Spring 1948; SEV->BLA convoy only if CON vacated.

Fall 1947: F GRE attacks BUL/SOUTH with F CON supporting to dislodge Turkish A BUL. NAP, ROM, VEN hold per Austria/France/Germany pledges. Turkey offered CON withdrawal but I declined; still hostile. Russia kept pledges. Next: if BUL taken, hold it and reinforce; keep TUN defended.

Fall 1947: holding all units. England has 7 centers; BEL and MUN-type empty centers give no growth now. Pledges: France keeps PIC out of BEL/HOL and fleets out of ENG/Channel/NTH, kept so far. Germany keeps BER/DEN/KIE out of HOL/BEL/NTH, kept so far. Russia kept Baltic pledge. Next: look for a legal gain, e.g. attack DEN/KIE if Germany weakens, or move F NTH to HEL to set up HOL convoy.

Fall 1947: Attacking Italian F CON with F BLA, supported by A BUL staying in BUL, for a 2-vs-1 attack if CON is left undefended. Our A BUL and F BLA stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI, RUM and SEV, as pledged to Austria and Russia. Italy has refused to withdraw CON and threatens BUL. Russia pledged F SEV and A RUM stay out of BLA, BUL and CON. Austria's border pact holds. Watch Italian F GRE moving in

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1948. Our pledges stand: no Austrian unit enters GRE, BUL or CON. Are your F GRE, F CON, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN still staying out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE this spring? Tell me your Spring orders in writing so we can both trust the Adriatic and Balkan lines.

Austria here. Our A SER and A BUD will keep out of BUL and CON this spring. Are your A BUL and F BLA holding to the pact, staying out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM? Tell me your Spring 1948 orders in writing, and whether Italy's F GRE or F CON is your target.

Austria here, Spring 1948. The Fall 1947 truce still stands: no German unit enters VIE, BUD, TRI or SER, and Austria stays out of BOH and MUN. Please confirm in writing that your A BOH holds in BOH and that you will give notice before any change. Austria will answer in kind.

England to Germany, Spring 1948: Please confirm A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring, with no German move into HOL, BEL or NTH. My F NTH, F LON and F LVP stay out of DEN and KIE while you keep that pledge. Tell me your plans for BOH and MUN.

England to France, Spring 1948: Please confirm A PIC stays out of BEL and HOL, and your fleets stay out of ENG, the Channel and NTH. My A HOL holds BEL this spring. Any French move into BEL will be opposed, so give me notice before any change in the Low Countries.

England to Russia, Spring 1948: Please confirm F SWE and A WAR stay out of NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI and DEN this spring. My F STP/NORTH and F LVP stay out of the Baltic and the NOR-to-SWE routes. Warn me before any change in Scandinavia.

France to England, Spring 1948: Are A HOL and BEL still holding this spring? I am keeping A PIC out of BEL and HOL and my fleets out of ENG, the Channel and NTH. If you plan to vacate Belgium, please give me notice first, as agreed.

France to Germany, Spring 1948: Please confirm A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A BOH stay out of BUR, PIC, the Rhine and BEL this spring. If England vacates the Low Countries, let's agree a split before either of us moves.

France to Italy, Spring 1948: Our western Mediterranean pledges still hold: F MAO and A MAR stay off WES and TUN. Please keep F ION, F SMY and A NAP out of WES, Spain and Portugal, and tell me first about any change near Tunisia.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1948: As promised, I give notice that the truce ends this spring. A BOH will move to VIE. Withdraw A VIE to GAL or TYR and I will not attack it. Otherwise expect a fight. Tell me your Spring orders for VIE and BUD.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1948: Austria is weak, and I am moving A BOH against VIE this spring. I propose you take BUD or GAL with A RUM and A WAR, while I take VIE and TRI in later turns. Confirm your Spring orders so we avoid collisions. My A BER, A DEN and A KIE stay home.

Germany to England, Spring 1948: A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring, and none of them enters HOL, BEL or NTH. A BOH is moving south against Austria, not toward you. Please keep F NTH, F LON and F LVP out of DEN and KIE as before.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1948: Your A BUL is still cut off. Withdraw it to Serbia or Rumania this spring, or F GRE and F CON will attack Bulgaria. Italy will not enter BLA or ANK. If F BLA moves on CON, that is war. Confirm in writing.

Italy to Russia, Spring 1948: Please confirm F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold this spring and stay out of BUL, BLA, GRE and the Aegean. Italy's F CON, F GRE and A VEN will not enter RUM, UKR or SEV. I will warn you before any unit nears BLA.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1948: Italy confirms F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this spring, and A VEN stays out of TRI. Our action is only against Turkey in Bulgaria. Please keep A SER and A BUD out of GRE and BUL.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1948: Your A BOH and A MUN still sit next to our WAR and RUM. Tell me your Spring 1948 orders for A BOH, A MUN, A BER, A DEN and A KIE in writing. Russia will not enter BOH or MUN this spring. Let us talk about a joint move against Austria's VIE or BUD this year, if you are free of your truce.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1948: Italy holds CON with strength and is the main threat to both of us. Russia keeps F SEV and A RUM out of BLA, BUL and CON this spring. Tell me whether you will push on CON or GRE this year. A written plan against Italy would suit both of us once you name your Spring orders for F BLA and A BUL.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1948: We are down to two centres and need a lasting peace. Proposal: our F BLA and A BUL will not enter CON, GRE or AEG this Spring, and F CON and F GRE stay out of BUL and BLA. Please answer in writing before orders are final.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1948: Please confirm in writing that F SEV and A RUM stay out of BLA, BUL and CON this Spring. Turkey will keep F BLA and A BUL out of RUM, SEV and WAR, and proposes a written Black Sea non-aggression pact now.

Austria refuses to withdraw. A VIE holds this spring with A BUD supporting, and TRI and SER hold. Any German unit entering VIE, BUD, TRI or SER will meet full resistance. Your A BOH should return to MUN or BER, and Austria will stay out of MUN and BOH. Our armies can face Russia later, but not while you attack our centres.

Austria confirms: A SER and A BUD hold and will not enter GRE, BUL or CON. You have not mentioned F CON in your Spring orders. Please confirm in writing that F CON, F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE, and that A VEN stays out of TRI. Austria will judge your moves by what they do.

England to France, Spring 1948: Confirmed. A HOL holds BEL this spring, and F NTH, F LON and F LVP hold too. We make no move into PIC, BRE, MAR, POR or MAO. Please keep A PIC holding and out of BEL and HOL, and keep your fleets out of ENG, the Channel and NTH. Any French entry into BEL will be opposed, and I will give you notice before any change in the Low Countries.

England to Germany, Spring 1948: Noted. I expect A BER, A DEN and A KIE to hold this spring with no move into HOL, BEL or NTH. My F NTH, F LON and F LVP will stay out of DEN and KIE while you keep that pledge. A BOH moving south against Austria is your business, so keep your northern units home. Any German move toward HOL or the North Sea will be opposed.

France to England, Spring 1948: Confirmed. A PIC holds this spring and will not enter BEL or HOL. F MAO stays out of ENG, the Channel and NTH. A BRE, A MAR and A POR also hold. Please keep A HOL and your fleets out of PIC, BRE, MAR, POR and MAO, and give me notice before any change in the Low Countries.

Germany to England, Spring 1948: A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold, and none enters HOL, BEL or NTH. A BOH is moving south against VIE, not toward you. Keep F NTH, F LON and F LVP out of DEN and KIE and we stay quiet in the north.

Germany to France, Spring 1948: A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring, with no German move into BUR, PIC, the Rhine, BEL or HOL. A BOH goes south to VIE, not west. I will tell you before any change in the west, and we can talk about the Low Countries later.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1948: The truce ends as I warned. A BOH moves to VIE. Withdraw A VIE to GAL or TYR and I will not attack it. Otherwise expect a fight. Tell me your Spring orders for VIE and BUD.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1948: A BOH moves to VIE this spring. A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold. No German unit enters GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV or SWE. Please take BUD or GAL with A RUM and A WAR, and confirm your Spring orders so we avoid collisions.

Italy confirms: A NAP holds this spring and no Italian unit moves toward WES, TUN, Spain or Portugal. Tunis is Italian and will be defended, so keep F MAO and A MAR off WES, TUN and Italian soil. We will tell you first about any change in the western Mediterranean.

Italy confirms for Spring 1948: F GRE, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE, and A VEN stays out of TRI. F CON's operations are against Turkey in Bulgaria only. Please keep A SER and A BUD out of GRE and BUL as pledged.

Declined. Your A BUL is cut off and must withdraw to Serbia or Rumania this spring, or F GRE and F CON will attack Bulgaria. F CON stays in Constantinople. Italy treats any F BLA move on CON as war. Withdrawal is your only way to keep BUL.

Russia confirms: F SWE and A WAR hold this spring, and neither enters NWG, NOR, NTH, EDI, DEN or SIL. Please keep F STP/NORTH and F LVP out of the Baltic as agreed. I will warn you before any change in Scandinavia.

Russia confirms: F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold this spring and none enters BUL, BLA, GRE or the Aegean. Please keep F CON, F GRE and A VEN out of RUM, UKR and SEV. Tell me before any Italian unit nears BLA.

Russia will keep F SEV and A RUM out of BLA, BUL and CON this spring. A Black Sea non-aggression pact is worth discussing, but I need your F BLA and A BUL to stay out of RUM, SEV and WAR in writing first. Name your spring orders.

Russia's answer is not yet. Your A BOH and A MUN sit beside our WAR and RUM, so show me your spring orders in writing. No German unit may enter GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV or SWE. We can revisit Austria once your truce is clear.

Turkey accepts your position in writing for Spring 1948. Our F BLA and A BUL will not enter CON, GRE or AEG this spring. Please confirm F CON and F GRE stay out of BUL and BLA, and that no Italian unit moves into ANK or BLA. If you agree, Turkey will hold and we can talk again in Fall.

Turkey confirms in writing: our A BUL and F BLA will not enter SER, BUD, VIE, TRI or RUM this spring, and we hold our current positions. Your A SER and A BUD must stay out of BUL and CON. Turkey is focused on rebuilding after Italy's pressure. Sign and hold, and we will respect the Serbian border pact.

Turkey agrees to a written Black Sea non-aggression pact. Our F BLA and A BUL will not enter RUM, SEV or WAR this spring. Please confirm F SEV and A RUM stay out of BLA, BUL and CON. Once that is signed, we can discuss a convoy line through BLA if CON is ever vacated.

notes.note: Spring 1948: Germany's A BOH moves to VIE and the truce is broken. VIE holds with BUD supporting, SER and TRI hold. Italy and Turkey have pledged no entry to SER/BUD/TRI/VIE; Turkey confirmed in writing. Watch German BOH and any Russian move toward GAL/WAR. Retake the initiative once VIE is safe.

Spring 1948: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). Pledges kept by Italy, Turkey, England, Germany so far; German A BOH moving to VIE. No safe unowned centers. Watch German BOH/MUN toward WAR/RUM. Reassess Fall 1948.

Spring 1948: all holds, keeping pledges to England (PIC out of BEL/HOL, fleets out of ENG/Channel/NTH/MAO), Italy (no WES/TUN) and Germany (no BUR/PIC/Rhine). No unowned SCs. Reassess if England vacates BEL; consider MAO to ENG convoy setup then.

Spring 1948: F GRE attacks BUL/SOUTH with F CON supporting to take Turkish-held BUL. NAP, ROM, VEN hold per Austria/France/Germany pledges. Austria, Russia kept pledges. Turkey repeatedly broke withdrawal demands; it now proposes a hold. Next: if BUL taken, hold it and reinforce; keep TUN defended.

Spring 1948: all units hold. Germany, France and Russia confirmed pledges (no HOL/BEL/NTH entry by Germany, PIC out of BEL/HOL, SWE/WAR out of northern seas). Watch BEL and DEN. Convoy HOL->DEN needs F NTH at HEL first; not yet.

Spring 1948: BOH attacks VIE as announced to Austria (expect bounce, no support available). BER, DEN, KIE hold per pledges to England (no HOL/BEL/NTH) and France (no BUR/PIC/Rhine/BEL). Russia wants no German entry to GAL/WAR/RUM/SEV/SWE; asked me to take BUD/GAL, but I cannot reach them this turn. Watch Austria's VIE and Russia's Fall moves.

Spring 1948: holding BLA and BUL to keep ANK and BUL, honoring pacts with Italy, Russia and Austria (no CON/GRE/AEG, RUM/SEV/WAR, SER/BUD). Italy refuses to withdraw CON and threatens BUL. Russia and Austria say they are keeping their pledges. Watch Italian F GRE into BUL and any move into ANK or BLA.

messages.body: Austria here, Fall 1948. Your A BOH bounced on VIE last spring and the truce is void. Withdraw A BOH to MUN or BOH and hold, and Austria will not enter BOH or MUN this Fall. If you attack VIE again, A VIE and A BUD will hold and resist fully. Confirm your Fall orders for BOH and BER in writing.
