Austria here, Fall 1948. Your Turkish fight in Bulgaria does not concern us. Confirm in writing that F CON, F BUL/SOUTH, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this Fall. Austria will not enter GRE, BUL or CON. Tell me your Fall orders so we can both trust the Balkan line.

Austria here, Fall 1948. Germany's A BOH threatens our VIE, and I want to know whether your A WAR or A RUM plan to move toward GAL or BUD. Confirm in writing that neither will enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI this Fall, and tell me your Fall orders.

England to Germany, Fall 1948: Please confirm A BER, A DEN, A KIE hold this autumn with no move into HOL, BEL or NTH. I will keep F NTH, F LON and F LVP out of DEN and KIE while you do. If you plan any move north or west, tell me first.

England to France, Fall 1948: Confirm A PIC stays out of BEL and HOL, and your fleets stay out of ENG, the Channel and NTH. A HOL holds BEL this autumn. Any French move into BEL will be opposed, so give me notice before any change in the Low Countries.

England here. A HOL holds BEL this autumn and I am not releasing it. Our standing terms stand: A PIC stays out of BEL and HOL, and your fleets stay out of ENG, the Channel and NTH. Any entry into BEL will be opposed. If your moves keep to those terms, I will tell you before any change in the Low Countries.

France to England, Fall 1949: A PIC holds this autumn and will not enter BEL or HOL. My fleets stay out of ENG, the Channel and NTH, and F MAO holds. I cannot promise my plans beyond this autumn. If your A HOL leaves Belgium, I expect notice first, as agreed. Please keep your fleets out of PIC, BRE, MAR, POR and MAO.

Germany to England, Fall 1949: A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this autumn, with no German move into HOL, BEL or NTH. A BOH attacks VIE only. I keep my pledge while your F NTH, F LON and F LVP stay out of DEN and KIE. I will tell you before any change in the north or west.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1949: A BOH moves into VIE this autumn and I will not withdraw it. If A VIE retreats to GAL or TYR, A BOH holds in BOH and I will not enter VIE, sparing BUD and SER. Otherwise expect a full attack on VIE and BUD.

Germany to France, Fall 1949: A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this autumn, and none enters BUR, PIC, the Rhine, BEL or HOL. A BOH attacks VIE, not west. I still cannot commit to a Low Countries split while England holds HOL and BEL. If that changes, we will talk before anyone moves.

Germany to Italy, Fall 1949: Thank you. I have no units aimed at TRI, SER or your Adriatic. My Fall orders are A BOH to VIE, with BER, DEN and KIE holding at home. I will keep my fleets out of the Tyrrhenian and Ionian, and I ask that you keep your units out of the north of Austria.

Italy confirms for Fall 1949: F BUL/SOUTH, F CON, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE this autumn, and A VEN stays out of TRI. Our Adriatic and Balkan units hold. Please keep A SER and A BUD out of GRE, BUL and CON as you pledged. Italy is watching Germany on Vienna and will tell you if that changes.

Italy confirms: F BUL/SOUTH and F CON hold this Fall and will not enter RUM, UKR, SEV or BLA. No Italian unit moves toward the Black Sea. Please keep F SEV, A RUM and A WAR holding and out of BUL, BLA, GRE and the Aegean. If either side plans a move near the Black Sea, we will warn each other first.

Russia confirms in writing: A WAR and A RUM hold this Fall and will not enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Our other units stay home as well. Germany's A BOH is the threat to VIE, so keep VIE and BUD held and supported. I will tell you at once if any German unit moves toward GAL or WAR.

Russia will not join a strike on Austria. A WAR, A RUM, F SEV and F SWE hold this Fall. Your A BOH attacking VIE is your own affair. Your pledge not to enter GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV or SWE must be kept, and any German unit near them will be treated as hostile. Keep A BER, A DEN and A KIE home.

Russia declines the move of A RUM to BUL this Fall. It would leave our northern flank open. F SEV and A RUM hold. We stay out of BLA, BUL and CON as pledged. Keep F BLA and A BUL out of RUM, SEV and WAR. If Italy's F SOUTH leaves BUL, we can discuss a written plan for BUL and CON next year.

Turkey confirms in writing: F BLA holds this Fall and will not enter CON, BUL, GRE or AEG. We ask that no Italian unit enters BLA or ANK, and that F CON stays out of BLA. Please confirm this in writing before orders are final, so the Black Sea stays quiet.

Turkey agrees to your plan for BUL. A RUM moves to BUL, F BLA supports it from the Black Sea, and F SEV holds. Turkey will not enter RUM, SEV or WAR, and will take CON only after Italy vacates it. Please confirm in writing before orders are final.

notes.note: Fall 1949: BUD supports VIE holding against German A BOH. VIE, SER, TRI hold. Italy kept Balkan/Adriatic pledges so far. Germany keeps attacking VIE. Russia pledged WAR/RUM stay out of GAL/BUD/SER/VIE/TRI. Keep BUD and VIE defended; no entry to GRE/BUL/CON.

Fall 1949: all units hold to honour pacts with Austria, France, Russia, Germany, Turkey. No unowned centres in reach. Watch Turkish F BLA vs CON; Turkey has pledged repeatedly. Keep TUN defended. Next: reassess if Turkey breaks word or unowned centres appear.

Fall 1949: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). Pledges kept with Italy, Turkey, Austria, Germany; no entry to GAL/BUD/SER/VIE/TRI, BUL/BLA/CON, NWG/NOR/NTH/EDI/DEN/SIL. Declined Turkey's RUM->BUL plan. Watch German BOH/MUN toward WAR/GAL. Reassess Spring 1950 for unowned centers.

Fall 1949: all holds. No unowned SCs; BEL needs England's HOL to leave, and pledges to England, Italy and Germany block other gains. England promised notice before any Low Countries change. Reassess if HOL vacates BEL or Germany splits.

Fall 1949: BOH attacks VIE as announced (expect bounce, no support). BER, DEN, KIE hold per pledges to England (no HOL/BEL/NTH), France (no BUR/PIC/Rhine/BEL), Russia (no GAL/WAR/RUM/SEV/SWE). Italy: no Tyrrhenian/Ionian entry. Austria refuses withdrawal. Reassess Spring 1950: VIE may fall if Austria weakens; watch Russia and England's north.

Fall 1949: F BLA holds per written pledges to Italy and Russia (no CON, BUL, GRE, AEG, RUM, SEV, WAR). Russia declined A RUM to BUL, so no joint BUL/CON push. Italy pledged no entry into BLA or ANK; watch for it. Turkey has 1 centre (ANK). Revisit CON only if Italy vacates it, with Russian support.

Fall 1949: held all units. Germany, France pledges kept so far (no HOL/BEL/NTH entry, PIC out of BEL/HOL, fleets out of ENG/Channel/NTH). Russia kept Baltic pledge. No unowned centers; DEN attack bounces with German units home, so no convoy to DEN now. Watch Germany's KIE/BER/DEN and French moves; revisit growth if Germany weakens.

messages.body: Austria asks again: withdraw A BOH to MUN or BER this spring. We will not enter BOH or MUN. Your attacks on VIE have bounced and cost you units. Germany gains more by facing Russia and Italy than by a losing fight for Vienna. Please answer in writing with your Spring orders.

Austria here. We have held SER, BUD, TRI and VIE and kept A SER and A BUD out of GRE, BUL and CON. Please confirm your F CON, F BUL/SOUTH, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN stay out of those four this spring. Tell me your Spring orders in writing, and whether you plan any move toward Turkey.

Austria asks for written confirmation that A WAR and A RUM will not enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI this spring. Germany's A BOH is the shared threat. If Germany moves toward GAL or WAR, let us coordinate. Please share your Spring orders.

England to France, Spring 1950: Please confirm A PIC stays out of BEL and HOL, and your fleets stay out of ENG, the Channel and NTH. A HOL holds BEL this spring. Italy is now our largest rival at 8 centres, so I propose we both watch its Balkan and Mediterranean growth and talk before either of us moves against it.

England to Germany, Spring 1950: Please confirm A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring with no move into HOL, BEL or NTH. My F NTH, F LON and F LVP stay out of DEN and KIE while your pledge holds. Tell me now if BOH or MUN plans change, since any northern move would be opposed.

France here, Spring 1950. Are A HOL and your fleets staying put this spring? I still need a path to growth. If A HOL leaves Belgium, I want notice first and a clear split of BEL and HOL. My fleets stay out of ENG, the Channel and NTH while our terms hold.

France to Germany, Spring 1950: Will A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A BOH keep out of BUR, PIC, the Rhine, BEL and HOL this spring? My A PIC stays out of your area. If England vacates the Low Countries, I propose we agree a split before either of us moves.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1950: A BOH is attacking VIE again and Austria's BUD and GAL are open to us both. I confirm again that no German unit enters GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV or SWE. Please tell me your Spring orders for A RUM and A WAR so we avoid collisions and any shared gains are clear.

Germany to Italy, Spring 1950: I still have no units aimed at TRI, SER or your Adriatic positions, and I keep my fleets out of the Tyrrhenian and Ionian. Please confirm A VEN and A ROM stay out of TRI and SER this spring, and tell me your Spring orders.

Italy confirms its pledges: NAP, ROM, VEN, BUL/SOUTH and CON stay out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE this spring. With Germany pressing Vienna, what are your Spring 1950 orders? If Vienna falls, Italy and Austria should coordinate on TRI and SER so Germany cannot take the Adriatic. Please reply in writing.

Italy confirms in writing: F BUL/SOUTH and F CON hold this spring, and no Italian unit enters BLA or ANK. Turkey's F BLA must hold or stay out of CON, BUL, GRE and AEG. Please confirm that in writing before orders are final, and keep your units out of Bulgaria and Greece.

Italy has no units aimed at your Vienna attack. Please confirm A BOH moving to VIE will not threaten TRI or SER, and that your fleets stay out of the Tyrrhenian and Ionian. Tell me your Spring 1950 orders for BER, DEN and KIE so we both know where we stand.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1950: Your A BOH and A MUN sit beside our WAR and RUM. Confirm in writing that no German unit enters GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV or SWE this spring. Russia holds WAR, RUM, SEV, SWE and MOS and will not enter BOH, MUN, VIE or BUD. Please send your Spring orders first.

Russia to Italy, Spring 1950: You lead the board, so I want clarity. Confirm F CON, F BUL/SOUTH and A VEN will not enter RUM, UKR, SEV or BLA this spring. Russia holds MOS, RUM, SEV, SWE and WAR and will not enter BUL, BLA, CON or GRE. Please send your Spring orders.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1950: Turkey's F BLA holds this spring and will not enter CON, BUL, GRE or AEG. Please confirm in writing that no Italian unit enters BLA or ANK, and that F CON stays out of BLA. If F CON or F SOUTH leaves its province, we can discuss the Black Sea arrangement again.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1950: Our F BLA holds this spring and stays out of RUM, SEV and WAR. If Italy's F SOUTH leaves BUL or F CON leaves CON, Turkey wants to take CON and Russia can take BUL. Please confirm in writing that your forces will not enter BLA, CON or ANK this spring.

Austria here, Spring 1950. Our orders: A SER, A BUD, F TRI and A VIE hold, with no move into GRE, BUL or CON. We will not attack Turkey. Italy's F CON, F BUL/SOUTH, A NAP, A ROM and A VEN must stay out of SER, BUD, TRI and VIE, and A VEN stays out of TRI. Germany is attacking VIE; if you want Adriatic coordination on TRI and SER, put it in writing and show it by your moves.

England to France, Spring 1950: Confirmed. A HOL holds BEL this spring, and my fleets stay out of ENG, the Channel and NTH. Please keep A PIC out of BEL and HOL, and keep F MAO out of the Channel. I have no plans to release Belgium now. Italy's growth is the real threat to both of us, so let's coordinate against it rather than against each other.

France to England, Spring 1950: Confirmed. A PIC holds this spring and will not enter BEL or HOL. My fleets, including F MAO, hold and stay out of ENG, the Channel and NTH. I agree Italy's growth is a concern and we should talk before either of us moves against it. I cannot promise beyond this spring, but I will give you notice before any change in the Low Countries.

Germany here, Spring 1950. Austria's refusal stands. A BOH attacks VIE this spring. If A VIE retreats to GAL or TYR, A BOH holds in BOH and I will not enter VIE, sparing BUD, SER and TRI. Otherwise expect a full attack on VIE and BUD.

Germany here, Spring 1950. Confirmed. A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring, with no move into HOL, BEL or NTH. A BOH attacks VIE only and does not enter MUN. Keep F NTH, F LON and F LVP out of DEN and KIE and we stay at peace in the north.

Germany here, Spring 1950. A BER, A DEN, A KIE hold and none enters BUR, PIC, the Rhine, BEL or HOL. A BOH attacks VIE, not west. I still cannot commit to a Low Countries split while England holds HOL and BEL. If that changes, we talk before anyone moves.

Germany here, Spring 1950. A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this spring. A BOH attacks VIE, not your Adriatic. My fleets stay out of the Tyrrhenian and Ionian. Please confirm A VEN and A ROM stay out of TRI and SER, and tell me your Spring orders.

Germany here, Spring 1950. I confirm again that no German unit enters GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV or SWE. A BOH attacks VIE, and BUD and GAL are open to us both. Please send your Spring orders for A RUM and A WAR so we avoid collisions and share the gains.

Italy confirms for Spring 1950: F CON, F BUL/SOUTH and A VEN will not enter RUM, UKR, SEV or BLA. Italy will not enter BUL-adjacent Russian areas or GRE. Keep F SEV, A RUM and A WAR holding and out of BUL, BLA, GRE and the Aegean. We will warn each other before any Black Sea move.

Italy confirms: A VEN and A ROM hold this spring and will not enter TRI or SER. A BOH to VIE does not threaten Italy. Keep your fleets out of the Tyrrhenian and Ionian. Italy's Spring 1950 orders are hold or Balkan moves only, and we will tell you before anything changes.

Italy confirms for Spring 1950: NAP, ROM, VEN, BUL/SOUTH and CON will not enter SER, BUD, TRI or VIE. Our Spring orders are holds in the Adriatic and Balkans. Keep A SER and A BUD out of GRE, BUL and CON. If Vienna falls, we can discuss TRI and SER, but nothing is settled yet.

Italy confirms in writing: no Italian unit enters BLA or ANK this spring. F BUL/SOUTH and F CON hold this spring. Your F BLA must hold or move away from CON, BUL, GRE and the Aegean, and F CON must stay out of BLA. Keep your units out of Bulgaria and Greece, and we can talk again next season.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1950: We will not join a strike on Austria. Russia holds A WAR, A RUM, F SEV, F SWE and A MOS this spring and will not enter BOH, MUN, VIE or BUD. Your A BOH and A MUN are beside our WAR and RUM. Any German unit entering GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV or SWE will be treated as hostile. Keep A BER, A DEN and A KIE home.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1950, written confirmation: A WAR and A RUM hold this spring. Neither enters GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Our full orders are A MOS, A WAR, A RUM, F SEV and F SWE all holding. Germany's A BOH is the shared threat to VIE, and we will not help it. I will warn you at once if German units move toward GAL or WAR.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1950: Confirmed in writing. Our F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold this spring and will not enter BLA, BUL, CON or ANK. Please keep F BLA out of RUM, SEV and WAR as agreed. We will discuss BUL and CON again only if Italy's F SOUTH or F CON actually vacates its square, and then only in writing before orders are final.

Turkey confirms: F BLA holds this Spring and will not enter CON, BUL, GRE, SMY or AEG. In return, we ask that no Italian unit enters BLA or ANK, and that F CON stays out of BLA. Turkey holds ANK only, so a quiet Black Sea suits both of us. Please confirm in writing before orders are final.

notes.note: Spring 1950: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). Pledges kept with all powers; no entry into GAL/BUD/SER/VIE/TRI, BOH/MUN, BUL/BLA/CON/ANK. Watch German BOH/MUN toward WAR/GAL/RUM. Turkey wants CON/BUL; declined unless Italy vacates in writing. Reassess Fall 1950.

Spring 1950: VIE held, BUD supports VIE holding vs German A BOH. SER and TRI hold. No moves toward GRE/BUL/CON. Italy and Russia pledges kept so far; Germany still attacking VIE. Next: retake initiative once VIE safe; watch BOH/MUN and Russian WAR/RUM toward GAL.

Spring 1950: all Italian units hold, keeping pledges to Austria, Germany, Russia, Turkey. No unowned centres in reach. Watch Turkish F BLA vs CON and Germany on VIE. Reconsider ANK strike only if Turkey breaks its word. Keep TUN defended.

Spring 1950: all holds. Pledges to England (PIC out of BEL/HOL, fleets out of ENG/Channel/NTH), Italy (no WES/TUN), Germany (no BUR/PIC/Rhine) kept. No unowned SCs. England still holds BEL; reassess if HOL vacates BEL.

Spring 1950: BER, DEN, KIE hold per pledges to England (no HOL/BEL/NTH), France (no BUR/PIC/Rhine/BEL), Russia (no GAL/WAR/RUM/SEV/SWE). BOH attacks VIE as announced to Austria (expect bounce). Austria has refused withdrawal. Watch Russia and Italy; reassess Fall 1950 and the VIE attack.

Spring 1950: F BLA moves to ANK, my only centre, which is empty. This keeps pledges to Italy and Russia (no CON/BUL/GRE/AEG, RUM/SEV/WAR). Italy has pledged no entry into BLA/ANK. Watch Italian F CON and F SOUTH; if either vacates, revisit CON with Russia.

Spring 1950: F NTH to HEL sets up convoy of A HOL to DEN next turn, if DEN is weak. Others hold. Pledges: France kept PIC out of BEL/HOL and fleets out of ENG/Channel/NTH. Germany kept BER/DEN/KIE out of HOL/BEL/NTH. Russia kept Baltic pledge. Watch NOR now that NTH leaves it open; Russian SWE pledged to stay out. Italy is the main rival; coordinate with France.

messages.body: Austria here, Fall 1950. Your A BOH has attacked VIE for three seasons and both our centres are losing. Both of us are on 4 centres while Italy leads with 8. Withdraw A BOH to MUN or BER and Austria will not enter BOH or MUN. Let us end this and face the real leader together.

Austria here, Fall 1950. Germany's A BOH still threatens VIE. Please confirm in writing that A WAR and A RUM stay out of GAL, BUD, SER, VIE and TRI. If German units move toward GAL or WAR, I will tell you at once. Share your Fall orders so we can coordinate.

Austria here, Fall 1950. Italy is far ahead with 8 centres and is the danger to us both. I will keep A SER and A BUD out of BUL and CON. Please confirm your A BUL and F BLA stay out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. If Italy's F CON or F GRE moves against you, let us discuss pressure on Italy together.

England to France, Fall 1950: Our pledges have held. I propose we coordinate against Italy. If Italian fleets move west toward MAR or TUN, we both respond. Please confirm A PIC stays out of BEL and HOL, and F MAO stays out of ENG, the Channel and NTH this autumn.

England to Germany, Fall 1950: Please confirm A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this autumn, with no move into HOL, BEL or NTH. My F NTH, F LON and F LVP stay out of DEN and KIE while your pledge holds. Tell me now if BOH or MUN plans change.

England to Italy, Fall 1950: You are now our largest rival at 8 centres. Please tell me your plans for TUN, GRE and the Balkans this autumn, and whether any Italian fleet heads west toward MAR or the Tyrrhenian. My fleets stay in the North Sea and Channel.

France to Italy, Fall 1950: Our western Mediterranean pledges still matter. Please confirm A NAP, F ION and F SMY stay out of WES, Spain and Portugal this autumn, and tell me first before any move near Tunis. I am keeping F MAO and A MAR off WES and TUN.

France to England, Fall 1950: My PIC stays out of BEL and HOL, and my fleets stay out of ENG, the Channel and NTH. Is A HOL staying in Belgium this autumn? If it leaves, I want notice first and a clear split of BEL. Let's agree how to handle Italy's growth together.

France to Germany, Fall 1950: Will A BER, A DEN, A KIE and A BOH keep out of BUR, PIC, the Rhine, BEL and HOL this autumn? If England's HOL ever vacates Belgium, I propose we agree a split before anyone moves. Please confirm.

Germany, Fall 1950: A BOH attacks VIE this autumn and I will not withdraw it. If A VIE retreats to GAL or TYR, A BOH holds in BOH and I will not enter VIE, sparing BUD and TRI. Otherwise expect a full attack on VIE and BUD. Please answer in writing with your orders.

Germany to England, Fall 1950: A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this autumn, with no German move into HOL, BEL or NTH. A BOH attacks VIE only. Keep F NTH, F LON and F LVP out of DEN and KIE and we stay at peace in the north.

Italy asks Germany to confirm in writing that A BOH taking VIE will not be followed by any move into TRI, SER or the Adriatic. Italy will keep A VEN and A ROM holding this Fall and will not enter TRI or SER. Please keep your fleets out of the Tyrrhenian and Ionian.

Italy confirms F CON, F BUL/SOUTH and A VEN stay out of RUM, UKR, SEV and BLA this Fall. Please confirm F SEV, A RUM and A WAR hold and stay out of BUL, GRE and the Aegean. Tell me first if Russia plans any move south or west toward Austria or Germany.

Italy confirms no Italian unit enters BLA or ANK this Fall. F CON stays put and will not enter BLA. Turkey's F BLA must hold or stay out of CON, BUL, GRE and the Aegean. Italy will warn you before any change.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1950: this is our last autumn, so let's strike Italy together. My A RUM attacks BUL and F SEV moves to BLA to support it. Please move F ANK to CON now, since Italy's F CON may be weakened. Confirm in writing before orders lock.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1950: Our F ANK holds this Fall and cannot reach BUL or CON. If Italy vacates BUL or CON, Russia takes BUL and Turkey takes CON via BLA. Will your A RUM or F SEV move into BUL or BLA this Fall? Please answer in writing before orders are final.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1950: Your pledges have kept the Black Sea quiet. Please confirm in writing whether F CON and F SOUTH hold this Fall. If either leaves, Turkey will not contest CON or BUL before Russia has a say. Keep ANK and BLA free of Italian units.

Austria's answer is unchanged: A VIE holds with A BUD supporting, and TRI and SER hold. Your A BOH has attacked VIE for three seasons. Withdraw A BOH to MUN or BER this Fall and Austria will not enter BOH or MUN. Otherwise every attack on VIE and BUD meets full resistance and both our centres bleed. Germany is also falling behind Italy, so the choice is yours.

England here, Fall 1950. A HOL holds BEL this autumn and will not leave. Your PIC stays out of BEL and HOL, and my fleets stay out of ENG, the Channel and NTH, as agreed. I agree Italy is the danger. If Italian fleets move west toward MAR or TUN, we respond together. Please keep F MAO out of the Channel too.

England here, Fall 1950. Confirmed: my A HOL holds BEL, and my F NTH, F LON and F LVP stay out of DEN and KIE while your A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold with no move into HOL, BEL or NTH. Any German northern move will be opposed. Tell me before BOH or MUN changes.

France here. Confirmed for Fall 1950: A PIC holds and stays out of BEL and HOL, and my fleets, including F MAO, stay out of ENG, the Channel and NTH. A HOL staying in Belgium this autumn is your decision; I will not move into BEL. If A HOL does leave, I expect notice first. Italy's growth matters to us both, so let us keep talking before either of us moves against it.

Germany to Italy, Fall 1950: I confirm no German unit enters TRI, SER or the Adriatic this autumn. A BOH attacks VIE only. My units have no fleets near the Tyrrhenian or Ionian, so they stay clear. Please keep A VEN and A ROM holding as you have promised.

Germany to England, Fall 1950: Confirmed. A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this autumn, with no German move into HOL, BEL or NTH. A BOH attacks VIE only. Keep F NTH, F LON and F LVP out of DEN and KIE, and we remain at peace in the north.

Germany to France, Fall 1950: A BER, A DEN and A KIE hold this autumn, and none enters BUR, PIC, the Rhine, BEL or HOL. A BOH attacks VIE, not the west. I still cannot commit to a Low Countries split while England holds HOL and BEL. We will talk if that changes.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1950: Austria's refusal stands. A BOH attacks VIE this autumn. If A VIE retreats to GAL or TYR, A BOH holds in BOH and I will not enter VIE, sparing BUD and TRI. Otherwise expect a full attack on VIE and BUD. Your choice decides this.

Italy to England, Fall 1950: My fleets stay in the Mediterranean. No Italian fleet heads west toward MAR, the Tyrrhenian or the Western Med this autumn. Our moves are in the Balkans, where F BUL/SOUTH and F CON hold. TUN stays defended. Keep your North Sea and Channel fleets where they are and we will have no quarrel.

Italy to France, Fall 1950: Confirmed. Italy has no F ION or F SMY now, and A NAP holds this autumn. No Italian unit moves toward WES, TUN, Spain or Portugal. TUN is Italian and will be defended. Keep F MAO and A MAR off WES, TUN and Italian soil, and tell me first about any western Mediterranean change.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1950: Italy confirms F CON and F BUL/SOUTH hold this Fall. No Italian unit enters BLA or ANK. F CON will not enter BLA. Please confirm in writing that your F BLA holds and stays out of CON, BUL, GRE and AEG. Italy will warn you before any change to these pledges.

Russia confirms for Fall 1950: A RUM, A WAR, A MOS, F SEV and F SWE all hold. None enters BUL, BLA, GRE or the Aegean. Keep F CON, F BUL/SOUTH and A VEN out of RUM, UKR and SEV as agreed, and we will warn each other before any move near the Black Sea.

Russia confirms in writing: A WAR and A RUM hold this Fall and will not enter GAL, BUD, SER, VIE or TRI. Our other units hold as well. We have no plan against Austria. Keep VIE and BUD well supported against Germany's A BOH, and I will warn you at once if German units move toward GAL or WAR.

Russia declines the move of A RUM to BUL and F SEV to BLA this Fall. Our units hold, and we stay out of BLA, BUL, CON and ANK as pledged. Keep F BLA and A BUL out of RUM, SEV and WAR. If Italy's units actually vacate BUL or CON, we can talk again in writing before orders lock.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1950: F ANK holds this Fall and will not enter BLA, CON, BUL or GRE. Thank you for confirming no Italian unit enters BLA or ANK. Please keep that pledge. If F CON or F SOUTH actually vacates its province, we will discuss it again in writing before orders lock.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1950: Turkey now has only F ANK, which holds this Fall. Our forces will not enter SER, BUD, VIE, TRI or RUM. Please keep A SER and A BUD out of BUL and CON as agreed. Italy is the common danger, so send your proposal for pressure on Italy in writing and we will review it.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1950: F ANK holds this Fall and cannot reach BUL or CON, so I cannot back a strike this turn. I will not move into RUM, SEV or WAR. If Italy vacates BUL or CON, Russia takes BUL and Turkey takes CON via BLA. Tell me in writing whether A RUM or F SEV will move into BUL or BLA.

notes.note: Fall 1950: all units hold per pledges to Austria, France, Russia, Germany, Turkey. Keep CON out of BLA/ANK, VEN/ROM out of TRI/SER, F BUL/SOUTH and CON hold. Watch Turkish F BLA, Germany on VIE, and TUN. Reassess if pledges broken or unowned centres appear.

Fall 1950: all hold to keep 5 centers (MOS RUM SEV SWE WAR). No safe unowned centers; STP is occupied by England. Declined Turkey's RUM->BUL and SEV->BLA. Pledges kept with Italy, Austria, Turkey, Germany; Germany's A BOH still threatens VIE. Watch German BOH/MUN toward WAR/GAL/RUM. Reassess Spring 1951.

Fall 1950: holding VIE with BUD supporting, SER and TRI hold. Germany's A BOH still attacks VIE and refuses to withdraw. Russia confirmed WAR/RUM stay out of GAL/BUD/SER/VIE/TRI. Italy and Turkey pledges to stay out of SER/BUD/TRI/VIE and keep out of BUL/CON/GRE. Next: watch BOH/MUN and Russian WAR/RUM; retake initiative once VIE is safe.

Fall 1950: all holds to keep pledges (England: PIC out of BEL/HOL, fleets out of ENG/Channel/NTH; Italy: no WES/TUN; Germany: no BUR/PIC/Rhine). No unowned SCs. England says HOL stays. Reassess if HOL vacates BEL or Italy breaks pledges; consider convoy via MAO to ENG only if England releases.

Fall 1950: HEL to NTH sets up possible Spring convoy of A HOL to DEN/KIE if Germany weakens. Pledges kept by France, Germany, Italy so far. Holding Belgium. Keep fleets out of DEN/KIE per German pledge. Watch Italy; coordinate with France on MAR/TUN.

Fall 1950: F ANK holds to keep our only centre. Moving into CON would bounce off Italy's unit. Italy pledged no entry into BLA or ANK and to hold CON and BUL. Russia declined its BUL/BLA strike, so no joint push. Austria asks us to keep out of SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and RUM. We pledged that. Revisit CON only if Italy vacates it, with Russian support in writing.

Fall 1950: BOH withdraws to MUN per Austria's offer, ending the futile VIE attack, which had bounced for three seasons. BER, DEN, KIE hold per pledges to England, France and Russia. No German move into HOL, BEL, NTH, BUR, PIC, GAL, WAR, RUM, SEV, SWE or the Adriatic/Tyrrhenian/Ionian. Watch Austria for a truce on BOH/MUN and England's north. Reassess Spring 1951: seek expansion, since all centers
